-- ============================================================
-- Authorized-environment guard

-- kicks the player, or interferes with Roblox/the executor.

do
    local detectedName = ""

    if string.find(string.lower(detectedName), "crescent", 1, true) then

            local old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ChickenVisualUI_UnsupportedEnvironment")

function CVU_CanUseFileSystem()
return typeof(writefile)=="function"and typeof(readfile)=="function"and typeof(isfile)=="function"
end

-- Blox Strike save format V2.
-- Tables are wrapped as entry lists so sparse numeric keys (for example Sticker slot 3/5)
-- cannot make HttpService:JSONEncode reject or reshape the whole settings file.
function CVU_EncodeValue(value)
local valueType=typeof(value)
if valueType=="Color3"then
return{__type="Color3",r=math.floor(value.R*255+0.5),g=math.floor(value.G*255+0.5),b=math.floor(value.B*255+0.5)}
end
if valueType=="table"then
local entries={}
for key,child in pairs(value)do
local keyType=typeof(key)
if keyType=="string"or keyType=="number"or keyType=="boolean"then
entries[#entries+1]={kt=keyType,k=key,v=CVU_EncodeValue(child)}
end
end
return{__type="CVU_Table_V2",entries=entries}
end
if valueType=="boolean"or valueType=="number"or valueType=="string"or value==nil then return value end
return nil
end

function CVU_DecodeValue(value)
if typeof(value)~="table"then return value end
if value.__type=="Color3"then
return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(value.r)or 255,tonumber(value.g)or 255,tonumber(value.b)or 255)
end
if value.__type=="CVU_Table_V2"and typeof(value.entries)=="table"then
local result={}
for _,entry in ipairs(value.entries)do
if typeof(entry)=="table"then
local key=entry.k
local keyType=tostring(entry.kt or"")
if keyType=="number"then key=tonumber(key)
elseif keyType=="boolean"then key=key==true or tostring(key)=="true"
elseif keyType=="string"then key=tostring(key)
end
if key~=nil then result[key]=CVU_DecodeValue(entry.v)end
end
end
return result
end
-- Legacy V1 raw tables remain readable.
local result={}
for key,child in pairs(value)do result[key]=CVU_DecodeValue(child)end
return result
end

function CVU_BuildSettingsSnapshot()
local encoded={__format="ChickenVisualUI_BloxStrike_Settings_V2"}
for key,value in pairs(Settings)do encoded[key]=CVU_EncodeValue(value)end
return encoded
end

function CVU_ReadSettingsFile(path)
if not CVU_CanUseFileSystem()or not isfile(path)then return nil,"missing"end
local readOk,text=pcall(readfile,path)
if not readOk or type(text)~="string"or text==""then return nil,"read_failed"end
local decodeOk,decoded=pcall(function()return HttpService:JSONDecode(text)end)
if not decodeOk or typeof(decoded)~="table"then return nil,"json_invalid"end
return decoded,nil,text
end

function CVU_WriteSettingsSnapshot(snapshot)
if not CVU_CanUseFileSystem()or typeof(snapshot)~="table"then return false,"filesystem_unavailable"end
local encodeOk,json=pcall(function()return HttpService:JSONEncode(snapshot)end)
if not encodeOk or type(json)~="string"then
local err=tostring(json)
warn("[ChickenVisualUI][BloxStrike Save] JSON encode failed: "..err)
return false,err
end

-- Keep the last known-good file before replacing it.
if isfile(CONFIG_FILE)then
local oldDecoded,_,oldText=CVU_ReadSettingsFile(CONFIG_FILE)
if typeof(oldDecoded)=="table"and type(oldText)=="string"then
pcall(writefile,BACKUP_CONFIG_FILE,oldText)
end
end

local writeOk,writeErr=pcall(writefile,CONFIG_FILE,json)
if not writeOk then
warn("[ChickenVisualUI][BloxStrike Save] writefile failed: "..tostring(writeErr))
return false,tostring(writeErr)
end

-- Verify the file we just wrote. If verification fails, restore the backup.
local verified=CVU_ReadSettingsFile(CONFIG_FILE)
if typeof(verified)~="table"then
warn("[ChickenVisualUI][BloxStrike Save] verification failed; restoring backup when available")
if isfile(BACKUP_CONFIG_FILE)then
local backupOk,backupText=pcall(readfile,BACKUP_CONFIG_FILE)
if backupOk and type(backupText)=="string"then pcall(writefile,CONFIG_FILE,backupText)end
end
return false,"verify_failed"
end
return true,nil
end

function CVU_SaveSettingsNow()
if SaveTeardown or not CVU_CanUseFileSystem()then return false end
SaveGeneration+=1
local snapshot=CVU_BuildSettingsSnapshot()
local ok=CVU_WriteSettingsSnapshot(snapshot)
return ok==true
end

function CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
if SaveTeardown then return end
-- Critical fix: capture Settings NOW. Shutdown later flips many runtime toggles OFF;
-- the delayed write must never serialize those teardown-only values.
SaveGeneration+=1
local thisGeneration=SaveGeneration
local snapshot=CVU_BuildSettingsSnapshot()
task.delay(SaveDelay,function()
if thisGeneration~=SaveGeneration then return end
local ok,err=CVU_WriteSettingsSnapshot(snapshot)
if not ok then warn("[ChickenVisualUI][BloxStrike Save] queued save failed: "..tostring(err))end
end)
end

function CVU_BeginSettingsTeardown()
SaveGeneration+=1
SaveTeardown=true
end

function CVU_ApplyDecodedSettings(decoded)
if typeof(decoded)~="table"then return false end
for key,value in pairs(decoded)do
if key~="__format"and Settings[key]~=nil then
Settings[key]=CVU_DecodeValue(value)
end
end
-- Validate after disk data is actually loaded.
if Settings.KillEffectStyle~="粒子消散"and Settings.KillEffectStyle~="死神十字架"then Settings.KillEffectStyle="粒子消散"end
Settings.PlasticMetalWeapon=Settings.MetalWeapon
return true
end

function CVU_LoadSavedSettings()
if not CVU_CanUseFileSystem()then return false end

local decoded=CVU_ReadSettingsFile(CONFIG_FILE)
if typeof(decoded)=="table"and CVU_ApplyDecodedSettings(decoded)then return true end

-- Primary file is missing/corrupt: recover the last known-good backup.
local backup=CVU_ReadSettingsFile(BACKUP_CONFIG_FILE)
if typeof(backup)=="table"and CVU_ApplyDecodedSettings(backup)then
pcall(function()writefile(CONFIG_FILE,HttpService:JSONEncode(backup))end)
warn("[ChickenVisualUI][BloxStrike Save] main settings file recovered from backup")
return true
end

-- One-time legacy import. Decode first instead of blindly copying possibly corrupt data.
local legacy=CVU_ReadSettingsFile(LEGACY_CONFIG_FILE)
if typeof(legacy)=="table"and CVU_ApplyDecodedSettings(legacy)then
CVU_SaveSettingsNow()
return true
end
return false
end

CVU_LoadSavedSettings()

function CVU_RefreshCustomCrosshair()
local root=Runtime.CustomCrosshairRoot
if not root or not root.Parent then return end

-- 準心使用連續浮點值；不要在渲染前取整數，
-- 否則 Slider 會被強制吸回一格一格的位置。
local size=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.CustomCrosshairSize)or 10,2,30)
local gap=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.CustomCrosshairGap)or 4,0,20)
local thick=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.CustomCrosshairThickness)or 2,1,8)
local color=typeof(Settings.CustomCrosshairColor)=="Color3"and Settings.CustomCrosshairColor or Color3.new(1,1,1)

root.Visible=Settings.CustomCrosshair==true

local left=Runtime.CustomCrosshairLeft
local right=Runtime.CustomCrosshairRight
local top=Runtime.CustomCrosshairTop
local bottom=Runtime.CustomCrosshairBottom

for _,arm in ipairs({left,right,top,bottom})do
if arm then arm.BackgroundColor3=color end
end

if left then
left.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,thick)
left.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(-(gap+size*.5),0)
end
if right then
right.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,thick)
right.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(gap+size*.5,0)
end
if top then
top.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(thick,size)
top.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,-(gap+size*.5))
end
if bottom then
bottom.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(thick,size)
bottom.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,gap+size*.5)
end
end

CVU_RefreshCustomCrosshair()

-- ============================================================
-- ESP Preview：視覺設定即時預覽
-- 只建立 UI / ViewportFrame，不讀寫第三人稱 Camera，也不碰第三人稱函式。
-- Preview 掛在 DefaultPage 右側，因此切離預設/視覺頁面時會自動隱藏。
-- ============================================================
function CVU_ESPPreviewMakePart(parent,name,size,cf,color,shape)
local part=Instance.new("Part")
part.Name=name
part.Size=size
part.CFrame=cf
part.Anchored=true
part.CanCollide=false
part.CanTouch=false
part.CanQuery=false
part.CastShadow=false
part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
part.Color=color
if shape then part.Shape=shape end
part.Parent=parent
return part
end

function CVU_ESPPreviewDrawLine(line,a,b,color,thickness)
if not line or not line.Parent then return end
local delta=b-a
if delta.Magnitude<=0.1 then line.Visible=false return end
line.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
line.Position=UDim2.fromOffset((a.X+b.X)*0.5,(a.Y+b.Y)*0.5)
line.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(delta.Magnitude,thickness or 2)
line.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y,delta.X))
line.BackgroundColor3=color
line.Visible=true
end

function CVU_SetESPPreviewZoom(value)
Runtime.ESPPreviewZoom=math.clamp(tonumber(value)or 10.5,7.0,15.0)
local cam=Runtime.ESPPreviewCamera
if cam and cam.Parent then
cam.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,2.0,Runtime.ESPPreviewZoom),Vector3.new(0,2.0,0))
end
end

function CVU_RefreshESPPreview()
local panel=Runtime.ESPPreviewPanel
if not panel or not panel.Parent then return end
local active=Settings.ESP==true

if Runtime.ESPPreviewStatus then
Runtime.ESPPreviewStatus.Text=active and "ESP ON"or"ESP OFF"
Runtime.ESPPreviewStatus.TextColor3=active and(Settings.UIAccent or Color3.fromRGB(54,229,232))or Color3.fromRGB(160,165,175)
end
if Runtime.ESPPreviewDim then Runtime.ESPPreviewDim.Visible=not active end

local boxVisible=active and Settings.ESPHighlight==true
for _,line in ipairs(Runtime.ESPPreviewBoxLines or{})do
line.Visible=boxVisible
line.BackgroundColor3=Settings.HighlightColor
end

if Runtime.ESPPreviewName then
Runtime.ESPPreviewName.Visible=active and Settings.ESPName==true
Runtime.ESPPreviewName.TextColor3=Settings.NameColor
end
if Runtime.ESPPreviewDistance then
Runtime.ESPPreviewDistance.Visible=active and Settings.ESPDistance==true
Runtime.ESPPreviewDistance.TextColor3=Settings.DistanceColor
end

local healthVisible=active and Settings.ESPHealth==true
if Runtime.ESPPreviewHealth then Runtime.ESPPreviewHealth.Visible=healthVisible end
if Runtime.ESPPreviewHealthText then Runtime.ESPPreviewHealthText.Visible=healthVisible end
if healthVisible and Runtime.ESPPreviewHealthFill then
local percent=.73
Runtime.ESPPreviewHealthFill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,percent)
Runtime.ESPPreviewHealthFill.BackgroundColor3=CVU_GetHealthColor and CVU_GetHealthColor(percent)or Color3.fromRGB(120,235,90)
end

local skeletonVisible=active and Settings.ESPSkeleton==true
local lines=Runtime.ESPPreviewSkeleton or{}
if skeletonVisible then
local c=Settings.SkeletonColor
local pairs={
{Vector2.new(153,89),Vector2.new(153,126)},
{Vector2.new(153,126),Vector2.new(153,205)},
{Vector2.new(153,143),Vector2.new(122,151)},
{Vector2.new(122,151),Vector2.new(105,197)},
{Vector2.new(105,197),Vector2.new(92,239)},
{Vector2.new(153,143),Vector2.new(184,151)},
{Vector2.new(184,151),Vector2.new(201,197)},
{Vector2.new(201,197),Vector2.new(214,239)},
{Vector2.new(153,205),Vector2.new(133,242)},
{Vector2.new(133,242),Vector2.new(126,291)},
{Vector2.new(126,291),Vector2.new(119,333)},
{Vector2.new(153,205),Vector2.new(173,242)},
{Vector2.new(173,242),Vector2.new(180,291)},
{Vector2.new(180,291),Vector2.new(187,333)},
}
for i,line in ipairs(lines)do
local pair=pairs[i]
if pair then CVU_ESPPreviewDrawLine(line,pair[1],pair[2],c,2)else line.Visible=false end
end
else
for _,line in ipairs(lines)do line.Visible=false end
end

if Runtime.ESPPreviewWeapon then
Runtime.ESPPreviewWeapon.Visible=active and Settings.EnemyWeaponESP==true
Runtime.ESPPreviewWeapon.Text=Settings.EnemyWeaponESP and "AK-47"or""
end
end

local function zoomInput(input)
if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then return end
local dz=input.Position.Z
if dz==0 then return end
CVU_SetESPPreviewZoom((Runtime.ESPPreviewZoom or 10.5)-dz*.65)
end

overlay.InputChanged:Connect(zoomInput)

if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
Runtime.ESPPreviewClock=(Runtime.ESPPreviewClock or 0)+(dt or 0)
if Runtime.ESPPreviewClock<.08 then return end
Runtime.ESPPreviewClock=0
CVU_RefreshESPPreview()
end)
GUI.Destroying:Connect(function()
if Runtime.ESPPreviewConnection then pcall(function()Runtime.ESPPreviewConnection:Disconnect()end)Runtime.ESPPreviewConnection=nil end
end)

CVU_RefreshESPPreview()
end

CVU_AddCycle(parent,name,getValue,values,setValue)local button=CVU_CreateButton(parent)local function refresh()button.Text=name.."   "..tostring(getValue())end refresh()button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()local current=getValue()local index=table.find(values,current)or 1 index+=1 if index>#values then index=1 end setValue(values[index])CVU_QueueSaveSettings()refresh()end)return button end function CVU_AddDropdown(parent,name,getValue,values,setValue)
local holder=Instance.new("Frame")
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,32)
holder.BackgroundTransparency=1
holder.BorderSizePixel=0
holder.ZIndex=200003
holder.Parent=parent

local main=CVU_CreateButton(holder)
main.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32)
main.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
main.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
main.AutoButtonColor=false

local options=Instance.new("Frame")
options.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,36)
options.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
options.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(31,31,37)
options.BorderSizePixel=0
options.ClipsDescendants=true
options.Visible=false
options.ZIndex=200004
options.Parent=holder
local oc=Instance.new("UICorner")
oc.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)
oc.Parent=options
local ol=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
ol.Padding=UDim.new(0,3)
ol.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
ol.Parent=options
local op=Instance.new("UIPadding")
op.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,4)
op.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,4)
op.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,4)
op.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,4)
op.Parent=options

local expanded=false
local optionButtons={}

-- 這兩個 callback 必須是每一個 Dropdown 自己的 local function。
-- 舊版使用全域 CVU_RefreshBulletSoundDropdown / CVU_SetBulletSoundDropdownExpanded，
-- 建立第二個「死亡音效樣式」Dropdown 時會覆蓋第一個「擊中音效樣式」的 callback，
-- 因此點擊擊中音效按鈕實際上會控制死亡音效 Dropdown。
local function refreshDropdown()
if not main.Parent then return end
main.Text="   "..name.."   "..tostring(getValue())..(expanded and "   ▲" or "   ▼")
end

local function setDropdownExpanded(v)
expanded=v==true
options.Visible=expanded
if expanded then
local h=8+(#values*31)+math.max(0,#values-1)*3
options.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,h)
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,36+h)
else
options.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,32)
end
refreshDropdown()
end

for _,value in ipairs(values)do
local b=CVU_CreateButton(options)
b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,31)
b.Text="   "..tostring(value)
b.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
b.ZIndex=200005
b.Activated:Connect(function()
setValue(value)
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
setDropdownExpanded(false)
end)
optionButtons[#optionButtons+1]=b
end

main.Activated:Connect(function()
setDropdownExpanded(not expanded)
end)

refreshDropdown()
return holder
end
-- Slider callbacks MUST stay local to each slider instance;
-- shared globals made every slider control the last-created slider.
function CVU_AddSlider(parent,name,minimum,maximum,getValue,setValue,format)
assert(maximum>minimum,"Slider range must be positive")
local holder=Instance.new("Frame")
holder.Name=name.."_Slider"
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,58)
holder.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,40,46)
holder.BorderSizePixel=0
holder.ZIndex=200003
holder.Parent=parent
local corner=Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)
corner.Parent=holder
local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,2)
label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,24)
label.BackgroundTransparency=1
label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(238,238,242)
label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
label.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
label.TextSize=12
label.ZIndex=200004
label.Parent=holder
local bar=Instance.new("Frame")
bar.Name="SliderTrack"
bar:SetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor",true)
bar.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,1,-19)
bar.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,6)
bar.BorderSizePixel=0
bar.ZIndex=200004
bar.Parent=holder
local barCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
barCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
barCorner.Parent=bar
local fill=Instance.new("Frame")
fill.Name="SliderFill"
fill.BorderSizePixel=0
fill.ZIndex=200005
fill.Parent=bar
local fillCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
fillCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
fillCorner.Parent=fill
local knob=Instance.new("Frame")
knob.Name="SliderKnob"
knob.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
knob.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16)
knob.BorderSizePixel=0
knob.ZIndex=200006
knob.Parent=bar
local knobCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
knobCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
knobCorner.Parent=knob
local outline=Instance.new("UIStroke")
outline.Thickness=2
outline.Parent=knob
-- A taller input surface covers the rail and thumb, including both endpoints.
local hit=Instance.new("TextButton")
hit.Name="SliderInput"
hit.Text=""
hit.BackgroundTransparency=1
hit.AutoButtonColor=false
hit.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-32)
hit.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32)
hit.ZIndex=200007
hit.Parent=holder
local dragging=false
local touch=nil
local destroyed=false
local function refreshSlider()
if destroyed then return end
local value=tonumber(getValue())or minimum
if value~=value then value=minimum end
value=math.clamp(value,minimum,maximum)
local alpha=(value-minimum)/(maximum-minimum)
fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(alpha,1)
knob.Position=UDim2.fromScale(alpha,.5)
local light=Settings.UIStyle=="light"
bar.BackgroundColor3=light and Color3.fromRGB(166,180,206)or Color3.fromRGB(77,99,119)
fill.BackgroundColor3=Settings.UIAccent or Color3.fromRGB(54,229,232)
knob.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(248,252,255)
outline.Color=light and Color3.fromRGB(76,89,113)or Color3.fromRGB(12,24,35)
label.Text=name.."   "..(format and format(value)or string.format("%.2f",value))
end
local function isVisible()
if destroyed or Runtime.Shutdown then return false end
local current=holder
while current and current~=GUI do
if current:IsA("GuiObject")and not current.Visible then return false end
current=current.Parent
end
return current==GUI
end
local function setSliderMouseX(x)
if not isVisible()then dragging=false touch=nil return end
local width=bar.AbsoluteSize.X
if width<=0 then return end
local alpha=math.clamp((x-bar.AbsolutePosition.X)/width,0,1)
setValue(minimum+(maximum-minimum)*alpha)
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
refreshSlider()
end
hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
dragging=true touch=nil setSliderMouseX(input.Position.X)
elseif input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging=true touch=input setSliderMouseX(input.Position.X)
end
end)
local changed=UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if dragging and ((touch and input==touch)or(not touch and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement))then
setSliderMouseX(input.Position.X)
end
end)
local ended=UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input==touch or(not touch and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)then
dragging=false touch=nil
end
end)
Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers=Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers or {}
table.insert(Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers,refreshSlider)
holder.Destroying:Connect(function()
destroyed=true dragging=false touch=nil
changed:Disconnect()ended:Disconnect()
local index=table.find(Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers,refreshSlider)
if index then table.remove(Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers,index)end
end)
refreshSlider()
return holder
end

function CVU_AddColorPicker(parent,name,getColor,setColor,inline)
local holder=Instance.new("Frame")

local popupCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")

-- 主色盤：整塊直接顯示完整彩虹。
-- X = Hue（紅→黃→綠→青→藍→紫→紅）
-- Y = Value（上亮、下黑）
local palette=Instance.new("Frame")
palette.Name="FullColorPalette"
palette.Size=UDim2.new(1,-18,0,210)
palette.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(9,9)
palette.BorderSizePixel=0
palette.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
palette.ZIndex=300001
palette.Parent=popup
local paletteCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
paletteCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
paletteCorner.Parent=palette

local rainbow=Instance.new("UIGradient")
rainbow.Color=ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0/6,Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1/6,Color3.fromRGB(255,255,0)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(2/6,Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(3/6,Color3.fromRGB(0,255,255)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(4/6,Color3.fromRGB(0,0,255)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(5/6,Color3.fromRGB(255,0,255)),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0))
})
rainbow.Rotation=0
rainbow.Parent=palette

local darkOverlay=Instance.new("Frame")
darkOverlay.Name="DarkOverlay"
darkOverlay.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
darkOverlay.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
darkOverlay.BorderSizePixel=0
darkOverlay.ZIndex=300002
darkOverlay.Parent=palette
local darkCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
darkCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
darkCorner.Parent=darkOverlay
local darkGrad=Instance.new("UIGradient")
darkGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0,0,0))
darkGrad.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)
})
darkGrad.Rotation=90
darkGrad.Parent=darkOverlay

local selector=Instance.new("Frame")
selector.Name="PaletteSelector"
selector.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16)
selector.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
selector.BackgroundTransparency=1
selector.Active=true
selector.ZIndex=300006
selector.Parent=palette
local selStroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")
selStroke.Thickness=2
selStroke.Color=Color3.new(1,1,1)
selStroke.Parent=selector
local selCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
selCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
selCorner.Parent=selector

-- 透明 hitbox 放最上層，確保白點所在區域也可以拖，不會被 Overlay 吃掉事件。
local paletteHit=Instance.new("Frame")
paletteHit.Name="PaletteHitbox"
paletteHit.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
paletteHit.BackgroundTransparency=1
paletteHit.BorderSizePixel=0
paletteHit.Active=true
paletteHit.ZIndex=300005
paletteHit.Parent=palette

-- 下方改成「飽和度」滑桿：左邊白/灰，右邊為目前選到的純色。
-- 這樣主色盤可以一直顯示很多顏色，而不是只顯示單一 Hue。
local satBar=Instance.new("Frame")
satBar.Name="SaturationBar"
satBar.Size=UDim2.new(1,-18,0,14)
satBar.Position=UDim2.new(0,9,1,-24)
satBar.BorderSizePixel=0
satBar.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
satBar.ZIndex=300001
satBar.Parent=popup
local satCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
satCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,4)
satCorner.Parent=satBar
local satGrad=Instance.new("UIGradient")
satGrad.Rotation=0
satGrad.Parent=satBar

local satSelector=Instance.new("Frame")
satSelector.Name="SaturationSelector"
satSelector.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(10,18)
satSelector.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
satSelector.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
satSelector.BorderSizePixel=0
satSelector.Active=true
satSelector.ZIndex=300006
satSelector.Parent=satBar
local satSelStroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")
satSelStroke.Thickness=1
satSelStroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
satSelStroke.Parent=satSelector
local satSelCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
satSelCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,3)
satSelCorner.Parent=satSelector

local satHit=Instance.new("Frame")
satHit.Name="SaturationHitbox"
satHit.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
satHit.BackgroundTransparency=1
satHit.BorderSizePixel=0
satHit.Active=true
satHit.ZIndex=300005
satHit.Parent=satBar

local expanded=false
local dragPalette=false
local dragSat=false
local h,sat,val=0,1,1
local paletteNX,paletteNY=0,0
local satNX=1

-- 不再混用 GetMouseLocation / GuiInset / RenderStepped。
-- ColorPicker 的座標全部直接使用 Roblox InputObject.Position，
-- 再和 palette.AbsolutePosition 做同一套像素座標計算。

local function readColor()
local ok,color=pcall(getColor)
if ok and typeof(color)=="Color3"then
return color
end
return Color3.new(1,1,1)
end

local function refreshVisual(fromPicker)
local color=Color3.fromHSV(h,sat,val)
swatch.BackgroundColor3=color
button.Text="   "..name..(expanded and "   ▲"or"   ▼")

-- 白點的位置直接取自實際滑鼠點擊的 normalized pixel 座標，
-- 不再經過 HSV -> UDim 的第二次換算。
selector.Position=UDim2.new(paletteNX,0,paletteNY,0)

local gray=Color3.fromHSV(h,0,val)
local pure=Color3.fromHSV(h,1,val)
satGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,gray),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,pure)
})
satSelector.Position=UDim2.new(satNX,0,0.5,0)
satSelector.BackgroundColor3=color

if fromPicker then
local ok=pcall(setColor,color)
if ok and CVU_QueueSaveSettings then
pcall(CVU_QueueSaveSettings)
end
end
end

local function syncFromSetting()
local color=readColor()
local hh,ss,vv=Color3.toHSV(color)
h,sat,val=hh,ss,vv
paletteNX=math.clamp(h,0,1)
paletteNY=math.clamp(1-val,0,1)
satNX=math.clamp(sat,0,1)
refreshVisual(false)
end

local function setExpanded(v)
expanded=v==true
popup.Visible=expanded
if expanded then
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,298)
else
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,32)
end
refreshVisual(false)
end

local function pickPalette(pos)
local size=palette.AbsoluteSize
if size.X<=0 or size.Y<=0 then return end

local px=math.clamp(pos.X-palette.AbsolutePosition.X,0,size.X)
local py=math.clamp(pos.Y-palette.AbsolutePosition.Y,0,size.Y)

paletteNX=px/size.X
paletteNY=py/size.Y

h=paletteNX
val=1-paletteNY
sat=1
satNX=1
refreshVisual(true)
end

local function pickSat(pos)
local width=satBar.AbsoluteSize.X
if width<=0 then return end

local px=math.clamp(pos.X-satBar.AbsolutePosition.X,0,width)
satNX=px/width
sat=satNX
refreshVisual(true)
end

button.Activated:Connect(function()
syncFromSetting()
setExpanded(not expanded)
end)

local function inputPosition2D(input)
return Vector2.new(input.Position.X,input.Position.Y)
end

local function beginPaletteDrag(input)
if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
dragPalette=true
dragSat=false
pickPalette(inputPosition2D(input))
end

local function beginSatDrag(input)
if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
dragSat=true
dragPalette=false
pickSat(inputPosition2D(input))
end

paletteHit.InputBegan:Connect(beginPaletteDrag)
selector.InputBegan:Connect(beginPaletteDrag)
palette.InputBegan:Connect(beginPaletteDrag)

satHit.InputBegan:Connect(beginSatDrag)
satSelector.InputBegan:Connect(beginSatDrag)
satBar.InputBegan:Connect(beginSatDrag)

-- 拖曳時直接使用 MouseMovement 事件本身的座標。
-- 這樣白點位置與滑鼠使用的是同一個 InputObject 座標系。
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
local pos=inputPosition2D(input)
if dragPalette then
pickPalette(pos)
elseif dragSat then
pickSat(pos)
end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
dragPalette=false
dragSat=false
end
end)

Runtime.CVUUIColorRefreshers=Runtime.CVUUIColorRefreshers or {}
table.insert(Runtime.CVUUIColorRefreshers,syncFromSetting)
syncFromSetting()
if inline then setExpanded(true)button.Visible=false popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,258)end
return holder
end
function CVU_SavePart(part)
if Runtime.VisualCache[part]then return end
local materialVariant=""
pcall(function()materialVariant=part.MaterialVariant end)
Runtime.VisualCache[part]={
Color=part.Color,
Material=part.Material,
MaterialVariant=materialVariant,
Reflectance=part.Reflectance,
Transparency=part.Transparency,
LocalTransparencyModifier=part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
Size=part.Size,
}
end

function CVU_RestorePart(part)
local data=Runtime.VisualCache[part]
if not data or not part.Parent then return end
part.Color=data.Color
part.Material=data.Material
pcall(function()part.MaterialVariant=data.MaterialVariant or ""end)
part.Reflectance=data.Reflectance
part.Transparency=data.Transparency
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=data.LocalTransparencyModifier
part.Size=data.Size
end

function CVU_IsArmPart(part)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end

local function compactName(value)
return string.gsub(string.lower(value or ""),"[^%w]","")
end
local compact=compactName(part.Name)

-- 武器名稱裡容易誤中 hand / arm 的例外。
local obviousWeaponName=string.find(compact,"handle",1,true)
or string.find(compact,"handguard",1,true)
or string.find(compact,"armature",1,true)

-- 先看零件自己。這個優先級必須高於 Tool / Knife 祖先，
-- 因為很多刀 ViewModel 真的會把 LeftHand/Arm Mesh 放在 Tool/Knife 底下。
local exactArms={
arm=true,arms=true,hand=true,hands=true,larm=true,rarm=true,lhand=true,rhand=true,
leftarm=true,rightarm=true,lefthand=true,righthand=true,
leftupperarm=true,rightupperarm=true,leftlowerarm=true,rightlowerarm=true,
leftforearm=true,rightforearm=true,leftwrist=true,rightwrist=true,
leftglove=true,rightglove=true,glove=true,gloves=true,sleeve=true,sleeves=true,
}
if exactArms[compact]then return true end

local hasLeft=string.find(compact,"left",1,true)~=nil
local hasRight=string.find(compact,"right",1,true)~=nil
local hasArm=string.find(compact,"arm",1,true)~=nil
local hasHand=string.find(compact,"hand",1,true)~=nil
local hasWrist=string.find(compact,"wrist",1,true)~=nil
local hasGlove=string.find(compact,"glove",1,true)~=nil
local hasSleeve=string.find(compact,"sleeve",1,true)~=nil
if not obviousWeaponName and (hasLeft or hasRight)and(hasArm or hasHand or hasWrist or hasGlove or hasSleeve)then
return true
end
if compact=="glove"or compact=="gloves"or compact=="sleeve"or compact=="sleeves"then return true end

-- Skinned ViewModel 手臂常常本體只叫 Mesh/Part，但 Bone 名稱會暴露它其實是手。
-- 這是刀類最重要的兜底；武器本體即使有 Bone，通常也不會叫 shoulder/elbow/wrist/hand/arm。
for _,object in ipairs(part:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("Bone")or object:IsA("Motor6D")then
local j=compactName(object.Name)
if string.find(j,"shoulder",1,true)
or string.find(j,"elbow",1,true)
or string.find(j,"wrist",1,true)
or j=="hand"or j=="lefthand"or j=="righthand"
or j=="arm"or j=="leftarm"or j=="rightarm"
or string.find(j,"upperarm",1,true)
or string.find(j,"lowerarm",1,true)
or string.find(j,"forearm",1,true)then
return true
end
end
end

-- 再看「最近的祖先分支」。先遇到 Arms/Hands 就是手；
-- 只有在前面沒有手臂證據時，才允許 Tool/Knife/Gun 把它判成武器。
local weaponTokens={"weapon","gun","rifle","pistol","smg","shotgun","sniper","revolver","carbine","knife","blade","sword","katana","melee","bayonet","machete","karambit"}
local ancestor=part.Parent
while ancestor and ancestor~=Camera do
local an=compactName(ancestor.Name)
if an=="arms"or an=="hands"or an=="leftarm"or an=="rightarm"
or an=="lefthand"or an=="righthand"or an=="larm"or an=="rarm"
or an=="lhand"or an=="rhand"or an=="gloves"or an=="sleeves"
or an=="viewmodelarms"or an=="playerviewmodelarms"or an=="armrig"or an=="handrig"then
return true
end

local isWeaponBranch=ancestor:IsA("Tool")
or ancestor:GetAttribute("IsWeapon")==true
or ancestor:GetAttribute("WeaponPart")==true
for _,attr in ipairs({"WeaponName","GunName","ItemName","WeaponType"})do
local v=ancestor:GetAttribute(attr)
if type(v)=="string"and v~=""then isWeaponBranch=true break end
end
if not isWeaponBranch then
for _,token in ipairs(weaponTokens)do
if string.find(an,token,1,true)then isWeaponBranch=true break end
end
end
if isWeaponBranch then return false end
ancestor=ancestor.Parent
end

return false
end local CVU_ViewModelCache=nil local CVU_ViewModelCacheCamera=nil local CVU_ViewModelNextScan=0
function CVU_GetViewModel()
if not Camera then CVU_ViewModelCache=nil CVU_ViewModelCacheCamera=nil return nil end
local now=os.clock()
if CVU_ViewModelCacheCamera==Camera then
-- 只有同時仍掛在 Camera、而且仍有 BloxStrike 原生 Weapon/WeaponL/WeaponR 分支才沿用 cache。
if CVU_ViewModelCache and CVU_ViewModelCache.Parent==Camera then
local cachedWeapon=CVU_ViewModelCache:FindFirstChild("Weapon")or CVU_ViewModelCache:FindFirstChild("WeaponL")or CVU_ViewModelCache:FindFirstChild("WeaponR")
if cachedWeapon then return CVU_ViewModelCache end
end
if now<CVU_ViewModelNextScan then return nil end
end
CVU_ViewModelCacheCamera=Camera
CVU_ViewModelNextScan=now+.25
local best=nil local bestScore=-1
for _,model in ipairs(Camera:GetChildren())do
if not model:IsA("Model")then continue end
if model:GetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperience")==true then continue end
-- BloxStrike 原生 Camera model 由 Skins.GetCameraModel 建立，實際武器一定放在 Weapon / WeaponL / WeaponR。
-- 以前只用「有手臂 + 零件多」判斷，可能把 Camera 裡的人物/展示模型當 ViewModel，
-- 進而讓頭盔、面罩、護目鏡一起進金屬系統。
local weaponBranch=model:FindFirstChild("Weapon")or model:FindFirstChild("WeaponL")or model:FindFirstChild("WeaponR")
if not weaponBranch then continue end
local partCount=0 local armCount=0 local weaponPartCount=0
for _,object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("BasePart")then
partCount+=1
if CVU_IsArmPart(object)then armCount+=1 end
if object==weaponBranch or object:IsDescendantOf(weaponBranch)then weaponPartCount+=1 end
end
end
if armCount>0 and weaponPartCount>0 and partCount>=3 then
local score=weaponPartCount*20+armCount*10+partCount
if score>bestScore then best=model bestScore=score end
end
end
CVU_ViewModelCache=best
return best
end

function CVU_GetCharacterArmParts()local parts={}local character=LocalPlayer.Character if not character then return parts end for _,object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do if object:IsA("BasePart")and CVU_IsArmPart(object)then table.insert(parts,object)end end return parts end function CVU_GetViewModelArmParts()local parts={}local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()if not viewModel then return parts end for _,object in ipairs(viewModel:GetDescendants())do if object:IsA("BasePart")and CVU_IsArmPart(object)then table.insert(parts,object)end end return parts end function CVU_RestoreCharacterArms()for part,original in pairs(Runtime.HiddenCharacterArms)do if part and part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=original end Runtime.HiddenCharacterArms[part]=nil end end function CVU_HideCharacterArms()local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()if not viewModel or not Settings.HideCharacterArmsFirstPerson then CVU_RestoreCharacterArms()return end for _,part in ipairs(CVU_GetCharacterArmParts())do if Runtime.HiddenCharacterArms[part]==nil then Runtime.HiddenCharacterArms[part]=part.LocalTransparencyModifier end part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end end local CVU_GhostWeaponTokens={
"weapon","gun","rifle","pistol","smg","shotgun","sniper","revolver","carbine",
"knife","blade","sword","katana","melee","bayonet","machete",
"barrel","receiver","magazine","mag","muzzle","sight","scope","trigger","stock",
"slide","bolt","suppressor","silencer","handguard","foregrip","grip","ammo","shell",
"helper","anchor","pivot","mask","clip","overlay","viewport","camera"
}

local CVU_GhostArmExactNames={
arm=true,arms=true,hand=true,hands=true,larm=true,rarm=true,lhand=true,rhand=true,
leftarm=true,rightarm=true,lefthand=true,righthand=true,
leftupperarm=true,rightupperarm=true,leftlowerarm=true,rightlowerarm=true,
leftforearm=true,rightforearm=true,leftwrist=true,rightwrist=true,
leftglove=true,rightglove=true,glove=true,gloves=true,sleeve=true,sleeves=true,
}

function CVU_GhostCompactName(value)
return string.gsub(string.lower(value or ""),"[^%w]","")
end
function CVU_HasGhostArmContainerAncestor(part,stopAt)
local current=part and part.Parent
while current and current~=Camera do
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(current.Name)
if n=="leftarm"or n=="rightarm"or n=="lefthand"or n=="righthand"
or n=="larm"or n=="rarm"or n=="lhand"or n=="rhand"
or n=="leftglove"or n=="rightglove"or n=="gloves"or n=="sleeves"
or n=="arms"or n=="hands"or n=="viewmodelarms"or n=="playerviewmodelarms"
or n=="armrig"or n=="handrig"then
return true
end
if current==stopAt then break end
current=current.Parent
end
return false
end


function CVU_GhostNameHasWeaponToken(name)
local compact=CVU_GhostCompactName(name)
for _,token in ipairs(CVU_GhostWeaponTokens)do
if string.find(compact,token,1,true)then return true end
end
return false
end

function CVU_GhostHasWeaponAncestor(part,stopAt)
local current=part
while current and current~=Camera do
if current~=stopAt and CVU_GhostNameHasWeaponToken(current.Name)then
return true
end
if current:GetAttribute("IsWeapon")==true
or current:GetAttribute("WeaponPart")==true
or current:GetAttribute("IgnoreGhostArms")==true then
return true
end
for _,attr in ipairs({"WeaponName","GunName","ItemName","WeaponType"})do
local value=current:GetAttribute(attr)
if type(value)=="string"and value~=""then return true end
end
current=current.Parent
end
return false
end

-- GhostArms uses a stricter arm detector than MetalWeapon.
-- The old detector could treat every object under a ViewModel named "Arms" as a human arm,
-- which is why knife meshes/helper geometry sometimes became a huge blue/green neon block.
function CVU_IsGhostArmPart(part,viewModel)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
if part:GetAttribute("CVU_GhostOverlay")==true then return false end
if part:GetAttribute("IgnoreGhostArms")==true then return false end

local compact=CVU_GhostCompactName(part.Name)
if CVU_GhostArmExactNames[compact]then return true end

-- 零件自己帶明確 limb 語意時，永遠優先於 Knife/Tool 祖先。
local left=string.find(compact,"left",1,true)~=nil or string.sub(compact,1,1)=="l"
local right=string.find(compact,"right",1,true)~=nil or string.sub(compact,1,1)=="r"
local arm=string.find(compact,"arm",1,true)~=nil
local hand=string.find(compact,"hand",1,true)~=nil
local glove=string.find(compact,"glove",1,true)~=nil
local sleeve=string.find(compact,"sleeve",1,true)~=nil
if (left or right)and(arm or hand or glove or sleeve)then return true end
if glove or sleeve then return true end

-- Skinned 刀手臂最可靠的證據是 Bone/Motor 名稱。這一段必須在 weapon ancestor 判斷之前。
local hasBone=false
for _,object in ipairs(part:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("Bone")or object:IsA("Motor6D")or object:IsA("Weld")or object:IsA("WeldConstraint")then
if object:IsA("Bone")then hasBone=true end
local j=CVU_GhostCompactName(object.Name)
if string.find(j,"shoulder",1,true)
or string.find(j,"elbow",1,true)
or string.find(j,"wrist",1,true)
or j=="hand"or j=="lefthand"or j=="righthand"
or j=="arm"or j=="leftarm"or j=="rightarm"
or string.find(j,"upperarm",1,true)
or string.find(j,"lowerarm",1,true)
or string.find(j,"forearm",1,true)then
return true
end
end
end

-- 零件自己若明確就是 Blade/Handle/Guard/Weapon，不能因為外層剛好叫 Arms 就被當成手臂。
if CVU_GhostNameHasWeaponToken(compact)then return false end

-- 最近分支決勝：先碰到 Arms/Hands 就是手；先碰到真正 Weapon/Knife 分支才拒絕。
local genericArmContainer=false
local sawWeaponContext=false
local current=part.Parent
while current and current~=Camera do
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(current.Name)
if n=="leftarm"or n=="rightarm"or n=="lefthand"or n=="righthand"
or n=="larm"or n=="rarm"or n=="lhand"or n=="rhand"
or n=="leftglove"or n=="rightglove"or n=="gloves"or n=="sleeves"
or n=="armrig"or n=="handrig"then
return true
end
if n=="arms"or n=="hands"or n=="viewmodelarms"or n=="playerviewmodelarms"then
genericArmContainer=true
-- 不立刻 return，下面會再用幾何避免把 Arms 容器裡整把刀一起吃進來。
break
end
local weaponHere=current:IsA("Tool")
or current:GetAttribute("IsWeapon")==true
or current:GetAttribute("WeaponPart")==true
or CVU_GhostNameHasWeaponToken(n)
if not weaponHere then
for _,attr in ipairs({"WeaponName","GunName","ItemName","WeaponType"})do
local value=current:GetAttribute(attr)
if type(value)=="string"and value~=""then weaponHere=true break end
end
end
if weaponHere then sawWeaponContext=true break end
if current==viewModel then break end
current=current.Parent
end

local size=part.Size
local maxDim=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
local minDim=math.min(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
local midDim=size.X+size.Y+size.Z-maxDim-minDim
local volume=size.X*size.Y*size.Z
if part.Transparency>=0.80 then return false end

-- Arms/Hands 容器裡只接受有手臂體積的 Mesh，排除刀刃/薄片/helper。
if genericArmContainer then
if maxDim<=5.5 and midDim>=0.18 and minDim>=0.055 and volume>=0.035 then return true end
end

-- 刀 ViewModel 中匿名 Mesh/Part 若帶 Bone 且有明顯厚度，視為 skinned 手臂。
if sawWeaponContext and hasBone then
local genericName=(compact=="mesh"or compact=="meshpart"or compact=="part"or compact=="body"or compact=="skin"or compact=="rig"or compact=="")
if genericName and maxDim<=5.5 and midDim>=0.32 and minDim>=0.14 and volume>=0.12 then return true end
end

return false
end

function CVU_GetGhostArmParts()
local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
local root=viewModel or LocalPlayer.Character
local knifeClone=Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled and Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone or nil
local now=os.clock()
if Runtime.GhostArmScanRoot==root
and Runtime.GhostArmScanKnifeClone==knifeClone
and now<(Runtime.GhostArmScanNext or 0)then
return Runtime.GhostArmScanParts or{},viewModel
end
local result={}
local seen=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

local function collect(scanRoot,vmContext)
if not scanRoot or not scanRoot.Parent then return end

if scanRoot:IsA("BasePart")
and CVU_IsGhostArmPart(scanRoot,vmContext)
and not seen[scanRoot]then
result[#result+1]=scanRoot
seen[scanRoot]=true
end

for _,object in ipairs(scanRoot:GetDescendants())do
if CVU_IsGhostArmPart(object,vmContext)
and not seen[object]then
result[#result+1]=object
seen[object]=true
end
end
end

if root then
collect(root,viewModel)
end

-- 穩定版體驗刀具在 native rebuild 失敗時會用獨立 CameraModel fallback。
-- CVU_GetViewModel() 會故意排除 CVU 自己的 CameraModel，
-- 因此前一版 GhostArms 只染到被隱藏的原手，沒有染到畫面上真正可見的刀具手。
if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
and knifeClone
and knifeClone.Parent then
collect(knifeClone,knifeClone)
end

Runtime.GhostArmScanRoot=root
Runtime.GhostArmScanKnifeClone=knifeClone
Runtime.GhostArmScanParts=result
Runtime.GhostArmScanNext=now+.65
return result,viewModel
end

function CVU_DestroyGhostOverlayEntry(part)
local entry=Runtime.GhostArmOverlays and Runtime.GhostArmOverlays[part]
if not entry then return end
if entry.Object and entry.Object.Parent then pcall(function()entry.Object:Destroy()end)end
Runtime.GhostArmOverlays[part]=nil
end

function CVU_DestroyGhostArmOverlays()
if Runtime.GhostArmOverlays then
for part in pairs(Runtime.GhostArmOverlays)do
CVU_DestroyGhostOverlayEntry(part)
end
end
Runtime.GhostArmOverlays={}
if Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder and Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder.Parent then
pcall(function()Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder:Destroy()end)
end
Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder=nil
end
function CVU_RestoreGhostSourceVisual(part,visual)
if not part or not part.Parent or not visual then return false end

pcall(function()
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=visual.LocalTransparencyModifier or 0
part.Reflectance=visual.Reflectance or 0
if visual.Color then part.Color=visual.Color end
if visual.Material then part.Material=visual.Material end
part.MaterialVariant=visual.MaterialVariant or""
part.Size=visual.Size or part.Size

if part:IsA("MeshPart")and visual.MeshPartTextureID~=nil then
part.TextureID=visual.MeshPartTextureID
end
end)

for mesh,color in pairs(visual.SpecialMeshColors or {})do
if mesh and mesh.Parent then
pcall(function()mesh.VertexColor=color end)
end
end

for mesh,textureId in pairs(visual.SpecialMeshTextureIds or {})do
if mesh and mesh.Parent then
pcall(function()mesh.TextureId=textureId or""end)
end
end

for obj,data in pairs(visual.TextureStates or {})do
if obj and obj.Parent and data then
pcall(function()obj.Transparency=data.Transparency or 0 end)
pcall(function()if data.Texture~=nil then obj.Texture=data.Texture end end)
pcall(function()if data.TextureId~=nil then obj.TextureId=data.TextureId end end)
pcall(function()if data.Color3 then obj.Color3=data.Color3 end end)
end
end

for obj,data in pairs(visual.SurfaceStates or {})do
if obj and obj.Parent and data then
pcall(function()if data.ColorMap~=nil then obj.ColorMap=data.ColorMap end end)
pcall(function()if data.NormalMap~=nil then obj.NormalMap=data.NormalMap end end)
pcall(function()if data.RoughnessMap~=nil then obj.RoughnessMap=data.RoughnessMap end end)
pcall(function()if data.MetalnessMap~=nil then obj.MetalnessMap=data.MetalnessMap end end)
end
end

return true
end

function CVU_RestoreGhostSourceArms()
for part,original in pairs(Runtime.GhostSourceArms)do
if part and part.Parent then
local visual=Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals and Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals[part]
if visual then
CVU_RestoreGhostSourceVisual(part,visual)
else
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=original or 0
end

pcall(function()part:SetAttribute("CVU_GhostArmSource",nil)end)
pcall(function()part:SetAttribute("IgnoreMetalVisual",nil)end)
end

Runtime.GhostSourceArms[part]=nil
if Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals then
Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals[part]=nil
end
end
end

function CVU_SaveGhostSourceVisual(part)
if not part or not part.Parent then return nil end
Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals=Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local state=Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals[part]

if not state then
local variant=""
pcall(function()variant=part.MaterialVariant end)

state={
LocalTransparencyModifier=part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
Reflectance=part.Reflectance,
Size=part.Size,
Color=part.Color,
Material=part.Material,
MaterialVariant=variant,
MeshPartTextureID=nil,
SpecialMeshColors={},
SpecialMeshTextureIds={},
TextureStates={},
SurfaceStates={},
}

if part:IsA("MeshPart")then
pcall(function()state.MeshPartTextureID=part.TextureID end)
end

for _,obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
local okColor,color=pcall(function()return obj.VertexColor end)
if okColor then state.SpecialMeshColors[obj]=color end
local okTex,tex=pcall(function()return obj.TextureId end)
if okTex then state.SpecialMeshTextureIds[obj]=tex end

elseif obj:IsA("Decal")or obj:IsA("Texture")then
local data={
Transparency=obj.Transparency,
Texture=nil,
TextureId=nil,
Color3=nil,
}
pcall(function()data.Texture=obj.Texture end)
pcall(function()data.TextureId=obj.TextureId end)
pcall(function()data.Color3=obj.Color3 end)
state.TextureStates[obj]=data

elseif obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
local data={
ColorMap=nil,
NormalMap=nil,
RoughnessMap=nil,
MetalnessMap=nil,
}
pcall(function()data.ColorMap=obj.ColorMap end)
pcall(function()data.NormalMap=obj.NormalMap end)
pcall(function()data.RoughnessMap=obj.RoughnessMap end)
pcall(function()data.MetalnessMap=obj.MetalnessMap end)
state.SurfaceStates[obj]=data
end
end

Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals[part]=state
end
return state
end

function CVU_ApplyGhostSourceVisual(part)
if not part or not part.Parent then return end
local state=CVU_SaveGhostSourceVisual(part)
if not state then return end

local desiredTransparency=math.clamp(
tonumber(Settings.GhostArmTransparency)or 0.45,
0,
0.95
)
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=
math.max(tonumber(state.LocalTransparencyModifier)or 0,desiredTransparency)

local reflect=math.clamp(
tonumber(Settings.GhostArmReflectance)or 0.20,
0,
1
)
part.Reflectance=math.clamp(reflect*0.75,0,0.75)

local ghostColor=Settings.GhostArmColor or Color3.fromRGB(200,215,255)
part.Color=ghostColor

-- 關鍵修正：
-- 刀具 CameraModel 的手套通常有自己的 TextureID / SurfaceAppearance，
-- Part.Color 會被那些貼圖蓋掉，所以會出現「刀是藍黃手、槍是綠手」。
-- GhostArms ON 時把所有手臂都統一成乾淨的 SmoothPlastic + GhostArmColor。
part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
pcall(function()part.MaterialVariant=""end)

if part:IsA("MeshPart")then
pcall(function()part.TextureID=""end)
end

for _,obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
pcall(function()
obj.TextureId=""
obj.VertexColor=Vector3.new(ghostColor.R,ghostColor.G,ghostColor.B)
end)

elseif obj:IsA("Decal")or obj:IsA("Texture")then
pcall(function()obj.Transparency=1 end)

elseif obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
-- 不 Destroy；只暫時清 map，關閉 GhostArms 時原值可以原地恢復。
pcall(function()obj.ColorMap=""end)
pcall(function()obj.NormalMap=""end)
pcall(function()obj.RoughnessMap=""end)
pcall(function()obj.MetalnessMap=""end)
end
end

-- 長度永遠從原始 Size 計算，不累乘。
local base=state.Size or part.Size
local requested=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.GhostArmLength)or 1,0.70,1.60)
local factor=requested
if part:IsA("MeshPart")or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Bone",true)then
factor=1+(requested-1)*0.35
end

local x,y,z=base.X,base.Y,base.Z
if base.X>=base.Y and base.X>=base.Z then
x=base.X*factor
elseif base.Y>=base.X and base.Y>=base.Z then
y=base.Y*factor
else
z=base.Z*factor
end
pcall(function()part.Size=Vector3.new(x,y,z)end)
end


function CVU_GetGhostOverlayFolder()
if not Camera then return nil end
if Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder and Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder.Parent~=Camera then
CVU_DestroyGhostArmOverlays()
end
if not Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder or not Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder.Parent then
local folder=Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name="CVU_GhostArmOverlays"
folder:SetAttribute("CVU_GhostOverlay",true)
folder.Parent=Camera
Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder=folder
end
return Runtime.GhostOverlayFolder
end

function CVU_CalcGhostShellSize(part)
local base=part.Size
local shell=1.008
local x,y,z=base.X*shell,base.Y*shell,base.Z*shell
local requested=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.GhostArmLength)or 1,0.70,1.60)

-- Complex/skinned MeshParts are never stretched. Stretching those is what produced giant slabs on knives.
if part:IsA("MeshPart")or part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Bone",true)then
return Vector3.new(x,y,z)
end

-- For simple limb Parts, keep the old length control but only along the longest axis.
if base.X>=base.Y and base.X>=base.Z then x=base.X*requested
elseif base.Y>=base.X and base.Y>=base.Z then y=base.Y*requested
else z=base.Z*requested end
return Vector3.new(x,y,z)
end

function CVU_CreateGhostHighlight(part,folder)
local highlight=Instance.new("Highlight")
highlight.Name="CVU_GhostHighlight_"..part.Name
highlight:SetAttribute("CVU_GhostOverlay",true)
highlight.Adornee=part
highlight.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
highlight.Parent=folder
return{Kind="Highlight",Object=highlight}
end

function CVU_CreateGhostShell(part,folder)
-- V10：發光手臂改用 Highlight，不再複製一層幾乎重疊的 Mesh。
-- 透明 Neon Mesh 疊在原手臂上會因深度排序 / Z-fighting 產生閃爍，刀類 ViewModel 特別明顯。
return CVU_CreateGhostHighlight(part,folder)
end

function CVU_UpdateGhostOverlay(part,entry)
if not part or not part.Parent or not entry or not entry.Object or not entry.Object.Parent then return false end
if entry.Kind=="Highlight"then
local highlight=entry.Object
highlight.Adornee=part
highlight.FillColor=Settings.GhostArmColor
highlight.OutlineColor=Settings.GhostArmColor
local ghostTransparency=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.GhostArmTransparency)or 0.45,0,0.95)
-- Highlight 是額外疊在原手臂上的發光層；如果它跟原手臂用同樣透明度，兩層相加看起來會接近實心。
-- 因此 Fill 固定比原手臂更透明，只留下柔和發光與輪廓。
local reflect=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.GhostArmReflectance)or 0.20,0,1)
highlight.FillTransparency=math.clamp(0.58+ghostTransparency*0.20-reflect*0.10,0.42,0.82)
highlight.OutlineTransparency=math.clamp(0.72-reflect*0.58,0.06,0.76)
highlight.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded
highlight.Enabled=true
else
-- 舊版殘留 Shell 不再沿用；下一次立即重建成 Highlight。
return false
end
return true
end

function CVU_ApplyGhostArms()
if not Settings.GhostArms then
CVU_DestroyGhostArmOverlays()
Runtime.GhostArmParts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
CVU_RestoreGhostSourceArms()
CVU_RestoreCharacterArms()
if CVU_IsAnyMetalEnabled() then
Runtime.LastGhostArmMetalSync=os.clock()
pcall(CVU_QueueMetalWeaponRefresh,true)
end
return
end

local folder=CVU_GetGhostOverlayFolder()
if not folder then return end
local arms,viewModel=CVU_GetGhostArmParts()
local keep=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GhostArmParts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

for _,part in ipairs(arms)do
keep[part]=true
Runtime.GhostArmParts[part]=true

-- 先把舊金屬狀態清掉，再記錄 GhostArms 的原始值；順序反過來會把錯誤的金屬 Size/Reflectance 當成手臂原始值。
if Runtime.MetalWeaponParts and Runtime.MetalWeaponParts[part]then
pcall(function()CVU_RestorePart(part)end)
Runtime.MetalWeaponParts[part]=nil
end
if Runtime.GhostSourceArms[part]==nil then
Runtime.GhostSourceArms[part]=part.LocalTransparencyModifier
end
CVU_SaveGhostSourceVisual(part)
pcall(function()part:SetAttribute("CVU_GhostArmSource",true)end)
pcall(function()part:SetAttribute("IgnoreMetalVisual",true)end)
CVU_ApplyGhostSourceVisual(part)

local entry=Runtime.GhostArmOverlays[part]
if not entry or not entry.Object or not entry.Object.Parent then
entry=CVU_CreateGhostShell(part,folder)
Runtime.GhostArmOverlays[part]=entry
end
if not CVU_UpdateGhostOverlay(part,entry)then
CVU_DestroyGhostOverlayEntry(part)
end
end

for part in pairs(Runtime.GhostArmOverlays)do
if not keep[part]or not part or not part.Parent then
CVU_DestroyGhostOverlayEntry(part)
end
end

for part in pairs(Runtime.GhostSourceArms)do
if not keep[part]or not part or not part.Parent then
if part and part.Parent then
local visual=Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals and Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals[part]
if visual then
CVU_RestoreGhostSourceVisual(part,visual)
else
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=Runtime.GhostSourceArms[part] or 0
end
pcall(function()part:SetAttribute("CVU_GhostArmSource",nil)end)
pcall(function()part:SetAttribute("IgnoreMetalVisual",nil)end)
end
Runtime.GhostSourceArms[part]=nil
if Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals then Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals[part]=nil end
end
end

-- The game's original ViewModel arms are only made partially transparent.
-- The separate shell/highlight supplies the glow, while the base arm stays visible underneath.
if viewModel then CVU_HideCharacterArms()else CVU_RestoreCharacterArms()end
if CVU_IsAnyMetalEnabled() then
local now=os.clock()
if now-(Runtime.LastGhostArmMetalSync or 0)>.45 then
Runtime.LastGhostArmMetalSync=now
-- GhostArms 已經在 Reapply 階段排除手臂，不需要每 0.45 秒 force rebuild；force rebuild 會讓刀子顏色一閃一閃。
pcall(CVU_QueueMetalWeaponRefresh,false)
end
end
end

-- 某些刀類 ViewModel 每幀會把手臂 LocalTransparencyModifier 寫回 0。
-- 用最後階段 RenderStep 做保護：只在透明度低於使用者設定時補回，不干擾 ADS 主動把手臂隱藏成 1。
function CVU_EnforceGhostArmTransparency()
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.GhostArms then return end
local requested=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.GhostArmTransparency)or .45,0,.95)
for part in pairs(Runtime.GhostArmParts)do
if part and part.Parent then
local visual=Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals and Runtime.GhostSourceVisuals[part]
local base=visual and tonumber(visual.LocalTransparencyModifier)or 0
local desired=math.max(base,requested)
if part.LocalTransparencyModifier<desired then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=desired end
local entry=Runtime.GhostArmOverlays and Runtime.GhostArmOverlays[part]
local highlight=entry and entry.Kind=="Highlight"and entry.Object
if highlight and highlight.Parent then
if highlight.Adornee~=part then highlight.Adornee=part end
if not highlight.Enabled then highlight.Enabled=true end
end
end
end
end

pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_GhostTransparency")end) pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_ESPProjection")end)
pcall(function()
RunService:BindToRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_GhostTransparency",1999,CVU_EnforceGhostArmTransparency)
end)

function CVU_GetEquippedTool()
local character=LocalPlayer.Character
if not character then return nil end
return character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Tool")
end

function CVU_GetHeldWeaponVisualRoot()
-- 第一人稱只使用 LocalPlayer 自己 Camera 裡的 ViewModel。
-- 這個 ViewModel 本來就只有自己的武器/手臂，不需要再靠武器名稱硬比對。
-- V60/V61 那套名稱比對太嚴格，很多遊戲的 VM 子模型叫 Arms/GunModel/Weapon，
-- 所以實際武器永遠匹配不到，金屬效果看起來就像完全沒用。
local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
if viewModel then
return viewModel
end

-- 第三人稱 / 沒有 ViewModel 時，只退回 LocalPlayer 自己 Character 內目前裝備的 Tool。
return CVU_GetEquippedTool()
end


local CVU_MetalPositiveWeaponTokens={
"weapon","gun","rifle","pistol","smg","shotgun","sniper","revolver","carbine",
"knife","blade","sword","katana","melee","bayonet","machete","karambit",
"barrel","receiver","magazine","muzzle","sight","scope","trigger","stock",
"slide","bolt","suppressor","silencer","handguard","foregrip","grip","ammo","shell"
}

function CVU_IsInsideActiveWeaponBranch(object,viewModel)
if not object then return false end

-- 第一人稱：只承認目前 ViewModel 裡 BloxStrike 原生的 Weapon / WeaponL / WeaponR 分支。
-- 手臂、手套、角色頭部、頭盔、護目鏡、吊飾基座等即使名稱含 gun/scope/lens，也不能越界。
if viewModel and (object==viewModel or object:IsDescendantOf(viewModel))then
local current=object
while current and current~=viewModel do
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(current.Name)
if n=="weapon"or n=="weaponl"or n=="weaponr"then return true end
if current:GetAttribute("IsWeapon")==true or current:GetAttribute("WeaponPart")==true then return true end
current=current.Parent
end
return false
end

-- 第三人稱 / 沒有 Camera ViewModel：只承認 LocalPlayer 自己目前裝備的 Tool。
local tool=CVU_GetEquippedTool()
if tool and (object==tool or object:IsDescendantOf(tool))then return true end
return false
end

function CVU_IsClearlyWeaponPart(part,viewModel)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
return CVU_IsInsideActiveWeaponBranch(part,viewModel)
end

local CVU_StrongLocalMeleeTokens={
"blade","knife","karambit","bayonet","machete","katana","sword","edge","hilt","guard","handle","grip","weapon"
}

function CVU_IsMeleeViewModelContext(part,viewModel)
local current=part
while current and current~=Camera do
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(current.Name)
if string.find(n,"knife",1,true)or string.find(n,"blade",1,true)
or string.find(n,"karambit",1,true)or string.find(n,"bayonet",1,true)
or string.find(n,"machete",1,true)or string.find(n,"katana",1,true)
or string.find(n,"sword",1,true)or string.find(n,"melee",1,true)then
return true
end
if current==viewModel then break end
current=current.Parent
end
return false
end

function CVU_HasStrongLocalMeleeWeaponIdentity(part,viewModel)
local current=part
local depth=0
while current and current~=Camera and depth<=2 do
if current:GetAttribute("IsWeapon")==true or current:GetAttribute("WeaponPart")==true then return true end
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(current.Name)
for _,token in ipairs(CVU_StrongLocalMeleeTokens)do
if string.find(n,token,1,true)then return true end
end
if current==viewModel then break end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
return false
end

function CVU_IsLikelySkinnedMeleeArm(part,viewModel)
if not CVU_IsMeleeViewModelContext(part,viewModel)then return false end
if CVU_HasStrongLocalMeleeWeaponIdentity(part,viewModel)then return false end

-- 刀 ViewModel 的手臂通常是 rigged Mesh；真正刀刃通常不是。
if part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Bone",true)then return true end

-- 最後用幾何兜底：厚、長、有體積的泛用 Mesh/Part 比較像前臂，
-- 刀刃/護手/握把通常更薄或有明確 weapon 名稱。
local size=part.Size
local dims={size.X,size.Y,size.Z}
table.sort(dims)
local minDim,midDim,maxDim=dims[1],dims[2],dims[3]
local volume=size.X*size.Y*size.Z
if maxDim>=1.05 and midDim>=0.38 and minDim>=0.18 and volume>=0.20 then
return true
end
return false
end

function CVU_IsHardProtectedArmPart(part,viewModel)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
if part:GetAttribute("CVU_GhostArmSource")==true then return true end
if Runtime.GhostArmParts and Runtime.GhostArmParts[part]then return true end
-- GhostArms 與 MetalWeapon 共用同一套 arm classifier，避免兩套判斷互相打架。
if CVU_IsGhostArmPart(part,viewModel)then return true end
if CVU_IsArmPart(part)then return true end
if CVU_IsLikelySkinnedMeleeArm(part,viewModel)then return true end
return false
end

-- Charm isolation：BloxStrike 會把吊飾的 CharmBase 直接掛進 Camera weapon model。
-- 金屬系統若把 CharmBase 內的動態 BasePart 當成槍身建立 coat shell，
-- shell 不會跟 HingeConstraint 完全同步，畫面上就會出現準星旁邊跟著吊飾晃動的「反光碎片」。
-- 因此吊飾整棵 hierarchy 永遠保留遊戲原生材質/幾何，完全不進 Metal / PlasticMetal / Lens 分類。
function CVU_IsCharmVisualObject(object,viewModel)
if not object then return false end
local current=object
local depth=0
while current and current~=Camera and depth<=12 do
if current:GetAttribute("CVU_CharmVisual")==true then return true end
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(current.Name)
if n=="charmbase"or n=="weaponcharm"or n=="charmmodel"or string.sub(n,1,9)=="charmbase"then
return true
end
-- 部分版本可能把 CharmBase 改名；只有名稱帶 charm 且內部確實存在 HingeConstraint 時才視為吊飾，
-- 避免誤判槍本體單純叫 CharmAttachment 的定位點。
if current:IsA("Model")and string.find(n,"charm",1,true)then
local ok,hinge=pcall(function()return current:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("HingeConstraint",true)end)
if ok and hinge then return true end
end
if current==viewModel then break end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
return false
end

-- Register-limit-safe scope optical split fix: optical helpers intentionally avoid top-level locals.
-- Scope optical split fix:
-- 1) Reticle / render plane / scope screen = display plane. Never tint, clone, resize or reflect it.
-- 2) Real Lens / Glass = keep the ORIGINAL part in place and only raise Reflectance.
--    We deliberately do not create a metal shell for the lens, so the scope reflection can never "fly" away.
Runtime.OpticalDisplayTokens={
"reticle","crosshair","scopeview","scoperender","rendersurface","renderplane",
"viewscreen","displayscreen","scopeui","viewport","overlay","hud","screenquad"
}

Runtime.OpticalLensTokens={
"lens","glass","scopeglass","scopelens","sightglass","sightlens",
"opticglass","opticlens","reddotglass","reddotlens","reflexglass","reflexlens",
"reflector","mirror","objectiveglass","objectivelens","ocularlens","eyelens"
}

Runtime.OpticalContextTokens={"scope","sight","optic","sniper","reddot","reflex","holo","objective","ocular"}

function CVU_HasOpticalContext(part,viewModel)
local current=part
local depth=0
while current and current~=Camera and depth<=6 do
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(current.Name)
for _,token in ipairs(Runtime.OpticalContextTokens)do
if string.find(n,token,1,true)then return true end
end
if current==viewModel then break end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
return false
end

function CVU_HasOpticalSurfaceData(part)
if not part then return false end
if part:IsA("MeshPart")then
local ok,textureId=pcall(function()return part.TextureID end)
if ok and type(textureId)=="string" and textureId~=""then return true end
end
for _,child in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("Decal")or child:IsA("Texture")or child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")or child:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
return true
end
end
return false
end

function CVU_IsOpticalDisplayPart(part,viewModel)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
if not CVU_IsInsideActiveWeaponBranch(part,viewModel)then return false end
if CVU_IsCharmVisualObject(part,viewModel)then return false end
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(part.Name)
for _,token in ipairs(Runtime.OpticalDisplayTokens)do
if string.find(n,token,1,true)then return true end
end
return false
end

function CVU_IsOpticalLensPart(part,viewModel)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
if not CVU_IsInsideActiveWeaponBranch(part,viewModel)then return false end
if CVU_IsCharmVisualObject(part,viewModel)then return false end
if CVU_IsOpticalDisplayPart(part,viewModel)then return false end
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(part.Name)

-- Explicit Lens/Glass names are the safest signal.
for _,token in ipairs(Runtime.OpticalLensTokens)do
if string.find(n,token,1,true)then return true end
end

-- Some games call the front lens simply Part/Mesh.  For those, require:
-- optical ancestry + surface data + a thin disc/plate proportion.
if CVU_HasOpticalContext(part,viewModel)and CVU_HasOpticalSurfaceData(part)then
local s=part.Size
local dims={s.X,s.Y,s.Z}
table.sort(dims)
local thin,mid,wide=dims[1],dims[2],dims[3]
if thin<=0.16 and wide<=5.5 and mid>=0.18 and (mid/math.max(wide,0.001))>=0.55 then
return true
end
end

return false
end

function CVU_GetOpticalLensReflectance()
local userReflect=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.MetalWeaponReflectance)or 0.62,0,1)
return math.clamp(userReflect*1.10,0.38,0.92)
end

function CVU_ApplyOpticalLensReflection(part)
if not part or not part.Parent then return end
CVU_SavePart(part)
local original=Runtime.VisualCache[part]
if not original then return end

-- Stage 2 permanent rule: scope Lens / Glass / Reticle is owned by BloxStrike, not by MetalWeapon.
-- MetalWeapon may use the lens only as an ADS-location hint; it must never recolor, resize, duplicate,
-- increase Reflectance, or overwrite Transparency / LocalTransparencyModifier.
part.Color=original.Color
part.Material=original.Material
pcall(function()part.MaterialVariant=original.MaterialVariant or ""end)
part.Reflectance=original.Reflectance
pcall(function()part.Size=original.Size end)
end

function CVU_IsMetalVisualPart(part)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()

-- Stage 2 核心邊界：金屬效果只能存在於目前武器的 Weapon / WeaponL / WeaponR 或 LocalPlayer Tool。
-- 以前這個函式最後預設 return true，導致 ViewModel 裡「不是手臂的任何零件」都可能被金屬化；
-- 頭盔鏡片、角色配件、展示模型因此會被誤傷。現在未進武器分支就直接拒絕。
if not CVU_IsInsideActiveWeaponBranch(part,viewModel)then return false end

-- 吊飾會用 HingeConstraint 動態擺動；絕不能替它建立獨立 metal coat shell。
if CVU_IsCharmVisualObject(part,viewModel)then return false end

-- 光學顯示平面完全不碰；真正 Lens/Glass 交給「原位反光」系統，兩者都不建立 metal shell。
if CVU_IsOpticalDisplayPart(part,viewModel)then return false end
if CVU_IsOpticalLensPart(part,viewModel)then return false end

-- 手臂優先級永遠高於 Knife/Gun 祖先名稱。
-- 這修正拿刀時 ViewModel 上層叫 Knife，導致底下真手臂被誤判成武器的問題。
if CVU_IsHardProtectedArmPart(part,viewModel)then return false end

local clearWeapon=CVU_IsClearlyWeaponPart(part,viewModel)
if not clearWeapon then
if CVU_IsGhostArmPart(part,viewModel)then return false end
if CVU_HasGhostArmContainerAncestor(part,viewModel)then return false end
end

if part:GetAttribute("IgnoreMetalVisual")==true then return false end

local n=string.lower(part.Name or "")
if n=="humanoidrootpart"
or n=="root"
or n=="rootpart"
or n=="camera"
or string.find(n,"helper",1,true)
or string.find(n,"anchor",1,true)
or string.find(n,"pivot",1,true)
or string.find(n,"scopeui",1,true)
or string.find(n,"viewport",1,true)
or string.find(n,"overlay",1,true)
or string.find(n,"reticle",1,true)
or string.find(n,"crosshair",1,true)then
return false
end

-- Clip/Mask 在部分武器模型其實是真實可見零件，不再只因名稱就排除。
-- 仍然用透明度與尺寸把真正的輔助遮罩擋掉。
if part.Transparency>=0.55 then return false end

local size=part.Size
local maxDim=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
local minDim=math.min(size.X,size.Y,size.Z)
if maxDim>12 then return false end
if maxDim>6 and minDim<0.08 then return false end

return true
end

function CVU_GetMetalSurfaceOwnerPart(object)
if not object then return nil end
if object:IsA("BasePart")then return object end
local parent=object.Parent
while parent do
if parent:IsA("BasePart")then return parent end
parent=parent.Parent
end
return nil
end

function CVU_GetHighReflectMetalColor()
local color=Settings.MetalWeaponColor or Color3.fromRGB(220,225,235)
local h,s,v=Color3.toHSV(color)
-- 高反光金屬不能讓底色太暗，否則看起來會像塑膠漆。
-- 保留選色 Hue，但把亮度抬高、飽和度稍微壓低，讓高光更像拋光金屬。
v=math.max(v,math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.MetalWeaponCoatBrightness)or 1,0.75,1))
s=math.min(s,0.72)
return Color3.fromHSV(h,s,v)
end

function CVU_GetColorLuminance(color)
if typeof(color)~="Color3"then return 1 end
return math.clamp(color.R*0.2126+color.G*0.7152+color.B*0.0722,0,1)
end

function CVU_HasMetalSourceDetail(part)
if not part then return false end
if part:IsA("MeshPart")then
local ok,textureId=pcall(function()return part.TextureID end)
if ok and type(textureId)=="string"and textureId~=""then return true end
end
for _,object in ipairs(part:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
return true
elseif object:IsA("Decal")or object:IsA("Texture")then
local transparency=0
pcall(function()transparency=object.Transparency end)
if transparency<0.99 then return true end
elseif object:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
local textureId=""
pcall(function()textureId=object.TextureId end)
if type(textureId)=="string"and textureId~=""then return true end
end
end
return false
end

function CVU_IsMeleeBladePart(part)
local current=part
while current and current~=Camera do
local n=string.lower(current.Name or "")
if string.find(n,"knife",1,true)
or string.find(n,"blade",1,true)
or string.find(n,"karambit",1,true)
or string.find(n,"bayonet",1,true)
or string.find(n,"machete",1,true)
or string.find(n,"katana",1,true)
or string.find(n,"sword",1,true)
or string.find(n,"melee",1,true)then
return true
end
current=current.Parent
end
return false
end

function CVU_GetMetalCoatStyle(part)
local targetColor=CVU_GetHighReflectMetalColor()
local baseColor=part and part.Color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
local luminance=CVU_GetColorLuminance(baseColor)
local hasDetail=CVU_HasMetalSourceDetail(part)
local isMelee=CVU_IsMeleeBladePart(part)

-- 亮面金屬殼仍然要保留原槍的黑/亮反差。
-- 純色、沒貼圖的零件如果直接套滿粉色，就會整塊像塑膠玩具。
-- 刀面則要更完整地覆蓋，避免底下黑色斑塊從塗層透出來。
local tintStrength=0.30+luminance*0.22+(hasDetail and 0.10 or -0.08)
if isMelee then
	tintStrength=math.max(tintStrength,0.48)
end
tintStrength=math.clamp(tintStrength,0.18,isMelee and 0.72 or 0.55)
local coatColor=baseColor:Lerp(targetColor,tintStrength)

-- 固定金屬反光：不再提供 UI 調整，也不依武器類型自動加減。
local reflectance=0.15

local baseCoat=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.MetalWeaponCoatTransparency)or 0.10,0.02,0.40)
local coatTransparency=baseCoat+(1-luminance)*0.16+(hasDetail and 0 or 0.12)
if isMelee then
coatTransparency=coatTransparency-0.16
end
coatTransparency=math.clamp(coatTransparency,isMelee and 0.03 or 0.08,isMelee and 0.22 or 0.55)

return coatColor,reflectance,coatTransparency
end

function CVU_GetPlasticMetalBaseReflectance()
return 0.15
end

function CVU_ApplyPlasticMetalBase(part)
if not part or not part.Parent then return end
part.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
pcall(function()part.MaterialVariant=""end)
part.Color=Settings.MetalWeaponColor
part.Reflectance=CVU_GetPlasticMetalBaseReflectance()
end

function CVU_RestoreMetalSourceStyleOnly(part)
local original=Runtime.VisualCache[part]
if not original or not part or not part.Parent then return end
part.Color=original.Color
part.Material=original.Material
pcall(function()part.MaterialVariant=original.MaterialVariant or ""end)
part.Reflectance=original.Reflectance
end

function CVU_ApplyMetalFallbackSurface(part,coatColor)
-- Shell 建不起來（最常見是帶 Bone 的 skinned Mesh）時，直接處理原武器表面。
-- 這就是 V11 原本漏掉整塊零件的地方。
if part:IsA("MeshPart")then pcall(function()part.TextureID=""end)end
for _,object in ipairs(part:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
pcall(function()object.TextureId=""end)
pcall(function()object.VertexColor=Vector3.new(1,1,1)end)
elseif object:IsA("Decal")or object:IsA("Texture")then
pcall(function()object.Transparency=1 end)
elseif object:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
pcall(function()object.ColorMap=""end)
pcall(function()object.Color=coatColor end)
end
end
end

function CVU_ApplyDirectMetalFallback(part)
if not part or not part.Parent then return end
if Settings.PlasticMetalWeapon then
-- 塑膠模式有開時，fallback 就維持塑膠亮面底層。
CVU_ApplyPlasticMetalBase(part)
CVU_ApplyMetalFallbackSurface(part,Settings.MetalWeaponColor)
else
-- 只有高反光模式時，如果 shell 建不起來，才直接把原零件做成較強的金屬 fallback。
local coatColor,coatReflectance=CVU_GetMetalCoatStyle(part)
part.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
pcall(function()part.MaterialVariant=""end)
part.Color=coatColor
part.Reflectance=math.clamp(coatReflectance,0.15,0.90)
CVU_ApplyMetalFallbackSurface(part,coatColor)
end
Runtime.MetalDirectFallbackParts[part]=true
end

function CVU_DestroyMetalCoatEntry(part)
local entry=Runtime.MetalCoatOverlays and Runtime.MetalCoatOverlays[part]
if not entry then return end
if entry.Object and entry.Object.Parent then pcall(function()entry.Object:Destroy()end)end
Runtime.MetalCoatOverlays[part]=nil
end

function CVU_IsLegacyMetalCoatArtifact(object)
if not object then return false end
local name=tostring(object.Name or"")
if name=="CVU_HighReflectMetalCoat"then return true end
if string.sub(name,1,14)=="CVU_MetalCoat_"then return true end
if name=="CVU_MetalCoatWeld"then return true end
local ok,flag=pcall(function()return object:GetAttribute("CVU_MetalCoat")end)
return ok and flag==true
end

function CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts(root)
if not root then return 0 end
local removed=0

-- Destroy top-level legacy folder first; it owns all of the old enlarged reflective shells.
for _,child in ipairs(root:GetChildren())do
if child and child.Parent and CVU_IsLegacyMetalCoatArtifact(child)then
pcall(function()child:Destroy()end)
removed+=1
end
end

-- Hot reloads from older builds can leave an orphan shell/weld even after the folder reference is lost.
-- Search only roots that ChickenVisual itself could have touched (Camera / local character / Characters folder),
-- never the whole map every frame.
for _,object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if object and object.Parent and CVU_IsLegacyMetalCoatArtifact(object)then
pcall(function()object:Destroy()end)
removed+=1
end
end
return removed
end

function CVU_DestroyMetalCoatOverlays()
if Runtime.MetalCoatOverlays then
for part in pairs(Runtime.MetalCoatOverlays)do
CVU_DestroyMetalCoatEntry(part)
end
end
Runtime.MetalCoatOverlays={}

if Runtime.MetalCoatFolder and Runtime.MetalCoatFolder.Parent then
pcall(function()Runtime.MetalCoatFolder:Destroy()end)
end
Runtime.MetalCoatFolder=nil

-- IMPORTANT: cleanup must not depend on Settings.MetalWeapon or the current Runtime table.
-- An older script could have created a cloned visor/scope shell and then lost its table on hot reload.
-- Purge by persistent name/attribute so Metal OFF really means zero metal-clone geometry remains.
pcall(CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts,Workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera)
pcall(CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts,LocalPlayer.Character)
local charactersFolder=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
if charactersFolder then pcall(CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts,charactersFolder)end
end

-- Do one unconditional legacy cleanup at startup. This intentionally runs even when MetalWeapon is OFF.
task.defer(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
pcall(CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts,Workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera)
pcall(CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts,LocalPlayer.Character)
local charactersFolder=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
if charactersFolder then pcall(CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts,charactersFolder)end
end)

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
task.defer(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
pcall(CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts,character)
pcall(CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts,Workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera)
end)
end)

Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
task.defer(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
pcall(CVU_PurgeLegacyMetalCoatArtifacts,Workspace.CurrentCamera)
end)
end)

function CVU_GetMetalCoatFolder()
-- Stage 2: duplicated metal coat folders are permanently retired.
-- Always purge any legacy overlay left by an older hot-reloaded build and refuse to create a new one.
CVU_DestroyMetalCoatOverlays()
return nil
end

Runtime.ADSScopeOverlayLastScan=Runtime.ADSScopeOverlayLastScan or 0
Runtime.ADSScopeOverlayVisible=Runtime.ADSScopeOverlayVisible or false
Runtime.ADSStateFlagLastScan=Runtime.ADSStateFlagLastScan or 0
Runtime.ADSStateFlagVisible=Runtime.ADSStateFlagVisible or false

function CVU_IsADSForwardObstructionPart(part)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
local current=part
local depth=0
while current and depth<=5 do
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(current.Name)
if string.find(n,"barrel",1,true)
or string.find(n,"muzzle",1,true)
or string.find(n,"suppressor",1,true)
or string.find(n,"silencer",1,true)
or string.find(n,"flashhider",1,true)
or string.find(n,"compensator",1,true)
or string.find(n,"muzzlebrake",1,true)
or string.find(n,"fronttube",1,true)then
return true
end
if current==Runtime.MetalWeaponRoot then break end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
return false
end

function CVU_HasActiveScopedOptic()
return Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope==true or next(Runtime.MetalOpticalLensParts or {})~=nil
end

Runtime.ScopeWeaponRoot=Runtime.ScopeWeaponRoot or nil
Runtime.ScopeWeaponCapable=Runtime.ScopeWeaponCapable or false
Runtime.ScopeWeaponCapabilityNextCheck=Runtime.ScopeWeaponCapabilityNextCheck or 0
Runtime.ScopeOverlayScanPasses=Runtime.ScopeOverlayScanPasses or 0

-- 判斷目前武器是否具備狙擊鏡，只供金屬武器 ADS 前端幾何遮擋保護使用。
-- 這裡只在目前 ViewModel 變更或快取過期時掃一次，避免 RenderStep 反覆遞迴造成卡頓。
function CVU_CurrentWeaponLooksScoped()
local root=CVU_GetHeldWeaponVisualRoot()
local now=os.clock()
if Runtime.ScopeWeaponRoot==root and now<(Runtime.ScopeWeaponCapabilityNextCheck or 0)then
return Runtime.ScopeWeaponCapable==true
end
Runtime.ScopeWeaponRoot=root
Runtime.ScopeWeaponCapabilityNextCheck=now+0.75
local scoped=false
local weaponName=nil
if type(CVU_GetPlayerWeaponName)=="function"then
pcall(function()weaponName=CVU_GetPlayerWeaponName(LocalPlayer)end)
end
if type(weaponName)=="string"then
local compact=string.lower(string.gsub(weaponName,"[^%w]",""))
if compact=="awp"or compact=="ssg08"or string.find(compact,"sniper",1,true)then scoped=true end
end
if not scoped and root and root.Parent then
local function scopeToken(obj)
local n=string.lower(string.gsub((obj and obj.Name)or"","[^%w]",""))
return string.find(n,"sniperscope",1,true)~=nil
or string.find(n,"scope",1,true)~=nil
or string.find(n,"sniper",1,true)~=nil
or n=="awp"or string.find(n,"ssg08",1,true)~=nil
end
if scopeToken(root)then
scoped=true
else
local checked=0
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Model")or obj:IsA("BasePart")or obj:IsA("Folder")or obj:IsA("Attachment")then
checked+=1
if scopeToken(obj)then scoped=true break end
if checked>=220 then break end
end
end
end
end
Runtime.ScopeWeaponCapable=scoped
return scoped
end

-- ADS V3：不再每 0.1 秒掃 PlayerGui:GetDescendants()，
-- 也不再對 ViewModel / Character 做大量遞迴 FindFirstChild。
-- 這兩段就是上一版變卡的主要原因。
Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope=Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope or false
Runtime.ADSCurrentWeaponRoot=Runtime.ADSCurrentWeaponRoot or nil
Runtime.ADSRightMouseDown=Runtime.ADSRightMouseDown or false
Runtime.ADSLatched=Runtime.ADSLatched or false
Runtime.ADSLatchedRoot=Runtime.ADSLatchedRoot or nil
Runtime.ADSScopedSession=Runtime.ADSScopedSession or false
Runtime.ADSLastTogglePress=Runtime.ADSLastTogglePress or 0
Runtime.ADSLastPositive=Runtime.ADSLastPositive or 0
Runtime.ADSRootHasScopeRaw=Runtime.ADSRootHasScopeRaw or false
Runtime.ADSRootChangedAt=Runtime.ADSRootChangedAt or 0
Runtime.ADSRootChangeGraceUntil=Runtime.ADSRootChangeGraceUntil or 0

function CVU_UpdateADSWeaponScopeHint(root)
local now=os.clock()
local rootChanged=Runtime.ADSCurrentWeaponRoot~=root

if rootChanged then
Runtime.ADSCurrentWeaponRoot=root
Runtime.ADSRootChangedAt=now
Runtime.ADSRootChangeGraceUntil=now+0.55

-- 非 ADS 狀態可以直接把 latch root 跟著目前武器走。
-- ADS 中先不要立刻改，因為 BloxStrike 進鏡時可能短暫重建 ViewModel。
if not Runtime.ADSScopedSession then
Runtime.ADSLatchedRoot=root
end
end

local hasScope=next(Runtime.MetalOpticalLensParts or {})~=nil

if not hasScope and root and root.Parent then
local function hasScopeToken(obj)
if not obj then return false end
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(obj.Name)
return string.find(n,"scope",1,true)
or string.find(n,"sniper",1,true)
or string.find(n,"optic",1,true)
or string.find(n,"reddot",1,true)
or string.find(n,"reflex",1,true)
or string.find(n,"holo",1,true)
end

if hasScopeToken(root)then
hasScope=true
else
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if (obj:IsA("Model")or obj:IsA("BasePart")or obj:IsA("Folder"))and hasScopeToken(obj)then
hasScope=true
break
end
end
end
end

-- 這是「目前這棵 root 實際有沒有 scope」的原始結果。
-- 不能被 ADS latch 強行改成 true，否則狙擊槍切手槍後會把手槍永久當成 scoped weapon。
Runtime.ADSRootHasScopeRaw=hasScope

if Runtime.ADSScopedSession and Runtime.ADSLatched then
if hasScope then
-- scoped ViewModel 如果真的重建成另一棵有 scope 的 root，正式接手新的 root。
Runtime.ADSLatchedRoot=root
Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope=true
elseif now<(Runtime.ADSRootChangeGraceUntil or 0)then
-- ViewModel 剛重建的短暫空窗，先保留 0.55 秒，避免真正進鏡時閃回槍管。
Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope=true
else
-- grace 過後仍看不到 scope，就不要再用舊 latch 偽造「目前武器有 scope」。
Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope=false
end
else
Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope=hasScope
end

return Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope
end

function CVU_IsScopedADSActive()
if not Settings.MetalWeapon then return false end

-- 一旦已經確認進入 scoped session，就不能因 ViewModel 重建後暫時抓不到 Lens
-- 而把 ADS 判定掉回 false。
local scopedKnown=(Runtime.ADSScopedSession and Runtime.ADSLatched)
or Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope
or CVU_HasActiveScopedOptic()
if not scopedKnown then return false end

local cam=Workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then
return (Runtime.ADSScopedSession and Runtime.ADSLatched)or Runtime.ADSRightMouseDown==true
end

local now=os.clock()
local fov=tonumber(cam.FieldOfView)or 70
if Runtime.ADSBaseFOV==nil then Runtime.ADSBaseFOV=fov end

local rightDown=Runtime.ADSRightMouseDown==true
if not rightDown then
pcall(function()
rightDown=UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
end)
end

-- FOV 只作為額外訊號，不再拿它當唯一的持續 ADS 判定。
-- 這款遊戲開鏡後 scope UI 仍在，但 FOV / 右鍵狀態會恢復，
-- 所以上一版才會 1~2 秒後把槍管放回來。
if not rightDown and not Runtime.ADSLatched and fov>(Runtime.ADSBaseFOV-3)then
Runtime.ADSBaseFOV=Runtime.ADSBaseFOV*0.92+fov*0.08
end

local zoomed=fov<=math.max(20,(Runtime.ADSBaseFOV or fov)-8)
