CVU_KnifeExpUnbindFeedbackActions()

-- CAS 与游戏武器控制器的触发顺序会随 ViewModel 重建改变。
-- 原始输入监听只负责抢先停止 Inspect，不播放攻击也不吞输入；
-- 后续攻击仍由游戏和上面的状态机决定。
Runtime.KnifeExperienceRawInterruptConnection=
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
if processed
or Runtime.Shutdown
or not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
or not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()
or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then return end
if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return end
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting
or (Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack and Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack.IsPlaying)then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceRawInterruptAt=os.clock()
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpStopInspect,"RawAttackInput")
end
end)

ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionInspect,

10000,
Enum.KeyCode.F

10000,
Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,

)

Runtime.KnifeExperienceFeedbackBound=true
CVU_KnifeExpBuildOriginalKnifeSoundIds()
return true
end

function CVU_SnapshotSkyObject(sky)
    if not sky or not sky:IsA("Sky")then return nil end
    local data={Name=sky.Name}
    for _,key in ipairs({
        "SkyboxBk","SkyboxDn","SkyboxFt","SkyboxLf","SkyboxRt","SkyboxUp",
        "SunTextureId","MoonTextureId","SunAngularSize","MoonAngularSize",
        "StarCount","CelestialBodiesShown",
    })do
        pcall(function()data[key]=sky[key]end)
    end
    return data
end

function CVU_CaptureSkyObjects(snapshot)
    if type(snapshot)~="table"then return end
    snapshot.Skies={}
    for _,obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren())do
        if obj:IsA("Sky")and obj:GetAttribute("CVU_RealSkybox")~=true then
            local data=CVU_SnapshotSkyObject(obj)
            if data then snapshot.Skies[#snapshot.Skies+1]=data end
        end
    end
end

function CVU_DestroyAllSkyObjects()
    for _,obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren())do
        if obj:IsA("Sky")then
            pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)
        end
    end
    CVU_RealSkyboxObject=nil
end

function CVU_RestoreSkyObjects(snapshot)
    if type(snapshot)~="table"then return end
    CVU_DestroyAllSkyObjects()
    for index,data in ipairs(snapshot.Skies or{})do
        local sky=Instance.new("Sky")
        sky.Name=tostring(data.Name or("Sky_"..index))
        for _,key in ipairs({
            "SkyboxBk","SkyboxDn","SkyboxFt","SkyboxLf","SkyboxRt","SkyboxUp",
            "SunTextureId","MoonTextureId","SunAngularSize","MoonAngularSize",
            "StarCount","CelestialBodiesShown",
        })do
            if data[key]~=nil then pcall(function()sky[key]=data[key]end)end
        end
        sky.Parent=Lighting
    end
    CVU_RealSkyboxActive=false
    CVU_RealSkyboxMode=nil
    CVU_RealSkyboxObject=nil
end

function CVU_ApplyRealSkybox(mode)
    local cfg=CVU_RealSkyboxPresets[mode]
    if type(cfg)~="table"then return false end

    if not SkyRestoreSnapshot then CVU_CaptureSkyRestoreState()end

    if not CVU_RealSkyboxActive
    or CVU_RealSkyboxMode~=mode
    or not CVU_RealSkyboxObject
    or not CVU_RealSkyboxObject.Parent then
        CVU_DestroyAllSkyObjects()
        local sky=Instance.new("Sky")
        sky.Name="雞視覺_真Skybox"
        sky:SetAttribute("CVU_RealSkybox",true)
        CVU_RealSkyboxObject=sky
        CVU_RealSkyboxActive=true
        CVU_RealSkyboxMode=mode
        sky.Parent=Lighting
    end

    local sky=CVU_RealSkyboxObject
    for _,key in ipairs({"SkyboxBk","SkyboxDn","SkyboxFt","SkyboxLf","SkyboxRt","SkyboxUp"})do
        if cfg[key]then pcall(function()sky[key]=cfg[key]end)end
    end
    pcall(function()sky.CelestialBodiesShown=cfg.CelestialBodiesShown~=false end)
    pcall(function()sky.StarCount=tonumber(cfg.StarCount)or 0 end)

    Lighting.ClockTime=tonumber(cfg.ClockTime)or Lighting.ClockTime
    Lighting.Brightness=tonumber(cfg.Brightness)or Lighting.Brightness
    Lighting.ExposureCompensation=tonumber(cfg.Exposure)or 0
    if typeof(cfg.Ambient)=="Color3"then Lighting.Ambient=cfg.Ambient end
    if typeof(cfg.OutdoorAmbient)=="Color3"then Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=cfg.OutdoorAmbient end

    return true
end

function CVU_LeaveRealSkyboxIfNeeded()
    if CVU_RealSkyboxActive and SkyRestoreSnapshot then
        CVU_RestoreSkyObjects(SkyRestoreSnapshot)
    end
end

function CVU_IsOwnedSkyEffect(object)
    if not object then return false end
    local owned=false
    pcall(function()owned=object:GetAttribute("CVU_SkyEffect")==true end)
    return owned
        or object.Name=="雞視覺_天空"
        or object.Name=="雞視覺_天空光暈"
end

function CVU_DestroyStaleSkyEffects(keepAtmosphere,keepBloom)
    for _,object in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren())do
        if object~=keepAtmosphere and object~=keepBloom and CVU_IsOwnedSkyEffect(object)then
            pcall(function()object:Destroy()end)
        end
    end
end

function CVU_EnsureSkyEffects()
    -- 先清掉舊腳本/重複執行留下來的天空物件，避免關閉後還有另一份 Atmosphere/Bloom 留著。
    CVU_DestroyStaleSkyEffects(SkyAtmosphere,SkyBloom)

    if not SkyAtmosphere or not SkyAtmosphere.Parent then
        SkyAtmosphere=Instance.new("Atmosphere")
        SkyAtmosphere.Name="雞視覺_天空"
        SkyAtmosphere:SetAttribute("CVU_SkyEffect",true)
        SkyAtmosphere.Parent=Lighting
    end
    if not SkyBloom or not SkyBloom.Parent then
        SkyBloom=Instance.new("BloomEffect")
        SkyBloom.Name="雞視覺_天空光暈"
        SkyBloom:SetAttribute("CVU_SkyEffect",true)
        SkyBloom.Parent=Lighting
    end
end

function CVU_ClearSkyEffects()
    -- 不只清 local reference，也掃 Lighting，把舊版本殘留的同名天空物件一起刪掉。
    CVU_DestroyStaleSkyEffects(nil,nil)
    if SkyAtmosphere and SkyAtmosphere.Parent then pcall(function()SkyAtmosphere:Destroy()end)end
    if SkyBloom and SkyBloom.Parent then pcall(function()SkyBloom:Destroy()end)end
    SkyAtmosphere=nil
    SkyBloom=nil
end

function CVU_CaptureSkyRestoreState()
    if SkyRestoreSnapshot then return end
    SkyRestoreSnapshot={
        ClockTime=Lighting.ClockTime,
        Brightness=Lighting.Brightness,
        ExposureCompensation=Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
        Ambient=Lighting.Ambient,
        OutdoorAmbient=Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
        FogColor=Lighting.FogColor,
        FogStart=Lighting.FogStart,
        FogEnd=Lighting.FogEnd,
        ColorShift_Top=Lighting.ColorShift_Top,
        ColorShift_Bottom=Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom,
    }
    CVU_CaptureSkyObjects(SkyRestoreSnapshot)
end

function CVU_ApplyLightingSnapshot(o)
    if not o then return end
    if o.ClockTime~=nil then Lighting.ClockTime=o.ClockTime end
    if o.Brightness~=nil then Lighting.Brightness=o.Brightness end
    if o.ExposureCompensation~=nil then Lighting.ExposureCompensation=o.ExposureCompensation end
    if o.Ambient~=nil then Lighting.Ambient=o.Ambient end
    if o.OutdoorAmbient~=nil then Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=o.OutdoorAmbient end
    if o.FogColor~=nil then Lighting.FogColor=o.FogColor end
    if o.FogStart~=nil then Lighting.FogStart=o.FogStart end
    if o.FogEnd~=nil then Lighting.FogEnd=o.FogEnd end
    if o.ColorShift_Top~=nil then Lighting.ColorShift_Top=o.ColorShift_Top end
    if o.ColorShift_Bottom~=nil then Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom=o.ColorShift_Bottom end
end

function CVU_RestoreSkyOriginalState()
    SkyRestoreGeneration+=1
    local generation=SkyRestoreGeneration
    local snapshot=SkyRestoreSnapshot or Runtime.OriginalLighting

    CVU_ClearSkyEffects()
    CVU_RestoreSkyObjects(snapshot)
    CVU_ApplyLightingSnapshot(snapshot)
    SkyRestoreSnapshot=nil

    -- 有些遊戲/舊版 CVU 會在同一幀晚一點再改 Lighting；下一幀再驗證一次。
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait()
        if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
        if Settings.Skybox then return end
        if generation~=SkyRestoreGeneration then return end
        CVU_ClearSkyEffects()
        CVU_RestoreSkyObjects(snapshot)
        CVU_ApplyLightingSnapshot(snapshot)
        if Settings.Fog then pcall(CVU_EnsureFog)end
    end)
end

function CVU_DestroyWeatherObjectsByName(kind)
local names
if kind=="rain"then
names={
["雞視覺_下雨"]=true,
["雞視覺_雨天色調"]=true,
["CVU_Rain"]=true,
["CVU_RainPart"]=true,
["CVU_RainColor"]=true,
}
else
names={
["雞視覺_下雪"]=true,
["CVU_Snow"]=true,
["CVU_SnowPart"]=true,
}
end
for _,root in ipairs({Workspace,Lighting})do
for _,object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if names[object.Name]then
pcall(function()object:Destroy()end)
end
end
end
end

function CVU_ClearRain()
CVU_RainCleanupGeneration+=1
local generation=CVU_RainCleanupGeneration
if RainPart then pcall(function()RainPart:Destroy()end)RainPart=nil end
if RainColorEffect then pcall(function()RainColorEffect:Destroy()end)RainColorEffect=nil end
CVU_DestroyWeatherObjectsByName("rain")
for _,delayTime in ipairs({0,0.05,0.18,0.40})do
task.delay(delayTime,function()
if generation~=CVU_RainCleanupGeneration or Settings.Rain then return end
CVU_DestroyWeatherObjectsByName("rain")
end)
end
end

function CVU_ClearSnow()
CVU_SnowCleanupGeneration+=1
local generation=CVU_SnowCleanupGeneration
if SnowPart then pcall(function()SnowPart:Destroy()end)SnowPart=nil end
CVU_DestroyWeatherObjectsByName("snow")
for _,delayTime in ipairs({0,0.05,0.18,0.40})do
task.delay(delayTime,function()
if generation~=CVU_SnowCleanupGeneration or Settings.Snow then return end
CVU_DestroyWeatherObjectsByName("snow")
end)
end
end

-- Clean leftovers from older CVU copies even when the saved toggle starts OFF.
if not Settings.Rain then pcall(CVU_ClearRain)end
if not Settings.Snow then pcall(CVU_ClearSnow)end

local CVU_ThirdPersonCharacterConnections={}
local CVU_ThirdPersonAimAttributes={"IsScoped","Scoped","IsAiming","Aiming","ADS"}

local function CVU_HasThirdPersonAimAttribute(object)
 if not object then return false end
 for _,key in ipairs(CVU_ThirdPersonAimAttributes)do
 if object:GetAttribute(key)==true then return true end
 end
 return false
end

function CVU_KeepThirdPersonCharacterVisible()
-- 第三人稱開啟時固定顯示本機角色。
if not Settings.ThirdPersonMode then return end

local character=LocalPlayer.Character
if not character then return end

 if Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheCharacter~=character then
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheDirty=true
 end
 if Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheDirty then
 CVU_RebuildThirdPersonCache(character)
 end

 for _,object in ipairs(Runtime.ThirdPersonVisibleParts or {})do
 if object.Parent and object:IsDescendantOf(character)then
 local saved=Runtime.ThirdPersonModelState[object]

if not saved then
saved={
Transparency=object.Transparency,
LocalTransparencyModifier=object.LocalTransparencyModifier,
}
Runtime.ThirdPersonModelState[object]=saved
end

local headHidden=Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeHeadParts
and Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeHeadParts[object]~=nil
 if headHidden then
 if object.LocalTransparencyModifier~=1 then object.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end
 if object.Transparency~=1 then object.Transparency=1 end
continue
end

-- Roblox / 遊戲第一人稱 CameraScript 若又把自己人物設成 LTM=1，
-- 第三人稱期間每幀保持本機角色可見。
if object.LocalTransparencyModifier>0.01 then
object.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
end

-- 只恢復原本可見、後來才被完全隱藏的零件。
-- HumanoidRootPart 或原本就透明的輔助零件不會被硬顯示。
if saved.Transparency<0.95 and object.Transparency>=0.95 then
object.Transparency=saved.Transparency
end
end
end
end

function CVU_RestoreThirdPersonHead()
 local hiddenParts=Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeHeadParts
 if not hiddenParts then
 Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeHeadParts={}
 return
 end
 for part,value in pairs(hiddenParts)do
 if part.Parent then
if type(value)=="table"then
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=value.LocalTransparencyModifier
part.Transparency=value.Transparency
else
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=value
end
 end
 end
 table.clear(hiddenParts)
end

function CVU_GetThirdPersonHeadParts(character,humanoid)
local result={}local seen={}
local function add(part)
if part and part:IsA("BasePart")and not seen[part]then seen[part]=true result[#result+1]=part end
end
-- Head is the official R6/R15 name. GetBodyPartR15 also supports standard
-- packages whose visual mesh is not found reliably by a direct path lookup.
add(character and character:FindFirstChild("Head"))
add(character and character:FindFirstChild("CollisionHead"))
if character and humanoid then
for _,part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do
if part:IsA("BasePart")then
local ok,bodyPart=pcall(function()return humanoid:GetBodyPartR15(part)end)
if ok and bodyPart==Enum.BodyPartR15.Head then add(part)end
end
end
end
if character then
for _,part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do
if part:IsA("BasePart")then
local name=part.Name:lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
if name=="head"or name=="collisionhead"or name=="characterhead"then add(part)end
end
end
end
-- Standard Neck Motor6D points to the actual head part in both common rigs.
if character then
for _,joint in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do
if joint:IsA("Motor6D")and joint.Name:lower():find("neck",1,true)then add(joint.Part1)end
end
end
return result
end

function CVU_DisconnectThirdPersonCharacterCache()
 for _,connection in ipairs(CVU_ThirdPersonCharacterConnections)do
 connection:Disconnect()
 end
 table.clear(CVU_ThirdPersonCharacterConnections)
end

function CVU_RebuildThirdPersonCache(character)
 character=character or LocalPlayer.Character
 if not character then return end

 local visibleParts={}
 for _,object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do
 if object:IsA("BasePart")and object.Name~="HumanoidRootPart"then
 visibleParts[#visibleParts+1]=object
 end
 end

 local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local heads=CVU_GetThirdPersonHeadParts(character,humanoid)
 local headSet={}
 local headHideParts={}
 local function addHeadPart(part)
 if part and part:IsA("BasePart")and not headSet[part]then
 headSet[part]=true
 headHideParts[#headHideParts+1]=part
 end
 end
 for _,head in ipairs(heads)do
 addHeadPart(head)
 for _,object in ipairs(head:GetDescendants())do addHeadPart(object)end
 end
 for _,accessory in ipairs(character:GetChildren())do
 if accessory:IsA("Accessory")then
 local handle=accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
 if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")then
 local onHead=false
 for _,joint in ipairs(handle:GetChildren())do
 if joint:IsA("Weld")or joint:IsA("Motor6D")or joint:IsA("WeldConstraint")then
 if headSet[joint.Part0]or headSet[joint.Part1]then onHead=true break end
 elseif joint:IsA("Attachment")then
 for _,head in ipairs(heads)do
 if head:FindFirstChild(joint.Name)then onHead=true break end
 end
 end
 if onHead then break end
 end
 if onHead then addHeadPart(handle)end
 end
 end
 end

 Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheCharacter=character
 Runtime.ThirdPersonVisibleParts=visibleParts
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCachedHeads=heads
 Runtime.ThirdPersonHeadHideParts=headHideParts
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheDirty=false
end

function CVU_BindThirdPersonCharacterCache(character)
 CVU_DisconnectThirdPersonCharacterCache()
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheDirty=true
 CVU_RebuildThirdPersonCache(character)
 if not character then return end
 CVU_ThirdPersonCharacterConnections[#CVU_ThirdPersonCharacterConnections+1]=character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function()
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheDirty=true
 end)
 CVU_ThirdPersonCharacterConnections[#CVU_ThirdPersonCharacterConnections+1]=character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function()
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheDirty=true
 end)
end

function CVU_UpdateThirdPersonHead()
 local character=LocalPlayer.Character
 local camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera
 local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if character and(Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheCharacter~=character or Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheDirty)then
 CVU_RebuildThirdPersonCache(character)
 end
 local heads=Runtime.ThirdPersonCachedHeads or{}
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.ThirdPersonMode or #heads==0 or not camera or(humanoid and humanoid.Health<=0)then
CVU_RestoreThirdPersonHead()return
 end
 local vm=CVU_GetViewModel()
 local aiming=CVU_HasThirdPersonAimAttribute(character)
 or(vm~=character and CVU_HasThirdPersonAimAttribute(vm))
do
local base=Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeBaseFOV or 70
local zoomed=camera.FieldOfView<base-7
local rightDown=Runtime.ThirdPersonAimHeld==true
or UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2)
 local cachedMask=Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeMask
 local mayNeedMask=aiming or zoomed or rightDown
 or(cachedMask and cachedMask.Parent and CVU_IsLikelyScopeBlackoutGui(cachedMask))
 if mayNeedMask and os.clock()>=(Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeNextScan or 0)then
 Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeNextScan=os.clock()+.35
Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeMask=CVU_FindVisibleScopeBlackout()
end
local maskObject=Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeMask
local mask=maskObject and maskObject.Parent and CVU_IsLikelyScopeBlackoutGui(maskObject)or false
aiming=aiming or mask or zoomed or rightDown
if not aiming then Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeBaseFOV=math.max(base,camera.FieldOfView)end
end
local firing=Runtime.ThirdPersonFireHeld==true
or UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
or os.clock()<(Runtime.ThirdPersonFireUntil or 0)
if not aiming and not firing then CVU_RestoreThirdPersonHead()return end
Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeHeadParts=Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeHeadParts or {}
 local function hide(part)
 if not part:IsA("BasePart")then return end
if Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeHeadParts[part]==nil then
Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeHeadParts[part]={
LocalTransparencyModifier=part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
Transparency=part.Transparency,
}
end
 if part.LocalTransparencyModifier~=1 then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end
 if part.Transparency~=1 then part.Transparency=1 end
 end
 for _,part in ipairs(Runtime.ThirdPersonHeadHideParts or heads)do hide(part)end
end

function CVU_RestoreThirdPersonCharacterState()
CVU_RestoreThirdPersonHead()
for object,saved in pairs(Runtime.ThirdPersonModelState)do
if object and object.Parent and saved then
object.Transparency=saved.Transparency
object.LocalTransparencyModifier=saved.LocalTransparencyModifier
end
Runtime.ThirdPersonModelState[object]=nil
end
end

function CVU_StartThirdPerson()
local character=LocalPlayer.Character
if not character or not character.Parent then return false end
Runtime.ThirdPersonCharacter=character
Runtime.ThirdPersonScopeBaseFOV=(Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView)or 70
 Runtime.ThirdPersonModelState=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 CVU_RestoreFirstPersonCharacterModel()
 CVU_RestoreCharacterArms()
 CVU_BindThirdPersonCharacterCache(character)
 CVU_KeepThirdPersonCharacterVisible()
return true
end

function CVU_StopThirdPerson()
 CVU_DisconnectThirdPersonCharacterCache()
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCharacter=nil
 CVU_RestoreThirdPersonCharacterState()
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheCharacter=nil
 Runtime.ThirdPersonVisibleParts={}
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCachedHeads={}
 Runtime.ThirdPersonHeadHideParts={}
 Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheDirty=false
pcall(CVU_HideFirstPersonCharacterModel)
end

function CVU_SetThirdPerson(v)
Runtime.ThirdPersonGeneration+=1
Settings.ThirdPersonMode=v==true
if Settings.ThirdPersonMode then
CVU_StartThirdPerson()
else
CVU_StopThirdPerson()
end
end
local CVU_ThirdPersonRaycastParams=RaycastParams.new()
local CVU_ThirdPersonInputConnections={}
CVU_ThirdPersonInputConnections[1]=UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
Runtime.ThirdPersonFireHeld=true
Runtime.ThirdPersonFireUntil=os.clock()+.20
elseif input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
Runtime.ThirdPersonAimHeld=true
end
end)
CVU_ThirdPersonInputConnections[2]=UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
Runtime.ThirdPersonFireHeld=false
Runtime.ThirdPersonFireUntil=os.clock()+.12
elseif input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
Runtime.ThirdPersonAimHeld=false
end
end)
GUI.Destroying:Connect(function()
for _,connection in ipairs(CVU_ThirdPersonInputConnections)do connection:Disconnect()end
RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_ThirdPersonVisibility")
pcall(CVU_StopThirdPerson)
end)
pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_ThirdPersonVisibility")end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_ThirdPersonVisibility",Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+10,function(dt)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.ThirdPersonMode then
Runtime.ThirdPersonVisibilityClock=0
CVU_RestoreThirdPersonHead()return
end
Runtime.ThirdPersonVisibilityClock=(Runtime.ThirdPersonVisibilityClock or 0)+(dt or 0)
if Runtime.ThirdPersonCacheDirty or Runtime.ThirdPersonVisibilityClock>=.08 then
Runtime.ThirdPersonVisibilityClock=0
CVU_KeepThirdPersonCharacterVisible()
end
CVU_UpdateThirdPersonHead()
end)
CVU_ThirdPersonRaycastParams.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
CVU_ThirdPersonRaycastParams.IgnoreWater=true

function CVU_UpdateThirdPersonCamera()
 if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.ThirdPersonMode then return end
 Camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera
local character=LocalPlayer.Character
if not character or not Camera then return end

local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not root then return end

local current=Camera.CFrame

-- 相機錨點固定使用 HumanoidRootPart + 固定高度。
-- 不使用 Head.Position，避免頭部動畫造成第三人稱鏡頭與準星偏移。
local pivotPosition=root.Position+Vector3.new(0,1.65,0)
local distance=math.clamp(Settings.ThirdPersonDistance or 12,2,35)

-- 直接沿 Roblox 原本算好的視角往後移，不改滑鼠朝向，也不改遊戲的 Zoom 設定。
local desiredPosition=pivotPosition-current.LookVector*distance

-- 防止第三人稱鏡頭穿牆。
 if Runtime.ThirdPersonRaycastCharacter~=character then
 Runtime.ThirdPersonRaycastCharacter=character
 CVU_ThirdPersonRaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances={character}
 end
local rayDirection=desiredPosition-pivotPosition
local hit=Workspace:Raycast(pivotPosition,rayDirection,CVU_ThirdPersonRaycastParams)
if hit then
desiredPosition=hit.Position+hit.Normal*.35
end

-- 只覆蓋鏡頭位置，旋轉完全沿用原遊戲 CameraScript 的結果。
Camera.CFrame=CFrame.new(desiredPosition)*current.Rotation
end


-- ============================================================
-- Active-match character gate
-- BloxStrike puts real round participants under:
-- workspace.Characters["Counter-Terrorists"] / workspace.Characters.Terrorists
-- Lobby/menu showcase characters are outside this tree and must never receive ESP.
-- ============================================================
function CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter(player)
if not player or player.Parent~=Players then return nil end

local function activeTeamName(value)
local s=tostring(value or"")
return s=="Counter-Terrorists"or s=="Terrorists"or s=="CT"or s=="T"
end

local direct=player.Character
if direct and (not direct:IsA("Model")or not direct.Parent or not direct:IsDescendantOf(Workspace))then direct=nil end

-- First trust BloxStrike's real round-character tree.  Do not require Player.Character
-- to be parented there because some builds keep Player.Character elsewhere while the
-- replicated combat model lives under workspace.Characters.
local characters=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
if characters then
for _,teamName in ipairs({"Counter-Terrorists","Terrorists"})do
local folder=characters:FindFirstChild(teamName)
if folder then
if direct and direct:IsDescendantOf(folder)then return direct end

local byName=folder:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
if byName and byName:IsA("Model")then return byName end

-- A few BloxStrike builds/nameplates do not use the Roblox username as the model
-- name.  Resolve those models by ownership metadata instead of hiding ESP entirely.
for _,candidate in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do
if candidate:IsA("Model")then
local owner=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(candidate)
if owner==player then return candidate end
local uid=candidate:GetAttribute("UserId")or candidate:GetAttribute("PlayerUserId")
if tonumber(uid)==player.UserId then return candidate end
local ownerName=candidate:GetAttribute("PlayerName")or candidate:GetAttribute("Username")
if type(ownerName)=="string"and ownerName==player.Name then return candidate end
end
end
end
end
end

-- Fallback for builds where the real combat character remains Player.Character.
-- Require explicit round-team assignment so lobby/menu showcase avatars stay hidden.
local teamAttr=player:GetAttribute("Team")
local teamObject=player.Team and player.Team.Name or nil
if (activeTeamName(teamAttr)or activeTeamName(teamObject))and direct and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(direct)==player then
return direct
end
return nil
end

function CVU_IsFirstPersonWeaponVisual(obj)
if not obj then return false end

local currentCamera=Workspace.CurrentCamera
if currentCamera and (obj==currentCamera or obj:IsDescendantOf(currentCamera))then
return true
end

local ancestor=obj
while ancestor and ancestor~=Workspace do
local n=string.gsub(string.lower(ancestor.Name or ""),"[^%w]","")
if n=="viewmodel"
or n=="viewmodels"
or n=="firstperson"
or n=="firstpersonmodel"
or n=="fpsviewmodel"
or n=="weaponviewmodel"
or n=="arms"
or n=="viewarms"
or n=="fpsarms" then
return true
end

if ancestor:GetAttribute("ViewModel")==true
or ancestor:GetAttribute("IsViewModel")==true
or ancestor:GetAttribute("FirstPerson")==true
or ancestor:GetAttribute("IsFirstPerson")==true then
return true
end

ancestor=ancestor.Parent
end

return false
end

function CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(obj)
if not obj then return false end
local ancestor=obj
while ancestor and ancestor~=Workspace do
if CVU_WeaponESPCharacterSet[ancestor]then return true end
if ancestor:IsA("Model")and ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")then return true end
ancestor=ancestor.Parent
end
return false
end

function CVU_IsAttachedToCharacter(root)
if not root then return false end
-- Joints can be parented to the hand rather than the weapon.
local parts=root:GetDescendants()
if root:IsA("BasePart")then parts[#parts+1]=root end
for _,part in ipairs(parts)do
if part:IsA("BasePart")then
for _,connected in ipairs(part:GetConnectedParts(true))do
if CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(connected)or CVU_IsFirstPersonWeaponVisual(connected)then return true end
end
end
end
for _,joint in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if joint:IsA("Weld")or joint:IsA("WeldConstraint")or joint:IsA("Motor6D")then
local p0=joint.Part0 local p1=joint.Part1
if (p0 and CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(p0))or(p1 and CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(p1))then return true end
elseif joint:IsA("Constraint")then
local ok,a0,a1=pcall(function()return joint.Attachment0,joint.Attachment1 end)
if not ok then continue end
if (a0 and CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(a0))or(a1 and CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(a1))then return true end
end
end
return false
end

function CVU_IsLooseDroppedWeapon(root)
if not root or not root.Parent or not root:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)then
return false
end

-- 武器透視只允許世界掉落物；第一人稱 Camera/ViewModel 永遠不是地板武器。
if CVU_IsFirstPersonWeaponVisual(root)then
return false
end

if CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(root)then
return false
end

if root:GetAttribute("CanPickup")==false then return false end

for _,attr in ipairs({"Equipped","IsEquipped","Held","IsHeld"})do
if root:GetAttribute(attr)==true then
return false
end
end

-- Owner/OwnerName can record the previous owner of a dropped item.
for _,attr in ipairs({"EquippedBy","Holder"})do
local v=root:GetAttribute(attr)
if typeof(v)=="Instance"and v.Parent then
return false
elseif type(v)=="string"and v~=""then
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if v==player.Name or v==player.DisplayName then
return false
end
end
end
end

if CVU_IsAttachedToCharacter(root)then
return false
end

return true
end

function CVU_IsWeaponESPCandidateFast(obj)
if not obj or not obj.Parent then return false end

-- BloxStrike 的真正掉落武器來源非常明確：
-- Workspace.Debris 的直接子 Model，必須同時具有 Weapon 字串與 CanPickup=true。
-- 不再用「名稱像武器」判斷，否則地圖道具（洗手台、裝飾 Mesh、碰撞箱）
-- 只要名稱剛好含有 T / Glove / AUG 等 token 就可能被誤標。
local debris=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
if not debris then return false end
if obj.Parent~=debris or not obj:IsA("Model")then return false end
if obj:GetAttribute("CanPickup")~=true then return false end

local weapon=obj:GetAttribute("Weapon")
if type(weapon)~="string"or weapon==""then return false end

local visual=obj:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
if not(visual and visual:IsA("Model"))then return false end
if CVU_IsFirstPersonWeaponVisual(obj)then return false end
if CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(obj)then return false end
return true
end

function CVU_GetDroppedWeaponRoot(obj)
if not obj then return nil end
local debris=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
if not debris then return nil end

-- 事件有時會先收到掉落武器裡面的 Part/Model；往上找 Debris 的直接子 wrapper。
local root=obj
while root and root.Parent and root.Parent~=debris and root~=Workspace do
root=root.Parent
end
if not root or root.Parent~=debris then return nil end
if not CVU_IsWeaponESPCandidateFast(root)then return nil end
if not CVU_IsLooseDroppedWeapon(root)then return nil end
return root
end

function CVU_GetDroppedWeaponName(root)
if not root then return"未知武器"end

for _,attr in ipairs({"Weapon","WeaponName","ItemName","GunName","DisplayName"})do
local v=root:GetAttribute(attr)
if type(v)=="string"and v~=""then
return v
end
end

if CVU_NormalizeWeaponName then
local normalized=CVU_NormalizeWeaponName(root.Name)
if normalized then return normalized end
end

local name=root.Name
name=string.gsub(name,"^Dropped[_%s%-]*","")
name=string.gsub(name,"^Weapon[_%s%-]*","")
if name==""then name="未知武器"end
return name
end

function CVU_GetDroppedWeaponPart(root)
if not root then return nil end
local visual=root:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
if visual and visual:IsA("Model")then
local handle=visual:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")and handle.Transparency<1 then return handle end
for _,part in ipairs(visual:GetDescendants())do
if part:IsA("BasePart")and part.Transparency<1 then return part end
end
end

if root:IsA("Tool")then
return root:FindFirstChild("Handle")or root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
elseif root:IsA("Model")then
return root.PrimaryPart or root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
elseif root:IsA("BasePart")then
return root
end

return nil
end

function CVU_CreateWeaponESP(root)
if not root or CVU_WeaponESPObjects[root]then return end

local h=Instance.new("Highlight")
h.Name="DroppedWeaponHighlight"
h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
h.FillTransparency=1
h.OutlineTransparency=0
h.Enabled=false
h.Adornee=root:FindFirstChild("Weapon")or root
h.Parent=GUI

local bill=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
bill.Name="DroppedWeaponBillboard"
bill.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(220,42)
bill.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,1.3,0)
bill.AlwaysOnTop=true
bill.ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
bill.Enabled=false
bill.Parent=GUI

local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
label.BackgroundTransparency=1
label.TextColor3=Settings.WeaponESPColor
label.TextStrokeTransparency=.4
label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
label.TextSize=13
label.ZIndex=100012
label.Parent=bill

local row=Instance.new("TextLabel")
row.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,27)
row.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(35,35,41)
row.BackgroundTransparency=.08
row.BorderSizePixel=0
row.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(238,238,242)
row.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
row.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
row.TextSize=12
row.Visible=false
row.ZIndex=100012
row.Parent=CVU_WeaponESPList
local rc=Instance.new("UICorner")
rc.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)
rc.Parent=row

local ancestryConn
ancestryConn=root.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if not root.Parent
or not root:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
or CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(root)
or CVU_IsFirstPersonWeaponVisual(root)then
CVU_DestroyWeaponESP(root)
end
end)

CVU_WeaponESPObjects[root]={
Highlight=h,
Billboard=bill,
Label=label,
Row=row,
AncestryConnection=ancestryConn,
}
end

function CVU_DestroyWeaponESP(root)
local data=CVU_WeaponESPObjects[root]
if not data then return end

for _,o in pairs(data)do
if typeof(o)=="Instance"and o.Parent then
o:Destroy()
elseif typeof(o)=="RBXScriptConnection"then
pcall(function()o:Disconnect()end)
end
end

CVU_WeaponESPObjects[root]=nil
end

function CVU_RegisterDroppedWeapon(obj)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.WeaponESP then return end
if not CVU_IsWeaponESPCandidateFast(obj)then return end
local root=CVU_GetDroppedWeaponRoot(obj)
if root then
local meta=CVU_WeaponESPCandidates[root]
if not meta then
CVU_WeaponESPCandidates[root]={Part=CVU_GetDroppedWeaponPart(root),Name=CVU_GetDroppedWeaponName(root)}
end
end
end

function CVU_StartDroppedWeaponInitialScan()
CVU_WeaponESPScanGeneration+=1
local generation=CVU_WeaponESPScanGeneration
task.spawn(function()
local debris=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
if not debris then return end

-- 只掃 BloxStrike 真正的掉落武器容器；不再 BFS 全 Workspace。
local children=debris:GetChildren()
for index,child in ipairs(children)do
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.WeaponESP or generation~=CVU_WeaponESPScanGeneration then return end
if child:IsA("Model")then CVU_RegisterDroppedWeapon(child)end
if index%20==0 then RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()end
end
end)
end

function CVU_SetWeaponESP(v)
Settings.WeaponESP=v==true
CVU_WeaponESPScanGeneration+=1
CVU_WeaponESPUpdateClock=0
CVU_WeaponESPValidateClock=0

if Settings.WeaponESP then
CVU_StartDroppedWeaponInitialScan()
else
CVU_WeaponESPPanel.Visible=false
local roots={}
for root in pairs(CVU_WeaponESPObjects)do roots[#roots+1]=root end
for _,root in ipairs(roots)do CVU_DestroyWeaponESP(root)end
CVU_WeaponESPCandidates=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
end
end

-- 新掉落物只做事件式檢查，不再全 Workspace 輪詢。
local CVU_WeaponESPAddedConnection=Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.WeaponESP then return end
if not(obj:IsA("Model")or obj:IsA("BasePart"))then return end

task.delay(.08,function()
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.WeaponESP then return end
local root=CVU_GetDroppedWeaponRoot(obj)
if root then CVU_RegisterDroppedWeapon(root)end
end)
end)

local CVU_WeaponESPCharacterConnections={}
function CVU_BindWeaponESPCharacter(character)
-- BloxStrike 掉槍後會由遊戲建立 Workspace.Debris wrapper；
-- 不再把 Character.ChildRemoved 當成掉落武器來源，避免手套/手臂零件被誤判。
return
end

for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if player.Character then
CVU_BindWeaponESPCharacter(player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(CVU_BindWeaponESPCharacter)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(CVU_BindWeaponESPCharacter)
end)

local CVU_WEAPON_ESP_ACTIVE_DISTANCE=500
local CVU_WeaponESPRescanClock=0
function CVU_UpdateWeaponESP(dt)
if not Settings.WeaponESP then return end
CVU_WeaponESPRescanClock+=(dt or 0)
if CVU_WeaponESPRescanClock>=.8 then
CVU_WeaponESPRescanClock=0
CVU_StartDroppedWeaponInitialScan()
end
CVU_WeaponESPUpdateClock+=(dt or 0)
CVU_WeaponESPValidateClock+=(dt or 0)
if CVU_WeaponESPUpdateClock<.20 then return end
CVU_WeaponESPUpdateClock=0
local doSlowValidate=false
if CVU_WeaponESPValidateClock>=3.0 then CVU_WeaponESPValidateClock=0 doSlowValidate=true end
local panelMode=Settings.WeaponESPDisplayMode=="右側列表"
CVU_WeaponESPPanel.Visible=panelMode
local rows={}
for root,meta in pairs(CVU_WeaponESPCandidates)do
if not root or not root.Parent or not root:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)then
if root then CVU_DestroyWeaponESP(root)end
CVU_WeaponESPCandidates[root]=nil
continue
end
local part=meta and meta.Part
if not part or not part.Parent or (part~=root and not part:IsDescendantOf(root))then
part=CVU_GetDroppedWeaponPart(root)
if meta then meta.Part=part end
end
if not part then
CVU_DestroyWeaponESP(root)
if doSlowValidate then CVU_WeaponESPCandidates[root]=nil end
continue
end
local distance=(Camera.CFrame.Position-part.Position).Magnitude
local near=distance<=CVU_WEAPON_ESP_ACTIVE_DISTANCE
local active=CVU_WeaponESPObjects[root]~=nil
-- 遠距離候選物只保留一筆 Lua 資料，不建立 Highlight/Billboard；靠近才建立。
if active or near or doSlowValidate then
if CVU_IsFirstPersonWeaponVisual(root)or CVU_IsInsidePlayerCharacterFast(root)then
CVU_DestroyWeaponESP(root) CVU_WeaponESPCandidates[root]=nil continue
end
end
if near and (not CVU_IsWeaponESPCandidateFast(root)or not CVU_IsLooseDroppedWeapon(root))then
CVU_DestroyWeaponESP(root) CVU_WeaponESPCandidates[root]=nil continue
end
if not near then
if active then CVU_DestroyWeaponESP(root)end
continue
end
if not active then CVU_CreateWeaponESP(root)end
local data=CVU_WeaponESPObjects[root]
if not data then continue end
local name=(meta and meta.Name)or CVU_GetDroppedWeaponName(root)
if meta and not meta.Name then meta.Name=name end
local screen,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
local visible=onScreen and screen.Z>0
local weaponVisual=root:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
data.Highlight.Adornee=weaponVisual and weaponVisual:IsA("Model")and weaponVisual or root
data.Highlight.OutlineColor=Settings.WeaponESPColor
data.Highlight.FillTransparency=1
data.Highlight.OutlineTransparency=0
data.Highlight.Enabled=visible
data.Billboard.Adornee=part
data.Billboard.Enabled=(not panelMode)and visible
data.Label.Text=string.format("%s  ·  %dm",name,math.floor(distance))
data.Label.TextColor3=Settings.WeaponESPColor
data.Row.Text="   "..name.."    "..math.floor(distance).."m"
data.Row.Visible=panelMode
rows[#rows+1]={Data=data,Distance=distance}
end
if panelMode then
table.sort(rows,function(a,b)return a.Distance<b.Distance end)
for index,item in ipairs(rows)do item.Data.Row.LayoutOrder=index end
end
end

08",["AWP"]="AWP",}function CVU_EnsureEnemyWeaponNameIndex()
local folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder
if not folder and type(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData)=="function"then pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder end
if Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameIndexFolder==folder and Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameTokens then return end
Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameIndexFolder=folder
Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameTokens={}
Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameExact={}
local function addToken(source,canonical)
if type(source)~="string"or source==""or type(canonical)~="string"or canonical==""then return end
local words=string.upper(source):gsub("[^%w]+"," "):gsub("%s+"," "):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
local compact=string.upper(source):gsub("[^%w]","")
if compact==""then return end
Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameExact[compact]=canonical
Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameTokens[#Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameTokens+1]={Words=words,Compact=compact,Name=canonical}
end
for alias,canonical in pairs(WeaponAliases)do addToken(alias,canonical)end
for canonical in pairs(CombatWeaponData)do addToken(canonical,canonical)end
if folder then
for _,obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do
if obj:IsA("Folder")or obj:IsA("Model")then addToken(obj.Name,obj.Name)end
end
end
table.sort(Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameTokens,function(a,b)return #a.Compact>#b.Compact end)
end

function CVU_NormalizeWeaponName(name)
if type(name)~="string"or name==""then return nil end
CVU_EnsureEnemyWeaponNameIndex()
local words=string.upper(name):gsub("[^%w]+"," "):gsub("%s+"," "):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
local compact=string.upper(name):gsub("[^%w]","")
local exact=Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameExact and Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameExact[compact]
if exact then return exact end
local padded=" "..words.." "
for _,entry in ipairs(Runtime.EnemyWeaponNameTokens or{})do
if entry.Words~=""and string.find(padded," "..entry.Words.." ",1,true)then return entry.Name end
local token=entry.Compact
if #token>=4 and string.find(compact,token,1,true)then return entry.Name end
if #token<4 and(compact==token or string.sub(compact,1,#token)==token or string.sub(compact,-#token)==token)then return entry.Name end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_UpdateESP(dt)
if not Settings.ESP then
CVU_ESPUpdateClock=0
if CVU_ESPWasEnabled then
CVU_ESPWasEnabled=false
for _,data in pairs(ESPObjects)do CVU_HideESP(data)end
end
return
end
CVU_ESPWasEnabled=true
CVU_ESPUpdateClock+=(dt or 0)
if CVU_ESPUpdateClock<.05 then return end
CVU_ESPUpdateClock=0
CVU_UpdateESPImmediate()
end

-- ESP screen-space projection is separated from the slower data refresh.
-- BillboardGui/Highlight follow 3D objects by themselves, but Health/Skeleton are 2D Frames and
-- must be reprojected after the camera has finished rotating every rendered frame.
function CVU_UpdateESPProjection()
if not Settings.ESP or not Camera then return end
if not Settings.ESPHealth and not Settings.ESPSkeleton then return end

for player,data in pairs(ESPObjects)do
if player.Parent~=Players or not CVU_ShouldShowESP(player)then
if data.Health then data.Health.Visible=false end
for _,line in ipairs(data.Skeleton)do line.Visible=false end
continue
end

local character=CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter(player)
local root=character and(character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or character:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
if not character or not root then
if data.Health then data.Health.Visible=false end
for _,line in ipairs(data.Skeleton)do line.Visible=false end
continue
end

local rootScreen,rootOnScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
if not rootOnScreen or rootScreen.Z<=0 then
if data.Health then data.Health.Visible=false end
for _,line in ipairs(data.Skeleton)do line.Visible=false end
continue
end

if Settings.ESPHealth then
local hp,maxHP=CVU_GetHealth(character)
local bounds=hp and maxHP and maxHP>0 and CVU_GetScreenBounds(character) or nil
if bounds then
local percent=math.clamp(hp/maxHP,0,1)
data.Health.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(bounds.Left-9,bounds.Top)
data.Health.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(5,bounds.Height)
data.HealthFill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,percent)
data.HealthFill.BackgroundColor3=CVU_GetHealthColor(percent)
data.Health.Visible=true
else
data.Health.Visible=false
end
else
data.Health.Visible=false
end

if Settings.ESPSkeleton then
local bones=character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")and R15Bones or R6Bones
local projected={}
local function getProjectedPart(name)
local cached=projected[name]
if cached~=nil then return cached[1],cached[2] end
local part=character:FindFirstChild(name)
if not part then
projected[name]={false,false}
return false,false
end
local point,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
local ok=onScreen and point.Z>0
local value=ok and Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y) or false
projected[name]={value,ok}
return value,ok
end

for index,line in ipairs(data.Skeleton)do
local pair=bones[index]
if not pair then
line.Visible=false
continue
end
local a,visibleA=getProjectedPart(pair[1])
local b,visibleB=getProjectedPart(pair[2])
if visibleA and visibleB and a and b then
CVU_DrawLine(line,a,b)
else
line.Visible=false
end
end
else
for _,line in ipairs(data.Skeleton)do line.Visible=false end
end
end
end

-- 敵人手持武器：比舊版多檢查角色內直接掛載的武器 Model，並排除背部 / holster 模型。
function CVU_FindWeaponNameFromObject(root)
if not root then return nil end
for _,attributeName in ipairs({"CurrentWeapon","EquippedWeapon","Weapon","WeaponName","GunName","ItemName"})do
local value=root:GetAttribute(attributeName)
if type(value)=="string"then
local normalized=CVU_NormalizeWeaponName(value)
if normalized then return normalized end
end
end

for _,object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("StringValue")and(object.Name=="CurrentWeapon"or object.Name=="EquippedWeapon"or object.Name=="Weapon"or object.Name=="WeaponName"or object.Name=="GunName")then
local normalized=CVU_NormalizeWeaponName(object.Value)
if normalized then return normalized end
end
end

local bestName=nil
local bestScore=-math.huge
local checked=0
for _,object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("Tool")or object:IsA("Model")or object:IsA("Folder")then
local normalized=CVU_NormalizeWeaponName(object.Name)
if normalized then
local score=object:IsA("Tool")and 100 or 10
if object.Parent==root then score+=20 end
if object:GetAttribute("IsEquipped")==true or object:GetAttribute("Equipped")==true then score+=80 end
local ancestry=""
local current=object.Parent
local depth=0
while current and current~=root and depth<4 do
ancestry=ancestry.." "..string.lower(current.Name)
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
if string.find(ancestry,"back",1,true)or string.find(ancestry,"holster",1,true)or string.find(ancestry,"stored",1,true)then score-=80 end
if score>bestScore then bestScore=score bestName=normalized end
end
checked+=1
if checked>=180 then break end
end
end
return bestName
end

function CVU_ScanPlayerWeaponName(targetPlayer)
if not targetPlayer then return nil end
local character=CVU_GetPlayerCombatCharacter(targetPlayer)
local fromCharacter=CVU_FindWeaponNameFromObject(character)
if fromCharacter then return fromCharacter end
for _,attributeName in ipairs({"CurrentWeapon","EquippedWeapon","Weapon","WeaponName","GunName"})do
local normalized=CVU_NormalizeWeaponName(targetPlayer:GetAttribute(attributeName))
if normalized then return normalized end
end
for _,object in ipairs(targetPlayer:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("StringValue")and(object.Name=="CurrentWeapon"or object.Name=="EquippedWeapon"or object.Name=="WeaponName"or object.Name=="GunName")then
local normalized=CVU_NormalizeWeaponName(object.Value)
if normalized then return normalized end
end
end

return nil
end

local CVU_EnemyWeaponIconCache={}
local CVU_EnemyWeaponESPObjects={}

function CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(value)
if typeof(value)=="number"and value>0 then return"rbxassetid://"..tostring(math.floor(value))end
if type(value)~="string"or value==""then return nil end
if string.find(value,"rbxasset",1,true)or string.find(value,"http",1,true)then return value end
local digits=string.match(value,"^%s*(%d+)%s*$")
if digits then return"rbxassetid://"..digits end
return nil
end

function CVU_GetWeaponIconImage(weaponName)
if not weaponName then return nil end
local cached=CVU_EnemyWeaponIconCache[weaponName]
if cached and(cached.Image or os.clock()-cached.Time<8)then return cached.Image or nil end
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)
local image=nil

if type(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties)=="function"then
local ok,properties=pcall(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties,weaponName)
if ok and type(properties)=="table"then
local seen={}
local function inspect(value,depth)
if image or type(value)~="table"or depth>3 or seen[value]then return end
seen[value]=true
for key,child in pairs(value)do
local compact=string.lower(string.gsub(tostring(key),"[^%w]",""))
if string.find(compact,"icon",1,true)or string.find(compact,"thumbnail",1,true)or compact=="image"or compact=="imageid"then
image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(child)
if image then return end
end
end
for _,child in pairs(value)do if type(child)=="table"then inspect(child,depth+1)end end
end
inspect(properties,0)
end
end

local folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder and Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
if not image and folder then
for _,key in ipairs({"Icon","IconId","Image","ImageId","Thumbnail","ThumbnailId"})do
image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(folder:GetAttribute(key))
if image then break end
end
end
if not image and folder then
for _,object in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants())do
local compact=string.lower(string.gsub(object.Name,"[^%w]",""))
if string.find(compact,"icon",1,true)or string.find(compact,"thumbnail",1,true)then
if object:IsA("ImageLabel")or object:IsA("ImageButton")then image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(object.Image)end
if not image and(object:IsA("Decal")or object:IsA("Texture"))then image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(object.Texture)end
if image then break end
end
end
end

CVU_EnemyWeaponIconCache[weaponName]={Image=image or false,Time=os.clock()}
return image
end

function CVU_ClearEnemyWeaponViewport(data)
if not data then return end
if data.ViewWorld then
for _,child in ipairs(data.ViewWorld:GetChildren())do child:Destroy()end
end
if data.Viewport then data.Viewport.Visible=false end
data.ViewModel=nil
end

function CVU_BuildEnemyWeaponViewport(data,weaponName)
if not data or not data.Viewport or not data.ViewWorld or not data.ViewCamera or not weaponName then return false end
CVU_ClearEnemyWeaponViewport(data)
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
local built=nil
if type(CVU_SkinPreviewBuildSource)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(CVU_SkinPreviewBuildSource,"gun",weaponName,"Stock")
if ok and result then built=result end
end
if not built then
local folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder and Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
local source=folder and(folder:FindFirstChild("Camera")or folder)
if source then
local ok,clone=pcall(function()return source:Clone()end)
if ok and clone then
built=Instance.new("Model")
built.Name="EnemyWeaponIcon_"..weaponName
clone.Parent=built
end
end
end
if not built then return false end
local parts=0
if type(CVU_SkinPreviewPrepareModel)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(CVU_SkinPreviewPrepareModel,built)
if ok then parts=tonumber(result)or 0 end
else
for _,obj in ipairs(built:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Script")or obj:IsA("LocalScript")or obj:IsA("ModuleScript")then obj:Destroy()
elseif obj:IsA("BasePart")then
parts+=1 obj.Anchored=true obj.CanCollide=false obj.CanTouch=false obj.CanQuery=false obj.CastShadow=false obj.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
end
end
end
if parts<=0 then built:Destroy()return false end
local ok,cf,size=pcall(function()return built:GetBoundingBox()end)
if not ok or typeof(cf)~="CFrame"or typeof(size)~="Vector3"then built:Destroy()return false end
local shift=-cf.Position
for _,obj in ipairs(built:GetDescendants())do if obj:IsA("BasePart")then obj.CFrame=obj.CFrame+shift end end
built.Parent=data.ViewWorld
data.ViewModel=built
local largest=math.max(size.X,size.Y,size.Z,0.5)
local distance=math.max(2.2,largest*1.75)
local target=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
if size.Z>size.X*1.15 then
data.ViewCamera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(distance,size.Y*0.12,0),target)
else
data.ViewCamera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,size.Y*0.12,distance),target)
end
data.Viewport.Visible=true
return true
end

function CVU_UpdateEnemyWeaponESP()

end
local character=CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter(player)

data.Label.Text=weaponName
end
data.Billboard.Adornee=root
data.Billboard.Enabled=true
end
end

function CVU_UpdateESPDirectionIndicators()
if not Settings.ESP or not Settings.ESPDirectionIndicators or not Camera then
CVU_HideAllESPDirections()
return
end

local center=Camera.ViewportSize/2
local radius=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.ESPDirectionRadius)or 82,42,180)
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if player==LocalPlayer or not CVU_ShouldShowESP(player)then
local old=CVU_ESPDirectionObjects[player]
if old then old.Visible=false end
continue
end

local character=CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter(player)
local root=character and(character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")or character.PrimaryPart)
local indicator=CVU_GetOrCreateESPDirection(player)
if not root then indicator.Visible=false continue end

local screen,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
local direction
if onScreen and screen.Z>0 then
local delta=Vector2.new(screen.X,screen.Y)-center
direction=delta.Magnitude>10 and delta.Unit or Vector2.new(0,-1)
else
local relative=root.Position-Camera.CFrame.Position
local right=relative:Dot(Camera.CFrame.RightVector)
local forward=relative:Dot(Camera.CFrame.LookVector)
local compass=Vector2.new(right,-forward)
direction=compass.Magnitude>.001 and compass.Unit or Vector2.new(0,-1)
end

indicator.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(center.X+direction.X*radius,center.Y+direction.Y*radius)
indicator.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(direction.Y,direction.X))+90
indicator.TextColor3=Settings.ESPDirectionColor
indicator.Visible=true
end

for player,indicator in pairs(CVU_ESPDirectionObjects)do
if player.Parent~=Players then
if indicator then indicator:Destroy()end
CVU_ESPDirectionObjects[player]=nil
end
end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
local indicator=CVU_ESPDirectionObjects[player]
if indicator then indicator:Destroy()end
CVU_ESPDirectionObjects[player]=nil
end)

-- ============================================================
-- Confirmed Hit Sound infrastructure V6
-- Root fix: no pre-shot gun-audio gate.
--
-- The old implementation had ONE global ShotAudioGate for all bullets.  Under rapid fire,
-- each new bullet finalized the previous gate as a miss before the server/client hit state
-- had time to settle.  That caused delayed/missing/incorrect hit sounds and gun-audio replay.
-- Hit sound is now event-driven: preserve the game's original shot audio completely and
-- play the selected local hit sound only after an actual enemy collision / HP fallback.
-- ============================================================
Runtime.DingHitSoundPreloadStarted=Runtime.DingHitSoundPreloadStarted or false
