function CVU_PreloadDingHitSound()
if Runtime.DingHitSoundPreloadStarted then return end
Runtime.DingHitSoundPreloadStarted=true

task.spawn(function()
local probes={
{"玻璃",Runtime.DingHitSoundId or "rbxassetid://6607204501","DingHitSoundReady"},
{"鈴鐺",Runtime.BellHitSoundId or "rbxassetid://6534947240","BellHitSoundReady"},
{"電子重音",Runtime.ElectronicHeavyHitSoundId or "rbxassetid://5633695679","ElectronicHeavyHitSoundReady"},
{"重音鈴鐺",Runtime.HeavyBellHitSoundId or "rbxassetid://2868331684","HeavyBellHitSoundReady"},
{"Roblox擊殺音效",Runtime.RobloxKillHitSoundId or "rbxassetid://5700183626","RobloxKillHitSoundReady"},
{"mc攻擊",Runtime.MCAttackHitSoundId or "rbxassetid://4018616850","MCAttackHitSoundReady"},
{"CSGO擊中",Runtime.HeadshotSoundId or "rbxassetid://6937353691","HeadshotSoundReady"},
{"自己死亡1",Runtime.LocalDeathSoundId or "rbxassetid://4275842574","LocalDeathSoundReady"},
{"自己死亡2",Runtime.LocalDeathSound2Id or "rbxassetid://4965083997","LocalDeathSound2Ready"},
}
local sounds={}
for i,info in ipairs(probes)do
local sound=Instance.new("Sound")
sound.Name="CVU_HitSoundPreload_"..tostring(i)
sound.SoundId=info[2]
sound.Volume=0
sound.Parent=SoundService
sounds[i]=sound
end
local ok=pcall(function()game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(sounds)end)
for i,info in ipairs(probes)do
local loaded=false
local sound=sounds[i]
if sound then pcall(function()loaded=sound.IsLoaded end)end
Runtime[info[3]]=ok and loaded
if not Runtime[info[3]]then warn("[ChickenVisualUI] "..info[1].." 音效無法載入："..tostring(info[2]))end
if sound and sound.Parent then sound:Destroy()end
end
end)
end

-- =========================
-- Confirmed Hit Sound system V2
-- 核心照 RageByte：本地 Shot 時間 + 敵人真實血量下降。
-- 不再用 hitObject / Mouse.Target 當硬性條件，避免刀、ViewModel、牆面命中資訊格式不同時把真正命中擋掉。
-- =========================
local CVU_HitStatesModule=nil
local CVU_HitStatesLastTry=0
local CVU_HitNeuron=nil
local CVU_HitNeuronLastTry=0
local CVU_HitLastSerialByPlayer=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

function CVU_GetHitStatesModule()
if CVU_HitStatesModule then return CVU_HitStatesModule end
local now=os.clock()
if now-CVU_HitStatesLastTry<1 then return nil end
CVU_HitStatesLastTry=now
pcall(function()
local modules=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
local moduleScript=modules and modules:FindFirstChild("States")
if moduleScript and moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript")then
local result=require(moduleScript)
if type(result)=="table"and type(result.GetStateValue)=="function"then
CVU_HitStatesModule=result
end
end
end)
return CVU_HitStatesModule
end

function CVU_GetHitNeuron()
if CVU_HitNeuron then return CVU_HitNeuron end
local now=os.clock()
if now-CVU_HitNeuronLastTry<1 then return nil end
CVU_HitNeuronLastTry=now
pcall(function()
local neuronModule=ReplicatedFirst:FindFirstChild("neuron")
if neuronModule and neuronModule:IsA("ModuleScript")then
local result=require(neuronModule)
if result then CVU_HitNeuron=result end
end
end)
return CVU_HitNeuron
end

function CVU_GetConfirmedHitHealth(char)
if not char or not char.Parent then return nil,nil end
local states=CVU_GetHitStatesModule()
if states then
local ok,hp=pcall(function()return states:GetStateValue(char,"Health")end)
if ok and typeof(hp)=="number"then
local maxHP=nil
pcall(function()maxHP=states:GetStateValue(char,"MaxHealth")end)
if typeof(maxHP)~="number"or maxHP<=0 then maxHP=150 end
return hp,maxHP
end
end
return CVU_GetHealth(char)
end

function CVU_AddUniqueHitCharacter(list,seen,char)
if char and char.Parent and char:IsA("Model")and not seen[char]then
seen[char]=true
list[#list+1]=char
end
end

local CVU_HitCharacterResolveCache=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
function CVU_GetHitCharactersForPlayer(plr)
local now=os.clock()
local cached=plr and CVU_HitCharacterResolveCache[plr]
if cached and now-cached.Time<.5 then
local valid=true
for _,char in ipairs(cached.List)do if not char or not char.Parent then valid=false break end end
if valid then return cached.List end
end
local list={}
local seen=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

-- 先沿用 Roblox Character。
CVU_AddUniqueHitCharacter(list,seen,plr and plr.Character)

-- 這個遊戲可能使用 neuron / Chickynoid 的實際戰鬥角色。
local neuron=CVU_GetHitNeuron()
if neuron and plr then
pcall(function()
local char=neuron:get_character(plr)
CVU_AddUniqueHitCharacter(list,seen,char)
end)
end

-- 再補 Workspace.Characters 裡的自訂角色。
if plr then
local charactersFolder=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
if charactersFolder then
for _,folder in ipairs(charactersFolder:GetChildren())do
local char=folder:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
CVU_AddUniqueHitCharacter(list,seen,char)
end
end
end

if plr then CVU_HitCharacterResolveCache[plr]={List=list,Time=now}end
return list
end


function CVU_ResolveEnemyPlayerFromHitObject(obj)
if typeof(obj)~="Instance"or not obj.Parent then return nil,nil end

for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if plr~=LocalPlayer then
for _,char in ipairs(CVU_GetHitCharactersForPlayer(plr))do
if char and char.Parent then
local isHit=false
pcall(function()
isHit=(obj==char)or obj:IsDescendantOf(char)
end)
if isHit then return plr,char end
end
end
end
end

return nil,nil
end

function CVU_GetShotInstance(value)
if typeof(value)=="Instance"then return value end

-- RaycastResult 在 Roblox 不是 Instance，但真正碰撞物件放在 .Instance。
if typeof(value)=="RaycastResult"then
local obj=nil
pcall(function()obj=value.Instance end)
if typeof(obj)=="Instance"then return obj end
end

if type(value)=="table"then
for _,key in ipairs({
"Instance","instance","hitObject","hitPart","part","Part",
"Target","target","Object","object",
})do
local obj=value[key]
if typeof(obj)=="Instance"then return obj end
if typeof(obj)=="RaycastResult"then
local resultObj=nil
pcall(function()resultObj=obj.Instance end)
if typeof(resultObj)=="Instance"then return resultObj end
end
end
end

return nil
end

function CVU_IsOwnShotSupportInstance(obj)
if typeof(obj)~="Instance"then return false end

local vm=CVU_GetViewModel()
if vm then
local ok=false
pcall(function()ok=(obj==vm)or obj:IsDescendantOf(vm)end)
if ok then return true end
end

local char=LocalPlayer.Character
if char then
local ok=false
pcall(function()ok=(obj==char)or obj:IsDescendantOf(char)end)
if ok then return true end
end

local tool=CVU_GetEquippedTool and CVU_GetEquippedTool()or nil
if tool then
local ok=false
pcall(function()ok=(obj==tool)or obj:IsDescendantOf(tool)end)
if ok then return true end
end

return false
end

function CVU_ClassifyShotHitObject(obj)
if typeof(obj)~="Instance"or not obj.Parent then return "unknown",nil,nil,nil end

local plr,char=CVU_ResolveEnemyPlayerFromHitObject(obj)
if plr then
return "enemy",plr,char,obj
end

-- 槍本身、ViewModel、自己角色不是 bullet impact。
if CVU_IsOwnShotSupportInstance(obj)then
return "unknown",nil,nil,nil
end

-- 有一個真正存在於世界中的非敵人碰撞 Instance，就視為明確打牆/地板/物件。
return "world",nil,nil,obj
end

function CVU_GetShotHitDisposition(shot)
if type(shot)~="table"then return "unknown",nil,nil,nil end

-- 先看最常見的「真正碰撞結果」欄位。
for _,key in ipairs({
"hitObject","hitPart","HitObject","HitPart",
"Instance","instance","part","Part",
"raycastResult","RaycastResult","result","Result",
})do
local obj=CVU_GetShotInstance(shot[key])
if obj then
local kind,plr,char,hitObj=CVU_ClassifyShotHitObject(obj)
if kind~="unknown"then return kind,plr,char,hitObj end
end
end

-- 再看 Hits / hits。只要其中有敵人，敵人優先；否則記住世界碰撞。
local sawWorld=nil
local hits=shot.Hits or shot.hits
if type(hits)=="table"then
for _,hit in pairs(hits)do
local obj=CVU_GetShotInstance(hit)
if obj then
local kind,plr,char,hitObj=CVU_ClassifyShotHitObject(obj)
if kind=="enemy"then return kind,plr,char,hitObj end
if kind=="world"and not sawWorld then sawWorld=hitObj end
end
end
end
if sawWorld then return "world",nil,nil,sawWorld end

-- target/Target 有些遊戲不是碰撞結果，所以最後才看。
for _,key in ipairs({"target","Target"})do
local obj=CVU_GetShotInstance(shot[key])
if obj then
local kind,plr,char,hitObj=CVU_ClassifyShotHitObject(obj)
if kind~="unknown"then return kind,plr,char,hitObj end
end
end

return "unknown",nil,nil,nil
end

function CVU_GetActualShotEnemyTarget(shot)
local kind,plr,char,obj=CVU_GetShotHitDisposition(shot)
if kind=="enemy"then return plr,char,obj end
return nil,nil,nil
end

function CVU_ShotLooksLikeCharacterHit(shot)
return select(1,CVU_GetShotHitDisposition(shot))=="enemy"
end

function CVU_ResetHitSoundShotState(spawnGrace)
Runtime.LastLocalShot=0
Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial=0
Runtime.LastLocalShotTarget=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotHadObject=false
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetCharacter=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetSerial=0
Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition="none"
Runtime.HitShotBaseline=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.HitShotBaselineSerial=0
Runtime.HitFallbackAimPlayer=nil
Runtime.HitFallbackAimCharacter=nil
Runtime.HitShotLifeGeneration=0
Runtime.HitMonitorAccumulator=0
Runtime.HitHealthCache=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.HitSoundLifeGeneration=(Runtime.HitSoundLifeGeneration or 0)+1
Runtime.HitSoundSpawnGraceUntil=os.clock()+(tonumber(spawnGrace)or 0)
end

function CVU_IsHitBaselineCharacterAlive(char)
if not char or not char.Parent then return false end
if char:GetAttribute("Dead")==true
or char:GetAttribute("IsDead")==true
or char:GetAttribute("Eliminated")==true
or char:GetAttribute("Killed")==true then
return false
end

local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
if hum.Health<=0 or hum:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
return false
end
end

local hp=select(1,CVU_GetConfirmedHitHealth(char))
if typeof(hp)=="number"and hp<=0 then return false end
return true
end

function CVU_GetHitFallbackAimTarget()
local camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera
if not camera then return nil,nil end

local mousePos=UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
local ray=camera:ViewportPointToRay(mousePos.X,mousePos.Y)

local params=RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.IgnoreWater=true

local filter={camera}
for _,char in ipairs(CVU_GetHitCharactersForPlayer(LocalPlayer))do
if char then filter[#filter+1]=char end
end
params.FilterDescendantsInstances=filter

local result=Workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin,ray.Direction*5000,params)
if not result or not result.Instance then return nil,nil end

local plr,char=CVU_ResolveEnemyPlayerFromHitObject(result.Instance)
if plr and char and CVU_IsHitBaselineCharacterAlive(char)then
return plr,char
end
return nil,nil
end

function CVU_CaptureShotHealthBaseline(targetPlayer,targetChar)
-- Performance fix: 不再每一發掃描整個玩家列表。
-- Rapid Fire 20~30 發/秒時，舊做法會把「所有玩家 x 所有角色 x Health state」每發重做一次，
-- 命中敵人時再疊加 40Hz HP monitor，這就是交火時卡頓的主要來源之一。
Runtime.HitShotBaseline=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.HitShotBaselineSerial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0

local function captureOne(plr,char)
if not plr or plr==LocalPlayer or not char or not CVU_IsHitBaselineCharacterAlive(char)then return false end
local hp=Runtime.HitHealthCache and Runtime.HitHealthCache[char]or nil
if typeof(hp)~="number"or hp<=0 then hp=select(1,CVU_GetConfirmedHitHealth(char))end
if typeof(hp)~="number"or hp<=0 then return false end
Runtime.HitShotBaseline[char]={Player=plr,Health=hp,LifeGeneration=Runtime.HitSoundLifeGeneration or 0}
Runtime.HitHealthCache[char]=hp
return true
end

if captureOne(targetPlayer,targetChar)then return true end
if captureOne(Runtime.HitFallbackAimPlayer,Runtime.HitFallbackAimCharacter)then return true end
return false
end

function CVU_EnsureHitBaselineForTarget(plr,char)
if not plr or plr==LocalPlayer or not char then return false end
local serial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0
if Runtime.HitShotBaselineSerial~=serial then
Runtime.HitShotBaseline=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.HitShotBaselineSerial=serial
end
if Runtime.HitShotBaseline[char]then return true end
if not CVU_IsHitBaselineCharacterAlive(char)then return false end
local hp=Runtime.HitHealthCache and Runtime.HitHealthCache[char]or nil
if typeof(hp)~="number"or hp<=0 then hp=select(1,CVU_GetConfirmedHitHealth(char))end
if typeof(hp)~="number"or hp<=0 then return false end
Runtime.HitShotBaseline[char]={Player=plr,Health=hp,LifeGeneration=Runtime.HitSoundLifeGeneration or 0}
Runtime.HitHealthCache[char]=hp
return true
end

function CVU_SetConfirmedShotTarget(plr,char,obj,disposition)
if not plr or plr==LocalPlayer then return false end
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer=plr
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetCharacter=char
Runtime.LastLocalShotTarget=obj
Runtime.LastLocalShotHadObject=obj~=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetSerial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0
Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition=disposition or "enemy"
return true
end

function CVU_IsHitAudioTrackingEnabled()
return Settings.BulletSound==true or CVU_AnyGunKillCounterEnabled()
end

function CVU_IsHeadshotObject(obj,char)
if typeof(obj)~="Instance"or not obj.Parent then return false end
local current=obj
for _=1,5 do
if not current then break end
local name=string.lower(current.Name or "")
if name=="head"
or name=="chicken head"
or string.find(name,"headhitbox",1,true)
or string.find(name,"head_hitbox",1,true)
or string.find(name,"hitboxhead",1,true)
then
return true
end
if current==char then break end
current=current.Parent
end
return false
end

function CVU_IsLastConfirmedHeadshot(target)
if not Settings.HeadshotSound then return false end
local serial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0
if serial<=0 or Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetSerial~=serial then return false end
if Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition~="enemy"and Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition~="fallback_enemy"then return false end

local char=Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetCharacter
if typeof(target)=="Instance"then
if target:IsA("Player")then
if Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer~=target then return false end
elseif target:IsA("Model")then
if char~=target then return false end
end
end

return CVU_IsHeadshotObject(Runtime.LastLocalShotTarget,char)
end

function CVU_PlayHeadshotSound()
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.HeadshotSound then return false end
local serial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0
if serial<=0 or Runtime.LastHeadshotSoundSerial==serial then return false end
Runtime.LastHeadshotSoundSerial=serial
CVU_PlayLocalAssetSound(
Runtime.HeadshotSoundId or "rbxassetid://6937353691",
"CVU_CSGOHeadshotSound",
2
)
return true
end

function CVU_RecordLocalShot(preTargetPlayer,preTargetChar,preDisposition)
if not CVU_IsHitAudioTrackingEnabled()then return false end
local now=os.clock()
Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotWeapon=CVU_GetCurrentLocalGunName()
Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotEnabled=
CVU_IsGunKillCounterActive(Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotWeapon)
Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotAt=now

-- Effects.Identify 與 MouseButton1 有時會在同一發子彈都回報一次。
if now-(Runtime.LastLocalShot or 0)<0.025 then
Runtime.LastLocalShot=now
return false
end

Runtime.LastLocalShot=now
Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial=(Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0)+1
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer=preTargetPlayer
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetCharacter=preTargetChar
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetSerial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial
Runtime.LastLocalShotTarget=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotHadObject=false
Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition=preDisposition or"unknown"
Runtime.HitShotLifeGeneration=Runtime.HitSoundLifeGeneration or 0

Runtime.HitFallbackAimPlayer=nil
Runtime.HitFallbackAimCharacter=nil
-- 已經從 Shot table 知道真正敵人時，就完全不做額外 Raycast。
-- 只有 unknown shot 才做一次準心 fallback。
if not preTargetPlayer and preDisposition~="world"
and now>=(Runtime.HitSoundSpawnGraceUntil or 0)then
Runtime.HitFallbackAimPlayer,Runtime.HitFallbackAimCharacter=CVU_GetHitFallbackAimTarget()
end

CVU_CaptureShotHealthBaseline(preTargetPlayer,preTargetChar)
return true
end

function CVU_PrimeHitHealthCache()
if not CVU_IsHitAudioTrackingEnabled()then return end
for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if plr~=LocalPlayer then
for _,char in ipairs(CVU_GetHitCharactersForPlayer(plr))do
local hp=select(1,CVU_GetConfirmedHitHealth(char))
if typeof(hp)=="number"then
Runtime.HitHealthCache[char]=hp
end
end
end
end
end

function CVU_FindHitSoundShotPayload(args)
if type(args)~="table"then return nil end
local n=tonumber(args.n)or #args
local fallback=nil
for i=1,n do
local value=args[i]
if type(value)=="table"then
local strong=
value.fromServer~=nil
or value.hitObject~=nil or value.HitObject~=nil
or value.hitPart~=nil or value.HitPart~=nil
or value.raycastResult~=nil or value.RaycastResult~=nil
or value.Hits~=nil or value.hits~=nil
if strong then return value end
if not fallback and (
value.Origin~=nil or value.origin~=nil
or value.Direction~=nil or value.direction~=nil
or value.target~=nil or value.Target~=nil
)then fallback=value end
end
end
if fallback then return fallback end
-- Preserve compatibility with the older observed signature, but do not depend on it.
return type(args[4])=="table"and args[4]or nil
end

function CVU_InstallHitSoundShotHook()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Runtime.HitSoundShotHooked then return Runtime.HitSoundShotHooked end
local installed=false
pcall(function()
local modules=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
local handlers=modules and modules:FindFirstChild("Handlers")
local effectsModule=handlers and handlers:FindFirstChild("Effects")
if not effectsModule or not effectsModule:IsA("ModuleScript")then return end
local effects=require(effectsModule)
if type(effects)~="table"or type(effects.Identify)~="function"then return end

local original=effects.Identify
local wrapper
wrapper=function(self,id,...)
-- Preserve nil holes/trailing nils exactly.
local args=table.pack(...)
local shot=nil
local preKind="unknown"
local preTargetPlayer=nil
local preTargetChar=nil
local preTargetObject=nil
local localShot=false

if not Runtime.Shutdown and id=="Shot"then
shot=CVU_FindHitSoundShotPayload(args)
if type(shot)=="table"and shot.fromServer~=true then
localShot=true
preKind,preTargetPlayer,preTargetChar,preTargetObject=CVU_GetShotHitDisposition(shot)
CVU_RecordLocalShot(preTargetPlayer,preTargetChar,preKind)
Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition=preKind
if preKind=="enemy"and preTargetPlayer then
CVU_EnsureHitBaselineForTarget(preTargetPlayer,preTargetChar)
CVU_SetConfirmedShotTarget(preTargetPlayer,preTargetChar,preTargetObject,"enemy")
elseif preKind=="world"then
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetCharacter=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotTarget=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotHadObject=true
end
end
end

local results=table.pack(original(self,id,table.unpack(args,1,args.n)))

if localShot and shot then
local postKind,postPlayer,postChar,postObject=CVU_GetShotHitDisposition(shot)
local finalKind=postKind
local finalPlayer=postPlayer
local finalChar=postChar
local finalObject=postObject
if finalKind~="enemy"and preKind=="enemy"then
finalKind=preKind
finalPlayer=preTargetPlayer
finalChar=preTargetChar
finalObject=preTargetObject
end

if finalKind=="enemy"and finalPlayer then
CVU_EnsureHitBaselineForTarget(finalPlayer,finalChar)
CVU_SetConfirmedShotTarget(finalPlayer,finalChar,finalObject,"enemy")
CVU_NotifyConfirmedHit(finalPlayer,true,.55)
elseif postKind=="world"then
Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition="world"
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetCharacter=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotTarget=nil
Runtime.LastLocalShotHadObject=true
elseif Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition~="enemy"then
Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition="unknown"
end
end

return table.unpack(results,1,results.n)
end
Runtime.HitSoundEffectsModule=effects
Runtime.HitSoundEffectsOriginal=original
Runtime.HitSoundEffectsWrapper=wrapper
effects.Identify=wrapper
Runtime.HitSoundShotHooked=true
installed=true
end)
return installed
end

function CVU_UninstallHitSoundShotHook()
local effects=Runtime.HitSoundEffectsModule
local wrapper=Runtime.HitSoundEffectsWrapper
local original=Runtime.HitSoundEffectsOriginal
if effects and wrapper and original then
pcall(function()
if effects.Identify==wrapper then effects.Identify=original end
end)
end
Runtime.HitSoundEffectsModule=nil
Runtime.HitSoundEffectsOriginal=nil
Runtime.HitSoundEffectsWrapper=nil
Runtime.HitSoundShotHooked=false
end

-- Effects 有時稍晚才建立，所以持續重試直到成功。
task.spawn(function()
while not Runtime.Shutdown do
if CVU_IsHitAudioTrackingEnabled()and CVU_InstallHitSoundShotHook()then break end
task.wait(1.0)
end
end)

function CVU_ShouldPlayConfirmedHit(plr,oldHealth,newHealth)
if not CVU_IsHitAudioTrackingEnabled()then return false end
if not plr or plr==LocalPlayer then return false end
if typeof(oldHealth)~="number"or typeof(newHealth)~="number"then return false end
if newHealth>=oldHealth then return false end

local now=os.clock()
local shotAge=now-(Runtime.LastLocalShot or 0)
if shotAge<0 or shotAge>.48 then return false end

local serial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0
if serial<=0 then return false end
if Runtime.HitShotBaselineSerial~=serial then return false end
if Runtime.HitShotLifeGeneration~=(Runtime.HitSoundLifeGeneration or 0)then return false end

-- Shot 已明確撞到牆/地板，就算別人在同一瞬間掉血也不能算我的命中。
if Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition=="world"then return false end

-- 有 actual target 時必須完全吻合；fallback target 建立後也走同一條。
if Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer and Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer~=plr then
return false
end

if CVU_HitLastSerialByPlayer[plr]==serial then return false end
return true
end

function CVU_NotifyConfirmedHit(target,requireRecentShot,shotWindow)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not CVU_IsHitAudioTrackingEnabled()then return false end

local now=os.clock()
local serial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0

if requireRecentShot then
local window=tonumber(shotWindow)or 0.75
local age=now-(Runtime.LastLocalShot or 0)
if age<0 or age>window then return false end
if serial<=0 then return false end
if Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetSerial~=serial then return false end
if Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition=="world"then return false end

-- Dedupe by shot serial. This allows legitimate rapid-fire hits.
if typeof(target)=="Instance"then
if target:IsA("Player")then
if Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer~=target then return false end
if CVU_HitLastSerialByPlayer[target]==serial then return false end
CVU_HitLastSerialByPlayer[target]=serial
else
if Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetCharacter~=target then return false end
if Runtime.HitSoundLastSerialByCharacter[target]==serial then return false end
Runtime.HitSoundLastSerialByCharacter[target]=serial
end
else
return false
end
else
-- External/admin confirmed events have no bullet serial.
if now-(Runtime.LastHitSoundTime or 0)<0.012 then return false end
end

Runtime.LastHitSoundTime=now
if Settings.BulletSound then CVU_PlayBulletSound()end
return true
end

function CVU_NotifyConfirmedKill(target)
-- 給管理員 / 自訂驗證程式使用：呼叫者已經確認擊殺，
-- 所以不再強迫它一定要經過 BloxStrike 的 Effects.Identify / HP 下降流程。
local counted=CVU_RecordGunKillCounter(target)
local notified=CVU_NotifyConfirmedHit(target,false,0)
return counted or notified
end

-- Confirmed Hit Sound V5：
-- 優先使用真正 bullet target；如果遊戲 Shot table 根本不公開 hitObject，
-- 才用「這一發之前的 HP baseline -> 這一發之後真的掉血」做後備確認。
-- 明確打到 world 的 Shot 永遠不進 fallback，所以打牆不會亂響。
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if not CVU_IsHitAudioTrackingEnabled()then
Runtime.HitMonitorAccumulator=0
return
end

local serial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0
if serial<=0
or Runtime.HitShotBaselineSerial~=serial
or os.clock()-(Runtime.LastLocalShot or 0)>.48
or Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition=="world" then
Runtime.HitMonitorAccumulator=0
return
end

Runtime.HitMonitorAccumulator=(Runtime.HitMonitorAccumulator or 0)+(dt or 0)
-- 25Hz 足夠確認 HP 下降；舊版 40Hz 在高射速交火時沒有必要。
if Runtime.HitMonitorAccumulator<.040 then return end
Runtime.HitMonitorAccumulator=0

local exactPlayer=Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer
local exactChar=Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetCharacter

for char,data in pairs(Runtime.HitShotBaseline or {})do
if char and char.Parent and type(data)=="table"then
local plr=data.Player
local oldHP=data.Health

-- 有 actual target 時只看那個人；沒有 target 才允許 baseline fallback 找真正掉血的人。
local fallbackPlayer=Runtime.HitFallbackAimPlayer
local fallbackChar=Runtime.HitFallbackAimCharacter

local candidate=(plr~=nil and plr~=LocalPlayer)
and (
(exactPlayer~=nil and plr==exactPlayer
and (exactChar==nil or char==exactChar or plr==exactPlayer))
or
(exactPlayer==nil
and fallbackPlayer~=nil
and plr==fallbackPlayer
and char==fallbackChar)
)

if candidate and typeof(oldHP)=="number"
and data.LifeGeneration==(Runtime.HitSoundLifeGeneration or 0)
and char.Parent then
local hp=select(1,CVU_GetConfirmedHitHealth(char))
if typeof(hp)=="number"then
Runtime.HitHealthCache[char]=hp

if hp<oldHP and CVU_ShouldPlayConfirmedHit(plr,oldHP,hp)then
-- Shot table 沒提供 target，但 HP baseline 證明這一發後這個敵人真的掉血。
if exactPlayer==nil then
CVU_SetConfirmedShotTarget(plr,char,nil,"fallback_enemy")
exactPlayer=plr
exactChar=char
end

CVU_NotifyConfirmedHit(plr,true,.48)
break
end
end
end
end
end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- Confirmed Kill event fallback
-- 自訂遊戲 / 管理員測試可能直接驗證死亡，沒有走 BloxStrike 的標準 HP 掉血流程。
-- 只綁事件，不新增 RenderStepped / Heartbeat 輪詢。
-- ============================================================
Runtime.HitSoundDeathConnections=Runtime.HitSoundDeathConnections or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

function CVU_UnbindHitSoundDeathCharacter(char)
local list=Runtime.HitSoundDeathConnections and Runtime.HitSoundDeathConnections[char]
if list then
for _,conn in ipairs(list)do
pcall(function()conn:Disconnect()end)
end
Runtime.HitSoundDeathConnections[char]=nil
end
end

function CVU_BindHitSoundDeathCharacter(plr,char)
if not plr or plr==LocalPlayer or not char then return end
CVU_UnbindHitSoundDeathCharacter(char)

local list={}
Runtime.HitSoundDeathConnections[char]=list

local function confirmedDead()
if Runtime.Shutdown or not CVU_IsHitAudioTrackingEnabled()then return end
-- 自動死亡 fallback 只接受已經由 actual hit / HP fallback 鎖定的同一個 target。
-- 明確打牆與未知 target 都不靠 Died 猜測，避免別人的擊殺誤觸發。
if Runtime.LastLocalShotDisposition~="world"
and Runtime.LastLocalShotTargetPlayer==plr
and os.clock()-(Runtime.LastLocalShot or 0)<=.50 then
CVU_NotifyConfirmedKill(plr)
end
end

local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
list[#list+1]=hum.Died:Connect(confirmedDead)
end

list[#list+1]=char:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Dead"):Connect(function()
if char:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then confirmedDead()end
end)

local states=char:FindFirstChild("PlayerStates")
if states then
local hp=states:FindFirstChild("Health")
if hp and hp:IsA("ValueBase")then
list[#list+1]=hp.Changed:Connect(function(value)
local n=tonumber(value)
if n~=nil and n<=0 then confirmedDead()end
end)
end
end

list[#list+1]=char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
if child:IsA("Humanoid")then
list[#list+1]=child.Died:Connect(confirmedDead)
elseif child.Name=="PlayerStates"then
local hp=child:FindFirstChild("Health")
if hp and hp:IsA("ValueBase")then
list[#list+1]=hp.Changed:Connect(function(value)
local n=tonumber(value)
if n~=nil and n<=0 then confirmedDead()end
end)
end
end
end)
end

function CVU_BindHitSoundDeathPlayer(plr)
if not plr or plr==LocalPlayer then return end
if plr.Character then CVU_BindHitSoundDeathCharacter(plr,plr.Character)end
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
CVU_BindHitSoundDeathCharacter(plr,char)
end)
end

for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
CVU_BindHitSoundDeathPlayer(plr)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(CVU_BindHitSoundDeathPlayer)

-- ============================================================
-- Local-player death sound
-- 4275842574：只處理「本機玩家自己死亡」。
-- 為避免別人死亡或單純環境死亡誤播，實際播放需要：
--   A) 本機角色已確認死亡
--   B) 1.6 秒內 KillFeed 同時出現本機名稱 + 一名敵人名稱
-- 兩個事件先後順序都可以。
-- ============================================================
Runtime.LocalDeathConnections=Runtime.LocalDeathConnections or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.LocalDeathMarkedCharacters=Runtime.LocalDeathMarkedCharacters or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.LocalDeathSerial=Runtime.LocalDeathSerial or 0
Runtime.LocalDeathPlayedSerial=Runtime.LocalDeathPlayedSerial or 0
Runtime.LocalDeathPendingUntil=Runtime.LocalDeathPendingUntil or 0
Runtime.LocalDeathFeedUntil=Runtime.LocalDeathFeedUntil or 0
Runtime.LocalDeathFeedSeen=Runtime.LocalDeathFeedSeen or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

function CVU_PlayConfirmedLocalDeathSound()
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.LocalDeathSound then return false end
local serial=Runtime.LocalDeathSerial or 0
if serial<=0 or Runtime.LocalDeathPlayedSerial==serial then return false end
Runtime.LocalDeathPlayedSerial=serial
Runtime.LocalDeathPendingUntil=0
Runtime.LocalDeathFeedUntil=0
local deathMode=Settings.LocalDeathSoundMode or "死亡音效1"
local deathId=Runtime.LocalDeathSoundId or "rbxassetid://4275842574"
local deathName="CVU_LocalPlayerDeathSound1"

if deathMode=="死亡音效2"then
deathId=Runtime.LocalDeathSound2Id or "rbxassetid://4965083997"
deathName="CVU_LocalPlayerDeathSound2"
end

CVU_PlayLocalAssetSound(
deathId,
deathName,
2
)
return true
end

function CVU_TryResolveLocalDeathSound()
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.LocalDeathSound then return false end
local now=os.clock()
if now<=(Runtime.LocalDeathPendingUntil or 0)
and now<=(Runtime.LocalDeathFeedUntil or 0)then
return CVU_PlayConfirmedLocalDeathSound()
end
return false
end

function CVU_MarkLocalCharacterAlive(char)
if char then Runtime.LocalDeathMarkedCharacters[char]=nil end
end

function CVU_MarkLocalCharacterDead(char)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.LocalDeathSound or not char then return end
if Runtime.LocalDeathMarkedCharacters[char]then return end
Runtime.LocalDeathMarkedCharacters[char]=true
Runtime.LocalDeathSerial=(Runtime.LocalDeathSerial or 0)+1
Runtime.LocalDeathPendingUntil=os.clock()+1.6
CVU_TryResolveLocalDeathSound()
end

function CVU_UnbindLocalDeathCharacter(char)
local list=Runtime.LocalDeathConnections and Runtime.LocalDeathConnections[char]
if not list then return end
for _,conn in ipairs(list)do
pcall(function()conn:Disconnect()end)
end
Runtime.LocalDeathConnections[char]=nil
end

function CVU_BindLocalDeathCharacter(char)
if not char or not char.Parent then return end
if Runtime.LocalDeathConnections[char]then return end

local list={}
Runtime.LocalDeathConnections[char]=list

local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
list[#list+1]=hum.Died:Connect(function()
CVU_MarkLocalCharacterDead(char)
end)
list[#list+1]=hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(hp)
if tonumber(hp)and hp>0 then CVU_MarkLocalCharacterAlive(char)end
end)
end

list[#list+1]=char:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Dead"):Connect(function()
if char:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then
CVU_MarkLocalCharacterDead(char)
else
CVU_MarkLocalCharacterAlive(char)
end
end)

local function bindStates(states)
if not states then return end
local hp=states:FindFirstChild("Health")
if hp and hp:IsA("ValueBase")then
list[#list+1]=hp.Changed:Connect(function(value)
local n=tonumber(value)
if n~=nil then
if n<=0 then CVU_MarkLocalCharacterDead(char)
else CVU_MarkLocalCharacterAlive(char)end
end
end)
end
end

bindStates(char:FindFirstChild("PlayerStates"))

list[#list+1]=char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
if child:IsA("Humanoid")then
list[#list+1]=child.Died:Connect(function()
CVU_MarkLocalCharacterDead(char)
end)
list[#list+1]=child.HealthChanged:Connect(function(hp)
if tonumber(hp)and hp>0 then CVU_MarkLocalCharacterAlive(char)end
end)
elseif child.Name=="PlayerStates"then
bindStates(child)
end
end)
end

function CVU_BindAllLocalDeathCharacters()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
for _,char in ipairs(CVU_GetHitCharactersForPlayer(LocalPlayer))do
CVU_BindLocalDeathCharacter(char)
end
end

function CVU_CheckLocalDeathKillFeed(obj)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.LocalDeathSound then return end
if not obj or not obj.Parent or Runtime.LocalDeathFeedSeen[obj]or obj:IsDescendantOf(GUI)then return end
if not obj:IsA("GuiObject")then return end
Runtime.LocalDeathFeedSeen[obj]=true

task.defer(function()
task.wait(.03)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.LocalDeathSound or not obj or not obj.Parent then return end

local texts={}
if obj:IsA("TextLabel")or obj:IsA("TextButton")then
if obj.Text and obj.Text~=""then texts[#texts+1]=obj.Text end
end
for _,d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants())do
if d:IsA("TextLabel")or d:IsA("TextButton")then
if d.Text and d.Text~=""then texts[#texts+1]=d.Text end
end
end
if #texts==0 then return end

local all=string.lower(table.concat(texts," "))
local myName=string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name or "")
local myDisplay=string.lower(LocalPlayer.DisplayName or "")
local hasMe=(myName~=""and string.find(all,myName,1,true)~=nil)
or(myDisplay~=""and string.find(all,myDisplay,1,true)~=nil)
if not hasMe then return end

local hasEnemy=false
for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if plr~=LocalPlayer and not CVU_IsSameTeam(plr)then
local n=string.lower(plr.Name or "")
local d=string.lower(plr.DisplayName or "")
if (n~=""and string.find(all,n,1,true))
or(d~=""and string.find(all,d,1,true))then
hasEnemy=true
break
end
end
end
if not hasEnemy then return end

Runtime.LocalDeathFeedUntil=os.clock()+1.6
CVU_TryResolveLocalDeathSound()
end)
end

-- 初始角色 + BloxStrike 自訂戰鬥角色
CVU_BindAllLocalDeathCharacters()

LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
-- 換生命 / 復活時，上一條命的 target、HP baseline、pending gate 全部作廢。
-- 0.45 秒內仍允許真正 Effects.Identify 的 exact hit；
-- 只是暫停不可靠的 unknown-HP fallback，避免重生/屍體清理誤觸發。
CVU_ResetHitSoundShotState(0.45)
Runtime.LocalDeathPendingUntil=0
Runtime.LocalDeathFeedUntil=0
Runtime.LocalDeathMarkedCharacters[char]=nil
CVU_BindLocalDeathCharacter(char)
for _,delayTime in ipairs({0.25,0.8,1.5})do
task.delay(delayTime,function()
if not Runtime.Shutdown then CVU_BindAllLocalDeathCharacters()end
end)
end
end)

-- KillFeed 只做事件監聽，不增加每幀輪詢。
for _,d in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants())do
if d:IsA("GuiObject")then CVU_CheckLocalDeathKillFeed(d)end
end
PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
if d:IsA("GuiObject")then CVU_CheckLocalDeathKillFeed(d)end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- Glass Weapon (style only)
-- 純玻璃樣式版本：移除裂紋、爆裂音效、血量聯動。
-- 主武器、副武器、刀子只要成為目前 ViewModel，就直接套用玻璃外觀。
-- ============================================================
Runtime.GlassWeaponOriginalParts=Runtime.GlassWeaponOriginalParts or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GlassWeaponStyleQueued=false
Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration=Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration or 0
Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning=false
Runtime.GlassWeaponTint=Runtime.GlassWeaponTint or Color3.fromRGB(238,242,248)
Runtime.GlassWeaponReflectance=Runtime.GlassWeaponReflectance or 0.03
Runtime.GlassWeaponTransparency=Runtime.GlassWeaponTransparency or 0.48
Runtime.GlassWeaponFrostBlend=Runtime.GlassWeaponFrostBlend or 0.28

-- 體驗刀具的 Glass 使用「保留皮膚」模式：
-- 只改 Glass material / transparency / reflectance，
-- 不刪 SurfaceAppearance、TextureID、Decal 或 SpecialMesh TextureId。
Runtime.GlassKnifeSkinTintBlend=Runtime.GlassKnifeSkinTintBlend or 0.12

-- 體驗刀具玻璃恢復用的永久 baseline。
-- 同一刀型 + 同一 skin 不會因為 Glass ON/OFF 被清掉；
-- 只有刀型/skin 真正改變時才重建 baseline。
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts=
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentKey=Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentKey or nil
Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration=Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration or 0

-- Scope / optic front lens 的玻璃外觀要比槍身更像真正鏡片：
-- 透明度更低一點、反光更高一點，避免保持原本黑色鏡面洞洞感。
Runtime.GlassLensTint=Runtime.GlassLensTint or Color3.fromRGB(232,240,248)
Runtime.GlassLensReflectance=Runtime.GlassLensReflectance or 0.08
Runtime.GlassLensTransparency=Runtime.GlassLensTransparency or 0.18

function CVU_DisconnectGlassWeaponHealth()
-- 純樣式玻璃版本不需要綁任何血量事件；保留空函式避免舊流程報錯。
end

function CVU_IsActiveKnifeExperienceGlassPart(part,viewModel)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
if not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled then return false end

-- visual fallback CameraModel
local clone=Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone
if clone and clone.Parent
and (part==clone or part:IsDescendantOf(clone))then
return true
end

-- native Viewmodel.new replacement
if not viewModel or not viewModel.Parent then return false end
if part~=viewModel and not part:IsDescendantOf(viewModel)then return false end
if not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()then return false end

local desiredWeapon=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType())
if not desiredWeapon then return false end

return Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName==desiredWeapon
or Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeKnife==desiredWeapon
end

function CVU_GetGlassKnifePersistentKey()
local weaponName=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType())
local skinName=CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceSkin()
return tostring(weaponName or"").."|"..tostring(skinName)
end

function CVU_ResetGlassKnifePersistentBaseline()
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentKey=CVU_GetGlassKnifePersistentKey()
Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration=(Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration or 0)+1
end

function CVU_EnsureGlassKnifePersistentKey()
local key=CVU_GetGlassKnifePersistentKey()
if Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentKey~=key then
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentKey=key
Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration=(Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration or 0)+1
end
return key
end

function CVU_GlassWeaponRestorePartState(part,saved,forceSurfaceReplace)
if not part or not part.Parent or not saved then return false end

pcall(function()
part.Material=saved.Material
part.MaterialVariant=saved.MaterialVariant or""
part.Color=saved.Color
part.Reflectance=saved.Reflectance
part.Transparency=saved.Transparency
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=saved.LocalTransparencyModifier
if part:IsA("MeshPart")then
part.TextureID=saved.MeshPartTextureID or""
end
end)

for _,childData in ipairs(saved.ChildVisuals or {})do
if childData.Kind=="SurfaceAppearance"then
if forceSurfaceReplace then
for _,obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")
and (not childData.Name or obj.Name==childData.Name)then
pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)
end
end
end

local hasSurface=false
for _,obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")
and (not childData.Name or obj.Name==childData.Name)then
hasSurface=true
break
end
end

if not hasSurface and childData.Clone then
local clone=childData.Clone:Clone()
clone.Parent=part
end

elseif childData.Kind=="Decal"or childData.Kind=="Texture"then
local obj=childData.Object
if not obj or not obj.Parent then
for _,candidate in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if candidate.ClassName==childData.Kind
and (not childData.Name or candidate.Name==childData.Name)then
obj=candidate
break
end
end
end

if obj and obj.Parent then
pcall(function()obj.Transparency=childData.Transparency or 0 end)
pcall(function()if childData.Texture~=nil then obj.Texture=childData.Texture end end)
pcall(function()if childData.TextureId~=nil then obj.TextureId=childData.TextureId end end)
pcall(function()if childData.Color3 then obj.Color3=childData.Color3 end end)
end

elseif childData.Kind=="SpecialMesh"then
local obj=childData.Object
if not obj or not obj.Parent then
for _,candidate in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if candidate:IsA("SpecialMesh")
and (not childData.Name or candidate.Name==childData.Name)then
obj=candidate
break
end
end
end

if obj and obj.Parent then
pcall(function()if childData.TextureId~=nil then obj.TextureId=childData.TextureId end end)
pcall(function()if childData.VertexColor then obj.VertexColor=childData.VertexColor end end)
end
end
end

return true
end

function CVU_RestoreGlassKnifePersistentBaseline()
CVU_EnsureGlassKnifePersistentKey()

for part,saved in pairs(Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts or {})do
if part and part.Parent and saved then
CVU_GlassWeaponRestorePartState(part,saved,true)
pcall(function()
part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassWeaponPart",nil)
part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassPreserveKnifeSkin",nil)
end)
end
end
end

function CVU_ScheduleGlassKnifePersistentRestore()
Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration=(Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration or 0)+1
local generation=Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration

local function restore()
if Runtime.Shutdown
or Settings.GlassWeapon
or generation~=(Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration or 0)then
return
end
pcall(CVU_RestoreGlassKnifePersistentBaseline)
end

-- 同幀、下一個 task、以及 0.05 秒後各補一次。
-- 不是重新套 skin，只是防止 BloxStrike 同幀最後又把 Glass 寫回去。
restore()
task.defer(restore)
task.delay(0.05,restore)
end

function CVU_GlassWeaponSavePart(part)
if not part or not part.Parent then return nil end

local existing=Runtime.GlassWeaponOriginalParts[part]
if existing then return existing end

local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
local preserveKnifeSkin=CVU_IsActiveKnifeExperienceGlassPart(part,viewModel)

if preserveKnifeSkin then
CVU_EnsureGlassKnifePersistentKey()
local persistent=Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts[part]
if persistent then
Runtime.GlassWeaponOriginalParts[part]=persistent
return persistent
end
end

local variant=""
pcall(function()variant=part.MaterialVariant end)

local saved={
Material=part.Material,
MaterialVariant=variant,
Color=part.Color,
Reflectance=part.Reflectance,
Transparency=part.Transparency,
LocalTransparencyModifier=part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
MeshPartTextureID=nil,
ChildVisuals={},
}

if part:IsA("MeshPart")then
pcall(function()saved.MeshPartTextureID=part.TextureID end)
end

for _,obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
saved.ChildVisuals[#saved.ChildVisuals+1]={
Kind="SurfaceAppearance",
Name=obj.Name,
Clone=obj:Clone(),
}

elseif obj:IsA("Decal")or obj:IsA("Texture")then
local data={
Kind=obj.ClassName,
Name=obj.Name,
Object=obj,
Transparency=obj.Transparency,
Texture=nil,
TextureId=nil,
Color3=nil,
}
pcall(function()data.Texture=obj.Texture end)
pcall(function()data.TextureId=obj.TextureId end)
pcall(function()data.Color3=obj.Color3 end)
saved.ChildVisuals[#saved.ChildVisuals+1]=data

elseif obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
local data={
Kind="SpecialMesh",
Name=obj.Name,
Object=obj,
TextureId=nil,
VertexColor=nil,
}
pcall(function()data.TextureId=obj.TextureId end)
pcall(function()data.VertexColor=obj.VertexColor end)
saved.ChildVisuals[#saved.ChildVisuals+1]=data
end
end

Runtime.GlassWeaponOriginalParts[part]=saved

if preserveKnifeSkin then
-- 這份才是「真正原始 skin」。
-- Glass OFF 不會清掉它，所以第二次、第三次、第四次都能回到同一個原始狀態。
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts[part]=saved
end

return saved
end

function CVU_GlassWeaponDestroyCracksOnPart(part)
-- 純樣式玻璃版本沒有裂紋物件，保留空函式供舊流程相容。
end

function CVU_ClearGlassWeaponVisuals(restoreParts)
for part,saved in pairs(Runtime.GlassWeaponOriginalParts or {})do
if part and part.Parent then
CVU_GlassWeaponDestroyCracksOnPart(part)

if restoreParts and saved then
local persistentKnife=
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts
and Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts[part]~=nil

CVU_GlassWeaponRestorePartState(
part,
persistentKnife and Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts[part]or saved,
persistentKnife
)
end

pcall(function()
part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassWeaponPart",nil)
part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassPreserveKnifeSkin",nil)
end)
end
end

-- 一般 Glass cache 每次循環照舊清掉。
-- 體驗刀具真正的 persistent baseline 不在這裡清除。
Runtime.GlassWeaponOriginalParts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GlassWeaponHiddenParts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
end

function CVU_ForceGlassWeaponCleanup()
Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration=(Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration or 0)+1
Runtime.GlassWeaponStyleQueued=false
Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning=true

CVU_DisconnectGlassWeaponHealth()
CVU_ClearGlassWeaponVisuals(true)

-- 第二道保險：若某個舊 ViewModel 零件還留著玻璃 ownership 標記，
-- 直接把標記清掉，避免後續材質同步誤認為它仍屬於玻璃系統。
local function clearOwnership(root)
if not root then return end
if root:IsA("BasePart")and root:GetAttribute("CVU_GlassWeaponPart")==true then
pcall(function()
root:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassWeaponPart",nil)
root:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassPreserveKnifeSkin",nil)
end)
end
for _,part in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if part:IsA("BasePart")and part:GetAttribute("CVU_GlassWeaponPart")==true then
pcall(function()
part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassWeaponPart",nil)
part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassPreserveKnifeSkin",nil)
end)
end
end
end

clearOwnership(CVU_GetViewModel())
clearOwnership(Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone)

Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning=false
end

function CVU_GetGlassWeaponParts()
local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
local parts={}
local seen=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

local function collect(root,vmForChecks)
if not root or not root.Parent then return end

local function add(part)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")or seen[part]then return end
if part.Transparency>=0.985 then return end

local vm=vmForChecks or viewModel
local isExperience=CVU_IsActiveKnifeExperienceGlassPart(part,viewModel)

-- Knife-experience fallback is an explicitly owned weapon model.
-- Everything else must be inside the exact native Weapon / WeaponL / WeaponR branch.
if not isExperience and not CVU_IsInsideActiveWeaponBranch(part,vm)then return end
if CVU_IsHardProtectedArmPart(part,vm)then return end
if CVU_IsCharmVisualObject(part,vm)then return end

-- Stage 2 v2: scope glass/reticle is 100% native for BOTH metal and glass modes.
-- No ChickenVisual material effect is allowed to rewrite any optical geometry.
if CVU_IsOpticalDisplayPart(part,vm)or CVU_IsOpticalLensPart(part,vm)then return end

if isExperience or CVU_IsMetalVisualPart(part)then
parts[#parts+1]=part
seen[part]=true
end
end

if root:IsA("BasePart")then add(root)end
for _,part in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if part:IsA("BasePart")then add(part)end
end
end

if viewModel then
collect(viewModel,viewModel)
end

local clone=Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone
if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled and clone and clone.Parent then
collect(clone,viewModel)
end

return parts
end

function CVU_ApplyGlassOpticalLens(part)
if not part or not part.Parent then return end

-- Stage 2 v2 permanent rule:
-- optics are never stylized by GlassWeapon. If an older build touched this lens,
-- restore its saved native state and remove ownership markers.
local saved=Runtime.GlassWeaponOriginalParts and Runtime.GlassWeaponOriginalParts[part]
if saved then
pcall(CVU_GlassWeaponRestorePartState,part,saved,true)
end
pcall(function()
part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassWeaponPart",nil)
part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassPreserveKnifeSkin",nil)
end)
end

function CVU_ApplyGlassWeaponBase(part)
if not part or not part.Parent then return end
if CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()~="glass"or not Settings.GlassWeapon then return end

local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
local preserveKnifeSkin=CVU_IsActiveKnifeExperienceGlassPart(part,viewModel)
local saved=CVU_GlassWeaponSavePart(part)
if not saved then return end

pcall(function()
part.Material=Enum.Material.Glass
part.MaterialVariant=""

if preserveKnifeSkin then
-- 關鍵修正：
-- 體驗刀具保留原 skin 顏色與 coating，只加玻璃材質感。
local tint=Runtime.GlassWeaponTint or Color3.fromRGB(238,242,248)
local blend=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.GlassKnifeSkinTintBlend)or 0.12,0,0.35)
part.Color=(saved.Color or part.Color):Lerp(tint,blend)
else
-- 一般槍械維持原本純玻璃冷白樣式。
part.Color=Runtime.GlassWeaponTint or Color3.fromRGB(238,242,248)
end

part.Reflectance=Runtime.GlassWeaponReflectance or 0.03
part.Transparency=math.max(saved.Transparency or 0, Runtime.GlassWeaponTransparency or 0.48)
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=0

-- 體驗刀具絕對不能清 TextureID；否則 Fade/Doppler 等 skin 會變整把白色。
if part:IsA("MeshPart")and not preserveKnifeSkin then
part.TextureID=""
end

part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassWeaponPart",true)
part:SetAttribute("CVU_GlassPreserveKnifeSkin",preserveKnifeSkin)
end)

-- 體驗刀具：SurfaceAppearance / Texture / SpecialMesh coating 全部原封不動。
if preserveKnifeSkin then
return
end

-- 一般槍械仍然使用既有純玻璃樣式。
for _,obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)
elseif obj:IsA("Decal")or obj:IsA("Texture")then
pcall(function()obj.Transparency=1 end)
pcall(function()obj.Texture="" end)
pcall(function()obj.TextureId="" end)
elseif obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
pcall(function()obj.TextureId="" end)
pcall(function()obj.VertexColor=Vector3.new(1,1,1)end)
end
end
end

function CVU_ApplyGlassWeaponCrackLevel(level)
if not Settings.GlassWeapon then return end
for _,part in ipairs(CVU_GetGlassWeaponParts())do
CVU_ApplyGlassWeaponBase(part)
end
end

end

function CVU_GetLocalGlassHealthRatio()
return nil,nil,nil
end

function CVU_GetLocalGlassHealthRatio()
local bestRatio=nil
local bestHP=nil
local bestMax=nil

for _,char in ipairs(CVU_GetHitCharactersForPlayer(LocalPlayer))do
local hp,maxHP=CVU_GetConfirmedHitHealth(char)
if typeof(hp)=="number"then
maxHP=(typeof(maxHP)=="number"and maxHP>0)and maxHP or 100
local ratio=math.clamp(hp/maxHP,0,1)
if bestRatio==nil or ratio<bestRatio then
bestRatio=ratio
bestHP=hp
bestMax=maxHP
end
end
end

if bestRatio==nil and LocalPlayer.Character then
local hp,maxHP=CVU_GetHealth(LocalPlayer.Character)
if typeof(hp)=="number"then
maxHP=(typeof(maxHP)=="number"and maxHP>0)and maxHP or 100
bestRatio=math.clamp(hp/maxHP,0,1)
bestHP=hp
bestMax=maxHP
end
end

return bestRatio,bestHP,bestMax
end

function CVU_IsGlassWeaponVisualCorrect(part,viewModel)
if not part or not part.Parent or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return true end

local isLens=viewModel and CVU_IsOpticalLensPart(part,viewModel)
local preserveKnifeSkin=CVU_IsActiveKnifeExperienceGlassPart(part,viewModel)

if part:GetAttribute("CVU_GlassWeaponPart")~=true then return false end
if part.Material~=Enum.Material.Glass then return false end
if part.LocalTransparencyModifier>0.01 then return false end

-- 一般槍械的「純玻璃」才要求 coating 被拿掉。
-- 體驗刀具反過來：skin coating 存在是正確狀態，不能被 validation 當成錯誤反覆刪除。
if not preserveKnifeSkin then
if part:IsA("MeshPart")then
local textureId=""
pcall(function()textureId=part.TextureID end)
if type(textureId)=="string"and textureId~=""then return false end
end

for _,obj in ipairs(part:GetChildren())do
if obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
return false
elseif obj:IsA("Decal")or obj:IsA("Texture")then
local trans=1
pcall(function()trans=obj.Transparency end)
if trans<0.99 then return false end
elseif obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
local textureId=""
pcall(function()textureId=obj.TextureId end)
if type(textureId)=="string"and textureId~=""then return false end
end
end
end

if isLens then
local wanted=Runtime.GlassLensTransparency or 0.18
if part.Transparency<wanted-0.06 or part.Transparency>0.48 then return false end
else
local wanted=Runtime.GlassWeaponTransparency or 0.48
if part.Transparency<wanted-0.08 then return false end
end

return true
end

function CVU_IsGlassWeaponEligiblePart(part,viewModel)
if not part or not part.Parent or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
if part.Transparency>=0.985 then return false end

local isExperience=CVU_IsActiveKnifeExperienceGlassPart(part,viewModel)
if isExperience then return true end

-- Cached ownership from an older buggy build is NOT permission to keep modifying the object.
-- It still has to belong to the current weapon branch right now.
if not CVU_IsInsideActiveWeaponBranch(part,viewModel)then return false end
if CVU_IsHardProtectedArmPart(part,viewModel)then return false end
if CVU_IsCharmVisualObject(part,viewModel)then return false end
if CVU_IsOpticalDisplayPart(part,viewModel)or CVU_IsOpticalLensPart(part,viewModel)then return false end

return CVU_IsMetalVisualPart(part)
end

function CVU_ValidateHeldGlassWeapon()
if Runtime.Shutdown
or not Settings.GlassWeapon
or Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning
or CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()~="glass"then
Runtime.GlassValidationAccumulator=0
Runtime.GlassValidationLastRoot=nil
Runtime.GlassValidationLastEligibleCount=0
return
end

local root=CVU_GetHeldWeaponVisualRoot()
local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
if not root or not viewModel then return end

local rootChanged=Runtime.GlassValidationLastRoot~=root
Runtime.GlassValidationLastRoot=root

local eligibleCount=0
local needsRepair=rootChanged

for _,part in ipairs(CVU_GetGlassWeaponParts())do
if CVU_IsGlassWeaponEligiblePart(part,viewModel)then
eligibleCount+=1
if not CVU_IsGlassWeaponVisualCorrect(part,viewModel)then
needsRepair=true
break
end
end
end

-- 同一個 ViewModel root 裡換槍時，root 名稱可能完全不變；
-- eligible part 數量變化一樣視為換槍 / 新零件加入。
if eligibleCount~=(Runtime.GlassValidationLastEligibleCount or 0)then
needsRepair=true
end
Runtime.GlassValidationLastEligibleCount=eligibleCount

if needsRepair then
CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache()
CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel()
end
end

function CVU_UpdateGlassWeaponValidation(dt)
if not Settings.GlassWeapon then
Runtime.GlassValidationAccumulator=0
return
end

Runtime.GlassValidationAccumulator=(Runtime.GlassValidationAccumulator or 0)+(dt or 0)
local interval=tonumber(Runtime.GlassValidationInterval)or 0.15
if Runtime.GlassValidationAccumulator<interval then return end
Runtime.GlassValidationAccumulator=0

pcall(CVU_ValidateHeldGlassWeapon)
end

function CVU_GlassWeaponCheckDamage()
if Runtime.Shutdown
or not Settings.GlassWeapon
or Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning
or CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()~="glass" then return end
if Runtime.GlassWeaponStyleQueued then return end
Runtime.GlassWeaponStyleQueued=true
local generation=Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration or 0
task.defer(function()
Runtime.GlassWeaponStyleQueued=false
if Runtime.Shutdown
or not Settings.GlassWeapon
or Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning
or generation~=(Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration or 0)then return end
CVU_ApplyGlassWeaponCrackLevel(0)
end)
end

function CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel()
if Runtime.Shutdown
or not Settings.GlassWeapon
or Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning
or CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()~="glass" then return end
CVU_ApplyGlassWeaponCrackLevel(0)
end

function CVU_ResetGlassWeaponLife()
CVU_ClearGlassWeaponVisuals(true)
if Settings.GlassWeapon then
CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel()
end
end

function CVU_SetGlassWeapon(enabled)
enabled=enabled==true

-- 切換玻璃時，直接更新「目前武器視覺擁有者」，
-- 讓所有舊的 ViewModel defer / delay callback 立即失效。
if not enabled then
CVU_SetWeaponVisualOwner("none")
Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration=(Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration or 0)+1
Runtime.GlassValidationAccumulator=0
Runtime.GlassValidationLastRoot=nil
Runtime.GlassValidationLastEligibleCount=0
Settings.GlassWeapon=false

-- 同一幀直接把所有保存的 Material / Color / TextureID / SurfaceAppearance 還原。
-- 不等待 0.15s validation，也不靠換槍後才恢復。
CVU_ForceGlassWeaponCleanup()
CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache()

-- 體驗刀具的原始 skin baseline 不會因這次 cleanup 被清掉。
-- 再做一次 race-safe restore，確保第 2 次以後 OFF 也一定回原樣。
if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled then
pcall(CVU_ScheduleGlassKnifePersistentRestore)
end

-- 體驗刀具仍然保持原本 native/fallback 狀態；只重新確認刀具 sound/inspect wiring。
-- 不 force re-equip、不按 Q。
if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled and CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()then
local desiredWeapon=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType())
if desiredWeapon then
pcall(CVU_BS_LoadNativeKnifeTracks,desiredWeapon)
task.spawn(function()
local sounds=CVU_BS_GetSoundRoot(desiredWeapon)
if sounds then pcall(CVU_BS_PreloadInstance,sounds)end
end)
if not Runtime.KnifeExperienceFeedbackBound then
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpBindFeedbackActions)
end
end
end
return
end

-- 玻璃與金屬不能同時碰同一把武器。
-- 先把金屬完整撤掉，再讓玻璃接手。
CVU_SetWeaponVisualOwner("glass")
Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration=(Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration or 0)+1
Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration=(Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration or 0)+1
local generation=Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration
local visualGeneration=Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration

if Settings.MetalWeapon or Settings.PlasticMetalWeapon
or next(Runtime.MetalWeaponParts or {})~=nil
or next(Runtime.MetalCoatOverlays or {})~=nil then
-- Glass / Metal 交接只處理武器材質，不拆掉體驗刀具。
Settings.MetalWeapon=false
Settings.PlasticMetalWeapon=false
pcall(CVU_RestoreMetalWeaponParts)
pcall(CVU_ResetADSState)
end

Settings.GlassWeapon=true
CVU_ForceGlassWeaponCleanup()
Settings.GlassWeapon=true
Runtime.GlassValidationAccumulator=0
Runtime.GlassValidationLastRoot=nil
Runtime.GlassValidationLastEligibleCount=0
Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration=generation
Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning=false
CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache()
CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel()

-- ViewModel 可能分幀加入零件；延遲刷新必須同時檢查 glass generation 與 visual owner generation。
task.delay(0.20,function()
if not Runtime.Shutdown
and Settings.GlassWeapon
and not Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning
and generation==(Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration or 0)
and visualGeneration==(Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration or 0)
and CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="glass" then
CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel()
end
end)

task.delay(0.75,function()
if not Runtime.Shutdown
and Settings.GlassWeapon
and not Runtime.GlassWeaponTransitioning
and generation==(Runtime.GlassWeaponGeneration or 0)
and visualGeneration==(Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration or 0)
and CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="glass" then
CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel()
end
end)
end

function CVU_GetCharacterStablePivot(char)
if not char or not char.Parent then return nil end
local root=char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")or char.PrimaryPart
if root and root:IsA("BasePart")then
return root.CFrame
end
local ok,cf=pcall(function()return char:GetPivot()end)
if ok then return cf end
return nil
end

-- 只在擊殺特效開啟時以 10 Hz 記錄死亡前位置；每幀掃全玩家沒有必要。
local CVU_DeathPivotClock=0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if not Settings.CVU_KillEffect then CVU_DeathPivotClock=0 return end
CVU_DeathPivotClock+=(dt or 0)
if CVU_DeathPivotClock<.10 then return end
CVU_DeathPivotClock=0
for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
local char=plr.Character
if char and char.Parent then
local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local cf=CVU_GetCharacterStablePivot(char)
if hum and cf then
if hum.Health>0 and hum:GetState()~=Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
Runtime.LastAlivePivot[char]=cf Runtime.DeathPositionCache[char]=nil
elseif Runtime.DeathPositionCache[char]==nil then
Runtime.DeathPositionCache[char]=Runtime.LastAlivePivot[char]or cf
end
end
end
end
end)

function CVU_KillEffect(c)
if not Settings.CVU_KillEffect or not c or not c.Parent then return end
local n=c.Name
-- 優先使用死亡前最後一個穩定位置，避免 ragdoll / 斜坡滑動造成特效錯位。
local cf=Runtime.DeathPositionCache[c]or Runtime.LastAlivePivot[c]or CVU_GetCharacterStablePivot(c)
if not cf then return end
local p=cf.Position
local a=c.Archivable
c.Archivable=true
local ok,x=pcall(function()return c:Clone()end)
c.Archivable=a
if not ok or not x then return end

for _,o in ipairs(c:GetDescendants())do
if o:IsA("BasePart")then
o.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
o.CanCollide=false
elseif o:IsA("Decal")or o:IsA("Texture")then
o.Transparency=1
end
end

-- Kill Effect clone 只保留人物本體輪廓。
-- c:Clone() 會把 Accessory / CharacterArmor / WeaponModel / WeaponAttachments 一起複製；
-- 單純清 TextureID 不足以去掉所有玩家皮膚、手套與武器外觀，所以先整個移除裝備/外觀容器。
local killEffectTrash={}
for _,o in ipairs(x:GetDescendants())do
local key=string.lower(tostring(o.Name or"")):gsub("[^%w]","")
local equipmentContainer=
(o:IsA("Model")or o:IsA("Folder"))and(
key=="characterarmor"
or key=="weaponmodel"
or key=="weaponattachments"
)
local cosmeticObject=
o:IsA("Accessory")
or o:IsA("Tool")
or o:IsA("CharacterMesh")

if equipmentContainer or cosmeticObject then
killEffectTrash[#killEffectTrash+1]=o
end
end
for _,o in ipairs(killEffectTrash)do
if o and o.Parent then pcall(function()o:Destroy()end)end
end

-- 第二輪才處理真正留下的人物幾何，避免裝備子零件先被改色後又殘留。
for _,o in ipairs(x:GetDescendants())do
local key=string.lower(tostring(o.Name or"")):gsub("[^%w]","")
if o:IsA("Script")or o:IsA("LocalScript")or o:IsA("Humanoid")or o:IsA("Animator")then
o:Destroy()
elseif o:IsA("Motor6D")and(
string.find(key,"weaponattachment",1,true)==1
or string.find(key,"gloveattachment",1,true)==1
)then
o:Destroy()
elseif o:IsA("BasePart")then
o.Anchored=true
o.CanCollide=false
o.CanTouch=false
o.CanQuery=false
o.CastShadow=false
o.Transparency=0
o.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
o.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
o.Color=Settings.KillEffectColor
pcall(function()
o.Reflectance=0
o.MaterialVariant=""
end)
if o:IsA("MeshPart")then
pcall(function()o.TextureID=""end)
end
elseif o:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")
or o:IsA("Decal")
or o:IsA("Texture")
or o:IsA("Shirt")
or o:IsA("Pants")
or o:IsA("ShirtGraphic")
or o:IsA("BodyColors")then
o:Destroy()
elseif o:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
pcall(function()
o.TextureId=""
o.VertexColor=Vector3.new(Settings.KillEffectColor.R,Settings.KillEffectColor.G,Settings.KillEffectColor.B)
end)
end
end

x.Name="KillEffectGhost"
x.Parent=Workspace
x:PivotTo(cf)

local function MakeParticles(root,color,mode)
if not root then return nil end
local att=Instance.new("Attachment")
att.Name="KillEffectParticles"
att.Parent=root
local e=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
e.Name="KillEffectBurst"
e.Rate=0
e.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(.8,1.8)
e.Speed=NumberRange.new(2.5,7)
e.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(180,180)
e.Acceleration=Vector3.new(0,2.2,0)
e.Drag=1.2
e.LightEmission=1
e.LightInfluence=0
e.Color=ColorSequence.new(color)
e.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.65,.08),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
e.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.20),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.35,.15),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
e.Parent=att
if mode=="heavy" then
e:Emit(180)
else
e:Emit(90)
end
return att,e
end

if style=="死神十字架"then
local root=x:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or x.PrimaryPart or x:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
local cross=Instance.new("Model")
cross.Name="KillCross"
cross.Parent=Workspace

local pole=Instance.new("Part")
pole.Name="Pole"
pole.Anchored=true
pole.CanCollide=false
pole.CanTouch=false

emitCount=18

particleCount+=emitCount

NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)
})

NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,.17),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(.55,.11),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)
})

e:Emit(120-particleCount)
end

function CVU_StopMusic()
 Runtime.MusicGeneration=(Runtime.MusicGeneration or 0)+1

 end

function CVU_ApplyMusic(restart)

 CVU_StopMusic()
