-- ============================================================
-- Music hotkey / 播歌快捷鍵
-- Uses UserInputService directly so every keyboard/mouse InputObject Roblox exposes
-- can be captured. Vendor-only macro/HID keys that Roblox itself never exposes
-- cannot be observed from Luau; recognized gaming/media keys are accepted normally.
-- No input is swallowed, so binding Mouse1/Mouse2 etc. still lets the game receive it.
-- ============================================================
function CVU_MusicHotkeyTokenFromInput(input,wheelDirection)
 if not input then return nil end
 local userTypeName=""
 local keyName=""
 pcall(function()userTypeName=input.UserInputType.Name end)
 pcall(function()keyName=input.KeyCode.Name end)
 if userTypeName=="Keyboard" then
  if keyName~=""and keyName~="Unknown"then return"K:"..keyName end
  return nil
 end
 if string.sub(userTypeName,1,11)=="MouseButton"then
  return"M:"..userTypeName
 end
 if userTypeName=="MouseWheel"then
  local direction=tonumber(wheelDirection)
  if not direction then pcall(function()direction=input.Position.Z end)end
  if direction and direction>0 then return"MW:Up"end
  if direction and direction<0 then return"MW:Down"end
 end
 return nil
end

function CVU_MusicHotkeyDisplay(token)
 token=tostring(token or"None")
 if token==""or token=="None"then return"未設定"end
 if string.sub(token,1,2)=="K:"then
  local name=string.sub(token,3)
  local pretty={
   LeftControl="左 Ctrl",RightControl="右 Ctrl",LeftShift="左 Shift",RightShift="右 Shift",
   LeftAlt="左 Alt",RightAlt="右 Alt",Return="Enter",Backspace="Backspace",Space="Space",
   CapsLock="Caps Lock",NumLock="Num Lock",ScrollLock="Scroll Lock",Print="Print Screen",
   PageUp="Page Up",PageDown="Page Down",Home="Home",End="End",Insert="Insert",Delete="Delete",
   Up="↑",Down="↓",Left="←",Right="→",
  }
  return pretty[name]or name
 end
 if string.sub(token,1,2)=="M:"then
  local name=string.sub(token,3)
  local pretty={MouseButton1="滑鼠左鍵",MouseButton2="滑鼠右鍵",MouseButton3="滑鼠中鍵",MouseButton4="滑鼠側鍵 1",MouseButton5="滑鼠側鍵 2"}
  return pretty[name]or name
 end
 if token=="MW:Up"then return"滑鼠滾輪 ↑"end
 if token=="MW:Down"then return"滑鼠滾輪 ↓"end
 return token
end

function CVU_SetMusicEnabled(enabled)
 Settings.MusicEnabled=enabled==true
 if Settings.MusicEnabled then CVU_ApplyMusic(true)else CVU_StopMusic()end
 CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
 pcall(CVU_RefreshAllToggleVisuals)
 if type(Runtime.MusicHotkeyRefresh)=="function"then pcall(Runtime.MusicHotkeyRefresh)end
 if type(Runtime.MusicUIRefresh)=="function"then pcall(Runtime.MusicUIRefresh)end
end

function CVU_MusicHotkeyMatches(input,wheelDirection)
 local wanted=tostring(Settings.MusicHotkey or"None")
 if wanted=="None"or wanted==""then return false end
 return CVU_MusicHotkeyTokenFromInput(input,wheelDirection)==wanted
end

function CVU_MusicHotkeyFire(input,wheelDirection,isRelease)
 if Runtime.Shutdown then return false end
 local token=CVU_MusicHotkeyTokenFromInput(input,wheelDirection)
 if not token then return false end

 -- Capture mode intentionally accepts Escape, function keys, mouse buttons, etc.
 -- The separate Clear button is used to unassign instead of reserving a cancel key.
 if Runtime.MusicHotkeyCapturing and not isRelease then
  Settings.MusicHotkey=token
  Runtime.MusicHotkeyCapturing=false
  Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive=false
  CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
  if type(Runtime.MusicHotkeyRefresh)=="function"then pcall(Runtime.MusicHotkeyRefresh)end
  return true
 end

 if token~=tostring(Settings.MusicHotkey or"None")then return false end
 if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end

 local mode=tostring(Settings.MusicHotkeyMode or"切換")
 if string.sub(token,1,3)=="MW:"then mode="切換"end -- wheel has no meaningful release event
 if mode=="按住"then
  if isRelease then
   if Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive then
    Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive=false
    CVU_SetMusicEnabled(false)
   end
  elseif not Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive then
   Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive=true
   CVU_SetMusicEnabled(true)
  end
  return true
 end

 if isRelease then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now-(Runtime.MusicHotkeyLastTrigger or 0)<.10 then return true end
 Runtime.MusicHotkeyLastTrigger=now
 CVU_SetMusicEnabled(not Settings.MusicEnabled)
 return true
end

Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections=Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections or{}
Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections[#Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections+1]=UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,_processed)
 CVU_MusicHotkeyFire(input,nil,false)
end)
Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections[#Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections+1]=UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input,_processed)
 CVU_MusicHotkeyFire(input,nil,true)
end)
Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections[#Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections+1]=UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input,_processed)
 local userTypeName=""
 pcall(function()userTypeName=input.UserInputType.Name end)
 if userTypeName~="MouseWheel"then return end
 local direction=0
 pcall(function()direction=input.Position.Z end)
 if direction~=0 then CVU_MusicHotkeyFire(input,direction,false)end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- Gun MOD：FireRate v2
-- 修正：不能只改目前「外觀槍械分類」裡的 module table。
-- BloxStrike 的已生成 WeaponComponent / 驗證用快取可能持有另一份 Properties table，
-- 所以使用「官方槍械白名單 + live properties 掃描」；刀、手榴彈、C4、手套仍排除。
-- ============================================================
function CVU_GunModGetHeldGunName()
 local tool=CVU_GetEquippedTool()
 local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
 local now=os.clock()
 if Runtime.GunModDetectTool==tool
 and Runtime.GunModDetectViewModel==viewModel
 and now<(Runtime.GunModDetectUntil or 0)then
  return Runtime.GunModDetectedWeapon
 end
 local function finish(name)
  Runtime.GunModDetectTool=tool
  Runtime.GunModDetectViewModel=viewModel
  Runtime.GunModDetectedWeapon=name
  Runtime.GunModDetectUntil=now+.15
  return name
 end
 local direct=type(CVU_GetCurrentLocalGunName)=="function"and CVU_GetCurrentLocalGunName()or nil
 if direct and (type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)~="function"or CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(direct))then return finish(direct)end
 local candidates={}
 for _,root in ipairs({tool or false,viewModel or false})do
  if root then
   candidates[#candidates+1]=root.Name
   for _,key in ipairs({"Weapon","WeaponName","GunName","ItemName"})do
    local value=root:GetAttribute(key)
    if type(value)=="string"then candidates[#candidates+1]=value end
   end
   local checked=0
   for _,child in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
    if child:IsA("Model")or child:IsA("Folder")or child:IsA("Tool")or child:IsA("StringValue")then
     candidates[#candidates+1]=child:IsA("StringValue")and child.Value or child.Name
     checked+=1
     if checked>=120 then break end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 for _,name in ipairs(candidates)do
  local resolved=type(CVU_ResolveNativeGunName)=="function"and CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(name)or nil
  if not resolved and type(CVU_NormalizeWeaponName)=="function"then resolved=CVU_NormalizeWeaponName(name)end
  if resolved and (type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)~="function"or CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(resolved))then return finish(resolved)end
  if type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)=="function"and CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(name)then return finish(name)end
 end
 return finish(nil)
end

function CVU_GunModWriteFireRate(config,value)
 if type(config)~="table"or typeof(value)~="number"then return false end
 local current=nil
 pcall(function()current=rawget(config,"FireRate")end)
 if typeof(current)=="number"and math.abs(current-value)<0.000001 then return true end
 local wasReadonly=false
 if typeof(isreadonly)=="function"then pcall(function()wasReadonly=isreadonly(config)==true end)end
 if typeof(setreadonly)=="function"then pcall(function()setreadonly(config,false)end)end
 local ok=pcall(function()rawset(config,"FireRate",value)end)
 if wasReadonly and typeof(setreadonly)=="function"then pcall(function()setreadonly(config,true)end)end
 return ok
end

function CVU_GunModGetAllGunNames()
 if type(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData)=="function"then pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)end
 -- 不能為了快速射擊去切換外觀頁的槍械分類；直接讀已建立的 groups / Assets folders。
 local result,seen={},{}
 local function add(name)
  if type(name)~="string"or name==""or seen[name]then return end
  if type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)=="function"and not CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(name)then return end
  seen[name]=true result[#result+1]=name
 end
 for _,list in pairs(Runtime.GunExperienceModelsByCategory or{})do
  if type(list)=="table"then for _,name in ipairs(list)do add(name)end end
 end
 -- 如果某版 Assets.Skins 沒有完整分類，直接從正式 Weapons / Skins folder 補齊。
 for _,folder in ipairs({Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder,Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder})do
  if folder then for _,child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do add(child.Name)end end
 end
 -- 已確認的 BloxStrike 火器 fallback。額外名稱只有真的能通過 NativeGunName 才會加入。
 for _,name in ipairs({
  "Glock-18","USP-S","P250","Tec-9","Five-SeveN","Desert Eagle","Dual Berettas",
  "MAC-10","MP9","P90","Negev","Nova","XM1014","Galil AR","FAMAS","AK-47",
  "M4A1-S","M4A4","SG 553","AUG","SSG 08","AWP","R8 Revolver","MAG-7","G3SG1"
 })do add(name)end
 table.sort(result,function(a,b)return string.lower(a)<string.lower(b)end)
 Runtime.GunModNativeGunNames=result
 return result
end

function CVU_GunModLooksLikeGunProperties(config)
 if type(config)~="table"then return false end
 local fire=rawget(config,"FireRate")
 if typeof(fire)~="number"or fire<=0 then return false end
 local score=0
 for _,key in ipairs({"BulletsPerShot","Range","RangeModifier","ArmorPenetration","Penetration","Damage","MagazineSize","ClipSize","Recoil","Spread"})do
  if rawget(config,key)~=nil then score+=1 end
 end
 return score>=2
end

function CVU_GunModFindOwnerFromTable(config)
 if type(config)~="table"then return nil end
 -- 有些 live object / properties table 自己就帶武器名稱。
 for _,key in ipairs({"Name","Weapon","WeaponName","GunName","ItemName"})do
  local value=rawget(config,key)
  if type(value)=="string"then
   local resolved=type(CVU_ResolveNativeGunName)=="function"and CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(value)or value
   if type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)~="function"or CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(resolved)then return resolved end
  end
 end
 -- 先比 table identity；官方 require cache / WeaponComponent 通常會直接共用它。
 for weaponName,native in pairs(Runtime.GunModNativeProperties or{})do
  if config==native then return weaponName end
 end
 -- 新版若 clone Properties，使用不含 FireRate 的官方欄位做 fingerprint。
 if not CVU_GunModLooksLikeGunProperties(config)then return nil end
 local bestName=nil
 local bestScore=0
 for weaponName,native in pairs(Runtime.GunModNativeProperties or{})do
  if type(native)=="table"then
   local score=0
   local compared=0
   for _,key in ipairs({"BulletsPerShot","Range","RangeModifier","ArmorPenetration","Penetration","MagazineSize","ClipSize"})do
    local a=rawget(config,key)
    local b=rawget(native,key)
    if a~=nil and b~=nil then
     compared+=1
     if a==b then score+=1 end
    end
   end
   if compared>=2 and score>bestScore then bestScore=score bestName=weaponName end
  end
 end
 if bestScore>=2 then return bestName end
 return nil
end

function CVU_GunModRememberFireRateTable(config,weaponName)
 if type(config)~="table"then return false end
 if type(weaponName)~="string"or weaponName==""then return false end
 if type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)=="function"and not CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(weaponName)then return false end
 local ok,fireRate=pcall(function()return rawget(config,"FireRate")end)
 if not ok or typeof(fireRate)~="number"or fireRate<=0 then return false end
 Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates=Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.GunModFireRateTables=Runtime.GunModFireRateTables or{}
 Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners=Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName=Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName or{}
 local original=Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName[weaponName]
 if typeof(original)~="number"or original<=0 then
  original=fireRate
  Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName[weaponName]=original
 end
 if Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates[config]==nil then
  Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates[config]=original
  Runtime.GunModFireRateTables[#Runtime.GunModFireRateTables+1]=config
 end
 Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners[config]=weaponName
 return true
end

function CVU_GunModScanFireRateTables(force)
 local now=os.clock()
 -- getgc(true) 很重，不能在交火中每秒掃整個 Lua GC。
 -- 一般情況只在換槍 / ViewModel 重建時 force scan；30 秒才做一次保險掃描。
 if not force and now-(Runtime.GunModLastScanAt or 0)<30.0 then return #(Runtime.GunModFireRateTables or{})end
 Runtime.GunModLastScanAt=now
 Runtime.GunModFireRateTables=Runtime.GunModFireRateTables or{}
 Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates=Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners=Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.GunModNativeProperties=Runtime.GunModNativeProperties or{}
 Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName=Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName or{}

 local names=CVU_GunModGetAllGunNames()
 if type(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties)=="function"then
  for _,weaponName in ipairs(names)do
   local ok,properties=pcall(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties,weaponName)
   if ok and type(properties)=="table"then
    Runtime.GunModNativeProperties[weaponName]=properties
    if Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName[weaponName]==nil then
     local original=rawget(properties,"FireRate")
     if typeof(original)=="number"and original>0 then Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName[weaponName]=original end
    end
    CVU_GunModRememberFireRateTable(properties,weaponName)
   end
  end
 end

 local liveFound=0
 if typeof(getgc)=="function"then
  local ok,objects=pcall(getgc,true)
  if ok and type(objects)=="table"then
   for _,object in pairs(objects)do
    if type(object)=="table"then
     -- WeaponComponent / weapon object：Name + Properties 是最可靠的 live 路徑。
     local props=rawget(object,"Properties")
     local objectName=rawget(object,"Name")
     if type(props)=="table"and type(objectName)=="string"then
      local resolved=type(CVU_ResolveNativeGunName)=="function"and CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(objectName)or objectName
      if type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)~="function"or CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(resolved)then
       if CVU_GunModRememberFireRateTable(props,resolved)then liveFound+=1 end
      end
     elseif CVU_GunModLooksLikeGunProperties(object)then
      local owner=CVU_GunModFindOwnerFromTable(object)
      if owner and CVU_GunModRememberFireRateTable(object,owner)then liveFound+=1 end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end

 local count=#(Runtime.GunModFireRateTables or{})
 Runtime.GunModFireStatus=count>0
 and("已找到 "..tostring(count).." 個槍械 FireRate table（live "..tostring(liveFound).."）｜刀/投擲物/C4 排除")
 or"沒有找到槍械 FireRate；請進入對局並拿出一把槍"
 return count
end

function CVU_GunModIsChargeWeapon(weaponName)
 -- R8 Revolver 使用按住扳機/擊錘蓄力後才真正開火的原生流程。
 -- 這不是單純 FireRate 週期，因此不要把它當一般半自動手槍硬改。
 return tostring(weaponName or"")=="R8 Revolver"
end

function CVU_GunModGetEffectiveRequestedRate()
 local quickEnabled=Settings.GunModEnabled==true
 local rageEnabled=Settings.RageWallShootEnabled==true
 local quickRate=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.GunModRate)or 12)+.5),4,50)
 local rageRate=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.RageWallRate)or 12)+.5),4,30)
 Settings.GunModRate=quickRate
 Settings.RageWallRate=rageRate
 if quickEnabled and rageEnabled then return math.max(quickRate,rageRate),quickRate,rageRate end
 if quickEnabled then return quickRate,quickRate,nil end
 if rageEnabled then return rageRate,nil,rageRate end
 return nil,nil,nil
end

function CVU_GunModApplyFireRates()
 local rate,quickRate,rageRate=CVU_GunModGetEffectiveRequestedRate()
 if not rate then return false end
 CVU_GunModScanFireRateTables(false)
 local interval=1/rate
 local applied=0
 local skippedCharge=0
 local held=CVU_GunModGetHeldGunName()
 for _,config in ipairs(Runtime.GunModFireRateTables or{})do
  local owner=Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners and Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners[config]
  if owner and (type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)~="function"or CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(owner))then
   if CVU_GunModIsChargeWeapon(owner)then
    local original=(Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName and Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName[owner])
    or(Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates and Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates[config])
    if typeof(original)=="number"and original>0 then CVU_GunModWriteFireRate(config,original)end
    skippedCharge+=1
   elseif CVU_GunModWriteFireRate(config,interval)then
    applied+=1
   end
  end
 end
 Runtime.GunModAppliedCount=applied
 Runtime.GunModAppliedInterval=interval
 Runtime.GunModHeldWeapon=held
 if CVU_GunModIsChargeWeapon(held)then
  Runtime.GunModFireStatus="R8 Revolver：保留原生蓄力扳機"
 elseif applied>0 then
  if quickRate and rageRate then
   Runtime.GunModFireStatus="快速射擊 "..tostring(quickRate).."/s｜暴怒自動射擊 "..tostring(rageRate).."/s｜FireRate ceiling "..tostring(rate).."/s"
  elseif rageRate then
   Runtime.GunModFireStatus="暴怒穿牆自動射擊 "..tostring(rageRate).."/s｜已同步 "..tostring(applied).." 個槍械 table"
  else
   Runtime.GunModFireStatus="快速射擊 "..tostring(quickRate).." 次/秒｜"..tostring(held or"目前未辨識持槍").."｜已同步 "..tostring(applied).." 個槍械 table"
  end
  if skippedCharge>0 then Runtime.GunModFireStatus=Runtime.GunModFireStatus.."｜R8 已排除" end
 end
 return applied>0
end

function CVU_GunModRestoreFireRates()
 local restored=0
 for _,config in ipairs(Runtime.GunModFireRateTables or{})do
  local owner=Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners and Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners[config]
  local original=(owner and Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName and Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName[owner])
  or(Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates and Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates[config])
  if original~=nil and CVU_GunModWriteFireRate(config,original)then restored+=1 end
 end
 Runtime.GunModAppliedCount=0
 Runtime.GunModAppliedInterval=nil
 Runtime.GunModFireStatus="快速射擊已關閉，已還原 "..tostring(restored).." 個槍械設定"
 return restored
end

function CVU_GunModSetEnabled(enabled)
 Settings.GunModEnabled=enabled==true
 Settings.GunModRate=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.GunModRate)or 12)+.5),4,50)
 Runtime.GunModAccumulator=0
 Runtime.GunModLastScanAt=0
 Runtime.GunModLastTool=nil
 Runtime.GunModLastViewModel=nil
 Runtime.GunModLastHeldWeapon=nil
 if Settings.GunModEnabled then
  -- 快速射擊與偽穿牆 / 暴怒穿牆共用原生 Weapon.shoot() 與同一批 FireRate table。
  if (Settings.PseudoWallPenetration==true or Settings.RageWallShootEnabled==true) and type(CVU_InstallPseudoWallPenetration)=="function"then
   pcall(CVU_InstallPseudoWallPenetration)
  end
  CVU_GunModScanFireRateTables(true)
  CVU_GunModApplyFireRates()
 elseif Settings.RageWallShootEnabled==true then
  CVU_GunModScanFireRateTables(true)
  CVU_GunModApplyFireRates()
 else
  CVU_GunModRestoreFireRates()
 end
end

Runtime.GunModHeartbeat=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 if Runtime.Shutdown or (Settings.GunModEnabled~=true and Settings.RageWallShootEnabled~=true) then return end
 Runtime.GunModAccumulator=(Runtime.GunModAccumulator or 0)+(dt or 0)
 if Runtime.GunModAccumulator<.20 then return end
 Runtime.GunModAccumulator=0

 -- 只有換 Tool / ViewModel / 持槍名稱時才重新做重型 live scan。
 local tool=CVU_GetEquippedTool()
 local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
 local held=CVU_GunModGetHeldGunName()
 local changed=tool~=Runtime.GunModLastTool
 or viewModel~=Runtime.GunModLastViewModel
 or held~=Runtime.GunModLastHeldWeapon
 Runtime.GunModLastTool=tool
 Runtime.GunModLastViewModel=viewModel
 Runtime.GunModLastHeldWeapon=held
 if changed then
  Runtime.GunModLastScanAt=0
  CVU_GunModScanFireRateTables(true)
 end
 CVU_GunModApplyFireRates()
end)

if Settings.GunModEnabled then task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_GunModSetEnabled,true)end)end

function CVU_ShutdownGunMod()
 CVU_GunModSetEnabled(false)
 if Runtime.GunModHeartbeat then pcall(function()Runtime.GunModHeartbeat:Disconnect()end)end
 Runtime.GunModFireRateTables=nil
 Runtime.GunModOriginalFireRates=nil
 Runtime.GunModFireRateOwners=nil
 Runtime.GunModNativeProperties=nil
 Runtime.GunModNativeOriginalByName=nil
end

-- 投票踢出保護只能攔截由本機 LocalScript 呼叫的 Player:Kick。
-- Roblox 伺服器直接中斷連線無法由客戶端取消，因此這裡保留清楚的狀態供檢查。
function CVU_InstallVoteKickProtection()
if Runtime.VoteKickHookInstalled then return true end
if typeof(hookmetamethod)~="function"or typeof(getnamecallmethod)~="function"then
Runtime.VoteKickProtectionStatus="目前執行環境不支援本機 Kick 攔截"
return false
end
local oldNamecall
local function handler(self,...)
local method=""
pcall(function()method=string.lower(tostring(getnamecallmethod()))end)
if not Runtime.Shutdown and Settings.VoteKickProtection==true and self==LocalPlayer and method=="kick"then
Runtime.VoteKickBlockedCount=(Runtime.VoteKickBlockedCount or 0)+1
Runtime.VoteKickProtectionStatus="已攔截一次本機 Kick 呼叫"
Runtime.VoteKickLastBlockedAt=os.clock()
return nil
end
return oldNamecall(self,...)
end
local wrapper=handler
if typeof(newcclosure)=="function"then wrapper=newcclosure(handler)end
local ok,result=pcall(function()return hookmetamethod(game,"__namecall",wrapper)end)
if not ok or type(result)~="function"then
Runtime.VoteKickProtectionStatus="安裝本機 Kick 攔截失敗"
return false
end
oldNamecall=result
Runtime.VoteKickOldNamecall=oldNamecall
Runtime.VoteKickHookInstalled=true
Runtime.VoteKickProtectionStatus="本機 Kick 攔截已就緒"
return true
end

function CVU_SetVoteKickProtection(enabled)
Settings.VoteKickProtection=enabled==true
if Settings.VoteKickProtection then
CVU_InstallVoteKickProtection()
else
Runtime.VoteKickProtectionStatus="投票踢出保護已關閉"
end
end

PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.VoteKickProtection then return end
if not object:IsA("TextLabel")and not object:IsA("TextButton")then return end
task.defer(function()
if not object or not object.Parent then return end
local text=string.lower(tostring(object.Text or""))
local vote=string.find(text,"vote",1,true)or string.find(text,"投票",1,true)
local kick=string.find(text,"kick",1,true)or string.find(text,"踢",1,true)
local me=string.find(text,string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name),1,true)
or string.find(text,string.lower(LocalPlayer.DisplayName),1,true)
if vote and kick and me then
Runtime.VoteKickProtectionStatus="偵測到針對你的投票踢出；等待本機 Kick 攔截"
Runtime.VoteKickLastDetectedAt=os.clock()
end
end)
end)

if Settings.VoteKickProtection then task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_InstallVoteKickProtection)end)end

function CVU_IsConfirmedDead(char)
if not char then return false end

-- 1) 優先只相信 Character 自己的 Humanoid。
local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
return hum.Health<=0 or hum:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
end

-- 2) 只讀 Character 本體上的死亡 Attribute。
-- 不再遞迴找子模型，避免武器 / 裝備 / 臨時模型裡的 Dead/HP 誤判。
for _,attrName in ipairs({"Dead","IsDead","Eliminated","Killed"})do
if char:GetAttribute(attrName)==true then
return true
end
end

-- 3) 只接受 Character 直接子層的 Health/HP/HitPoints。
-- 舊版 FindFirstChild(name,true) 可能抓到武器、護甲或其他子模型的 0 HP。
for _,name in ipairs({"Health","HP","HitPoints"})do
local v=char:FindFirstChild(name)
if v and (v:IsA("NumberValue")or v:IsA("IntValue"))then
local n=tonumber(v.Value)
if n~=nil then
return n<=0
end
end
end

-- 4) 不再把「暫時離開 Workspace」直接視為死亡。
-- 某些角色在受擊、換容器、LOD / ragdoll 切換時會短暫被搬動，
-- 這正是會造成單次受擊白光誤觸發的來源。
return false
end

function CVU_WaitConfirmedDead(char,timeout)
local deadline=os.clock()+(timeout or .65)
repeat
if CVU_IsConfirmedDead(char)then return true end
task.wait(.035)
until os.clock()>=deadline
return CVU_IsConfirmedDead(char)
end

function CVU_FCBN(n)if not n or n==""then return nil end local p=Players:FindFirstChild(n)if p and p.Character and p.Character.Parent then return p.Character end local chars=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")if chars then for _,team in ipairs(chars:GetChildren())do local m=team:FindFirstChild(n)if m and m:IsA("Model")then return m end end end for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do if plr.DisplayName==n or plr.Name==n then if plr.Character and plr.Character.Parent then return plr.Character end if chars then for _,team in ipairs(chars:GetChildren())do local m=team:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)if m and m:IsA("Model")then return m end end end end end end local KillFeedSeen=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})function CVU_PKFO(obj)if Runtime.Shutdown or(not Settings.CVU_KillEffect and not Settings.BulletSound and not CVU_AnyGunKillCounterEnabled())or not obj or KillFeedSeen[obj]or obj:IsDescendantOf(GUI)then return end KillFeedSeen[obj]=true task.defer(function()task.wait(.03)if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end local texts={}if obj:IsA("TextLabel")or obj:IsA("TextButton")then texts[#texts+1]=obj.Text end for _,d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("TextLabel")or d:IsA("TextButton")then if d.Text and d.Text~=""then texts[#texts+1]=d.Text end end end if#texts==0 then return end local all=table.concat(texts," ")local me=(string.find(string.lower(all),string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name),1,true)~=nil)or(string.find(string.lower(all),string.lower(LocalPlayer.DisplayName),1,true)~=nil)if not me then return end for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do if plr~=LocalPlayer and not CVU_IsSameTeam(plr)then local a=string.lower(all)if string.find(a,string.lower(plr.Name),1,true)or string.find(a,string.lower(plr.DisplayName),1,true)then local char=CVU_FCBN(plr.Name)or CVU_FCBN(plr.DisplayName)if char then
if CVU_WaitConfirmedDead(char,.65)then
-- Kill Feed 已同時包含「本地玩家 + 敵人」且死亡驗證成功，
-- 因此可作為自訂傷害流程 / 瞬殺流程的可靠後備確認。
CVU_NotifyConfirmedKill(plr)
if Settings.CVU_KillEffect then CVU_KillEffect(char)end
end
return
end end end end end)end function CVU_BindKillFeed(root)if not root then return end for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("GuiObject")then CVU_PKFO(d)end end root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)if d:IsA("GuiObject")then CVU_PKFO(d)end end)end CVU_BindKillFeed(PlayerGui)function CVU_IsChicken(model)if not model or not model:IsA("Model")then return false end if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)then return false end return CollectionService:HasTag(model,"Chicken")or model:GetAttribute("Chicken")==true or model:GetAttribute("EntityType")=="Chicken"end function CVU_ChickenAlive(chicken)if not chicken or not chicken.Parent or not chicken:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)then return false end if chicken:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return false end local hp=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(chicken))return hp==nil or hp>0 end function CVU_GetChickenPart(chicken)for _,name in ipairs(Settings.ChickenParts)do local part=chicken:FindFirstChild(name,true)if part and part:IsA("BasePart")then return part end end return chicken.PrimaryPart end function CVU_GetChickenTeam(chicken)local team=chicken:GetAttribute("Team")if team~=nil then return tostring(team)end local value=chicken:FindFirstChild("Team",true)if value and value:IsA("ValueBase")then return tostring(value.Value)end return nil end function CVU_IsChickenTeammate(chicken)if not Settings.TeamCheck then return false end local mine=CVU_GetPlayerTeamKey(LocalPlayer)local theirs=CVU_GetChickenTeam(chicken)if not mine or not theirs then return false end local mineValue=string.match(mine,":(.+)$")or mine return tostring(mineValue)==tostring(theirs)end function CVU_BuildChickenCandidate(chicken)if not CVU_IsChicken(chicken)then return nil end if not CVU_ChickenAlive(chicken)then return nil end if CVU_IsChickenTeammate(chicken)then return nil end local part=CVU_GetChickenPart(chicken)if not part then return nil end local screen,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)if not onScreen or screen.Z<=0 then return nil end local center=Camera.ViewportSize/2 local crosshairDistance=(Vector2.new(screen.X,screen.Y)-center).Magnitude if crosshairDistance>Settings.FOVRadius then return nil end local root=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")local worldDistance=root and(root.Position-part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge local health=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(chicken))or 100 return{Chicken=chicken,Part=part,CrosshairDistance=crosshairDistance,WorldDistance=worldDistance,Health=health,}end function CVU_BetterChicken(a,b)if not b then return true end if Settings.TargetMode=="準心最近"then return a.CrosshairDistance<b.CrosshairDistance elseif Settings.TargetMode=="準心最遠"then return a.CrosshairDistance>b.CrosshairDistance elseif Settings.TargetMode=="最低血量"then if a.Health==b.Health then return a.CrosshairDistance<b.CrosshairDistance end return a.Health<b.Health elseif Settings.TargetMode=="最高血量"then if a.Health==b.Health then a.CrosshairDistance<b.CrosshairDistance end return a.WorldDistance>b.WorldDistance end return false end function CVU_GetBestChicken()local best=nil for _,chicken in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Chicken"))do local candidate=CVU_BuildChickenCandidate(chicken)if candidate and CVU_BetterChicken(candidate,best)then best=candidate end end if not best then return nil,nil end return best.Chicken,best.Part end function CVU_GetPredictedPosition(part,origin)if not Settings.Prediction then return part.Position end local CVU_ShouldModifyChicken()if not Settings.ChickenSilent then return false end local chicken=Runtime.CurrentChicken local part=Runtime.CurrentChickenPart if not chicken or not part then return false end index>finalIndex then finalIndex=index end end end if not finalIndex then return result end local finalHit=hits[finalIndex]local target=CVU_GetPredictedPosition(Runtime.CurrentChickenPart,origin)finalHit.Instance=Runtime.CurrentChickenPart finalHit.Position=target if finalHit.Exit~=nil then finalHit.Exit=false end result.Chicken=true local delta=target-origin if delta.Magnitude>0.001 then result.Direction=delta.Unit result.Distance=delta.Magnitude end return result end function CVU_GetRagePosition(part)local target=part.Position if Settings.RagePosition=="後方"then local position=target+part.CFrame.LookVector*Settings.BehindDistance return CFrame.lookAt(position,target)end local position=target+Vector3.new(0,Settings.AboveHeight,0)return CFrame.lookAt(position,target)end function CVU_MoveToChicken(part)local character=LocalPlayer.Character if not character then return end if Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame==nil then Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame=character:GetPivot()end character:PivotTo(CVU_GetRagePosition(part))end function CVU_ReturnCharacter()local character=LocalPlayer.Character if character and Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame then character:PivotTo(Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame)end Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame=nil end function CVU_RageFire()if not Settings.ChickenRage then return end if not CVU_ShouldModifyChicken()then return end local now=os.clock()if now-Runtime.LastFire<Settings.FireInterval then return end Runtime.LastFire=now if _G.ChickenVisual and type(_G.ChickenVisual.OnFireRequested)=="function"then _G.ChickenVisual.OnFireRequested(Runtime.CurrentChicken,Runtime.CurrentChickenPart)end end

function CVU_UpdateSpectatorCounter()
CVU_BuildSpectatorCounterGui()
if not Runtime.SpectatorCounterGui then return end
Runtime.SpectatorCounterGui.Visible=Settings.SpectatorCounter==true
if not Settings.SpectatorCounter then return end
local raw=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Spectators")
local count=math.max(0,math.floor(tonumber(raw)or 0))
Runtime.SpectatorCounterTitle.Text="觀戰者  "..tostring(count)
Runtime.SpectatorCounterNames.Text=count>0 and"BloxStrike 僅公開準確數量"or"目前無觀戰者"
Runtime.SpectatorCounterGui.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(214,58)
Runtime.SpectatorCounterNames.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,0,18)
end

function CVU_DisconnectSpectatorCounterListener()
if Runtime.SpectatorCounterAttributeConnection then
pcall(function()Runtime.SpectatorCounterAttributeConnection:Disconnect()end)
Runtime.SpectatorCounterAttributeConnection=nil
end
end

function CVU_SetSpectatorCounter(enabled)
Settings.SpectatorCounter=enabled==true
CVU_BuildSpectatorCounterGui()
CVU_DisconnectSpectatorCounterListener()
if Settings.SpectatorCounter then
Runtime.SpectatorCounterAttributeConnection=LocalPlayer:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Spectators"):Connect(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
CVU_UpdateSpectatorCounter()
end)
end
CVU_UpdateSpectatorCounter()
end

GUI.Destroying:Connect(function()
CVU_DisconnectSpectatorCounterListener()
end)

-- ============================================================
-- 無後座力
-- 只處理鏡頭 / 武器 recoil，不再改 Bullet spread。
-- ============================================================
function CVU_InstallNoRecoil()
if Runtime.NoRecoilInstalled then return true end
local controllers=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
local moduleScript=controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("CameraController")
if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript")then
Runtime.NoRecoilStatus="找不到 CameraController"
return false
end

local ok,cameraController=pcall(require,moduleScript)
if not ok or type(cameraController)~="table"then
Runtime.NoRecoilStatus="無法載入 CameraController"
return false
end

local oldKick=cameraController.weaponKick
local oldSetRecoil=cameraController.setWeaponRecoil
if type(oldKick)~="function"then
Runtime.NoRecoilStatus="CameraController.weaponKick 不存在"
return false
end

Runtime.NoRecoilCameraController=cameraController
Runtime.NoRecoilOriginalWeaponKick=oldKick
Runtime.NoRecoilOriginalSetWeaponRecoil=type(oldSetRecoil)=="function"and oldSetRecoil or nil

cameraController.weaponKick=function(...)
if Settings.NoRecoil==true then return end
return oldKick(...)
end

if type(oldSetRecoil)=="function"then
cameraController.setWeaponRecoil=function(...)
if Settings.NoRecoil==true then return end
return oldSetRecoil(...)
end
end

Runtime.NoRecoilInstalled=true
Runtime.NoRecoilStatus="無後座力已就緒"
return true
end

function CVU_SetNoRecoil(enabled)
Settings.NoRecoil=enabled==true
if Settings.NoRecoil then
if not CVU_InstallNoRecoil()then
Settings.NoRecoil=false
return false
end
local controller=Runtime.NoRecoilCameraController
if controller then
if type(controller.toWeaponFirePosition)=="function"then pcall(controller.toWeaponFirePosition)end
local originalSet=Runtime.NoRecoilOriginalSetWeaponRecoil
if type(originalSet)=="function"then
pcall(originalSet,{Damper=1,Speed=40,Value=Vector3.new(0,0,0)},1)
end
end
Runtime.NoRecoilStatus="無後座力已開啟"
else
Runtime.NoRecoilStatus="無後座力已關閉"
end
return true
end

function CVU_ShutdownNoRecoil()
Settings.NoRecoil=false
local controller=Runtime.NoRecoilCameraController
if controller then
if type(Runtime.NoRecoilOriginalWeaponKick)=="function"then
controller.weaponKick=Runtime.NoRecoilOriginalWeaponKick
end
if type(Runtime.NoRecoilOriginalSetWeaponRecoil)=="function"then
controller.setWeaponRecoil=Runtime.NoRecoilOriginalSetWeaponRecoil
end
end
Runtime.NoRecoilInstalled=false
Runtime.NoRecoilCameraController=nil
Runtime.NoRecoilOriginalWeaponKick=nil
Runtime.NoRecoilOriginalSetWeaponRecoil=nil
end

-- ============================================================
-- 子彈散布調整
-- 完全獨立於無後座力。
-- 0% = 原版散布；100% = 無散布。數字越大，實際散布越低。
-- ============================================================
function CVU_InstallBulletSpread()
if Runtime.BulletSpreadInstalled then return true end
local components=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Components")
local weaponModule=components and components:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
local classes=weaponModule and weaponModule:FindFirstChild("Classes")
local bulletScript=classes and classes:FindFirstChild("Bullet")
if not bulletScript or not bulletScript:IsA("ModuleScript")then
Runtime.BulletSpreadStatus="找不到 Bullet 模組"
return false
end

local okBullet,bulletClass=pcall(require,bulletScript)
if not okBullet or type(bulletClass)~="table"then
Runtime.BulletSpreadStatus="無法載入 Bullet 模組"
return false
end

local oldTrueSpread=bulletClass.getTrueSpread
local oldBaseSpread=bulletClass.getBaseSpread
if type(oldTrueSpread)~="function"then
Runtime.BulletSpreadStatus="Bullet.getTrueSpread 不存在"
return false
end

Runtime.BulletSpreadClass=bulletClass
Runtime.BulletSpreadOriginalGetTrueSpread=oldTrueSpread
Runtime.BulletSpreadOriginalGetBaseSpread=type(oldBaseSpread)=="function"and oldBaseSpread or nil

bulletClass.getTrueSpread=function(self,...)
local value=oldTrueSpread(self,...)
if Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled==true and type(value)=="number"then
local reduction=math.clamp((tonumber(Settings.BulletSpreadPercent)or 35)/100,0,1)
local scale=1-reduction
return math.max(0,value*scale)
end
return value
end

if type(oldBaseSpread)=="function"then
bulletClass.getBaseSpread=function(self,...)
local value=oldBaseSpread(self,...)
if Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled==true and type(value)=="number"then
local reduction=math.clamp((tonumber(Settings.BulletSpreadPercent)or 35)/100,0,1)
local scale=1-reduction
return math.max(0,value*scale)
end
return value
end
end

Runtime.BulletSpreadInstalled=true
Runtime.BulletSpreadStatus="子彈散布調整已就緒"
return true
end

function CVU_SetBulletSpread(enabled)
Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled=enabled==true
if Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled then
if not CVU_InstallBulletSpread()then
Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled=false
return false
end
Runtime.BulletSpreadStatus="子彈散布降低已開啟｜"..string.format("%.0f%%",math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.BulletSpreadPercent)or 35,0,100))
else
Runtime.BulletSpreadStatus="子彈散布調整已關閉"
end
return true
end

function CVU_ShutdownBulletSpread()
Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled=false
local bulletClass=Runtime.BulletSpreadClass
if bulletClass then
if type(Runtime.BulletSpreadOriginalGetTrueSpread)=="function"then
bulletClass.getTrueSpread=Runtime.BulletSpreadOriginalGetTrueSpread
end
if type(Runtime.BulletSpreadOriginalGetBaseSpread)=="function"then
bulletClass.getBaseSpread=Runtime.BulletSpreadOriginalGetBaseSpread
end
end
Runtime.BulletSpreadInstalled=false
Runtime.BulletSpreadClass=nil
Runtime.BulletSpreadOriginalGetTrueSpread=nil
Runtime.BulletSpreadOriginalGetBaseSpread=nil
end


-- ============================================================
-- 偽子彈穿牆 V1｜真 ShootWeapon 傷害封包測試
-- 原則：不修改 Properties.Penetration，避免觸發 BloxStrike 客戶端完整性檢查。
-- 只在「準心附近有敵人 + 射線確實先撞到非角色物件」時，改寫 Bullet._performRaycast 回傳的 Hits。
-- ShootWeapon 仍由遊戲原生 Weapon.shoot() 發送，因此這不是純 tracer / VFX。
-- V1 的目的只有一個：驗證 server 是否接受 client 回報的牆 entry/exit + enemy hit。
-- ============================================================
Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled=Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled or false
Runtime.PseudoWallBulletClass=Runtime.PseudoWallBulletClass or nil
Runtime.PseudoWallOriginalPerformRaycast=Runtime.PseudoWallOriginalPerformRaycast or nil
Runtime.PseudoWallAttempts=Runtime.PseudoWallAttempts or 0
Runtime.PseudoWallLastTarget=Runtime.PseudoWallLastTarget or nil
Runtime.PseudoWallLastAttemptAt=Runtime.PseudoWallLastAttemptAt or 0
Runtime.PseudoWallDamageConfirmed=Runtime.PseudoWallDamageConfirmed or false
Runtime.PseudoWallPendingChecks=Runtime.PseudoWallPendingChecks or 0
Runtime.PseudoWallConfirmedEvents=Runtime.PseudoWallConfirmedEvents or 0
Runtime.PseudoWallLastConfirmedHP=Runtime.PseudoWallLastConfirmedHP or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus=Runtime.PseudoWallStatus or "偽穿牆：OFF"
Runtime.RageWallLastFireAt=Runtime.RageWallLastFireAt or 0
Runtime.RageWallLastScanAt=Runtime.RageWallLastScanAt or 0
Runtime.RageWallShooter=Runtime.RageWallShooter or nil
Runtime.RageWallLastHeldWeapon=Runtime.RageWallLastHeldWeapon or nil
Runtime.RageWallLastTarget=Runtime.RageWallLastTarget or nil
Runtime.RageWallLastHookTarget=Runtime.RageWallLastHookTarget or nil
Runtime.PseudoWallTargetHoldUntil=Runtime.PseudoWallTargetHoldUntil or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.PseudoWallSkippedPendingCount=Runtime.PseudoWallSkippedPendingCount or 0
Runtime.RageWallSkippedPendingCount=Runtime.RageWallSkippedPendingCount or 0
Runtime.RageWallStatus=Runtime.RageWallStatus or "暴怒穿牆：OFF"
Runtime.BulletCurveStatus=Runtime.BulletCurveStatus or "子彈轉彎：OFF"
Runtime.RageWallAccumulator=Runtime.RageWallAccumulator or 0

function CVU_PseudoWallGetFireModeLabel()
 local labels={}
 if Settings.GunModEnabled==true then labels[#labels+1]="快速射擊 "..tostring(math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.GunModRate)or 12)+.5),4,50)).."/s" end
 if Settings.RageWallShootEnabled==true then labels[#labels+1]="暴怒360 "..tostring(math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.RageWallRate)or 12)+.5),4,30)).."/s" end
 return #labels>0 and ("｜"..table.concat(labels," + ")) or ""
end

function CVU_PseudoWallGetTeamValue(player)
if not player then return nil end
if player.Team and not player.Neutral then return tostring(player.Team.Name)end
local attr=player:GetAttribute("Team")
if attr~=nil then return tostring(attr)end
local character=nil
if type(CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter,player)
if ok then character=result end
end
character=character or player.Character
if character then
local charAttr=character:GetAttribute("Team")
if charAttr~=nil then return tostring(charAttr)end
local states=character:FindFirstChild("PlayerStates")
local value=states and states:FindFirstChild("Team")
if value and value:IsA("ValueBase")then return tostring(value.Value)end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_PseudoWallIsEnemyPlayer(player)
if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return false end

-- 這裡故意不吃 Settings.TeamCheck；偽穿牆永遠不應該選到隊友。
-- 只比較真正 team 值，不使用 CVU_GetPlayerTeamKey 的來源前綴，
-- 避免 TEAM:CT 與 ATTR:CT 被錯判成不同隊。
local mine=CVU_PseudoWallGetTeamValue(LocalPlayer)
local theirs=CVU_PseudoWallGetTeamValue(player)
if mine~=nil and theirs~=nil then return mine~=theirs end

-- 無法可靠辨識敵我時 fail-closed：不改這發子彈。
return false
end

function CVU_PseudoWallGetCharacter(player)
if not player then return nil end
local character=nil
if type(CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter,player)
if ok then character=result end
end
if not character then character=player.Character end
if not character or not character.Parent or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)then return nil end
if character:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return nil end
local hp=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))
if hp~=nil and hp<=0 then return nil end
return character
end

function CVU_PseudoWallGetBestPart(character)
if not character then return nil,nil end
local center=Camera.ViewportSize*0.5
local bestPart=nil
local bestScreen=math.huge
local targetMode=tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or "自動")
local names=nil

-- 指定部位時只使用該部位對應的真實角色 BasePart；R15 / R6 各自有 fallback。
if targetMode=="頭部"then
names={"Head","CollisionHead"}
elseif targetMode=="胸口"then
names={"UpperTorso","Torso"}
elseif targetMode=="腹部"then
names={"LowerTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"}
elseif targetMode=="左手臂"then
names={"LeftUpperArm","LeftLowerArm","LeftHand","Left Arm"}
elseif targetMode=="右手臂"then
names={"RightUpperArm","RightLowerArm","RightHand","Right Arm"}
elseif targetMode=="左腿"then
names={"LeftUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg","LeftFoot","Left Leg"}
elseif targetMode=="右腿"then
names={"RightUpperLeg","RightLowerLeg","RightFoot","Right Leg"}
else
names={"Head","UpperTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"}
end

-- 指定模式按 fallback 順序取第一個存在且在畫面內的部位；自動模式才比較準心距離。
for _,name in ipairs(names)do
local part=character:FindFirstChild(name,true)
if part and part:IsA("BasePart")then
local screen,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
if onScreen and screen.Z>0 then
local distance=(Vector2.new(screen.X,screen.Y)-center).Magnitude
if targetMode~="自動"then return part,distance end
if distance<bestScreen then
bestScreen=distance
bestPart=part
end
end
end
end
return bestPart,bestScreen
end

function CVU_RageWallGetConfiguredPart(character)
 if not character then return nil end
 local targetMode=tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or "自動")
 local names
 if targetMode=="頭部"then
  names={"Head","CollisionHead"}
 elseif targetMode=="胸口"then
  names={"UpperTorso","Torso"}
 elseif targetMode=="腹部"then
  names={"LowerTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"}
 elseif targetMode=="左手臂"then
  names={"LeftUpperArm","LeftLowerArm","LeftHand","Left Arm"}
 elseif targetMode=="右手臂"then
  names={"RightUpperArm","RightLowerArm","RightHand","Right Arm"}
 elseif targetMode=="左腿"then
  names={"LeftUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg","LeftFoot","Left Leg"}
 elseif targetMode=="右腿"then
  names={"RightUpperLeg","RightLowerLeg","RightFoot","Right Leg"}
 else
  -- 360 模式沒有「準心最近」可比較；自動模式優先身體中心，最後才回退到頭。
  names={"UpperTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart","LowerTorso","Head"}
 end
 for _,name in ipairs(names)do
  local part=character:FindFirstChild(name,true)
  if part and part:IsA("BasePart")then return part end
 end
 return nil
end

function CVU_PseudoWallGetHeadRetargetDelay(rageMode)
 local rate=12
 if rageMode==true then
  rate=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.RageWallRate)or 12)+.5),4,30)
  -- 暴怒模式仍保留很短的死亡同步保護，但不再用舊版 6/rate（30/s 時約 0.20s）硬卡射速。
  -- 只略過接下來約 2 發，讓多目標時維持完整 cadence，單目標也能很快重新檢查。
  return math.clamp(2/rate,.065,.12)
 elseif Settings.GunModEnabled==true then
  rate=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.GunModRate)or 12)+.5),4,50)
 end
 -- 普通偽穿牆保留較保守的死亡 replication 等待窗。
 return math.clamp(6/rate,.18,.30)
end

function CVU_PseudoWallIsTargetHeld(player)
 if tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or "自動")~="頭部"then return false end
 local untilTime=Runtime.PseudoWallTargetHoldUntil and Runtime.PseudoWallTargetHoldUntil[player]
 if typeof(untilTime)~="number"then return false end
 if os.clock()>=untilTime then
  Runtime.PseudoWallTargetHoldUntil[player]=nil
  return false
 end
 return true
end

function CVU_PseudoWallMarkHeadTargetPending(player,rageMode)
 if not player or tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or "自動")~="頭部"then return end
 Runtime.PseudoWallTargetHoldUntil=Runtime.PseudoWallTargetHoldUntil or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.PseudoWallTargetHoldUntil[player]=os.clock()+CVU_PseudoWallGetHeadRetargetDelay(rageMode==true)
end

function CVU_RageWallFindTarget360(origin,maxRange)
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"then return nil end
 local range=math.max(1,tonumber(maxRange)or 500)
 local best=nil
 Runtime.RageWallSkippedPendingCount=0

 -- Raycast 只拿世界幾何當 blocker；所有玩家角色都排除，避免隊友或另一名敵人被誤當成牆。
 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.IgnoreWater=true
 local ignore={}
 if LocalPlayer.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=LocalPlayer.Character end
 for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  local c=CVU_PseudoWallGetCharacter(p)
  if c then ignore[#ignore+1]=c end
 end
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore

 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if CVU_PseudoWallIsEnemyPlayer(player)then
   if CVU_PseudoWallIsTargetHeld(player)then
    Runtime.RageWallSkippedPendingCount=(Runtime.RageWallSkippedPendingCount or 0)+1
   else
    local character=CVU_PseudoWallGetCharacter(player)
    local part=CVU_RageWallGetConfiguredPart(character)
    if part then
     local delta=part.Position-origin
     local distance=delta.Magnitude
     if distance>0.1 and distance<=range+2 then
      local blocker=Workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,params)
      local score=distance
      if not best or score<best.Score then
       best={
        Player=player,
        Character=character,
        Part=part,
        Position=part.Position,
        Distance=distance,
        Direction=delta.Unit,
        Blocker=blocker,
        Score=score,
        Rage360=true,
       }
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

function CVU_PseudoWallInstanceBelongsToPlayerCharacter(instance)
if not instance then return false end
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
local character=CVU_PseudoWallGetCharacter(player)
if character and (instance==character or instance:IsDescendantOf(character))then
return true
end
end
return false
end

function CVU_PseudoWallFindTarget(origin,shotDirection,maxRange)
if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or typeof(shotDirection)~="Vector3"then return nil end
if shotDirection.Magnitude<=0.001 then return nil end
local fov=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.PseudoWallFOV)or 85,10,220)
local range=math.max(1,tonumber(maxRange)or 500)
local best=nil
Runtime.PseudoWallSkippedPendingCount=0

for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if CVU_PseudoWallIsEnemyPlayer(player)then
if CVU_PseudoWallIsTargetHeld(player)then
Runtime.PseudoWallSkippedPendingCount=(Runtime.PseudoWallSkippedPendingCount or 0)+1
else
local character=CVU_PseudoWallGetCharacter(player)
local part,screenDistance=CVU_PseudoWallGetBestPart(character)
if part and screenDistance and screenDistance<=fov then
local delta=part.Position-origin
local distance=delta.Magnitude
if distance>0.1 and distance<=range+2 then
local targetUnit=delta.Unit
-- PseudoWallFOV 的螢幕像素圓就是唯一 FOV 邊界。
-- 舊版這裡另有固定 dot>=0.992（約 7.25 度）的第二道角度門檻，
-- 會把 220px 等較大的 FOV 外圈再次裁掉，造成「圈變大但實際射擊範圍沒跟著變」。
-- 目標既然已通過上面的 screenDistance<=fov，就不要再用固定角度縮小有效範圍。
local params=RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.IgnoreWater=true
local ignore={}
if LocalPlayer.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=LocalPlayer.Character end
params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
local blocker=Workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,params)

-- 必須真的先撞到牆/場景物件；直視敵人時完全走原版子彈。
if blocker and blocker.Instance
and not (blocker.Instance==character or blocker.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character))
and not CVU_PseudoWallInstanceBelongsToPlayerCharacter(blocker.Instance)then
local score=screenDistance+(distance/range)*8
if not best or score<best.Score then
best={
Player=player,
Character=character,
Part=part,
Position=part.Position,
Distance=distance,
Direction=targetUnit,
Blocker=blocker,
Score=score,
}
end
end
end
end
end
end
end
return best
end

-- ============================================================
-- BloxStrike 子彈轉彎｜只改「沒有牆擋住」的敵人
-- 依公開 BloxStrike silent-aim 實作的 visible-only 原則：先做真實 LOS raycast，
-- 只有射線沒有先撞到世界幾何 / 其他角色時才允許重新導向；牆後敵人完全交給偽穿牆。
-- ============================================================
function CVU_BulletCurveFindVisibleTarget(origin,maxRange)
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"then return nil end
 local fov=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.PseudoWallFOV)or 85,10,220)
 local range=math.max(1,tonumber(maxRange)or 500)
 local best=nil
 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.IgnoreWater=true
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances=LocalPlayer.Character and {LocalPlayer.Character} or {}
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if CVU_PseudoWallIsEnemyPlayer(player) and not CVU_PseudoWallIsTargetHeld(player)then
   local character=CVU_PseudoWallGetCharacter(player)
   local part,screenDistance=CVU_PseudoWallGetBestPart(character)
   if part and screenDistance and screenDistance<=fov then
    local delta=part.Position-origin
    local distance=delta.Magnitude
    if distance>0.1 and distance<=range+2 then
     local hit=Workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,params)
     local visible=(hit==nil) or (hit.Instance and (hit.Instance==character or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)))
     if visible then
      local score=screenDistance+(distance/range)*8
      if not best or score<best.Score then
       best={
        Player=player,Character=character,Part=part,Position=part.Position,Distance=distance,
        Direction=delta.Unit,Blocker=nil,Score=score,BulletCurve=true,
       }
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

function CVU_PseudoWallConfirmDamage(candidate,beforeHP,attemptSerial)
if not candidate or not candidate.Character then return end
local character=candidate.Character
Runtime.PseudoWallPendingChecks=(Runtime.PseudoWallPendingChecks or 0)+1
if beforeHP~=nil then
local trackedHP=Runtime.PseudoWallLastConfirmedHP[character]
if trackedHP==nil or beforeHP>trackedHP then Runtime.PseudoWallLastConfirmedHP[character]=beforeHP end
end
task.delay(.55,function()
Runtime.PseudoWallPendingChecks=math.max(0,(Runtime.PseudoWallPendingChecks or 1)-1)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if not character or not character.Parent then return end
local afterHP=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))
local observedHP=Runtime.PseudoWallLastConfirmedHP[character]
if observedHP==nil then observedHP=beforeHP end
if observedHP~=nil and afterHP~=nil and afterHP<observedHP then
Runtime.PseudoWallLastConfirmedHP[character]=afterHP
Runtime.PseudoWallDamageConfirmed=true
Runtime.PseudoWallConfirmedEvents=(Runtime.PseudoWallConfirmedEvents or 0)+1
local rapid=CVU_PseudoWallGetFireModeLabel()
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆：已確認真傷害"..rapid.."｜"..tostring(candidate.Player and candidate.Player.Name or"enemy").."｜"..tostring(observedHP).." → "..tostring(afterHP)
elseif attemptSerial==(Runtime.PseudoWallAttempts or 0) then
-- 只讓目前最新一發更新「尚未確認」狀態；舊 shot 的延遲 callback 不覆蓋較新的結果。
local rapid=CVU_PseudoWallGetFireModeLabel()
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆：已送 ShootWeapon"..rapid.."｜等待傷害確認｜"..tostring(candidate.Player and candidate.Player.Name or"enemy")
end
end)
end

function CVU_InstallPseudoWallPenetration()
if Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled then return true end
local components=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Components")
local weaponModule=components and components:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
local classes=weaponModule and weaponModule:FindFirstChild("Classes")
local bulletScript=classes and classes:FindFirstChild("Bullet")
if not bulletScript or not bulletScript:IsA("ModuleScript")then
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆：找不到 Bullet 模組"
return false
end

local ok,bulletClass=pcall(require,bulletScript)
if not ok or type(bulletClass)~="table"then
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆：無法載入 Bullet 模組"
return false
end

local original=bulletClass._performRaycast
if type(original)~="function"then
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆：Bullet._performRaycast 不存在"
return false
end

Runtime.PseudoWallBulletClass=bulletClass
Runtime.PseudoWallOriginalPerformRaycast=original

bulletClass._performRaycast=function(self,spread,...)
 local result=original(self,spread,...)
 local standardEnabled=Settings.PseudoWallPenetration==true
 local curveEnabled=Settings.BulletCurveEnabled==true
 local rageEnabled=Settings.RageWallShootEnabled==true
 if Runtime.Shutdown or (not standardEnabled and not curveEnabled and not rageEnabled) then return result end
 if type(result)~="table"or typeof(result.Origin)~="Vector3"or typeof(result.Direction)~="Vector3"then return result end

 local properties=type(self)=="table"and self.Properties or nil
 local maxRange=type(properties)=="table"and tonumber(properties.Range)or 500
 local candidate
 local shotMode=nil
 if rageEnabled then
  candidate=CVU_RageWallFindTarget360(result.Origin,maxRange)
  if candidate then shotMode="rage" end
 else
  if standardEnabled then
   candidate=CVU_PseudoWallFindTarget(result.Origin,result.Direction,maxRange)
   if candidate then shotMode="wall" end
  end
  if not candidate and curveEnabled then
   candidate=CVU_BulletCurveFindVisibleTarget(result.Origin,maxRange)
   if candidate then shotMode="curve" end
  end
 end
 if not candidate then return result end

 local blocker=candidate.Blocker
 local wallInstance=blocker and blocker.Instance or nil
 -- wall 模式必須真的有牆；curve 模式則恰好相反，只接受 LOS 已確認可見的敵人。
 if shotMode=="wall" and not wallInstance then return result end

 local hits={}
 if wallInstance and shotMode~="curve" then
  local enterPos=blocker.Position
  local fakeExitPos=enterPos+candidate.Direction*0.025
  local wallMaterial="Plastic"
  pcall(function()wallMaterial=blocker.Material.Name end)
  local wallNormal=blocker.Normal or Vector3.zero
  hits[#hits+1]={Position=enterPos,Instance=wallInstance,Material=wallMaterial,Normal=wallNormal,Exit=false}
  hits[#hits+1]={Position=fakeExitPos,Instance=wallInstance,Material=wallMaterial,Normal=-wallNormal,Exit=true}
 end

 local targetMaterial="Plastic"
 pcall(function()targetMaterial=candidate.Part.Material.Name end)
 hits[#hits+1]={
  Position=candidate.Position,
  Instance=candidate.Part,
  Material=targetMaterial,
  Normal=-candidate.Direction,
  Exit=false,
 }

 result.Direction=candidate.Direction
 result.Distance=candidate.Distance
 result.Hits=hits
 result.CVU_PseudoWall=shotMode=="wall" or shotMode=="rage"
 result.CVU_BulletCurve=shotMode=="curve"
 result.CVU_RageWall360=rageEnabled==true

 Runtime.PseudoWallAttempts=(Runtime.PseudoWallAttempts or 0)+1
 Runtime.PseudoWallLastTarget=candidate.Player
 Runtime.PseudoWallLastAttemptAt=os.clock()
 Runtime.PseudoWallDamageConfirmed=false
 if not rageEnabled then
  -- 普通偽穿牆與 visible-only 子彈轉彎都在真實改寫 enemy hit 後進短暫 pending。
  CVU_PseudoWallMarkHeadTargetPending(candidate.Player,false)
 end
 if rageEnabled then
  Runtime.RageWallLastTarget=candidate.Player
  -- 記住這一發 Bullet hook 真正改寫到哪一名玩家；FireOnce 成功返回後再進入短暫 pending，
  -- 這樣下一發 360 掃描會直接換下一名敵人，而不是等死亡 replication 才換。
  Runtime.RageWallLastHookTarget=candidate.Player
 end
 local rapid=CVU_PseudoWallGetFireModeLabel()
 local modeLabel=shotMode=="curve" and "子彈轉彎：直視敵人重新導向" or (rageEnabled and "暴怒穿牆360：送出 ShootWeapon 命中資料" or "偽穿牆：送出真 ShootWeapon 命中資料")
 Runtime.PseudoWallStatus=modeLabel..rapid.."｜"..tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or"自動").."/"..tostring(candidate.Part and candidate.Part.Name or"part").."｜"..tostring(candidate.Player and candidate.Player.Name or"enemy")
 if shotMode=="curve"then Runtime.BulletCurveStatus=Runtime.PseudoWallStatus end
 local beforeHP=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(candidate.Character))
 CVU_PseudoWallConfirmDamage(candidate,beforeHP,Runtime.PseudoWallAttempts)
 return result
end

Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled=true
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆 V1 已就緒｜等待牆後敵人"
return true
end

function CVU_SetPseudoWallPenetration(enabled)
Settings.PseudoWallPenetration=enabled==true
if Settings.PseudoWallPenetration then
if not CVU_InstallPseudoWallPenetration()then
Settings.PseudoWallPenetration=false
return false
end
if Settings.GunModEnabled==true then
pcall(CVU_GunModApplyFireRates)
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆 V1 已開啟｜快速射擊聯動 "..tostring(Settings.GunModRate).."/s"
else
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆 V1 已開啟｜只測真傷害"
end
else
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆：OFF"
end
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
return true
end

function CVU_SetBulletCurve(enabled)
 Settings.BulletCurveEnabled=enabled==true
 if Settings.BulletCurveEnabled then
  if not CVU_InstallPseudoWallPenetration()then
   Settings.BulletCurveEnabled=false
   Runtime.BulletCurveStatus="子彈轉彎：Bullet hook 安裝失敗"
   return false
  end
  Runtime.BulletCurveStatus="子彈轉彎：ON｜只改可見敵人｜牆後敵人不處理"
 else
  Runtime.BulletCurveStatus="子彈轉彎：OFF"
 end
 if type(CVU_UpdateFOV)=="function"then pcall(CVU_UpdateFOV)end
 CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
 return true
end

function CVU_RageWallGetLiveShooter(forceScan)
 local held=CVU_GunModGetHeldGunName()
 if not held then
  Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：目前未辨識持槍"
  Runtime.RageWallShooter=nil
  return nil
 end
 if CVU_GunModIsChargeWeapon(held)then
  Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：R8 Revolver 保留原生蓄力，不自動射擊"
  Runtime.RageWallShooter=nil
  return nil
 end

 local function valid(object)
  if type(object)~="table"then return false end
  local props=rawget(object,"Properties")
  if type(props)~="table"then return false end
  local shoot=nil
  pcall(function()shoot=object.shoot end)
  if type(shoot)~="function"then return false end
  local name=rawget(object,"Name")or rawget(object,"WeaponName")
  local resolved=type(name)=="string"and ((type(CVU_ResolveNativeGunName)=="function"and CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(name))or name)or nil
  if not resolved and type(CVU_GunModFindOwnerFromTable)=="function"then
   resolved=CVU_GunModFindOwnerFromTable(props)
  end
  return resolved==held
 end

 if not forceScan and Runtime.RageWallShooter and Runtime.RageWallLastHeldWeapon==held and valid(Runtime.RageWallShooter)then
  return Runtime.RageWallShooter
 end
 local now=os.clock()
 if not forceScan and now-(Runtime.RageWallLastScanAt or 0)<.35 then return nil end
 Runtime.RageWallLastScanAt=now
 Runtime.RageWallShooter=nil
 Runtime.RageWallLastHeldWeapon=held
 if typeof(getgc)=="function"then
  local ok,objects=pcall(getgc,true)
  if ok and type(objects)=="table"then
   for _,object in pairs(objects)do
    if valid(object)then
     Runtime.RageWallShooter=object
     break
    end
   end
  end
 end
 if not Runtime.RageWallShooter then
  Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：找不到目前武器的 live Weapon.shoot"
 end
 return Runtime.RageWallShooter
end

function CVU_RageWallFireOnce()
 if Settings.RageWallShootEnabled~=true then return false end
 local shooter=CVU_RageWallGetLiveShooter(false)
 if not shooter then return false end
 local properties=rawget(shooter,"Properties")
 local maxRange=type(properties)=="table"and tonumber(properties.Range)or 500
 local origin=Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or nil
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"then return false end
 local candidate=CVU_RageWallFindTarget360(origin,maxRange)
 if not candidate then
  Runtime.RageWallLastTarget=nil
  if tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or "自動")=="頭部"and (Runtime.RageWallSkippedPendingCount or 0)>0 then
   Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：等待爆頭死亡同步｜暫不重複灌同一名敵人"
  else
   Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：360° 目前沒有可射擊敵人"
  end
  return false
 end
 Runtime.RageWallLastTarget=candidate.Player
 Runtime.RageWallLastHookTarget=nil
 local shoot=nil
 pcall(function()shoot=shooter.shoot end)
 if type(shoot)~="function"then
  Runtime.RageWallShooter=nil
  return false
 end
 local ok,err=pcall(shoot,shooter)
 if not ok then
  Runtime.RageWallShooter=nil
  Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：Weapon.shoot 呼叫失敗｜"..tostring(err)
  return false
 end
 local actualTarget=Runtime.RageWallLastHookTarget or candidate.Player
 Runtime.RageWallLastTarget=actualTarget
 CVU_PseudoWallMarkHeadTargetPending(actualTarget,true)
 Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：360° 自動射擊｜"..tostring(Settings.RageWallRate).."/s｜"..tostring(actualTarget and actualTarget.Name or"enemy").."｜"..tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or"自動")
 return true
end

function CVU_SetRageWallShoot(enabled)
 Settings.RageWallShootEnabled=enabled==true
 Settings.RageWallRate=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.RageWallRate)or 12)+.5),4,30)
 Runtime.RageWallLastFireAt=0
 Runtime.RageWallAccumulator=0
 Runtime.RageWallLastScanAt=0
 Runtime.RageWallShooter=nil
 Runtime.RageWallLastHeldWeapon=nil
 Runtime.RageWallLastTarget=nil
 Runtime.RageWallLastHookTarget=nil
 Runtime.PseudoWallTargetHoldUntil=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.PseudoWallSkippedPendingCount=0
 Runtime.RageWallSkippedPendingCount=0
 if Settings.RageWallShootEnabled then
  if not CVU_InstallPseudoWallPenetration()then
   Settings.RageWallShootEnabled=false
   Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：Bullet hook 安裝失敗"
   return false
  end
  CVU_GunModScanFireRateTables(true)
  CVU_GunModApplyFireRates()
  Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：ON｜360° 敵人掃描｜自動跳過隊友｜上限 30/s"
 else
  Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：OFF"
  if Settings.GunModEnabled==true then CVU_GunModApplyFireRates()else CVU_GunModRestoreFireRates()end
 end
 CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
 return true
end

Runtime.RageWallHeartbeat=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
 if Runtime.Shutdown or Settings.RageWallShootEnabled~=true then return end
 local rate=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.RageWallRate)or 12)+.5),4,30)
 Settings.RageWallRate=rate
 local interval=1/rate
 Runtime.RageWallAccumulator=math.min((Runtime.RageWallAccumulator or 0)+(dt or 0),interval*4)
 local fired=0
 -- 用 accumulator 補回 frame jitter 漏掉的節拍；最多一次 Heartbeat 補 3 發，避免單幀爆量。
 while Runtime.RageWallAccumulator>=interval and fired<3 do
  Runtime.RageWallAccumulator-=interval
  Runtime.RageWallLastFireAt=os.clock()
  CVU_RageWallFireOnce()
  fired+=1
 end
end)

function CVU_ShutdownRageWallShoot()
 Settings.RageWallShootEnabled=false
 Runtime.RageWallStatus="暴怒穿牆：OFF"
 Runtime.RageWallShooter=nil
 Runtime.RageWallLastTarget=nil
 if Runtime.RageWallHeartbeat then pcall(function()Runtime.RageWallHeartbeat:Disconnect()end)Runtime.RageWallHeartbeat=nil end
 if Settings.GunModEnabled==true then pcall(CVU_GunModApplyFireRates)else pcall(CVU_GunModRestoreFireRates)end
end

if Settings.RageWallShootEnabled then
 task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_SetRageWallShoot,true)end)
end

function CVU_ShutdownPseudoWallPenetration()
Settings.PseudoWallPenetration=false
Settings.BulletCurveEnabled=false
local bulletClass=Runtime.PseudoWallBulletClass
if bulletClass and type(Runtime.PseudoWallOriginalPerformRaycast)=="function"
and bulletClass._performRaycast~=Runtime.PseudoWallOriginalPerformRaycast then
pcall(function()bulletClass._performRaycast=Runtime.PseudoWallOriginalPerformRaycast end)
end
Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled=false
Runtime.PseudoWallBulletClass=nil
Runtime.PseudoWallOriginalPerformRaycast=nil
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="偽穿牆：OFF"
end

if Settings.NoRecoil then
task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_SetNoRecoil,true)end)
end
if Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled then
task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_SetBulletSpread,true)end)
end
if Settings.PseudoWallPenetration then
task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_SetPseudoWallPenetration,true)end)
end
if Settings.BulletCurveEnabled then
task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_SetBulletCurve,true)end)
end

task.defer(function()
if Settings.SpectatorCounter then CVU_SetSpectatorCounter(true)end
end)

pcall(CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook)

end

-- ============================================================
-- 體驗刀具：獨立開關。
-- OFF：下面「刀具類型 / 刀具皮膚」完全隱藏。
-- ON ：才顯示兩個選擇；更換刀型 / skin 只在下一局套用。
-- ============================================================
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshKnifeSkinOptions,Settings.KnifeExperience)
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGloveModelOptions)
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGloveSkinOptions,Settings.GloveExperience)
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGunModelOptions)
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGunSkinOptions,Settings.GunExperience)

-- Startup asset reconciliation.
-- BloxStrike can populate ReplicatedStorage a little after this script starts.
-- Retry without saving until native skin folders are genuinely available.
task.spawn(function()
 local deadline=os.clock()+8.0
 while not Runtime.Shutdown and os.clock()<deadline do
  pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,true)
  pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshKnifeSkinOptions,Settings.KnifeExperience)
  pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGloveModelOptions)
  pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGloveSkinOptions,Settings.GloveExperience)
  pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGunModelOptions,Settings.GunExperienceCategory)
  pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGunSkinOptions,Settings.GunExperience)

  if Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder~=nil then
   Runtime.BloxStrikeAppearanceRestoreReady=true
   if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled then pcall(CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook)end
   if Settings.GloveExperienceEnabled then
    pcall(CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook)
    pcall(CVU_BS_InstallGloveExperienceHook)
   end
   if Settings.GunExperienceEnabled then pcall(CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook)end
   break
  end
  task.wait(.35)
 end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- C4 / CT 拆包工具
--
-- Remote Defuse:
--   優先走遊戲原生 Router "Start Defuse Bomb"，
--   並只在遠距離拆包啟用期間阻止 DefuseBomb 因 >10 studs 的本機 Cancel(false)。
--   若原生 Router 沒拿到 server ack，再 fallback 到官方 C4.StartDefuse packet。
--   如果伺服器本身驗證玩家距離，客戶端不能保證繞過；狀態會明確顯示 server reject。
--
-- C4 Advisor:
--   不使用穿牆直線距離。
--   透過 PathfindingService 計算目前位置 -> C4 周圍可站立點的走道 waypoint 距離。
-- ============================================================
Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseBomb=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionId=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial=Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial or 0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStartLocal=0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus or"關閉"
Runtime.RemoteDefuseRemotes=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseInputController=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseRouter=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDefuseModule=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseHeartbeat=nil

Runtime.C4ESPHighlight=nil
Runtime.C4AdvisorFrame=nil
Runtime.C4AdvisorText=nil
Runtime.C4PathBusy=false
Runtime.C4PathGeneration=0
Runtime.C4PathBomb=nil
Runtime.C4PathStart=nil
Runtime.C4PathDistance=nil
Runtime.C4PathTime=nil
Runtime.C4PathStatus="idle"
Runtime.C4PathComputedAt=0
Runtime.C4UtilityClock=0

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRemotes()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseRemotes then return Runtime.RemoteDefuseRemotes end
local ok,remotes=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Database.Security.Remotes)
end)
if ok and type(remotes)=="table"
and type(remotes.C4)=="table"
and type(remotes.C4.StartDefuse)=="table"
and type(remotes.C4.CancelDefuse)=="table"
and type(remotes.C4.Defused)=="table"
then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseRemotes=remotes
return remotes
end
return nil
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRouter()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseRouter then return Runtime.RemoteDefuseRouter end
local ok,router=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Database.Security.Router)
end)
if ok and type(router)=="table"and type(router.broadcastRouter)=="function"then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseRouter=router
return router
end
return nil
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetInputController()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseInputController then return Runtime.RemoteDefuseInputController end
local ok,controller=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Controllers.InputController)
end)
if ok and type(controller)=="table"then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseInputController=controller
return controller
end
return nil
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseInstallNativeCancelGuard()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel then return true end
local ok,module=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Interface.Screens.Gameplay.Middle.DefuseBomb)
end)
if not ok or type(module)~="table"or type(module.CancelDefuse)~="function"then
return false
end

local oldCancel=module.CancelDefuse
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDefuseModule=module
Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel=oldCancel

module.CancelDefuse=function(self,forced,...)
-- 遊戲原生 heartbeat 在距離 >10 或 Use 狀態不符時會呼叫 CancelDefuse(false)。
-- 遠程模式期間只攔本機 false cancel；server/強制 true cancel 仍照常執行。
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive==true and Settings.RemoteDefuse==true and forced~=true then
return
end
return oldCancel(self,forced,...)
end

return true
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseRestoreNativeCancelGuard()
local module=Runtime.RemoteDefuseDefuseModule
local old=Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel
if module and type(old)=="function"then
pcall(function()module.CancelDefuse=old end)
end
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDefuseModule=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel=nil
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()
return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")=="Counter-Terrorists"
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseAlive()
local character=LocalPlayer.Character
if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)then return false end
local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
return humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBomb()
local tagged=CollectionService:GetTagged("Bomb")
local bomb=tagged and tagged[1]or nil
if not bomb or not bomb.Parent then return nil end
if bomb:GetAttribute("Defused")==true then return nil end
if bomb:GetAttribute("Exploding")==true then return nil end
if bomb:GetAttribute("Exploded")==true then return nil end
return bomb
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBombRoot(bomb)
if not bomb then return nil end
return bomb.PrimaryPart or bomb:FindFirstChild("Weapon",true)or bomb:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseDistance(bomb)
local character=LocalPlayer.Character
local root=character and(character.PrimaryPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
local bombRoot=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBombRoot(bomb)
if not root or not bombRoot then return math.huge end
return(root.Position-bombRoot.Position).Magnitude
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseUseHeld()
if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end
local controller=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetInputController()
if controller and type(controller.isActionActive)=="function"then
local ok,value=pcall(controller.isActionActive,"Use")
if ok then return value==true end
end
return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E)
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel(reason,silent)
local wasActive=Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive
local sessionId=Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionId
local nativeStarted=Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted
local directSent=Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent

-- 先解除 active，讓 Router Cancel 可以正常進原版 CancelDefuse。
Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseBomb=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionId=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStartLocal=0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent=false

if wasActive and not silent then
if nativeStarted then
local router=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRouter()
if router then
pcall(router.broadcastRouter,"Cancel Defuse Bomb")
end
end

if directSent and sessionId~=nil then
local remotes=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRemotes()
if remotes then
pcall(function()
remotes.C4.CancelDefuse.Send({SessionId=sessionId})
end)
end
end
end

Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=tostring(reason or"已取消")
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseSendDirectFallback()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent then return true end
local remotes=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRemotes()
if not remotes then return false end

Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial=(Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial+1)%4294967295
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial<=0 then Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial=1 end
local sessionId=Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionId=sessionId

local ok=pcall(function()
remotes.C4.StartDefuse.Send({SessionId=sessionId})
end)

if ok then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent=true
return true
end
return false
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseBegin(bomb)
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then return false end
if Settings.RemoteDefuse~=true then return false end
if not CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="僅限 CT"
return false
end
if not CVU_RemoteDefuseAlive()then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="角色未存活"
return false
end
if not bomb then return false end

local distance=CVU_RemoteDefuseDistance(bomb)
if distance<=10 then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="近距離使用原生拆包"
return false
end

Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive=true
Runtime.RemoteDefuseBomb=bomb
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStartLocal=Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=os.clock()+1.15
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent=false

pcall(CVU_RemoteDefuseInstallNativeCancelGuard)

-- 只改本機 Bomb attribute，讓原生 Use/Defuse UI 能走自己的正常流程。
pcall(function()bomb:SetAttribute("CanDefuse",true)end)

local router=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRouter()
if router then
local ok=pcall(router.broadcastRouter,"Start Defuse Bomb")
if ok then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted=true
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=string.format("原生遠距離拆包請求｜%.0f stud",distance)
return true
end
end

-- Router 不可用才直接 fallback。
if CVU_RemoteDefuseSendDirectFallback()then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=os.clock()+1.50
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=string.format("直接遠距離拆包請求｜%.0f stud",distance)
return true
end

CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("StartDefuse 發送失敗",true)
return false
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseStep()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end

if Settings.RemoteDefuse~=true then
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("關閉")end
return
end

if not CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()then
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("僅限 CT")end
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="僅限 CT"
return
end

if not CVU_RemoteDefuseAlive()then
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("角色死亡")end
return
end

local bomb=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBomb()
if not bomb then
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("沒有可拆除的 C4",true)end
return
end

local useHeld=CVU_RemoteDefuseUseHeld()

if not Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then
if useHeld and CVU_RemoteDefuseDistance(bomb)>10 then
CVU_RemoteDefuseBegin(bomb)
end
return
end

if Runtime.RemoteDefuseBomb~=bomb then
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("C4 已更換")
return
end

-- 防止原生 Bomb observer 每幀把 CanDefuse 改回 false。
pcall(function()bomb:SetAttribute("CanDefuse",true)end)

if not useHeld then
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("已放開使用鍵")
return
end

if bomb:GetAttribute("Defused")==true then
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("拆包成功",true)
return
end

local serverAccepted=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb")==true
if not serverAccepted then
if os.clock()>Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline then
if not Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent then
if CVU_RemoteDefuseSendDirectFallback()then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=os.clock()+1.50
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="原生流程未 ACK｜改送直接 StartDefuse"
else
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("遠距離拆包請求失敗",true)
end
else
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("伺服器拒絕遠距離拆包",true)
end
end
return
end

local hasKit=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("HasDefuseKit")==true
local defuseTime=hasKit and 5 or 10
local serverStart=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("DefuseStartTime")
local startTime=typeof(serverStart)=="number"and serverStart or Runtime.RemoteDefuseStartLocal
local elapsed=Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-startTime

Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=string.format(
"CT 遠距離拆包｜%.1f / %.1f 秒｜%.0f stud",
math.max(elapsed,0),
defuseTime,
CVU_RemoteDefuseDistance(bomb)
)

-- 原生 Router 已成功啟動時，由 DefuseBomb 自己送 Defused。
-- 只有完全走 direct fallback 時，這裡才補送完成 packet。
if elapsed>=defuseTime
and not Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish
and Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted~=true then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish=true
local remotes=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRemotes()
if remotes then
pcall(function()remotes.C4.Defused.Send()end)
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="已提交 Defused"
end
end
end

function CVU_SetRemoteDefuse(enabled)
Settings.RemoteDefuse=enabled==true
if not Settings.RemoteDefuse then
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("關閉")
CVU_RemoteDefuseRestoreNativeCancelGuard()
else
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()and"CT 遠距離拆包待命"or"僅限 CT"
pcall(CVU_RemoteDefuseInstallNativeCancelGuard)
end
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
return Settings.RemoteDefuse
end

function CVU_C4EnsureESPHighlight()
local h=Runtime.C4ESPHighlight
if h and h.Parent then return h end
h=Instance.new("Highlight")
h.Name="CVU_C4_Planted_ESP"
h.DepthMode=Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
h.FillTransparency=.58
h.OutlineTransparency=0
h.Enabled=false
h.Parent=Workspace
Runtime.C4ESPHighlight=h
return h
end

function CVU_C4UpdateESP()
local h=CVU_C4EnsureESPHighlight()
local bomb=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBomb()
if Settings.C4ESP==true and bomb then
h.Adornee=bomb
h.FillColor=Settings.C4ESPColor
h.OutlineColor=Settings.C4ESPColor
h.Enabled=true
else
h.Enabled=false
h.Adornee=nil
end
end

return Runtime.C4AdvisorFrame
end

local frame=Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name="C4DefuseAdvisor"
frame.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0)
frame.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,16)
frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(500,62)
frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(45,55,70)
frame.BackgroundTransparency=.10
frame.BorderSizePixel=0
frame.Visible=false
frame.ZIndex=100700
frame.Parent=Overlay
round(frame,8)

local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Name="AdvisorStroke"

stroke.Thickness=1

label.Text=""

label.Parent=frame

return frame
