function CVU_C4GetBombRemaining(bomb)
if not bomb then return nil end
local raw=bomb:GetAttribute("BombPlanted")
if type(raw)~="string"or raw==""then return nil end

local ok,data=pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode,HttpService,raw)
if not ok or type(data)~="table"then return nil end

local plantedAt=tonumber(data.Time)
local total=tonumber(data.TimeUntilExplode)or 40
if not plantedAt then return nil end

return math.max((plantedAt+math.max(total,.1))-Workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),0)
end

function CVU_C4GetCharacterNavInfo()
local character=LocalPlayer.Character
if not character then return nil,nil,nil end
local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or character.PrimaryPart
local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return nil,nil,nil end
return root,humanoid,math.max(tonumber(humanoid.WalkSpeed)or 16,1)
end

function CVU_C4PathDistanceForWaypoints(startPos,waypoints,bombPos)
if type(waypoints)~="table"or #waypoints==0 then return nil end
local distance=0
local previous=startPos
for _,waypoint in ipairs(waypoints)do
if waypoint and typeof(waypoint.Position)=="Vector3"then
distance+=(waypoint.Position-previous).Magnitude
previous=waypoint.Position
end
end

-- 路徑終點只要到 C4 附近即可；最後幾 stud 視為互動範圍，不用硬走到 C4 幾何中心。
local finalGap=(bombPos-previous).Magnitude
if finalGap>6.5 then return nil end
return distance
end

function CVU_C4ComputeBestWalkPathAsync(bomb)
if Runtime.C4PathBusy then return end
local root,humanoid,walkSpeed=CVU_C4GetCharacterNavInfo()
local bombRoot=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBombRoot(bomb)
if not root or not bombRoot then return end

Runtime.C4PathBusy=true
Runtime.C4PathGeneration+=1
local generation=Runtime.C4PathGeneration
local startPos=root.Position
local bombPos=bombRoot.Position

task.spawn(function()
local bestDistance=nil
local bestStatus="NoPath"

if (startPos-bombPos).Magnitude<=5 then
bestDistance=0
bestStatus="NearBomb"
else
local candidates={
bombPos,
bombPos+Vector3.new(4,0,0),
bombPos+Vector3.new(-4,0,0),
bombPos+Vector3.new(0,0,4),
bombPos+Vector3.new(0,0,-4),
bombPos+Vector3.new(3,0,3),
bombPos+Vector3.new(-3,0,3),
bombPos+Vector3.new(3,0,-3),
bombPos+Vector3.new(-3,0,-3),
}

for _,goal in ipairs(candidates)do
if generation~=Runtime.C4PathGeneration then break end

local ok,path=pcall(function()
local p=PathfindingService:CreatePath({
AgentRadius=2,
AgentHeight=5,
AgentCanJump=true,
AgentCanClimb=true,
WaypointSpacing=3,
})
p:ComputeAsync(startPos,goal)
return p
end)

if ok and path and path.Status==Enum.PathStatus.Success then
local distance=CVU_C4PathDistanceForWaypoints(startPos,path:GetWaypoints(),bombPos)
if distance and(not bestDistance or distance<bestDistance)then
bestDistance=distance
bestStatus="Success"
end
end
end
end

if generation==Runtime.C4PathGeneration then
Runtime.C4PathBomb=bomb
Runtime.C4PathStart=startPos
Runtime.C4PathDistance=bestDistance
Runtime.C4PathTime=bestDistance and(bestDistance/walkSpeed)or nil
Runtime.C4PathStatus=bestStatus
Runtime.C4PathComputedAt=os.clock()
Runtime.C4PathBusy=false
end
end)
end

function CVU_C4MaybeRefreshPath(bomb)
if not Settings.C4DefuseAdvisor then return end
local root=select(1,CVU_C4GetCharacterNavInfo())
if not root or not bomb then return end

local moved=
not Runtime.C4PathStart
or(root.Position-Runtime.C4PathStart).Magnitude>=5

local changed=Runtime.C4PathBomb~=bomb
local stale=os.clock()-(Runtime.C4PathComputedAt or 0)>=.85

if not Runtime.C4PathBusy and(changed or moved or stale)then
CVU_C4ComputeBestWalkPathAsync(bomb)
end
end

function CVU_C4GetRemainingDefuseTime()
local total=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("HasDefuseKit")==true and 5 or 10
if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb")==true then
local start=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("DefuseStartTime")
if typeof(start)=="number"then
return math.max(total-(Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-start),0)
end
end
return total
end

function CVU_C4UpdateAdvisor()
local frame=CVU_C4EnsureAdvisorUI()
if Settings.C4DefuseAdvisor~=true or not CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()then
frame.Visible=false
return
end

local bomb=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBomb()
if not bomb then
frame.Visible=false
return
end

frame.Visible=true
CVU_C4MaybeRefreshPath(bomb)

local remaining=CVU_C4GetBombRemaining(bomb)
if not remaining then
frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(90,90,100)
Runtime.C4AdvisorText.Text="C4 已安裝｜等待炸彈計時資料"
return
end

local defuseTime=CVU_C4GetRemainingDefuseTime()
local routeTime=nil

if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb")==true then
routeTime=0
elseif Runtime.C4PathBomb==bomb then
routeTime=Runtime.C4PathTime
end

if routeTime==nil then
frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,55,55)
Runtime.C4AdvisorText.Text=string.format(
"C4 %.1fs｜正在計算實際走道路徑…｜不使用穿牆直線距離",
remaining
)
return
end

-- 留 0.35 秒給抵達後互動／網路延遲，避免剛好 0.0 秒被誤判成安全。
local required=routeTime+defuseTime+.35
local margin=remaining-required
local canDefuse=margin>=0

frame.BackgroundColor3=
canDefuse
and Color3.fromRGB(45,105,200)
or Color3.fromRGB(190,48,48)

Runtime.C4AdvisorText.Text=string.format(
"%s｜C4 %.1fs｜走道 %.1fs｜拆包 %.1fs｜餘裕 %+.1fs",
canDefuse and"可成功拆包"or"時間不足，快撤離",
remaining,
routeTime,
defuseTime,
margin
)
end

function CVU_SetC4ESP(enabled)
Settings.C4ESP=enabled==true
CVU_C4UpdateESP()
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
end

function CVU_SetC4DefuseAdvisor(enabled)
Settings.C4DefuseAdvisor=enabled==true
Runtime.C4PathGeneration+=1
Runtime.C4PathBusy=false
Runtime.C4PathBomb=nil
Runtime.C4PathStart=nil
Runtime.C4PathDistance=nil
Runtime.C4PathTime=nil
Runtime.C4PathStatus="idle"
Runtime.C4PathComputedAt=0
CVU_C4UpdateAdvisor()
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
end

local ok,err=pcall(CVU_RemoteDefuseStep)
if not ok then Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="錯誤｜"..tostring(err)end

Runtime.C4UtilityClock+=(dt or 0)
if Runtime.C4UtilityClock>=.10 then
Runtime.C4UtilityClock%=.10
pcall(CVU_C4UpdateESP)
pcall(CVU_C4UpdateAdvisor)
end
end)

function CVU_SetWeaponVisualOwner(owner)

end

function CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()

return "none"
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------
-- ViewModel refresh recursion guard
-- ------------------------------------------------------------
-- 任何 ChickenVisual 自己建立的 Camera 視覺物件，都不能再反過來觸發
-- Camera.DescendantAdded -> CVU_RefreshViewModelVisuals。
function CVU_IsOwnCameraVisual(obj)
local current=obj
local depth=0
while current and depth<10 do
local name=current.Name or""

if string.sub(name,1,4)=="CVU_"then return true end
if current:GetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperience")==true then return true end
if current:GetAttribute("CVU_GhostOverlay")==true then return true end
if current:GetAttribute("CVU_MetalCoat")==true then return true end

if current==Camera then break end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
return false
end

function CVU_BeginViewModelMutation()
Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth=(Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth or 0)+1
end

function CVU_EndViewModelMutation()
Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth=math.max((Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth or 1)-1,0)
end

function CVU_IsViewModelMutationActive()
return (Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth or 0)>0
end

function CVU_RefreshViewModelVisuals()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end

-- 自己正在改 ViewModel 時，事件監聽器可能同步收到 DescendantAdded。
-- 這些事件就是這次 mutation 的結果，直接忽略，不能再排下一輪 refresh。
if CVU_IsViewModelMutationActive()then return end

if not Settings.GhostArms and not CVU_IsAnyMetalEnabled() and not Settings.GlassWeapon then return end
CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache()

if Runtime.ViewModelVisualRefreshQueued then
if CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="metal"and CVU_IsAnyMetalEnabled()then
Runtime.MetalRefreshNeedsRebuild=true
end
return
end

-- Register-safe: queued generation / owner / pcall result live in Runtime instead of
-- allocating more locals in this already register-heavy root build.
Runtime.ViewModelVisualRefreshQueued=true
Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedGeneration=Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration or 0
Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedOwner=CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()

task.defer(function()
Runtime.ViewModelVisualRefreshQueued=false
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if (Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedGeneration or 0)~=(Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration or 0)then return end

Camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera
if not Camera then return end
CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache()

CVU_BeginViewModelMutation()
Runtime.ViewModelVisualMutationOK,Runtime.ViewModelVisualLastError=pcall(function()
-- 同一個 mutation 內先處理手臂，再只套當前 owner 的一種武器效果。
if Settings.GhostArms then
pcall(CVU_ApplyGhostArms)
end

if Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedOwner=="metal"
and CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="metal"
and CVU_IsAnyMetalEnabled()then
pcall(CVU_ApplyMetalWeapon,true)
pcall(CVU_RefreshKnifeExperience,false)
Runtime.MetalRefreshNeedsRebuild=false

elseif Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedOwner=="glass"
and CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="glass"
and Settings.GlassWeapon then
pcall(CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel)
end
end)
CVU_EndViewModelMutation()

if Runtime.ViewModelVisualMutationOK~=true then
warn("[ChickenVisualUI] ViewModel refresh mutation failed: "..tostring(Runtime.ViewModelVisualLastError))
end
end)
end

function CVU_BindCamera(camera)
if not camera then return end

camera.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)

if CVU_IsViewModelMutationActive()then return end

camera.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)

or obj:IsA("Decal")

for line in catalog:gmatch("[^\n]+")do
local row=string.split(line,"|")
if #row==5 then translations[#translations+1]=row end
end
table.sort(translations,function(a,b)return #a[1]>#b[1]end)
local function tr(text)
local index=table.find(languageCodes,Settings.UILanguage)or 1
if index==1 then return text end
-- Replace against original text in one pass; translations never become input.
local out={} local cursor=1
while cursor<=#text do
local found=false
for _,row in ipairs(translations)do
if text:sub(cursor,cursor+#row[1]-1)==row[1]then
out[#out+1]=row[index] cursor+=#row[1] found=true break
end
end
if not found then out[#out+1]=text:sub(cursor,cursor) cursor+=1 end
end
return table.concat(out)
end
local textRecords=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function watchText(obj)
if not(obj:IsA("TextLabel")or obj:IsA("TextButton"))or textRecords[obj]then return end
if obj:GetAttribute("CVU_LanguageNative")then return end
local rec={raw=obj.Text,busy=false,rendered=nil} textRecords[obj]=rec
local function render()
rec.busy=true rec.rendered=tr(rec.raw) obj.Text=rec.rendered rec.busy=false
end
obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
-- Roblox may defer property events until after the write has returned.
if rec.busy or obj.Text==rec.rendered then return end rec.raw=obj.Text render()
end)
render()
end
local function refreshLanguage()
for obj,rec in pairs(textRecords)do
if obj.Parent then rec.busy=true rec.rendered=tr(rec.raw) obj.Text=rec.rendered rec.busy=false end
end
end
local function make(class,parent,props)
local obj=Instance.new(class)
for k,v in pairs(props or {})do obj[k]=v end
obj.Parent=parent return obj
end
local function text(parent,label,x,y,w,h,size)
return make("TextLabel",parent,{Text=label,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundTransparency=1,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextSize=size or 14,Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,ZIndex=200005,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(225,230,240)})
end
local function round(obj,r)
local c=obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")or make("UICorner",obj)
c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r)
end
local function card(parent,x,y,w,h)
local obj=make("Frame",parent,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(27,30,38),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=200003})
round(obj,12)
make("UIStroke",obj,{Color=Color3.fromRGB(65,75,90),Transparency=.55})
return obj
end
local function button(parent,label,x,y,w,h,callback)
local b=make("TextButton",parent,{Text=label,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,44,53),TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,240,250),TextSize=13,TextWrapped=true,Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=200006,AutoButtonColor=true})
round(b,7) b.Activated:Connect(callback) return b
end

-- Quarter-pixel scanlines with fractional edge coverage, built once.
-- Curved barbs keep their contour when the UI is enlarged; no asset fetch.
local featherRoot=make("Frame",Main,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(43,10),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(96,98),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=200003})
local function featherSpan(x,y,width,alpha)
if width<=0 or alpha<=0 then return end
-- UDim offsets are integers: a .25 offset height becomes zero.
-- Scale components preserve fractional geometry against the 96 x 98 root.
local f=make("Frame",featherRoot,{Position=UDim2.fromScale(x/96,y/98),Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/96,.25/98),BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundColor3=Settings.UIAccent,BackgroundTransparency=1-math.clamp(alpha,0,1),ZIndex=200003})
f:SetAttribute("CVU_Accent",true)
end
local function featherPolygon(points)
local minY,maxY=100,0
for _,p in ipairs(points)do minY=math.min(minY,p[2]) maxY=math.max(maxY,p[2])end
for row=math.floor(minY*4),math.ceil(maxY*4)-1 do
local y=(row+.5)/4
local hits={}
for i,a in ipairs(points)do
local b=points[i%#points+1]
if(a[2]<=y and b[2]>y)or(b[2]<=y and a[2]>y)then
hits[#hits+1]=a[1]+(y-a[2])*(b[1]-a[1])/(b[2]-a[2])
end
end
table.sort(hits)
for i=1,#hits-1,2 do
local left,right=hits[i],hits[i+1]
local first,last=math.floor(left*4),math.ceil(right*4)-1
if first==last then
featherSpan(first/4,row/4,.25,(right-left)*4)
else
featherSpan(first/4,row/4,.25,((first+1)/4-left)*4)
featherSpan((first+1)/4,row/4,(last-first-1)/4,1)
featherSpan(last/4,row/4,.25,(right-last/4)*4)
end
end
end
end
local function featherCurve(points,a,b,c,d)
for step=0,20 do
local t=step/20 local u=1-t

function CVU_SkinPreviewCollectInstances(value,parent,seen)
seen=seen or{}
if typeof(value)=="Instance"then
if seen[value]then return 0 end
seen[value]=true
local ok,clone=pcall(function()return value:Clone()end)
local usingOriginal=false
if not ok or not clone then
if value.Parent~=nil then return 0 end
clone=value
usingOriginal=true
end
clone.Parent=parent
if not usingOriginal and value.Parent==nil then pcall(function()value:Destroy()end)end
return 1
end
if type(value)~="table"or seen[value]then return 0 end
seen[value]=true
local count=0
for _,child in pairs(value)do count+=CVU_SkinPreviewCollectInstances(child,parent,seen)end
return count
end

function CVU_SkinPreviewPrepareModel(model)
if not model then return 0 end
if type(CVU_BS_SanitizePreviewModel)=="function"then
return CVU_BS_SanitizePreviewModel(model)
end
local count=0
for _,obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")then
obj.Anchored=true obj.CanCollide=false obj.CanTouch=false obj.CanQuery=false obj.Massless=true
count+=1
end
end
return count
end

function CVU_ModernSkinStripArms(model)
if not model then return end
local trash={}
for _,obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")then
local arm=false
if type(CVU_IsArmPart)=="function"then local ok,result=pcall(CVU_IsArmPart,obj)arm=ok and result==true end
local key=string.lower(obj.Name or""):gsub("[^%w]","")
if arm or key=="lefthand"or key=="righthand"or key=="leftarm"or key=="rightarm"or key=="leftlowerarm"or key=="rightlowerarm"or key=="leftupperarm"or key=="rightupperarm"or key=="leftglove"or key=="rightglove"or key=="sleeve"then
trash[#trash+1]=obj
end
end
end
for _,obj in ipairs(trash)do if obj and obj.Parent then pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)end end
end

function CVU_SkinPreviewExtractKnifeGeometry(root,modelName)
if not root then return nil end

-- Camera models are built for first-person gameplay and may contain extra rig/helper
-- branches.  For the inventory/configurator we only want the actual weapon assembly.
-- BloxStrike's native Skins code addresses these assemblies as Weapon / WeaponL / WeaponR.
local wanted={weapon=true,weaponl=true,weaponr=true}
local picked={}

local function key(name)
return string.lower(tostring(name or"")):gsub("[^%w]","")
end

local function alreadyInsidePicked(obj)
for _,parent in ipairs(picked)do
local ok,result=pcall(function()return obj:IsDescendantOf(parent)end)
if ok and result then return true end
end
return false
end

if (root:IsA("Model")or root:IsA("BasePart"))and wanted[key(root.Name)]then
picked[1]=root
else
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if (obj:IsA("Model")or obj:IsA("BasePart"))and wanted[key(obj.Name)]and not alreadyInsidePicked(obj)then
picked[#picked+1]=obj
end
end
end

if #picked==0 then
return root
end

local holder=Instance.new("Model")
holder.Name="KnifeGeometry_"..tostring(modelName or"")
holder:SetAttribute("CVU_PreviewMode","knife")
holder:SetAttribute("CVU_PreviewName",tostring(modelName or""))

for _,obj in ipairs(picked)do
local ok,clone=pcall(function()return obj:Clone()end)
if ok and clone then clone.Parent=holder end
end

if #holder:GetDescendants()==0 then
holder:Destroy()
return root
end

pcall(function()root:Destroy()end)
return holder
end

function CVU_SkinPreviewBuildSource(mode,modelName,skinName,config)
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
if mode=="glove"then
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
local getter=Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveOriginalGetGloves
if type(getter)~="function"and type(lib)=="table"then getter=lib.GetGloves end
if type(getter)~="function"then return nil,"找不到 GetGloves"end
local results=table.pack(pcall(getter,modelName,skinName,0))
if not results[1]then return nil,tostring(results[2]or"GetGloves failed")end
local holder=Instance.new("Model")
holder.Name="GlovePreview_"..modelName
holder:SetAttribute("CVU_PreviewMode","glove")
holder:SetAttribute("CVU_PreviewName",tostring(modelName or""))
local seen={}
for i=2,results.n do CVU_SkinPreviewCollectInstances(results[i],holder,seen)end
if #holder:GetDescendants()==0 then holder:Destroy()return nil,"手套模型為空"end
if type(CVU_BS_SanitizePreviewModel)=="function"then pcall(CVU_BS_SanitizePreviewModel,holder)end
return holder,nil
end

-- Guns keep using the clean Character/world representation.
-- Knives are different: some third-person Character templates (notably Skeleton Knife)
-- are simplified/placeholder meshes.  For knife gallery thumbnails, prefer the game's
-- real CameraModel, then sanitize + strip arms so the actual knife geometry is retained.
local result=nil
local buildError=nil
if mode=="knife"and type(CVU_BS_BuildCameraModel)=="function"then
local okKnife,builtKnife=pcall(CVU_BS_BuildCameraModel,modelName,skinName,config)
if okKnife and builtKnife then
result=CVU_SkinPreviewExtractKnifeGeometry(builtKnife,modelName)or builtKnife
else
buildError=tostring(Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildError or builtKnife or"Knife CameraModel failed")
end
end

if not result then
if type(CVU_BS_BuildPreviewModel)~="function"then return nil,buildError or"找不到 CharacterModel preview builder"end
local okPreview,builtPreview=pcall(CVU_BS_BuildPreviewModel,modelName,skinName,config)
if okPreview and builtPreview then
result=builtPreview
else
return nil,tostring(buildError or Runtime.BloxStrikeLastPreviewError or builtPreview or"建立乾淨預覽失敗")
end
end

local holder=Instance.new("Model")
holder.Name="CleanPreview_"..modelName
holder:SetAttribute("CVU_PreviewMode",mode=="knife"and"knife"or"gun")
holder:SetAttribute("CVU_PreviewName",tostring(modelName or""))
CVU_SkinPreviewCollectInstances(result,holder,{})
if #holder:GetDescendants()==0 then holder:Destroy()return nil,"預覽模型為空"end
if type(CVU_BS_SanitizePreviewModel)=="function"then pcall(CVU_BS_SanitizePreviewModel,holder)end
return holder,nil
end

function CVU_ModernSkinGetAllWeapons()
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
local result={}
local seen={}
if Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder then
for _,folder in ipairs(Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder:GetChildren())do
local name=folder.Name
if not seen[name]and CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(name)then seen[name]=true result[#result+1]=name end
end
end
if #result==0 then
for _,name in ipairs({"Glock-18","USP-S","P250","Tec-9","Five-SeveN","Desert Eagle","Dual Berettas","MAC-10","MP9","P90","Negev","Nova","XM1014","Galil AR","FAMAS","AK-47","M4A1-S","SG 553","AUG","SSG 08","AWP"})do
result[#result+1]=name
end
end
table.sort(result,function(a,b)return string.lower(a)<string.lower(b)end)
return result
end

function CVU_ModernSkinGetSkins(weaponName)
local result={}
local hasStock=false

for _,skin in ipairs(CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(weaponName,false)or{"Stock"})do
local name=tostring(skin or"")
if name~=""then
result[#result+1]=name
if string.lower(name)=="stock"then hasStock=true end
end
end

-- 槍械一定保留 Stock，而且固定排第一張。
if not hasStock then result[#result+1]="Stock"end

table.sort(result,function(a,b)
local al=string.lower(tostring(a))
local bl=string.lower(tostring(b))
local aStock=al=="stock"
local bStock=bl=="stock"

if aStock~=bStock then return aStock end

local ca=CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weaponName,a,false)
local cb=CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weaponName,b,false)
local fa=ca and ca.Favorite==true or false
local fb=cb and cb.Favorite==true or false
if fa~=fb then return fa end

return al<bl
end)

return result
end

Runtime.ModernSkinResolvedInfoFn=Runtime.ModernSkinResolvedInfoFn or nil

function CVU_ModernSkinGetResolvedItemInfo(name,skin)
name=tostring(name or"")
skin=tostring(skin or"")
if name==""or skin==""then return nil end

local resolver=Runtime.ModernSkinResolvedInfoFn
if resolver==nil then
local ok,result=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Components.Common.GetResolvedSkinInformation)
end)
if ok and type(result)=="function"then
resolver=result
Runtime.ModernSkinResolvedInfoFn=result
else
Runtime.ModernSkinResolvedInfoFn=false
resolver=false
end
end

if type(resolver)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(resolver,name,skin)
if ok and type(result)=="table"then return result end
end

pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetSkinInformation)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(lib.GetSkinInformation,name,skin)
if ok and type(result)=="table"then return result end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_ModernSkinResolveSpecialImage(itemType,name,skin,pattern,floatValue,knownInfo)
local info=type(knownInfo)=="table"and knownInfo or CVU_ModernSkinGetResolvedItemInfo(name,skin)
if type(info)~="table"then return nil,nil end

local image=nil
local kind=string.lower(tostring(itemType or""))

if kind=="charm"and type(info.charmImages)=="table"then
local wanted=tostring(pattern or"")
for _,entry in ipairs(info.charmImages)do
if type(entry)=="table"and tostring(entry.pattern or"")==wanted then
image=entry.assetId or entry.imageAssetId
break
end
end
end

if not image and kind~="charm"then
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetWearImageForFloat)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(lib.GetWearImageForFloat,info,tonumber(floatValue)or 0.9999)
if ok then image=result end
end
end

image=image or info.imageAssetId
if type(CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue)=="function"then
image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(image)
end
return image,info
end

function CVU_ModernSkinGetInventoryItems()
local ok,controller=pcall(function()return require(ReplicatedStorage.Controllers.DataController)end)
if not ok or type(controller)~="table"or type(controller.Get)~="function"then return{}end
local okInv,inventory=pcall(controller.Get,LocalPlayer,"Inventory")
return okInv and type(inventory)=="table"and inventory or{}
end

function CVU_ModernSkinGetCharmOptions()
if type(Runtime.ModernSkinCharmOptions)=="table"then return Runtime.ModernSkinCharmOptions end

local result={}
local seen={}
local assets=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
local charmRoot=assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Charms")

local function findModel(skin,pattern)
if not charmRoot then return nil end
local folder=charmRoot:FindFirstChild(tostring(skin or""))
if not folder then return nil end
return folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(pattern or""))
end

local function add(skin,pattern,image,model,itemName)
skin=tostring(skin or"")
pattern=pattern~=nil and pattern or 1
if skin==""then return end
local key=string.lower(skin).."\0"..tostring(pattern)
if seen[key]then
-- If the earlier entry only had a 3D fallback, enrich it with the native 2D image.
local existing=seen[key]
if type(existing)=="table"and not existing.Image and image then existing.Image=image end
return
end
local entry={
Skin=skin,
Pattern=pattern,
Image=image,
Model=model,
Name=itemName or"Charm",
Label=skin.." · "..tostring(pattern)
}
seen[key]=entry
result[#result+1]=entry
end

-- 1) BloxStrike native schema.  Native Inventory uses charmImages[Pattern].assetId.
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetAllSkinsForWeapon)=="function"then
for _,baseName in ipairs({"Charm","Charms"})do
local ok,schemas=pcall(lib.GetAllSkinsForWeapon,baseName)
if ok and type(schemas)=="table"then
for _,info in ipairs(schemas)do
if type(info)=="table"then
local skin=tostring(info.skin or info.Skin or"")
if type(info.charmImages)=="table"and #info.charmImages>0 then
for _,img in ipairs(info.charmImages)do
if type(img)=="table"then
local pattern=img.pattern or 1
local image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(img.assetId or img.imageAssetId)
add(skin,pattern,image,findModel(skin,pattern),baseName)
end
end
else
local image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(info.imageAssetId)
add(skin,1,image,findModel(skin,1),baseName)
end
end
end
end
end
end

-- 2) Inventory entries give us the exact Name/Skin pair used by the live game.
for _,item in ipairs(CVU_ModernSkinGetInventoryItems())do
if type(item)=="table"and item.Type=="Charm"then
local image=CVU_ModernSkinResolveSpecialImage("Charm",item.Name,item.Skin,item.Pattern,item.Float)
add(item.Skin,item.Pattern or 1,image,findModel(item.Skin,item.Pattern or 1),item.Name)
end
end

-- 3) Keep every local charm model as a fallback, but try the same native image schema first.
if charmRoot then
for _,skinFolder in ipairs(charmRoot:GetChildren())do
if skinFolder.Name~="CharmBase"then
local info=CVU_ModernSkinGetResolvedItemInfo("Charm",skinFolder.Name)
for _,variant in ipairs(skinFolder:GetChildren())do
if variant:IsA("Model")or variant:IsA("Folder")then
local pattern=tonumber(variant.Name)or variant.Name
local image=nil
if info then image=CVU_ModernSkinResolveSpecialImage("Charm","Charm",skinFolder.Name,pattern,nil,info)end
add(skinFolder.Name,pattern,image,variant,"Charm")
end
end
end
end
end

table.sort(result,function(a,b)return string.lower(a.Label)<string.lower(b.Label)end)
Runtime.ModernSkinCharmOptions=result
return result
end

function CVU_ModernSkinGetStickerOptions()
local inventory=CVU_ModernSkinGetInventoryItems()
local attrs=ReplicatedStorage:GetAttributes()

local inventoryStickerCount=0
for _,item in ipairs(inventory)do
if type(item)=="table"then
local typ=string.lower(tostring(item.Type or""))
local tags=item.Tags or item.tags
local tagged=false
if type(tags)=="table"then
for _,tag in pairs(tags)do
if string.find(string.lower(tostring(tag or"")),"sticker",1,true)then tagged=true break end
end
elseif type(tags)=="string"then
tagged=string.find(string.lower(tags),"sticker",1,true)~=nil
end
if typ=="sticker"or tagged then inventoryStickerCount+=1 end
end
end

local stampParts={"inv:"..tostring(inventoryStickerCount)}
for name,value in pairs(attrs)do
local lower=string.lower(tostring(name or""))
if type(value)=="string"
and (string.find(lower,"skin",1,true)
or string.find(lower,"case",1,true)
or string.find(lower,"stock",1,true)
or string.find(lower,"item",1,true))then
stampParts[#stampParts+1]=name..":"..tostring(#value)..":"..value:sub(1,24)
end
end
table.sort(stampParts)
local schemaStamp=table.concat(stampParts,"||")

if type(Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptions)=="table"
and #Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptions>0
and Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptionsStamp==schemaStamp then
return Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptions
end

local result={}
local seen={}
local stickerFamilies={}
local diagnostics={
Inventory=inventoryStickerCount,
CaseItems=0,
TypedSchema=0,
HeuristicSchema=0,
Families=0,
DecodedAttributes=0,
}

pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib

if not Runtime.BloxStrikeCasesLib then
pcall(function()
Runtime.BloxStrikeCasesLib=require(
ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Database")
:WaitForChild("Components")
:WaitForChild("Libraries")
:WaitForChild("Cases")
)
end)
end
local casesLib=Runtime.BloxStrikeCasesLib

local function normalizeImage(info)
if type(info)~="table"then return nil end
local image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(
info.imageAssetId or info.assetId or info.ImageAssetId or info.Image
)
if image then return image end
for _,fieldName in ipairs({"wearImages","charmImages"})do
local list=info[fieldName]
if type(list)=="table"then
for _,entry in pairs(list)do
local candidate=nil
if type(entry)=="table"then
candidate=entry.assetId or entry.imageAssetId or entry.ImageAssetId or entry.Image
elseif type(entry)=="string"or typeof(entry)=="number"then
candidate=entry
end
candidate=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(candidate)
if candidate then return candidate end
end
end
end
return nil
end

local function resolveInfo(name,skin,knownInfo)
if type(knownInfo)=="table"then return knownInfo end
if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetSkinInformation)=="function"then
local ok,info=pcall(lib.GetSkinInformation,name,skin)
if ok and type(info)=="table"then return info end
end
if type(CVU_ModernSkinGetResolvedItemInfo)=="function"then
local ok,info=pcall(CVU_ModernSkinGetResolvedItemInfo,name,skin)
if ok and type(info)=="table"then return info end
end
return nil
end

local function registerFamily(name)
name=tostring(name or"")
if name==""then return end
local key=string.lower(name)
if stickerFamilies[key]then return end
stickerFamilies[key]=name
diagnostics.Families+=1
end

local function add(name,skin,knownInfo,directImage,source)
name=tostring(name or"Sticker")
skin=tostring(skin or"")
if skin==""or string.lower(skin)=="stock"then return end

local info=resolveInfo(name,skin,knownInfo)
local image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(directImage)or normalizeImage(info)
local key=string.lower(name).."\0"..string.lower(skin)
if seen[key]then
local existing=seen[key]
if not existing.Image and image then existing.Image=image end
if not existing.Info and info then existing.Info=info end
return
end

local lowerName=string.lower(name)
local generic=
lowerName=="sticker"
or lowerName=="stickers"
or string.find(lowerName,"sticker",1,true)~=nil
local label=generic and skin or(name.." · "..skin)
local entry={
Name=name,
Skin=skin,
Value=skin,
Image=image,
Info=info,
Label=label,
Source=source,
}
seen[key]=entry
result[#result+1]=entry
end

local function isKnownAppearanceFamily(baseName)
if CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(baseName)then return true end
if CVU_BS_IsNativeKnifeName(baseName)then return true end
if type(CVU_BS_IsGloveModelName)=="function"and CVU_BS_IsGloveModelName(baseName)then return true end
return false
end

local function scanCase(caseInfo)
if type(caseInfo)~="table"then return end
local contents=caseInfo.contents or caseInfo.Contents
if type(contents)~="table"then return end
local caseType=string.lower(tostring(caseInfo.caseType or caseInfo.CaseType or caseInfo.Type or""))
local caseIsSticker=string.find(caseType,"sticker",1,true)~=nil

for _,contentInfo in pairs(contents)do
if type(contentInfo)=="table"then
local item=type(contentInfo.skin)=="table"and contentInfo.skin
or(type(contentInfo.Skin)=="table"and contentInfo.Skin)
or contentInfo
local weaponName=tostring(item.weaponName or item.WeaponName or item.name or item.Name or"")
local skinName=tostring(item.skinName or item.SkinName or(type(item.skin)=="string"and item.skin)or(type(item.Skin)=="string"and item.Skin)or"")
local itemType=string.lower(tostring(item.type or item.Type or item.itemType or item.ItemType or""))
local isSticker=caseIsSticker
or itemType=="sticker"
or string.find(itemType,"sticker",1,true)~=nil

if isSticker and skinName~=""then
if weaponName~=""then registerFamily(weaponName)end
local info=weaponName~=""and resolveInfo(weaponName,skinName,nil)or nil
local directImage=item.imageAssetId or item.assetId or item.ImageAssetId or item.Image
add(weaponName~=""and weaponName or"Sticker",skinName,info,directImage,"Case")
diagnostics.CaseItems+=1
end
end
end
end

-- 1) Inventory 是最可靠的 Sticker 類型標籤。更重要的是：
--    一旦知道 item.Name，立刻把它當成 Sticker family，之後可向 Skins library 展開整個 family，
--    不再只顯示「自己擁有的那幾張」。
for _,item in ipairs(inventory)do
if type(item)=="table"then
local typ=string.lower(tostring(item.Type or""))
local tags=item.Tags or item.tags
local tagged=false
if type(tags)=="table"then
for _,tag in pairs(tags)do
if string.find(string.lower(tostring(tag or"")),"sticker",1,true)then tagged=true break end
end
elseif type(tags)=="string"then
tagged=string.find(string.lower(tags),"sticker",1,true)~=nil
end
if typ=="sticker"or tagged then
local family=tostring(item.Name or"Sticker")
registerFamily(family)
add(
family,
item.Skin or item.Name,
resolveInfo(family,item.Skin or item.Name,nil),
item.imageAssetId or item.assetId or item.ImageAssetId or item.Image,
"Inventory"
)
end
end
end

-- 2) Case library 的原生 case.contents 正是 Store 用來畫內容物的資料。
--    BloxStrike Store 會讀 contents[].skin.weaponName / skinName / type；
--    Sticker Capsule 不是 Assets.Stickers 資料夾，也不是只靠 "Sticker" bucket。
if type(Runtime.ModernSkinObservedCases)=="table"then
for _,caseInfo in pairs(Runtime.ModernSkinObservedCases)do scanCase(caseInfo)end
end
if type(casesLib)=="table"and type(casesLib.GetCases)=="function"then
local ok,cases=pcall(casesLib.GetCases)
if ok and type(cases)=="table"then
for _,caseInfo in pairs(cases)do scanCase(caseInfo)end
end
end

-- 3) 兼容現在與未來可能修正拼字的 Attribute 名稱；並掃描所有 case/skin/stock/item JSON attribute。
local decodedSkinSchemas={}
for attrName,raw in pairs(attrs)do
local lower=string.lower(tostring(attrName or""))
if type(raw)=="string"and raw~=""
and (string.find(lower,"case",1,true)
or string.find(lower,"skin",1,true)
or string.find(lower,"stock",1,true)
or string.find(lower,"item",1,true))then
local ok,decoded=pcall(function()return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)end)
if ok and type(decoded)=="table"then
diagnostics.DecodedAttributes+=1
if string.find(lower,"case",1,true)then
for _,caseInfo in pairs(decoded)do scanCase(caseInfo)end
end
if string.find(lower,"skin",1,true)or string.find(lower,"stock",1,true)or string.find(lower,"item",1,true)then
decodedSkinSchemas[#decodedSkinSchemas+1]=decoded
end
end
end
end

-- 4) Skins schema：先吃明確 type=Sticker / family 名稱；再用「非武器、非手套、非 Charm，
--    而且有直接 2D imageAssetId」作保守 fallback。這補上某些 live schema 不帶 type 的情況。
local function scanSkinSchema(decoded)
if type(decoded)~="table"then return end
for baseName,bucket in pairs(decoded)do
if type(bucket)=="table"then
baseName=tostring(baseName or"")
local baseLower=string.lower(baseName)
local familyKnown=stickerFamilies[baseLower]~=nil
local explicitSticker=
baseLower=="sticker"
or baseLower=="stickers"
or string.find(baseLower,"sticker",1,true)~=nil

local typedSticker=false
local typedOther=false
local charmish=false
local directImageCount=0
local entries={}

for skinKey,info in pairs(bucket)do
if type(info)=="table"then
entries[#entries+1]={Key=skinKey,Info=info}
local typ=string.lower(tostring(info.type or info.Type or info.itemType or info.ItemType or""))
if typ~=""then
if typ=="sticker"or string.find(typ,"sticker",1,true)~=nil then
typedSticker=true
else
typedOther=true
end
end
if type(info.charmImages)=="table"and #info.charmImages>0 then charmish=true end
if normalizeImage(info)then directImageCount+=1 end
end
end

local excludedName=
string.find(baseLower,"charm",1,true)
or string.find(baseLower,"graffiti",1,true)
or string.find(baseLower,"music",1,true)
or string.find(baseLower,"capsule",1,true)
or string.find(baseLower,"case",1,true)
or string.find(baseLower,"grenade",1,true)
or string.find(baseLower,"taser",1,true)
or string.find(baseLower,"zeus",1,true)
or string.find(baseLower,"badge",1,true)

local heuristicSticker=
not explicitSticker
and not familyKnown
and not typedSticker
and not typedOther
and not charmish
and not excludedName
and not isKnownAppearanceFamily(baseName)
and #entries>0
and directImageCount==#entries

if explicitSticker or familyKnown or typedSticker or heuristicSticker then
registerFamily(baseName)
for _,entry in ipairs(entries)do
local info=entry.Info
local typ=string.lower(tostring(info.type or info.Type or info.itemType or info.ItemType or""))
local thisIsSticker=
explicitSticker
or familyKnown
or heuristicSticker
or typ=="sticker"
or string.find(typ,"sticker",1,true)~=nil
if thisIsSticker then
local skin=tostring(info.skin or info.Skin or info.skinName or info.SkinName or entry.Key or"")
add(baseName,skin,info,info.imageAssetId or info.assetId or info.ImageAssetId or info.Image,
heuristicSticker and"SchemaFallback"or"Schema")
if heuristicSticker then diagnostics.HeuristicSchema+=1 else diagnostics.TypedSchema+=1 end
end
end
end
end
end
end

if type(Runtime.ModernSkinObservedSkins)=="table"then scanSkinSchema(Runtime.ModernSkinObservedSkins)end
for _,decoded in ipairs(decodedSkinSchemas)do scanSkinSchema(decoded)end

-- 5) 已知 Sticker family 全量展開。這一步是舊版漏掉的關鍵：
--    舊版即使從 Inventory 知道一張 Sticker，也沒有拿 item.Name 回頭列出該 family 的所有 skin。
if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetAllSkinsForWeapon)=="function"then
for _,baseName in pairs(stickerFamilies)do
local ok,schemas=pcall(lib.GetAllSkinsForWeapon,baseName)
if ok and type(schemas)=="table"then
for key,info in pairs(schemas)do
if type(info)=="table"then
local skin=tostring(info.skin or info.Skin or info.skinName or info.SkinName or key or"")
add(baseName,skin,info,info.imageAssetId or info.assetId or info.ImageAssetId or info.Image,"Family")
end
end
end
end
end

-- 6) 舊 build 的 generic bucket fallback。
if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetAllSkinsForWeapon)=="function"then
for _,baseName in ipairs({"Sticker","Stickers","Sticker Capsule","StickerCapsule"})do
local ok,schemas=pcall(lib.GetAllSkinsForWeapon,baseName)
if ok and type(schemas)=="table"then
for key,info in pairs(schemas)do
if type(info)=="table"then
local skin=tostring(info.skin or info.Skin or info.skinName or info.SkinName or key or"")
add(baseName,skin,info,info.imageAssetId or info.assetId or info.ImageAssetId or info.Image,"Generic")
end
end
end
end
end

table.sort(result,function(a,b)return string.lower(a.Label)<string.lower(b.Label)end)
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerDiagnostics=diagnostics

if #result>0 then
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptions=result
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptionsStamp=schemaStamp
else
-- 空結果不快取。若 BloxStrike 稍後才下發 Cases / Item stock schema，下一次 render 立即再查。
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptions=nil
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptionsStamp=nil
end

if not Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSchemaConnections then
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSchemaConnections={}

local function schemaChanged(kind,payload)
if kind=="skins"and type(payload)=="table"then Runtime.ModernSkinObservedSkins=payload end
if kind=="cases"and type(payload)=="table"then Runtime.ModernSkinObservedCases=payload end
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptions=nil
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerOptionsStamp=nil
if Runtime.ModernSkinPage=="stickers"
and Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot
and Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot.Parent then
task.defer(function()
if not Runtime.Shutdown and Runtime.ModernSkinPage=="stickers"then pcall(CVU_ModernSkinRender)end
end)
end
end

for _,attributeName in ipairs({"AvaiableSkins","AvailableSkins","AvaiableCases","AvailableCases"})do
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSchemaConnections[#Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSchemaConnections+1]=
ReplicatedStorage:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attributeName):Connect(function()
schemaChanged(string.find(string.lower(attributeName),"case",1,true)and"cases"or"skins",nil)
end)
end

if type(lib)=="table"and lib.OnItemStockSchemasUpdated and type(lib.OnItemStockSchemasUpdated.Connect)=="function"then
local ok,connection=pcall(function()
return lib.OnItemStockSchemasUpdated:Connect(function(schema)
schemaChanged("skins",schema)
end)
end)
if ok and connection then
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSchemaConnections[#Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSchemaConnections+1]=connection
end
end

if type(casesLib)=="table"and type(casesLib.ObserveAvailableCases)=="function"then
local ok,stop=pcall(casesLib.ObserveAvailableCases,function(cases)
schemaChanged("cases",cases)
end)
if ok and type(stop)=="function"then
local wrapper={}
function wrapper:Disconnect()
local f=stop
stop=nil
if f then pcall(f)end
end
Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSchemaConnections[#Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSchemaConnections+1]=wrapper
end
end
end

return result
end

function CVU_ModernSkinFindStickerOptionByValue(value)
value=tostring(value or"")
if value==""then return nil end
local target=string.lower(value)

for _,entry in ipairs(CVU_ModernSkinGetStickerOptions())do
if type(entry)=="table"then
local v=tostring(entry.Value or entry.Skin or"")
if string.lower(v)==target then return entry end
end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_ModernSkinFindCharmOption(skin,pattern)
skin=tostring(skin or"")
if skin==""then return nil end
local wantedPattern=tostring(pattern or 1)
for _,entry in ipairs(CVU_ModernSkinGetCharmOptions())do
if type(entry)=="table"
and tostring(entry.Skin or"")==skin
and tostring(entry.Pattern or 1)==wantedPattern then
return entry
end
end
return nil
end

-- 小型 Sticker / Charm slot 專用 2D 圖片。
-- 不能沿用 inventory card 的 StaticSkinThumb 幾何，因為那個 helper 預留了 30~42px 名稱區，
-- 放進 40~60px 的小格會得到接近 0 / 負高度，造成「明明選到了但看不到圖片」。
function CVU_ModernSkinAttachSlotImage(holder,image)
if not holder or not holder.Parent then return false end
image=type(CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue)=="function"and CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(image)or image
if type(image)~="string"or image==""then return false end

for _,child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren())do
if child.Name=="CVU_SlotThumb"then child:Destroy()end
end

local icon=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
icon.Name="CVU_SlotThumb"
icon.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
icon.Position=UDim2.fromScale(.5,.5)
icon.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,1,-8)
icon.BackgroundTransparency=1
icon.BorderSizePixel=0
icon.Image=image
icon.ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
icon.ImageTransparency=0
icon.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
icon.ZIndex=200009
icon.Parent=holder
return true
end

TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,240,248),
Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,
TextSize=20,

return b

function CVU_ModernSkinBuildCharmModel(entry)
if type(entry)~="table"or typeof(entry.Model)~="Instance"then return nil end

if not ok or not clone then return nil end
local holder=Instance.new("Model")

return holder
end

function CVU_ModernSkinGetVisualBounds(model)
if not model then return nil,nil end
local minV=nil
local maxV=nil
local function includePoint(p)
if not minV then minV=p maxV=p return end
minV=Vector3.new(math.min(minV.X,p.X),math.min(minV.Y,p.Y),math.min(minV.Z,p.Z))
maxV=Vector3.new(math.max(maxV.X,p.X),math.max(maxV.Y,p.Y),math.max(maxV.Z,p.Z))
end

for _,obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")and obj.Transparency<0.98 and obj.LocalTransparencyModifier<0.98 then
local half=obj.Size*.5
local cf=obj.CFrame
for _,offset in ipairs({
Vector3.new(-half.X,-half.Y,-half.Z),Vector3.new(half.X,-half.Y,-half.Z),
Vector3.new(-half.X,half.Y,-half.Z),Vector3.new(half.X,half.Y,-half.Z),
Vector3.new(-half.X,-half.Y,half.Z),Vector3.new(half.X,-half.Y,half.Z),
Vector3.new(-half.X,half.Y,half.Z),Vector3.new(half.X,half.Y,half.Z),
})do includePoint(cf:PointToWorldSpace(offset))end
end
end

if not minV or not maxV then
local ok,cf,size=pcall(function()return model:GetBoundingBox()end)
if ok then return cf,size end
return nil,nil
end
return CFrame.new((minV+maxV)*.5),maxV-minV
end

function CVU_ModernSkinTransformPreviewModel(model,transform)
if not model or typeof(transform)~="CFrame"then return false end
local ok=pcall(function()
model:PivotTo(transform*model:GetPivot())
end)
if ok then return true end
for _,obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")then obj.CFrame=transform*obj.CFrame end
end
return true
end

function CVU_ModernSkinCenterPreviewModel(model)
local cf=select(1,CVU_ModernSkinGetVisualBounds(model))
if typeof(cf)~="CFrame"then return false end
return CVU_ModernSkinTransformPreviewModel(model,CFrame.new(-cf.Position))
end

function CVU_ModernSkinChooseKnifePreviewPose(model)
if not model then return end
CVU_ModernSkinCenterPreviewModel(model)

-- Do NOT run knife models through the gun "longest-axis" normalizer.
-- That old path could rotate a knife 90 degrees and then apply a second knife-specific
-- correction, which is why curved knives / butterflies could look broken or edge-on.
-- Instead test a small set of whole-model orientations and keep the clearest silhouette.
local basePivot=model:GetPivot()
local bestRotation=CFrame.new()
local bestScore=-math.huge
local yawCandidates={0,90,180,270}
local rollCandidates={0,90,-90,180}

for _,yaw in ipairs(yawCandidates)do
for _,roll in ipairs(rollCandidates)do
local rot=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(yaw),math.rad(roll))
pcall(function()model:PivotTo(rot*basePivot)end)
local _,size=CVU_ModernSkinGetVisualBounds(model)
if typeof(size)=="Vector3"then
local depth=math.max(size.Z,0.05)
local projected=math.max(size.X,0.01)*math.max(size.Y,0.01)
local landscapeBonus=size.X>=size.Y and 1.18 or .88
local score=(projected/depth)*landscapeBonus
if score>bestScore then
bestScore=score
bestRotation=rot
end
end
end
end

pcall(function()model:PivotTo(bestRotation*basePivot)end)
CVU_ModernSkinCenterPreviewModel(model)

-- Small presentation tilt only; this never changes relative part transforms.
local previewName=tostring(model:GetAttribute("CVU_PreviewName")or"")
local knifeKey=string.lower(previewName):gsub("[^%w]","")
local correction=CFrame.new()
if knifeKey=="karambit"then
correction=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(-6),math.rad(4))
elseif knifeKey=="butterflyknife"then
correction=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(4),math.rad(-3))
elseif knifeKey=="m9bayonet"then
correction=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(-3),0)
elseif knifeKey=="gutknife"then
correction=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(4),math.rad(2))
elseif knifeKey=="stilettoknife"then
correction=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(-4),0)
elseif knifeKey=="skeletonknife"then
correction=CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(3),0)
end

local presentation=CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-4),math.rad(8),math.rad(-14))*correction
CVU_ModernSkinTransformPreviewModel(model,presentation)
CVU_ModernSkinCenterPreviewModel(model)
end

function CVU_ModernSkinFitViewport(viewport,model)
if not viewport or not model then return false end
local mode=string.lower(tostring(model:GetAttribute("CVU_PreviewMode")or""))

CVU_ModernSkinCenterPreviewModel(model)

if mode=="knife"then
CVU_ModernSkinChooseKnifePreviewPose(model)
elseif mode~="glove"then
-- Gun-only orientation normalization.  Knives deliberately bypass this block.
local _,size=CVU_ModernSkinGetVisualBounds(model)
if size and size.Z>size.X*1.03 then
CVU_ModernSkinTransformPreviewModel(model,CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(90),0))
end
local _,horizontal=CVU_ModernSkinGetVisualBounds(model)
if horizontal and horizontal.Y>horizontal.X*1.18 then
CVU_ModernSkinTransformPreviewModel(model,CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-90)))
end
CVU_ModernSkinCenterPreviewModel(model)
end

local cf,size=CVU_ModernSkinGetVisualBounds(model)
if typeof(cf)~="CFrame"or typeof(size)~="Vector3"then return false end

local camera=Instance.new("Camera")
if mode=="knife"then camera.FieldOfView=22
elseif mode=="gun"then camera.FieldOfView=27
else camera.FieldOfView=30 end
camera.Parent=viewport
viewport.CurrentCamera=camera

local aspect=1.72
if viewport.AbsoluteSize.Y>2 then aspect=math.max(viewport.AbsoluteSize.X/viewport.AbsoluteSize.Y,1.05)end
local tanHalf=math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView)*.5)
local fitY=size.Y/(2*tanHalf)
local fitX=size.X/(2*tanHalf*aspect)
local distance=math.max(fitX,fitY)+math.max(size.Z,0.08)*.52
distance=math.clamp(distance*(mode=="knife"and 1.16 or 1.10),1.25,42)
local target=cf.Position

if mode=="glove"then
camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(target+Vector3.new(distance*.42,size.Y*.04,distance),target)
else
camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(target+Vector3.new(0,0,distance),target)
end
return true
end

function CVU_ModernSkinApplyOrbitCamera(viewport,model)
if not viewport or not model then return end
local camera=viewport.CurrentCamera
if not camera then
camera=Instance.new("Camera")
camera.Parent=viewport
viewport.CurrentCamera=camera
end

local cf,size=CVU_ModernSkinGetVisualBounds(model)
if typeof(cf)~="CFrame"or typeof(size)~="Vector3"then return end
local target=cf.Position
local previewMode=string.lower(tostring(model:GetAttribute("CVU_PreviewMode")or""))

-- Lower FOV for knives removes the "fisheye / stretched" look in the large 3D preview.
if previewMode=="knife"then camera.FieldOfView=22
elseif previewMode=="gun"then camera.FieldOfView=32
else camera.FieldOfView=30 end

local aspect=1.72
if viewport.AbsoluteSize.Y>2 then aspect=math.max(viewport.AbsoluteSize.X/viewport.AbsoluteSize.Y,1.05)end
local tanHalf=math.tan(math.rad(camera.FieldOfView)*.5)
local fitY=size.Y/(2*tanHalf)
local fitX=size.X/(2*tanHalf*aspect)
local fixedDistance=math.max(fitX,fitY)+math.max(size.Z,0.08)*.42
fixedDistance=math.clamp(fixedDistance*(previewMode=="knife"and 1.12 or 1.06),1.05,34)

viewport:SetAttribute("CVU_FixedDistance",fixedDistance)
viewport:SetAttribute("CVU_Zoom",nil)

local yaw=tonumber(viewport:GetAttribute("CVU_Yaw"))or 0
local pitch=tonumber(viewport:GetAttribute("CVU_Pitch"))or 4
local orbit=CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(math.rad(pitch),math.rad(yaw),0)*CFrame.new(0,0,fixedDistance)
camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt((CFrame.new(target)*orbit).Position,target)
end

function CVU_ModernSkinEnableViewportOrbit(viewport,model)
if not viewport or not model or viewport:GetAttribute("CVU_OrbitBound")==true then return end
viewport:SetAttribute("CVU_OrbitBound",true)
viewport.Active=true

-- BloxStrike 原生 2D inventory gun icon 的槍口朝左。
-- Configure 一進來就用最大固定尺寸；使用者只可以拖曳旋轉，不可以縮放。
local previewMode=string.lower(tostring(model:GetAttribute("CVU_PreviewMode")or""))
local defaultYaw=previewMode=="gun"and 180 or 0
local defaultPitch=previewMode=="knife"and 4 or 6
viewport:SetAttribute("CVU_Yaw",defaultYaw)
viewport:SetAttribute("CVU_Pitch",defaultPitch)
CVU_ModernSkinApplyOrbitCamera(viewport,model)

local dragging=false
local dragStart=nil
local startYaw=0
local startPitch=0

viewport.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
dragging=true
dragStart=input.Position
startYaw=tonumber(viewport:GetAttribute("CVU_Yaw"))or 0
startPitch=tonumber(viewport:GetAttribute("CVU_Pitch"))or 4
end
end)

viewport.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging=false end
end)

local moveConnection
local endConnection

moveConnection=UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if not dragging or not viewport.Parent or input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
local delta=input.Position-dragStart
viewport:SetAttribute("CVU_Yaw",startYaw-delta.X*.35)
viewport:SetAttribute("CVU_Pitch",math.clamp(startPitch-delta.Y*.25,-32,32))
CVU_ModernSkinApplyOrbitCamera(viewport,model)
end)

endConnection=UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging=false end
end)

viewport.Destroying:Connect(function()
dragging=false
if moveConnection then pcall(function()moveConnection:Disconnect()end)moveConnection=nil end
if endConnection then pcall(function()endConnection:Disconnect()end)endConnection=nil end
end)
end

-- BloxStrike 原生 2D skin 圖片。
-- 遊戲自己的 Skins library 已提供 GetSkinInformation / GetWearImageForFloat；
-- 庫存小卡優先直接使用這些 ImageAsset，而不是即時建立 3D Viewport。
Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinImageCache=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinImageCache or{}

function CVU_BS_GetSkinImage(weaponName,skinName,wear)
weaponName=tostring(weaponName or"")
skinName=tostring(skinName or"Stock")
if weaponName==""then return nil end
wear=math.clamp(tonumber(wear)or 0,0,1)

pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)

local cacheKey=weaponName.."\0"..skinName.."\0"..string.format("%.4f",wear)
local cached=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinImageCache[cacheKey]
if cached~=nil then return cached or nil end

local image=nil
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
local info=nil

if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetSkinInformation)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(lib.GetSkinInformation,weaponName,skinName)
if ok and type(result)=="table"then info=result end
end

-- 跟 BloxStrike 原生 Loadout / DeathCard 相同：
-- 先使用當前磨損度圖片，沒有時才退回 skin 的 imageAssetId。
if info and type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetWearImageForFloat)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(lib.GetWearImageForFloat,info,wear)
if ok then image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(result)end
end

if not image and info then
image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(info.imageAssetId)
end

-- 某些版本的資料可能沒有 GetWearImageForFloat，但 wearImages 仍存在。
if not image and info and type(info.wearImages)=="table"then
local fallback=nil
for _,entry in pairs(info.wearImages)do
if type(entry)=="table"then
local candidate=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(entry.assetId or entry.imageAssetId or entry.Image or entry.image)
fallback=fallback or candidate
if candidate and tostring(entry.wear or"")=="Factory New"then
image=candidate
break
end
elseif type(entry)=="string"or typeof(entry)=="number"then
fallback=fallback or CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(entry)
end
end
image=image or fallback
end

-- Stock 最後再退回 GetWeaponProperties() 的 Icon / ReverseIcon。
if not image and skinName=="Stock"then
image=CVU_GetWeaponIconImage(weaponName)
end

Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinImageCache[cacheKey]=image or false
return image
end

function CVU_ModernSkinAttachCardImage(holder,weaponName,skinName,wear)
if not holder or not holder.Parent then return false end
if holder:GetAttribute("CVU_FullPreview")==true then return false end

local image=CVU_BS_GetSkinImage(weaponName,skinName,wear)
if type(image)~="string"or image==""then return false end

for _,child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren())do
if child.Name=="StaticSkinThumb"then child:Destroy()end
end

local icon=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
icon.Name="StaticSkinThumb"
icon.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
icon.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.5,-15)
icon.Size=UDim2.new(1,-18,1,-40)
icon.BackgroundTransparency=1
icon.BorderSizePixel=0
icon.Image=image
icon.ImageColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
icon.ImageTransparency=0
icon.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
icon.ZIndex=200007
icon.Parent=holder
holder:SetAttribute("CVU_UsingNative2DThumb",true)
return true
end

function CVU_ModernSkinAttachRawCardImage(holder,image)
if not holder or not holder.Parent then return false end
image=type(CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue)=="function"and CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(image)or image
if type(image)~="string"or image==""then return false end

for _,child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren())do
if child.Name=="StaticSkinThumb"then child:Destroy()end
end

local icon=Instance.new("ImageLabel")
icon.Name="StaticSkinThumb"
icon.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
icon.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.5,-15)
icon.Size=UDim2.new(1,-22,1,-42)
icon.BackgroundTransparency=1
icon.BorderSizePixel=0
icon.Image=image
icon.ImageColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
icon.ImageTransparency=0
icon.ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Fit
icon.ZIndex=200007
icon.Parent=holder
return true
end

function CVU_ModernSkinAttachViewport(holder,builder)
if not holder or not holder.Parent or type(builder)~="function"then return end
local viewport=Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
viewport.Name="StaticSkinThumb"
-- Inventory cards reserve space for their fixed name/rarity area; the Configure preview uses the full panel.
if holder:GetAttribute("CVU_FullPreview")==true then
viewport.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,8)
viewport.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,1,-16)
else
-- Center the weapon thumbnail in the visual area above the fixed name strip.
-- Using AnchorPoint avoids left/right bias from hard-coded offsets.
viewport.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
viewport.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.5,-15)
viewport.Size=UDim2.new(1,-22,1,-44)
end
viewport.BackgroundTransparency=1
viewport.BorderSizePixel=0
viewport.ClipsDescendants=true
viewport.Ambient=Color3.fromRGB(205,210,220)
viewport.LightColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
viewport.LightDirection=Vector3.new(-.45,-.65,-.55)
viewport.ZIndex=200007
viewport.Parent=holder
local world=Instance.new("WorldModel")world.Parent=viewport
local ok,model=pcall(builder)
if not ok or not model then viewport:Destroy()return end
CVU_SkinPreviewPrepareModel(model)
local previewMode=string.lower(tostring(model:GetAttribute("CVU_PreviewMode")or""))
if previewMode~="glove"then CVU_ModernSkinStripArms(model)end
model.Parent=world
if not CVU_ModernSkinFitViewport(viewport,model)then viewport:Destroy()return end
if holder:GetAttribute("CVU_FullPreview")==true then
pcall(CVU_ModernSkinEnableViewportOrbit,viewport,model)
end
end

function CVU_ModernSkinQueueThumb(card,builder,weaponName,skinName,wear)
Runtime.ModernSkinThumbQueue=Runtime.ModernSkinThumbQueue or{}
Runtime.ModernSkinThumbQueue[#Runtime.ModernSkinThumbQueue+1]={
Card=card,
Builder=builder,
WeaponName=weaponName,
SkinName=skinName,
Wear=wear,
Built=false,
Building=false
}
end

function CVU_ModernSkinRefreshConfigPreview(holder,weapon,skin,cfg,delaySeconds)
if not holder or not holder.Parent then return end
Runtime.ModernSkinConfigPreviewSerial=(Runtime.ModernSkinConfigPreviewSerial or 0)+1
local serial=Runtime.ModernSkinConfigPreviewSerial
task.delay(math.max(tonumber(delaySeconds)or 0,0),function()
if Runtime.Shutdown or serial~=Runtime.ModernSkinConfigPreviewSerial then return end
if not holder or not holder.Parent then return end
for _,child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren())do
if child.Name=="StaticSkinThumb"then child:Destroy()end
end
pcall(CVU_ModernSkinAttachViewport,holder,function()
local built=CVU_SkinPreviewBuildSource("gun",weapon,skin,cfg)
return built
end)
end)
end

function CVU_ModernSkinRefreshVisibleThumbs()
local scroll=Runtime.ModernSkinContent
if not scroll or not scroll.Parent then return end
local top=scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y-120
local bottom=scroll.AbsolutePosition.Y+scroll.AbsoluteSize.Y+120
for _,record in ipairs(Runtime.ModernSkinThumbQueue or{})do
local card=record.Card
if not record.Built and not record.Building and card and card.Parent then
local y=card.AbsolutePosition.Y
local h=card.AbsoluteSize.Y
if y+h>=top and y<=bottom then
record.Building=true
local serial=Runtime.ModernSkinRenderSerial
task.defer(function()
if serial==Runtime.ModernSkinRenderSerial and card and card.Parent then
local used2D=false
if record.WeaponName then
local ok,result=pcall(CVU_ModernSkinAttachCardImage,card,record.WeaponName,record.SkinName or"Stock",record.Wear)
used2D=ok and result==true
end
if not used2D then
pcall(CVU_ModernSkinAttachViewport,card,record.Builder)
end
end
record.Built=true record.Building=false
end)
end
end
end
end

function CVU_ModernSkinMarkPending(reason)
Runtime.LobbyAppearancePreferredKind="gun"
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallBuyPreviewHooks)
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
if Settings.GunExperienceEnabled then
Runtime.GunExperiencePending=true
Runtime.GunExperiencePendingSerial=(Runtime.GunExperiencePendingSerial or 0)+1
Runtime.GunExperienceStatus="已修改外觀；下一局套用｜"..tostring(Settings.GunExperience).."｜"..tostring(Settings.GunExperienceSkin)
Runtime.GunExperienceLastPendingReason=tostring(reason or"ModernSkinBrowser")
end

-- Lobby 展示與遊戲內體驗開關分離：UI 一改 skin / wear / 貼紙就立即刷新。
task.defer(function()
if not Runtime.Shutdown then pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceRefresh,true)end
end)
end

function CVU_ModernSkinSelectSkin(weaponName,skinName)
Runtime.LobbyAppearancePreferredKind="gun"
Settings.GunExperience=weaponName
Settings.GunExperienceSkin=skinName
Settings.GunExperienceCategory=CVU_BS_GetGunExperienceCategory(weaponName)
if type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)~="table"then Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory={}end
Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory[weaponName]=skinName
CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weaponName,skinName,true)
CVU_ModernSkinMarkPending("SkinSelect")
end

function CVU_ModernSkinClearContent()
Runtime.ModernSkinRenderSerial=(Runtime.ModernSkinRenderSerial or 0)+1
Runtime.ModernSkinThumbQueue={}
local content=Runtime.ModernSkinContent
if not content then return end
for _,child in ipairs(content:GetChildren())do child:Destroy()end
content.CanvasPosition=Vector2.zero
end

Runtime.ModernSkinRarityColors=Runtime.ModernSkinRarityColors or{
Stock=Color3.fromRGB(195,195,195),
Blue=Color3.fromRGB(75,106,255),
Purple=Color3.fromRGB(136,71,255),
Pink=Color3.fromRGB(211,44,230),
Red=Color3.fromRGB(235,75,75),
Special=Color3.fromRGB(255,215,0),
Forbidden=Color3.fromRGB(65,15,18),
}

function CVU_ModernSkinGetRarity(weaponName,skinName)
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
local rarity="Stock"
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetSkinInformation)=="function"then
local ok,info=pcall(lib.GetSkinInformation,tostring(weaponName or""),tostring(skinName or"Stock"))
if ok and type(info)=="table"and type(info.rarity)=="string"and info.rarity~=""then rarity=info.rarity end
end
return rarity,Runtime.ModernSkinRarityColors[rarity]or Runtime.ModernSkinRarityColors.Stock
end

function CVU_ModernSkinApplyRarity(card,weaponName,skinName)
if not card then return end
local rarity,color=CVU_ModernSkinGetRarity(weaponName,skinName)

-- Quality color belongs INSIDE the item tile, CS-inventory style.
local tint=card:FindFirstChild("RarityTint")
if not tint then
 tint=Instance.new("Frame")
 tint.Name="RarityTint"
 tint.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
 tint.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,-30)
 tint.BackgroundTransparency=1
 tint.BorderSizePixel=0
 tint.ZIndex=200006
 tint.Parent=card
end
tint.BackgroundColor3=color

local accent=card:FindFirstChild("RarityAccent")
if not accent then
 accent=Instance.new("Frame")
 accent.Name="RarityAccent"
 accent.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
 accent.Size=UDim2.new(0,4,1,-4)
 accent.BorderSizePixel=0
 accent.ZIndex=200009
 accent.Parent=card
end
accent.BackgroundColor3=color

local bar=card:FindFirstChild("RarityBar")
if not bar then
 bar=Instance.new("Frame")
 bar.Name="RarityBar"
 bar.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,1)
 bar.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,0)
 bar.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,4)
 bar.BorderSizePixel=0
 bar.ZIndex=200010
 bar.Parent=card
end
bar.BackgroundColor3=color
card:SetAttribute("CVU_Rarity",rarity)
end

function CVU_ModernSkinCard(parent,title,onClick)
local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
b.Text=""
b.AutoButtonColor=false
b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(24,27,32)
b.BorderSizePixel=0
b.ClipsDescendants=true
b.ZIndex=200005
b.Parent=parent
round(b,7)

-- Clear separation between each inventory item without turning it into a form button.
local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Name="CardStroke"
stroke.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
stroke.LineJoinMode=Enum.LineJoinMode.Round
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,79,92)
stroke.Transparency=.10
stroke.Thickness=1.10
stroke.Parent=b

-- Fixed-height name region.  Every tile stays aligned even when weapon/skin names differ.
local nameArea=Instance.new("Frame")
nameArea.Name="NameArea"
nameArea.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,1)
nameArea.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-4)
nameArea.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,26)
nameArea.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(15,19,25)
nameArea.BackgroundTransparency=.08
nameArea.BorderSizePixel=0
nameArea.ZIndex=200007
nameArea.Parent=b

local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Name="ItemName"
label.BackgroundTransparency=1
label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,0)
label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,0)
label.Text=tostring(title or"")
label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(229,233,241)
label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
label.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
label.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
label.Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium
label.TextSize=11
label.ZIndex=200011
label.Parent=nameArea

b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
if not b.Parent then return end
-- Model chooser stays neutral; it should never look like a selected/apply state.
if b:GetAttribute("CVU_ModelChooser")==true then
if stroke.Parent then
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,79,92)
stroke.Transparency=.10
stroke.Thickness=1.10
end
return
end
-- Inventory tiles keep the same dark background on hover.
-- Only the border may brighten slightly, so the weapon image never gets visually dimmed.
if stroke.Parent and stroke.Thickness<1.9 then
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(108,118,132)
stroke.Transparency=.04
end
end)
b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
if not b.Parent then return end
if b:GetAttribute("CVU_ModelChooser")==true then
if stroke.Parent then
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,79,92)
stroke.Transparency=.10
stroke.Thickness=1.10
end
return
end
if stroke.Parent and stroke.Thickness<1.9 then
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,79,92)
stroke.Transparency=.10
end
end)
if type(onClick)=="function"then b.Activated:Connect(onClick)end
return b,stroke,label
end

function CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardApplied(stroke)
if not stroke or not stroke.Parent then return end
stroke.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
stroke.Transparency=0
stroke.Thickness=2.75
end

function CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardPending(stroke)
if not stroke or not stroke.Parent then return end
-- A skin/model the player has selected must already read as selected in the gallery.
-- The actually-applied state above uses the same white border, just thicker.
stroke.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
stroke.Transparency=0
stroke.Thickness=2.10
end

function CVU_ModernSkinResetCardStroke(stroke)
if not stroke or not stroke.Parent then return end
stroke.ApplyStrokeMode=Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,79,92)
stroke.Transparency=.10
stroke.Thickness=1.10
end

function CVU_ModernSkinRefreshGunSkinBorders(weaponName)
local content=Runtime.ModernSkinContent
if not content or not content.Parent then return end
weaponName=tostring(weaponName or Runtime.ModernSkinWeapon or"")

-- 白框只有一種語意：目前 UI 真正選中的 skin。
-- Applied / 上一局 / SkinMemory 都不得再畫第二個白框。
for _,card in ipairs(content:GetChildren())do
if card:IsA("GuiButton")
and card:GetAttribute("CVU_GunSkinCard")==true
and tostring(card:GetAttribute("CVU_WeaponName")or"")==weaponName then
local skin=tostring(card:GetAttribute("CVU_SkinName")or"")
local stroke=card:FindFirstChild("CardStroke")
CVU_ModernSkinResetCardStroke(stroke)
if Settings.GunExperience==weaponName and Settings.GunExperienceSkin==skin then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardPending(stroke)
end
end
end
end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceRefreshSkinBorders(kind,displayName,nativeName)
local content=Runtime.SimpleAppearanceContent
if not content or not content.Parent then return end

for _,card in ipairs(content:GetChildren())do
if card:IsA("GuiButton")
and card:GetAttribute("CVU_AppearanceSkinCard")==true
and tostring(card:GetAttribute("CVU_AppearanceKind")or"")==tostring(kind)
and tostring(card:GetAttribute("CVU_AppearanceNative")or"")==tostring(nativeName)then

local skin=tostring(card:GetAttribute("CVU_SkinName")or"")
local stroke=card:FindFirstChild("CardStroke")
CVU_ModernSkinResetCardStroke(stroke)

-- 白框只看「目前全域真正選中的種類 + skin」。
-- SkinMemory 只保留資料，不再用來畫每個種類自己的歷史白框。
local pending=false
local applied=false

if kind=="glove"then
local isCurrentType=tostring(Settings.GloveExperience or"")==tostring(nativeName)
pending=isCurrentType
and tostring(Settings.GloveExperienceSkin or"")~=""
and tostring(Settings.GloveExperienceSkin or"")==skin

applied=pending
and Runtime.GloveExperienceAppliedEnabled==true
and Runtime.GloveExperienceAppliedModel==nativeName
and Runtime.GloveExperienceAppliedSkin==skin
else
local isCurrentType=tostring(Settings.KnifeExperience or"")==tostring(displayName)
pending=isCurrentType
and tostring(Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin or"")~=""
and tostring(Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin or"")==skin

applied=pending
and Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled==true
and Runtime.KnifeExperienceAppliedType==displayName
and Runtime.KnifeExperienceAppliedSkin==skin
end

if applied then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardApplied(stroke)
elseif pending then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardPending(stroke)
end
end
end
end

function CVU_ModernSkinRaiseToggle(toggle)
if not toggle then return end
toggle.ZIndex=200006
local track=toggle:FindFirstChild("ToggleTrack")
if track then
track.ZIndex=200007
local knob=track:FindFirstChild("ToggleKnob")
if knob then knob.ZIndex=200008 end
end
end

function CVU_ModernSkinCreateGrid()
local content=Runtime.ModernSkinContent

-- The card UIStroke extends slightly outside the tile.
-- Without an inset, the ScrollingFrame clips the first row's TOP stroke
-- and the first column's LEFT stroke.  Give every edge real breathing room.
local edgePadding=Instance.new("UIPadding")
edgePadding.Name="InventoryEdgePadding"
edgePadding.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,4)
edgePadding.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,4)
edgePadding.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,4)
edgePadding.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,4)
edgePadding.Parent=content

local grid=Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
-- Keep the current tile density / proportions.
grid.CellSize=UDim2.fromOffset(196,142)
grid.CellPadding=UDim2.fromOffset(10,10)
grid.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
grid.Parent=content
grid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
if content and content.Parent then
content.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,grid.AbsoluteContentSize.Y+20)
end
end)
return grid
end

function CVU_ModernSkinSetHeader(path,canBack)
if Runtime.ModernSkinBreadcrumb then Runtime.ModernSkinBreadcrumb.Text=tostring(path or"Inventory › Items")end
if Runtime.ModernSkinBackButton then Runtime.ModernSkinBackButton.Visible=canBack==true end
end

function CVU_ModernSkinGo(page,weaponName,skinName,slot)
Runtime.ModernSkinPage=page or"weapons"
if weaponName then Runtime.ModernSkinWeapon=weaponName end
if skinName then Runtime.ModernSkinSkin=skinName end
if slot then Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSlot=slot end
CVU_ModernSkinRender()
end

function CVU_ModernSkinRenderWeapons()
CVU_ModernSkinSetHeader("Inventory  ›  Items",false)
CVU_ModernSkinCreateGrid()
local query=string.lower(tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText or""))
local order=0
for _,weaponName in ipairs(CVU_ModernSkinGetAllWeapons())do
if query==""or string.find(string.lower(weaponName),query,1,true)then
order+=1
local selectedWeapon=weaponName
local card,stroke=CVU_ModernSkinCard(Runtime.ModernSkinContent,selectedWeapon,function()
Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText="" if Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox then Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox.Text=""end
CVU_ModernSkinGo("skins",selectedWeapon,nil)
end)
card.LayoutOrder=order
CVU_ModernSkinApplyRarity(card,selectedWeapon,"Stock")
-- Weapon-type chooser is navigation only: never draw the white selected/applied border here.
-- The white border is reserved for the actual skin card inside that weapon's skin page.
CVU_ModernSkinQueueThumb(card,function()
local built=CVU_SkinPreviewBuildSource("gun",selectedWeapon,"Stock",nil)
return built
end,selectedWeapon,"Stock",0)
end
end
task.defer(CVU_ModernSkinRefreshVisibleThumbs)
end

function CVU_ModernSkinRenderSkins()
local weapon=tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinWeapon or Settings.GunExperience or"AWP")
CVU_ModernSkinSetHeader("Inventory  ›  Items  ›  "..weapon,true)
CVU_ModernSkinCreateGrid()
local query=string.lower(tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText or""))
local order=0
for _,skinName in ipairs(CVU_ModernSkinGetSkins(weapon))do
if query==""or string.find(string.lower(skinName),query,1,true)then
order+=1
local selectedSkin=skinName
local isStock=string.lower(tostring(selectedSkin))=="stock"
local cfg=isStock and nil or CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weapon,selectedSkin,true)
local title=(cfg and cfg.Favorite and"★  "or"")..selectedSkin
local card,stroke=CVU_ModernSkinCard(Runtime.ModernSkinContent,title,function()
-- 單擊即完成選取。非 Stock skin 直接進 Configure，
-- 讓「加入我的最愛 / 磨損度 / 自定義名稱」立即出現，不再要求第二次點擊。
CVU_ModernSkinSelectSkin(weapon,selectedSkin)

if not isStock then
Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText=""
if Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox then Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox.Text=""end
CVU_ModernSkinGo("config",weapon,selectedSkin)
else
-- Stock 沒有 per-skin Configure；留在 skin gallery，並立即刷新唯一白框。
CVU_ModernSkinRefreshGunSkinBorders(weapon)
end
end)
card:SetAttribute("CVU_GunSkinCard",true)
card:SetAttribute("CVU_WeaponName",weapon)
card:SetAttribute("CVU_SkinName",selectedSkin)
card.LayoutOrder=order
CVU_ModernSkinApplyRarity(card,weapon,selectedSkin)
-- 槍械 skin 頁只允許目前 UI 選中的那一張有白框。
if Settings.GunExperience==weapon and Settings.GunExperienceSkin==selectedSkin then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardPending(stroke)
end
CVU_ModernSkinQueueThumb(card,function()
local built=CVU_SkinPreviewBuildSource("gun",weapon,selectedSkin,cfg)
return built
end,weapon,selectedSkin,cfg and cfg.Wear or 0)
end
end
task.defer(CVU_ModernSkinRefreshVisibleThumbs)
end

local removeAllStickers=button(left,"移除全部貼紙",12,488,371,34,function()

CVU_ModernSkinRender()

removeAllStickers.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(238,185,190)

text(right,"Configure",14,10,220,24,13)
local wearHolder=make("Frame",right,{

)

-- StatTrak 保持目前每 Skin 是否開啟、槍種共用擊殺數的既有邏輯。

)

)
