function CVU_ModernSkinRenderCharms()
local weapon=tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinWeapon or Settings.GunExperience or"AWP")
local skin=tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinSkin or Settings.GunExperienceSkin or"Stock")
local cfg=CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weapon,skin,true)
CVU_ModernSkinSetHeader("Inventory  ›  "..weapon.."  ›  "..skin.."  ›  Charms",true)
CVU_ModernSkinCreateGrid()

-- Configure 頁已移除「移除吊飾」按鍵。
-- 仍保留 gallery 裡的「不使用吊飾」，讓玩家真的需要清除時有唯一入口。
local noneCard,noneStroke=CVU_ModernSkinCard(Runtime.ModernSkinContent,"不使用吊飾",function()
cfg.Charm=false
CVU_SyncGunSkinAttachmentFlags(cfg)
CVU_ModernSkinMarkPending("CharmNone")
CVU_ModernSkinGo("config",weapon,skin)
end)
noneCard.LayoutOrder=0
if not(type(cfg.Charm)=="table"and type(cfg.Charm.Skin)=="string"and cfg.Charm.Skin~="")then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardPending(noneStroke)
end

local query=string.lower(tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText or""))
local order=0
for _,entry in ipairs(CVU_ModernSkinGetCharmOptions())do
if query==""or string.find(string.lower(entry.Label),query,1,true)then
order+=1
local selected=entry
local c,stroke=CVU_ModernSkinCard(Runtime.ModernSkinContent,selected.Label,function()
cfg.Charm={Skin=selected.Skin,Pattern=selected.Pattern,Position="1"}
CVU_SyncGunSkinAttachmentFlags(cfg)
CVU_ModernSkinMarkPending("CharmSelect")
Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText=""
if Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox then Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox.Text=""end
CVU_ModernSkinGo("config",weapon,skin)
end)
c.LayoutOrder=order

if type(cfg.Charm)=="table"
and tostring(cfg.Charm.Skin or"")==tostring(selected.Skin or"")
and tostring(cfg.Charm.Pattern or 1)==tostring(selected.Pattern or 1)then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardPending(stroke)
end

local usedImage=false
if selected.Image then
local ok,result=pcall(CVU_ModernSkinAttachRawCardImage,c,selected.Image)
usedImage=ok and result==true
end
if not usedImage then
CVU_ModernSkinQueueThumb(c,function()return CVU_ModernSkinBuildCharmModel(selected)end)
end
end
end
task.defer(CVU_ModernSkinRefreshVisibleThumbs)
end

function CVU_ModernSkinRenderStickers()
local weapon=tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinWeapon or Settings.GunExperience or"AWP")
local skin=tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinSkin or Settings.GunExperienceSkin or"Stock")
local slot=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.ModernSkinStickerSlot)or 1,1,5)
local cfg=CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weapon,skin,true)

CVU_ModernSkinSetHeader("Inventory  ›  "..weapon.."  ›  "..skin.."  ›  Sticker "..slot,true)
CVU_ModernSkinCreateGrid()

local clearCard,clearStroke=CVU_ModernSkinCard(Runtime.ModernSkinContent,"移除此位置貼紙",function()
cfg.Stickers[slot]=nil
CVU_SyncGunSkinAttachmentFlags(cfg)
CVU_ModernSkinMarkPending("StickerRemove")
CVU_ModernSkinGo("config",weapon,skin)
end)
clearCard.LayoutOrder=0
if not(type(cfg.Stickers)=="table"and type(cfg.Stickers[slot])=="string"and cfg.Stickers[slot]~="")then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardPending(clearStroke)
end

local clearAllCard=CVU_ModernSkinCard(Runtime.ModernSkinContent,"移除全部貼紙",function()
cfg.Stickers={}
CVU_SyncGunSkinAttachmentFlags(cfg)
CVU_ModernSkinMarkPending("StickerRemoveAll")
CVU_ModernSkinGo("config",weapon,skin)
end)
clearAllCard.LayoutOrder=1

local options=CVU_ModernSkinGetStickerOptions()
if #options==0 then
local d=type(Runtime.ModernSkinStickerDiagnostics)=="table"and Runtime.ModernSkinStickerDiagnostics or{}
local message=
"目前這個 client 沒有可列出的 Sticker catalog。這不是介面卡住：BloxStrike 把 Sticker 當獨立 Inventory item，"..
"完整清單主要來自 Sticker Capsule 的 case.contents / Item stock schema，而不是 Assets.Stickers。\n"..
"診斷：Inventory Sticker="..tostring(d.Inventory or 0)..
"｜Capsule 內容="..tostring(d.CaseItems or 0)..
"｜Schema 明確="..tostring(d.TypedSchema or 0)..
"｜Schema fallback="..tostring(d.HeuristicSchema or 0)..
"｜Sticker families="..tostring(d.Families or 0).."。"
local note=text(Runtime.ModernSkinContent,message,18,140,790,112,12)
note.TextWrapped=true
note.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,165,180)
return
end

local query=string.lower(tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText or""))
local order=1
local currentValue=type(cfg.Stickers)=="table"and tostring(cfg.Stickers[slot]or"")or""

for _,entry in ipairs(options)do
local label=tostring(entry.Label or entry.Skin or entry.Value or"Sticker")
if query==""or string.find(string.lower(label),query,1,true)then
order+=1
local selected=entry
local c,stroke=CVU_ModernSkinCard(Runtime.ModernSkinContent,label,function()
local chosen=tostring(selected.Value or selected.Skin or"")
if chosen==""then return end
cfg.Stickers[slot]=chosen
CVU_SyncGunSkinAttachmentFlags(cfg)
CVU_ModernSkinMarkPending("StickerSelect")
Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText=""
if Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox then Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox.Text=""end
CVU_ModernSkinGo("config",weapon,skin)
end)
c.LayoutOrder=order

if currentValue~=""and string.lower(currentValue)==string.lower(tostring(selected.Value or selected.Skin or""))then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardPending(stroke)
end

-- Sticker gallery 一律優先用 BloxStrike 原生 2D imageAssetId。
-- 選下去回 Configure 後，同一張圖會立刻出現在該 slot。
if selected.Image then
pcall(CVU_ModernSkinAttachRawCardImage,c,selected.Image)
end
end
end
task.defer(CVU_ModernSkinRefreshVisibleThumbs)
end

function CVU_ModernSkinRender()
if not Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot or not Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot.Parent then return end
CVU_ModernSkinClearContent()
local page=Runtime.ModernSkinPage or"weapons"
if page=="skins"then CVU_ModernSkinRenderSkins()
elseif page=="config"then CVU_ModernSkinRenderConfig()
elseif page=="charms"then CVU_ModernSkinRenderCharms()
elseif page=="stickers"then CVU_ModernSkinRenderStickers()
else Runtime.ModernSkinPage="weapons"CVU_ModernSkinRenderWeapons()end
end

Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot=make("Frame",Runtime.GunBrowserHost,{Name="ModernSkinBrowser",Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,23,29),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=200003})round(Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot,10)
make("UIStroke",Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot,{Color=Color3.fromRGB(61,69,82),Transparency=.5,Thickness=1})
Runtime.ModernSkinBackButton=button(Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot,"‹",12,10,36,32,function()
local page=Runtime.ModernSkinPage
if page=="skins"then CVU_ModernSkinGo("weapons")
elseif page=="config"then CVU_ModernSkinGo("skins",Runtime.ModernSkinWeapon,nil)
elseif page=="charms"or page=="stickers"then CVU_ModernSkinGo("config",Runtime.ModernSkinWeapon,Runtime.ModernSkinSkin)
else CVU_ModernSkinGo("weapons")end
end)
Runtime.ModernSkinBreadcrumb=text(Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot,"Inventory  ›  Items",56,10,520,32,12)
Runtime.ModernSkinBreadcrumb.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox=make("TextBox",Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot,{Position=UDim2.new(1,-242,0,10),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(230,32),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(15,18,23),BorderSizePixel=0,Text="",PlaceholderText="Search",ClearTextOnFocus=false,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(225,230,240),PlaceholderColor3=Color3.fromRGB(110,122,140),TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,TextSize=12,ZIndex=200006})round(Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox,7)
Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText=tostring(Runtime.ModernSkinSearchBox.Text or"")CVU_ModernSkinRender()end)
Runtime.ModernSkinContent=make("ScrollingFrame",Runtime.ModernSkinBrowserRoot,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,54),Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-66),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=5,CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),ZIndex=200004})
Runtime.ModernSkinContent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(function()task.defer(CVU_ModernSkinRefreshVisibleThumbs)end)
Runtime.ModernSkinPage="weapons"
Runtime.ModernSkinSearchText=""
Runtime.ModernSkinRenderSerial=0
Runtime.ModernSkinThumbQueue={}


-- ============================================================
-- Appearance Inventory v2
-- 舊外觀控制全部收進隱藏相容容器；畫面只保留新的 Inventory Browser。
-- ============================================================
for _,control in ipairs({
Runtime.KnifeExperienceToggle,Runtime.KnifeExperienceButton,Runtime.KnifeExperienceSkinButton,
Runtime.GloveExperienceToggle,Runtime.GloveExperienceButton,Runtime.GloveExperienceSkinButton,
})do
if control and control.Parent then
control.Parent=appearanceScroll
control.Visible=false
end
end
for _,control in ipairs({
Runtime.GunExperienceToggle,Runtime.GunExperienceCategoryButton,Runtime.GunExperienceButton,Runtime.GunExperienceSkinButton,
})do

function CVU_AppearanceSetKnifeEnabled(enabled)
enabled=enabled==true
Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled=enabled
if enabled then Runtime.LobbyAppearancePreferredKind="knife"end
if enabled then
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshKnifeSkinOptions,Settings.KnifeExperience)
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook)
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus="體驗刀具已開啟｜更換刀型/skin 將於下一局套用"
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpBindFeedbackActions)
else
Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeSwapGeneration=(Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeSwapGeneration or 0)+1
pcall(CVU_ClearKnifeExperience)
if not Runtime.GloveExperienceAppliedEnabled
and not Settings.GloveExperienceEnabled
and not Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedEnabled
and not Settings.GunExperienceEnabled then
pcall(CVU_BS_UninstallNativeViewmodelHook)
end
Runtime.KnifeExperiencePending=false
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeKnife=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeSkin=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus="體驗刀具：OFF｜原生模型下次重建時恢復原裝"

enabled=enabled==true

if enabled then
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)

pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGloveSkinOptions,Settings.GloveExperience)
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook)
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallGloveExperienceHook)
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallBuyPreviewHooks)

else

pcall(CVU_BS_UninstallGloveExperienceHook)

and not Settings.GunExperienceEnabled then

function CVU_AppearanceSetGunEnabled(enabled)

else

Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeGunSkin=nil

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceGrid()

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetModels(kind)
local result={}
if kind=="glove"then
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGloveModelOptions)
for _,name in ipairs(Runtime.GloveExperienceModelOptions or{})do
-- T Glove / CT Glove are the game's base team gloves, not premium glove models.
-- Keep them available to the game's internals, but hide them from this chooser.
if name~="T Glove"and name~="CT Glove"then
result[#result+1]={Display=name,Native=name}
end
end
return result
end
local ordered={"蝴蝶刀","爪刀","M9刺刀","折疊刀","剖腹刀","細劍","骷髏刀","光劍"}
for _,display in ipairs(ordered)do
local native=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(display)
if native then result[#result+1]={Display=display,Native=native}end
end
return result
end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetSkins(kind,nativeName)
local result={}
local source=CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(nativeName,kind=="knife")or{}

for _,skin in ipairs(source)do
local name=tostring(skin or"")
local lower=string.lower(name)

-- 刀具與手套的 Stock 都不是 gallery skin。
if name~=""and not((kind=="knife"or kind=="glove")and lower=="stock")then
result[#result+1]=name
end
end

table.sort(result,function(a,b)
local al=string.lower(tostring(a))
local bl=string.lower(tostring(b))

-- 刀具、手套都把 Vanilla 放第一張。
if kind=="knife"or kind=="glove"then
if al=="vanilla"and bl~="vanilla"then return true end
if bl=="vanilla"and al~="vanilla"then return false end
end

-- 刀具現在也有「我的最愛」；Vanilla 之後優先顯示 Favorite。
if kind=="knife"then
local ca=CVU_GetKnifeSkinConfig(nativeName,a,false)
local cb=CVU_GetKnifeSkinConfig(nativeName,b,false)
local fa=ca and ca.Favorite==true or false
local fb=cb and cb.Favorite==true or false
if fa~=fb then return fa end
end

return al<bl
end)

return result
end

-- 刀具 / 手套型號總覽頁封面。
-- Stock 不再拿來當 gallery thumbnail；優先 Vanilla，否則第一個真實 skin。
function CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetModelThumbSkin(kind,nativeName)
if kind~="knife"and kind~="glove"then return"Stock"end

local skins=CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetSkins(kind,nativeName)
local firstNonStock=nil

for _,skinName in ipairs(skins)do
local name=tostring(skinName or"")
local lower=string.lower(name)

if lower=="vanilla"then return name end
if lower~=""and lower~="stock"and not firstNonStock then firstNonStock=name end
end

-- nil = 沒有合法 2D gallery 圖，交給 3D fallback；絕不塞 Stock。
return firstNonStock
end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceAttachThumb(card,kind,nativeName,skinName)
if not card or not card.Parent then return end
task.defer(function()
if not card or not card.Parent then return end

-- 刀具與手套小卡都優先吃 BloxStrike 原生 2D 圖。
-- 若該 skin 沒有圖片，才回到舊的 3D Viewport。
if kind=="knife"or kind=="glove"then
local requestedSkin=skinName
local lower=string.lower(tostring(requestedSkin or""))

-- 刀具與手套都禁止用 Stock 當 gallery 縮圖。
if type(requestedSkin)=="string"and requestedSkin~=""and lower~="stock"then
local ok,used2D=pcall(CVU_ModernSkinAttachCardImage,card,nativeName,requestedSkin,0)
if ok and used2D==true then return end
end
end

local mode=kind=="glove"and"glove"or"knife"
pcall(CVU_ModernSkinAttachViewport,card,function()
local built=CVU_SkinPreviewBuildSource(mode,nativeName,skinName,nil)
return built
end)
end)
end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceSelectModel(kind,displayName,nativeName)

state.Page="skins"
state.Model=nativeName
state.Display=displayName
state.Skin=nil
Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchText=""
if Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchBox then Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchBox.Text=""end

-- 只是在瀏覽某個刀型 / 手套種類。
-- 不修改目前真正選中的 Settings，也不恢復這個種類舊的 skin。
-- 真正點某一張 skin 卡片時，CVU_SimpleAppearanceSelectSkin 才改選擇。
CVU_SimpleAppearanceRender()
end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetRememberedSkin(kind,displayName,nativeName)
-- 這裡只回傳「目前全域真正選中的 skin」。
-- 不再讀每個種類自己的歷史記憶。
if kind=="glove"then
if tostring(Settings.GloveExperience or"")==tostring(nativeName)then
local skin=tostring(Settings.GloveExperienceSkin or"")
return skin~=""and skin or nil
end
return nil
end

if tostring(Settings.KnifeExperience or"")==tostring(displayName)then
local skin=tostring(Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin or"")
return skin~=""and skin or nil
end
return nil
end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceSelectSkin(kind,displayName,nativeName,skinName)
if kind=="knife"then Runtime.LobbyAppearancePreferredKind="knife"
elseif kind=="glove"then Runtime.LobbyAppearancePreferredKind="glove"end

if kind=="glove"then
-- 真正點 skin 時才切換目前唯一選中的手套。
Settings.GloveExperience=nativeName
Settings.GloveExperienceSkin=skinName
CVU_RememberGloveSkin(false)
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallGloveExperienceHook)
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallBuyPreviewHooks)
pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceRefresh,true)

if Settings.GloveExperienceEnabled then
CVU_QueueGloveExperienceNextRound("AppearanceV2GloveSkin")
pcall(CVU_BS_TouchBuyPreviewWindow,1.2)
end

-- Lobby 不受體驗手套開關限制，選中後立即更新展示。
task.defer(function()
if not Runtime.Shutdown then pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceRefresh,true)end
end)
else
-- 真正點 skin 時才切換目前唯一選中的刀具。
Settings.KnifeExperience=displayName
Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin=skinName
CVU_RememberKnifeSkin()

if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled then
CVU_QueueKnifeExperienceNextRound("AppearanceV2KnifeSkin")
end
end

CVU_QueueSaveSettings()

if kind=="knife"then
local state=CVU_SimpleAppearanceState("knife")
state.Page="config"
state.Model=nativeName
state.Display=displayName
state.Skin=skinName
Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchText=""
if Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchBox then Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchBox.Text=""end
CVU_SimpleAppearanceRender()
else
-- 手套仍維持原本的一鍵選擇，不新增不必要的 Configure 頁。
CVU_SimpleAppearanceRefreshSkinBorders(kind,displayName,nativeName)
end
end


function CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetRandomPriorityPools(kind)
kind=kind=="glove"and"glove"or"knife"
local pools={Special={},Red={},Other={}}
for _,entry in ipairs(CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetModels(kind))do
local display=tostring(entry.Display)
local native=tostring(entry.Native)
for _,skinName in ipairs(CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetSkins(kind,native))do
local rarity=select(1,CVU_ModernSkinGetRarity(native,skinName))
local pack={Display=display,Native=native,Skin=skinName,Rarity=rarity}
if rarity=="Special"then
table.insert(pools.Special,pack)
elseif rarity=="Red"then
table.insert(pools.Red,pack)
else
table.insert(pools.Other,pack)
end
end
end
return pools
end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceApplyRandomPriority(kind)
kind=kind=="glove"and"glove"or"knife"
local pools=CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetRandomPriorityPools(kind)
local source=#pools.Special>0 and pools.Special or (#pools.Red>0 and pools.Red or pools.Other)
if #source==0 then return end
local pick=source[math.random(1,#source)]
local state=CVU_SimpleAppearanceState(kind)
state.Page="skins"
state.Model=pick.Native
state.Display=pick.Display
state.Skin=pick.Skin
Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchText=""
if Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchBox then Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchBox.Text="" end
CVU_SimpleAppearanceSelectSkin(kind,pick.Display,pick.Native,pick.Skin)
end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetKnifeAnimationOptions()
-- Animation source choices must not depend on which knife cards happened to be
-- discovered/rendered.  Use the canonical mapping directly so every action row always
-- has the full source list.
local values={"跟隨刀型"}
local seen={["跟隨刀型"]=true}
local ordered={"蝴蝶刀","爪刀","M9刺刀","折疊刀","剖腹刀","細劍","骷髏刀","光劍"}
for _,display in ipairs(ordered)do
local native=Runtime.BloxStrikeKnifeNames and Runtime.BloxStrikeKnifeNames[display]or nil
if native and not seen[display]then
seen[display]=true
values[#values+1]=display
end
end
return values
end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceRefreshKnifePreview(holder,nativeName,skinName,cfg,delaySeconds)
if not holder or not holder.Parent then return end
Runtime.SimpleAppearanceKnifePreviewSerial=(Runtime.SimpleAppearanceKnifePreviewSerial or 0)+1
local serial=Runtime.SimpleAppearanceKnifePreviewSerial
task.delay(math.max(tonumber(delaySeconds)or 0,0),function()
if Runtime.Shutdown or serial~=Runtime.SimpleAppearanceKnifePreviewSerial then return end
if not holder or not holder.Parent then return end
for _,child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("ViewportFrame")or child.Name=="StaticSkinThumb"then child:Destroy()end
end
pcall(CVU_ModernSkinAttachViewport,holder,function()
return CVU_SkinPreviewBuildSource("knife",nativeName,skinName,cfg)
end)
end)
end

local function setKnifeActionSource(field,reason,delta)

refreshActionSummary()

end

function CVU_SimpleAppearanceRender()
if not Runtime.SimpleAppearanceRoot or not Runtime.SimpleAppearanceRoot.Parent then return end
CVU_SimpleAppearanceClear()
local kind=Runtime.SimpleAppearanceKind=="glove"and"glove"or"knife"
local state=CVU_SimpleAppearanceState(kind)
local query=string.lower(tostring(Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchText or""))
local content=Runtime.SimpleAppearanceContent

if kind=="knife"and state.Page=="config"and state.Model then
CVU_SimpleAppearanceRenderKnifeConfig(state)
return
end

Runtime.SimpleAppearanceSearchBox.Visible=true
CVU_SimpleAppearanceGrid()
if state.Page=="skins"and state.Model then
Runtime.SimpleAppearanceBackButton.Visible=true
Runtime.SimpleAppearanceBreadcrumb.Text="Inventory  ›  "..(kind=="glove"and"手套"or"刀具").."  ›  "..tostring(state.Display or state.Model)
local order=0
for _,skinName in ipairs(CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetSkins(kind,state.Model))do
if query==""or string.find(string.lower(skinName),query,1,true)then
order+=1
local selectedSkin=skinName
local displayName=tostring(state.Display or state.Model)
local nativeName=tostring(state.Model)
local card,stroke=CVU_ModernSkinCard(content,selectedSkin,function()
CVU_SimpleAppearanceSelectSkin(kind,displayName,nativeName,selectedSkin)
end)
card:SetAttribute("CVU_AppearanceSkinCard",true)
card:SetAttribute("CVU_AppearanceKind",kind)
card:SetAttribute("CVU_AppearanceDisplay",displayName)
card:SetAttribute("CVU_AppearanceNative",nativeName)
card:SetAttribute("CVU_SkinName",selectedSkin)
card.LayoutOrder=order
CVU_ModernSkinApplyRarity(card,nativeName,selectedSkin)
local pending=false
local applied=false

if kind=="glove"then
local isCurrentType=tostring(Settings.GloveExperience or"")==tostring(nativeName)
pending=isCurrentType
and tostring(Settings.GloveExperienceSkin or"")~=""
and tostring(Settings.GloveExperienceSkin or"")==selectedSkin

applied=pending
and Runtime.GloveExperienceAppliedEnabled==true
and Runtime.GloveExperienceAppliedModel==nativeName
and Runtime.GloveExperienceAppliedSkin==selectedSkin
else
local isCurrentType=tostring(Settings.KnifeExperience or"")==tostring(displayName)
pending=isCurrentType
and tostring(Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin or"")~=""
and tostring(Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin or"")==selectedSkin

applied=pending
and Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled==true
and Runtime.KnifeExperienceAppliedType==displayName
and Runtime.KnifeExperienceAppliedSkin==selectedSkin
end

if applied then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardApplied(stroke)
elseif pending then
CVU_ModernSkinMarkCardPending(stroke)
end
CVU_SimpleAppearanceAttachThumb(card,kind,nativeName,selectedSkin)
end
end
return
end

state.Page="models"
state.Skin=nil
Runtime.SimpleAppearanceBackButton.Visible=false
Runtime.SimpleAppearanceBreadcrumb.Text="Inventory  ›  "..(kind=="glove"and"手套"or"刀具")
local order=0
for _,entry in ipairs(CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetModels(kind))do
local label=tostring(entry.Display)
if query==""or string.find(string.lower(label),query,1,true)or string.find(string.lower(tostring(entry.Native)),query,1,true)then
order+=1
local selectedDisplay=entry.Display
local selectedNative=entry.Native
local card,stroke=CVU_ModernSkinCard(content,selectedDisplay,function()
CVU_SimpleAppearanceSelectModel(kind,selectedDisplay,selectedNative)
end)
card.LayoutOrder=order

-- MODEL chooser is navigation only.
-- Do not paint Stock rarity here (Stock is near-white and can read like a selected frame),
-- and never apply pending/applied white borders.  Keep only the normal neutral card stroke.
if stroke then
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(70,79,92)
stroke.Transparency=.10
stroke.Thickness=1.10
end
card:SetAttribute("CVU_ModelChooser",true)

local modelThumbSkin=CVU_SimpleAppearanceGetModelThumbSkin(kind,selectedNative)
CVU_SimpleAppearanceAttachThumb(card,kind,selectedNative,modelThumbSkin)
end
end
end

local originals=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function isPreserved(obj)
local p=obj
while p and p~=Main do
if p:GetAttribute("CVU_ThemePreview")or p:GetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor")then return true end
if p.Name=="ToggleTrack"then return true end
if p.Name=="Swatch"or p.Name=="FullColorPalette"or p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")then return true end
p=p.Parent
end
return false
end
local function themeObject(obj)
if isPreserved(obj)then return end
local light=Settings.UIStyle=="light"
if obj:IsA("GuiObject")then
if not originals[obj]then originals[obj]=obj.BackgroundColor3 end
local original=originals[obj]
local max=math.max(original.R,original.G,original.B)local min=math.min(original.R,original.G,original.B)
if obj:GetAttribute("CVU_Accent")then obj.BackgroundColor3=Settings.UIAccent
elseif max-min<.12 and obj.BackgroundTransparency<1 then
obj.BackgroundColor3=light and Color3.fromRGB(242,245,253)or Color3.fromRGB(18,30,40)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomCrosshairLockSpeed(px)
 px=math.max(0,tonumber(px)or 0)
 local nearScale=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomLockSpeedNear)or 1.00,.60,1.60)
 local midScale=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomLockSpeedMid)or 1.00,.60,1.60)
 local farScale=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomLockSpeedFar)or 1.00,.60,1.60)
 if px<=60 then return nearScale,"準心最近" end
 if px<120 then
  local a=math.clamp((px-60)/60,0,1)
  a=a*a*(3-2*a)
  return nearScale+(midScale-nearScale)*a,"近→中"
 end
 if px<=220 then return midScale,"準心中距離" end
 if px<320 then
  local a=math.clamp((px-220)/100,0,1)
  a=a*a*(3-2*a)
  return midScale+(farScale-midScale)*a,"中→遠"
 end
 return farScale,"準心最遠"
end

local source=[========[
--[[
RIVALS Cosmetics Unlock - Standalone V3
Persistent native cosmetic experience.

Changes from V2:
  1) ONE master button unlocks:
       - Skin
       - Wrap
       - Charm
       - Finisher / kill animation
  2) Per-player autosave:
       weapon -> Skin / Wrap / Charm / Finisher selections
  3) Saved selections are rebuilt from the CURRENT CosmeticLibrary on next run.
  4) Closing the UI only hides the UI.
       The unlock hooks and saved overrides KEEP RUNNING in the background.
  5) Re-running V3 in the same session simply re-opens the existing UI.
       It does NOT tear down/reinstall the hooks.
  6) "STOP BACKGROUND" is the only UI action that actually restores original functions.

Base weapon ownership is NEVER unlocked by this script.
No purchase remote / permanent server ownership is written.
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
if not LocalPlayer then
    warn("[RIVALS Cosmetics V3] LocalPlayer missing")
    return
end

local G = getgenv and getgenv() or _G

-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Singleton behavior:
-- if V3 is already alive in this Roblox session, running the file again only
-- re-opens the hidden UI. This is important because closing the UI should NOT
-- turn off the unlocker.
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------

local existingV3 = G.RIVALS_CosmeticsUnlock_V3_State

local PlayerScripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 15)
local Controllers = PlayerScripts and PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
local Modules = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")

if not Controllers or not Modules then
    warn("[RIVALS Cosmetics V3] RIVALS modules/controllers not found")
    return
end

local function safeRequire(obj)
    if not obj then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(require, obj)
    if ok then return value end
    return nil
end

local CosmeticLibrary = safeRequire(Modules:FindFirstChild("CosmeticLibrary"))
local PlayerDataUtility = safeRequire(Modules:FindFirstChild("PlayerDataUtility"))
local ReplicatedClass = safeRequire(Modules:FindFirstChild("ReplicatedClass"))
local PlayerDataController = safeRequire(Controllers:FindFirstChild("PlayerDataController"))

if type(CosmeticLibrary) ~= "table" or type(CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics) ~= "table" then
    warn("[RIVALS Cosmetics V3] CosmeticLibrary unavailable")
    return
end

if type(PlayerDataController) ~= "table" then
    warn("[RIVALS Cosmetics V3] PlayerDataController unavailable")
    return
end

-- Remove old standalone test generations once.
-- Before restoring them, capture their CURRENT local selections so upgrading
-- from V2 -> V3 does not throw away the cosmetics the player already picked.
local MigratedRuntimeSelections = {}

local function captureLegacyOverrides(legacyState)
    if type(legacyState) ~= "table" or type(legacyState.Overrides) ~= "table" then
        return
    end

    for weaponName, ov in pairs(legacyState.Overrides) do
        if type(weaponName) == "string" and type(ov) == "table" then
            local row = MigratedRuntimeSelections[weaponName] or {}

            for _, ct in ipairs({"Skin", "Wrap", "Charm", "Finisher"}) do
                local cosmetic = ov[ct]
                if type(cosmetic) == "table" and type(cosmetic.Name) == "string" then
                    row[ct] = {
                        Name = cosmetic.Name,
                        IsInverted = cosmetic.IsInverted ~= nil
                            and cosmetic.IsInverted == true
                            or (cosmetic.Inverted ~= nil and cosmetic.Inverted == true or nil),
                        OnlyUseFavorites = cosmetic.OnlyUseFavorites ~= nil
                            and cosmetic.OnlyUseFavorites == true
                            or nil,
                    }
                end
            end

            if next(row) ~= nil then
                MigratedRuntimeSelections[weaponName] = row
            end
        end
    end
end

captureLegacyOverrides(existingV3)
if existingV3 and type(existingV3.Restore) == "function" then
    pcall(existingV3.Restore)
end

local oldV2 = G.RIVALS_CosmeticsUnlock_TestState
captureLegacyOverrides(oldV2)
if oldV2 and type(oldV2.Restore) == "function" then
    pcall(oldV2.Restore)
end

local oldSkin = G.RIVALS_SkinUnlock_TestState
captureLegacyOverrides(oldSkin)
if oldSkin and type(oldSkin.Restore) == "function" then
    pcall(oldSkin.Restore)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- PERSISTENCE
-- ============================================================================

local FILE_IO_AVAILABLE =
    type(writefile) == "function"
    and type(readfile) == "function"

local CONFIG_FOLDER = "ChickenVisualUI"
local CONFIG_BASENAME =
    ("RIVALS_CosmeticsUnlock_%s.json"):format(tostring(LocalPlayer.UserId))

local CONFIG_PATH = CONFIG_BASENAME

if FILE_IO_AVAILABLE and type(makefolder) == "function" then
    local canUseFolder = true

    if type(isfolder) == "function" then
        local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, CONFIG_FOLDER)
        if not ok or not exists then
            local made = pcall(makefolder, CONFIG_FOLDER)
            canUseFolder = made
        end
    else
        -- makefolder normally errors if it already exists, which is harmless.
        pcall(makefolder, CONFIG_FOLDER)
    end

    if canUseFolder then
        CONFIG_PATH = CONFIG_FOLDER .. "/" .. CONFIG_BASENAME
    end
end

local State = {
    Restored = false,
    MasterUnlock = true,

    -- V2's finisher replacement was explicitly experimental.
    -- The user has now tested the feature successfully, so in V3 the master
    -- unlock also controls local finisher playback.
    ForceFinisherPlayback = true,

    -- Runtime cosmetic tables rebuilt from CURRENT CosmeticLibrary:
    -- Overrides[weaponName][Skin/Wrap/Charm/Finisher] = cosmeticTable
    Overrides = {},

    -- Primitive save metadata:
    -- SavedSelections[weaponName][type] = {Name=..., IsInverted=..., ...}
    SavedSelections = {},

    LastSelectedWeapon = nil,
    LastFinisherWeapon = nil,

    Counts = {
        Skin = 0,
        Wrap = 0,
        Charm = 0,
        Finisher = 0,
    },

    SaveSupported = FILE_IO_AVAILABLE,
    ConfigPath = CONFIG_PATH,
    SaveQueued = 0,
    SaveError = nil,
    LoadedFromDisk = false,

    OrigOwnsCosmetic = CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmetic,
    OrigOwnsCosmeticForWeapon = CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticForWeapon,
    OrigOwnsCosmeticForSomething = CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticForSomething,
    OrigOwnsCosmeticNormally = CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticNormally,
    OrigOwnsCosmeticUniversally = CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticUniversally,

    OrigPDCGetWeaponData = PlayerDataController.GetWeaponData,
    OrigPDUGetWeaponData = nil,

    OrigReplicatedGet = ReplicatedClass and ReplicatedClass.Get or nil,
    OrigNamecall = nil,

    ClientEntity = nil,
    OrigPlayFinisher = nil,
    FinisherHookInstalled = false,

    Gui = nil,
    UIVisible = false,
}

G.RIVALS_CosmeticsUnlock_V3_State = State

local function canonicalType(raw)
    if raw == "Skin" then return "Skin" end
    if raw == "Wrap" or raw == "Wrapping" then return "Wrap" end
    if raw == "Charm" then return "Charm" end
    if raw == "Finisher" or raw == "Execution" then return "Finisher" end
    return nil
end

local function typeEnabled(ct)
    return State.MasterUnlock == true
        and (ct == "Skin" or ct == "Wrap" or ct == "Charm" or ct == "Finisher")
end

local function resolveCosmeticName(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end

    if CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[name] then
        return name
    end

    local renamed = CosmeticLibrary.RENAMED_COSMETICS
    if type(renamed) == "table" and renamed[name] and CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[renamed[name]] then
        return renamed[name]
    end

    -- Small durability fallback for capitalization changes.
    local lower = string.lower(name)
    for currentName in pairs(CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics) do
        if type(currentName) == "string" and string.lower(currentName) == lower then
            return currentName
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function cosmeticInfo(name)
    local resolved = resolveCosmeticName(name)
    if not resolved then return nil, nil, nil end

    local info = CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics[resolved]
    if type(info) ~= "table" then return nil, nil, nil end

    return info, canonicalType(info.Type), resolved
end

local function shouldUnlock(name)
    local _, ct = cosmeticInfo(name)
    return ct ~= nil and typeEnabled(ct)
end

local function shallowCopy(src)
    local out = {}
    if type(src) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(src) do
            out[k] = v
        end
    end
    return out
end

local function cloneCosmetic(name, expectedType, options)
    local info, ct, resolvedName = cosmeticInfo(name)
    if not info or not ct then return nil end
    if expectedType and ct ~= expectedType then return nil end

    local copy = shallowCopy(info)
    copy.Name = copy.Name or resolvedName

    if options then
        if options.IsInverted ~= nil then
            copy.Inverted = options.IsInverted
            copy.IsInverted = options.IsInverted
        end
        if options.OnlyUseFavorites ~= nil then
            copy.OnlyUseFavorites = options.OnlyUseFavorites
        end
    end

    return copy
end

for _, info in pairs(CosmeticLibrary.Cosmetics) do
    if type(info) == "table" then
        local ct = canonicalType(info.Type)
        if ct then
            State.Counts[ct] += 1
        end
    end
end

local function primitiveSelectionFromCosmetic(cosmetic)
    if type(cosmetic) ~= "table" or type(cosmetic.Name) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end

    local data = {
        Name = cosmetic.Name,
    }

    if cosmetic.IsInverted ~= nil then
        data.IsInverted = cosmetic.IsInverted == true
    elseif cosmetic.Inverted ~= nil then
        data.IsInverted = cosmetic.Inverted == true
    end

    if cosmetic.OnlyUseFavorites ~= nil then
        data.OnlyUseFavorites = cosmetic.OnlyUseFavorites == true
    end

    return data
end

local function buildConfigTable()
    local selections = {}

    for weaponName, ov in pairs(State.Overrides) do
        if type(weaponName) == "string" and type(ov) == "table" then
            local row = {}

            for _, ct in ipairs({"Skin", "Wrap", "Charm", "Finisher"}) do
                local primitive = primitiveSelectionFromCosmetic(ov[ct])
                if primitive then
                    row[ct] = primitive
                end
            end

            if next(row) ~= nil then
                selections[weaponName] = row
            end
        end
    end

    return {
        Version = 3,
        MasterUnlock = State.MasterUnlock == true,
        ForceFinisherPlayback = State.ForceFinisherPlayback == true,
        LastSelectedWeapon = State.LastSelectedWeapon,
        LastFinisherWeapon = State.LastFinisherWeapon,
        Selections = selections,
    }
end

local function saveConfigNow()
    if not FILE_IO_AVAILABLE then
        return false
    end

    local okEncode, encoded = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, buildConfigTable())
    if not okEncode then
        State.SaveError = tostring(encoded)
        return false
    end

    local okWrite, err = pcall(writefile, CONFIG_PATH, encoded)
    if not okWrite then
        -- Folder path may not be available in a limited executor. Retry flat.
        if CONFIG_PATH ~= CONFIG_BASENAME then
            CONFIG_PATH = CONFIG_BASENAME
            State.ConfigPath = CONFIG_PATH
            okWrite, err = pcall(writefile, CONFIG_PATH, encoded)
        end
    end

    if not okWrite then
        State.SaveError = tostring(err)
        return false
    end

    State.SaveError = nil
    return true
end

local function queueSave()
    if not FILE_IO_AVAILABLE then return end

    State.SaveQueued += 1
    local ticket = State.SaveQueued

    task.delay(0.12, function()
        if State.Restored then return end
        if ticket ~= State.SaveQueued then return end
        saveConfigNow()
    end)
end

local function readSavedConfig()
    if not FILE_IO_AVAILABLE then return nil end

    local okRead, content = pcall(readfile, CONFIG_PATH)
    if not okRead and CONFIG_PATH ~= CONFIG_BASENAME then
        local okFlat, flatContent = pcall(readfile, CONFIG_BASENAME)
        if okFlat then
            CONFIG_PATH = CONFIG_BASENAME
            State.ConfigPath = CONFIG_PATH
            content = flatContent
            okRead = true
        end
    end

    if not okRead or type(content) ~= "string" or content == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local okDecode, decoded = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, content)
    if not okDecode or type(decoded) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end

    return decoded
end

local function ensureWeaponOverride(weaponName)
    if type(weaponName) ~= "string" or weaponName == "" then return nil end
    State.Overrides[weaponName] = State.Overrides[weaponName] or {}
    return State.Overrides[weaponName]
end

local function cleanWeaponOverride(weaponName)
    local ov = State.Overrides[weaponName]
    if ov and next(ov) == nil then
        State.Overrides[weaponName] = nil
    end
end

local function setOverride(weaponName, ct, cosmeticName, options, suppressSave)
    if type(weaponName) ~= "string" or weaponName == "" or not ct then
        return false
    end

    local ov = ensureWeaponOverride(weaponName)
    if not ov then return false end

    if cosmeticName == nil or cosmeticName == "" or cosmeticName == "None"
        or cosmeticName == "NONE" or cosmeticName == "RANDOM_COSMETIC" then

        ov[ct] = nil
        cleanWeaponOverride(weaponName)

        if not suppressSave then queueSave() end
        return true
    end

    local cloned = cloneCosmetic(cosmeticName, ct, options)
    if not cloned then
        return false
    end

    -- Skin must belong to the currently selected base weapon.
    if ct == "Skin" and cloned.ItemName and cloned.ItemName ~= weaponName then
        return false
    end

    ov[ct] = cloned
    State.LastSelectedWeapon = weaponName

    if ct == "Finisher" then
        State.LastFinisherWeapon = weaponName
    end

    if not suppressSave then
        queueSave()
    end

    return true
end

local function loadSelectionsFromDisk()
    local cfg = readSavedConfig()
    if not cfg then return false end

    if cfg.MasterUnlock ~= nil then
        State.MasterUnlock = cfg.MasterUnlock == true
    end

    if cfg.ForceFinisherPlayback ~= nil then
        State.ForceFinisherPlayback = cfg.ForceFinisherPlayback == true
    end

    if type(cfg.LastSelectedWeapon) == "string" then
        State.LastSelectedWeapon = cfg.LastSelectedWeapon
    end

    if type(cfg.LastFinisherWeapon) == "string" then
        State.LastFinisherWeapon = cfg.LastFinisherWeapon
    end

    local selections = cfg.Selections
    if type(selections) == "table" then
        for weaponName, row in pairs(selections) do
            if type(weaponName) == "string" and type(row) == "table" then
                for _, ct in ipairs({"Skin", "Wrap", "Charm", "Finisher"}) do
                    local saved = row[ct]

                    if type(saved) == "string" then
                        -- V2/early compatibility.
                        setOverride(weaponName, ct, saved, {}, true)

                    elseif type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.Name) == "string" then
                        setOverride(
                            weaponName,
                            ct,
                            saved.Name,
                            {
                                IsInverted = saved.IsInverted,
                                OnlyUseFavorites = saved.OnlyUseFavorites,
                            },
                            true
                        )
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    State.LoadedFromDisk = true
    return true
end

-- Load saved choices BEFORE installing the new hooks.
loadSelectionsFromDisk()

-- Current V2 runtime choices are newer than the disk config, so let them win.
-- This makes upgrading to V3 seamless in the same Roblox session.
local migratedAny = false
for weaponName, row in pairs(MigratedRuntimeSelections) do
    if type(row) == "table" then
        for _, ct in ipairs({"Skin", "Wrap", "Charm", "Finisher"}) do
            local saved = row[ct]
            if type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.Name) == "string" then
                if setOverride(
                    weaponName,
                    ct,
                    saved.Name,
                    {
                        IsInverted = saved.IsInverted,
                        OnlyUseFavorites = saved.OnlyUseFavorites,
                    },
                    true
                ) then
                    migratedAny = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

if migratedAny then
    State.LoadedFromDisk = true
end

-- ============================================================================
-- LOCAL REFRESH + WEAPON DATA
-- ============================================================================

local refreshing = false

local function fireLocalRefresh()
    if refreshing then return end
    refreshing = true

    pcall(function()
        local sig = PlayerDataController:GetDataChangedSignal("WeaponInventory")
        if sig and type(sig.Fire) == "function" then sig:Fire() end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local sig = PlayerDataController:GetDataChangedSignal("CosmeticInventory")
        if sig and type(sig.Fire) == "function" then sig:Fire() end
    end)

    refreshing = false
end

local function applyOverridesToWeaponData(weaponName, data)
    if type(data) ~= "table" or type(weaponName) ~= "string" then
        return data
    end

    if not State.MasterUnlock then
        return data
    end

    local ov = State.Overrides[weaponName]
    if not ov then return data end

    local copy = shallowCopy(data)

    if ov.Skin then copy.Skin = ov.Skin end
    if ov.Wrap then copy.Wrap = ov.Wrap end
    if ov.Charm then copy.Charm = ov.Charm end
    if ov.Finisher then copy.Finisher = ov.Finisher end

    return copy
end

-- ============================================================================
-- OWNERSHIP GATES: ONE MASTER STATE FOR SKIN / WRAP / CHARM / FINISHER
-- ============================================================================

if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmetic) == "function" then
    CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmetic = function(self, inventory, name, weapon, ...)
        if shouldUnlock(name) then return true end
        return State.OrigOwnsCosmetic(self, inventory, name, weapon, ...)
    end
end

if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmeticForWeapon) == "function" then
    CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticForWeapon = function(self, inventory, name, weapon, ...)
        if shouldUnlock(name) then return true end
        return State.OrigOwnsCosmeticForWeapon(self, inventory, name, weapon, ...)
    end
end

if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmeticForSomething) == "function" then
    CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticForSomething = function(self, inventory, name, ...)
        if shouldUnlock(name) then return true end
        return State.OrigOwnsCosmeticForSomething(self, inventory, name, ...)
    end
end

if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmeticNormally) == "function" then
    CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticNormally = function(self, inventory, name, weapon, ...)
        if shouldUnlock(name) then return true end
        return State.OrigOwnsCosmeticNormally(self, inventory, name, weapon, ...)
    end
end

if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmeticUniversally) == "function" then
    CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticUniversally = function(self, inventory, name, weapon, ...)
        if shouldUnlock(name) then return true end
        return State.OrigOwnsCosmeticUniversally(self, inventory, name, weapon, ...)
    end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- WEAPON DATA OVERRIDES
-- ============================================================================

if type(State.OrigPDCGetWeaponData) == "function" then
    PlayerDataController.GetWeaponData = function(self, weaponName, ...)
        local data = State.OrigPDCGetWeaponData(self, weaponName, ...)
        return applyOverridesToWeaponData(weaponName, data)
    end
end

if type(PlayerDataUtility) == "table" then
    local mt = getmetatable(PlayerDataUtility)

    if mt and type(mt.GetWeaponData) == "function" then
        State.OrigPDUGetWeaponData = mt.GetWeaponData

        mt.GetWeaponData = function(self, dataSource, weaponName, ...)
            local data, index =
                State.OrigPDUGetWeaponData(self, dataSource, weaponName, ...)

            return applyOverridesToWeaponData(weaponName, data), index
        end
    end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- NATIVE VIEWMODEL PATHS
--
-- Skin  -> Name
-- Wrap  -> Wrap -> game's own _UpdateWrap / WrapController
-- Charm -> Charm -> game's own Charm module
-- ============================================================================

local function isLocalViewModelObject(o)
    if type(o) ~= "table" then return false end

    local ci = rawget(o, "ClientItem")
    if type(ci) ~= "table" then return false end

    local cf = rawget(ci, "ClientFighter")
    if type(cf) ~= "table" then return false end

    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        if cf.IsLocalPlayer ~= nil then
            return cf.IsLocalPlayer == true
        end
        if cf.Player ~= nil then
            return cf.Player == LocalPlayer
        end
        return false
    end)

    return ok and result == true
end

local function baseWeaponFromViewModelObject(o, fallbackName)
    local ci = rawget(o, "ClientItem")
    if type(ci) == "table" and type(ci.Name) == "string" then
        return ci.Name
    end
    return fallbackName
end

if ReplicatedClass and type(State.OrigReplicatedGet) == "function" then
    ReplicatedClass.Get = function(o, key, ...)
        local value = State.OrigReplicatedGet(o, key, ...)

        if not State.MasterUnlock or not isLocalViewModelObject(o) then
            return value
        end

        local baseWeapon = baseWeaponFromViewModelObject(o, value)
        local ov =
            type(baseWeapon) == "string"
            and State.Overrides[baseWeapon]
            or nil

        if not ov then return value end

        if key == "Name" and ov.Skin then
            return ov.Skin.Name or value
        end

        if key == "Wrap" and ov.Wrap then
            return ov.Wrap
        end

        if key == "Charm" and ov.Charm then
            return ov.Charm
        end

        return value
    end
end

-- ============================================================================
-- NATIVE RIVALS COSMETIC CLICKS
-- ============================================================================

local Remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
local DataRemotes = Remotes and Remotes:FindFirstChild("Data")
local EquipCosmeticRemote =
    DataRemotes and DataRemotes:FindFirstChild("EquipCosmetic")
local EquipFinisherRemote =
    DataRemotes and DataRemotes:FindFirstChild("EquipFinisher")

local canHookNamecall =
    type(hookmetamethod) == "function"
    and type(getnamecallmethod) == "function"

if canHookNamecall and (EquipCosmeticRemote or EquipFinisherRemote) then
    State.OrigNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()

        if State.MasterUnlock and method == "FireServer" then
            local args = {...}

            if EquipCosmeticRemote and self == EquipCosmeticRemote then
                local weaponName = args[1]
                local rawType = args[2]
                local cosmeticName = args[3]
                local options =
                    type(args[4]) == "table"
                    and args[4]
                    or {}

                local ct = canonicalType(rawType)

                if ct and typeEnabled(ct) then
                    local ok =
                        setOverride(
                            weaponName,
                            ct,
                            cosmeticName,
                            options,
                            false
                        )

                    if ok then
                        fireLocalRefresh()
                        return
                    end
                end
            end

            if EquipFinisherRemote
                and self == EquipFinisherRemote
                and typeEnabled("Finisher") then

                local weaponName = args[1]
                local finisherName = args[2]

                local ok =
                    setOverride(
                        weaponName,
                        "Finisher",
                        finisherName,
                        {},
                        false
                    )

                if ok then
                    fireLocalRefresh()
                    return
                end
            end
        end

        return State.OrigNamecall(self, ...)
    end)
end

-- ============================================================================
-- FINISHER / KILL ANIMATION
-- ============================================================================

local function selectedFinisherName()
    local weaponName =
        State.LastFinisherWeapon
        or State.LastSelectedWeapon

    if weaponName then
        local ov = State.Overrides[weaponName]
        if ov and ov.Finisher and ov.Finisher.Name then
            return ov.Finisher.Name
        end
    end

    for _, ov in pairs(State.Overrides) do
        if ov.Finisher and ov.Finisher.Name then
            return ov.Finisher.Name
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function installFinisherHook()
    if State.FinisherHookInstalled then return true end

    local clientEntityModule =
        PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Modules")
        and PlayerScripts.Modules:FindFirstChild("ClientReplicatedClasses")
        and PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses:FindFirstChild("ClientEntity")

    local ClientEntity = safeRequire(clientEntityModule)

    if type(ClientEntity) ~= "table"
        or type(ClientEntity._PlayFinisher) ~= "function" then
        return false
    end

    State.ClientEntity = ClientEntity
    State.OrigPlayFinisher = ClientEntity._PlayFinisher

    ClientEntity._PlayFinisher =
        function(self, finisherName, isFinal, eliminator, serial)

            if State.MasterUnlock and State.ForceFinisherPlayback then
                local ourKill = false

                if eliminator == LocalPlayer then
                    ourKill = true

                elseif type(eliminator) == "string" then
                    ourKill =
                        string.lower(eliminator)
                        == string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name)
                end

                if ourKill then
                    local override = selectedFinisherName()

                    if override then
                        local finishersFolder =
                            Modules:FindFirstChild("Finishers")

                        if not finishersFolder
                            or finishersFolder:FindFirstChild(override) then
                            finisherName = override
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            return State.OrigPlayFinisher(
                self,
                finisherName,
                isFinal,
                eliminator,
                serial
            )
        end

    State.FinisherHookInstalled = true
    return true
end

local function uninstallFinisherHook()
    if State.FinisherHookInstalled
        and State.ClientEntity
        and type(State.OrigPlayFinisher) == "function" then

        State.ClientEntity._PlayFinisher =
            State.OrigPlayFinisher
    end

    State.FinisherHookInstalled = false
    State.ClientEntity = nil
    State.OrigPlayFinisher = nil
end

if State.MasterUnlock and State.ForceFinisherPlayback then
    installFinisherHook()
end

-- ============================================================================
-- STOP / RESTORE
-- ============================================================================

function State.Restore()
    if State.Restored then return end

    -- Preserve the current choices before shutting down the runtime.
    saveConfigNow()

    State.Restored = true
    State.MasterUnlock = false

    uninstallFinisherHook()

    if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmetic) == "function" then
        CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmetic =
            State.OrigOwnsCosmetic
    end

    if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmeticForWeapon) == "function" then
        CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticForWeapon =
            State.OrigOwnsCosmeticForWeapon
    end

    if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmeticForSomething) == "function" then
        CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticForSomething =
            State.OrigOwnsCosmeticForSomething
    end

    if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmeticNormally) == "function" then
        CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticNormally =
            State.OrigOwnsCosmeticNormally
    end

    if type(State.OrigOwnsCosmeticUniversally) == "function" then
        CosmeticLibrary.OwnsCosmeticUniversally =
            State.OrigOwnsCosmeticUniversally
    end

    if type(State.OrigPDCGetWeaponData) == "function" then
        PlayerDataController.GetWeaponData =
            State.OrigPDCGetWeaponData
    end

    if type(State.OrigPDUGetWeaponData) == "function"
        and type(PlayerDataUtility) == "table" then

        local mt = getmetatable(PlayerDataUtility)
        if mt then
            mt.GetWeaponData =
                State.OrigPDUGetWeaponData
        end
    end

    if ReplicatedClass
        and type(State.OrigReplicatedGet) == "function" then
        ReplicatedClass.Get =
            State.OrigReplicatedGet
    end

    if State.OrigNamecall
        and type(hookmetamethod) == "function" then

        pcall(function()
            hookmetamethod(
                game,
                "__namecall",
                State.OrigNamecall
            )
        end)
    end

    fireLocalRefresh()

    if State.Gui then
        pcall(function()
            State.Gui:Destroy()
        end)
        State.Gui = nil
    end

    if G.RIVALS_CosmeticsUnlock_V3_State == State then
        G.RIVALS_CosmeticsUnlock_V3_State = nil
    end
end

local function clearSavedChoices()
    State.Overrides = {}
    State.LastSelectedWeapon = nil
    State.LastFinisherWeapon = nil

    queueSave()
    fireLocalRefresh()
end



-- Embedded-provider API used by ChickenVisualUI RIVALS Edition.
function State.SetMasterEnabled(value)
    if State.Restored then return false end
    State.MasterUnlock = value == true
    if State.MasterUnlock then
        State.ForceFinisherPlayback = true
        installFinisherHook()
    else
        uninstallFinisherHook()
    end
    queueSave()
    fireLocalRefresh()
    return State.MasterUnlock
end

function State.RefreshNative()
    if State.Restored then return false end
    fireLocalRefresh()
    return true
end

function State.ClearSavedChoices()
    if State.Restored then return false end
    clearSavedChoices()
    return true
end

function State.SaveNow()
    if State.Restored then return false end
    return saveConfigNow()
end

function State.GetSummary()
    local weapons, cosmetics = 0, 0
    for _, ov in pairs(State.Overrides or {}) do
        weapons += 1
        if type(ov) == "table" then
            for _ in pairs(ov) do cosmetics += 1 end
        end
    end
    return {
        MasterUnlock = State.MasterUnlock == true,
        ForceFinisherPlayback = State.ForceFinisherPlayback == true,
        Counts = State.Counts,
        WeaponCount = weapons,
        CosmeticCount = cosmetics,
        SaveSupported = State.SaveSupported == true,
        LoadedFromDisk = State.LoadedFromDisk == true,
        SaveError = State.SaveError,
        ConfigPath = State.ConfigPath,
        FinisherHookInstalled = State.FinisherHookInstalled == true,
    }
end

-- The standalone UI used to do these at the bottom. Keep the behavior in backend mode.
fireLocalRefresh()
if State.SaveSupported then
    task.defer(function()
        if not State.Restored then saveConfigNow() end
    end)
end

return State

]========]
local compileOk,chunk=pcall(loadstring,source)
if compileOk and type(chunk)=="function"then
local runOk,state=pcall(chunk)
if runOk and type(state)=="table"then
Runtime.RivalsCosmeticsState=state
else
warn("[ChickenVisualUI RIVALS] Cosmetics backend failed:",state)
end
else
warn("[ChickenVisualUI RIVALS] Cosmetics backend compile failed:",chunk)
end
end

function CVU_RefreshCustomCrosshair()
local root=Runtime.CustomCrosshairRoot
if not root or not root.Parent then return end

-- 準心使用連續浮點值；不要在渲染前取整數，
-- 否則 Slider 會被強制吸回一格一格的位置。
local size=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.CustomCrosshairSize)or 10,2,30)
local gap=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.CustomCrosshairGap)or 4,0,20)
local thick=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.CustomCrosshairThickness)or 2,1,8)
local color=typeof(Settings.CustomCrosshairColor)=="Color3"and Settings.CustomCrosshairColor or Color3.new(1,1,1)

root.Visible=Settings.CustomCrosshair==true

local left=Runtime.CustomCrosshairLeft
local right=Runtime.CustomCrosshairRight
local top=Runtime.CustomCrosshairTop
local bottom=Runtime.CustomCrosshairBottom

for _,arm in ipairs({left,right,top,bottom})do
if arm then arm.BackgroundColor3=color end
end

if left then
left.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,thick)
left.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(-(gap+size*.5),0)
end
if right then
right.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size,thick)
right.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(gap+size*.5,0)
end
if top then
top.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(thick,size)
top.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,-(gap+size*.5))
end
if bottom then
bottom.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(thick,size)
bottom.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,gap+size*.5)
end
end

-- ============================================================
-- ESP Preview：視覺設定即時預覽
-- 只建立 UI / ViewportFrame，不讀寫第三人稱 Camera，也不碰第三人稱函式。
-- Preview 掛在 DefaultPage 右側，因此切離預設/視覺頁面時會自動隱藏。
-- ============================================================
function CVU_ESPPreviewMakePart(parent,name,size,cf,color,shape)
local part=Instance.new("Part")
part.Name=name
part.Size=size
part.CFrame=cf
part.Anchored=true
part.CanCollide=false
part.CanTouch=false
part.CanQuery=false
part.CastShadow=false
part.Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
part.Color=color
if shape then part.Shape=shape end
part.Parent=parent
return part
end

function CVU_ESPPreviewDrawLine(line,a,b,color,thickness)
if not line or not line.Parent then return end
local delta=b-a
if delta.Magnitude<=0.1 then line.Visible=false return end
line.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
line.Position=UDim2.fromOffset((a.X+b.X)*0.5,(a.Y+b.Y)*0.5)
line.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(delta.Magnitude,thickness or 2)
line.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y,delta.X))
line.BackgroundColor3=color
line.Visible=true
end

function CVU_SetESPPreviewZoom(value)
Runtime.ESPPreviewZoom=math.clamp(tonumber(value)or 10.5,7.0,15.0)
local cam=Runtime.ESPPreviewCamera
if cam and cam.Parent then
cam.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0,2.0,Runtime.ESPPreviewZoom),Vector3.new(0,2.0,0))
end
end

local active=Settings.ESP==true

if Runtime.ESPPreviewStatus then

end

local boxVisible=active and Settings.ESPHighlight==true
for _,line in ipairs(Runtime.ESPPreviewBoxLines or{})do

line.BackgroundColor3=Settings.HighlightColor
end

if Runtime.ESPPreviewName then

end
if Runtime.ESPPreviewDistance then

end

local healthVisible=active and Settings.ESPHealth==true
if Runtime.ESPPreviewHealth then Runtime.ESPPreviewHealth.Visible=healthVisible end

if healthVisible and Runtime.ESPPreviewHealthFill then
local percent=.73
Runtime.ESPPreviewHealthFill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,percent)
Runtime.ESPPreviewHealthFill.BackgroundColor3=CVU_GetHealthColor and CVU_GetHealthColor(percent)or Color3.fromRGB(120,235,90)
end

local skeletonVisible=active and Settings.ESPSkeleton==true
local lines=Runtime.ESPPreviewSkeleton or{}
if skeletonVisible then
local c=Settings.SkeletonColor
local pairs={
{Vector2.new(153,89),Vector2.new(153,126)},
{Vector2.new(153,126),Vector2.new(153,205)},
{Vector2.new(153,143),Vector2.new(122,151)},
{Vector2.new(122,151),Vector2.new(105,197)},
{Vector2.new(105,197),Vector2.new(92,239)},
{Vector2.new(153,143),Vector2.new(184,151)},
{Vector2.new(184,151),Vector2.new(201,197)},
{Vector2.new(201,197),Vector2.new(214,239)},
{Vector2.new(153,205),Vector2.new(133,242)},
{Vector2.new(133,242),Vector2.new(126,291)},
{Vector2.new(126,291),Vector2.new(119,333)},
{Vector2.new(153,205),Vector2.new(173,242)},
{Vector2.new(173,242),Vector2.new(180,291)},
{Vector2.new(180,291),Vector2.new(187,333)},
}
for i,line in ipairs(lines)do
local pair=pairs[i]
if pair then CVU_ESPPreviewDrawLine(line,pair[1],pair[2],c,2)else line.Visible=false end
end
else
for _,line in ipairs(lines)do line.Visible=false end
end

if Runtime.ESPPreviewWeapon then
Runtime.ESPPreviewWeapon.Visible=active and Settings.EnemyWeaponESP==true
Runtime.ESPPreviewWeapon.Text=Settings.EnemyWeaponESP and "AK-47"or""
end
end

CVU_AddCycle(parent,name,getValue,values,setValue)local button=CVU_CreateButton(parent)local function refresh()button.Text=name.."   "..tostring(getValue())end refresh()button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()local current=getValue()local index=table.find(values,current)or 1 index+=1 if index>#values then index=1 end setValue(values[index])CVU_QueueSaveSettings()refresh()end)return button end function CVU_AddDropdown(parent,name,getValue,values,setValue)
local holder=Instance.new("Frame")
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,32)
holder.BackgroundTransparency=1
holder.BorderSizePixel=0
holder.ZIndex=200003
holder.Parent=parent

local main=CVU_CreateButton(holder)
main.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32)
main.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
main.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
main.AutoButtonColor=false

local options=Instance.new("Frame")
options.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,36)
options.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
options.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(31,31,37)
options.BorderSizePixel=0
options.ClipsDescendants=true
options.Visible=false
options.ZIndex=200004
options.Parent=holder
local oc=Instance.new("UICorner")
oc.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)
oc.Parent=options
local ol=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
ol.Padding=UDim.new(0,3)
ol.SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
ol.Parent=options
local op=Instance.new("UIPadding")
op.PaddingTop=UDim.new(0,4)
op.PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,4)
op.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,4)
op.PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,4)
op.Parent=options

local expanded=false
local optionButtons={}

-- 這兩個 callback 必須是每一個 Dropdown 自己的 local function。
-- 舊版使用全域 CVU_RefreshBulletSoundDropdown / CVU_SetBulletSoundDropdownExpanded，
-- 建立第二個「死亡音效樣式」Dropdown 時會覆蓋第一個「擊中音效樣式」的 callback，
-- 因此點擊擊中音效按鈕實際上會控制死亡音效 Dropdown。
local function refreshDropdown()
if not main.Parent then return end
main.Text="   "..name.."   "..tostring(getValue())..(expanded and "   ▲" or "   ▼")
end

local function setDropdownExpanded(v)
expanded=v==true
options.Visible=expanded
if expanded then
local h=8+(#values*31)+math.max(0,#values-1)*3
options.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,h)
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,36+h)
else
options.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,32)
end
refreshDropdown()
end

for _,value in ipairs(values)do
local b=CVU_CreateButton(options)
b.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,31)
b.Text="   "..tostring(value)
b.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
b.ZIndex=200005
b.Activated:Connect(function()
setValue(value)
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
setDropdownExpanded(false)
end)
optionButtons[#optionButtons+1]=b
end

main.Activated:Connect(function()
setDropdownExpanded(not expanded)
end)

refreshDropdown()
return holder
end
-- Slider callbacks MUST stay local to each slider instance;
-- shared globals made every slider control the last-created slider.
function CVU_AddSlider(parent,name,minimum,maximum,getValue,setValue,format)
assert(maximum>minimum,"Slider range must be positive")
local holder=Instance.new("Frame")
holder.Name=name.."_Slider"
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,58)
holder.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,40,46)
holder.BorderSizePixel=0
holder.ZIndex=200003
holder.Parent=parent
local corner=Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,5)
corner.Parent=holder
local label=Instance.new("TextLabel")
label.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,2)
label.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,24)
label.BackgroundTransparency=1
label.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(238,238,242)
label.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
label.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham
label.TextSize=12
label.ZIndex=200004
label.Parent=holder
local bar=Instance.new("Frame")
bar.Name="SliderTrack"
bar:SetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor",true)
bar.Position=UDim2.new(0,12,1,-19)
bar.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,6)
bar.BorderSizePixel=0
bar.ZIndex=200004
bar.Parent=holder
local barCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
barCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
barCorner.Parent=bar
local fill=Instance.new("Frame")
fill.Name="SliderFill"
fill.BorderSizePixel=0
fill.ZIndex=200005
fill.Parent=bar
local fillCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
fillCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
fillCorner.Parent=fill
local knob=Instance.new("Frame")
knob.Name="SliderKnob"
knob.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
knob.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(16,16)
knob.BorderSizePixel=0
knob.ZIndex=200006
knob.Parent=bar
local knobCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
knobCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
knobCorner.Parent=knob
local outline=Instance.new("UIStroke")
outline.Thickness=2
outline.Parent=knob
-- A taller input surface covers the rail and thumb, including both endpoints.
local hit=Instance.new("TextButton")
hit.Name="SliderInput"
hit.Text=""
hit.BackgroundTransparency=1
hit.AutoButtonColor=false
hit.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-32)
hit.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,32)
hit.ZIndex=200007
hit.Parent=holder
local dragging=false
local touch=nil
local destroyed=false
local function refreshSlider()
if destroyed then return end
local value=tonumber(getValue())or minimum
if value~=value then value=minimum end
value=math.clamp(value,minimum,maximum)
local alpha=(value-minimum)/(maximum-minimum)
fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(alpha,1)
knob.Position=UDim2.fromScale(alpha,.5)
local light=Settings.UIStyle=="light"
bar.BackgroundColor3=light and Color3.fromRGB(166,180,206)or Color3.fromRGB(77,99,119)
fill.BackgroundColor3=Settings.UIAccent or Color3.fromRGB(54,229,232)
knob.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(248,252,255)
outline.Color=light and Color3.fromRGB(76,89,113)or Color3.fromRGB(12,24,35)
label.Text=name.."   "..(format and format(value)or string.format("%.2f",value))
end
local function isVisible()
if destroyed or Runtime.Shutdown then return false end
local current=holder
while current and current~=GUI do
if current:IsA("GuiObject")and not current.Visible then return false end
current=current.Parent
end
return current==GUI
end
local function setSliderMouseX(x)
if not isVisible()then dragging=false touch=nil return end
local width=bar.AbsoluteSize.X
if width<=0 then return end
local alpha=math.clamp((x-bar.AbsolutePosition.X)/width,0,1)
setValue(minimum+(maximum-minimum)*alpha)
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
refreshSlider()
end
hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
dragging=true touch=nil setSliderMouseX(input.Position.X)
elseif input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging=true touch=input setSliderMouseX(input.Position.X)
end
end)
local changed=UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if dragging and ((touch and input==touch)or(not touch and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement))then
setSliderMouseX(input.Position.X)
end
end)
local ended=UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input==touch or(not touch and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)then
dragging=false touch=nil
end
end)
Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers=Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers or {}
table.insert(Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers,refreshSlider)
holder.Destroying:Connect(function()
destroyed=true dragging=false touch=nil
changed:Disconnect()ended:Disconnect()
local index=table.find(Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers,refreshSlider)
if index then table.remove(Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers,index)end
end)
refreshSlider()
return holder
end

local satNX=1

-- 不再混用 GetMouseLocation / GuiInset / RenderStepped。
-- ColorPicker 的座標全部直接使用 Roblox InputObject.Position，
-- 再和 palette.AbsolutePosition 做同一套像素座標計算。

local function readColor()
local ok,color=pcall(getColor)
if ok and typeof(color)=="Color3"then
return color
end
return Color3.new(1,1,1)
end

local function refreshVisual(fromPicker)
local color=Color3.fromHSV(h,sat,val)
swatch.BackgroundColor3=color
button.Text="   "..name..(expanded and "   ▲"or"   ▼")

-- 白點的位置直接取自實際滑鼠點擊的 normalized pixel 座標，
-- 不再經過 HSV -> UDim 的第二次換算。
selector.Position=UDim2.new(paletteNX,0,paletteNY,0)

local gray=Color3.fromHSV(h,0,val)
local pure=Color3.fromHSV(h,1,val)
satGrad.Color=ColorSequence.new({
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,gray),
ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,pure)
})
satSelector.Position=UDim2.new(satNX,0,0.5,0)
satSelector.BackgroundColor3=color

if fromPicker then
local ok=pcall(setColor,color)
if ok and CVU_QueueSaveSettings then
pcall(CVU_QueueSaveSettings)
end
end
end

local function syncFromSetting()
local color=readColor()
local hh,ss,vv=Color3.toHSV(color)
h,sat,val=hh,ss,vv
paletteNX=math.clamp(h,0,1)
paletteNY=math.clamp(1-val,0,1)
satNX=math.clamp(sat,0,1)
refreshVisual(false)
end

local function setExpanded(v)
expanded=v==true
popup.Visible=expanded
if expanded then
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,298)
else
holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,32)
end
refreshVisual(false)
end

local function pickPalette(pos)
local size=palette.AbsoluteSize
if size.X<=0 or size.Y<=0 then return end

local px=math.clamp(pos.X-palette.AbsolutePosition.X,0,size.X)
local py=math.clamp(pos.Y-palette.AbsolutePosition.Y,0,size.Y)

paletteNX=px/size.X
paletteNY=py/size.Y

h=paletteNX
val=1-paletteNY
sat=1
satNX=1
refreshVisual(true)
end

local function pickSat(pos)
local width=satBar.AbsoluteSize.X
if width<=0 then return end

local px=math.clamp(pos.X-satBar.AbsolutePosition.X,0,width)
satNX=px/width
sat=satNX
refreshVisual(true)
end

button.Activated:Connect(function()
syncFromSetting()
setExpanded(not expanded)
end)

local function inputPosition2D(input)
return Vector2.new(input.Position.X,input.Position.Y)
end

local function beginPaletteDrag(input)
if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
dragPalette=true
dragSat=false
pickPalette(inputPosition2D(input))
end

local function beginSatDrag(input)
if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
dragSat=true
dragPalette=false
pickSat(inputPosition2D(input))
end

paletteHit.InputBegan:Connect(beginPaletteDrag)
selector.InputBegan:Connect(beginPaletteDrag)
palette.InputBegan:Connect(beginPaletteDrag)

satHit.InputBegan:Connect(beginSatDrag)
satSelector.InputBegan:Connect(beginSatDrag)
satBar.InputBegan:Connect(beginSatDrag)

-- 拖曳時直接使用 MouseMovement 事件本身的座標。
-- 這樣白點位置與滑鼠使用的是同一個 InputObject 座標系。
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
local pos=inputPosition2D(input)
if dragPalette then
pickPalette(pos)
elseif dragSat then
pickSat(pos)
end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
dragPalette=false
dragSat=false
end
end)

Runtime.CVUUIColorRefreshers=Runtime.CVUUIColorRefreshers or {}
table.insert(Runtime.CVUUIColorRefreshers,syncFromSetting)
syncFromSetting()
if inline then setExpanded(true)button.Visible=false popup.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)holder.Size=UDim2.new(1,-4,0,258)end
return holder
end
function CVU_SavePart(part)
if Runtime.VisualCache[part]then return end
local materialVariant=""
pcall(function()materialVariant=part.MaterialVariant end)
Runtime.VisualCache[part]={
Color=part.Color,
Material=part.Material,
MaterialVariant=materialVariant,
Reflectance=part.Reflectance,
Transparency=part.Transparency,
LocalTransparencyModifier=part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
Size=part.Size,
}
end

function CVU_RestorePart(part)
local data=Runtime.VisualCache[part]
if not data or not part.Parent then return end
part.Color=data.Color
part.Material=data.Material
pcall(function()part.MaterialVariant=data.MaterialVariant or ""end)
part.Reflectance=data.Reflectance
part.Transparency=data.Transparency
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=data.LocalTransparencyModifier
part.Size=data.Size
end

function CVU_IsArmPart(part)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end

local function compactName(value)
return string.gsub(string.lower(value or ""),"[^%w]","")
end
local compact=compactName(part.Name)

-- 武器名稱裡容易誤中 hand / arm 的例外。
local obviousWeaponName=string.find(compact,"handle",1,true)
or string.find(compact,"handguard",1,true)
or string.find(compact,"armature",1,true)

-- 先看零件自己。這個優先級必須高於 Tool / Knife 祖先，
-- 因為很多刀 ViewModel 真的會把 LeftHand/Arm Mesh 放在 Tool/Knife 底下。
local exactArms={
arm=true,arms=true,hand=true,hands=true,larm=true,rarm=true,lhand=true,rhand=true,
leftarm=true,rightarm=true,lefthand=true,righthand=true,
leftupperarm=true,rightupperarm=true,leftlowerarm=true,rightlowerarm=true,
leftforearm=true,rightforearm=true,leftwrist=true,rightwrist=true,
leftglove=true,rightglove=true,glove=true,gloves=true,sleeve=true,sleeves=true,
}
if exactArms[compact]then return true end

local hasLeft=string.find(compact,"left",1,true)~=nil
local hasRight=string.find(compact,"right",1,true)~=nil
local hasArm=string.find(compact,"arm",1,true)~=nil
local hasHand=string.find(compact,"hand",1,true)~=nil
local hasWrist=string.find(compact,"wrist",1,true)~=nil
local hasGlove=string.find(compact,"glove",1,true)~=nil
local hasSleeve=string.find(compact,"sleeve",1,true)~=nil
if not obviousWeaponName and (hasLeft or hasRight)and(hasArm or hasHand or hasWrist or hasGlove or hasSleeve)then
return true
end
if compact=="glove"or compact=="gloves"or compact=="sleeve"or compact=="sleeves"then return true end

-- Skinned ViewModel 手臂常常本體只叫 Mesh/Part，但 Bone 名稱會暴露它其實是手。
-- 這是刀類最重要的兜底；武器本體即使有 Bone，通常也不會叫 shoulder/elbow/wrist/hand/arm。
for _,object in ipairs(part:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("Bone")or object:IsA("Motor6D")then
local j=compactName(object.Name)
if string.find(j,"shoulder",1,true)
or string.find(j,"elbow",1,true)
or string.find(j,"wrist",1,true)
or j=="hand"or j=="lefthand"or j=="righthand"
or j=="arm"or j=="leftarm"or j=="rightarm"
or string.find(j,"upperarm",1,true)
or string.find(j,"lowerarm",1,true)
or string.find(j,"forearm",1,true)then
return true
end
end
end

-- 再看「最近的祖先分支」。先遇到 Arms/Hands 就是手；
-- 只有在前面沒有手臂證據時，才允許 Tool/Knife/Gun 把它判成武器。
local weaponTokens={"weapon","gun","rifle","pistol","smg","shotgun","sniper","revolver","carbine","knife","blade","sword","katana","melee","bayonet","machete","karambit"}
local ancestor=part.Parent
while ancestor and ancestor~=Camera do
local an=compactName(ancestor.Name)
if an=="arms"or an=="hands"or an=="leftarm"or an=="rightarm"
or an=="lefthand"or an=="righthand"or an=="larm"or an=="rarm"
or an=="lhand"or an=="rhand"or an=="gloves"or an=="sleeves"
or an=="viewmodelarms"or an=="playerviewmodelarms"or an=="armrig"or an=="handrig"then
return true
end

local isWeaponBranch=ancestor:IsA("Tool")
or ancestor:GetAttribute("IsWeapon")==true
or ancestor:GetAttribute("WeaponPart")==true
for _,attr in ipairs({"WeaponName","GunName","ItemName","WeaponType"})do
local v=ancestor:GetAttribute(attr)
if type(v)=="string"and v~=""then isWeaponBranch=true break end
end
if not isWeaponBranch then
for _,token in ipairs(weaponTokens)do
if string.find(an,token,1,true)then isWeaponBranch=true break end
end
end
if isWeaponBranch then return false end
ancestor=ancestor.Parent
end

return false
end local CVU_ViewModelCache=nil local CVU_ViewModelCacheCamera=nil local CVU_ViewModelNextScan=0
function CVU_GetViewModel()
if not Camera then CVU_ViewModelCache=nil CVU_ViewModelCacheCamera=nil return nil end
local now=os.clock()
if CVU_ViewModelCacheCamera==Camera then
-- 只有同時仍掛在 Camera、而且仍有 BloxStrike 原生 Weapon/WeaponL/WeaponR 分支才沿用 cache。
if CVU_ViewModelCache and CVU_ViewModelCache.Parent==Camera then
local cachedWeapon=CVU_ViewModelCache:FindFirstChild("Weapon")or CVU_ViewModelCache:FindFirstChild("WeaponL")or CVU_ViewModelCache:FindFirstChild("WeaponR")
if cachedWeapon then return CVU_ViewModelCache end
end
if now<CVU_ViewModelNextScan then return nil end
end
CVU_ViewModelCacheCamera=Camera
CVU_ViewModelNextScan=now+.25
local best=nil local bestScore=-1
for _,model in ipairs(Camera:GetChildren())do
if not model:IsA("Model")then continue end
if model:GetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperience")==true then continue end
-- BloxStrike 原生 Camera model 由 Skins.GetCameraModel 建立，實際武器一定放在 Weapon / WeaponL / WeaponR。
-- 以前只用「有手臂 + 零件多」判斷，可能把 Camera 裡的人物/展示模型當 ViewModel，
-- 進而讓頭盔、面罩、護目鏡一起進金屬系統。
local weaponBranch=model:FindFirstChild("Weapon")or model:FindFirstChild("WeaponL")or model:FindFirstChild("WeaponR")
if not weaponBranch then continue end
local partCount=0 local armCount=0 local weaponPartCount=0
for _,object in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("BasePart")then
partCount+=1
if CVU_IsArmPart(object)then armCount+=1 end
if object==weaponBranch or object:IsDescendantOf(weaponBranch)then weaponPartCount+=1 end
end
end
if armCount>0 and weaponPartCount>0 and partCount>=3 then
local score=weaponPartCount*20+armCount*10+partCount
if score>bestScore then best=model bestScore=score end
end
end
CVU_ViewModelCache=best
return best
end

function CVU_GetCharacterArmParts()local parts={}local character=LocalPlayer.Character if not character then return parts end for _,object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do if object:IsA("BasePart")and CVU_IsArmPart(object)then table.insert(parts,object)end end return parts end function CVU_GetViewModelArmParts()local parts={}local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()if not viewModel then return parts end for _,object in ipairs(viewModel:GetDescendants())do if object:IsA("BasePart")and CVU_IsArmPart(object)then table.insert(parts,object)end end return parts end function CVU_RestoreCharacterArms()for part,original in pairs(Runtime.HiddenCharacterArms)do if part and part.Parent then part.LocalTransparencyModifier=original end Runtime.HiddenCharacterArms[part]=nil end end function CVU_HideCharacterArms()local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()if not viewModel or not Settings.HideCharacterArmsFirstPerson then CVU_RestoreCharacterArms()return end for _,part in ipairs(CVU_GetCharacterArmParts())do if Runtime.HiddenCharacterArms[part]==nil then Runtime.HiddenCharacterArms[part]=part.LocalTransparencyModifier end part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1 end end local CVU_GhostWeaponTokens={
"weapon","gun","rifle","pistol","smg","shotgun","sniper","revolver","carbine",
"knife","blade","sword","katana","melee","bayonet","machete",
"barrel","receiver","magazine","mag","muzzle","sight","scope","trigger","stock",
"slide","bolt","suppressor","silencer","handguard","foregrip","grip","ammo","shell",
"helper","anchor","pivot","mask","clip","overlay","viewport","camera"
}

local CVU_GhostArmExactNames={
arm=true,arms=true,hand=true,hands=true,larm=true,rarm=true,lhand=true,rhand=true,
leftarm=true,rightarm=true,lefthand=true,righthand=true,
leftupperarm=true,rightupperarm=true,leftlowerarm=true,rightlowerarm=true,
leftforearm=true,rightforearm=true,leftwrist=true,rightwrist=true,
leftglove=true,rightglove=true,glove=true,gloves=true,sleeve=true,sleeves=true,
}

function CVU_GhostCompactName(value)
return string.gsub(string.lower(value or ""),"[^%w]","")
end
function CVU_HasGhostArmContainerAncestor(part,stopAt)
local current=part and part.Parent
while current and current~=Camera do
local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(current.Name)
