Runtime.HUDSkinDisplayNameFn=Runtime.HUDSkinDisplayNameFn or nil

function CVU_GetHUDSkinDisplayName(skinName)
skinName=tostring(skinName or"")
if skinName==""then return""end

local lower=string.lower(skinName)
if lower=="stock"or lower=="vanilla"then return""end

local fn=Runtime.HUDSkinDisplayNameFn
if fn==nil then
local ok,result=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Components.Common.GetSkinDisplayName)
end)
if ok and type(result)=="function"then
fn=result
Runtime.HUDSkinDisplayNameFn=result
else
Runtime.HUDSkinDisplayNameFn=false
fn=false
end
end

local displayName=skinName
if type(fn)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(fn,skinName)
if ok and type(result)=="string"and result~=""then
displayName=result
end
end

local displayLower=string.lower(displayName)
if displayLower=="stock"or displayLower=="vanilla"then return""end
return displayName
end

function CVU_BS_GetKnifeTypeFromNative(nativeName)
nativeName=tostring(nativeName or"")
if nativeName==""then return nil end
local target=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(nativeName)

for displayName,resolvedNative in pairs(Runtime.BloxStrikeKnifeNames or{})do
if CVU_KnifeExpNorm(resolvedNative)==target then
return displayName
end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_GetKnifeHUDActiveType()
-- HUD 只允許跟「已經真的建成功 / 套上的刀」。
-- 不讀 Pending、不讀 Applied、不讀 Settings。
local confirmed=Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedType
if type(confirmed)~="string"or confirmed==""then return nil end

-- ConfirmedType 必須仍然和目前 active ViewModel 狀態一致。
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceNativeFullVM~=true then return nil end
if tostring(Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveType or"")~=confirmed then return nil end

return confirmed
end

function CVU_GetKnifeHUDSkin(typeName)
typeName=tostring(typeName or CVU_GetKnifeHUDActiveType()or"")
if typeName==""then return""end

-- 跟 HUD 一樣，只信「實際建成功後記錄的 skin」。
if typeName==tostring(Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedType or"")then
local skin=Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedSkin
if type(skin)=="string"and skin~=""then return skin end
end

return""
end

function CVU_GetKnifeConfiguredCustomName(nativeName,skinName)
nativeName=tostring(nativeName or"")
skinName=tostring(skinName or"")
if nativeName==""or skinName==""then return""end

-- 第1階段的 Name 設定是 Weapon + Skin 各自獨立。
-- 儲存表名稱雖然沿用 GunSkinConfigs，但 key 本身就是原生 WeaponName，
-- 所以刀具 HUD 也直接讀同一組 per-Weapon/per-Skin NameSuffix。
local root=type(Settings.GunSkinConfigs)=="table"and Settings.GunSkinConfigs or nil
local weaponConfigs=root and root[nativeName]or nil
local cfg=type(weaponConfigs)=="table"and weaponConfigs[skinName]or nil
local customName=type(cfg)=="table"and tostring(cfg.NameSuffix or"")or""
return customName
end

function CVU_GetKnifeHUDName(typeName)
local nativeName=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(typeName)
if type(nativeName)~="string"or nativeName==""then
nativeName=tostring(typeName or"")
end
if nativeName==""then nativeName="Knife"end

local skinName=CVU_GetKnifeHUDSkin(typeName)
local skinDisplay=CVU_GetHUDSkinDisplayName(skinName)

-- HUD 命名規則：武器/刀具本體名稱永遠保留。
-- 自訂名稱只取代後面的 skin 名稱：
-- Karambit | Doppler -> Karambit | Ray
local customName=""
if tostring(typeName or"")==tostring(Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedType or"")
and tostring(skinName or"")==tostring(Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedSkin or"")then
customName=tostring(Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedCustomName or"")
else
customName=CVU_GetKnifeConfiguredCustomName(nativeName,skinName)
end

if customName~=""then
return nativeName.." | "..customName
end
if skinDisplay~=""then
return nativeName.." | "..skinDisplay
end
return nativeName
end

function CVU_GetKnifeHUDImage(typeName)
local nativeName=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(typeName)
if not nativeName then return nil end
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)

local image=nil

-- Gameplay Bottom Inventory 原生 HUD 用的是 v42.Properties.Icon。
-- 這裡也固定只優先使用 Icon，不再讓通用 icon scanner 隨機抓到 ReverseIcon。
if type(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties)=="function"then
local ok,props=pcall(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties,nativeName)
if ok and type(props)=="table"then
image=props.Icon
if type(image)~="string"or image==""then
image=props.ReverseIcon
end
end
end

-- 只有 weapon properties 完全拿不到時才 fallback stock schema。
if type(image)~="string"or image==""then
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetSkinInformation)=="function"then
local ok,info=pcall(lib.GetSkinInformation,nativeName,"Stock")
if ok and type(info)=="table"then
image=info.imageAssetId
end
end
end

if type(CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue)=="function"then
image=CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue(image)
end
return type(image)=="string"and image~=""and image or nil
end

function CVU_FindKnifeHUDIcon()
local cachedIcon=Runtime.KnifeHUDIcon
local cachedName=Runtime.KnifeHUDNameLabel

if cachedIcon and cachedIcon.Parent and cachedIcon:IsA("ImageLabel")and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(cachedIcon)then
if cachedName and cachedName.Parent and cachedName:IsA("TextLabel")and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(cachedName)then
return cachedIcon,cachedName
end

-- Icon 還活著但文字 cache 掉了，只在同一個 Melee frame 裡補找一次。
local meleeFrame=cachedIcon:FindFirstAncestor("Melee")
if meleeFrame then
local weapon=meleeFrame:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
local label=weapon and weapon:FindFirstChild("WeaponName")
if label and not label:IsA("TextLabel")then
label=label:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel",true)
end
if label and label:IsA("TextLabel")then
Runtime.KnifeHUDNameLabel=label
return cachedIcon,label
end
end

return cachedIcon,nil
end

Runtime.KnifeHUDIcon=nil
Runtime.KnifeHUDNameLabel=nil

local playerGui=LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
if not playerGui then return nil,nil end

-- Matches BloxStrike Gameplay/Bottom/Inventory:
-- <Melee frame>/Weapon/Melee       -> ImageLabel
-- <Melee frame>/Weapon/WeaponName  -> TextLabel
for _,candidate in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants())do
if candidate:IsA("GuiObject")and candidate.Name=="Melee"then
local weapon=candidate:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
if weapon then
local icon=weapon:FindFirstChild("Melee")
if icon and not icon:IsA("ImageLabel")then
icon=icon:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel",true)
end
if not icon then
icon=weapon:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel",true)
end

local nameLabel=weapon:FindFirstChild("WeaponName")
if nameLabel and not nameLabel:IsA("TextLabel")then
nameLabel=nameLabel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel",true)
end

if icon and icon:IsA("ImageLabel")and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(icon)then
Runtime.KnifeHUDIcon=icon
if nameLabel and nameLabel:IsA("TextLabel")and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(nameLabel)then
Runtime.KnifeHUDNameLabel=nameLabel
end
return icon,Runtime.KnifeHUDNameLabel
end
end
end
end

return nil,nil
end

function CVU_UpdateKnifeHUDIcon(typeName)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return false end
if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled~=true then return false end

-- 只能改自己正在操作時的 HUD。
-- 觀戰別人時即使 UI 仍在 LocalPlayer.PlayerGui，也不能覆寫。
if not CVU_IsLocalGameplayHUDContext()then
pcall(CVU_RestoreKnifeHUDIcon)
return false
end

typeName=typeName or CVU_GetKnifeHUDActiveType()

-- 沒有確認「刀已經真的套上」就完全不碰 HUD。
if type(typeName)~="string"or typeName==""then
return false
end
if typeName~=Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedType then
return false
end
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceNativeFullVM~=true
or Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveType~=typeName then
return false
end

local image=CVU_GetKnifeHUDImage(typeName)
local hudName=CVU_GetKnifeHUDName(typeName)
if not image then return false end

local icon,nameLabel=CVU_FindKnifeHUDIcon()
if not icon then return false end

if not CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(icon)then return false end
if Runtime.KnifeHUDOriginalImages[icon]==nil then
Runtime.KnifeHUDOriginalImages[icon]=icon.Image
end

Runtime.KnifeHUDWriteGuard=true
local writeOk,writeErr=pcall(function()
if icon.Image~=image then icon.Image=image end
icon.Visible=true

-- BloxStrike 原生 HUD 會把 T Knife / CT Knife 顯示成 "Knife"。
-- 刀型體驗啟用時，這裡同步覆寫成真正選到的刀型名稱。
if nameLabel and nameLabel.Parent and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(nameLabel)then
if Runtime.KnifeHUDOriginalTexts[nameLabel]==nil then
Runtime.KnifeHUDOriginalTexts[nameLabel]=nameLabel.Text
end
if nameLabel.Text~=hudName then nameLabel.Text=hudName end
nameLabel.Visible=true
end
end)
Runtime.KnifeHUDWriteGuard=false
if not writeOk then warn("[KnifeHUD sync]",writeErr)return false end

Runtime.KnifeHUDLastType=typeName
Runtime.KnifeHUDLastImage=image
Runtime.KnifeHUDLastName=hudName
return true
end

function CVU_RestoreKnifeHUDIcon()
local lastImage=Runtime.KnifeHUDLastImage
local lastName=Runtime.KnifeHUDLastName
Runtime.KnifeHUDWriteGuard=true

for icon,original in pairs(Runtime.KnifeHUDOriginalImages or{})do
if icon and icon.Parent and icon:IsA("ImageLabel")and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(icon)then
-- 如果遊戲已經重畫成觀戰目標自己的刀圖，就不要用舊值覆蓋。
if lastImage and icon.Image==lastImage then
pcall(function()icon.Image=original or""end)
end
end
end

for label,original in pairs(Runtime.KnifeHUDOriginalTexts or{})do
if label and label.Parent and label:IsA("TextLabel")and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(label)then
-- 同理，只還原仍是我們注入的英文刀名。
if lastName and label.Text==lastName then
pcall(function()label.Text=original or"Knife"end)
end
end
end
Runtime.KnifeHUDWriteGuard=false

Runtime.KnifeHUDOriginalImages=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.KnifeHUDOriginalTexts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.KnifeHUDIcon=nil
Runtime.KnifeHUDNameLabel=nil
Runtime.KnifeHUDLastType=nil
Runtime.KnifeHUDLastImage=nil
Runtime.KnifeHUDLastName=nil
end

function CVU_DisconnectKnifeHUDInstanceListeners()
for _,connection in ipairs(Runtime.KnifeHUDInstanceConnections or{})do
pcall(function()connection:Disconnect()end)
end
Runtime.KnifeHUDInstanceConnections={}
end

function CVU_RefreshKnifeHUDFromEvent()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Runtime.KnifeHUDWriteGuard then return end
if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled~=true then return end
if not CVU_IsLocalGameplayHUDContext()then
pcall(CVU_RestoreKnifeHUDIcon)
return
end
local confirmedType=CVU_GetKnifeHUDActiveType()
if confirmedType then pcall(CVU_UpdateKnifeHUDIcon,confirmedType)end
end

function CVU_BindKnifeHUDInstances(icon,nameLabel)
CVU_DisconnectKnifeHUDInstanceListeners()
if not icon or not icon.Parent then return false end

local connections=Runtime.KnifeHUDInstanceConnections
connections[#connections+1]=icon:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function()
if Runtime.KnifeHUDWriteGuard then return end
local confirmedType=CVU_GetKnifeHUDActiveType()
if not confirmedType then return end
local expected=CVU_GetKnifeHUDImage(confirmedType)
if expected and icon.Image~=expected then CVU_RefreshKnifeHUDFromEvent()end
end)
connections[#connections+1]=icon.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_,parent)
if parent==nil then
Runtime.KnifeHUDIcon=nil
Runtime.KnifeHUDNameLabel=nil
CVU_QueueKnifeHUDBind()
end
end)

if nameLabel and nameLabel.Parent then
connections[#connections+1]=nameLabel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
if Runtime.KnifeHUDWriteGuard then return end
local confirmedType=CVU_GetKnifeHUDActiveType()
if not confirmedType then return end
local expected=CVU_GetKnifeHUDName(confirmedType)
if nameLabel.Text~=expected then CVU_RefreshKnifeHUDFromEvent()end
end)
connections[#connections+1]=nameLabel.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_,parent)
if parent==nil then
Runtime.KnifeHUDNameLabel=nil
CVU_QueueKnifeHUDBind()
end
end)
end
return true
end

function CVU_QueueKnifeHUDBind()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Runtime.KnifeHUDBindQueued then return end
Runtime.KnifeHUDBindQueued=true
task.defer(function()
Runtime.KnifeHUDBindQueued=false
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
local icon,nameLabel=CVU_FindKnifeHUDIcon()
if icon then
CVU_BindKnifeHUDInstances(icon,nameLabel)
CVU_RefreshKnifeHUDFromEvent()
end
end)
end

function CVU_StopKnifeHUDSync()
Runtime.KnifeHUDFallbackGeneration=(Runtime.KnifeHUDFallbackGeneration or 0)+1
CVU_DisconnectKnifeHUDInstanceListeners()
if Runtime.KnifeHUDPlayerGuiConnection then
pcall(function()Runtime.KnifeHUDPlayerGuiConnection:Disconnect()end)
Runtime.KnifeHUDPlayerGuiConnection=nil
end
Runtime.KnifeHUDSyncStarted=false
Runtime.KnifeHUDBindQueued=false
end

function CVU_StartKnifeHUDSync()
if Runtime.KnifeHUDSyncStarted then return end
Runtime.KnifeHUDSyncStarted=true
Runtime.KnifeHUDFallbackGeneration=(Runtime.KnifeHUDFallbackGeneration or 0)+1
local generation=Runtime.KnifeHUDFallbackGeneration

-- 初始只找一次；之後由實際 HUD 物件的 Text/Image changed 事件即時修正。
CVU_QueueKnifeHUDBind()

-- BloxStrike 重建 Gameplay HUD 時，只對和 Melee HUD 結構有關的新增物件重新 bind。
Runtime.KnifeHUDPlayerGuiConnection=PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
local name=obj.Name
if name=="Melee"or name=="Weapon"or name=="WeaponName"then
CVU_QueueKnifeHUDBind()
end
end)

-- 低頻 fallback 只處理極少數沒有觸發重建事件／屬性事件的過渡情況；不再是主要同步機制。
task.spawn(function()
while not Runtime.Shutdown and Runtime.KnifeHUDFallbackGeneration==generation do
task.wait(1.5)
if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled==true then
CVU_QueueKnifeHUDBind()
CVU_RefreshKnifeHUDFromEvent()
end
end
end)
end

CVU_StartKnifeHUDSync()

function CVU_BS_GetKnifeOffset(weaponName)
return(Runtime.BloxStrikeKnifeOffsets and Runtime.BloxStrikeKnifeOffsets[weaponName])
or CFrame.new(0,-1.5,1.20)
end

function CVU_BS_IsNativeKnifeName(weaponName)
if type(weaponName)~="string"or weaponName==""then return false end

local normalized=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(weaponName)
if normalized=="tknife"or normalized=="ctknife"then return true end

for _,nativeName in pairs(Runtime.BloxStrikeKnifeNames or {})do
if CVU_KnifeExpNorm(nativeName)==normalized then return true end
end

-- BloxStrike 自己的 weapon properties 優先。
if type(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties)=="function"then
local ok,props=pcall(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties,weaponName)
if ok and type(props)=="table"then
local joined=string.lower(
tostring(props.Class or"").." "..
tostring(props.Type or"").." "..
tostring(props.Category or"")
)
if string.find(joined,"knife",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"melee",1,true)then
return true
end
end
end

-- 最後才用名稱 token fallback。
return string.find(normalized,"knife",1,true)~=nil
or string.find(normalized,"karambit",1,true)~=nil
or string.find(normalized,"bayonet",1,true)~=nil
or string.find(normalized,"stiletto",1,true)~=nil
or string.find(normalized,"skeleton",1,true)~=nil
or string.find(normalized,"lightsaber",1,true)~=nil
end

function CVU_BS_SafeRequire(moduleScript)
if not moduleScript or not moduleScript:IsA("ModuleScript")then return nil end
local ok,result=pcall(require,moduleScript)
if ok then return result end
return nil
end

function CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(force)
if Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeInitTried and not force then
return Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeAvailable
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeInitTried=true
Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeAvailable=false
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildError=nil

local assets=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder=assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Weapons")or nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder=assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Skins")or nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeAnimationsFolder=assets and assets:FindFirstChild("WeaponAnimations")or nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeSoundsFolder=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Sounds")

local database=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Database")
local components=database and database:FindFirstChild("Components")or nil
local libraries=components and components:FindFirstChild("Libraries")or nil
local skinsModule=libraries and libraries:FindFirstChild("Skins")or nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib=CVU_BS_SafeRequire(skinsModule)

local rsComponents=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Components")
local common=rsComponents and rsComponents:FindFirstChild("Common")or nil
local propsModule=common and common:FindFirstChild("GetWeaponProperties")or nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties=CVU_BS_SafeRequire(propsModule)

Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeAvailable=
Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder~=nil
and Runtime.BloxStrikeAnimationsFolder~=nil

return Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeAvailable
end

function CVU_BS_IsGloveModelName(name)
if type(name)~="string"or name==""then return false end

-- 遊戲自己的 weapon properties 優先。
if type(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties)=="function"then
local ok,props=pcall(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties,name)
if ok and type(props)=="table"then
local class=string.lower(tostring(props.Class or""))
local typ=string.lower(tostring(props.Type or""))
if class=="glove"
or string.find(class,"glove",1,true)
or string.find(typ,"glove",1,true)then
return true
end
end
end

local normalized=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(name)
if normalized=="handwraps"
or normalized=="tglove"
or normalized=="ctglove"
or normalized=="drivergloves"
or normalized=="operatorgloves"
or normalized=="sportsgloves"then
return true
end
return string.find(normalized,"glove",1,true)~=nil
end

function CVU_BS_RefreshGloveModelOptions()
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)

local values=Runtime.GloveExperienceModelOptions or {}
Runtime.GloveExperienceModelOptions=values
table.clear(values)

local seen={}
local found={}
local folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder
if folder then
for _,obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren())do
if (obj:IsA("Folder")or obj:IsA("Model"))
and CVU_BS_IsGloveModelName(obj.Name)
and not seen[obj.Name]then
seen[obj.Name]=true
found[#found+1]=obj.Name
end
end
end

-- 已知 BloxStrike glove 排序；遊戲未來新增的手套會自動排在後面。
local preferred={
"Sports Gloves","Driver Gloves","Operator Gloves",
"Hand Wraps","T Glove","CT Glove"
}
for _,name in ipairs(preferred)do
if seen[name]then values[#values+1]=name end
end

table.sort(found,function(a,b)return string.lower(a)<string.lower(b)end)
for _,name in ipairs(found)do
if not table.find(values,name)then
values[#values+1]=name
end
end

-- 若掃描時 Assets 還沒完整載入，保留已知名稱，避免 UI 變空。
if #values==0 then
for _,name in ipairs(preferred)do values[#values+1]=name end
end

if not table.find(values,Settings.GloveExperience)then
Settings.GloveExperience=
(table.find(values,"Sports Gloves")and"Sports Gloves")
or values[1]
or"Sports Gloves"
end

if Runtime.GloveExperienceButton and Runtime.GloveExperienceButton.Parent then
Runtime.GloveExperienceButton.Text=
"手套類型   "..tostring(Settings.GloveExperience)
end

return values
end

function CVU_RememberGloveSkin(onlyIfMissing)
if type(Settings.GloveExperienceSkinMemory)~="table"then
Settings.GloveExperienceSkinMemory={}
end
local model=Settings.GloveExperience
if type(model)~="string"or model==""then return end
if not onlyIfMissing or type(Settings.GloveExperienceSkinMemory[model])~="string"then
Settings.GloveExperienceSkinMemory[model]=Settings.GloveExperienceSkin or"Stock"
end
end

function CVU_BS_RefreshGloveSkinOptions(modelName)
local model=tostring(modelName or Settings.GloveExperience or"")
CVU_RememberGloveSkin(true)

local remembered=Settings.GloveExperienceSkinMemory[model]
if string.lower(tostring(remembered or""))=="stock"then remembered=nil end

local values=Runtime.GloveExperienceSkinOptions or {}
Runtime.GloveExperienceSkinOptions=values
table.clear(values)

local source=
model~="" and CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(model,false)
or {}

local vanilla=nil
local others={}

for _,name in ipairs(source)do
name=tostring(name or"")
local lower=string.lower(name)

-- 手套的 Stock 不再作為可選 skin。
if name~=""and lower~="stock"then
if lower=="vanilla"then
vanilla=name
else
others[#others+1]=name
end
end
end

table.sort(others,function(a,b)return string.lower(a)<string.lower(b)end)

if vanilla then values[#values+1]=vanilla end
for _,name in ipairs(others)do values[#values+1]=name end

if type(remembered)=="string"and table.find(values,remembered)then
Settings.GloveExperienceSkin=remembered
else
Settings.GloveExperienceSkin=values[1]or""
end

if type(Settings.GloveExperienceSkinMemory)=="table"and model~=""then
Settings.GloveExperienceSkinMemory[model]=Settings.GloveExperienceSkin
end

if Runtime.GloveExperienceSkinButton and Runtime.GloveExperienceSkinButton.Parent then
Runtime.GloveExperienceSkinButton.Text=
"手套皮膚   "..tostring(Settings.GloveExperienceSkin)
end

return values
end

Runtime.GloveExperienceStatus=

-- SkinsLib.GetGloves 是遊戲共用函式；若沒有作用域，別人的世界模型也會拿到本機選擇。
-- 只有本機第一人稱 Viewmodel.new / GetCameraModel 正在建立時才允許換手套。
function CVU_BS_GetBuildThreadKey()
 return coroutine.running()or Runtime.BloxStrikeBuildMainThreadKey
end

function CVU_BS_GetBuildThreadDepth(depths)
 local thread=CVU_BS_GetBuildThreadKey()
 return depths and(depths[thread]or 0)or 0
end

function CVU_BS_IsInsideLocalViewmodelBuild()
 return CVU_BS_GetBuildThreadDepth(Runtime.BloxStrikeLocalViewmodelBuildThreads)>0
end

function CVU_BS_IsInsideBuyPreviewBuild()
 return CVU_BS_GetBuildThreadDepth(Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewBuildThreads)>0
end

function CVU_BS_CallInsideLocalViewmodelBuild(callback,...)
local thread=CVU_BS_GetBuildThreadKey()
local depths=Runtime.BloxStrikeLocalViewmodelBuildThreads
depths[thread]=(depths[thread]or 0)+1
Runtime.BloxStrikeLocalViewmodelBuildDepth=
(Runtime.BloxStrikeLocalViewmodelBuildDepth or 0)+1
local results=table.pack(pcall(callback,...))
depths[thread]=math.max((depths[thread]or 1)-1,0)
if depths[thread]==0 then depths[thread]=nil end
Runtime.BloxStrikeLocalViewmodelBuildDepth=
math.max((Runtime.BloxStrikeLocalViewmodelBuildDepth or 1)-1,0)
if not results[1]then
error(results[2],0)
end
return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
end

function CVU_BS_GetInstancePlayerOwnership(value)
if typeof(value)~="Instance"then return nil end
if value:IsA("Player")then return value==LocalPlayer end

local current=value
local depth=0
while current and depth<14 do
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if current==player or (player.Character and (current==player.Character or value:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)))then
return player==LocalPlayer
end
end

for _,attributeName in ipairs({"OwnerUserId","PlayerUserId","UserId"})do
local id=current:GetAttribute(attributeName)
if typeof(id)=="number"then
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if player.UserId==id then return player==LocalPlayer end
end
end
end
for _,attributeName in ipairs({"Owner","Player","PlayerName","CharacterName"})do
local owner=current:GetAttribute(attributeName)
if type(owner)=="string"and owner~=""then
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if owner==player.Name or owner==player.DisplayName then return player==LocalPlayer end
end
end
end

if current:IsA("Model")then
local compact=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(current.Name)
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
local playerKey=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(player.Name)
local exact=compact==playerKey
local attached=string.find(compact,playerKey,1,true)==1
and (string.find(compact,"weapon",1,true)or string.find(compact,"attachment",1,true))
if exact or attached then return player==LocalPlayer end
end
end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
return nil
end

function CVU_BS_IsLocalViewmodelComponent(comp)
local localCharacter=LocalPlayer.Character
local localBackpack=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
local localPlayerGui=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
local currentCamera=Workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera

local function classify(value)
if typeof(value)~="Instance"then return nil end
local ownership=CVU_BS_GetInstancePlayerOwnership(value)
if ownership~=nil then return ownership end

for _,root in ipairs({localCharacter,localBackpack,localPlayerGui,currentCamera})do
if root then
local ok,inside=pcall(function()
return value==root or value:IsDescendantOf(root)
end)
if ok and inside then return true end
end
end

for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if player~=LocalPlayer then
local character=player.Character
if value==player then return false end
if character then
local ok,inside=pcall(function()
return value==character or value:IsDescendantOf(character)
end)
if ok and inside then return false end
end
end
end
return nil
end

local direct=classify(comp)
if direct~=nil then return direct end
if type(comp)=="table"then
local sawLocal=false
for _,key in ipairs({
"Player","Owner","LocalPlayer","Character","CharacterModel",
"Model","Viewmodel","ViewModel","Tool","Weapon"
})do
local ok,value=pcall(function()return rawget(comp,key)end)
if ok then
local state=classify(value)
if state==false then return false end
if state==true then sawLocal=true end
if type(value)=="string"and (key=="Player"or key=="Owner"or key=="LocalPlayer")then
if value==LocalPlayer.Name then sawLocal=true
elseif Players:FindFirstChild(value)then return false end
end
end
end
if not sawLocal then
local checked=0
local key,value=next(comp)
while key~=nil and checked<40 do
local state=classify(value)
if state==false then return false end
if state==true then sawLocal=true end
checked+=1
key,value=next(comp,key)
end
end
if sawLocal then return true end
end

-- 歸屬不明時拒絕替換。第三人稱背槍建立器常只傳一個無 owner 的 component；
-- 舊版把 unknown 當 local，正是隊友背槍被套成本機皮膚的來源。
return false
end

-- 購買選單使用的是全域 Skins Library。呼叫參數只要帶到其他玩家或
-- 其 Character，就必須完整保留原參數，不能套用本機的體驗皮膚。
function CVU_BS_ReferencesRemotePlayer(value,depth,seen)
 depth=depth or 0
 if depth>5 then return false end
 local valueType=typeof(value)
 if valueType=="Instance"then
 return CVU_BS_GetInstancePlayerOwnership(value)==false
 end
 if type(value)~="table"then return false end
 seen=seen or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 if seen[value]then return false end
 seen[value]=true
 local checked=0
 for key,child in pairs(value)do
 if type(key)=="string"and type(child)=="string"then
 local keyName=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(key)
 if keyName=="player"or keyName=="owner"or keyName=="playername"or keyName=="charactername"then
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
 if player~=LocalPlayer and (child==player.Name or child==player.DisplayName)then return true end
 end
 end
 end
 if CVU_BS_ReferencesRemotePlayer(key,depth+1,seen)
 or CVU_BS_ReferencesRemotePlayer(child,depth+1,seen)then
 return true
 end
 checked+=1
 if checked>=240 then break end
 end
 return false
end

function CVU_BS_ArgsReferenceRemotePlayer(args)
 if type(args)~="table"then return false end
 local seen=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 for index=1,args.n or #args do
 if CVU_BS_ReferencesRemotePlayer(args[index],0,seen)then return true end
 end
 return false
end

function CVU_BS_InstallGloveExperienceHook()
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)

local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
if type(lib)~="table"or type(lib.GetGloves)~="function"then
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastGloveError="找不到 SkinsLib.GetGloves"
return false
end

if Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveHooked
and Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveWrapperGetGloves
and lib.GetGloves==Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveWrapperGetGloves then
return true
end

local original=lib.GetGloves
if Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveWrapperGetGloves
and original==Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveWrapperGetGloves
and type(Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveOriginalGetGloves)=="function"then
original=Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveOriginalGetGloves
end

local wrapper
 wrapper=function(name,skin,float,...)
 local localBuild=CVU_BS_IsInsideLocalViewmodelBuild()
 local callArgs=table.pack(name,skin,float,...)
 local remoteCall=CVU_BS_ArgsReferenceRemotePlayer(callArgs)
 local buyBuild=not remoteCall and(
 CVU_BS_IsInsideBuyPreviewBuild()
 or (not localBuild and CVU_BS_IsBuyPreviewCall())
 )
local enabled=
(localBuild and CVU_GetAppliedGloveExperienceEnabled())
or (buyBuild and Settings.GloveExperienceEnabled==true)
if not Runtime.Shutdown and enabled then
local desiredModel=buyBuild
and (Settings.GloveExperience or"Sports Gloves")
or CVU_GetAppliedGloveExperienceModel()
local desiredSkin=buyBuild
and (Settings.GloveExperienceSkin or"Stock")
or CVU_GetAppliedGloveExperienceSkin()

-- 先嘗試 UI Applied 的 model + skin。
-- 這個入口同時被槍與刀的第一人稱 ViewModel 使用，
-- 所以不分武器種類，兩邊會拿到同一雙體驗手套。
local ok,result=pcall(
original,
desiredModel,
desiredSkin,
0,
...
)
if ok and result then
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastAppliedGloveModel=desiredModel
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastAppliedGloveSkin=desiredSkin
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastGloveError=nil
Runtime.GloveExperienceStatus=
"GetGloves｜"..tostring(desiredModel).."｜"..tostring(desiredSkin)
if buyBuild then
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewLastGlove=
tostring(desiredModel).."｜"..tostring(desiredSkin)
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewStatus=
"購買預覽手套｜"..Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewLastGlove
end
return result
end

-- 若該皮膚剛被遊戲更新/移除，Stock 再試一次；
-- 兩次都失敗才完全 pass-through，不破壞原版手套。
if desiredSkin~="Stock"then
local okStock,resultStock=pcall(
original,
desiredModel,
"Stock",
0,
...
)
if okStock and resultStock then
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastAppliedGloveModel=desiredModel
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastAppliedGloveSkin="Stock"
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastGloveError=nil
return resultStock
end
end

Runtime.BloxStrikeLastGloveError=tostring(result)
end

return original(name,skin,float,...)
end

Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveOriginalGetGloves=original
Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveWrapperGetGloves=wrapper
lib.GetGloves=wrapper
Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveHooked=true
return true
end

function CVU_BS_UninstallGloveExperienceHook()
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
local wrapper=Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveWrapperGetGloves
local original=Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveOriginalGetGloves

if type(lib)=="table"
and wrapper
and original
and lib.GetGloves==wrapper then
pcall(function()lib.GetGloves=original end)
end

Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveHooked=false
Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveOriginalGetGloves=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeGloveWrapperGetGloves=nil
end

function CVU_ShowKnifeExperienceToast(message,detail,duration)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not GUI or not GUI.Parent then return end

local frame=Runtime.KnifeExperienceToastFrame
if not frame or not frame.Parent then
frame=Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name="KnifeExperienceToast"
frame.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,1)
frame.Position=UDim2.new(1,-18,1,-18)
frame.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(360,82)
frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(20,21,27)
frame.BackgroundTransparency=0.06
frame.BorderSizePixel=0
frame.ZIndex=500000
frame.Parent=GUI

local corner=Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,9)
corner.Parent=frame

local stroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Thickness=1
stroke.Transparency=.18
stroke.Color=Color3.fromRGB(86,96,118)

local title=Instance.new("TextLabel")

title.TextSize=16

title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.ZIndex=500001
title.Parent=frame

local sub=Instance.new("TextLabel")

sub.TextSize=12

sub.ZIndex=500001

local title=frame:FindFirstChild("Title")
local sub=frame:FindFirstChild("Detail")
if title then title.Text=tostring(message or"體驗刀具")end
if sub then sub.Text=tostring(detail or"")end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceToastGeneration=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceToastGeneration or 0)+1

task.delay(tonumber(duration)or 3.2,function()

function CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(weaponName)
if type(weaponName)~="string"or weaponName==""then return false end
if CVU_BS_IsNativeKnifeName(weaponName)or CVU_BS_IsGloveModelName(weaponName)then return false end
local normalized=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(weaponName)
for _,token in ipairs({"grenade","flashbang","smoke","molotov","incendiary","decoy","bomb","c4","taser"})do
if string.find(normalized,token,1,true)then return false end
end
for _,group in pairs(Runtime.GunExperienceModelsByCategory or {})do
if table.find(group,weaponName)then return true end
end
local directSkinFolder=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder
and Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
if directSkinFolder
and not Runtime.GunExperienceIgnored[weaponName]
and not Runtime.GunExperienceKnives[weaponName]
and not Runtime.GunExperienceGloves[weaponName]then
return true
end
if table.find(Runtime.GunExperienceModelOptions or {},weaponName)then return true end

if type(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties)=="function"then
local ok,props=pcall(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties,weaponName)
if ok and type(props)=="table"then
local joined=string.lower(
tostring(props.Class or"").." "..
tostring(props.Type or"").." "..
tostring(props.Category or"")
)
if string.find(joined,"grenade",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"equipment",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"bomb",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"knife",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"melee",1,true)then
return false
end
if string.find(joined,"gun",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"rifle",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"pistol",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"smg",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"shotgun",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"sniper",1,true)
or string.find(joined,"weapon",1,true)then
return true
end
end
end
return false
end

function CVU_BS_GetGunExperienceCategory(weaponName)
if Runtime.GunExperienceCTOnly[weaponName]then return"反恐部隊"end
if Runtime.GunExperienceShared[weaponName]then return"共用槍械"end
return"恐怖分子"
end

function CVU_EnsureGunKillCounterTables()
-- 舊欄位只保留相容性；新版真正狀態存於每一個 gun skin config。
if type(Settings.GunKillCounterEnabled)~="table"then Settings.GunKillCounterEnabled={}end
if type(Settings.GunKillCounterKills)~="table"then Settings.GunKillCounterKills={}end
return Settings.GunKillCounterEnabled,Settings.GunKillCounterKills
end

function CVU_CopyGunKillCounterEnabled(source)
local result={}
if type(source)=="table"then
for weaponName,state in pairs(source)do
if type(weaponName)=="string"and state==true then result[weaponName]=true end
end
end
return result
end

function CVU_GetGunKillCounterSkinName(weaponName,useApplied,explicitSkin)
weaponName=tostring(weaponName or"")
if type(explicitSkin)=="string"and explicitSkin~=""then return explicitSkin end

if useApplied==true then
local memory=Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkinMemory
if type(memory)=="table"and type(memory[weaponName])=="string"and memory[weaponName]~=""then
return memory[weaponName]
end
if tostring(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedWeapon or"")==weaponName
and type(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkin)=="string"
and Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkin~=""then
return Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkin
end
end

local memory=type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)=="table"and Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory or{}
if type(memory[weaponName])=="string"and memory[weaponName]~=""then
return memory[weaponName]
end
if tostring(Settings.GunExperience or"")==weaponName
and type(Settings.GunExperienceSkin)=="string"
and Settings.GunExperienceSkin~=""then
return Settings.GunExperienceSkin
end
return"Stock"
end

function CVU_GetGunKillCounterConfig(weaponName,skinName,useApplied,create)
weaponName=tostring(weaponName or"")
skinName=CVU_GetGunKillCounterSkinName(weaponName,useApplied,skinName)
local cfg=nil
if useApplied==true then
if type(CVU_GetGunSkinConfigFromRoot)=="function"then
cfg=CVU_GetGunSkinConfigFromRoot(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs,weaponName,skinName)
end
else
if type(CVU_GetGunSkinConfig)=="function"then
cfg=CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weaponName,skinName,create==true)
end
end
return cfg,skinName
end

-- Script 啟動時先不要沿用舊版「每槍一個開關」的 applied map。
-- 真正 applied 狀態改由 Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs 的「槍+skin」讀取。
Runtime.GunKillCounterAppliedEnabled={}

function CVU_IsGunKillCounterEnabled(weaponName,skinName,useApplied)
local cfg=CVU_GetGunKillCounterConfig(weaponName,skinName,useApplied==true,false)
return type(cfg)=="table"and cfg.StatTrakEnabled==true
end

function CVU_IsGunKillCounterApplied(weaponName,skinName)
return CVU_IsGunKillCounterEnabled(weaponName,skinName,true)
end

function CVU_IsGunKillCounterActive(weaponName)
local skinName=CVU_GetGunKillCounterSkinName(weaponName,true,nil)
return Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedEnabled==true
and Settings.GunExperienceEnabled==true
and CVU_IsGunKillCounterApplied(weaponName,skinName)
and type(Runtime.GunKillCounterVisualReady)=="table"
and Runtime.GunKillCounterVisualReady[weaponName]==true
end

function CVU_GetGunKillCounterValue(weaponName,skinName,useApplied)
-- 擊殺數只屬於「槍械種類」，不屬於 skin。
-- 例如 AK-47 的 Aniki / Lore / Midas 全部讀同一個 AK-47 計數；
-- 但 StatTrakEnabled 仍然留在各自 skin config，彼此完全獨立。
CVU_EnsureGunKillCounterTables()
weaponName=tostring(weaponName or"")
local value=math.floor(tonumber(Settings.GunKillCounterKills[weaponName])or 0)
return math.clamp(value,0,999999)
end

function CVU_AnyGunKillCounterEnabled()
if Settings.GunExperienceEnabled~=true then return false end
for weaponName,state in pairs(Runtime.GunKillCounterVisualReady or{})do
if state==true and CVU_IsGunKillCounterActive(weaponName)then return true end
end
return false
end

function CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(value)
if type(value)~="string"or value==""then return nil end
local key=string.lower(value):gsub("[^%w]","")
for _,group in pairs(Runtime.GunExperienceModelsByCategory or {})do
for _,weaponName in ipairs(group)do
if string.lower(weaponName):gsub("[^%w]","")==key then return weaponName end
end
end
for _,weaponName in ipairs(Runtime.GunExperienceModelOptions or {})do
if string.lower(weaponName):gsub("[^%w]","")==key then return weaponName end
end
local skinsFolder=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder
if skinsFolder then
for _,folder in ipairs(skinsFolder:GetChildren())do
if string.lower(folder.Name):gsub("[^%w]","")==key
and CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(folder.Name)then
return folder.Name
end
end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_GetCurrentLocalGunName()
local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
if viewModel then
local direct=CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(viewModel.Name)
if direct then return direct end
for _,attributeName in ipairs({"Weapon","WeaponName","GunName","ItemName","CurrentWeapon","EquippedWeapon"})do
local value=viewModel:GetAttribute(attributeName)
local resolved=CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(value)
if resolved then return resolved end
end
end
local tool=CVU_GetEquippedTool and CVU_GetEquippedTool()or nil
if tool then
local direct=CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(tool.Name)
if direct then return direct end
for _,attributeName in ipairs({"Weapon","WeaponName","GunName","ItemName"})do
local resolved=CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(tool:GetAttribute(attributeName))
if resolved then return resolved end
end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_IsGunKillCounterVisualObject(obj,viewModel)
local current=obj
for _=1,9 do
if not current or current==viewModel then break end
local name=string.lower(current.Name or""):gsub("[^%w]","")
if string.find(name,"stattrak",1,true)
or string.find(name,"killtrack",1,true)
or string.find(name,"killcounter",1,true)then
return true
end
current=current.Parent
end
return false
end

function CVU_UpdateGunKillCounterVisual(weaponName)
local label=Runtime.GunKillCounterCountLabels
and Runtime.GunKillCounterCountLabels[weaponName]
local useApplied=Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedEnabled==true
local skinName=CVU_GetGunKillCounterSkinName(weaponName,useApplied,nil)
local count=CVU_GetGunKillCounterValue(weaponName,skinName,useApplied)
if label and label.Parent then label.Text="擊殺數   "..tostring(count)end

local viewModel=CVU_GetViewModel()
if not viewModel or CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(viewModel.Name)~=weaponName then return false end
viewModel:SetAttribute("CVU_GunKillCounter",count)
local display=string.format("%06d",count)
local changed=false
for _,obj in ipairs(viewModel:GetDescendants())do
if CVU_IsGunKillCounterVisualObject(obj,viewModel)then
if obj:IsA("TextLabel")or obj:IsA("TextButton")or obj:IsA("TextBox")then
obj.Text=display
changed=true
elseif obj:IsA("StringValue")then
obj.Value=display
changed=true
elseif obj:IsA("IntValue")or obj:IsA("NumberValue")then
obj.Value=count
changed=true
end
end
end
return changed
end

function CVU_ToggleGunKillCounter(weaponName,skinName)
skinName=CVU_GetGunKillCounterSkinName(weaponName,false,skinName)
local cfg=CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weaponName,skinName,true)
cfg.StatTrakEnabled=not(cfg.StatTrakEnabled==true)
CVU_EnsureGunKillCounterTables()
Settings.GunKillCounterKills[tostring(weaponName or"")]=CVU_GetGunKillCounterValue(weaponName,skinName,false)
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
if Settings.GunExperienceEnabled then
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallGunStatTrakHook)
CVU_QueueGunExperienceNextRound("GunKillCounterToggle")
end
pcall(CVU_RebuildGunExperienceAccordion)
return cfg.StatTrakEnabled
end

function CVU_ResetGunKillCounter(weaponName,skinName)
CVU_EnsureGunKillCounterTables()
weaponName=tostring(weaponName or"")
Settings.GunKillCounterKills[weaponName]=0
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
pcall(CVU_UpdateGunKillCounterVisual,weaponName)
pcall(CVU_RebuildGunExperienceAccordion)
return true
end

function CVU_RecordGunKillCounter(target)
if Runtime.Shutdown or Settings.GunExperienceEnabled~=true then return false end
local weaponName=Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotWeapon
if not weaponName or os.clock()-(Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotAt or 0)>3 then
weaponName=CVU_GetCurrentLocalGunName()
end
if not weaponName or not CVU_IsGunKillCounterActive(weaponName)then return false end
if Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotWeapon==weaponName
and Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotEnabled==false then return false end

local key=target
if typeof(target)=="Instance"and target:IsA("Model")then
key=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)or target
end
if key==nil then key="unknown"end
local character=typeof(key)=="Instance"and key:IsA("Player")and key.Character
or (typeof(target)=="Instance"and target:IsA("Model")and target or nil)
Runtime.GunKillCounterRecentTargets=Runtime.GunKillCounterRecentTargets
or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local recent=Runtime.GunKillCounterRecentTargets[key]
local now=os.clock()
local shotSerial=Runtime.LastLocalShotSerial or 0
if recent and (now-recent.Time<1.5
or (shotSerial>0 and recent.ShotSerial==shotSerial))then
return false
end
Runtime.GunKillCounterRecentTargets[key]={Character=character,Time=now,ShotSerial=shotSerial}

-- 擊殺數以槍械種類為唯一來源。skin 只決定這一把外觀要不要顯示 StatTrak。
CVU_EnsureGunKillCounterTables()
weaponName=tostring(weaponName or"")
local nextValue=math.clamp(CVU_GetGunKillCounterValue(weaponName,nil,false)+1,0,999999)
Settings.GunKillCounterKills[weaponName]=nextValue

CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
pcall(CVU_UpdateGunKillCounterVisual,weaponName)
return true
end

-- 購買介面右側人物是獨立的第三人稱預覽模型，不會經過第一人稱 Viewmodel.new。
-- 以下作用域只在 BuyMenu 建模期间开放，让 Skins Library 使用 UI 当前选择，
-- 结束后立即回到原参数，避免把本机预览皮肤套到场上其他玩家。
function CVU_BS_IsGuiActuallyVisible(gui)
local current=gui
local checked=0
while current and current~=PlayerGui and checked<24 do
if current:IsA("ScreenGui")and current.Enabled==false then return false end
if current:IsA("GuiObject")and current.Visible==false then return false end
current=current.Parent
checked+=1
end
return current==PlayerGui
end

function CVU_BS_TouchBuyPreviewWindow(duration)
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewWindowUntil=math.max(
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewWindowUntil or 0,
os.clock()+(tonumber(duration)or 0.8)
)
end

function CVU_BS_IsBuyMenuVisible(force)
local now=os.clock()
if not force and now-(Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewGuiCheckedAt or 0)<0.16 then
return Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewGuiVisible==true
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewGuiCheckedAt=now

local visible=false
for _,obj in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("GuiObject")and CVU_BS_IsGuiActuallyVisible(obj)then
local name=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(obj.Name)
local text=""
if obj:IsA("TextLabel")or obj:IsA("TextButton")or obj:IsA("TextBox")then
text=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(obj.Text)
end
if name=="buymenu"
or name=="buyframe"
or name=="purchasemenu"
or string.find(name,"buymenu",1,true)
or string.find(text,"buytimeremaining",1,true)
or string.find(text,"droppedweapon",1,true)then
visible=true
break
end
end
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewGuiVisible=visible
if visible then CVU_BS_TouchBuyPreviewWindow(0.45)end
return visible
end

function CVU_BS_IsBuyPreviewCall()
 if CVU_BS_IsInsideBuyPreviewBuild()then return true end

 -- 呼叫堆疊與可見購買介面必須同時成立。只看函式來源名稱會把同模組
 -- 建立的場上背槍誤認成右側購買預覽。
 if not CVU_BS_IsBuyMenuVisible(false)then return false end

 -- 只有呼叫堆疊能證明來自 BuyMenu 時才放行。
 -- 單靠 GUI 可見或短暫時間窗會誤傷同時重建的隊友背部武器。
 if type(debug)=="table"and type(debug.info)=="function"then
for level=2,9 do
local ok,source=pcall(debug.info,level,"s")
if not ok or source==nil then break end
local key=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(source)
if string.find(key,"buymenu",1,true)
or string.find(key,"purchase",1,true)
or string.find(key,"weaponshop",1,true)
or string.find(key,"loadoutpreview",1,true)then
CVU_BS_TouchBuyPreviewWindow(0.8)
return true
end
end
end
return false
end

function CVU_BS_CallInsideBuyPreviewBuild(callback,...)
local thread=CVU_BS_GetBuildThreadKey()
local depths=Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewBuildThreads
depths[thread]=(depths[thread]or 0)+1
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewBuildDepth=(Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewBuildDepth or 0)+1
CVU_BS_TouchBuyPreviewWindow(0.8)
local results=table.pack(pcall(callback,...))
depths[thread]=math.max((depths[thread]or 1)-1,0)
if depths[thread]==0 then depths[thread]=nil end
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewBuildDepth=
math.max((Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewBuildDepth or 1)-1,0)
if not results[1]then error(results[2],0)end
return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
end

function CVU_BS_GetBuyPreviewGunSkin(weaponName,originalSkin)
if Settings.GunExperienceEnabled~=true then return originalSkin end
local desired=nil
if type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)=="table"then
desired=Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory[weaponName]
end
if type(desired)~="string"
and weaponName==Settings.GunExperience then
desired=Settings.GunExperienceSkin
end
if type(desired)~="string"or desired==""then return originalSkin end
local available=CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(weaponName,false)
if table.find(available,desired)then return desired end
return originalSkin
end

function CVU_BS_RewriteBuyPreviewArgs(args)
if Settings.GunExperienceEnabled~=true then return false,nil,nil end
for weaponIndex=1,args.n do
local weaponName=args[weaponIndex]
if type(weaponName)=="string"and CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(weaponName)then
local available=CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(weaponName,false)
for skinIndex=weaponIndex+1,math.min(weaponIndex+3,args.n)do
local originalSkin=args[skinIndex]
if type(originalSkin)=="string"and table.find(available,originalSkin)then
local desiredSkin=CVU_BS_GetBuyPreviewGunSkin(weaponName,originalSkin)
if desiredSkin~=originalSkin then args[skinIndex]=desiredSkin end
return true,weaponName,desiredSkin
end
end
end
end
return false,nil,nil
end

function CVU_BS_IsBuyPreviewModelFunction(name)
local key=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(name)
if key=="getcameramodel"
or key=="getgloves"
or key=="getallskinsforweapon"then return false end
if not string.find(key,"model",1,true)then return false end
return string.find(key,"get",1,true)==1
or string.find(key,"create",1,true)==1
or string.find(key,"build",1,true)==1
end

function CVU_BS_InstallBuyPreviewHooks()
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
if type(lib)~="table"then
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewStatus="找不到 Skins Library"
return false
end

pcall(CVU_BS_InstallGunStatTrakHook)
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallGloveExperienceHook)
local hooks=Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewHooks or {}
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewHooks=hooks
local installed=0
for name,fn in pairs(lib)do
if type(name)=="string"
and type(fn)=="function"
and CVU_BS_IsBuyPreviewModelFunction(name)
and hooks[name]==nil then
local original=fn
local wrapper
 wrapper=function(...)
 local args=table.pack(...)
 if Runtime.Shutdown
 or CVU_BS_ArgsReferenceRemotePlayer(args)
 or not CVU_BS_IsBuyPreviewCall()then
return original(table.unpack(args,1,args.n))
end
local changed,weaponName,desiredSkin=CVU_BS_RewriteBuyPreviewArgs(args)
if not changed then return original(table.unpack(args,1,args.n))end

Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewLastFunction=name
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewLastWeapon=weaponName
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewLastSkin=desiredSkin
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewStatus=
"購買預覽｜"..tostring(name).."｜"..tostring(weaponName).."｜"..tostring(desiredSkin)
local results=table.pack(pcall(
CVU_BS_CallInsideBuyPreviewBuild,
original,
table.unpack(args,1,args.n)
))
if results[1]then return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)end
-- 游戏更新导致签名不同的时候完整退回原调用，购买菜单不能因此失效。
return original(...)
end
hooks[name]={Table=lib,Original=original,Wrapper=wrapper}
lib[name]=wrapper
installed+=1
end
end
if installed>0 or next(hooks)~=nil then
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewStatus="購買預覽同步已就緒"
return true
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewStatus="Skins Library 沒有找到第三人稱 Model 建立函式"
return false
end

function CVU_BS_UninstallBuyPreviewHooks()
for name,entry in pairs(Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewHooks or {})do
if type(entry)=="table"
and type(entry.Table)=="table"
and entry.Table[name]==entry.Wrapper then
pcall(function()entry.Table[name]=entry.Original end)
end
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewHooks={}
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewBuildDepth=0
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewBuildThreads=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewWindowUntil=0
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewStatus="購買預覽同步已關閉"
end

-- 自定名稱診斷狀態：
-- Viewmodel.new 會先讀 component.NameTag；GetCameraModel 第五參數再建立 NamePlate。
Runtime.GunNameTagLastWeapon=Runtime.GunNameTagLastWeapon or nil
Runtime.GunNameTagLastValue=Runtime.GunNameTagLastValue or nil

function CVU_BS_InstallGunStatTrakHook()
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
if type(lib)~="table"or type(lib.GetCameraModel)~="function"then return false end
if Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakWrapper
and lib.GetCameraModel==Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakWrapper then return true end

local original=lib.GetCameraModel
if original==Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakWrapper
and type(Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakOriginalGetCameraModel)=="function"then
original=Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakOriginalGetCameraModel
end
local wrapper
wrapper=function(weaponName,skinName,floatValue,originalStatTrak,originalNameTag,originalCharm,originalStickers,...)
local localBuild=CVU_BS_IsInsideLocalViewmodelBuild()
local callArgs=table.pack(weaponName,skinName,floatValue,originalStatTrak,originalNameTag,originalCharm,originalStickers,...)
local buyBuild=not localBuild
and not CVU_BS_ArgsReferenceRemotePlayer(callArgs)
and CVU_BS_IsBuyPreviewCall()
local experienceEnabled
if buyBuild then
experienceEnabled=Settings.GunExperienceEnabled==true
else
experienceEnabled=Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedEnabled==true
end
if not Runtime.Shutdown
and experienceEnabled
and (localBuild or buyBuild)
and CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(weaponName)then
local desiredSkin=skinName
if buyBuild then
desiredSkin=CVU_BS_GetBuyPreviewGunSkin(weaponName,skinName)
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewLastFunction="GetCameraModel"
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewLastWeapon=weaponName
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewLastSkin=desiredSkin
Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewStatus=
"購買預覽｜GetCameraModel｜"..tostring(weaponName).."｜"..tostring(desiredSkin)
end
local counterApplied
if buyBuild then
counterApplied=CVU_IsGunKillCounterEnabled(weaponName,desiredSkin,false)
else
counterApplied=CVU_IsGunKillCounterApplied(weaponName,desiredSkin)
end
local statTrak=counterApplied
and CVU_GetGunKillCounterValue(weaponName,desiredSkin,not buyBuild)
or nil
local cfg=CVU_GetGunExperienceConfig(weaponName,desiredSkin,not buyBuild)
local desiredFloat=floatValue
local desiredNameTag=originalNameTag
local desiredCharm=originalCharm
local desiredStickers=originalStickers
if type(cfg)=="table"then
desiredFloat=math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.Wear)or tonumber(floatValue)or 0,0,1)
if type(cfg.NameSuffix)=="string"and cfg.NameSuffix~=""then desiredNameTag=cfg.NameSuffix else desiredNameTag=nil end
desiredCharm=CVU_BuildCharmPayload(cfg)
desiredStickers=CVU_BuildFixedStickerPayload(cfg)
end
if buyBuild then
return CVU_BS_CallInsideBuyPreviewBuild(
original,weaponName,desiredSkin,desiredFloat,statTrak,desiredNameTag,desiredCharm,desiredStickers,...
)
end
local results=table.pack(pcall(
original,weaponName,desiredSkin,desiredFloat,statTrak,desiredNameTag,desiredCharm,desiredStickers,...
))
if not results[1]then error(results[2],0)end
Runtime.GunKillCounterVisualReady=Runtime.GunKillCounterVisualReady or{}
Runtime.GunKillCounterVisualReady[weaponName]=counterApplied==true
Runtime.GunKillCounterLastAppliedWeapon=weaponName
if counterApplied then
task.defer(function()
if not Runtime.Shutdown then
pcall(CVU_UpdateGunKillCounterVisual,weaponName)
pcall(CVU_RebuildGunExperienceAccordion)
end
end)
end
return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
end
return original(weaponName,skinName,floatValue,originalStatTrak,originalNameTag,originalCharm,originalStickers,...)
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakOriginalGetCameraModel=original
Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakWrapper=wrapper
lib.GetCameraModel=wrapper
return true
end

function CVU_BS_UninstallGunStatTrakHook()
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
local wrapper=Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakWrapper
local original=Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakOriginalGetCameraModel
if type(lib)=="table"and wrapper and original and lib.GetCameraModel==wrapper then
pcall(function()lib.GetCameraModel=original end)
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakOriginalGetCameraModel=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakWrapper=nil
end

-- 一次性清理舊版「全域外觀廣播」已經留下的其他玩家武器模型。
-- BloxStrike Observers.Players 本身會跳過 LocalPlayer；遠端玩家的 CurrentEquipped
-- 由 CreateWeaponModel(player, equipped, Slot1~3) 建立。這裡直接沿用同一條原生路徑重建，
-- 不改 Attribute，也不碰本機 Third Person。
function CVU_BS_RebuildRemotePlayerWeaponVisuals()
local controllers=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
local observers=controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("Observers")
local playersFolder=observers and observers:FindFirstChild("Players")
local components=playersFolder and playersFolder:FindFirstChild("Components")
local moduleScript=components and components:FindFirstChild("CreateWeaponModel")
local builder=CVU_BS_SafeRequire(moduleScript)
if type(builder)~="table"then return false end

for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if player~=LocalPlayer then
pcall(function()
if type(builder.ClearPlayerCache)=="function"then
builder.ClearPlayerCache(player)
end

local encoded=player:GetAttribute("CurrentEquipped")
if type(encoded)~="string"or encoded==""then return end
local equipped=HttpService:JSONDecode(encoded)
if type(equipped)~="table"then return end

local slots={}
for slot=1,3 do
local raw=player:GetAttribute("Slot"..slot)
if type(raw)=="string"and raw~=""then
local ok,decoded=pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode,HttpService,raw)
if ok and type(decoded)=="table"then slots[slot]=decoded end
end
end

builder(player,equipped,slots)
end)
end
end
return true
end

function CVU_BS_RefreshGunModelOptions(category)
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)
if type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)~="table"then
Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory={}
end
local values=Runtime.GunExperienceModelOptions or {}
Runtime.GunExperienceModelOptions=values
local groups={
["反恐部隊"]={},
["恐怖分子"]={},
["共用槍械"]={},
}
local skinsFolder=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder

-- 沿用參考程式的做法：遍歷 Assets.Skins，排除刀、手套、投擲物與裝備；
-- CT_ONLY / SHARED 使用固定名單，其餘有效皮膚資料夾歸到 T 武器。
if skinsFolder then
for _,folder in ipairs(skinsFolder:GetChildren())do
local name=folder.Name
if not Runtime.GunExperienceIgnored[name]
and not Runtime.GunExperienceKnives[name]
and not Runtime.GunExperienceGloves[name]
and not CVU_BS_IsGloveModelName(name)
and #folder:GetChildren()>0 then
local groupName=CVU_BS_GetGunExperienceCategory(name)
groups[groupName][#groups[groupName]+1]=name
end
end
else
local fallback={
["反恐部隊"]={"USP-S","Five-SeveN","MP9","FAMAS","M4A1-S","M4A4","AUG"},
["共用槍械"]={"P250","Desert Eagle","Dual Berettas","R8 Revolver","Negev","P90","Nova","XM1014","AWP","SSG 08"},
["恐怖分子"]={"Glock-18","Tec-9","MAC-10","Galil AR","AK-47","SG 553"},
}
groups=fallback
end

for _,list in pairs(groups)do
table.sort(list,function(a,b)return string.lower(a)<string.lower(b)end)
end
Runtime.GunExperienceModelsByCategory=groups

local selectedCategory=category or Settings.GunExperienceCategory
if not table.find(Runtime.GunExperienceCategories,selectedCategory)then
selectedCategory=CVU_BS_GetGunExperienceCategory(Settings.GunExperience)
end
Settings.GunExperienceCategory=selectedCategory
table.clear(values)
for _,name in ipairs(groups[selectedCategory]or {})do values[#values+1]=name end
if #values==0 then values[1]=Settings.GunExperience or"AK-47"end

if not table.find(values,Settings.GunExperience)then
Settings.GunExperience=values[1]
local remembered=Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory[Settings.GunExperience]
Settings.GunExperienceSkin=type(remembered)=="string"and remembered or"Stock"
end
if Runtime.GunExperienceButton and Runtime.GunExperienceButton.Parent then
Runtime.GunExperienceButton.Text="設定槍械   "..tostring(Settings.GunExperience)
end
if Runtime.GunExperienceCategoryButton and Runtime.GunExperienceCategoryButton.Parent then
Runtime.GunExperienceCategoryButton.Text="槍械分類   "..tostring(Settings.GunExperienceCategory)
end
return values
end

function CVU_RememberGunSkin(onlyIfMissing)
if type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)~="table"then
Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory={}
end
local weapon=Settings.GunExperience
if type(weapon)~="string"or weapon==""then return end
if not onlyIfMissing or type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory[weapon])~="string"then
Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory[weapon]=Settings.GunExperienceSkin or"Stock"
end
end

function CVU_BS_RefreshGunSkinOptions(weaponName)
local weapon=tostring(weaponName or Settings.GunExperience or"")
CVU_RememberGunSkin(true)
local remembered=Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory[weapon]
Settings.GunExperienceSkin=type(remembered)=="string"and remembered or"Stock"
local values=Runtime.GunExperienceSkinOptions or {}
Runtime.GunExperienceSkinOptions=values
table.clear(values)
for _,name in ipairs(CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(weapon,false)or {"Stock"})do
values[#values+1]=name
end
if #values==0 then values[1]="Stock"end
if not table.find(values,Settings.GunExperienceSkin)then
Settings.GunExperienceSkin=values[1]
end
if Runtime.GunExperienceSkinButton and Runtime.GunExperienceSkinButton.Parent then
Runtime.GunExperienceSkinButton.Text="槍械皮膚   "..tostring(Settings.GunExperienceSkin)
end
return values
end

function CVU_SelectGunExperienceAccordionCategory(categoryName)
CVU_RememberGunSkin(false)
Settings.GunExperienceCategory=categoryName
Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionExpandedWeapon=nil
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGunModelOptions,categoryName)
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGunSkinOptions,Settings.GunExperience)
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
pcall(CVU_RebuildGunExperienceAccordion)
end

function CVU_ToggleGunExperienceAccordionWeapon(weaponName)
Settings.GunExperience=weaponName
if type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)~="table"then
Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory={}
end
local remembered=Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory[weaponName]
Settings.GunExperienceSkin=type(remembered)=="string"and remembered or"Stock"
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGunSkinOptions,weaponName)
if Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionExpandedWeapon==weaponName then
Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionExpandedWeapon=nil
else
Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionExpandedWeapon=weaponName
end
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
pcall(CVU_RebuildGunExperienceAccordion)
end

function CVU_SelectGunExperienceAccordionSkin(weaponName,skinName)
Settings.GunExperience=weaponName
Settings.GunExperienceSkin=skinName
if type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)~="table"then
Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory={}
end
Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory[weaponName]=skinName
pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGunSkinOptions,weaponName)
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
if Settings.GunExperienceEnabled then
CVU_QueueGunExperienceNextRound("GunSkinAccordion")
pcall(CVU_BS_TouchBuyPreviewWindow,1.2)
end
pcall(CVU_RebuildGunExperienceAccordion)
end

function CVU_RebuildGunExperienceAccordion()
local parent=Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionParent
local makeFn=Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionMake
local buttonFn=Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionButton
local selectedColor=Color3.fromRGB(37,160,163)
local selectedTextColor=Color3.fromRGB(216,233,242)
if not parent or not parent.Parent or type(makeFn)~="function"or type(buttonFn)~="function"then return false end

if Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionRoot and Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionRoot.Parent then
Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionRoot:Destroy()
end

pcall(CVU_BS_RefreshGunModelOptions,Settings.GunExperienceCategory)
local category=Settings.GunExperienceCategory
local weapons=Runtime.GunExperienceModelsByCategory[category]or {}
local expandedWeapon=Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionExpandedWeapon
local expandedSkins=nil
if expandedWeapon and table.find(weapons,expandedWeapon)then
expandedSkins=CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(expandedWeapon,false)
else
Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionExpandedWeapon=nil
expandedWeapon=nil
end

local skinColumns=2
local expandedSkinRows=expandedSkins and math.ceil(#expandedSkins/skinColumns)or 0
local totalHeight=52+(#weapons*48)+(expandedSkinRows*38)+(expandedWeapon and 54 or 0)
local root=makeFn("Frame",parent,{
Name="GunExperienceAccordion",
Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,totalHeight),
BackgroundTransparency=1,
BorderSizePixel=0,
LayoutOrder=2,
ZIndex=200004,
Visible=Settings.GunExperienceEnabled==true,
})
Runtime.GunExperienceAccordionRoot=root
Runtime.GunKillCounterCountLabels={}

local categoryBar=makeFn("Frame",root,{
Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),
Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,42),
BackgroundTransparency=1,
BorderSizePixel=0,
ZIndex=200004,
})
for index,categoryName in ipairs(Runtime.GunExperienceCategories)do
local selectedCategory=categoryName
local active=selectedCategory==category
local categoryButton=buttonFn(
categoryBar,
(active and "✓  "or"")..selectedCategory,
(index-1)*282,
0,
274,
40,
function()CVU_SelectGunExperienceAccordionCategory(selectedCategory)end
)
if active then
categoryButton:SetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor",true)
categoryButton.BackgroundColor3=selectedColor
categoryButton.TextColor3=selectedTextColor
end
end

local cursorY=52
for _,weaponName in ipairs(weapons)do
local selectedWeapon=weaponName
local expanded=selectedWeapon==expandedWeapon
local skins=expanded and expandedSkins or nil
local rows=skins and math.ceil(#skins/skinColumns)or 0
local rowHeight=42+(expanded and rows*38+54 or 0)
local row=makeFn("Frame",root,{
Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,cursorY),
Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,rowHeight),
BackgroundTransparency=1,
BorderSizePixel=0,
ZIndex=200004,
})
local remembered=type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)=="table"
and Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory[selectedWeapon]or nil
local weaponButton=buttonFn(
row,
"   "..selectedWeapon.."    ·    "..tostring(remembered or"Stock"),
0,
0,
784,
40,
function()CVU_ToggleGunExperienceAccordionWeapon(selectedWeapon)end
)
weaponButton.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
if Settings.GunExperience==selectedWeapon then
weaponButton:SetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor",true)
weaponButton.BackgroundColor3=selectedColor
weaponButton.TextColor3=selectedTextColor
end
local arrowButton=buttonFn(
row,
expanded and "▲"or"▼",
792,
0,
54,
40,
function()CVU_ToggleGunExperienceAccordionWeapon(selectedWeapon)end
)
arrowButton.TextSize=16

if skins then
local counterEnabled=CVU_IsGunKillCounterEnabled(selectedWeapon,remembered or"Stock",false)
local counterApplied=CVU_IsGunKillCounterApplied(selectedWeapon,remembered or"Stock")
local counterActive=CVU_IsGunKillCounterActive(selectedWeapon)
local counterState
if counterActive then
counterState="已套用"
elseif counterEnabled then
counterState="已開啟｜下一局套用"
elseif counterApplied then
counterState="已關閉｜下一局移除"
else
counterState="已關閉"
end
local counterToggle=buttonFn(
row,
"擊殺記錄器   "..counterState,
8,
48,
395,
36,
function()CVU_ToggleGunKillCounter(selectedWeapon,remembered or"Stock")end
)
if counterEnabled then
counterToggle:SetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor",true)
counterToggle.BackgroundColor3=selectedColor
counterToggle.TextColor3=selectedTextColor
end
local countButton=buttonFn(
row,
"擊殺數   "..tostring(CVU_GetGunKillCounterValue(selectedWeapon,remembered or"Stock",false)),
411,
48,
260,
36,
function()end
)
countButton.AutoButtonColor=false
Runtime.GunKillCounterCountLabels[selectedWeapon]=countButton
local resetButton=buttonFn(
row,
"清零",
679,
48,
167,
36,
function()CVU_ResetGunKillCounter(selectedWeapon,remembered or"Stock")end
)
resetButton.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(72,38,43)
resetButton.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,185,190)

for skinIndex,skinName in ipairs(skins)do
local selectedSkin=skinName
local column=(skinIndex-1)%skinColumns
local skinRow=math.floor((skinIndex-1)/skinColumns)
local isSelected=remembered==selectedSkin
local skinButton=buttonFn(
row,
(isSelected and "✓  "or"")..selectedSkin,
column*419+8,
92+skinRow*38,
407,
32,
function()CVU_SelectGunExperienceAccordionSkin(selectedWeapon,selectedSkin)end
)
if isSelected then
skinButton:SetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor",true)

skinButton.TextColor3=selectedTextColor

cursorY+=rowHeight+6

return true
