function CVU_GetAppliedGunExperienceEnabled()
return Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedEnabled==true
end

function CVU_GetAppliedGunExperienceWeapon()
return Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedWeapon or Settings.GunExperience or"AK-47"
end

function CVU_CopyGunExperienceSkinMemory(source)
local result={}
if type(source)=="table"then
for weaponName,skinName in pairs(source)do
if type(weaponName)=="string"and type(skinName)=="string"then
result[weaponName]=skinName
end
end
end
return result
end

function CVU_CopyPlainConfigValue(value,depth)
depth=(tonumber(depth)or 0)+1
if depth>8 then return nil end
local kind=typeof(value)
if kind=="string"or kind=="number"or kind=="boolean"or value==nil then return value end
if kind~="table"then return nil end
local result={}
for key,child in pairs(value)do
local keyType=typeof(key)
if keyType=="string"or keyType=="number"then
result[key]=CVU_CopyPlainConfigValue(child,depth)
end
end
return result
end

function CVU_EnsureGunSkinConfigs()
if type(Settings.GunSkinConfigs)~="table"then Settings.GunSkinConfigs={}end
return Settings.GunSkinConfigs
end

function CVU_SyncGunSkinAttachmentFlags(cfg)
if type(cfg)~="table"then return false,false end

local charmEnabled=
type(cfg.Charm)=="table"
and type(cfg.Charm.Skin)=="string"
and cfg.Charm.Skin~=""
cfg.CharmEnabled=charmEnabled

local stickerEnabled=false
if type(cfg.Stickers)~="table"then cfg.Stickers={}end
for slot=1,5 do
local value=cfg.Stickers[slot]
if type(value)=="string"and value~=""then
stickerEnabled=true
break
end
end
cfg.StickerEnabled=stickerEnabled

return charmEnabled,stickerEnabled
end

function CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weaponName,skinName,create)
weaponName=tostring(weaponName or"")
skinName=tostring(skinName or"Stock")
local root=CVU_EnsureGunSkinConfigs()
local weaponTable=root[weaponName]
if type(weaponTable)~="table"then
if not create then return nil end
weaponTable={}
root[weaponName]=weaponTable
end
local cfg=weaponTable[skinName]
if type(cfg)~="table"then
if not create then return nil end
cfg={
Wear=0,
Favorite=false,
NameSuffix="",
CharmEnabled=false,
Charm=false,
StickerEnabled=false,
Stickers={},
StatTrakEnabled=false,
}
weaponTable[skinName]=cfg
end
if type(cfg.Stickers)~="table"then cfg.Stickers={}end
cfg.Wear=math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.Wear)or 0,0,1)
cfg.Favorite=cfg.Favorite==true
cfg.NameSuffix=type(cfg.NameSuffix)=="string"and cfg.NameSuffix or""
cfg.StatTrakEnabled=cfg.StatTrakEnabled==true
-- 舊版曾把擊殺數塞在每個 skin；新版只保留 skin 自己的開關。
cfg.StatTrakKills=nil
CVU_SyncGunSkinAttachmentFlags(cfg)
return cfg
end

function CVU_MigrateGunKillCountersToWeaponShared()
CVU_EnsureGunKillCounterTables()
local root=type(Settings.GunSkinConfigs)=="table"and Settings.GunSkinConfigs or{}
local legacyEnabled=type(Settings.GunKillCounterEnabled)=="table"and Settings.GunKillCounterEnabled or{}
local memory=type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)=="table"and Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory or{}

-- 先把曾經分散在各 skin 的數字合併回同一把槍。
-- 取最大值可避免使用者在不同舊版本間切換時把已累積的擊殺數吃掉。
for weaponName,skinTable in pairs(root)do
if type(weaponName)=="string"and type(skinTable)=="table"then
local shared=math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(Settings.GunKillCounterKills[weaponName])or 0),0,999999)
for _,cfg in pairs(skinTable)do
if type(cfg)=="table"then
shared=math.max(shared,math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg.StatTrakKills)or 0),0,999999))
cfg.StatTrakKills=nil
end
end
Settings.GunKillCounterKills[weaponName]=shared
end
end

-- 更舊版本只有「每槍一個開關」時，只把那個 ON 狀態搬到當時所選的 skin。
-- 已經有明確 per-skin 開關的設定絕不覆寫。
for weaponName,state in pairs(legacyEnabled)do
if type(weaponName)=="string"and state==true then
local skinName=memory[weaponName]
if type(skinName)~="string"or skinName==""then
if tostring(Settings.GunExperience or"")==weaponName then
skinName=tostring(Settings.GunExperienceSkin or"Stock")
else
skinName="Stock"
end
end
local weaponTable=root[weaponName]
local existing=type(weaponTable)=="table"and weaponTable[skinName]or nil
if type(existing)~="table"or existing.StatTrakEnabled==nil then
local cfg=CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weaponName,skinName,true)
cfg.StatTrakEnabled=true
end
end
end

-- Enabled 這張舊表不再當真實狀態來源；每個 skin 自己存 StatTrakEnabled。
Settings.GunKillCounterEnabled={}
end
CVU_MigrateGunKillCountersToWeaponShared()
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()

function CVU_CopyGunSkinConfigs(source)
local copied=CVU_CopyPlainConfigValue(type(source)=="table"and source or{},0)
return type(copied)=="table"and copied or{}
end

function CVU_GetGunSkinConfigFromRoot(root,weaponName,skinName)
if type(root)~="table"then return nil end
local weaponTable=root[tostring(weaponName or"")]
if type(weaponTable)~="table"then return nil end
local cfg=weaponTable[tostring(skinName or"Stock")]
return type(cfg)=="table"and cfg or nil
end

function CVU_GetGunExperienceConfig(weaponName,skinName,useApplied)
if useApplied then
return CVU_GetGunSkinConfigFromRoot(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs,weaponName,skinName)
end
return CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weaponName,skinName,false)
end

function CVU_GetGunWearLabel(value)
value=math.clamp(tonumber(value)or 0,0,1)
if value<0.07 then return"Factory New"end
if value<0.15 then return"Minimal Wear"end
if value<0.38 then return"Field-Tested"end
if value<0.45 then return"Well-Worn"end
return"Battle-Scarred"
end

function CVU_BuildFixedStickerPayload(cfg)
if type(cfg)~="table"or type(cfg.Stickers)~="table"then return nil end
CVU_SyncGunSkinAttachmentFlags(cfg)
if cfg.StickerEnabled~=true then return nil end
local positions={
{X=.12,Y=.48,Rotation=0},
{X=.30,Y=.50,Rotation=-4},
{X=.50,Y=.48,Rotation=2},
{X=.70,Y=.50,Rotation=0},
{X=.88,Y=.47,Rotation=4},
}
local result={}
for slot=1,5 do
local sticker=cfg.Stickers[slot]
if type(sticker)=="string"and sticker~=""then
local p=positions[slot]
result[#result+1]={Sticker=sticker,Position={X=p.X,Y=p.Y,Rotation=p.Rotation}}
end
end
return #result>0 and result or nil
end

function CVU_BuildCharmPayload(cfg)
if type(cfg)~="table"then return nil end
CVU_SyncGunSkinAttachmentFlags(cfg)
if cfg.CharmEnabled~=true or type(cfg.Charm)~="table"then return nil end
if type(cfg.Charm.Skin)~="string"or cfg.Charm.Skin==""then return nil end
return{
_id="CVU_LOCAL_CHARM",
Skin=cfg.Charm.Skin,
Pattern=cfg.Charm.Pattern or 1,
Position=tostring(cfg.Charm.Position or"1"),
}
end


-- ============================================================
-- Lobby native appearance sync
--
-- 原則：
-- 1. Lobby 展示與「體驗槍械 / 體驗手套」遊戲內開關完全分離。
-- 2. 槍械直接沿用 BloxStrike MenuSceneController 的原生 Character weapon 流程：
--    Skins.GetCharacterModel / GetBaseWeaponModel -> actor -> RightHand.WeaponAttachment Motor6D。
-- 3. 允許真正換槍型；例如 UI 選 AWP，大廳人物手上就真的換成 AWP Model。
-- 4. Skin / Wear / StatTrak / NameTag / Charm / Stickers 全部傳進 GetCharacterModel。
-- 5. 新槍 Model + WeaponAttachment 完成後才刪舊槍，避免瞬間空手或模型疊加。
-- 6. 手套套用前會遍歷 CharacterArmor，清掉全部 RightGlove / LeftGlove / CVU glove，
--    不再只 FindFirstChild 一個；Stock 也照原生 Assets.Weapons glove folder 正常展示。
-- 7. Shutdown / 重載時只恢復 Lobby 原始槍械與手套；不碰遊戲內第一人稱與第三人稱功能。
-- ============================================================
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceSnapshots=Runtime.LobbyAppearanceSnapshots or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceCharacter=nil
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceScanAt=0
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceLastSignature=nil

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceGetAttachGloves()
if type(Runtime.LobbyAppearanceAttachGloves)=="function"then
return Runtime.LobbyAppearanceAttachGloves
end

local database=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Database")
local components=database and database:FindFirstChild("Components")
local common=components and components:FindFirstChild("Common")
local moduleScript=common and common:FindFirstChild("AttachGlovesToCharacter")
local fn=CVU_BS_SafeRequire(moduleScript)

if type(fn)=="function"then
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceAttachGloves=fn
return fn
end
return nil
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceIsMatchTreeObject(obj)
local characters=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
return characters~=nil and obj~=nil and obj:IsDescendantOf(characters)
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceFindCharacter(force)
local cached=Runtime.LobbyAppearanceCharacter
if cached
and cached.Parent
and cached:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)
and not CVU_LobbyAppearanceIsMatchTreeObject(cached)
and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(cached)==nil then
return cached
end

local now=os.clock()
if not force and now<(Runtime.LobbyAppearanceScanAt or 0)then return nil end
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceScanAt=now+0.65

local debris=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
local inspectScene=Workspace:FindFirstChild("InspectScene")
local best=nil
local bestScore=-1

for _,obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Model")
and obj.Parent
and not CVU_LobbyAppearanceIsMatchTreeObject(obj)
and not(debris and obj:IsDescendantOf(debris))
and not(inspectScene and obj:IsDescendantOf(inspectScene))
and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj)==nil then

local right=obj:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
local left=obj:FindFirstChild("LeftHand")
if right and left then
local score=0
if obj.Name=="StandaloneCharacter"or obj.Name=="MenuCharacter"then score+=30 end
if obj:FindFirstChild("CharacterArmor")then score+=18 end
if obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")then score+=8 end
if right:FindFirstChild("WeaponAttachment")then score+=24 end

local ancestor=obj.Parent
for _=1,5 do
if not ancestor or ancestor==Workspace then break end
if ancestor:FindFirstChild("PlayerPart")then
score+=30
break
end
local n=string.lower(tostring(ancestor.Name or""))
if string.find(n,"menu",1,true)or string.find(n,"scene",1,true)then
score+=6
end
ancestor=ancestor.Parent
end

if score>bestScore then
bestScore=score
best=obj
end
end
end
end

if best and bestScore>=18 then
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceCharacter=best
return best
end

Runtime.LobbyAppearanceCharacter=nil
return nil
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceDirectChildForPart(actor,part)
if not actor or not part then return nil end
local current=part
while current and current.Parent and current.Parent~=actor do
current=current.Parent
end
if current and current.Parent==actor then return current end
return nil
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceFindWeaponAttachment(actor,preferCVU)
if not actor then return nil,nil end
local right=actor:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
if not right then return nil,nil end
local fallback=nil
for _,child in ipairs(right:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("Motor6D")and child.Name=="WeaponAttachment"then
if child:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeaponMotor")==true then
return child,right
end
if not fallback then fallback=child end
end
end
if preferCVU then return nil,right end
return fallback,right
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceGetCurrentWeapon(actor)
local motor=select(1,CVU_LobbyAppearanceFindWeaponAttachment(actor,false))
if not motor or not motor.Part1 then return nil,nil,motor end
local model=CVU_LobbyAppearanceDirectChildForPart(actor,motor.Part1)
if not model or not model:IsA("Model")then return nil,nil,motor end
local weaponName=nil
if type(CVU_ResolveNativeGunName)=="function"then
weaponName=CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(model.Name)
end
if not weaponName and type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)=="function"and CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(model.Name)then
weaponName=model.Name
end
return model,weaponName,motor
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceFindModelPrimaryPart(model)
if not model or not model:IsA("Model")then return nil end
if model.PrimaryPart and model.PrimaryPart:IsA("BasePart")then return model.PrimaryPart end
local weapon=model:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
local insert=weapon and weapon:FindFirstChild("Insert")
if insert and insert:IsA("BasePart")then
model.PrimaryPart=insert
return insert
end
local fallback=model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
if fallback then model.PrimaryPart=fallback end
return fallback
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearancePrepareWeaponModel(model)
local primary=CVU_LobbyAppearanceFindModelPrimaryPart(model)
if not primary then return nil end
for _,obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")then
obj.CanCollide=false
obj.CanQuery=false
obj.CanTouch=false
obj.Anchored=false
obj.Massless=true
end
end
return primary
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceApplyWeaponMotorOffsets(motor,model,weaponName)
if not motor or not model then return end
if tostring(weaponName)=="AK-47"then
motor.C0=CFrame.new(-0.251,0.806,-0.406)*CFrame.Angles(0,-1.5707963267948966,1.5707963267948966)
return
end
local properties=model:FindFirstChild("Properties")
if not properties then return end
local c0=properties:FindFirstChild("C0")
local c1=properties:FindFirstChild("C1")
if c0 and c0:IsA("CFrameValue")then motor.C0=c0.Value end
if c1 and c1:IsA("CFrameValue")then motor.C1=c1.Value end
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceGetNativeWeapon(actor)
-- 只找 BloxStrike 自己掛上的 WeaponAttachment；CVU 建立的替換槍不算原生槍。
if not actor then return nil,nil,nil end
local right=actor:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
if not right then return nil,nil,nil end
for _,motor in ipairs(right:GetChildren())do
if motor:IsA("Motor6D")
and motor.Name=="WeaponAttachment"
and motor:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeaponMotor")~=true
and motor.Part1 then
local model=CVU_LobbyAppearanceDirectChildForPart(actor,motor.Part1)
if model and model:IsA("Model")
and model:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeapon")~=true then
local weaponName=nil
if type(CVU_ResolveNativeGunName)=="function"then
weaponName=CVU_ResolveNativeGunName(model.Name)
end
if not weaponName
and type(CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName)=="function"
and CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(model.Name)then
weaponName=model.Name
end
if weaponName then return model,weaponName,motor end
end
end
end
return nil,nil,nil
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceRememberNativeWeapon(snap,model,weaponName,motor)
if not snap or not model or not weaponName or not motor then return false end
local previous=snap.OriginalWeapon
local same=previous and tostring(previous.NativeWeaponName or"")==tostring(weaponName)
if same and previous.Model then
snap.NativeWeaponName=weaponName
return true
end

local ok,clone=pcall(function()return model:Clone()end)
if not ok or not clone then
snap.NativeWeaponName=weaponName
return false
end
clone.Parent=nil
if previous and previous.Model then
pcall(function()previous.Model:Destroy()end)
end
snap.NativeWeaponName=weaponName
snap.OriginalWeapon={
Model=clone,
Name=model.Name,
NativeWeaponName=weaponName,
C0=motor.C0,
C1=motor.C1,
}
return true
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceCapture(actor)
if not actor then return nil end
local snapshots=Runtime.LobbyAppearanceSnapshots
local snap=snapshots[actor]
if snap then return snap end

snap={
WeaponApplied=false,
LastWeaponSignature=nil,
NativeWeaponName=nil,
OriginalWeapon=nil,
GloveApplied=false,
OriginalGloves={},
LastGloveSignature=nil,
}

local nativeModel,nativeWeaponName,nativeMotor=CVU_LobbyAppearanceGetNativeWeapon(actor)
if nativeModel and nativeWeaponName and nativeMotor then
CVU_LobbyAppearanceRememberNativeWeapon(snap,nativeModel,nativeWeaponName,nativeMotor)
end

local armor=actor:FindFirstChild("CharacterArmor")
if armor then
for _,child in ipairs(armor:GetChildren())do
if child.Name=="RightGlove"or child.Name=="LeftGlove"then
local ok,clone=pcall(function()return child:Clone()end)
if ok and clone then
clone.Parent=nil
snap.OriginalGloves[#snap.OriginalGloves+1]={Name=child.Name,Model=clone}
end
end
end
end

snapshots[actor]=snap
return snap
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceClearGloves(actor)
if not actor then return end
local armor=actor:FindFirstChild("CharacterArmor")
if not armor then return end
local remove={}
for _,child in ipairs(armor:GetChildren())do
if child.Name=="RightGlove"
or child.Name=="LeftGlove"
or child:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceGlove")==true then
remove[#remove+1]=child
end
end
for _,child in ipairs(remove)do
if child and child.Parent then pcall(function()child:Destroy()end)end
end
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceRestoreGloves(actor,snap)
if not actor or not snap then return end
CVU_LobbyAppearanceClearGloves(actor)
local armor=actor:FindFirstChild("CharacterArmor")
if not armor then
armor=Instance.new("Folder")
armor.Name="CharacterArmor"
armor.Parent=actor
end
for _,stored in ipairs(snap.OriginalGloves or{})do
local template=stored and stored.Model
if template then
local ok,clone=pcall(function()return template:Clone()end)
if ok and clone then
clone.Name=tostring(stored.Name or clone.Name)
clone.Parent=armor
local hand=actor:FindFirstChild(clone.Name=="RightGlove"and"RightHand"or"LeftHand")
local motor=clone:FindFirstChild("GloveAttachment",true)
local part=clone:IsA("BasePart")and clone or clone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
if hand and part then
if not motor or not motor:IsA("Motor6D")then
motor=Instance.new("Motor6D")
motor.Name="GloveAttachment"
motor.Parent=part
end
motor.Part0=hand
motor.Part1=part
end
end
end
end
snap.GloveApplied=false
snap.LastGloveSignature=nil
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceGlovesHealthy(actor,signature)
local snap=Runtime.LobbyAppearanceSnapshots and Runtime.LobbyAppearanceSnapshots[actor]
if not snap or snap.LastGloveSignature~=signature then return false end
local armor=actor and actor:FindFirstChild("CharacterArmor")
if not armor then return false end
local rightCount=0
local leftCount=0
for _,child in ipairs(armor:GetChildren())do
if child.Name=="RightGlove"then
rightCount+=1
if child:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceGlove")~=true then return false end
elseif child.Name=="LeftGlove"then
leftCount+=1
if child:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceGlove")~=true then return false end
end
end
return rightCount==1 and leftCount==1
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceApplyGloves(actor,modelName,skinName,signature)
local snap=CVU_LobbyAppearanceCapture(actor)
if not snap then return false end
if CVU_LobbyAppearanceGlovesHealthy(actor,signature)then return true end

pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
local attach=CVU_LobbyAppearanceGetAttachGloves()
if type(attach)~="function"then return false end

modelName=tostring(modelName or"Sports Gloves")
skinName=tostring(skinName or"Stock")
local sourceModel=nil
local sourceChildren=nil
local lowerSkin=string.lower(skinName)

-- 自訂 skin 走原生 Skins.GetGloves；Stock / 空值走原生 Assets.Weapons glove folder。
if lowerSkin~=""and lowerSkin~="stock"and type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetGloves)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(lib.GetGloves,modelName,skinName,0)
if ok and result and result:IsA("Model")then
sourceModel=result
sourceChildren=result:GetChildren()
end
end

if not sourceChildren then
local folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder and Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder:FindFirstChild(modelName)
if folder then sourceChildren=folder:GetChildren()end
end

if not sourceChildren then
if sourceModel then sourceModel:Destroy()end
return false
end

local armor=actor:FindFirstChild("CharacterArmor")
if not armor then
armor=Instance.new("Folder")
armor.Name="CharacterArmor"
armor.Parent=actor
end

CVU_LobbyAppearanceClearGloves(actor)
local ok=pcall(attach,sourceChildren,actor,armor)
if sourceModel then sourceModel:Destroy()end
if not ok then
pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceRestoreGloves,actor,snap)
return false
end

local rightCount=0
local leftCount=0
for _,child in ipairs(armor:GetChildren())do
if child.Name=="RightGlove"or child.Name=="LeftGlove"then
child:SetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceGlove",true)
if child.Name=="RightGlove"then rightCount+=1 else leftCount+=1 end
end
end
if rightCount<1 or leftCount<1 then
pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceRestoreGloves,actor,snap)
return false
end

snap.GloveApplied=true
snap.LastGloveSignature=signature
return true
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceResolveNativeGun(actor,snap)
-- 每次先看遊戲有沒有重新掛回原生槍；若有，就以那把槍為唯一槍種來源。
local nativeModel,nativeWeaponName,nativeMotor=CVU_LobbyAppearanceGetNativeWeapon(actor)
if nativeModel and nativeWeaponName and nativeMotor then
CVU_LobbyAppearanceRememberNativeWeapon(snap,nativeModel,nativeWeaponName,nativeMotor)
return nativeWeaponName
end

-- CVU 真模型替換期間，原生 Model 已被移除，所以使用第一次捕捉到的原生槍種。
local remembered=snap and snap.NativeWeaponName
if type(remembered)=="string"and remembered~=""then return remembered end
if snap and snap.OriginalWeapon then
local originalName=snap.OriginalWeapon.NativeWeaponName
if type(originalName)=="string"and originalName~=""then return originalName end
end

-- 新版自己建立的 Model 會保存 NativeWeaponName；只接受這個明確標記，不拿 UI 槍種猜。
local currentModel=select(1,CVU_LobbyAppearanceGetCurrentWeapon(actor))
if currentModel and currentModel:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeapon")==true then
local tagged=currentModel:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyNativeWeapon")
if type(tagged)=="string"and tagged~=""then return tagged end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceGetDesiredGun(actor,snap)
-- Lobby 槍種永遠跟 BloxStrike 原生展示槍一致。
-- UI 可以選其他槍的 Skin，但絕對不能因此把 M4A1-S 換成 AK-47（或反過來）。
local weaponName=CVU_LobbyAppearanceResolveNativeGun(actor,snap)
if type(weaponName)~="string"or weaponName==""then return nil,nil,nil end

local memory=type(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)=="table"and Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory or{}
local skinName=memory[weaponName]
if type(skinName)~="string"or skinName==""then
if tostring(Settings.GunExperience or"")==weaponName then
skinName=Settings.GunExperienceSkin
end
end
if type(skinName)~="string"or skinName==""then skinName="Stock"end

local cfg=nil
if string.lower(skinName)~="stock"then
cfg=CVU_GetGunSkinConfig(weaponName,skinName,false)
end
return weaponName,skinName,cfg
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceBuildWeaponSignature(weaponName,skinName,cfg)
local signature={tostring(weaponName),tostring(skinName)}
if type(cfg)=="table"then
signature[#signature+1]=string.format("%.4f",tonumber(cfg.Wear)or 0)
signature[#signature+1]=tostring(cfg.StatTrakEnabled==true)
if cfg.StatTrakEnabled==true then
signature[#signature+1]=tostring(CVU_GetGunKillCounterValue(weaponName,skinName,false))
end
signature[#signature+1]=tostring(cfg.NameSuffix or"")
if type(cfg.Charm)=="table"then
signature[#signature+1]=tostring(cfg.Charm.Skin or"")
signature[#signature+1]=tostring(cfg.Charm.Pattern or"")
signature[#signature+1]=tostring(cfg.Charm.Position or"")
else
signature[#signature+1]=""
end
if type(cfg.Stickers)=="table"then
for i=1,5 do signature[#signature+1]=tostring(cfg.Stickers[i]or"")end
end
end
return table.concat(signature,"|")
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceBuildNativeGun(weaponName,skinName,cfg)
pcall(CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData,false)
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
if type(lib)~="table"then return nil end

skinName=tostring(skinName or"Stock")
local lowerSkin=string.lower(skinName)
local model=nil

if lowerSkin~=""and lowerSkin~="stock"and type(lib.GetCharacterModel)=="function"then
local wear=0
local statTrak=nil
local nameTag=nil
local charm=nil
local stickers=nil
if type(cfg)=="table"then
wear=math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.Wear)or 0,0,1)
if cfg.StatTrakEnabled==true then
statTrak=CVU_GetGunKillCounterValue(weaponName,skinName,false)
end
nameTag=(type(cfg.NameSuffix)=="string"and cfg.NameSuffix~="")and cfg.NameSuffix or nil
charm=CVU_BuildCharmPayload(cfg)
stickers=CVU_BuildFixedStickerPayload(cfg)
end
local ok,result=pcall(
lib.GetCharacterModel,
weaponName,
skinName,
wear,
statTrak,
nameTag,
charm,
stickers,
nil
)
if ok and result and result:IsA("Model")then model=result end
end

if not model then
if lowerSkin~="stock"and lowerSkin~=""then
-- 自訂 skin 建立失敗時不偷退 Stock；保留失敗狀態讓下一次 refresh 重試。
return nil
end
if type(lib.GetBaseWeaponModel)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(lib.GetBaseWeaponModel,weaponName,"Character")
if ok and result and result:IsA("Model")then model=result end
end
if not model then
local folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder and Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
local template=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Character")
if template then
local ok,result=pcall(function()return template:Clone()end)
if ok and result and result:IsA("Model")then model=result end
end
end
end

if not model then return nil end
model.Name=weaponName
local primary=CVU_LobbyAppearancePrepareWeaponModel(model)
if not primary then
pcall(function()model:Destroy()end)
return nil
end
model:SetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeapon",true)
return model
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeaponHealthy(actor,signature)
local motor=select(1,CVU_LobbyAppearanceFindWeaponAttachment(actor,true))
if not motor or not motor.Part1 then return false end
local model=CVU_LobbyAppearanceDirectChildForPart(actor,motor.Part1)
if not model or not model:IsA("Model")then return false end
if model:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeapon")~=true then return false end
if model:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyWeaponSignature")~=signature then return false end
local right=actor:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
if not right then return false end
for _,child in ipairs(right:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("Motor6D")and child.Name=="WeaponAttachment"and child~=motor then
return false
end
end
return true
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceApplyGunNative(actor)
local snap=CVU_LobbyAppearanceCapture(actor)
if not snap then return false end
local weaponName,skinName,cfg=CVU_LobbyAppearanceGetDesiredGun(actor,snap)
if not weaponName then return false end
local signature=CVU_LobbyAppearanceBuildWeaponSignature(weaponName,skinName,cfg)
if snap.LastWeaponSignature==signature and CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeaponHealthy(actor,signature)then
return true
end

local oldMotor,right=CVU_LobbyAppearanceFindWeaponAttachment(actor,false)
if not right then return false end
local oldModel=nil
if oldMotor and oldMotor.Part1 then oldModel=CVU_LobbyAppearanceDirectChildForPart(actor,oldMotor.Part1)end

local newModel=CVU_LobbyAppearanceBuildNativeGun(weaponName,skinName,cfg)
if not newModel then return false end
local primary=newModel.PrimaryPart or CVU_LobbyAppearanceFindModelPrimaryPart(newModel)
if not primary then newModel:Destroy()return false end

-- 先建立新 Model + 新 WeaponAttachment，確認掛上手之後才刪舊的。
newModel.Parent=actor
local newMotor=Instance.new("Motor6D")
newMotor.Name="WeaponAttachment"
newMotor.Part0=right
newMotor.Part1=primary
newMotor:SetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeaponMotor",true)
CVU_LobbyAppearanceApplyWeaponMotorOffsets(newMotor,newModel,weaponName)
newMotor.Parent=right
newModel:SetAttribute("CVU_LobbyWeaponSignature",signature)
newModel:SetAttribute("CVU_LobbyNativeWeapon",weaponName)
newModel:SetAttribute("CVU_LobbySkinWeapon",weaponName)
newModel:SetAttribute("CVU_LobbySkinName",skinName)

-- 新槍已經掛好，現在才清掉舊 Attachment / 舊 Model 以及任何重複 Attachment。
for _,child in ipairs(right:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("Motor6D")and child.Name=="WeaponAttachment"and child~=newMotor then
pcall(function()child:Destroy()end)
end
end
if oldModel and oldModel~=newModel and oldModel.Parent then
pcall(function()oldModel:Destroy()end)
end
-- 若舊 Model 沒被 oldMotor 指到，也只清掉本系統先前建立的 Lobby weapon。
for _,child in ipairs(actor:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("Model")and child~=newModel and child:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeapon")==true then
pcall(function()child:Destroy()end)
end
end

snap.WeaponApplied=true
snap.LastWeaponSignature=signature
return true
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceRestoreWeapon(actor,snap)
if not actor or not snap then return end
local right=actor:FindFirstChild("RightHand")
if not right then return end

-- 先移除本系統建立的 weapon / attachment；若遊戲原生已經自行重建，就不再補第二把。
for _,child in ipairs(right:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("Motor6D")and child.Name=="WeaponAttachment"
and child:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeaponMotor")==true then
pcall(function()child:Destroy()end)
end
end
for _,child in ipairs(actor:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("Model")and child:GetAttribute("CVU_LobbyAppearanceWeapon")==true then
pcall(function()child:Destroy()end)
end
end

local nativeMotor=nil
for _,child in ipairs(right:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("Motor6D")and child.Name=="WeaponAttachment"then nativeMotor=child break end
end
if not nativeMotor and snap.OriginalWeapon and snap.OriginalWeapon.Model then
local ok,model=pcall(function()return snap.OriginalWeapon.Model:Clone()end)
if ok and model then
model.Name=tostring(snap.OriginalWeapon.Name or model.Name)
local primary=CVU_LobbyAppearancePrepareWeaponModel(model)
if primary then
model.Parent=actor
local motor=Instance.new("Motor6D")
motor.Name="WeaponAttachment"
motor.Part0=right
motor.Part1=primary
motor.C0=snap.OriginalWeapon.C0 or CFrame.new()
motor.C1=snap.OriginalWeapon.C1 or CFrame.new()
motor.Parent=right
else
model:Destroy()
end
end
end
snap.WeaponApplied=false
snap.LastWeaponSignature=nil
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceRefresh(force)
local actor=CVU_LobbyAppearanceFindCharacter(force)
if not actor then return false end

-- 槍械：保留 BloxStrike Lobby 原生槍種，只替該槍套用自己記住的 Character skin model。
pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceApplyGunNative,actor)

-- 手套：Lobby 不受 Experience Enabled 限制；Stock / 自訂 skin 都正常展示。
local modelName=tostring(Settings.GloveExperience or"Sports Gloves")
local skinName=tostring(Settings.GloveExperienceSkin or"Stock")
if skinName==""then skinName="Stock"end
local gloveSignature=modelName.."|"..skinName
pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceApplyGloves,actor,modelName,skinName,gloveSignature)
return true
end

function CVU_LobbyAppearanceShutdown()
for actor,snap in pairs(Runtime.LobbyAppearanceSnapshots or{})do
if actor and actor.Parent and snap then
pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceRestoreWeapon,actor,snap)
pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceRestoreGloves,actor,snap)
end
end
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceSnapshots=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceCharacter=nil
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceLastSignature=nil
end

Runtime.LobbyAppearanceHeartbeat=0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceHeartbeat+=(dt or 0)
if Runtime.LobbyAppearanceHeartbeat<0.45 then return end
Runtime.LobbyAppearanceHeartbeat=0
pcall(CVU_LobbyAppearanceRefresh,false)
end)

if type(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs)~="table"or next(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs)==nil then
Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs=CVU_CopyGunSkinConfigs(Settings.GunSkinConfigs)
end

function CVU_GetAppliedGunExperienceSkin(weaponName,originalSkin)
local memory=Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkinMemory
if type(memory)=="table"and type(memory[weaponName])=="string"then
return memory[weaponName]
end
if weaponName==Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedWeapon
and type(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkin)=="string"then
return Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkin
end
return originalSkin
end

-- ============================================================
-- Gun HUD name sync
-- 顯示格式：
-- AK-47 | Redline
-- AWP | 6767
-- 自訂名稱會取代 skin 顯示名稱；Stock 不顯示 skin 名。
-- ============================================================
Runtime.GunHUDNameSyncStarted=Runtime.GunHUDNameSyncStarted or false
Runtime.GunHUDSlots=Runtime.GunHUDSlots or{}
Runtime.GunHUDOriginalTexts=Runtime.GunHUDOriginalTexts or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GunHUDLastTexts=Runtime.GunHUDLastTexts or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GunHUDInstanceConnections=Runtime.GunHUDInstanceConnections or{}
Runtime.GunHUDPlayerGuiConnection=Runtime.GunHUDPlayerGuiConnection or nil
Runtime.GunHUDBindQueued=false
Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard=false
Runtime.NativeEquipHUDConnection=Runtime.NativeEquipHUDConnection or nil
Runtime.NativeEquipHUDSyncStarted=Runtime.NativeEquipHUDSyncStarted or false

function CVU_GunHUDImageKey(value)
local normalized=value
if type(CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(CVU_NormalizeWeaponIconValue,value)
if ok and result then normalized=result end
end
normalized=tostring(normalized or"")
if normalized==""then return nil end
return string.lower(normalized):gsub("%s+","")
end

function CVU_GetGunHUDWeaponProperties(weaponName)
if type(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties)=="function"then
local ok,props=pcall(Runtime.BloxStrikeGetWeaponProperties,weaponName)
if ok and type(props)=="table"then return props end
end

local ok,getter=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Components.Common.GetWeaponProperties)
end)
if ok and type(getter)=="function"then
local okProps,props=pcall(getter,weaponName)
if okProps and type(props)=="table"then return props end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_FindGunHUDSlots()
local cached=Runtime.GunHUDSlots
local valid=type(cached)=="table"and #cached>0

if valid then
for _,slot in ipairs(cached)do
if not(slot.Frame and slot.Frame.Parent
and slot.Weapon and slot.Weapon.Parent
and slot.Label and slot.Label.Parent
and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(slot.Frame)
and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(slot.Weapon)
and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(slot.Label))then
valid=false
break
end
end
end

if valid then return cached end

Runtime.GunHUDSlots={}
local playerGui=LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
if not playerGui then return Runtime.GunHUDSlots end

-- BloxStrike Gameplay/Bottom/Inventory:
-- Primary / Secondary -> Weapon -> WeaponName
for _,candidate in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants())do
if candidate:IsA("GuiObject")
and(candidate.Name=="Primary"or candidate.Name=="Secondary")
and candidate:FindFirstChild("Keybind")then

local weapon=candidate:FindFirstChild("Weapon")
if weapon then
local label=weapon:FindFirstChild("WeaponName")
if label and not label:IsA("TextLabel")then
label=label:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel",true)
end

if label and label:IsA("TextLabel")and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(label)
and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(candidate)and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(weapon)then
Runtime.GunHUDSlots[#Runtime.GunHUDSlots+1]={
Frame=candidate,
Weapon=weapon,
Label=label,
Slot=candidate.Name,
}
end
end
end
end

return Runtime.GunHUDSlots
end

function CVU_GetGunHUDVisibleImage(slot)
if type(slot)~="table"or not slot.Weapon then return nil end

for _,obj in ipairs(slot.Weapon:GetChildren())do
if obj:IsA("ImageLabel")and obj.Visible and tostring(obj.Image or"")~=""then
return CVU_GunHUDImageKey(obj.Image)
end
end

for _,obj in ipairs(slot.Weapon:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("ImageLabel")and obj.Visible and tostring(obj.Image or"")~=""then
return CVU_GunHUDImageKey(obj.Image)
end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_BuildGunHUDNameTargets()
local targets={}
if Settings.GunExperienceEnabled~=true then return targets end

-- HUD 應顯示「目前真正套用」的設定，不顯示仍在等待下一局的 pending 設定。
local skinMemory=
type(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkinMemory)=="table"
and Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkinMemory
or Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory

local configRoot=
type(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs)=="table"
and next(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs)
and Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs
or Settings.GunSkinConfigs

local currentWeapon=
Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedWeapon or Settings.GunExperience
local currentSkin=
Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkin or Settings.GunExperienceSkin

for weaponName,weaponConfigs in pairs(type(configRoot)=="table"and configRoot or{})do
if type(weaponName)=="string"and type(weaponConfigs)=="table"then
local skinName=type(skinMemory)=="table"and skinMemory[weaponName]or nil

if (type(skinName)~="string"or skinName=="")and weaponName==currentWeapon then
skinName=currentSkin
end

if type(skinName)=="string"and skinName~=""then
local cfg=weaponConfigs[skinName]
local skinDisplay=CVU_GetHUDSkinDisplayName(skinName)
local suffix=type(cfg)=="table"and tostring(cfg.NameSuffix or"")or""

local parts={weaponName}

-- 自訂名稱取代 skin 顯示名稱，而不是再多加第三段。
-- 例：
-- AWP | Dragon Lore
-- 自訂 6767 -> AWP | 6767
if suffix~=""then
parts[#parts+1]=suffix
elseif skinDisplay~=""then
parts[#parts+1]=skinDisplay
end

local props=CVU_GetGunHUDWeaponProperties(weaponName)
if type(props)=="table"then
local target={
WeaponName=weaponName,
SkinName=skinName,
Text=table.concat(parts," | "),
}

local iconKey=CVU_GunHUDImageKey(props.Icon)
local reverseKey=CVU_GunHUDImageKey(props.ReverseIcon)
if iconKey then targets[iconKey]=target end
if reverseKey then targets[reverseKey]=target end
end
end
end
end

return targets
end

function CVU_RestoreGunHUDNames()
Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard=true
for label,original in pairs(Runtime.GunHUDOriginalTexts or{})do
if label and label.Parent and label:IsA("TextLabel")and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(label)then
local lastText=Runtime.GunHUDLastTexts[label]
-- 遊戲已經自行刷新成另一把槍時不要用舊名稱覆蓋。
if lastText and label.Text==lastText then
pcall(function()label.Text=original or""end)
end
end
end
Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard=false

Runtime.GunHUDOriginalTexts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GunHUDLastTexts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
end

function CVU_UpdateGunHUDNames()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard then return false end

if Settings.GunExperienceEnabled~=true then
CVU_RestoreGunHUDNames()
return false
end

-- 槍械 skin 名 / 自定名稱同樣只屬於自己的 gameplay HUD。
-- 觀戰別人時，不能把自己的 AWP | 6767 套到別人的武器欄。
if not CVU_IsLocalGameplayHUDContext()then
CVU_RestoreGunHUDNames()
return false
end

local targets=CVU_BuildGunHUDNameTargets()
local slots=CVU_FindGunHUDSlots()
Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard=true
local ok,err=pcall(function()
for _,slot in ipairs(slots)do
local label=slot.Label
local imageKey=CVU_GetGunHUDVisibleImage(slot)
local target=imageKey and targets[imageKey]or nil

if label and label.Parent and CVU_IsLocalHUDObject(label)and target then
local previousLast=Runtime.GunHUDLastTexts[label]

-- 第一次接管，或遊戲剛重畫了原生名稱時，重新記錄原生文字。
if Runtime.GunHUDOriginalTexts[label]==nil
or(previousLast and label.Text~=previousLast)then
Runtime.GunHUDOriginalTexts[label]=label.Text
end

if label.Text~=target.Text then label.Text=target.Text end
label.Visible=true
Runtime.GunHUDLastTexts[label]=target.Text

elseif label and Runtime.GunHUDLastTexts[label]then
local lastText=Runtime.GunHUDLastTexts[label]
local original=Runtime.GunHUDOriginalTexts[label]

if label.Text==lastText then
pcall(function()label.Text=original or""end)
end

Runtime.GunHUDOriginalTexts[label]=nil
Runtime.GunHUDLastTexts[label]=nil
end
end
end)
Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard=false
if not ok then warn("[GunHUD sync]",err)return false end
return true
end

function CVU_DisconnectGunHUDInstanceListeners()
for _,connection in ipairs(Runtime.GunHUDInstanceConnections or{})do
pcall(function()connection:Disconnect()end)
end
Runtime.GunHUDInstanceConnections={}
end

function CVU_QueueGunHUDBind()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Runtime.GunHUDBindQueued then return end
Runtime.GunHUDBindQueued=true
task.defer(function()
Runtime.GunHUDBindQueued=false
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
CVU_DisconnectGunHUDInstanceListeners()
Runtime.GunHUDSlots={}
local slots=CVU_FindGunHUDSlots()
local connections=Runtime.GunHUDInstanceConnections

for _,slot in ipairs(slots)do
local label=slot.Label
if label and label.Parent then
connections[#connections+1]=label:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard then return end
-- 切槍時 BloxStrike 會先把 WeaponName 重畫成原生名稱；
-- 等這次 UI 寫入結束後，立即用目前 icon 對回 Weapon + Skin 設定。
task.defer(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard then return end
pcall(CVU_UpdateGunHUDNames)
end)
end)
end

if slot.Weapon and slot.Weapon.Parent then
for _,obj in ipairs(slot.Weapon:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("ImageLabel")then
connections[#connections+1]=obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard then return end
task.defer(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Runtime.GunHUDWriteGuard then return end
pcall(CVU_UpdateGunHUDNames)
end)
end)
end
end
end

if slot.Frame and slot.Frame.Parent then
connections[#connections+1]=slot.Frame.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_,parent)
if parent==nil then
Runtime.GunHUDSlots={}
CVU_QueueGunHUDBind()
end
end)
end
end

pcall(CVU_UpdateGunHUDNames)
end)
end

function CVU_StopGunHUDNameSync()
CVU_DisconnectGunHUDInstanceListeners()
if Runtime.GunHUDPlayerGuiConnection then
pcall(function()Runtime.GunHUDPlayerGuiConnection:Disconnect()end)
Runtime.GunHUDPlayerGuiConnection=nil
end
Runtime.GunHUDNameSyncStarted=false
Runtime.GunHUDBindQueued=false
end

function CVU_StartGunHUDNameSync()
if Runtime.GunHUDNameSyncStarted then return end
Runtime.GunHUDNameSyncStarted=true

-- 初始 bind 一次。之後不再用 0.35 秒 polling 掃 HUD。
CVU_QueueGunHUDBind()

-- HUD 被重建時才重新找 Primary / Secondary / WeaponName。
Runtime.GunHUDPlayerGuiConnection=PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
local name=obj.Name
if name=="Primary"or name=="Secondary"or name=="Weapon"or name=="WeaponName"then
CVU_QueueGunHUDBind()
end
end)
end

CVU_StartGunHUDNameSync()

-- ============================================================
-- Native weapon-switch HUD sync
-- BloxStrike InventoryController.OnInventoryItemEquipped 是真正的本機切槍事件。
-- 不提高 polling 頻率；切到 Primary / Secondary / Melee 時才同步對應 HUD。
-- ============================================================
function CVU_StartNativeEquipHUDSync()
if Runtime.NativeEquipHUDSyncStarted then return end
Runtime.NativeEquipHUDSyncStarted=true

local ok,controller=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Controllers.InventoryController)
end)
if not ok or type(controller)~="table"then return end

local signal=controller.OnInventoryItemEquipped
if not signal or type(signal.Connect)~="function"then return end

Runtime.NativeEquipHUDConnection=signal:Connect(function(_,item)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
local slot=nil
pcall(function()
slot=item and item.Properties and item.Properties.Slot or nil
end)

-- 原生 Inventory HUD 自己也監聽同一個事件。
-- defer 到本次事件派送結束，避免我們先寫、原版後寫又蓋回去。
task.defer(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if slot=="Melee"then
CVU_QueueKnifeHUDBind()
CVU_RefreshKnifeHUDFromEvent()
elseif slot=="Primary"or slot=="Secondary"then
CVU_QueueGunHUDBind()
pcall(CVU_UpdateGunHUDNames)
else
-- 少數切換資料沒有 Slot 時，不猜武器；只讓兩邊各自依目前 HUD cache 驗證。
CVU_QueueKnifeHUDBind()
CVU_QueueGunHUDBind()
end
end)
end)
end

CVU_StartNativeEquipHUDSync()

GUI.Destroying:Connect(function()
pcall(CVU_StopGunHUDNameSync)
if Runtime.NativeEquipHUDConnection then
pcall(function()Runtime.NativeEquipHUDConnection:Disconnect()end)
Runtime.NativeEquipHUDConnection=nil
end
Runtime.NativeEquipHUDSyncStarted=false
end)

function CVU_QueueGunExperienceNextRound(reason)
Runtime.GunExperiencePending=true
Runtime.GunExperiencePendingSerial=(Runtime.GunExperiencePendingSerial or 0)+1
Runtime.GunExperienceStatus="已更換；下一局套用｜"..
tostring(Settings.GunExperience).."｜"..tostring(Settings.GunExperienceSkin or"Stock")
CVU_ShowKnifeExperienceToast(
"你已更換，下一局才會套用",
"槍械  |  "..tostring(Settings.GunExperience).."  |  "..
tostring(Settings.GunExperienceSkin or"Stock"),
3.4
)
return true
end

function CVU_CommitGunExperienceNextRound(reason)
if Runtime.Shutdown or not Runtime.GunExperiencePending then return false end
CVU_RememberGunSkin(false)
Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedEnabled=Settings.GunExperienceEnabled==true
Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedWeapon=Settings.GunExperience or"AK-47"
Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkin=Settings.GunExperienceSkin or"Stock"
Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkinMemory=
CVU_CopyGunExperienceSkinMemory(Settings.GunExperienceSkinMemory)
Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedConfigs=CVU_CopyGunSkinConfigs(Settings.GunSkinConfigs)
Runtime.GunKillCounterAppliedEnabled={}
for weaponName,skinName in pairs(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkinMemory or{})do
if CVU_IsGunKillCounterApplied(weaponName,skinName)then
Runtime.GunKillCounterAppliedEnabled[weaponName]=true
end
end
-- 新一局提交后要等该枪的 GetCameraModel 确实带着 StatTrak 建好，
-- 在此之前监听器不能提前累计击杀。
Runtime.GunKillCounterVisualReady={}
Runtime.GunKillCounterLastAppliedWeapon=nil
Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotWeapon=nil
Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotEnabled=false
Runtime.GunKillCounterLastShotAt=0
Runtime.GunKillCounterRecentTargets=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GunExperiencePending=false
Runtime.GunExperienceLastCommitReason=tostring(reason or"NextRound")
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeGun=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeGunSkin=nil
if Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedEnabled then
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook)
Runtime.GunExperienceStatus="新一局設定已提交｜"..
tostring(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedWeapon).."｜"..
tostring(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkin)
else
Runtime.GunExperienceStatus="體驗槍械：OFF（新一局已恢復原版）"
end
CVU_ShowKnifeExperienceToast(
"體驗槍械已套用",
Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedEnabled and (
tostring(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedWeapon).."  |  "..
tostring(Runtime.GunExperienceAppliedSkin)
)or"OFF｜恢復原版槍械",
2.2
)
return true
end

function CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook()
pcall(CVU_BS_InstallGunStatTrakHook)
if Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelHooked
and Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelModule
and Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelWrapper
and Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelModule.new==Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelWrapper then
return true
end

CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)

local classes=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Classes")
local weaponComponent=classes and classes:FindFirstChild("WeaponComponent")or nil
local vmClasses=weaponComponent and weaponComponent:FindFirstChild("Classes")or nil
local vmModuleScript=vmClasses and vmClasses:FindFirstChild("Viewmodel")or nil
local vmModule=CVU_BS_SafeRequire(vmModuleScript)

if type(vmModule)~="table"or type(vmModule.new)~="function"then
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildError="找不到 RS.Classes.WeaponComponent.Classes.Viewmodel.new"
return false
end

-- 如果之前的 wrapper 被遊戲/其他腳本換掉，重新以目前函式作為 base。
local original=vmModule.new
if Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelWrapper
and original==Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelWrapper
and type(Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelOriginalNew)=="function"then
original=Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelOriginalNew
end

local wrapper
wrapper=function(comp,weapon,skin,inspecting,...)
local buildArgs=table.pack(comp,weapon,skin,inspecting,...)
local localBuild=not CVU_BS_ArgsReferenceRemotePlayer(buildArgs)
and CVU_BS_IsLocalViewmodelComponent(comp)
local function callOriginal(...)
if localBuild then
return CVU_BS_CallInsideLocalViewmodelBuild(original,...)
end
return original(...)
end

if not Runtime.Shutdown
and Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
and localBuild
and type(weapon)=="string"
and CVU_BS_IsNativeKnifeName(weapon)then

local appliedType=CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType()
local desiredWeapon=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(appliedType)
if desiredWeapon then
local desiredSkin=CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceSkin()

-- 選單資料可能比 ViewModel 晚載入；若指定 skin 已不存在就退 Stock，
-- 但刀型仍然要換，不能整個失敗後留回原版刀。
local available=CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(desiredWeapon,false)
if not table.find(available,desiredSkin)then
desiredSkin="Stock"
end

-- 切回體驗刀具時先把上一個 ViewModel 的自訂 action 狀態全部作廢。
-- 尤其 Butterfly Inspect 不能跨武器延續。
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpCancelActionState,"NativeViewmodelRebuild",true)

local ok,result=pcall(
callOriginal,
comp,
desiredWeapon,
desiredSkin,
false, -- 永遠從 fresh equip state 建立，不繼承上一把刀的 inspecting=true
...
)
if ok and result then
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildMethod="Viewmodel.new native swap"
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildError=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeBuildSerial=(Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeBuildSerial or 0)+1
Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeBuildAt=os.clock()
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeKnife=desiredWeapon
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeSkin=desiredSkin
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName=desiredWeapon
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveSkin=desiredSkin
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveType=appliedType
Runtime.KnifeExperienceNativeFullVM=true
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus=
"原生 Viewmodel.new｜"..desiredWeapon.."｜"..desiredSkin

-- 到這裡 original Viewmodel.new 已經成功回傳，才算「刀真的套上」。
Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedType=appliedType
Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedSkin=desiredSkin
Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedCustomName=CVU_GetKnifeConfiguredCustomName(desiredWeapon,desiredSkin)
pcall(CVU_UpdateKnifeHUDIcon,appliedType)

task.defer(function()
if Runtime.Shutdown
or not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
or Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeKnife~=desiredWeapon then return end
CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache()
pcall(CVU_BS_LoadNativeKnifeTracks,desiredWeapon)
task.spawn(function()
local sounds=CVU_BS_GetSoundRoot(desiredWeapon)
if sounds then pcall(CVU_BS_PreloadInstance,sounds)end
end)
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpBindFeedbackActions)
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpScheduleOriginalSoundMute)

if Settings.GhostArms then
pcall(CVU_ApplyGhostArms)
end

if Settings.GlassWeapon and CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="glass"then
pcall(CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel)
end
end)

return result
end

Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildError=
"Viewmodel.new swap failed: "..tostring(result)
end
end

if not Runtime.Shutdown
and localBuild
and CVU_GetAppliedGunExperienceEnabled()
and type(weapon)=="string"
and CVU_BS_IsNativeGunName(weapon)then
-- 槍械體驗只換目前這把槍自己的 skin；weapon 永遠沿用遊戲傳入值。
-- 名稱標籤必須在 Viewmodel.new 讀取 component.NameTag 之前就注入。
-- BloxStrike 的 Viewmodel.new 會把 comp.NameTag 複製到 Viewmodel.NameTag，
-- 所以這裡暫時覆寫 component，建完後立刻還原，避免污染遊戲自己的資料。
local desiredSkin=CVU_GetAppliedGunExperienceSkin(weapon,skin)
if type(desiredSkin)~="string"or desiredSkin==""then desiredSkin=skin end

local cfg=CVU_GetGunExperienceConfig(weapon,desiredSkin,true)
local hasNameOverride=type(cfg)=="table"
local desiredNameTag=nil
if hasNameOverride and type(cfg.NameSuffix)=="string"and cfg.NameSuffix~=""then
desiredNameTag=cfg.NameSuffix
end

Runtime.GunNameTagLastWeapon=weapon
Runtime.GunNameTagLastValue=desiredNameTag

local extraArgs=table.pack(...)
local function callGunOriginal(targetSkin)
local canOverride=hasNameOverride and type(comp)=="table"
local oldNameTag=nil
if canOverride then
oldNameTag=rawget(comp,"NameTag")
local okSet=pcall(function()comp.NameTag=desiredNameTag end)
if not okSet then canOverride=false end
end

local results=table.pack(pcall(
callOriginal,
comp,
weapon,
targetSkin,
inspecting,
table.unpack(extraArgs,1,extraArgs.n)
))

if canOverride then
pcall(function()comp.NameTag=oldNameTag end)
end

if not results[1]then error(results[2],0)end
return table.unpack(results,2,results.n)
end

-- 即使 skin 沒有改變，也必須走 callGunOriginal，
-- 因為使用者可能只改了自定名稱。
if desiredSkin==skin then
return callGunOriginal(skin)
end

local available=CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(weapon,false)
if not table.find(available,desiredSkin)then
return callGunOriginal(skin)
end

local ok,result=pcall(callGunOriginal,desiredSkin)
if ok and result then
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeGun=weapon
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeGunSkin=desiredSkin
Runtime.GunExperienceStatus="原生 Viewmodel.new｜"..
weapon.."｜皮膚/名稱｜"..desiredSkin..
(desiredNameTag and("｜"..desiredNameTag)or"")
return result
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildError=
"Gun skin/name swap failed: "..tostring(result)
end

return callOriginal(comp,weapon,skin,inspecting,...)
end

Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelModule=vmModule
Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelOriginalNew=original
Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelWrapper=wrapper
vmModule.new=wrapper
Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelHooked=true
return true
end

function CVU_BS_UninstallNativeViewmodelHook()
local module=Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelModule
local wrapper=Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelWrapper
local original=Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelOriginalNew

if module and wrapper and original then
pcall(function()
if module.new==wrapper then
module.new=original
end
end)
end

Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelHooked=false
Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelModule=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelOriginalNew=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelWrapper=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeNativeSwapRequestKey=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeLocalViewmodelBuildDepth=0
Runtime.BloxStrikeLocalViewmodelBuildThreads=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
pcall(CVU_BS_UninstallGunStatTrakHook)
end

if not folder then return out end

function CVU_BS_GetWeaponInfo(weaponName)
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)
local info={
Name=tostring(weaponName or""),
Exists=false,
Class=nil,
Type=nil,
HasCamera=false,
HasAnimations=false,
HasSounds=false,
}
local folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder and Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder:FindFirstChild(info.Name)
info.Exists=folder~=nil
info.HasCamera=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Camera")~=nil or false
info.HasAnimations=CVU_BS_GetAnimationFolder(info.Name)~=nil
info.HasSounds=CVU_BS_GetSoundRoot(info.Name)~=nil
