function CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(weaponName,force)
if type(weaponName)~="string"or weaponName==""then return{"Stock"}end
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)

if not force and Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinCache[weaponName]then
return Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinCache[weaponName]
end

local out={"Stock"}
local seen={Stock=true}
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib

-- 與參考程式相同，直接以 Assets.Skins/<武器>/<皮膚> 的資料夾名稱建立選項。
local directFolder=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder
and Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsFolder:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
if directFolder then
for _,entry in ipairs(directFolder:GetChildren())do
local name=entry.Name
if type(name)=="string"and name~=""and not seen[name]then
seen[name]=true
out[#out+1]=name
end
end
end

if type(lib)=="table"and type(lib.GetAllSkinsForWeapon)=="function"then
local ok,list=pcall(lib.GetAllSkinsForWeapon,weaponName)
if ok and type(list)=="table"then
for _,entry in ipairs(list)do
local name=nil
if type(entry)=="string"then
name=entry
elseif type(entry)=="table"then
name=entry.skin or entry.name
end
if type(name)=="string"and name~=""and not seen[name]then
seen[name]=true
out[#out+1]=name
end
end
end
end

table.sort(out,function(a,b)
if a=="Stock"then return true end
if b=="Stock"then return false end
return string.lower(a)<string.lower(b)
end)

Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinCache[weaponName]=out
return out
end

-- Each knife keeps its own pending skin in the existing saved settings.
function CVU_RememberKnifeSkin()
if type(Settings.KnifeExperienceSkinMemory)~="table"then
Settings.KnifeExperienceSkinMemory={}
end
Settings.KnifeExperienceSkinMemory[Settings.KnifeExperience]=Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin or"Stock"
end
function CVU_BS_RefreshKnifeSkinOptions(typeName)
typeName=typeName or Settings.KnifeExperience
if type(Settings.KnifeExperienceSkinMemory)~="table"then
Settings.KnifeExperienceSkinMemory={}
end

local remembered=Settings.KnifeExperienceSkinMemory[typeName]
-- 舊版把 Stock 當刀具 skin；現在 Stock 專門保留給 HUD icon。
-- 舊設定若是 Stock，直接視為沒有記憶，稍後改用 Vanilla。
if remembered==nil and typeName==Settings.KnifeExperience then
remembered=Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin
end
if string.lower(tostring(remembered or""))=="stock"then remembered=nil end

local weaponName=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(typeName)
local values=Runtime.KnifeExperienceSkinOptions or {}
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSkinOptions=values
table.clear(values)

local source=weaponName and CVU_BS_GetSkinsForWeapon(weaponName,false)or{}
local vanilla=nil
local others={}

for _,name in ipairs(source)do
name=tostring(name or"")
local lower=string.lower(name)
if name~=""and lower~="stock"then
if lower=="vanilla"then
vanilla=name
else
others[#others+1]=name
end
end
end

table.sort(others,function(a,b)return string.lower(a)<string.lower(b)end)
if vanilla then values[#values+1]=vanilla end
for _,name in ipairs(others)do values[#values+1]=name end

-- 正常刀型都有 Vanilla；極端情況沒有時，不把 Stock 加回 skin 選單。
if #values==0 then
Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin=""
else
if type(remembered)=="string"and table.find(values,remembered)then
Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin=remembered
else
Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin=values[1]
end
Settings.KnifeExperienceSkinMemory[typeName]=Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin
end

if type(CVU_ResetGlassKnifePersistentBaseline)=="function"then
pcall(CVU_ResetGlassKnifePersistentBaseline)
end

if Runtime.KnifeExperienceSkinButton and Runtime.KnifeExperienceSkinButton.Parent then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSkinButton.Text=
"體驗刀具皮膚   "..tostring(Settings.KnifeExperienceSkin)
end
return values
end

function CVU_BS_GetAnimationFolder(weaponName)
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)
local root=Runtime.BloxStrikeAnimationsFolder
local weapon=root and root:FindFirstChild(weaponName)or nil
return weapon and weapon:FindFirstChild("CameraAnimations")or nil
end

function CVU_BS_GetSoundRoot(weaponName)
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)
local root=Runtime.BloxStrikeSoundsFolder
if not root then return nil end
local exact=root:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
if exact then return exact end
local key=tostring(weaponName):lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
local best=nil
local bestDepth=math.huge
for _,child in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if child.Name:lower():gsub("[^%w]","")==key then
local depth=0
local current=child
while current and current~=root do
depth+=1
current=current.Parent
end
if depth<bestDepth then
best=child
bestDepth=depth
end
end
end
return best
end

function CVU_BS_PreloadInstance(root)
if not root then return false end
local preload={}
local function add(obj)
if obj:IsA("MeshPart")
or obj:IsA("Decal")
or obj:IsA("Texture")
or obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")
or obj:IsA("Sound")
or obj:IsA("Animation")then
preload[#preload+1]=obj
end
end
add(root)
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do add(obj)end
if #preload==0 then preload[1]=root end

local ok=pcall(function()
game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(preload)
end)
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastPreloadOK=ok
return ok
end

function CVU_BS_BuildCameraModel(weaponName,skinName,config)
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildMethod=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildError=nil

skinName=(type(skinName)=="string"and skinName~="")and skinName or"Stock"
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
local wear=0
local statTrak=nil
local nameTag=nil
local charm=nil
local stickers=nil
if type(config)=="table"then
wear=math.clamp(tonumber(config.Wear)or 0,0,1)
nameTag=(type(config.NameSuffix)=="string"and config.NameSuffix~="")and config.NameSuffix or nil
charm=CVU_BuildCharmPayload(config)
stickers=CVU_BuildFixedStickerPayload(config)
end

-- 靜態卡片預覽優先呼叫未包裝的原版 GetCameraModel，避免縮圖建立被當成真正 ViewModel。
local getter=Runtime.BloxStrikeGunStatTrakOriginalGetCameraModel
if type(getter)~="function"and type(lib)=="table"then getter=lib.GetCameraModel end
if type(getter)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(
getter,
weaponName,
skinName,
wear,
statTrak,
nameTag,
charm,
stickers,
nil
)
if ok and typeof(result)=="Instance"then
pcall(function()result.Parent=nil end)
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildMethod="SkinsLib.GetCameraModel"
return result
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildError=tostring(result)
end

if skinName=="Stock"then
local folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder and Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
local cameraTemplate=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Camera")
if cameraTemplate then
local ok,clone=pcall(function()return cameraTemplate:Clone()end)
if ok and clone then
clone.Parent=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildMethod="Assets.Weapons.Camera (Stock fallback)"
return clone
end
end
end
return nil
end


-- ============================================================
-- Clean inventory preview builder
-- IMPORTANT: thumbnails/config preview use the game's Character model,
-- not Camera/ViewModel. Camera models intentionally contain first-person
-- arms, animation helpers and ADS-only geometry (e.g. AUG scope pieces).
-- Character model is the third-person weapon representation other players see.
-- ============================================================
function CVU_BS_BuildPreviewModel(weaponName,skinName,config)
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastPreviewMethod=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastPreviewError=nil

skinName=(type(skinName)=="string"and skinName~="")and skinName or"Stock"
local lib=Runtime.BloxStrikeSkinsLib
local wear=0
local statTrak=nil
local nameTag=nil
local charm=nil
local stickers=nil
if type(config)=="table"then
wear=math.clamp(tonumber(config.Wear)or 0,0,1)
if config.StatTrakEnabled==true then
statTrak=CVU_GetGunKillCounterValue(weaponName,skinName,false)
end
nameTag=(type(config.NameSuffix)=="string"and config.NameSuffix~="")and config.NameSuffix or nil
charm=CVU_BuildCharmPayload(config)
stickers=CVU_BuildFixedStickerPayload(config)
end

-- Prefer the exact third-person Character model.  This avoids:
-- 1) Left/Right Arm meshes from Camera viewmodels
-- 2) HumanoidRootPart / animation rig helpers
-- 3) reload-only camera magazine helpers
-- 4) ADS-only scope geometry that only exists for the local first-person camera
local getter=nil
local characterHook=Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewHooks
and Runtime.BloxStrikeBuyPreviewHooks.GetCharacterModel or nil
if type(characterHook)=="table"and type(characterHook.Original)=="function"then
getter=characterHook.Original
elseif type(lib)=="table"then
getter=lib.GetCharacterModel
end
if type(getter)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(
getter,
weaponName,
skinName,
wear,
statTrak,
nameTag,
charm,
stickers,
nil
)
if ok and typeof(result)=="Instance"then
pcall(function()result.Parent=nil end)
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastPreviewMethod="SkinsLib.GetCharacterModel"
return result
end
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastPreviewError=tostring(result)
end

-- Stock fallback: clone Assets.Weapons/<weapon>/Character directly.
local folder=Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder and Runtime.BloxStrikeWeaponsFolder:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
local characterTemplate=folder and folder:FindFirstChild("Character")
if characterTemplate then
local ok,clone=pcall(function()return characterTemplate:Clone()end)
if ok and clone then
clone.Parent=nil
Runtime.BloxStrikeLastPreviewMethod="Assets.Weapons.Character fallback"
return clone
end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_BS_SanitizePreviewModel(model)
if not model then return 0 end
local previewMode=string.lower(tostring(model:GetAttribute("CVU_PreviewMode")or""))
local keepArmGeometry=previewMode=="glove"
local trash={}
for _,obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Script")or obj:IsA("LocalScript")or obj:IsA("ModuleScript")
or obj:IsA("RemoteEvent")or obj:IsA("RemoteFunction")
or obj:IsA("BindableEvent")or obj:IsA("BindableFunction")
or obj:IsA("AnimationController")or obj:IsA("Animator")then
trash[#trash+1]=obj
elseif obj:IsA("Sound")then
pcall(function()obj:Stop()end)
trash[#trash+1]=obj
elseif (obj:IsA("Folder")or obj:IsA("Model"))then
local nodeKey=string.lower(obj.Name or""):gsub("[^%w]","")
if nodeKey=="interactables"or nodeKey=="properties"or nodeKey=="camerashake"then
trash[#trash+1]=obj
end
elseif obj:IsA("BasePart")then
obj.Anchored=true
obj.CanCollide=false
obj.CanTouch=false
obj.CanQuery=false
obj.CastShadow=true
obj.Massless=true
obj.LocalTransparencyModifier=0

local key=string.lower(obj.Name or""):gsub("[^%w]","")
local maxDim=math.max(obj.Size.X,obj.Size.Y,obj.Size.Z)
local minDim=math.min(obj.Size.X,obj.Size.Y,obj.Size.Z)

local isArm=false
if type(CVU_IsArmPart)=="function"then
local ok,result=pcall(CVU_IsArmPart,obj)
isArm=ok and result==true
end

local helper=
key=="humanoidrootpart"or key=="rootpart"or key=="root"or key=="camera"
or string.find(key,"hitbox",1,true)
or string.find(key,"collision",1,true)
or string.find(key,"helper",1,true)
or string.find(key,"anchor",1,true)
or string.find(key,"camerashake",1,true)

-- ADS-only camera scope pieces are usually giant/thin helper geometry.
-- Keep the real physical scope body; only reject suspicious giant scope planes.
local adsPlane=(string.find(key,"scope",1,true)
or string.find(key,"optic",1,true)
or string.find(key,"reticle",1,true))
and maxDim>3.5 and minDim<0.35

if ((not keepArmGeometry)and isArm)or helper or adsPlane then trash[#trash+1]=obj end
end
end
for _,obj in ipairs(trash)do
if obj and obj.Parent then pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)end
end

local count=0
for _,obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")then count+=1 end
end
return count
end

function CVU_BS_PrepareNativeViewmodel(root)
if not root then return end
local destroyList={}
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Script")
or obj:IsA("LocalScript")
or obj:IsA("ModuleScript")
or obj:IsA("RemoteEvent")
or obj:IsA("RemoteFunction")
or obj:IsA("BindableEvent")
or obj:IsA("BindableFunction")then
destroyList[#destroyList+1]=obj
elseif obj:IsA("BasePart")then
obj.CanCollide=false
obj.CanTouch=false
obj.CanQuery=false
obj.CastShadow=false
obj.Massless=true

-- 本局立即刷新：
-- 新 CameraModel 內的手臂 / 手套 / 袖子現在也要直接顯示。
-- 舊 ViewModel 的手臂會在 Parent 新模型前被 CVU_KnifeExpHideOriginalArmsForPreview()
-- 立即移出畫面，所以這裡不再把新手臂強制透明。
obj.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
end
end
for _,obj in ipairs(destroyList)do
if obj and obj.Parent then pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)end
end
end

function CVU_BS_GetModelRootPart(root)
if not root then return nil end
if root:IsA("BasePart")then return root end
if root:IsA("Model")and root.PrimaryPart then return root.PrimaryPart end

local preferred={"HumanoidRootPart","RootPart","Root","Camera","Handle"}
for _,name in ipairs(preferred)do
local p=root:FindFirstChild(name,true)
if p and p:IsA("BasePart")then return p end
end
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")then return obj end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_BS_SetViewmodelCFrame(root,cf)
if not root or not root.Parent then return false end
local ok=false
if root:IsA("Model")then
ok=pcall(function()
if root.PrimaryPart then
root:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(cf)
else
root:PivotTo(cf)
end
end)
elseif root:IsA("BasePart")then
ok=pcall(function()root.CFrame=cf end)
end
return ok
end

function CVU_BS_FindWeaponActionSound(root,folderName,soundName,inspectIndex)
if not root then return nil end
if inspectIndex then
local wantedIndex=tonumber(inspectIndex)or 1
local wantedKey="inspect"..tostring(wantedIndex)
local best=nil
local bestScore=-math.huge

local function normalized(value)
return tostring(value or""):lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
end

local function scoreSound(sound)
if not sound:IsA("Sound")or type(sound.SoundId)~="string"or sound.SoundId==""then return end
local score=0
local current=sound
local depth=0
local sawWanted=false
local sawPlainInspect=false
local sawWrongNumber=false
while current and depth<7 do
local key=normalized(current.Name)
if key==wantedKey then
score+=260-depth*8
sawWanted=true
elseif key=="inspect"then
score+=70-depth*4
sawPlainInspect=true
elseif key==tostring(wantedIndex)
and current.Parent
and normalized(current.Parent.Name)=="inspect"then
score+=220-depth*7
sawWanted=true
else
local number=key:match("^inspect(%d+)$")
if number and tonumber(number)~=wantedIndex then
sawWrongNumber=true
end
end
if current==root then break end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end

if sawWrongNumber and not sawWanted then score-=500 end
if wantedIndex==1 and sawPlainInspect and not sawWrongNumber then score+=45 end
if wantedIndex>1 and not sawWanted then score-=250 end
if normalized(sound.Name)==tostring(wantedIndex)then score+=35 end

if score>bestScore then
best=sound
bestScore=score
end
end

if root:IsA("Sound")then scoreSound(root)end
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do scoreSound(obj)end

-- Inspect1 與 Inspect2 必須分開；第二種絕不退回第一種或無編號音效。
if best and bestScore>0 then return best end
return nil
end
local key=folderName:lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
local candidates={}
local exact=root:FindFirstChild(folderName,true)
if exact then candidates[#candidates+1]=exact end
local matches={}
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
local name=obj.Name:lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
if obj~=exact and(name==key or name:match("^(%a+)%d+$")==key)then
matches[#matches+1]=obj
end
end
table.sort(matches,function(a,b)return a:GetFullName()<b:GetFullName()end)
for _,obj in ipairs(matches)do candidates[#candidates+1]=obj end
for _,folder in ipairs(candidates)do
local sound=folder:IsA("Sound")and folder or folder:FindFirstChild(soundName or"1")
if sound and not sound:IsA("Sound")then sound=sound:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sound",true)end
if not sound then sound=folder:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Sound",true)end
if sound and sound:IsA("Sound")and sound.SoundId~=""then return sound end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_BS_PlayWeaponSound(weaponName,folderName,soundName,volumeFloor,inspectIndex)
local root=CVU_BS_GetSoundRoot(weaponName)
local sound=CVU_BS_FindWeaponActionSound(root,folderName,soundName,inspectIndex)
if not sound then return nil end

local ok,copy=pcall(function()return sound:Clone()end)
if not ok or not copy then return nil end

copy.Name="CVU_BloxStrike_"..tostring(folderName)
copy:SetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperienceSound",true)
if volumeFloor then
copy.Volume=math.max(copy.Volume,tonumber(volumeFloor)or 0)
end

-- 檢視音效是介面層的本機回饋，放 SoundService 可避免 Camera 下的 Sound
-- 因沒有 3D 發聲父節點而成功 Play 卻聽不到。
copy.Parent=SoundService
local generation=Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration
local normalizedFolder=tostring(folderName or""):lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
local inspectSound=normalizedFolder=="inspect"
or normalizedFolder:match("^inspect%d+$")~=nil
or normalizedFolder=="flip"
or normalizedFolder=="spin"
or normalizedFolder=="examine"
if inspectSound then Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSound=copy end
local started=false
local function playLoaded()
if started or not copy.Parent or Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled then return end
if inspectSound and (generation~=Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration or not Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting)then
copy:Destroy()
return
end
started=true
copy.TimePosition=0
copy:Play()
end
if copy.IsLoaded then
pcall(playLoaded)
else
task.spawn(function()
pcall(function()game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({copy})end)
pcall(playLoaded)
end)
-- 某些 Roblox 音效即使 PreloadAsync 已完成，IsLoaded 仍會晚一幀更新。
-- Play 本身會繼續載入，因此保留一次短延遲啟動，不再提早銷毀有效音效。
task.delay(0.08,function()pcall(playLoaded)end)
end

copy.Ended:Connect(function()
if copy and copy.Parent then copy:Destroy()end
end)
task.delay(10,function()
if copy and copy.Parent then copy:Destroy()end
end)
return copy
end

-- Butterfly 的第二個 Inspect 在不同版本的資產樹曾使用 Inspect2、
-- SecondInspect 或 Inspect/2。這裡直接鎖定第二組，避免通用搜尋器
-- 誤拿 Inspect1、Handling1 或沒有編號的第一組音效。
function CVU_BS_FindButterflyInspectSound(inspectIndex)
local wanted=math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(inspectIndex)or 1),1,2)
local weaponRoot=CVU_BS_GetSoundRoot("Butterfly Knife")
local soundsRoot=Runtime.BloxStrikeSoundsFolder
if not weaponRoot and not soundsRoot then return nil,nil end

local function normalized(value)
return tostring(value or""):lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
end

local best=nil
local bestPath=nil
local bestScore=-math.huge
local visited=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

local function scoreSound(sound,baseScore)
if visited[sound]
or not sound:IsA("Sound")
or type(sound.SoundId)~="string"
or sound.SoundId==""then return end
visited[sound]=true

local score=baseScore or 0
local current=sound
local depth=0
local exact=false
local wrong=false
local insideButterfly=weaponRoot and sound:IsDescendantOf(weaponRoot)or false
while current and depth<10 do
local key=normalized(current.Name)
if key=="butterflyknife"or key=="butterfly"then
insideButterfly=true
end
if wanted==2 then
if key=="inspect2"then score+=1200-depth*8 exact=true
elseif key=="secondinspect"then score+=1100-depth*8 exact=true
elseif key=="handling2"then score+=650-depth*8 exact=true
elseif key=="2"and current.Parent and normalized(current.Parent.Name)=="inspect"then
score+=1000-depth*8 exact=true
elseif key=="inspect1"or key=="firstinspect"or key=="handling1"then
wrong=true
end
else
if key=="inspect1"then score+=1200-depth*8 exact=true
elseif key=="firstinspect"then score+=1100-depth*8 exact=true
elseif key=="inspect"then score+=850-depth*8 exact=true
elseif key=="1"and current.Parent and normalized(current.Parent.Name)=="inspect"then
score+=1000-depth*8 exact=true
elseif key=="inspect2"or key=="secondinspect"or key=="handling2"then
wrong=true
end
end
if current==soundsRoot or current==weaponRoot then break end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end

if not insideButterfly or not exact or wrong then return end
if score>bestScore then
best=sound
bestPath=sound:GetFullName()
bestScore=score
end
end

if weaponRoot then
if weaponRoot:IsA("Sound")then scoreSound(weaponRoot,300)end
for _,obj in ipairs(weaponRoot:GetDescendants())do scoreSound(obj,300)end
end
-- 有些版本把刀具音效再包一層分類；武器根目錄找不到時才掃整個 Sounds，
-- 但仍要求祖先路徑中明確出現 Butterfly，避免串到其他武器的 Inspect2。
if not best and soundsRoot then
for _,obj in ipairs(soundsRoot:GetDescendants())do scoreSound(obj,0)end
end
return best,bestPath
end

function CVU_BS_PlayButterflyInspectSound(inspectIndex,volumeFloor)
local source,sourcePath=CVU_BS_FindButterflyInspectSound(inspectIndex)
if not source then return nil,nil end

local ok,copy=pcall(function()return source:Clone()end)
if not ok or not copy then return nil,sourcePath end

local label="Inspect"..tostring(inspectIndex)
copy.Name="CVU_BloxStrike_Butterfly_"..label
copy:SetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperienceSound",true)
copy:SetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperienceSoundSource",sourcePath or source.Name)
copy.Looped=false
-- 原遊戲的某些 Inspect2 綁在被本機靜音的武器 SoundGroup；
-- 體驗刀具的本機回饋音效脫離該群組，音量才不會仍是 0。
pcall(function()copy.SoundGroup=nil end)
if volumeFloor then copy.Volume=math.max(copy.Volume,tonumber(volumeFloor)or 0)end
copy.Parent=SoundService

Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSound=copy
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSoundSource=sourcePath
local generation=Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration
local started=false
local function playLoaded()
if started or not copy.Parent or Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled then return end
if generation~=Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration or not Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting then
copy:Destroy()
return
end
started=true
copy.TimePosition=0
copy:Play()
end

if copy.IsLoaded then
pcall(playLoaded)
else
task.spawn(function()
pcall(function()game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync({copy})end)
pcall(playLoaded)
end)
task.delay(0.08,function()pcall(playLoaded)end)
end
copy.Ended:Connect(function()
if copy and copy.Parent then copy:Destroy()end
end)
task.delay(10,function()
if copy and copy.Parent then copy:Destroy()end
end)
return copy,sourcePath
end

function CVU_KnifeExpResetTrack(track,fade)
if not track then return end
pcall(function()
if track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(tonumber(fade)or 0.02)end
end)
pcall(function()track.TimePosition=0 end)
end

function CVU_KnifeExpStopInspectSound()
local sound=Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSound
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSound=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSoundSource=nil
if sound then pcall(function()sound:Destroy()end)end
end

function CVU_KnifeExpStopInspect(reason)
CVU_KnifeExpStopInspectSound()
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration or 0)+1
Runtime.KnifeExperienceLastCancelReason=tostring(reason or"StopInspect")
CVU_KnifeExpResetTrack(Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack,0.025)
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting=false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectAnimationName=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSoundName=nil
end

function CVU_KnifeExpCancelActionState(reason,dropTracks)
Runtime.KnifeExperienceAttackStartUntil=0
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingSoundSerial=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingSoundSerial or 0)+1
CVU_KnifeExpStopInspectSound()
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration or 0)+1
Runtime.KnifeExperienceLastCancelReason=tostring(reason or"CancelAction")

for _,track in ipairs({
Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack,
})do
CVU_KnifeExpResetTrack(track,0.02)
end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting=false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwinging=false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceLastAttack=0
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingIndex=0
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectAnimationName=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSoundName=nil
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpRestoreOriginalKnifeSounds)

if dropTracks then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackRoot=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackWeapon=nil
end
end

function CVU_KnifeExpIsNativeActionConflictPlaying(weaponName)
local animator=select(1,CVU_KnifeExpGetAnimator())
local folder=CVU_BS_GetAnimationFolder(weaponName)
if not animator or not folder then return false end

local ids={}
for _,name in ipairs({"Equip","Swing1","Swing2","Heavy Swing","HeavySwing"})do
local anim=folder:FindFirstChild(name)
if anim and anim:IsA("Animation")and type(anim.AnimationId)=="string"and anim.AnimationId~=""then
ids[anim.AnimationId]=true
end
end
if next(ids)==nil then return false end

local ok,tracks=pcall(function()return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()end)
if not ok or type(tracks)~="table"then return false end

for _,track in ipairs(tracks)do
if track
and track.IsPlaying
and track~=Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack then
local anim=nil
pcall(function()anim=track.Animation end)
local id=anim and anim.AnimationId or nil
if id and ids[id]then return true end
end
end
return false
end

function CVU_KnifeExpInspectAnimations(folder)
local result={}
if not folder then return result end
for _,anim in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants())do
if anim:IsA("Animation")then
local name=anim.Name:lower():gsub("[^%w]","")
local number=name:match("^inspect(%d+)$")
if name=="inspect"or number then result[#result+1]={Animation=anim,Index=tonumber(number)or 1}end
end
end
table.sort(result,function(a,b)
if a.Index~=b.Index then return a.Index<b.Index end
return a.Animation:GetFullName()<b.Animation:GetFullName()
end)
local unique={}local seen={}
for _,entry in ipairs(result)do
if not seen[entry.Index]then seen[entry.Index]=true unique[#unique+1]=entry end
end
return unique
end

function CVU_BS_LoadNativeKnifeTracks(weaponName)
local animator,trackRoot=CVU_KnifeExpGetAnimator()
local folder=CVU_BS_GetAnimationFolder(weaponName)
if not animator or not folder then return false end

local sameRoot=
Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackRoot==trackRoot
and Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackWeapon==weaponName

if sameRoot
and (Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack
or Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track
or Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track
or Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack)then
return true
end

for _,track in ipairs({
Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack,
})do
if track then pcall(function()track:Stop(0.02)end)end
end

local function load(name)
local anim=folder:FindFirstChild(name)
if not anim or not anim:IsA("Animation")then return nil end
local ok,track=pcall(function()return animator:LoadAnimation(anim)end)
if ok then return track end
return nil
end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack=load("Equip")
Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack=load("Idle")
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack=load("Inspect")
if not Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack then
local variants=CVU_KnifeExpInspectAnimations(folder)
if variants[1]then
local ok,track=pcall(function()return animator:LoadAnimation(variants[1].Animation)end)
if ok then Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack=track end
end
end
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectVariantCursor=0
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track=load("Swing1")
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track=load("Swing2")
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack=load("Heavy Swing")or load("HeavySwing")
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectAnimationName=
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack and"Inspect"or nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackRoot=trackRoot
Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackWeapon=weaponName

if Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack then
pcall(function()
Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack.Looped=true
Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
end)
end
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack then
pcall(function()Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action end)
end
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack then
pcall(function()Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4 end)
end
for _,track in ipairs({
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track,
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack,
})do
if track then
pcall(function()track.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action3 end)
end
end

return Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack~=nil
or Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack~=nil
or Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack~=nil
or Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track~=nil
or Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track~=nil
or Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack~=nil
end

function CVU_IsKnifeExperienceObject(obj)
local current=obj
local depth=0
while current and depth<8 do
if current:GetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperience")==true then return true end
if current==Camera then break end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
return false
end

function CVU_KnifeExpHasToken(text,tokens)
local n=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(text)
for _,token in ipairs(tokens or {})do
if string.find(n,CVU_KnifeExpNorm(token),1,true)then return true end
end
return false
end

function CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()
local tool=CVU_GetEquippedTool()
local vm=CVU_GetViewModel()
local now=os.clock()
if Runtime.KnifeHeldCacheTool==tool
and Runtime.KnifeHeldCacheViewModel==vm
and now<(Runtime.KnifeHeldCacheUntil or 0)then
return Runtime.KnifeHeldCacheResult==true
end
local function finish(result)
Runtime.KnifeHeldCacheTool=tool
Runtime.KnifeHeldCacheViewModel=vm
Runtime.KnifeHeldCacheResult=result==true
Runtime.KnifeHeldCacheUntil=now+.12
return result==true
end
if tool then
local names={tool.Name}
for _,attr in ipairs({"WeaponType","ItemType","Category","WeaponName","ItemName"})do
local v=tool:GetAttribute(attr)
if type(v)=="string"then names[#names+1]=v end
end
local joined=table.concat(names," ")
if CVU_KnifeExpHasToken(joined,Runtime.KnifeExperienceKnifeTokens)then return finish(true)end
if CVU_KnifeExpHasToken(joined,Runtime.KnifeExperienceGunTokens)then return finish(false)end
end

if not vm then return finish(false)end

local knifeEvidence=0
local gunEvidence=0
local checked=0
for _,obj in ipairs(vm:GetDescendants())do
checked+=1
if checked>420 then break end
local n=obj.Name or ""
if CVU_KnifeExpHasToken(n,Runtime.KnifeExperienceKnifeTokens)then knifeEvidence+=1 end
if CVU_KnifeExpHasToken(n,Runtime.KnifeExperienceGunTokens)then gunEvidence+=1 end
end
return finish(knifeEvidence>0 and knifeEvidence>=gunEvidence)
end

function CVU_KnifeExpSourceNamePath(obj)
local chunks={}
local current=obj
local depth=0
while current and depth<4 do
chunks[#chunks+1]=current.Name or ""
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
return table.concat(chunks," ")
end

function CVU_KnifeExpMatchesType(obj,typeName)
local aliases=Runtime.KnifeExperienceAliases[typeName]
if not aliases then return false,0 end
local direct=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(obj and obj.Name or "")
local path=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(CVU_KnifeExpSourceNamePath(obj))
local score=0
for _,alias in ipairs(aliases)do
local a=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(alias)
if direct==a then score=math.max(score,160)
elseif string.find(direct,a,1,true)then score=math.max(score,125)
elseif string.find(path,a,1,true)then score=math.max(score,72)
end
end
return score>0,score
end

function CVU_KnifeExpCountVisualParts(root,limit)
local count=0
if root:IsA("BasePart")then return 1 end
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")then
count+=1
if count>=(limit or 100)then break end
end
end
return count
end

function CVU_KnifeExpFindNamedAsset(root,className)
local best=nil
local bestScore=-1
local function scoreObj(obj)
if not obj:IsA(className)then return end
local n=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(obj.Name)
local score=0
for _,token in ipairs(Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTokens or {})do
if string.find(n,CVU_KnifeExpNorm(token),1,true)then score=score+35 end
end
if string.find(n,"inspect",1,true)then score+=80 end
if string.find(n,"examine",1,true)then score+=65 end
if string.find(n,"flip",1,true)or string.find(n,"spin",1,true)then score+=30 end
if score>bestScore then bestScore=score best=obj end
end

scoreObj(root)
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
scoreObj(obj)
end
if bestScore<=0 then return nil end
return best
end

function CVU_KnifeExpSourceScore(obj,typeName)
if not obj or not obj.Parent then return -math.huge end
if not (obj:IsA("Model")or obj:IsA("Tool")or obj:IsA("Folder")or obj:IsA("BasePart"))then
return -math.huge
end

local matches,nameScore=CVU_KnifeExpMatchesType(obj,typeName)
if not matches then return -math.huge end

local visualCount=CVU_KnifeExpCountVisualParts(obj,120)
if visualCount<=0 then return -math.huge end

local score=nameScore
if obj:IsA("Tool")then score+=38
elseif obj:IsA("Model")then score+=32
elseif obj:IsA("BasePart")then score+=18
else score+=8 end

score+=math.min(visualCount,24)*1.5
if visualCount>90 then score-=35 end
if CVU_KnifeExpFindNamedAsset(obj,"Animation")then score+=28 end
if CVU_KnifeExpFindNamedAsset(obj,"Sound")then score+=18 end

return score
end

function CVU_KnifeExpGetSearchRoots()
local roots={ReplicatedStorage,ReplicatedFirst}
local backpack=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
if backpack then roots[#roots+1]=backpack end
local ok,starterPack=pcall(function()return game:GetService("StarterPack")end)
if ok and starterPack then roots[#roots+1]=starterPack end
local vm=CVU_GetViewModel()
if vm then roots[#roots+1]=vm end
return roots
end

function CVU_KnifeExpFindSource(typeName,force)
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSourceCache=Runtime.KnifeExperienceSourceCache or {}
local cached=Runtime.KnifeExperienceSourceCache[typeName]
if not force and cached and cached~=false and cached.Parent then return cached end
if not force and cached==false then return nil end

local best=nil
local bestScore=-math.huge
local scanned=0

for _,root in ipairs(CVU_KnifeExpGetSearchRoots())do
if root and root.Parent then
local rootScore=CVU_KnifeExpSourceScore(root,typeName)
if rootScore>bestScore then bestScore=rootScore best=root end

for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
scanned+=1
if scanned>7000 then break end
local score=CVU_KnifeExpSourceScore(obj,typeName)
if score>bestScore then
bestScore=score
best=obj
end
end
end
if scanned>7000 then break end
end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceSourceCache[typeName]=best or false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceLastScanCount=scanned
return best
end

function CVU_KnifeExpGetTargetAnchor()
local vm=CVU_GetViewModel()
if vm then
local best=nil
local bestScore=-math.huge
for _,part in ipairs(vm:GetDescendants())do
if part:IsA("BasePart")
and part.Parent
and part.Transparency<0.985
and not CVU_IsHardProtectedArmPart(part,vm)then
local n=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(part.Name)
local score=0
if string.find(n,"handle",1,true)then score+=70 end
if string.find(n,"knife",1,true)then score+=55 end
if string.find(n,"blade",1,true)then score+=50 end
if string.find(n,"melee",1,true)then score+=35 end
if CVU_IsMetalVisualPart(part)then score+=15 end
local s=part.Size
score+=math.min(s.X*s.Y*s.Z,4)*3
if score>bestScore then bestScore=score best=part end
end
end
if best then return best end
end

local tool=CVU_GetEquippedTool()
if tool then
local handle=tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")then return handle end
for _,part in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants())do
if part:IsA("BasePart")then return part end
end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_KnifeExpFindCloneAnchor(root)
if not root then return nil end
local best=nil
local bestScore=-math.huge
local candidates={}
if root:IsA("BasePart")then candidates[1]=root else
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("BasePart")then candidates[#candidates+1]=obj end
end
end

for _,part in ipairs(candidates)do
if part.Parent then
local n=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(part.Name)
local score=0
if string.find(n,"handle",1,true)then score+=90 end
if string.find(n,"root",1,true)then score+=55 end
if string.find(n,"knife",1,true)then score+=45 end
if string.find(n,"blade",1,true)then score+=35 end
if CVU_IsArmPart(part)then score-=140 end
local s=part.Size
score+=math.min(s.X*s.Y*s.Z,5)*2
if score>bestScore then bestScore=score best=part end
end
end
return best
end

function CVU_KnifeExpStripClone(root)
local toDestroy={}
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Script")
or obj:IsA("LocalScript")
or obj:IsA("ModuleScript")
or obj:IsA("RemoteEvent")
or obj:IsA("RemoteFunction")
or obj:IsA("BindableEvent")
or obj:IsA("BindableFunction")then
toDestroy[#toDestroy+1]=obj
elseif obj:IsA("BasePart")then
obj.CanCollide=false
obj.CanTouch=false
obj.CanQuery=false
obj.CastShadow=false
obj.Massless=true

if CVU_IsArmPart(obj)then
obj.Transparency=1
obj.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
else
obj.Material=Enum.Material.Metal
pcall(function()obj.MaterialVariant=""end)
obj.Color=Settings.MetalWeaponColor
obj.Reflectance=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.MetalWeaponReflectance)or 0.15,0.08,0.45)
obj.LocalTransparencyModifier=0
if obj:IsA("MeshPart")then
pcall(function()obj.TextureID=""end)
end
end
elseif obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")then
toDestroy[#toDestroy+1]=obj
elseif obj:IsA("Decal")or obj:IsA("Texture")then
pcall(function()obj.Transparency=1 end)
end
end
for _,obj in ipairs(toDestroy)do
if obj and obj.Parent then pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)end
end
end

function CVU_KnifeExpHasRig(root)
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Motor6D")or obj:IsA("Weld")or obj:IsA("WeldConstraint")then
return true
end
end
return false
end

function CVU_KnifeExpIsArmVisualForSwap(part,viewModel)
if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
if CVU_IsKnifeExperienceObject(part)then return false end

if CVU_IsGhostArmPart(part,viewModel)then return true end
if CVU_HasGhostArmContainerAncestor(part,viewModel)then return true end

local n=CVU_GhostCompactName(part.Name)
return n=="leftarm"
or n=="rightarm"
or n=="lefthand"
or n=="righthand"
or n=="larm"
or n=="rarm"
or n=="lhand"
or n=="rhand"
or string.find(n,"glove",1,true)~=nil
or string.find(n,"sleeve",1,true)~=nil
end

function CVU_KnifeExpRefreshHideCaches(vm,force)
if not vm then return end
local now=os.clock()
if not force
and Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideCacheVM==vm
and now<(Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideCacheNextScan or 0)then return end
local weaponParts={}
local armParts={}
for _,part in ipairs(vm:GetDescendants())do
if part:IsA("BasePart")and part.Parent then
if not CVU_IsHardProtectedArmPart(part,vm)and CVU_IsMetalVisualPart(part)then
weaponParts[#weaponParts+1]=part
end
if CVU_KnifeExpIsArmVisualForSwap(part,vm)then
armParts[#armParts+1]=part
end
end
end
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideCacheVM=vm
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideWeaponParts=weaponParts
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideArmParts=armParts
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideCacheNextScan=now+.45
end

function CVU_KnifeExpHideOriginalArmsForPreview()
local vm=CVU_GetViewModel()
if not vm then return false end
CVU_KnifeExpRefreshHideCaches(vm,false)

Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenArmParts=
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenArmParts or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

local changed=false
for _,part in ipairs(Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideArmParts or {})do
if part.Parent and part:IsDescendantOf(vm)then

if Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenArmParts[part]==nil then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenArmParts[part]={
LocalTransparencyModifier=part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
Transparency=part.Transparency,
}
end

-- 不 Destroy 原遊戲 rig；只在本機畫面立即移除。
-- 這樣切回原版刀/關閉體驗刀具時可以毫秒級完整復原，
-- 也不會把 BloxStrike 的 Motor6D / 動畫骨架拆壞。
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
changed=true
end
end
return changed
end

function CVU_KnifeExpRestoreOriginalArms()
for part,old in pairs(Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenArmParts or {})do
if part and part.Parent and old then
pcall(function()
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=old.LocalTransparencyModifier or 0
end)
end
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenArmParts[part]=nil
end
end

function CVU_KnifeExpRestoreOriginal()
for part,old in pairs(Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenParts or {})do
if part and part.Parent then
pcall(function()part.LocalTransparencyModifier=old end)
end
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenParts[part]=nil
end
for shell,old in pairs(Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenShells or {})do
if shell and shell.Parent and old then
pcall(function()
shell.Transparency=old.Transparency
shell.LocalTransparencyModifier=old.LocalTransparencyModifier
end)
end
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenShells[shell]=nil
end
end

function CVU_KnifeExpHideOriginal()
if not Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone then return end
local vm=CVU_GetViewModel()
if not vm then return end
CVU_KnifeExpRefreshHideCaches(vm,false)

Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenParts=Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenParts or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenShells=Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenShells or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

for _,part in ipairs(Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideWeaponParts or {})do
if part.Parent and part:IsDescendantOf(vm)then
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenParts[part]==nil then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenParts[part]=part.LocalTransparencyModifier
end
part.LocalTransparencyModifier=1

local entry=Runtime.MetalCoatOverlays and Runtime.MetalCoatOverlays[part]
local shell=entry and entry.Object
if shell and shell.Parent then
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenShells[shell]==nil then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHiddenShells[shell]={
Transparency=shell.Transparency,
LocalTransparencyModifier=shell.LocalTransparencyModifier,
}
end
shell.Transparency=1
shell.LocalTransparencyModifier=1
end
end
end
end

function CVU_ClearKnifeExperience()
Runtime.KnifeExperienceGeneration=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceGeneration or 0)+1
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpUnbindFeedbackActions)
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpRestoreOriginalKnifeSounds)

pcall(CVU_KnifeExpCancelActionState,"ClearKnifeExperience",true)

CVU_KnifeExpRestoreOriginal()
CVU_KnifeExpRestoreOriginalArms()

if Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone and Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone.Parent then
pcall(function()Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone:Destroy()end)
end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideCacheVM=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideWeaponParts={}
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideArmParts={}
Runtime.KnifeExperienceHideCacheNextScan=0
Runtime.KnifeHeldCacheUntil=0
Runtime.KnifeExperiencePreviewActive=false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceCloneAnchor=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceTargetAnchor=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSource=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveType=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveSkin=nil
Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedType=nil
Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedSkin=nil
Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedCustomName=nil
pcall(CVU_RestoreKnifeHUDIcon)
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStaticOffsets=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceRigged=false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceNativeFullVM=false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectAnimationName=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSoundName=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSoundSource=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackRoot=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackWeapon=nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting=false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwinging=false

-- 刀具整個被清掉時，舊 part refs 不再可用。
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentOriginalParts=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.GlassKnifePersistentKey=nil
Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration=(Runtime.GlassKnifeRestoreGeneration or 0)+1

Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus="關閉"
end

function CVU_KnifeExpBuildClone(typeName,forceSource)
CVU_ClearKnifeExperience()

if not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
or not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()then
return false
end

CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(forceSource==true)
local weaponName=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(typeName)
if not weaponName then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus="沒有對應的 BloxStrike 原生刀名"
return false
end

local skinName=CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceSkin()

-- 注意：此時 model 完全沒有 Parent 到 CurrentCamera。
-- GetCameraModel / Stock Camera 模板、skin、mesh、SurfaceAppearance 全部先完成。
local model=CVU_BS_BuildCameraModel(weaponName,skinName)
if not model then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus=
"無法建立 "..weaponName.."｜"..skinName..
"；非 Stock 不會退回『錯模型再補貼圖』"
return false
end

model.Name="CVU_KnifeExperience_"..weaponName
model:SetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperience",true)
model:SetAttribute("IgnoreMetalVisual",true)
model:SetAttribute("IgnoreGhostArms",true)

CVU_BS_PrepareNativeViewmodel(model)

local rootPart=CVU_BS_GetModelRootPart(model)
if not rootPart then
pcall(function()model:Destroy()end)
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus="原生 Camera Model 沒有可用 Root Part"
return false
end

-- 只 Anchor 整個原生 ViewModel 的 root；其餘 Motor6D / Weld rig 保留。
-- 這是為了避免先前那種手套掉地、抽動、爆手。
for _,part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants())do
if part:IsA("BasePart")then
part.Anchored=(part==rootPart)
end
end
if model:IsA("BasePart")then model.Anchored=true end

-- 先把所有 Mesh / SurfaceAppearance / Texture / Animation 預載好。
-- 新模型仍在 Camera 外，先完整準備，不讓裸模閃出。
CVU_BS_PreloadInstance(model)

-- 交換手臂：
-- 1) 先把目前 ViewModel 的舊手臂/手套從畫面移除
-- 2) 同一個刷新流程立刻把已完成的新 CameraModel Parent 進 Camera
-- 不再等待下一局。
CVU_KnifeExpHideOriginalArmsForPreview()

-- 完成品才真正進 Camera，新手臂/手套會直接可見。
model.Parent=Camera

Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone=model
Runtime.KnifeExperienceCloneAnchor=rootPart
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSource=model
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveType=typeName
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName=weaponName
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveSkin=skinName
Runtime.KnifeExperienceNativeFullVM=true
Runtime.KnifeExperienceRigged=true

-- model 已經 Parent 到 Camera，而且 active type/skin 都成功建立後，才確認 HUD。
Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedType=typeName
Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedSkin=skinName
Runtime.KnifeHUDConfirmedCustomName=CVU_GetKnifeConfiguredCustomName(weaponName,skinName)
pcall(CVU_UpdateKnifeHUDIcon,typeName)

local offset=CVU_BS_GetKnifeOffset(weaponName)
CVU_BS_SetViewmodelCFrame(model,Camera.CFrame*offset)

CVU_BS_LoadNativeKnifeTracks(weaponName)

-- 到這一步才隱藏原本的刀：同一個可見階段完成交換。
CVU_KnifeExpHideOriginal()

if Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack then
pcall(function()Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack:Play(0.03,1,1)end)
end
CVU_BS_PlayWeaponSound(weaponName,"Equip","1",4)
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpBindFeedbackActions)
CVU_KnifeExpScheduleOriginalSoundMute()

-- fallback CameraModel 是獨立於 CVU_GetViewModel() 的。
-- 建好後立刻讓 GhostArms 把「真正畫面上可見的刀具手」納入同一組顏色。
if Settings.GhostArms then
pcall(CVU_ApplyGhostArms)
end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus=
"原生完成品｜"..weaponName.."｜"..skinName..
"｜"..tostring(Runtime.BloxStrikeLastBuildMethod or"unknown")

if Settings.GlassWeapon and CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="glass"then
pcall(CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel)
end

return true
end

function CVU_RefreshKnifeExperience(forceSource)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return false end

if not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled then
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone then
CVU_ClearKnifeExperience()
end
return false
end

-- 穩定模式只保證 hook 已裝好。
-- UI Pending 不會在本局重建刀具，也不會模擬 Q。
local nativeReady=CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook()

if not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()then
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone then
CVU_ClearKnifeExperience()
end
return nativeReady
end

local appliedType=CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType()
local desiredWeapon=CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(appliedType)
local desiredSkin=CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceSkin()

-- 如果目前這一局已經是 Applied 刀具，只維持 Inspect/Sound wiring。
if desiredWeapon
and Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeKnife==desiredWeapon
and Runtime.BloxStrikeLastNativeSkin==desiredSkin then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName=desiredWeapon
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveSkin=desiredSkin
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActiveType=appliedType
Runtime.KnifeExperienceNativeFullVM=true
pcall(CVU_BS_LoadNativeKnifeTracks,desiredWeapon)
task.spawn(function()
local sounds=CVU_BS_GetSoundRoot(desiredWeapon)
if sounds then pcall(CVU_BS_PreloadInstance,sounds)end
end)
if not Runtime.KnifeExperienceFeedbackBound then
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpBindFeedbackActions)
end
return true
end

-- 有舊 fallback 就維持它；絕不因 Pending 選擇在本局換掉。
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone and Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone.Parent then
return true
end

-- Native hook 不可用時，才允許用 Applied（不是 Pending）作 fallback。
-- 所以即使 UI 剛選了新 skin，本局也不會偷換成新選擇。
if not nativeReady and appliedType then
local built=CVU_KnifeExpBuildClone(appliedType,false)
Runtime.KnifeExperiencePreviewActive=built==true
return built
end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus=
Runtime.KnifeExperiencePending
and "已更換；等待下一局套用"
or "等待下一次自然 ViewModel rebuild"
return true
end

function CVU_KnifeExpFindInspectAsset(className)
local roots={}
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone then roots[#roots+1]=Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone end
local source=Runtime.KnifeExperienceSource
if source then
roots[#roots+1]=source
if source.Parent then
roots[#roots+1]=source.Parent
if source.Parent.Parent then roots[#roots+1]=source.Parent.Parent end
end
end

for _,root in ipairs(roots)do
local found=CVU_KnifeExpFindNamedAsset(root,className)
if found then return found end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_KnifeExpGetAnimator()
local root=Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone

-- Native Viewmodel.new 成功時沒有 CVU clone。
-- Inspect track 必須載入到目前遊戲真正的 ViewModel Animator。
if not root or not root.Parent then
root=CVU_GetViewModel()
end
if not root then return nil,nil end

local animator=root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator",true)
if animator then return animator,root end

local controller=root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("AnimationController",true)
if controller then
animator=controller:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator")
if animator then return animator,root end
end

-- 只有 visual fallback clone 才允許補 AnimationController；
-- 不對遊戲原生 ViewModel 亂加骨架。
if root==Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone then
controller=controller or Instance.new("AnimationController")
if not controller.Parent then
controller.Name="CVU_KnifeAnimationController"
controller.Parent=root
end

animator=controller:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator")
if not animator then
animator=Instance.new("Animator")
animator.Parent=controller
end
return animator,root
end

return nil,root
end


function CVU_KnifeExpBuildOriginalKnifeSoundIds()
table.clear(Runtime.KnifeExperienceOriginalKnifeSoundIds)
CVU_BS_InitNativeSkinData(false)

local root=Runtime.BloxStrikeSoundsFolder
if not root then return false end

for _,weaponName in ipairs({"T Knife","CT Knife"})do
local folder=root:FindFirstChild(weaponName)
if folder then
for _,obj in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Sound")and type(obj.SoundId)=="string"and obj.SoundId~=""then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceOriginalKnifeSoundIds[obj.SoundId]=true
end
end
end
end

return next(Runtime.KnifeExperienceOriginalKnifeSoundIds)~=nil
end

function CVU_KnifeExpMuteOriginalKnifeSounds()
if not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled or not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()then return end
if next(Runtime.KnifeExperienceOriginalKnifeSoundIds)==nil then
CVU_KnifeExpBuildOriginalKnifeSoundIds()
end

local function scan(root)
if not root then return end
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Sound")
and obj:GetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperienceSound")~=true
and Runtime.KnifeExperienceOriginalKnifeSoundIds[obj.SoundId]then
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceMutedOriginalSounds[obj]==nil then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceMutedOriginalSounds[obj]=obj.Volume
end
obj.Volume=0
end
end
end

scan(Workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera)
scan(SoundService)
end

function CVU_KnifeExpRestoreOriginalKnifeSounds()
for sound,volume in pairs(Runtime.KnifeExperienceMutedOriginalSounds or {})do
if sound and sound.Parent then
pcall(function()sound.Volume=volume end)
end
Runtime.KnifeExperienceMutedOriginalSounds[sound]=nil
end
end

function CVU_KnifeExpScheduleOriginalSoundMute()
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpMuteOriginalKnifeSounds)
task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_KnifeExpMuteOriginalKnifeSounds)end)
task.delay(0.03,function()pcall(CVU_KnifeExpMuteOriginalKnifeSounds)end)
task.delay(0.08,function()pcall(CVU_KnifeExpMuteOriginalKnifeSounds)end)
end

function CVU_KnifeExpIsButterfly()
local name=Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName or CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType())
return name=="Butterfly Knife"
end

function CVU_KnifeExpAttackBusy()
if os.clock()<(Runtime.KnifeExperienceAttackStartUntil or 0)then return true end
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwinging then
local actualSwing=false
for _,key in ipairs({"KnifeExperienceSwing1Track","KnifeExperienceSwing2Track","KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack"})do
local track=Runtime[key]
if track and track.IsPlaying then actualSwing=true break end
end
if actualSwing then return true end
-- Stopped 回调偶尔会在 ViewModel 重建时丢失；没有轨道在播就清掉残留 busy。
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwinging=false
end
for _,key in ipairs({"KnifeExperienceSwing1Track","KnifeExperienceSwing2Track","KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack","KnifeExperienceEquipTrack"})do
local track=Runtime[key]
if track and track.IsPlaying then return true end
end
local name=Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName or CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType())
return name and CVU_KnifeExpIsNativeActionConflictPlaying(name)or false
end

function CVU_KnifeExpTrackHasStarted(track)
if not track or not track.IsPlaying then return false end
local timePosition=0
local weight=0
pcall(function()timePosition=track.TimePosition end)
pcall(function()weight=track.WeightCurrent end)
return timePosition>0.003 and weight>0.001
end

function CVU_KnifeExpFindPlayingAttackTrack(weaponName,heavy)
local animator=select(1,CVU_KnifeExpGetAnimator())
local folder=CVU_BS_GetAnimationFolder(weaponName)
if not animator or not folder then return nil end
local ids={}
local names=heavy
and {"Heavy Swing","HeavySwing"}
or {"Swing1","Swing2"}
for _,name in ipairs(names)do
local animation=folder:FindFirstChild(name)
if animation and animation:IsA("Animation")and animation.AnimationId~=""then
ids[animation.AnimationId]=true
end
end
local ok,tracks=pcall(function()return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()end)
if not ok or type(tracks)~="table"then return nil end
for _,candidate in ipairs(tracks)do
local animation=nil
pcall(function()animation=candidate.Animation end)
local key=CVU_KnifeExpNorm(
(animation and animation.Name or"").." "..tostring(candidate.Name or"")
)
local namedAttack=
(string.find(key,"swing",1,true)
or string.find(key,"slash",1,true)
or string.find(key,"attack",1,true))
and not string.find(key,"inspect",1,true)
and not string.find(key,"equip",1,true)
local idAttack=animation and ids[animation.AnimationId]
if (idAttack or namedAttack)
and CVU_KnifeExpTrackHasStarted(candidate)then return candidate end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_PlayKnifeExperienceSwing(heavy)
if Runtime.Shutdown
or not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
or not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()then
return false
end

if CVU_KnifeExpIsButterfly()and CVU_KnifeExpAttackBusy()then return false end
-- Accepted attacks interrupt inspect; rejected attacks change nothing.
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting
or (Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack and Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack.IsPlaying)then
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpStopInspect,"SwingStart")
end

local weaponName=
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName
or CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType())
if not weaponName then return false end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingIndex=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingIndex or 0)+1
local index=((Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingIndex-1)%3)+1
local fallbackActive=
Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone
and Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone.Parent

-- visual fallback 才自己播 Swing 動畫。
-- native ViewModel 已有遊戲自己的 attack animation；這裡只補正確刀具聲音，
-- 避免同一個 Animator 同時吃兩套 Swing。
local track=nil
if fallbackActive then
if not Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track
and not Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track
and not Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack then
CVU_BS_LoadNativeKnifeTracks(weaponName)
end

if heavy then
track=Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack
else
if index%2==1 then
track=Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track or Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track
else
track=Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track or Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track
end
end

if track then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration or 0)+1
local actionGeneration=Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwinging=true
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack then
pcall(function()Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack:Stop(0.025)end)
end
pcall(function()
if track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(0.01)end
track.TimePosition=0
track:Play(0.025,1,1)
end)
pcall(function()
track.Stopped:Once(function()
if actionGeneration==(Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration or 0)then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwinging=false
end
end)
end)
end
end

-- BloxStrike 公開刀具結構：
-- Heavy Swing -> HitOne
-- Swing1      -> HitTwo
-- Swing2      -> HitThree
local preferred
if heavy then
preferred="HitOne"
elseif index%2==1 then
preferred="HitTwo"
else
preferred="HitThree"
end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingSoundSerial=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingSoundSerial or 0)+1
local soundSerial=Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingSoundSerial

-- 原生游戏会在准备期拒绝挥刀。输入本身不能作为播放依据；
-- 等 Animator 的 Swing/Heavy Swing 时间轴真的开始前进，才补对应音效。
task.spawn(function()
local deadline=os.clock()+0.45
repeat
if Runtime.Shutdown
or soundSerial~=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingSoundSerial or 0)
or not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
or not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()then return end

local confirmedTrack=track
if not CVU_KnifeExpTrackHasStarted(confirmedTrack)then
confirmedTrack=CVU_KnifeExpFindPlayingAttackTrack(weaponName,heavy)
end
if confirmedTrack then
local sound=CVU_BS_PlayWeaponSound(weaponName,preferred,"1",5)
if not sound then
for _,folderName in ipairs(
heavy
and {"Heavy Swing","HeavySwing","SwingHeavy","Slash"}
or {"Swing"..tostring((index%2)+1),"Swing","Slash"}
)do
if not sound then
sound=CVU_BS_PlayWeaponSound(weaponName,folderName,"1",5)
end
end
end
if sound then CVU_KnifeExpScheduleOriginalSoundMute()end
return
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
until os.clock()>=deadline

-- 没有动画就是游戏拒绝了本次输入（例如开局五秒准备期）。
-- 此时不制造独立的挥刀声。
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus="游戏未接受挥刀，音效已阻止"
end)

return true
end

function CVU_PlayKnifeExperienceInspect()
if Runtime.Shutdown
or not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
or not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()then
return false
end

if Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting or Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwinging then
return false
end
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack and Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack.IsPlaying then
return false
end

local weaponName=
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName
or CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType())
if not weaponName then return false end

-- Butterfly 的 Equip / Swing 動畫很長；Action4 Inspect 不能在它們中間硬插入。
if CVU_KnifeExpIsNativeActionConflictPlaying(weaponName)then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus="刀具動作中，Inspect 已阻止避免衝突"
return false
end

local track=Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackWeapon~=weaponName
or not Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackRoot
or not Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackRoot.Parent then
track=nil
end

if not track then
CVU_BS_LoadNativeKnifeTracks(weaponName)
track=Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack
end

if not track then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus="這把刀找不到 CameraAnimations/Inspect"
return false
end

local variants=CVU_KnifeExpInspectAnimations(CVU_BS_GetAnimationFolder(weaponName))
local variantCount
if weaponName=="Karambit"then
variantCount=math.min(1,#variants)
elseif weaponName=="Butterfly Knife"then
-- 蝴蝶刀固定輪替 Inspect1 / Inspect2，各自使用同編號音效。
variantCount=math.min(2,#variants)
else
variantCount=#variants
end
local inspectIndex=1
local inspectAnimationName="Inspect"
if variantCount>0 then
local nextIndex=((Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectVariantCursor or 0)%variantCount)+1
local entry=variants[nextIndex]
-- 蝴蝶刀以實際播放次序配對，不依賴動畫物件是否剛好命名為 Inspect1/Inspect2。
-- 第一個檢視固定用 Inspect1；第二個檢視固定用 Inspect2。
inspectIndex=weaponName=="Butterfly Knife"and nextIndex or entry.Index
inspectAnimationName=entry.Animation.Name
if track.Animation~=entry.Animation then
local animator=CVU_KnifeExpGetAnimator()
local ok,newTrack=pcall(function()return animator:LoadAnimation(entry.Animation)end)
if not ok or not newTrack then return false end
pcall(function()track:Stop(0)track:Destroy()end)
track=newTrack Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack=track
end
track.Priority=Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectVariantCursor=nextIndex
end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration or 0)+1
local actionGeneration=Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingSoundSerial=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwingSoundSerial or 0)+1
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting=true
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack then
pcall(function()Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack:Stop(0.05)end)
end

local played=pcall(function()
if track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(0.03)end
track.TimePosition=0
track:Play(0.04,1,1)
end)
if not played then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting=false
return false
end

pcall(function()
track.Stopped:Once(function()
if actionGeneration==(Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionGeneration or 0)then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting=false
CVU_KnifeExpStopInspectSound()
end
end)
end)

-- Butterfly 必須精確走 Inspect1 / Inspect2，並使用專用搜尋與播放入口。
-- 專用入口會接受 Inspect2、SecondInspect、Inspect/2 三種原生資產結構，
-- 同時拒絕 Inspect1，避免第二個動作再次配到第一個聲音。
local sound=nil
if weaponName=="Butterfly Knife"then
sound=CVU_BS_PlayButterflyInspectSound(inspectIndex,4)
end
if not sound then
sound=CVU_BS_PlayWeaponSound(weaponName,"Inspect",tostring(inspectIndex),4,inspectIndex)
end

Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectSoundName=sound and sound.Name or nil
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectAnimationName=inspectAnimationName
if not sound then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceStatus="檢視動畫已播放，但找不到 "..weaponName.." 的 Inspect"..tostring(inspectIndex).." 音效"
local root=CVU_BS_GetSoundRoot(weaponName)
local available={}
if root then
for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if obj:IsA("Sound")then available[#available+1]=obj:GetFullName().." = "..obj.SoundId end
end
end
warn("[Knife inspect audio] "..weaponName.."\n"..(#available>0 and table.concat(available,"\n")or"沒有找到此刀的音效資產"))
end
CVU_KnifeExpScheduleOriginalSoundMute()
return true
end

function CVU_UpdateKnifeExperienceFrame()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end

local knifeHeld=Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled and CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()
if not knifeHeld then
-- 關鍵：native ViewModel 沒有 clone，所以舊版切槍時根本沒走 Clear。
-- 現在只要「上一幀還拿刀、這一幀已不是刀」就立刻砍掉全部自訂 action track。
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceWasKnifeHeld then
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpCancelActionState,"KnifeUnequipped",true)
end
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWasKnifeHeld=false
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone then CVU_ClearKnifeExperience()end
return
end
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWasKnifeHeld=true

local currentWeaponName=
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName
or CVU_BS_GetExactKnifeName(CVU_GetAppliedKnifeExperienceType())
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting
and currentWeaponName
and CVU_KnifeExpIsNativeActionConflictPlaying(currentWeaponName)then
-- 即使 Heavy/其他攻擊不是由我們的 Mouse1 handler 觸發，
-- 只要真正 Animator 開始播 Equip/Swing，就立刻終止自訂 Inspect。
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpStopInspect,"NativeActionConflict")
end

-- 本局立即刷新 preview：
-- 即使 native hook 已經存在，也要持續把這份完成品跟著 Camera，
-- 不然它只會停在建立當下的位置，看起來像「沒有刷新」。
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone and Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone.Parent then
local weaponName=Runtime.KnifeExperienceWeaponName
CVU_BS_SetViewmodelCFrame(
Runtime.KnifeExperienceClone,
Camera.CFrame*CVU_BS_GetKnifeOffset(weaponName)
)

local equipPlaying=Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack and Runtime.KnifeExperienceEquipTrack.IsPlaying
local inspectPlaying=Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack and Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack.IsPlaying
local swing1Playing=Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track and Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing1Track.IsPlaying
local swing2Playing=Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track and Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwing2Track.IsPlaying
local heavyPlaying=Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack and Runtime.KnifeExperienceHeavySwingTrack.IsPlaying
if not equipPlaying
and not inspectPlaying
and not swing1Playing
and not swing2Playing
and not heavyPlaying
and Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack then
if not Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack.IsPlaying then
pcall(function()Runtime.KnifeExperienceIdleTrack:Play(0.08,1,1)end)
end
end

CVU_KnifeExpHideOriginal()
CVU_KnifeExpHideOriginalArmsForPreview()

-- 同時保持 native hook；等遊戲下一次真的 rebuild 後會接手。
if Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelHooked or CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook()then
CVU_BS_EnsureNativeKnifeSwap(false)
end
return
end

-- 沒有 preview 時，才單純等待/維持 native path。
if Runtime.BloxStrikeViewmodelHooked or CVU_BS_InstallNativeViewmodelHook()then
CVU_BS_EnsureNativeKnifeSwap(false)
return
end

CVU_RefreshKnifeExperience(false)
end

pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_KnifeExperience")end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_KnifeExperience",Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value,function()
pcall(CVU_UpdateKnifeExperienceFrame)
end)

function CVU_KnifeExpUnbindFeedbackActions()
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceFeedbackBound then
pcall(function()ContextActionService:UnbindAction(Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionInspect)end)
pcall(function()ContextActionService:UnbindAction(Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionAttack)end)
end
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceRawInterruptConnection then
pcall(function()Runtime.KnifeExperienceRawInterruptConnection:Disconnect()end)
Runtime.KnifeExperienceRawInterruptConnection=nil
end
Runtime.KnifeExperienceFeedbackBound=false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting=false
Runtime.KnifeExperienceSwinging=false
end

function CVU_KnifeExpHandleFeedbackAction(actionName,inputState,inputObject)
local inputKey=inputObject and tostring(inputObject.UserInputType)..":"..tostring(inputObject.KeyCode)or actionName
Runtime.KnifeExperienceBlockedInputs=Runtime.KnifeExperienceBlockedInputs or {}
if inputState~=Enum.UserInputState.Begin then
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceBlockedInputs[inputKey]then
if inputState==Enum.UserInputState.End or inputState==Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceBlockedInputs[inputKey]=nil
end
return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end
return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end

if Runtime.Shutdown or not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
or not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then
return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end

local butterfly=CVU_KnifeExpIsButterfly()
local function block()
Runtime.KnifeExperienceBlockedInputs[inputKey]=true
return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink
end

if actionName==Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionInspect then
if butterfly and (Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting
or (Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack and Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack.IsPlaying)
or CVU_KnifeExpAttackBusy())then
return block()
end
local ok=false
pcall(function()ok=CVU_PlayKnifeExperienceInspect()==true end)
if ok then return block()end
return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end

if actionName==Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionAttack then
local heavy=inputObject and inputObject.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
if not butterfly and heavy then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end
-- 左右键的优先级高于 Inspect：先确实停止检视动画与检视音效，
-- 然后才判断是否已有另一段挥砍。挥与砍仍然不能互相打断。
local inspecting=Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting
or (Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack and Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack.IsPlaying)
if inspecting then pcall(CVU_KnifeExpStopInspect,"AttackInput")end
if butterfly and CVU_KnifeExpAttackBusy()then return block()end
local now=os.clock()
if butterfly or now-(Runtime.KnifeExperienceLastAttack or 0)>=(Runtime.KnifeExperienceAttackCooldown or 1.0)then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceLastAttack=now
pcall(CVU_PlayKnifeExperienceSwing,heavy)
-- Bridge the input-to-Animator delay; actual tracks govern the rest of the attack.
if butterfly then Runtime.KnifeExperienceAttackStartUntil=now+0.20 end
end
return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end
return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass
end

function CVU_KnifeExpBindFeedbackActions()
CVU_KnifeExpUnbindFeedbackActions()

-- CAS 与游戏武器控制器的触发顺序会随 ViewModel 重建改变。
-- 原始输入监听只负责抢先停止 Inspect，不播放攻击也不吞输入；
-- 后续攻击仍由游戏和上面的状态机决定。
Runtime.KnifeExperienceRawInterruptConnection=
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,processed)
if processed
or Runtime.Shutdown
or not Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
or not CVU_KnifeExpIsKnifeHeld()
or UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then return end
if input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
and input.UserInputType~=Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then return end
if Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspecting
or (Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack and Runtime.KnifeExperienceInspectTrack.IsPlaying)then
Runtime.KnifeExperienceRawInterruptAt=os.clock()
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpStopInspect,"RawAttackInput")
end
end)

ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionInspect,
CVU_KnifeExpHandleFeedbackAction,
false,
10000,
Enum.KeyCode.F
)

ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(
Runtime.KnifeExperienceActionAttack,
CVU_KnifeExpHandleFeedbackAction,
false,
10000,
Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,
Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
)

Runtime.KnifeExperienceFeedbackBound=true
CVU_KnifeExpBuildOriginalKnifeSoundIds()
return true
end

local FOVCircle=Instance.new("Frame")
FOVCircle.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
FOVCircle.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
FOVCircle.BackgroundTransparency=0
FOVCircle.BorderSizePixel=0
FOVCircle.Parent=Overlay
local FOVCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")FOVCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)FOVCorner.Parent=FOVCircle
local FOVGradient=Instance.new("UIGradient")FOVGradient.Name="FOVFillGradient" FOVGradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.80),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.93)}) FOVGradient.Parent=FOVCircle
local FOVStroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")FOVStroke.Thickness=2 FOVStroke.Parent=FOVCircle
local function CVU_FOVLightenColor(color,amount)
 local c=typeof(color)=="Color3"and color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
 local a=math.clamp(tonumber(amount)or .28,0,1)
 return Color3.new(c.R+(1-c.R)*a,c.G+(1-c.G)*a,c.B+(1-c.B)*a)
end

function CVU_UpdateFOV()
 if not Camera then return end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize/2
 FOVCircle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(center.X,center.Y)
 FOVCircle.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(Settings.FOVRadius*2,Settings.FOVRadius*2)
 FOVCircle.Visible=false
 FOVStroke.Color=Settings.FOVColor
 local fovFill1=typeof(Settings.FOVFillColor1)=="Color3"and Settings.FOVFillColor1 or Color3.fromRGB(92,88,235)
 local fovFill2=typeof(Settings.FOVFillColor2)=="Color3"and Settings.FOVFillColor2 or Color3.fromRGB(80,205,255)
 local fovFill2Light=CVU_FOVLightenColor(fovFill2,.30)
 FOVGradient.Color=ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,fovFill1),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,fovFill2Light)})
 FOVGradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.80),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.93)})
 FOVGradient.Rotation=Settings.FOVFillRotate==true and((os.clock()*32)%360)or 0

 local curveRadius=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.PseudoWallFOV)or 110,10,500)
 RivalsCurveFOVCircle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(center.X,center.Y)
 RivalsCurveFOVCircle.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(curveRadius*2,curveRadius*2)
 RivalsCurveFOVCircle.Visible=Settings.PseudoWallPenetration==true
 RivalsCurveFOVStroke.Color=CVU_FOVLightenColor(Settings.FOVColor,.18)

 local aimRadius=CVU_RIVALS_GetEffectiveAimFOV()
 local aimCenter=center
 local rivalsCombatActive=type(CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive)=="function"and CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive()or false
 if Settings.RivalsAimFOVFollow==true and rivalsCombatActive then
  local tracked=Runtime.RivalsAimFOVVisualCenter
  if typeof(tracked)=="Vector2"then aimCenter=tracked end
 end
 aimCenter=Vector2.new(math.clamp(aimCenter.X,0,Camera.ViewportSize.X),math.clamp(aimCenter.Y,0,Camera.ViewportSize.Y))
 RivalsAimFOVCircle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(aimCenter.X,aimCenter.Y)
 RivalsAimFOVCircle.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(aimRadius*2,aimRadius*2)
 -- V76: the Aim FOV is allowed to remain visible in the lobby as a settings preview.
 -- Lobby guard still disables target acquisition, tracking, mouse movement and Auto-fire.
 -- Free-follow is combat-only, so in the lobby the frame stays fixed at screen center.
 RivalsAimFOVCircle.Visible=Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true and Settings.RivalsAimFOVVisible==true
 if not rivalsCombatActive then Runtime.RivalsAimFOVVisualCenter=nil end
 RivalsAimFOVStroke.Enabled=Settings.RivalsAimFOVOutline==true
 RivalsAimFOVStroke.Color=typeof(Settings.RivalsAimFOVColor)=="Color3"and Settings.RivalsAimFOVColor or Color3.fromRGB(125,120,255)
 local aimFill1=typeof(Settings.RivalsAimFOVFillColor1)=="Color3"and Settings.RivalsAimFOVFillColor1 or Color3.fromRGB(92,88,235)
 local aimFill2=typeof(Settings.RivalsAimFOVFillColor2)=="Color3"and Settings.RivalsAimFOVFillColor2 or Color3.fromRGB(80,205,255)
 RivalsAimFOVGradient.Color=ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,aimFill1),ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,CVU_FOVLightenColor(aimFill2,.30))})
 RivalsAimFOVGradient.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.80),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.93)})
 RivalsAimFOVGradient.Enabled=Settings.RivalsAimFOVFill==true
 RivalsAimFOVCircle.BackgroundTransparency=Settings.RivalsAimFOVFill==true and 0 or 1
 RivalsAimFOVGradient.Rotation=Settings.RivalsAimFOVFillRotate==true and((os.clock()*32)%360)or 0
end

function CVU_SnapshotSkyObject(sky)
    if not sky or not sky:IsA("Sky")then return nil end
    local data={Name=sky.Name}
    for _,key in ipairs({
        "SkyboxBk","SkyboxDn","SkyboxFt","SkyboxLf","SkyboxRt","SkyboxUp",
        "SunTextureId","MoonTextureId","SunAngularSize","MoonAngularSize",
        "StarCount","CelestialBodiesShown",
    })do
        pcall(function()data[key]=sky[key]end)
    end
    return data
end

function CVU_CaptureSkyObjects(snapshot)
    if type(snapshot)~="table"then return end
    snapshot.Skies={}
    for _,obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren())do
        if obj:IsA("Sky")and obj:GetAttribute("CVU_RealSkybox")~=true then
            local data=CVU_SnapshotSkyObject(obj)
            if data then snapshot.Skies[#snapshot.Skies+1]=data end
        end
    end
end

function CVU_DestroyAllSkyObjects()
    for _,obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren())do
        if obj:IsA("Sky")then
            pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)
        end
    end
    CVU_RealSkyboxObject=nil
end

function CVU_RestoreSkyObjects(snapshot)
    if type(snapshot)~="table"then return end
    CVU_DestroyAllSkyObjects()
    for index,data in ipairs(snapshot.Skies or{})do
        local sky=Instance.new("Sky")
        sky.Name=tostring(data.Name or("Sky_"..index))
        for _,key in ipairs({
            "SkyboxBk","SkyboxDn","SkyboxFt","SkyboxLf","SkyboxRt","SkyboxUp",
            "SunTextureId","MoonTextureId","SunAngularSize","MoonAngularSize",
            "StarCount","CelestialBodiesShown",
        })do
            if data[key]~=nil then pcall(function()sky[key]=data[key]end)end
        end
        sky.Parent=Lighting
    end
    CVU_RealSkyboxActive=false
    CVU_RealSkyboxMode=nil
    CVU_RealSkyboxObject=nil
end

function CVU_ApplyRealSkybox(mode)
    local cfg=CVU_RealSkyboxPresets[mode]
    if type(cfg)~="table"then return false end

    if not SkyRestoreSnapshot then CVU_CaptureSkyRestoreState()end

    if not CVU_RealSkyboxActive
    or CVU_RealSkyboxMode~=mode
    or not CVU_RealSkyboxObject
    or not CVU_RealSkyboxObject.Parent then
        CVU_DestroyAllSkyObjects()
        local sky=Instance.new("Sky")
        sky.Name="雞視覺_真Skybox"
        sky:SetAttribute("CVU_RealSkybox",true)
        CVU_RealSkyboxObject=sky
        CVU_RealSkyboxActive=true
        CVU_RealSkyboxMode=mode
        sky.Parent=Lighting
    end

    local sky=CVU_RealSkyboxObject
    for _,key in ipairs({"SkyboxBk","SkyboxDn","SkyboxFt","SkyboxLf","SkyboxRt","SkyboxUp"})do
        if cfg[key]then pcall(function()sky[key]=cfg[key]end)end
    end
    pcall(function()sky.CelestialBodiesShown=cfg.CelestialBodiesShown~=false end)
    pcall(function()sky.StarCount=tonumber(cfg.StarCount)or 0 end)

    Lighting.ClockTime=tonumber(cfg.ClockTime)or Lighting.ClockTime
    Lighting.Brightness=tonumber(cfg.Brightness)or Lighting.Brightness
    Lighting.ExposureCompensation=tonumber(cfg.Exposure)or 0
    if typeof(cfg.Ambient)=="Color3"then Lighting.Ambient=cfg.Ambient end
    if typeof(cfg.OutdoorAmbient)=="Color3"then Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=cfg.OutdoorAmbient end

    return true
end

function CVU_LeaveRealSkyboxIfNeeded()
    if CVU_RealSkyboxActive and SkyRestoreSnapshot then
        CVU_RestoreSkyObjects(SkyRestoreSnapshot)
    end
end

function CVU_IsOwnedSkyEffect(object)
    if not object then return false end
    local owned=false
    pcall(function()owned=object:GetAttribute("CVU_SkyEffect")==true end)
    return owned
        or object.Name=="雞視覺_天空"
        or object.Name=="雞視覺_天空光暈"
end

function CVU_DestroyStaleSkyEffects(keepAtmosphere,keepBloom)
    for _,object in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren())do
        if object~=keepAtmosphere and object~=keepBloom and CVU_IsOwnedSkyEffect(object)then
            pcall(function()object:Destroy()end)
        end
    end
end

function CVU_EnsureSkyEffects()
    -- 先清掉舊腳本/重複執行留下來的天空物件，避免關閉後還有另一份 Atmosphere/Bloom 留著。
    CVU_DestroyStaleSkyEffects(SkyAtmosphere,SkyBloom)

    if not SkyAtmosphere or not SkyAtmosphere.Parent then
        SkyAtmosphere=Instance.new("Atmosphere")
        SkyAtmosphere.Name="雞視覺_天空"
        SkyAtmosphere:SetAttribute("CVU_SkyEffect",true)
        SkyAtmosphere.Parent=Lighting
    end
    if not SkyBloom or not SkyBloom.Parent then
        SkyBloom=Instance.new("BloomEffect")
        SkyBloom.Name="雞視覺_天空光暈"
        SkyBloom:SetAttribute("CVU_SkyEffect",true)
        SkyBloom.Parent=Lighting
    end
end

function CVU_ClearSkyEffects()
    -- 不只清 local reference，也掃 Lighting，把舊版本殘留的同名天空物件一起刪掉。
    CVU_DestroyStaleSkyEffects(nil,nil)
    if SkyAtmosphere and SkyAtmosphere.Parent then pcall(function()SkyAtmosphere:Destroy()end)end
    if SkyBloom and SkyBloom.Parent then pcall(function()SkyBloom:Destroy()end)end
    SkyAtmosphere=nil
    SkyBloom=nil
end

function CVU_CaptureSkyRestoreState()
    if SkyRestoreSnapshot then return end
    SkyRestoreSnapshot={
        ClockTime=Lighting.ClockTime,
        Brightness=Lighting.Brightness,
        ExposureCompensation=Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
        Ambient=Lighting.Ambient,
        OutdoorAmbient=Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
        FogColor=Lighting.FogColor,
        FogStart=Lighting.FogStart,
        FogEnd=Lighting.FogEnd,
        ColorShift_Top=Lighting.ColorShift_Top,
        ColorShift_Bottom=Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom,
    }
    CVU_CaptureSkyObjects(SkyRestoreSnapshot)
end

function CVU_ApplyLightingSnapshot(o)
    if not o then return end
    if o.ClockTime~=nil then Lighting.ClockTime=o.ClockTime end
    if o.Brightness~=nil then Lighting.Brightness=o.Brightness end
    if o.ExposureCompensation~=nil then Lighting.ExposureCompensation=o.ExposureCompensation end
    if o.Ambient~=nil then Lighting.Ambient=o.Ambient end
    if o.OutdoorAmbient~=nil then Lighting.OutdoorAmbient=o.OutdoorAmbient end
    if o.FogColor~=nil then Lighting.FogColor=o.FogColor end
    if o.FogStart~=nil then Lighting.FogStart=o.FogStart end
    if o.FogEnd~=nil then Lighting.FogEnd=o.FogEnd end
    if o.ColorShift_Top~=nil then Lighting.ColorShift_Top=o.ColorShift_Top end
    if o.ColorShift_Bottom~=nil then Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom=o.ColorShift_Bottom end
end

function CVU_RestoreSkyOriginalState()
    SkyRestoreGeneration+=1
    local generation=SkyRestoreGeneration
    local snapshot=SkyRestoreSnapshot or Runtime.OriginalLighting

    CVU_ClearSkyEffects()
    CVU_RestoreSkyObjects(snapshot)
    CVU_ApplyLightingSnapshot(snapshot)
    SkyRestoreSnapshot=nil

    -- 有些遊戲/舊版 CVU 會在同一幀晚一點再改 Lighting；下一幀再驗證一次。
    task.defer(function()
        task.wait()
        if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
        if Settings.Skybox then return end
        if generation~=SkyRestoreGeneration then return end
        CVU_ClearSkyEffects()
        CVU_RestoreSkyObjects(snapshot)
        CVU_ApplyLightingSnapshot(snapshot)
        if Settings.Fog then pcall(CVU_EnsureFog)end
    end)
end
 function CVU_ApplySky()
if not Settings.Skybox then
CVU_RestoreSkyOriginalState()
if Settings.Fog then CVU_EnsureFog()end
