function CVU_StopMusic()
 Runtime.MusicGeneration=(Runtime.MusicGeneration or 0)+1
 local sound=Runtime.MusicSound
 Runtime.MusicSound=nil
 Runtime.MusicSoundName=nil
 if sound then
 pcall(function()sound:Stop()end)
 pcall(function()sound:Destroy()end)
 end
end

function CVU_ApplyMusic(restart)
 if Runtime.Shutdown or Settings.MusicEnabled~=true then
 CVU_StopMusic()
 return false
 end
 local entry=Runtime.MusicByName[Settings.MusicTrack]
 if not entry then
 entry=Runtime.MusicCatalog[1]
 Settings.MusicTrack=entry.Name
 Settings.MusicCategory=entry.Mood
 end
 local sound=Runtime.MusicSound
 if not restart and sound and sound.Parent and Runtime.MusicSoundName==entry.Name then
 sound.Volume=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.MusicVolume)or .35,0,1)
 if not sound.Playing then pcall(function()sound:Play()end)end
 return true
 end
 CVU_StopMusic()
 sound=Instance.new("Sound")
 sound.Name="ChickenVisual_Music"
 sound.SoundId="rbxassetid://"..tostring(entry.Id)
 sound.Volume=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.MusicVolume)or .35,0,1)
 sound.Looped=true
 sound.RollOffMaxDistance=100000
 sound.Parent=SoundService
 Runtime.MusicSound=sound
 Runtime.MusicSoundName=entry.Name
 local ok=pcall(function()sound:Play()end)
 Runtime.MusicLastPlayOK=ok
 return ok
end

function CVU_SelectMusic(trackName)
 local entry=Runtime.MusicByName[trackName]
 if not entry then return false end
 Settings.MusicTrack=entry.Name
 Settings.MusicCategory=entry.Mood
 CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
 if Settings.MusicEnabled then CVU_ApplyMusic(true)end
 return true
end

-- ============================================================
-- Music hotkey / 播歌快捷鍵
-- Uses UserInputService directly so every keyboard/mouse InputObject Roblox exposes
-- can be captured. Vendor-only macro/HID keys that Roblox itself never exposes
-- cannot be observed from Luau; recognized gaming/media keys are accepted normally.
-- No input is swallowed, so binding Mouse1/Mouse2 etc. still lets the game receive it.
-- ============================================================
function CVU_MusicHotkeyTokenFromInput(input,wheelDirection)
 if not input then return nil end
 local userTypeName=""
 local keyName=""
 pcall(function()userTypeName=input.UserInputType.Name end)
 pcall(function()keyName=input.KeyCode.Name end)
 if userTypeName=="Keyboard" then
  if keyName~=""and keyName~="Unknown"then return"K:"..keyName end
  return nil
 end
 if string.sub(userTypeName,1,11)=="MouseButton"then
  return"M:"..userTypeName
 end
 if userTypeName=="MouseWheel"then
  local direction=tonumber(wheelDirection)
  if not direction then pcall(function()direction=input.Position.Z end)end
  if direction and direction>0 then return"MW:Up"end
  if direction and direction<0 then return"MW:Down"end
 end
 return nil
end

function CVU_MusicHotkeyDisplay(token)
 token=tostring(token or"None")
 if token==""or token=="None"then return"未設定"end
 if string.sub(token,1,2)=="K:"then
  local name=string.sub(token,3)
  local pretty={
   LeftControl="左 Ctrl",RightControl="右 Ctrl",LeftShift="左 Shift",RightShift="右 Shift",
   LeftAlt="左 Alt",RightAlt="右 Alt",Return="Enter",Backspace="Backspace",Space="Space",
   CapsLock="Caps Lock",NumLock="Num Lock",ScrollLock="Scroll Lock",Print="Print Screen",
   PageUp="Page Up",PageDown="Page Down",Home="Home",End="End",Insert="Insert",Delete="Delete",
   Up="↑",Down="↓",Left="←",Right="→",
  }
  return pretty[name]or name
 end
 if string.sub(token,1,2)=="M:"then
  local name=string.sub(token,3)
  local pretty={MouseButton1="滑鼠左鍵",MouseButton2="滑鼠右鍵",MouseButton3="滑鼠中鍵",MouseButton4="滑鼠側鍵 1",MouseButton5="滑鼠側鍵 2"}
  return pretty[name]or name
 end
 if token=="MW:Up"then return"滑鼠滾輪 ↑"end
 if token=="MW:Down"then return"滑鼠滾輪 ↓"end
 return token
end

function CVU_SetMusicEnabled(enabled)
 Settings.MusicEnabled=enabled==true
 if Settings.MusicEnabled then CVU_ApplyMusic(true)else CVU_StopMusic()end
 CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
 pcall(CVU_RefreshAllToggleVisuals)
 if type(Runtime.MusicHotkeyRefresh)=="function"then pcall(Runtime.MusicHotkeyRefresh)end
 if type(Runtime.MusicUIRefresh)=="function"then pcall(Runtime.MusicUIRefresh)end
end

function CVU_MusicHotkeyMatches(input,wheelDirection)
 local wanted=tostring(Settings.MusicHotkey or"None")
 if wanted=="None"or wanted==""then return false end
 return CVU_MusicHotkeyTokenFromInput(input,wheelDirection)==wanted
end

function CVU_MusicHotkeyFire(input,wheelDirection,isRelease)
 if Runtime.Shutdown then return false end
 local token=CVU_MusicHotkeyTokenFromInput(input,wheelDirection)
 if not token then return false end

 -- Capture mode intentionally accepts Escape, function keys, mouse buttons, etc.
 -- The separate Clear button is used to unassign instead of reserving a cancel key.
 if Runtime.MusicHotkeyCapturing and not isRelease then
  Settings.MusicHotkey=token
  Runtime.MusicHotkeyCapturing=false
  Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive=false
  CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
  if type(Runtime.MusicHotkeyRefresh)=="function"then pcall(Runtime.MusicHotkeyRefresh)end
  return true
 end

 if token~=tostring(Settings.MusicHotkey or"None")then return false end
 if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end

 local mode=tostring(Settings.MusicHotkeyMode or"切換")
 if string.sub(token,1,3)=="MW:"then mode="切換"end -- wheel has no meaningful release event
 if mode=="按住"then
  if isRelease then
   if Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive then
    Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive=false
    CVU_SetMusicEnabled(false)
   end
  elseif not Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive then
   Runtime.MusicHotkeyHoldActive=true
   CVU_SetMusicEnabled(true)
  end
  return true
 end

 if isRelease then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now-(Runtime.MusicHotkeyLastTrigger or 0)<.10 then return true end
 Runtime.MusicHotkeyLastTrigger=now
 CVU_SetMusicEnabled(not Settings.MusicEnabled)
 return true
end

Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections=Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections or{}
Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections[#Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections+1]=UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input,_processed)
 CVU_MusicHotkeyFire(input,nil,false)
end)
Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections[#Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections+1]=UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input,_processed)
 CVU_MusicHotkeyFire(input,nil,true)
end)
Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections[#Runtime.MusicHotkeyConnections+1]=UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input,_processed)
 local userTypeName=""
 pcall(function()userTypeName=input.UserInputType.Name end)
 if userTypeName~="MouseWheel"then return end
 local direction=0
 pcall(function()direction=input.Position.Z end)
 if direction~=0 then CVU_MusicHotkeyFire(input,direction,false)end
end)

-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS combat functions are installed by the native adapter below.
-- ============================================================

function CVU_IsConfirmedDead(char)
if not char then return false end

-- 1) 優先只相信 Character 自己的 Humanoid。
local hum=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
return hum.Health<=0 or hum:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead
end

-- 2) 只讀 Character 本體上的死亡 Attribute。
-- 不再遞迴找子模型，避免武器 / 裝備 / 臨時模型裡的 Dead/HP 誤判。
for _,attrName in ipairs({"Dead","IsDead","Eliminated","Killed"})do
if char:GetAttribute(attrName)==true then
return true
end
end

-- 3) 只接受 Character 直接子層的 Health/HP/HitPoints。
-- 舊版 FindFirstChild(name,true) 可能抓到武器、護甲或其他子模型的 0 HP。
for _,name in ipairs({"Health","HP","HitPoints"})do
local v=char:FindFirstChild(name)
if v and (v:IsA("NumberValue")or v:IsA("IntValue"))then
local n=tonumber(v.Value)
if n~=nil then
return n<=0
end
end
end

-- 4) 不再把「暫時離開 Workspace」直接視為死亡。
-- 某些角色在受擊、換容器、LOD / ragdoll 切換時會短暫被搬動，
-- 這正是會造成單次受擊白光誤觸發的來源。
return false
end

function CVU_WaitConfirmedDead(char,timeout)
local deadline=os.clock()+(timeout or .65)
repeat
if CVU_IsConfirmedDead(char)then return true end
task.wait(.035)
until os.clock()>=deadline
return CVU_IsConfirmedDead(char)
end

function CVU_FCBN(n)if not n or n==""then return nil end local p=Players:FindFirstChild(n)if p and p.Character and p.Character.Parent then return p.Character end local chars=Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")if chars then for _,team in ipairs(chars:GetChildren())do local m=team:FindFirstChild(n)if m and m:IsA("Model")then return m end end end for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do if plr.DisplayName==n or plr.Name==n then if plr.Character and plr.Character.Parent then return plr.Character end if chars then for _,team in ipairs(chars:GetChildren())do local m=team:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)if m and m:IsA("Model")then return m end end end end end end local KillFeedSeen=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})function CVU_PKFO(obj)if Runtime.Shutdown or(not Settings.CVU_KillEffect and not Settings.BulletSound and not CVU_AnyGunKillCounterEnabled())or not obj or KillFeedSeen[obj]or obj:IsDescendantOf(GUI)then return end KillFeedSeen[obj]=true task.defer(function()task.wait(.03)if not obj or not obj.Parent then return end local texts={}if obj:IsA("TextLabel")or obj:IsA("TextButton")then texts[#texts+1]=obj.Text end for _,d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("TextLabel")or d:IsA("TextButton")then if d.Text and d.Text~=""then texts[#texts+1]=d.Text end end end if#texts==0 then return end local all=table.concat(texts," ")local me=(string.find(string.lower(all),string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name),1,true)~=nil)or(string.find(string.lower(all),string.lower(LocalPlayer.DisplayName),1,true)~=nil)if not me then return end for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do if plr~=LocalPlayer and not CVU_IsSameTeam(plr)then local a=string.lower(all)if string.find(a,string.lower(plr.Name),1,true)or string.find(a,string.lower(plr.DisplayName),1,true)then local char=CVU_FCBN(plr.Name)or CVU_FCBN(plr.DisplayName)if char then
if CVU_WaitConfirmedDead(char,.65)then
-- Kill Feed 已同時包含「本地玩家 + 敵人」且死亡驗證成功，
-- 因此可作為自訂傷害流程 / 瞬殺流程的可靠後備確認。
CVU_NotifyConfirmedKill(plr)
if Settings.CVU_KillEffect then CVU_KillEffect(char)end
end
return
end end end end end)end function CVU_BindKillFeed(root)if not root then return end for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do if d:IsA("GuiObject")then CVU_PKFO(d)end end root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)if d:IsA("GuiObject")then CVU_PKFO(d)end end)end CVU_BindKillFeed(PlayerGui)function CVU_IsChicken(model)if not model or not model:IsA("Model")then return false end if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)then return false end return CollectionService:HasTag(model,"Chicken")or model:GetAttribute("Chicken")==true or model:GetAttribute("EntityType")=="Chicken"end function CVU_ChickenAlive(chicken)if not chicken or not chicken.Parent or not chicken:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)then return false end if chicken:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return false end local hp=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(chicken))return hp==nil or hp>0 end function CVU_GetChickenPart(chicken)for _,name in ipairs(Settings.ChickenParts)do local part=chicken:FindFirstChild(name,true)if part and part:IsA("BasePart")then return part end end return chicken.PrimaryPart end function CVU_GetChickenTeam(chicken)local team=chicken:GetAttribute("Team")if team~=nil then return tostring(team)end local value=chicken:FindFirstChild("Team",true)if value and value:IsA("ValueBase")then return tostring(value.Value)end return nil end function CVU_IsChickenTeammate(chicken)if not Settings.TeamCheck then return false end local mine=CVU_GetPlayerTeamKey(LocalPlayer)local theirs=CVU_GetChickenTeam(chicken)if not mine or not theirs then return false end local mineValue=string.match(mine,":(.+)$")or mine return tostring(mineValue)==tostring(theirs)end function CVU_BuildChickenCandidate(chicken)if not CVU_IsChicken(chicken)then return nil end if not CVU_ChickenAlive(chicken)then return nil end if CVU_IsChickenTeammate(chicken)then return nil end local part=CVU_GetChickenPart(chicken)if not part then return nil end local screen,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)if not onScreen or screen.Z<=0 then return nil end local center=Camera.ViewportSize/2 local crosshairDistance=(Vector2.new(screen.X,screen.Y)-center).Magnitude if crosshairDistance>Settings.FOVRadius then return nil end local root=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")local worldDistance=root and(root.Position-part.Position).Magnitude or math.huge local health=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(chicken))or 100 return{Chicken=chicken,Part=part,CrosshairDistance=crosshairDistance,WorldDistance=worldDistance,Health=health,}end function CVU_BetterChicken(a,b)if not b then return true end if Settings.TargetMode=="準心最近"then return a.CrosshairDistance<b.CrosshairDistance elseif Settings.TargetMode=="準心最遠"then return a.CrosshairDistance>b.CrosshairDistance elseif Settings.TargetMode=="最低血量"then if a.Health==b.Health then return a.CrosshairDistance<b.CrosshairDistance end return a.Health<b.Health elseif Settings.TargetMode=="最高血量"then if a.Health==b.Health then return a.CrosshairDistance<b.CrosshairDistance end return a.Health>b.Health elseif Settings.TargetMode=="距離最近"then if a.WorldDistance==b.WorldDistance then return a.CrosshairDistance<b.CrosshairDistance end return a.WorldDistance<b.WorldDistance elseif Settings.TargetMode=="距離最遠"then if a.WorldDistance==b.WorldDistance then return a.CrosshairDistance<b.CrosshairDistance end return a.WorldDistance>b.WorldDistance end return false end function CVU_GetBestChicken()local best=nil for _,chicken in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Chicken"))do local candidate=CVU_BuildChickenCandidate(chicken)if candidate and CVU_BetterChicken(candidate,best)then best=candidate end end if not best then return nil,nil end return best.Chicken,best.Part end function CVU_GetPredictedPosition(part,origin)if not Settings.Prediction then return part.Position end local travelTime=(part.Position-origin).Magnitude/math.max(Settings.BulletSpeed,1)return part.Position+part.AssemblyLinearVelocity*(travelTime+Settings.PredictionTime)end function CVU_ShouldModifyChicken()if not Settings.ChickenSilent then return false end local chicken=Runtime.CurrentChicken local part=Runtime.CurrentChickenPart if not chicken or not part then return false end if not CVU_IsChicken(chicken)then return false end if not CVU_ChickenAlive(chicken)then return false end if CVU_IsChickenTeammate(chicken)then return false end return true end function delta=target-origin if delta.Magnitude<=0.001 then return originalDirection end local magnitude=originalDirection.Magnitude if magnitude<=0 then magnitude=1000 end return delta.Unit*magnitude end function CVU_RedirectResult(result)if not CVU_ShouldModifyChicken()then return result end if type(result)~="table"then return result end local hits=result.Hits local origin=result.Origin if type(hits)~="table"or typeof(origin)~="Vector3"then return result end local finalIndex=nil for index,hit in pairs(hits)do if type(index)=="number"and type(hit)=="table"then if finalIndex==nil or index>finalIndex then finalIndex=index end end end if not finalIndex then return result end local finalHit=hits[finalIndex]local target=CVU_GetPredictedPosition(Runtime.CurrentChickenPart,origin)finalHit.Instance=Runtime.CurrentChickenPart finalHit.Position=target if finalHit.Exit~=nil then finalHit.Exit=false end result.Chicken=true local delta=target-origin if delta.Magnitude>0.001 then result.Direction=delta.Unit result.Distance=delta.Magnitude end return result end function CVU_GetRagePosition(part)local target=part.Position if Settings.RagePosition=="後方"then local position=target+part.CFrame.LookVector*Settings.BehindDistance return CFrame.lookAt(position,target)end local position=target+Vector3.new(0,Settings.AboveHeight,0)return CFrame.lookAt(position,target)end function CVU_MoveToChicken(part)local character=LocalPlayer.Character if not character then return end if Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame==nil then Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame=character:GetPivot()end character:PivotTo(CVU_GetRagePosition(part))end function CVU_ReturnCharacter()local character=LocalPlayer.Character if character and Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame then character:PivotTo(Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame)end Runtime.OriginalCharacterCFrame=nil end function CVU_RageFire()if not Settings.ChickenRage then return end if not CVU_ShouldModifyChicken()then return end local now=os.clock()if now-Runtime.LastFire<Settings.FireInterval then return end Runtime.LastFire=now if _G.ChickenVisual and type(_G.ChickenVisual.OnFireRequested)=="function"then _G.ChickenVisual.OnFireRequested(Runtime.CurrentChicken,Runtime.CurrentChickenPart)end end 
-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS native combat adapter V2
-- Verified RIVALS paths used here:
--   PlayerScripts.Modules.ItemTypes.Gun
--   PlayerScripts.Modules.ClientReplicatedClasses.ClientFighter.ClientItem.ClientViewModel
--   PlayerScripts.Controllers.FighterController / SpectateController / CameraController
--   ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ItemLibrary / GameplayUtility / Utility / EnumLibrary
--   ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.Replication.Fighter.UseItem + StartShooting
--
-- Important: RIVALS is NOT BloxStrike.
-- Rapid-fire, recoil, spread and wallbang below use RIVALS-native objects only.
-- ============================================================
function CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend()
-- Do not early-return just because one RIVALS module was found.  Some controllers/classes are
-- created later than ItemLibrary; retry missing pieces on every call so recoil/rapid-fire hooks
-- can bind to the actual live classes after respawn / map transition.
local scripts=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
local pmodules=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Modules")
local itemTypes=pmodules and pmodules:FindFirstChild("ItemTypes")
local replicatedModules=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
local controllers=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")

local function requireInto(field,module)
if Runtime[field]~=nil or not(module and module:IsA("ModuleScript"))then return end
pcall(function()
local value=require(module)
if value~=nil then Runtime[field]=value end
end)
end

requireInto("RivalsItemLibrary",replicatedModules and replicatedModules:FindFirstChild("ItemLibrary"))
requireInto("RivalsGameplayUtility",replicatedModules and replicatedModules:FindFirstChild("GameplayUtility"))
requireInto("RivalsUtility",replicatedModules and replicatedModules:FindFirstChild("Utility"))
requireInto("RivalsEnumLibrary",replicatedModules and replicatedModules:FindFirstChild("EnumLibrary"))
requireInto("RivalsGunModule",itemTypes and itemTypes:FindFirstChild("Gun"))

if Runtime.RivalsClientViewModel==nil then
pcall(function()
local clientClasses=pmodules and pmodules:FindFirstChild("ClientReplicatedClasses")
local fighter=clientClasses and clientClasses:FindFirstChild("ClientFighter")
local item=fighter and fighter:FindFirstChild("ClientItem")
local module=item and item:FindFirstChild("ClientViewModel")
if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript")then Runtime.RivalsClientViewModel=require(module)end
end)
end
requireInto("RivalsFighterController",controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("FighterController"))
requireInto("RivalsSpectateController",controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("SpectateController"))
requireInto("RivalsMechanicsController",controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("MechanicsController"))

-- CameraController is an object in some builds and a class/metatable proxy in others.  Keep every
-- plausible method table instead of assuming getmetatable(object) itself owns Update/Shake.
if Runtime.RivalsCameraControllerObject==nil or type(Runtime.RivalsCameraControllerMethodTables)~="table"then
pcall(function()
local module=controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("CameraController")
if module and module:IsA("ModuleScript")then
local object=require(module)
Runtime.RivalsCameraControllerObject=object
local tables,seen={},{}
local function add(tbl)
if type(tbl)=="table"and not seen[tbl]then seen[tbl]=true tables[#tables+1]=tbl end
end
add(object)
local mt=getmetatable(object)
add(mt)
if type(mt)=="table"then add(rawget(mt,"__index"))end
Runtime.RivalsCameraControllerMethodTables=tables
local primary=nil
for _,tbl in ipairs(tables)do
if type(rawget(tbl,"Update"))=="function"or type(rawget(tbl,"ShakeOnce"))=="function"or type(rawget(tbl,"Shake"))=="function"then primary=tbl break end
end
Runtime.RivalsCameraControllerMethods=primary or object
end
end)
end

local remotes=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
local replication=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Replication")
local fighterRemote=replication and replication:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
if Runtime.RivalsUseItemRemote==nil then Runtime.RivalsUseItemRemote=fighterRemote and fighterRemote:FindFirstChild("UseItem")or nil end

if Runtime.RivalsStartShootingEnum==nil and Runtime.RivalsEnumLibrary and type(Runtime.RivalsEnumLibrary.ToEnum)=="function"then
pcall(function()Runtime.RivalsStartShootingEnum=Runtime.RivalsEnumLibrary:ToEnum("StartShooting")end)
end

Runtime.RivalsCombatBackendReady=Runtime.RivalsItemLibrary~=nil
and Runtime.RivalsGunModule~=nil
and Runtime.RivalsFighterController~=nil
return Runtime.RivalsCombatBackendReady or Runtime.RivalsUseItemRemote~=nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
local controller=Runtime.RivalsFighterController
local fighter=controller and controller.LocalFighter
local item=fighter and fighter.EquippedItem
if not item then return nil end
return item
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedWeaponName(player)
if not player then return nil end
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
local controller=Runtime.RivalsFighterController
if controller and controller.Objects then
for _,fighter in pairs(controller.Objects)do
if fighter and fighter.Player==player and fighter.EquippedItem then
local item=fighter.EquippedItem
local name=item.Name
if type(name)~="string"or name==""then pcall(function()name=item:Get("Name")end)end
if type(name)=="string"and name~=""then return name end
end
end
end
if player==LocalPlayer then
local item=controller and controller.LocalFighter and controller.LocalFighter.EquippedItem
if item then
local name=item.Name
if type(name)~="string"or name==""then pcall(function()name=item:Get("Name")end)end
if type(name)=="string"and name~=""then return name end
end
end
return nil
end

-- Enemy weapon ESP uses the RIVALS FighterController instead of BloxStrike Tool/CameraModel paths.
function CVU_GetPlayerWeaponName(targetPlayer)
if not targetPlayer then return nil end
Runtime.RivalsWeaponNameCache=Runtime.RivalsWeaponNameCache or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local now=os.clock()
local cached=Runtime.RivalsWeaponNameCache[targetPlayer]
if cached and now-cached.Time<.35 then return cached.Name end
local name=CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedWeaponName(targetPlayer)
Runtime.RivalsWeaponNameCache[targetPlayer]={Name=name,Time=now}
return name
end

function CVU_BuildEnemyWeaponViewport(data,weaponName)
if type(CVU_ClearEnemyWeaponViewport)=="function"then pcall(CVU_ClearEnemyWeaponViewport,data)end
return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_EncodeCFrame(cf)
local utility=Runtime.RivalsUtility
if not utility or type(utility.EncodeCFrame)~="function"then return nil end
local ok,value=pcall(function()return utility:EncodeCFrame(cf)end)
if ok then return value end
ok,value=pcall(function()return utility.EncodeCFrame(cf)end)
if ok then return value end
return nil
end

-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS first-person ViewModel / Ghost Arms
-- RIVALS renders the live first-person model under Workspace.ViewModels.FirstPerson.
-- Do not use the BloxStrike Camera/Weapon/WeaponL/WeaponR detector here.
-- ============================================================
function CVU_RIVALS_GetFirstPersonViewModelRoot()
local viewModels=Workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels")
local firstPerson=viewModels and viewModels:FindFirstChild("FirstPerson")
if not firstPerson then return nil end
local children=firstPerson:GetChildren()
for index=#children,1,-1 do
local child=children[index]
if child:IsA("Model")or child:IsA("Folder")then return child end
end
return children[1]
end

function CVU_GetGhostArmParts()
local viewModel=CVU_RIVALS_GetFirstPersonViewModelRoot()
local root=viewModel or LocalPlayer.Character
local now=os.clock()
if Runtime.GhostArmScanRoot==root and now<(Runtime.GhostArmScanNext or 0)then
return Runtime.GhostArmScanParts or{},viewModel
end

local result={}
local seen=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
if root and root.Parent then
for _,object in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
if object:IsA("BasePart")and not seen[object]then
local isArm=false
if type(CVU_IsGhostArmPart)=="function"then
local ok,value=pcall(CVU_IsGhostArmPart,object,viewModel)
isArm=ok and value==true
end
if not isArm then
local compact=string.lower(object.Name or""):gsub("[^%w]","")
if string.find(compact,"arm",1,true)
or string.find(compact,"hand",1,true)
or string.find(compact,"glove",1,true)
or string.find(compact,"sleeve",1,true)then
isArm=true
end
end
if isArm then
seen[object]=true
result[#result+1]=object
end
end
end
end

Runtime.GhostArmScanRoot=root
Runtime.GhostArmScanKnifeClone=nil
Runtime.GhostArmScanParts=result
Runtime.GhostArmScanNext=now+.35
Runtime.GhostArmStatus=#result>0
and("RIVALS 發光手臂：找到 "..tostring(#result).." 個第一人稱手臂零件")
or"RIVALS 發光手臂：Workspace.ViewModels.FirstPerson 尚未找到手臂零件"
return result,viewModel
end

-- Weapon swaps rebuild Workspace.ViewModels.FirstPerson without touching Camera, so the old
-- BloxStrike Camera.DescendantAdded refresh never fires.  Watch only for a root change.
if not Runtime.RivalsGhostArmHeartbeat then
Runtime.RivalsGhostArmClock=0
Runtime.RivalsGhostArmLastRoot=nil
Runtime.RivalsGhostArmHeartbeat=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
if Runtime.Shutdown then
if Runtime.RivalsGhostArmHeartbeat then pcall(function()Runtime.RivalsGhostArmHeartbeat:Disconnect()end)Runtime.RivalsGhostArmHeartbeat=nil end
return
end
if Settings.GhostArms~=true then return end
Runtime.RivalsGhostArmClock=(Runtime.RivalsGhostArmClock or 0)+(dt or 0)
if Runtime.RivalsGhostArmClock<.18 then return end
Runtime.RivalsGhostArmClock=0
local root=CVU_RIVALS_GetFirstPersonViewModelRoot()
if root~=Runtime.RivalsGhostArmLastRoot then
Runtime.RivalsGhostArmLastRoot=root
Runtime.GhostArmScanNext=0
pcall(CVU_ApplyGhostArms)
end
end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS target/team helpers shared by wallbang + rage wallbang
-- ============================================================
Runtime.RivalsWallPendingTargets=Runtime.RivalsWallPendingTargets or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsWallDesyncSerial=Runtime.RivalsWallDesyncSerial or 0
Runtime.RivalsWallRestoreName="ChickenVisualUI_RivalsWallRestore"

function CVU_RIVALS_GetTeamID(player)
if not player then return nil end
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
local spectator=Runtime.RivalsSpectateController
if spectator and spectator.CurrentDuelSubject then
local duel=spectator.CurrentDuelSubject
local ok,dueler=pcall(function()return duel:GetDueler(player)end)
if ok and dueler then
local okTeam,team=pcall(function()return dueler:Get("TeamID")end)
if okTeam and team~=nil then return tostring(team)end
end
end
local attr=player:GetAttribute("TeamID")
if attr~=nil then return tostring(attr)end
if player.Team and not player.Neutral then return tostring(player.Team.Name)end
return nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)
if not player or player==LocalPlayer or player.Parent~=Players then return false end
local mine=CVU_RIVALS_GetTeamID(LocalPlayer)
local theirs=CVU_RIVALS_GetTeamID(player)
if mine~=nil and theirs~=nil then return mine~=theirs end
if LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team and not LocalPlayer.Neutral and not player.Neutral then
return LocalPlayer.Team~=player.Team
end
-- FFA / duel startup may expose no TeamID.  In that case every other live player is an enemy.
return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
if not player then return nil end
local character=nil
if type(CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter)=="function"then
local ok,value=pcall(CVU_GetActiveMatchCharacter,player)
if ok then character=value end
end
character=character or player.Character
if not character or not character.Parent or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)then return nil end
if character:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return nil end
local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if humanoid and humanoid.Health<=0 then return nil end
local hp=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))
if hp~=nil and hp<=0 then return nil end
return character
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsPendingTarget(player)
local expires=Runtime.RivalsWallPendingTargets and Runtime.RivalsWallPendingTargets[player]
if not expires then return false end
if os.clock()>=expires then Runtime.RivalsWallPendingTargets[player]=nil return false end
return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_MarkPendingTarget(player,rate)
if not player or tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or"自動")~="頭部"then return end
local r=math.max(1,tonumber(rate)or 12)
local hold=math.clamp(6/r,.18,.30)
Runtime.RivalsWallPendingTargets[player]=os.clock()+hold
end

-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS Anti-Katana
-- Katana deflect is short-lived.  We use the replicated remote-player deflect FX as the
-- primary signal and FighterController EquippedItem/_attack_cooldown as a guarded fallback.
-- A tiny hold buffer covers replication/ping skew; while dangerous, shots are skipped.
-- ============================================================
Runtime.RivalsKatanaDeflectUntil=Runtime.RivalsKatanaDeflectUntil or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
-- V65 Anti-Katana V2: one activation = one timed window.  Do NOT keep extending the
-- dangerous period merely because the replicated glow/FX remains enabled.
Runtime.RivalsKatanaDeflectState=Runtime.RivalsKatanaDeflectState or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaEffectiveDuration=1.00
-- V74: once Deflect activation is confirmed, never early-release from FX flicker.
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaTailMaxDuration=2.00
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaTailReleaseDebounce=.045 -- legacy telemetry only
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaReleaseBuffer=.025
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaCooldownDuration=4.00
-- Conservative frontal protection arc.  Attacks from a genuine rear/strong-side angle
-- are allowed even while the adaptive Deflect window is active.
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaFrontHalfAngle=100
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaHoldPixels=16
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaAimRadius=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaAimRadius or 180
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus or"待命"

-- V79 Anti-Katana V6: two-phase Auto-fire commit.
-- If the target can Quick-Melee to Katana, Auto-fire does a tiny final confirmation:
-- ready = 40 ms, suspicious startup = 60 ms, confirmed Deflect = cancel.
-- A Katana already in cooldown adds NO delay.
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireBaseDelay=.040
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireSuspectDelay=.060
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireTarget=nil
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStartedAt=0
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireRequiredDelay=0
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireAuthorizedUntil=0
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStage="idle"
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaLoadoutCache=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaLoadoutCache or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireWatch=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireWatch or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
-- V80 Anti-Katana V7 Detection First:
-- remember Katana capability/item references across instant Quick-Melee -> weapon swap.
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaRecentKatana=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaRecentKatana or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaDetectionVersion="V7.1 Startup Hard Block"
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaEvidenceHold=5.00
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaFXCache=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaFXCache or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaLastEvidence=nil
-- V81 Anti-Katana V7.1:
-- "suspected startup" is a HARD NO-FIRE state, not merely a 60 ms delay.
-- Any startup edge invalidates the current Auto-fire commit. After suspicion clears,
-- a completely fresh 40 ms READY confirmation is required.
Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeGate=false
Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeTarget=nil
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStartupBlockedShots=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStartupBlockedShots or 0
-- V67 local Katana Auto-Block.
-- Independent from Aim Assist: it predicts a real ranged threat, quick-melees to Katana,
-- then requests the native ADS/Deflect action.  The 4 s cooldown is respected.
Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus=Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus or"待命"
Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockBusy=false
Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockCooldownUntil=0
Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockLastTriggerAt=0
Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince=Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState=Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockLastThreat=nil
-- V70: no world-distance ceiling.  Distance only changes how strict the aim-intent evidence is.

function CVU_RIVALS_GetFighterObject(player)
if not player then return nil end
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
local controller=Runtime.RivalsFighterController
if not controller then return nil end
if player==LocalPlayer and controller.LocalFighter then return controller.LocalFighter end
if controller.Objects then
for _,fighter in pairs(controller.Objects)do
if fighter and fighter.Player==player then return fighter end
end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedItemForPlayer(player)
local fighter=CVU_RIVALS_GetFighterObject(player)
return fighter and fighter.EquippedItem or nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsShieldItem(item)
if not item then return false end
local names={}
local direct=rawget(item,"Name")
if type(direct)=="string"then names[#names+1]=direct end
pcall(function()
local value=item:Get("Name")
if type(value)=="string"then names[#names+1]=value end
end)
local info=rawget(item,"Info")
if type(info)=="table"then
for _,key in ipairs({"Name","DisplayName","ItemName","WeaponType","Type","Category","Class"})do
local value=rawget(info,key)
if type(value)=="string"then names[#names+1]=value end
end
end
local viewModel=rawget(item,"ViewModel")
if viewModel and type(viewModel.Name)=="string"then names[#names+1]=viewModel.Name end
for _,name in ipairs(names)do
local compact=string.lower(name):gsub("[^%w]","")
if string.find(compact,"shield",1,true)then return true end
end
return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsShieldEquipped(player)
if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return false end
return CVU_RIVALS_IsShieldItem(CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedItemForPlayer(player))
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(item)
if not item then return false end
local names={}
local direct=rawget(item,"Name")
if type(direct)=="string"then names[#names+1]=direct end
pcall(function()
local value=item:Get("Name")
if type(value)=="string"then names[#names+1]=value end
end)
local info=rawget(item,"Info")
if type(info)=="table"then
for _,key in ipairs({"Name","DisplayName","ItemName"})do
local value=rawget(info,key)
if type(value)=="string"then names[#names+1]=value end
end
end
local viewModel=rawget(item,"ViewModel")
if viewModel and type(viewModel.Name)=="string"then names[#names+1]=viewModel.Name end
for _,name in ipairs(names)do
if string.find(string.lower(name),"katana",1,true)then return true end
end
return false
end

-- V60: Equipped-Katana target state.  Aim acquisition may ignore this target for
-- primary/sniper weapons, while Secondary weapons are explicitly allowed to keep
-- locking/firing at the Katana holder.
function CVU_RIVALS_RememberKatanaEvidence(player,item,source)
 if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return end
 local now=tick()
 local hold=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaEvidenceHold)or 5.00
 local entry=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaRecentKatana[player]
 if type(entry)~="table"then entry={} Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaRecentKatana[player]=entry end
 entry.SeenAt=now
 entry.Until=math.max(tonumber(entry.Until)or 0,now+hold)
 if item~=nil then entry.Item=item end
 if source~=nil then entry.Source=tostring(source)end
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaLastEvidence=tostring(player.Name)..":"..tostring(source or"katana")
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetRecentKatanaEvidence(player)
 local entry=player and Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaRecentKatana[player]or nil
 if type(entry)~="table"then return false,nil,nil end
 if tick()>(tonumber(entry.Until)or 0)then
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaRecentKatana[player]=nil
  return false,nil,nil
 end
 return true,entry.Item,entry.Source
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaEquipped(player)
 if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return false end
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedItemForPlayer(player)
 local equipped=CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(item)
 if equipped then CVU_RIVALS_RememberKatanaEvidence(player,item,"equipped")end
 return equipped
end

function CVU_RIVALS_PlayerHasKatanaLoadout(player,forceRefresh)
 if not player then return false,nil end
 if player==LocalPlayer then
  if type(CVU_RIVALS_LocalHasKatanaLoadout)=="function"then
   return CVU_RIVALS_LocalHasKatanaLoadout(forceRefresh)
  end
  return false,nil
 end

 local now=os.clock()
 local cache=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaLoadoutCache[player]
 if forceRefresh~=true and type(cache)=="table"and(now-(tonumber(cache.At)or 0))<=.40 then
  if cache.Has==true then
   CVU_RIVALS_RememberKatanaEvidence(player,cache.Item,cache.Source or"loadout-cache")
  end
  return cache.Has==true,cache.Source
 end

 local found=false
 local source=nil
 local katanaRef=nil
 local function textHasKatana(value)
  return type(value)=="string"and string.find(string.lower(value),"katana",1,true)~=nil
 end
 local function valueLooksKatana(value,label)
  if found or value==nil then return end
  if type(value)=="table"then
   local ok,res=pcall(CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem,value)
   if ok and res==true then found=true source=label or"fighter item" katanaRef=value return end
   for _,key in ipairs({"Name","DisplayName","ItemName","WeaponName","Weapon","Melee","MeleeName"})do
    if textHasKatana(rawget(value,key))then found=true source=(label or"fighter table").."."..key return end
   end
  elseif typeof(value)=="Instance"then
   if textHasKatana(value.Name)then found=true source=label or"instance" katanaRef=value end
  elseif textHasKatana(value)then
   found=true source=label or"string"
  end
 end

 -- Currently equipped is definitive and cheapest.
 valueLooksKatana(CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedItemForPlayer(player),"EquippedItem")

 local fighter=CVU_RIVALS_GetFighterObject(player)
 if fighter and not found then
  for _,key in ipairs({
   "Items","ItemSlots","SlotItems","EquippedItems","Weapons","Loadout",
   "Inventory","Equipment","Melee","MeleeItem","MeleeWeapon","QuickMelee",
  })do
   local value=rawget(fighter,key)
   valueLooksKatana(value,key)
   if type(value)=="table"and not found then
    local n=0
    for k,v in pairs(value)do
     n+=1
     if n>48 then break end
     if textHasKatana(k)then found=true source=key.." key" break end
     valueLooksKatana(v,key.."["..tostring(k).."]")
     if found then break end
    end
   end
   if found then break end
  end
 end

 -- Shallow fighter scan for builds that rename the loadout container.
 if fighter and not found then
  local n=0
  for k,v in pairs(fighter)do
   n+=1
   if n>90 then break end
   local lk=string.lower(tostring(k))
   local relevant=string.find(lk,"item",1,true)
    or string.find(lk,"weapon",1,true)
    or string.find(lk,"loadout",1,true)
    or string.find(lk,"inventory",1,true)
    or string.find(lk,"slot",1,true)
    or string.find(lk,"equip",1,true)
    or string.find(lk,"melee",1,true)
   if relevant then
    valueLooksKatana(v,tostring(k))
    if type(v)=="table"and not found then
     local m=0
     for kk,vv in pairs(v)do
      m+=1
      if m>36 then break end
      if textHasKatana(kk)then found=true source=tostring(k).." key" break end
      valueLooksKatana(vv,tostring(k).."["..tostring(kk).."]")
      if found then break end
     end
    end
   end
   if found then break end
  end
 end

 -- Roblox Tool / replicated character fallback.
 if not found then
  local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
  if character then
   for _,obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do
    if textHasKatana(obj.Name)then found=true source="Character:"..obj.Name break end
   end
  end
 end
 if not found then
  local backpack=player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
  if backpack then
   for _,obj in ipairs(backpack:GetDescendants())do
    if textHasKatana(obj.Name)then found=true source="Backpack:"..obj.Name break end
   end
  end
 end

 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaLoadoutCache[player]={Has=found,Source=source,Item=katanaRef,At=now}
 if found then CVU_RIVALS_RememberKatanaEvidence(player,katanaRef,source or"loadout")end
 return found,source
end

-- V71: Auto Block is valid only if the LOCAL player's current RIVALS loadout
-- actually contains a Katana.  This is broader than "currently equipped": Quick Melee
-- must be allowed to pull Katana from the melee slot while a gun is held.
function CVU_RIVALS_LocalHasKatanaLoadout(forceRefresh)
 local now=os.clock()
 local cache=Runtime.RivalsLocalKatanaLoadoutCache
 if forceRefresh~=true and type(cache)=="table"and(now-(tonumber(cache.At)or 0))<=.45 then
  return cache.Has==true,cache.Source
 end

 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 local fighter=Runtime.RivalsFighterController and Runtime.RivalsFighterController.LocalFighter or nil
 local found=false
 local source=nil

 local function textHasKatana(value)
  return type(value)=="string"and string.find(string.lower(value),"katana",1,true)~=nil
 end

 local function valueLooksKatana(value,label)
  if found or value==nil then return end
  if type(value)=="table"then
   local ok,res=pcall(CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem,value)
   if ok and res==true then
    found=true source=label or"fighter item"
    return
   end
   for _,key in ipairs({"Name","DisplayName","ItemName","WeaponName","Weapon","Melee","MeleeName"})do
    local v=rawget(value,key)
    if textHasKatana(v)then
     found=true source=(label or"fighter table").."."..key
     return
    end
   end
  elseif typeof(value)=="Instance"then
   if textHasKatana(value.Name)then
    found=true source=label or"instance"
   end
  elseif textHasKatana(value)then
   found=true source=label or"string"
  end
 end

 if fighter and fighter.EquippedItem then
  valueLooksKatana(fighter.EquippedItem,"EquippedItem")
 end

 if fighter and not found then
  for _,key in ipairs({
   "Items","ItemSlots","SlotItems","EquippedItems","Weapons","Loadout",
   "Inventory","Equipment","Melee","MeleeItem","MeleeWeapon","QuickMelee",
  })do
   local value=rawget(fighter,key)
   valueLooksKatana(value,key)
   if type(value)=="table"and not found then
    local n=0
    for k,v in pairs(value)do
     n+=1
     if n>48 then break end
     if textHasKatana(k)then found=true source=key.." key" break end
     valueLooksKatana(v,key.."["..tostring(k).."]")
     if found then break end
    end
   end
   if found then break end
  end
 end

 if fighter and not found then
  local inspected=0
  for k,v in pairs(fighter)do
   inspected+=1
   if inspected>90 then break end
   local key=string.lower(tostring(k))
   local relevant=string.find(key,"item",1,true)
    or string.find(key,"weapon",1,true)
    or string.find(key,"loadout",1,true)
    or string.find(key,"inventory",1,true)
    or string.find(key,"slot",1,true)
    or string.find(key,"equip",1,true)
    or string.find(key,"melee",1,true)
   if relevant then
    valueLooksKatana(v,tostring(k))
    if type(v)=="table"and not found then
     local n=0
     for kk,vv in pairs(v)do
      n+=1
      if n>36 then break end
      if textHasKatana(kk)then found=true source=tostring(k).." key" break end
      valueLooksKatana(vv,tostring(k).."["..tostring(kk).."]")
      if found then break end
     end
    end
   end
   if found then break end
  end
 end

 if not found then
  pcall(function()
   for key,value in pairs(LocalPlayer:GetAttributes())do
    local k=string.lower(tostring(key))
    if string.find(k,"melee",1,true)or string.find(k,"weapon",1,true)or string.find(k,"loadout",1,true)then
     if textHasKatana(value)then
      found=true source="PlayerAttribute:"..tostring(key)
      break
     end
    end
   end
  end)
 end

 Runtime.RivalsLocalKatanaLoadoutCache={Has=found,Source=source,At=now}
 return found,source
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaFXSignal(player)
 if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return false,false,nil end
 local now=os.clock()
 local cached=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaFXCache[player]
 if type(cached)=="table"and now-(tonumber(cached.At)or 0)<=.012 then
  return cached.Signal==true,cached.Marker==true,cached.Source
 end

 local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
 if not character then return false,false,nil end

 local markerPresent=false
 local signal=false
 local source=nil

 local function mark(strong,label)
  markerPresent=true
  if strong and not signal then
   signal=true
   source=label
  elseif not source then
   source=label
  end
 end

 local function inspectNode(obj,label)
  if not obj then return end
  local strong=false
  if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter")or obj:IsA("Trail")or obj:IsA("Beam")or obj:IsA("Highlight")then
   strong=obj.Enabled==true
  elseif obj:IsA("BoolValue")then
   strong=obj.Value==true
  elseif obj:IsA("NumberValue")then
   strong=(tonumber(obj.Value)or 0)>0
  end
  if strong then mark(true,label..":"..obj.ClassName)end
  for _,key in ipairs({"Active","Enabled","Deflecting","IsDeflecting","Parrying","IsParrying","Blocking","IsBlocking","KatanaDeflect"})do
   local value=obj:GetAttribute(key)
   if value~=nil then
    mark(value==true or(tonumber(value)or 0)>0,label..":attr:"..key)
   end
  end
 end

 -- Exact marker first, recursively; RIVALS has moved this node between builds.
 local exact=character:FindFirstChild("_katana_deflect_active_not_local",true)
 if exact then
  mark(false,"exact-marker")
  inspectNode(exact,"exact-marker")
  for _,obj in ipairs(exact:GetDescendants())do inspectNode(obj,"exact-marker")end
 end

 -- Replicated character/root attributes are stronger and cheaper than broad descendant scans.
 for _,holder in ipairs({
  character,
  character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
  character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"),
  character:FindFirstChild("Torso"),
 })do
  if holder then
   for _,key in ipairs({
    "Deflecting","IsDeflecting","KatanaDeflect","KatanaDeflecting",
    "Parrying","IsParrying","Blocking","IsBlocking",
   })do
    local value=holder:GetAttribute(key)
    if value~=nil then
     mark(value==true or(tonumber(value)or 0)>0,holder.Name..":attr:"..key)
    end
   end
  end
 end

 -- Bounded semantic scan: only Deflect/Parry/Katana/Block-named nodes are inspected.
 -- This catches Trail/Particle/Bool marker variants without treating arbitrary effects as Deflect.
 local inspected=0
 for _,obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do
  inspected+=1
  if inspected>180 then break end
  local n=string.lower(tostring(obj.Name or""))
  local relevant=
   string.find(n,"deflect",1,true)
   or string.find(n,"parry",1,true)
   or string.find(n,"katana",1,true)
   or string.find(n,"block",1,true)
  if relevant then
   mark(false,"semantic:"..obj.Name)
   inspectNode(obj,"semantic:"..obj.Name)
   if signal then break end
  end
 end

 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaFXCache[player]={Signal=signal,Marker=markerPresent,Source=source,At=now}
 if signal or markerPresent then
  CVU_RIVALS_RememberKatanaEvidence(player,nil,source or"fx-marker")
 end
 return signal,markerPresent,source
end

function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateKatanaDeflectState(player)
 if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return nil end
 local now=tick()
 local states=Runtime.RivalsKatanaDeflectState
 local state=states[player]
 if not state then
  state={Signal=false,StartedAt=nil,EffectiveUntil=0,TailUntil=0,TailSignalLostAt=nil,SafeFireAt=0,CooldownUntil=0,HoldSide=nil,Generation=0}
  states[player]=state
 end

 local signal,markerPresent,signalSource=CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaFXSignal(player)
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedItemForPlayer(player)
 local katanaEquipped=CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(item)
 if katanaEquipped then
  CVU_RIVALS_RememberKatanaEvidence(player,item,"equipped-state")
 end

 local hasRecent,recentItem,recentSource=CVU_RIVALS_GetRecentKatanaEvidence(player)
 local loadoutCache=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaLoadoutCache[player]
 local cachedItem=type(loadoutCache)=="table"and loadoutCache.Item or nil
 local katanaItem=katanaEquipped and item or recentItem or cachedItem
 if katanaItem~=nil and not CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(katanaItem)then
  katanaItem=nil
 end

 -- V7: cooldown reconstruction survives Quick-Melee -> immediate weapon swap by retaining
 -- the last real Katana item reference for a short evidence window.
 local inferredStart=nil
 if katanaItem then
  local cd=rawget(katanaItem,"_attack_cooldown")
  if typeof(cd)=="number"and cd>now then
   local remaining=cd-now
   if remaining>=1.85 and remaining<=4.25 then
    inferredStart=cd-(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaCooldownDuration)or 4.00)
   end
  end
 end

 local rising=signal and state.Signal~=true
 local canStart=(state.StartedAt==nil)or now>=(tonumber(state.CooldownUntil)or 0)-.03
 if rising and canStart then
  local started=now
  if inferredStart and inferredStart<=now+.03 and now-inferredStart<=2.15 then started=inferredStart end
  state.StartedAt=started
  state.EffectiveUntil=started+(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaEffectiveDuration)or 1.00)
  state.TailUntil=started+(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaTailMaxDuration)or 2.00)
  state.TailSignalLostAt=nil
  -- Default safe-fire point is the conservative tail cap.  The phase resolver may release
  -- earlier if the Deflect signal is continuously absent during the tail.
  state.SafeFireAt=state.TailUntil+(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaReleaseBuffer)or .025)
  state.CooldownUntil=started+(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaCooldownDuration)or 4.00)
  state.HoldSide=nil
  state.Generation=(tonumber(state.Generation)or 0)+1
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="V7 已確認 Deflect｜"..tostring(signalSource or"FX rising")
 elseif canStart and state.StartedAt==nil and inferredStart and now-inferredStart>=0 and now-inferredStart<=2.15 then
  state.StartedAt=inferredStart
  state.EffectiveUntil=inferredStart+(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaEffectiveDuration)or 1.00)
  state.TailUntil=inferredStart+(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaTailMaxDuration)or 2.00)
  state.TailSignalLostAt=nil
  state.SafeFireAt=state.TailUntil+(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaReleaseBuffer)or .025)
  state.CooldownUntil=inferredStart+(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaCooldownDuration)or 4.00)
  state.HoldSide=nil
  state.Generation=(tonumber(state.Generation)or 0)+1
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="V7 cooldown 回推 Deflect｜"..string.format("%.0fms",(now-inferredStart)*1000)
 end

 state.Signal=signal
 state.MarkerPresent=markerPresent
 state.SignalSource=signalSource
 state.KatanaEquipped=katanaEquipped
 state.KatanaItem=katanaItem or state.KatanaItem
 state.KatanaRecentlySeen=hasRecent==true
 state.KatanaRecentSource=recentSource

 -- V74 signal telemetry only.
 -- FX loss is tracked, but never shortens the hard 2.00 s safety window.
 if state.StartedAt and now>=(tonumber(state.EffectiveUntil)or math.huge) then
  if signal then
   state.TailSignalLostAt=nil
  elseif state.TailSignalLostAt==nil then
   state.TailSignalLostAt=now
  end
 else
  state.TailSignalLostAt=nil
 end

 if state.StartedAt and now>=state.CooldownUntil then
  -- Keep the old generation around until the FX actually drops.  This prevents a lingering
  -- glow from re-triggering a fresh four-second cycle without a real new rising edge.
  if not signal then
   state.StartedAt=nil
   state.EffectiveUntil=0
   state.TailUntil=0
   state.TailSignalLostAt=nil
   state.SafeFireAt=0
   state.CooldownUntil=0
   state.HoldSide=nil
  end
 end
 return state
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaDeflectPhase(player)
 local state=CVU_RIVALS_UpdateKatanaDeflectState(player)
 if not state or not state.StartedAt then return "ready",state,0 end

 local now=tick()
 local elapsed=math.max(0,now-state.StartedAt)
 local hardUntil=tonumber(state.EffectiveUntil)or(state.StartedAt+1.00)
 local tailUntil=tonumber(state.TailUntil)or(state.StartedAt+2.00)
 local releaseBuffer=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaReleaseBuffer)or .025
 local safeUntil=tailUntil+releaseBuffer

 -- V75: full 2.00 s safety window. FX loss never releases early.
 if now<safeUntil then
  if now<hardUntil+releaseBuffer then
   state.ActiveStage="hard"
  else
   state.ActiveStage="hard_tail"
  end
  state.SafeFireAt=safeUntil
  return "active",state,elapsed
 end

 state.ActiveStage="cooldown"
 state.SafeFireAt=safeUntil
 if now<(tonumber(state.CooldownUntil)or 0)then return "cooldown",state,elapsed end
 state.ActiveStage="ready"
 return "ready",state,elapsed
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalInsideKatanaFrontArc(player)
 if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return true,0 end
 local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
 local root=character and(character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
 if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart")then return true,0 end
 local origin=Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or nil
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"then
  local localRoot=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  origin=localRoot and localRoot.Position or nil
 end
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"then return true,0 end

 local look=root.CFrame.LookVector
 local toward=origin-root.Position
 look=Vector3.new(look.X,0,look.Z)
 toward=Vector3.new(toward.X,0,toward.Z)
 if look.Magnitude<=.001 or toward.Magnitude<=.001 then return true,0 end
 local dot=math.clamp(look.Unit:Dot(toward.Unit),-1,1)
 local angle=math.deg(math.acos(dot))
 local halfAngle=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaFrontHalfAngle)or 100,70,130)
 return angle<=halfAngle,angle
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflectWindowActive(player)
 if Settings.RivalsAimAssist~=true or not player or player==LocalPlayer then return false,nil end
 local phase,state=CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaDeflectPhase(player)
 return phase=="active",state
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(player)
 -- "Deflecting" means dangerous to THIS local shot: guaranteed for ~1.00 s, then
 -- adaptively extended by the Deflect signal up to ~1.50 s, AND only inside the Katana
 -- user's frontal protection arc.  A rear/strong-side shot remains legal.
 local active,state=CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflectWindowActive(player)
 if not active then return false end
 local front,angle=CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalInsideKatanaFrontArc(player)
 if not front then
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="Katana 反傷中｜背側/強側角安全｜"..string.format("%.0f°",angle or 0)
  return false
 end
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaCooldown(player)
 local phase,state,elapsed=CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaDeflectPhase(player)
 return phase=="cooldown",state,elapsed
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireTarget=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStartedAt=0
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireRequiredDelay=0
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireAuthorizedUntil=0
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStage="idle"
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaPreFireRisk(player)
 if Settings.RivalsAntiKatana~=true or not player or player==LocalPlayer then
  return "none",0,nil
 end

 local nowTick=tick()
 local nowClock=os.clock()

 -- V7 Detection First: collect ALL evidence before deciding there is no Katana.
 -- A failed loadout scan must never override a currently equipped Katana or a live Deflect marker.
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedItemForPlayer(player)
 local katanaEquipped=CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(item)
 if katanaEquipped then CVU_RIVALS_RememberKatanaEvidence(player,item,"prefire-equipped")end

 local hasLoadout,loadoutSource=CVU_RIVALS_PlayerHasKatanaLoadout(player,false)
 local signal,markerPresent,signalSource=CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaFXSignal(player)
 local hasRecent,recentItem,recentSource=CVU_RIVALS_GetRecentKatanaEvidence(player)

 local capability=katanaEquipped or hasLoadout or hasRecent or signal or markerPresent
 if not capability then return "none",0,nil end

 -- Refresh phase AFTER evidence collection, so the state machine can consume the newest FX/cooldown.
 local phase,state=CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaDeflectPhase(player)
 if phase=="active"then
  local front=CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalInsideKatanaFrontArc(player)
  if front then return "confirmed",math.huge,state end
  return "rear_safe",0,state
 end
 if phase=="cooldown"then return "cooldown",0,state end

 local loadoutCache=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaLoadoutCache[player]
 local cachedItem=type(loadoutCache)=="table"and loadoutCache.Item or nil
 local katanaItem=katanaEquipped and item or recentItem or cachedItem
 if katanaItem~=nil and not CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(katanaItem)then katanaItem=nil end

 local cd=katanaItem and rawget(katanaItem,"_attack_cooldown")or nil
 local remaining=0
 if typeof(cd)=="number"and cd>nowTick then remaining=cd-nowTick end

 local watch=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireWatch[player]
 if type(watch)~="table"then
  watch={
   LastCooldown=nil,LastSignal=false,LastMarker=false,LastEquipped=false,
   LastAt=nowClock,SuspectUntil=0,
  }
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireWatch[player]=watch
 end

 local cooldownJump=false
 if typeof(cd)=="number"and typeof(watch.LastCooldown)=="number"then
  cooldownJump=cd>(watch.LastCooldown+.020)and cd>nowTick
 end
 local signalRise=signal==true and watch.LastSignal~=true
 local markerRise=markerPresent==true and watch.LastMarker~=true
 local equipRise=katanaEquipped==true and watch.LastEquipped~=true

 -- Entry sensitive: one strong signal OR multiple weaker capability edges immediately
 -- enter the 60 ms suspicious path.  This does not yet declare a full 2 s Deflect by itself.
 local strongStartup=
  signal==true
  or signalRise
  or cooldownJump
  or remaining>=1.60

 local weakStartup=
  markerRise
  or equipRise
  or(markerPresent and katanaEquipped)

 if strongStartup or weakStartup then
  -- V7.1: this is a startup observation HOLD, not a fire-delay target.
  -- Auto-fire is hard-blocked for the whole hold, then must restart a fresh 40 ms READY commit.
  watch.SuspectUntil=math.max(tonumber(watch.SuspectUntil)or 0,nowClock+.110)
  watch.LastEvidence=signalSource or loadoutSource or recentSource or(
   cooldownJump and"cooldown-jump"or(markerRise and"marker-rise"or(equipRise and"katana-equipped"or"katana-capable"))
  )
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaLastEvidence=tostring(player.Name)..":"..tostring(watch.LastEvidence)
 end

 watch.LastCooldown=typeof(cd)=="number"and cd or nil
 watch.LastSignal=signal==true
 watch.LastMarker=markerPresent==true
 watch.LastEquipped=katanaEquipped==true
 watch.LastAt=nowClock

 local suspected=nowClock<(tonumber(watch.SuspectUntil)or 0)
 if suspected then
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="V7 疑似 Deflect｜"..tostring(watch.LastEvidence or"Katana 起手")
  return "suspected",tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireSuspectDelay)or .060,state
 end

 -- Katana is merely available/remembered: retain the normal 40 ms race guard.
 return "ready",tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireBaseDelay)or .040,state
end

function CVU_RIVALS_AutoFireKatanaCommitReady(target,now)
 now=tonumber(now)or os.clock()
 local player=target and target.Player or nil
 if not player or not CVU_RIVALS_IsRealPlayerTarget(target)then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
  return true
 end

 local risk,delay=CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaPreFireRisk(player)

 -- V7.1: an ACTUAL startup suspicion is not a 60 ms timer that eventually permits fire.
 -- It invalidates the current commit completely. When the startup suspicion disappears,
 -- the target must arm a brand-new READY 40 ms confirmation from zero.
 if risk=="suspected"then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="V7.1 Katana 起手｜硬攔截 Auto-fire｜等待狀態確認"
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStartupBlockedShots=(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStartupBlockedShots or 0)+1
  return false
 end

 -- No Katana capability, Katana cooldown, or a genuinely safe rear angle = no added delay.
 if risk=="none"or risk=="cooldown"or risk=="rear_safe"then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
  return true
 end

 -- Confirmed frontal Deflect always wins over an armed Auto-fire.
 if risk=="confirmed"then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="二次確認｜已確認 Katana Deflect｜取消 Auto-fire"
  return false
 end

 local sameTarget=Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireTarget==player
 if not sameTarget then
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireTarget=player
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStartedAt=now
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireRequiredDelay=delay
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireAuthorizedUntil=0
 else
  -- Once a suspicious edge appears, never shorten the current confirmation from 60 -> 40 ms.
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireRequiredDelay=math.max(
   tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireRequiredDelay)or 0,
   tonumber(delay)or 0
  )
 end

 local required=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireRequiredDelay)or .040
 local elapsed=math.max(0,now-(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStartedAt)or now))

 -- If native StartShooting rejected one authorized frame, preserve authorization very briefly,
 -- but STILL re-check Katana state on every retry.
 if sameTarget and now<(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireAuthorizedUntil)or 0)then
  local finalRisk=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaPreFireRisk(player))
  if finalRisk=="confirmed"then
   CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
   Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="二次確認最後一刻抓到 Deflect｜取消 Auto-fire"
   return false
  end
  if finalRisk=="suspected"then
   CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
   Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="V7.1 native retry 前抓到 Katana 起手｜取消這一發"
   Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStartupBlockedShots=(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStartupBlockedShots or 0)+1
   return false
  end
  return true
 end

 if elapsed<required then
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStage=risk
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus=string.format(
   "Auto-fire 二次確認｜%s｜%.0f/%.0f ms",
   risk=="suspected"and"疑似 Katana 起手"or"Katana 可用",
   elapsed*1000,required*1000
  )
  return false
 end

 -- Final synchronous re-check on the exact frame we are about to authorize native fire.
 local finalRisk,finalDelay=CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaPreFireRisk(player)
 if finalRisk=="confirmed"then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="二次確認最後一刻抓到 Deflect｜取消 Auto-fire"
  return false
 end
 if finalRisk=="suspected"then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="V7.1 最後確認抓到 Katana 起手｜硬取消 Auto-fire"
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStartupBlockedShots=(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStartupBlockedShots or 0)+1
  return false
 end
 if finalRisk=="cooldown"or finalRisk=="none"or finalRisk=="rear_safe"then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
  return true
 end

 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStage="authorized"
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireAuthorizedUntil=now+.020
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus=string.format("Katana 二次確認通過｜%.0f ms",elapsed*1000)
 return true
end


-- ============================================================
-- Anti-Katana: restored simple holding-state policy
-- Enemy CURRENTLY holding Katana = unsafe for Primary/Sniper/etc.
-- Local Secondary and Melee are explicit exceptions.
-- No startup prediction / no 40-60ms wait / no 2.025s tail.
-- ============================================================
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaDetectionVersion="V60.1 Primary-Only Holding-Katana"

function CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaEquipped(player)
 if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return false end
 return CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedItemForPlayer(player))
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflectWindowActive(player)
 local localItem=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem)=="function"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem(localItem)then
  return false,nil
 end
 local equipped=CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaEquipped(player)
 return equipped,nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(player)
 local active=CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflectWindowActive(player)
 return active==true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaCooldown(player)
 return false,nil,0
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireTarget=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStartedAt=0
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireRequiredDelay=0
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireAuthorizedUntil=0
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireStage="idle"
 Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeGate=false
 Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeTarget=nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaPreFireRisk(player)
 if Settings.RivalsAntiKatana~=true or not player or player==LocalPlayer then
  return "none",0,nil
 end
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaEquipped(player)then
  return "confirmed",math.huge,nil
 end
 return "none",0,nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_AutoFireKatanaCommitReady(target,now)
 local localItem=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()

 -- Exact rule: ONLY proven Primary weapons participate in Anti-Katana.
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem)~="function"or not CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem(localItem)then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
  return true
 end

 local player=target and target.Player or nil
 if player and CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaEquipped(player)then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="Primary｜敵人持有 Katana｜禁止射擊"
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaBlockedShots=(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaBlockedShots or 0)+1
  return false
 end

 CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit()
 return true
end


-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS Katana Event Profiler V1
-- Passive telemetry only. It DOES NOT change the active Anti-Katana firing rule.
-- Goal: find which replicated/client signal arrives before visual Deflect reflection.
-- ============================================================
Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler or{
 Enabled=true,
 Events={},
 MaxEvents=240,
 States=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
 ConfirmAt=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
 MarkerStart=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
 FXStart=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
 Durations={Marker={},FX={}},
 Connections={},
 PlayerConnections=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
 BoundFX=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}),
 RemoteNames={},
 Installed=false,
}

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerNow()
 return os.clock()
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerCompact(value)
 local t=typeof(value)
 if t=="Instance"then
  local ok,name=pcall(function()return value:GetFullName()end)
  return ok and(tostring(value.ClassName)..":"..tostring(name))or(tostring(value.ClassName)..":"..tostring(value.Name))
 end
 if t=="string"or t=="number"or t=="boolean"then
  local str=tostring(value)
  return #str>90 and(string.sub(str,1,87).."...")or str
 end
 if t=="table"then
  local parts={}
  for _,key in ipairs({"Name","Action","ActionName","Input","Item","ItemName","Weapon","WeaponName","Type","Player","UserId"})do
   local ok,v=pcall(function()return value[key]end)
   if ok and v~=nil then
    parts[#parts+1]=tostring(key).."="..CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerCompact(v)
   end
   if #parts>=5 then break end
  end
  return #parts>0 and("{"..table.concat(parts,",").."}")or"{table}"
 end
 return tostring(value)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,kind,detail,at)
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 if type(p)~="table"or p.Enabled~=true then return end
 local event={
  T=tonumber(at)or CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerNow(),
  Player=player,
  PlayerName=player and player.Name or nil,
  Kind=tostring(kind or"event"),
  Detail=tostring(detail or""),
 }
 local list=p.Events
 list[#list+1]=event
 while #list>(tonumber(p.MaxEvents)or 240)do table.remove(list,1)end
 return event
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerRecent(window,player)
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 local out={}
 if type(p)~="table"then return out end
 local now=CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerNow()
 local span=math.max(.01,tonumber(window)or .30)
 for i=math.max(1,#p.Events-100),#p.Events do
  local e=p.Events[i]
  if e and now-(tonumber(e.T)or 0)<=span and(player==nil or e.Player==nil or e.Player==player)then
   out[#out+1]=e
  end
 end
 return out
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerConfirm(player,source)
 if not player then return end
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 if type(p)~="table"then return end
 local now=CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerNow()
 local last=p.ConfirmAt[player]
 if typeof(last)=="number"and now-last<.35 then return end
 p.ConfirmAt[player]=now
 CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,"CONFIRM",source,now)

 -- Print the ~300 ms leading edge once. This is what lets us compare:
 -- Remote -> EquippedItem -> cooldown -> marker -> reflection.
 local recent=CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerRecent(.30,player)
 print("[CVU KatanaProfiler] CONFIRM",player.Name,tostring(source),"events=",#recent)
 for _,e in ipairs(recent)do
  print(string.format("[CVU KatanaProfiler] %+.1fms | %s | %s | %s",
   ((tonumber(e.T)or now)-now)*1000,
   tostring(e.PlayerName or"GLOBAL"),
   tostring(e.Kind),
   tostring(e.Detail)))
 end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerAddDuration(bucket,value)
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 if type(p)~="table"or type(p.Durations)~="table"then return end
 local list=p.Durations[bucket]
 if type(list)~="table"then list={} p.Durations[bucket]=list end
 list[#list+1]=math.max(0,tonumber(value)or 0)
 while #list>40 do table.remove(list,1)end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindFX(player,obj)
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 if type(p)~="table"or not obj or p.BoundFX[obj]then return end
 local n=string.lower(tostring(obj.Name or""))
 if not(string.find(n,"katana",1,true)or string.find(n,"deflect",1,true)or string.find(n,"parry",1,true)or string.find(n,"block",1,true))then
  local par=obj.Parent
  local pn=par and string.lower(tostring(par.Name or""))or""
  if not(string.find(pn,"katana",1,true)or string.find(pn,"deflect",1,true)or string.find(pn,"parry",1,true))then return end
 end
 p.BoundFX[obj]=true

 if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter")or obj:IsA("Trail")or obj:IsA("Beam")then
  local function sample()
   local enabled=obj.Enabled==true
   local key=tostring(obj.ClassName)..":"..tostring(obj.Name)
   if enabled then
    if not p.FXStart[player]then
     p.FXStart[player]=CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerNow()
     CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,"fx_enabled",key,p.FXStart[player])
     CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerConfirm(player,"visual:"..key)
    end
   elseif p.FXStart[player]then
    local t=CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerNow()
    CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,"fx_disabled",key,t)
    CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerAddDuration("FX",t-p.FXStart[player])
    p.FXStart[player]=nil
   end
  end
  sample()
  local c=obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(sample)
  p.Connections[#p.Connections+1]=c
 elseif obj:IsA("BoolValue")then
  local function sampleBool()
   if obj.Value==true then
    CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,"bool_true",obj.Name)
    CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerConfirm(player,"bool:"..obj.Name)
   end
  end
  sampleBool()
  local c=obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(sampleBool)
  p.Connections[#p.Connections+1]=c
 end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindCharacter(player,character)
 if not player or not character then return end
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 if type(p)~="table"then return end
 local old=p.PlayerConnections[player]
 if type(old)=="table"then
  for _,c in ipairs(old)do pcall(function()c:Disconnect()end)end
 end
 local list={}
 p.PlayerConnections[player]=list

 local function added(obj)
  local n=string.lower(tostring(obj.Name or""))
  if n=="_katana_deflect_active_not_local"or string.find(n,"katana",1,true)or string.find(n,"deflect",1,true)or string.find(n,"parry",1,true)then
   local t=CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerNow()
   CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,"desc_added",obj.ClassName..":"..obj.Name,t)
   if n=="_katana_deflect_active_not_local"then
    p.MarkerStart[player]=t
    CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,"marker_added",obj.Name,t)
    CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerConfirm(player,"marker_added")
   end
   CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindFX(player,obj)
  end
 end
 local function removing(obj)
  local n=string.lower(tostring(obj.Name or""))
  if n=="_katana_deflect_active_not_local"then
   local t=CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerNow()
   CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,"marker_removed",obj.Name,t)
   local st=p.MarkerStart[player]
   if typeof(st)=="number"then CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerAddDuration("Marker",t-st)end
   p.MarkerStart[player]=nil
  end
 end
 list[#list+1]=character.DescendantAdded:Connect(added)
 list[#list+1]=character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(removing)
 for _,obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants())do added(obj)end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindPlayer(player)
 if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return end
 if player.Character then CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindCharacter(player,player.Character)end
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 local c=player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
  task.defer(CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindCharacter,player,character)
 end)
 p.Connections[#p.Connections+1]=c
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPoll()
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 if type(p)~="table"or p.Enabled~=true then return end
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if player~=LocalPlayer then
   local state=p.States[player]
   if type(state)~="table"then state={} p.States[player]=state end
   local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedItemForPlayer(player)
   local katana=CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(item)
   if katana~=state.Katana then
    state.Katana=katana
    CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,katana and"equipped_katana"or"unequipped_katana",item and tostring(rawget(item,"Name")or"Katana")or"nil")
   end
   local cd=item and rawget(item,"_attack_cooldown")or nil
   if katana and typeof(cd)=="number"then
    local prev=state.Cooldown
    if typeof(prev)~="number"or cd>prev+.08 then
     local remaining=cd-tick()
     CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(player,"cooldown_jump",string.format("remaining=%.3f",remaining))
     if remaining>=2.20 and remaining<=4.50 then
      CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerConfirm(player,"cooldown_jump:"..string.format("%.3f",remaining))
     end
    end
    state.Cooldown=cd
   else
    state.Cooldown=nil
   end
  end
 end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindRemote(remote)
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 if type(p)~="table"or not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent")then return end
 local key=remote:GetFullName()
 if p.RemoteNames[key]then return end
 p.RemoteNames[key]=true
 local c=remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
  local args={...}
  local parts={}
  for i=1,math.min(#args,6)do parts[#parts+1]="a"..i.."="..CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerCompact(args[i])end
  CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPush(nil,"remote:"..remote.Name,table.concat(parts," | "))
 end)
 p.Connections[#p.Connections+1]=c
end

function CVU_RIVALS_InstallKatanaProfiler()
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 if type(p)~="table"or p.Installed then return true end
 p.Installed=true
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindPlayer(player)end
 p.Connections[#p.Connections+1]=Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindPlayer)

 local remotes=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
 local replication=remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Replication")
 local fighter=replication and replication:FindFirstChild("Fighter")
 if fighter then
  for _,obj in ipairs(fighter:GetDescendants())do CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindRemote(obj)end
  p.Connections[#p.Connections+1]=fighter.DescendantAdded:Connect(CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerBindRemote)
 end

 local signal=RunService.PreSimulation or RunService.Heartbeat
 p.Connections[#p.Connections+1]=signal:Connect(CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerPoll)
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="Katana 持有即禁射｜Profiler V1 監聽中"
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerDump(seconds)
 local events=CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerRecent(tonumber(seconds)or 2.0,nil)
 local out={}
 for _,e in ipairs(events)do
  out[#out+1]={
   Time=e.T,
   Player=e.PlayerName,
   Kind=e.Kind,
   Detail=e.Detail,
  }
 end
 return out
end

function CVU_RIVALS_KatanaProfilerSummary()
 local p=Runtime.RivalsKatanaProfiler
 local function stats(list)
  if type(list)~="table"or #list==0 then return{Count=0,Avg=nil,Min=nil,Max=nil}end
  local sum,minv,maxv=0,math.huge,-math.huge
  for _,v in ipairs(list)do sum+=v minv=math.min(minv,v) maxv=math.max(maxv,v)end
  return{Count=#list,Avg=sum/#list,Min=minv,Max=maxv}
 end
 return{
  Installed=p and p.Installed==true or false,
  EventCount=p and #p.Events or 0,
  RemoteCount=p and(function()local n=0 for _ in pairs(p.RemoteNames)do n+=1 end return n end)()or 0,
  MarkerDuration=p and stats(p.Durations.Marker)or nil,
  FXDuration=p and stats(p.Durations.FX)or nil,
 }
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalKatanaCooldownRemaining(item)
 item=item or CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if not item or not CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(item)then return 0 end
 local now=tick()
 local cd=rawget(item,"_attack_cooldown")
 if typeof(cd)=="number"and cd>now then return cd-now end
 return 0
end

function CVU_RIVALS_LocalKatanaLooksDeflecting(item)
 item=item or CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if item and CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(item)then
  -- Deflect creates the long ~4 s attack cooldown.  A normal slash does not leave a
  -- remaining cooldown this large, so this is a useful local native signal.
  if CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalKatanaCooldownRemaining(item)>=2.45 then return true end
 end

 local character=LocalPlayer.Character
 local root=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root then
  for _,obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants())do
   local n=string.lower(tostring(obj.Name or""))
   if string.find(n,"katana",1,true)and string.find(n,"deflect",1,true)then
    if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter")and obj.Enabled then return true end
    if obj:IsA("BoolValue")and obj.Value==true then return true end
   end
  end
 end
 return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_AutoBlockWorldVisible(fromPart,toPart)
 if not fromPart or not toPart or not fromPart:IsA("BasePart")or not toPart:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
 local origin=fromPart.Position
 local delta=toPart.Position-origin
 if delta.Magnitude<=.01 then return true end

 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.IgnoreWater=true
 local ignore={}
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
  if character then ignore[#ignore+1]=character end
 end
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
 return Workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,params)==nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoBlockThreatProfile(kind,distance)
 distance=math.max(0,tonumber(distance)or 0)

 -- V70: first value is NOT a max distance anymore.  It is the maximum perpendicular
 -- miss-distance (studs) that the enemy aim ray may have from our body and still count
 -- as "very likely attacking me".  Because this is a world-space ray test, it works at
 -- 20 studs and 600+ studs without a hard range cutoff.
 local allowance,stableFor
 if kind=="sniper"then
  allowance,stableFor=5.0,.018
 elseif kind=="revolver"then
  allowance,stableFor=5.8,.022
 elseif kind=="crossbow"or kind=="bow"then
  allowance,stableFor=6.3,.024
 elseif kind=="shotgun"then
  allowance,stableFor=9.0,.018
 elseif kind=="launcher"then
  allowance,stableFor=10.5,.024
 else
  allowance,stableFor=6.8,.028
 end

 -- At point-blank / very close range character-body facing is noisier, so tolerate a
 -- slightly wider corridor.  At long distance the corridor stays tight automatically.
