 local closeBonus=math.clamp((55-distance)/14,0,3.2)
 return allowance+closeBonus,stableFor
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetEnemyAimingState(character,item)
 local aiming=false

 -- Native item state when replicated/available.
 if item then
  pcall(function()
   local getter=rawget(item,"Get")or item.Get
   if type(getter)=="function"and getter(item,"IsAiming")==true then aiming=true end
  end)
  if not aiming then
   pcall(function()
    local data=rawget(item,"Data")
    if type(data)=="table"and(data.IsAiming==true or data.Aiming==true or data.ADS==true)then aiming=true end
   end)
  end
  if not aiming then
   pcall(function()
    if rawget(item,"IsAiming")==true or rawget(item,"_is_aiming")==true or rawget(item,"Aiming")==true then aiming=true end
   end)
  end
 end

 -- RIVALS/character replicated ADS attributes are useful when the item table does not expose it.
 if not aiming and character then
  pcall(function()
   if type(CVU_HasThirdPersonAimAttribute)=="function"and CVU_HasThirdPersonAimAttribute(character)then
    aiming=true
   else
    for _,name in ipairs({"IsScoped","Scoped","IsAiming","Aiming","ADS"})do
     if character:GetAttribute(name)==true then aiming=true break end
    end
   end
  end)
 end
 return aiming
end

function CVU_RIVALS_RayMissDistance(origin,direction,targetPos)
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or typeof(direction)~="Vector3"or typeof(targetPos)~="Vector3"then
  return math.huge,-1,180
 end
 if direction.Magnitude<=.0001 then return math.huge,-1,180 end
 local dir=direction.Unit
 local rel=targetPos-origin
 local forward=rel:Dot(dir)
 if forward<=0 then return math.huge,forward,180 end
 local closest=origin+dir*forward
 local miss=(targetPos-closest).Magnitude
 local angle=180
 if rel.Magnitude>.001 then angle=math.deg(math.acos(math.clamp(dir:Dot(rel.Unit),-1,1)))end
 return miss,forward,angle
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetEnemyAttackIntent(character,item,localHead,localRoot,kind,distance,now,player)
 if not character or not localRoot then return nil end
 local enemyHead=character:FindFirstChild("Head")
 local enemyRoot=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not enemyRoot then return nil end

 -- Prefer head/camera-facing information when replicated; root facing is the fallback.
 local rays={}
 if enemyHead and enemyHead:IsA("BasePart")then
  rays[#rays+1]={Origin=enemyHead.Position,Direction=enemyHead.CFrame.LookVector,Source="head"}
 end
 rays[#rays+1]={Origin=enemyRoot.Position,Direction=enemyRoot.CFrame.LookVector,Source="root"}

 local velocity=localRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.new(0,0,0)
 local leadTime=kind=="sniper"and .045 or(kind=="crossbow"or kind=="bow")and .085 or .055
 local targets={}
 if localHead and localHead:IsA("BasePart")then
  targets[#targets+1]=localHead.Position
  targets[#targets+1]=localHead.Position+velocity*leadTime
 end
 targets[#targets+1]=localRoot.Position
 targets[#targets+1]=localRoot.Position+velocity*leadTime

 local bestMiss,bestAngle,bestSource=math.huge,180,"root"
 for _,ray in ipairs(rays)do
  for _,targetPos in ipairs(targets)do
   local miss,forward,angle=CVU_RIVALS_RayMissDistance(ray.Origin,ray.Direction,targetPos)
   if forward>0 and miss<bestMiss then
    bestMiss,bestAngle,bestSource=miss,angle,ray.Source
   end
  end
 end

 local allowance,stableFor=CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoBlockThreatProfile(kind,distance)
 local aiming=CVU_RIVALS_GetEnemyAimingState(character,item)

 -- At long range we demand a tighter "this ray really crosses me" result unless the
 -- enemy is actually ADS/scoped.  This removes the old range limit without making
 -- somebody merely facing our general direction burn Katana.
 local strictScale=1.0
 if distance>=180 and not aiming then strictScale=.78
 elseif distance>=90 and not aiming then strictScale=.88 end
 local effectiveAllowance=allowance*strictScale

 local state=Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState[player]
 if not state then
  state={LastMiss=math.huge,LastAt=now,StableSince=nil,LastShootCooldown=nil,RecentShotUntil=0}
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState[player]=state
 end

 -- Detect the native weapon cooldown jumping forward: that is strong evidence the enemy
 -- has just committed a shot.  For projectiles this can still save us; for hitscan it also
 -- makes repeated-shot intent very reliable.
 local shootCd=rawget(item,"_shoot_cooldown")
 if typeof(shootCd)=="number"then
  local previous=state.LastShootCooldown
  if typeof(previous)=="number"and shootCd>previous+.035 and shootCd>tick()then
   state.RecentShotUntil=now+.16
  end
  state.LastShootCooldown=shootCd
 end
 local recentShot=now<(tonumber(state.RecentShotUntil)or 0)

 -- Weapon readiness: don't spend Deflect while a clearly-known cooldown still has plenty
 -- of time left.  Unknown cooldown fields remain eligible.
 local ready=true
 if typeof(shootCd)=="number"and shootCd>tick()+.10 and not recentShot then ready=false end

 local insideCorridor=bestMiss<=effectiveAllowance
 local hardInside=bestMiss<=effectiveAllowance*.68
 local converging=false
 if typeof(state.LastMiss)=="number"and typeof(state.LastAt)=="number"then
  local dt=math.max(.001,now-state.LastAt)
  converging=(state.LastMiss-bestMiss)/dt>=7.0 and bestMiss<=effectiveAllowance*1.18
 end

 if insideCorridor or hardInside or(recentShot and bestMiss<=effectiveAllowance*1.25)then
  if not state.StableSince then state.StableSince=now end
 else
  state.StableSince=nil
 end

 local held=state.StableSince and(now-state.StableSince)or 0
 state.LastMiss=bestMiss
 state.LastAt=now

 -- ADS/scoped enemies need less confirmation; a ray that passes almost through our body
 -- is also strong enough on its own.  This keeps far-away expert snipers responsive.
 local requiredStable=stableFor
 if aiming then requiredStable=requiredStable*.55 end
 if hardInside then requiredStable=requiredStable*.45 end
 if recentShot then requiredStable=0 end
 if converging then requiredStable=requiredStable*.70 end

 local confidence=0
 if insideCorridor then confidence+=42 end
 if hardInside then confidence+=24 end
 if aiming then confidence+=18 end
 if ready then confidence+=10 end
 if converging then confidence+=8 end
 if recentShot then confidence+=35 end
 if held>=requiredStable then confidence+=18 end

 local likelyAttack=ready
  and(insideCorridor or hardInside or(recentShot and bestMiss<=effectiveAllowance*1.25))
  and held>=requiredStable
  and confidence>=68

 return{
  LikelyAttack=likelyAttack,
  MissDistance=bestMiss,
  Allowance=effectiveAllowance,
  AimAngle=bestAngle,
  AimSource=bestSource,
  Aiming=aiming,
  Ready=ready,
  StableFor=held,
  RequiredStable=requiredStable,
  RecentShot=recentShot,
  Converging=converging,
  Confidence=confidence,
 }
end

function CVU_RIVALS_FindAutoBlockThreat(now)
 if not Camera then return nil end
 local localCharacter=LocalPlayer.Character
 if not localCharacter then return nil end
 local localHumanoid=localCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if localHumanoid and localHumanoid.Health<=0 then return nil end

 local localHead=localCharacter:FindFirstChild("Head")
 local localRoot=localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local localPart=localHead or localRoot
 if not localRoot or not localPart then return nil end

 local best=nil
 local seen={}
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)then
   local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
   local humanoid=character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
   local enemyRoot=character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
   local enemyHead=character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
   local enemyPart=enemyHead or enemyRoot
   local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetEquippedItemForPlayer(player)

   if enemyRoot and enemyPart and item and(not humanoid or humanoid.Health>0)then
    local kind=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
    if kind~="melee"then
     local distance=(enemyRoot.Position-localRoot.Position).Magnitude

     -- NO DISTANCE LIMIT.  A 500-stud sniper can trigger if the actual world-space aim ray
     -- stays on us and the weapon is ready/aiming.
     if CVU_RIVALS_AutoBlockWorldVisible(enemyPart,localPart)then
      local intent=CVU_RIVALS_GetEnemyAttackIntent(
       character,item,localHead,localRoot,kind,distance,now,player
      )

      if intent and intent.LikelyAttack then
       seen[player]=true
       Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince[player]=Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince[player]or now

       -- Lower score = more urgent.  Aim-line accuracy dominates; distance contributes
       -- essentially nothing so a far sniper is not unfairly de-prioritized.
       local missRatio=intent.MissDistance/math.max(.1,intent.Allowance)
       local urgency=missRatio*100
       if kind=="sniper"then urgency-=18 end
       if intent.Aiming then urgency-=14 end
       if intent.RecentShot then urgency-=30 end
       if intent.Converging then urgency-=8 end
       urgency+=math.min(distance,1500)*.001

       local candidate={
        Player=player,Character=character,Item=item,Kind=kind,
        Distance=distance,Angle=intent.AimAngle,StableFor=intent.StableFor,
        AimMiss=intent.MissDistance,AimAllowance=intent.Allowance,
        Aiming=intent.Aiming,RecentShot=intent.RecentShot,
        Confidence=intent.Confidence,Score=urgency,
       }
       if not best or candidate.Score<best.Score then best=candidate end
      else
       Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince[player]=nil
      end
     else
      Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince[player]=nil
      local state=Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState[player]
      if state then state.StableSince=nil end
     end
    else
     Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince[player]=nil
     Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState[player]=nil
    end
   else
    Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince[player]=nil
    Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState[player]=nil
   end
  end
 end

 for player in pairs(Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince)do
  if not seen[player]then Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince[player]=nil end
 end
 return best
end

local CVU_RIVALS_AutoBlockKeyNames={
 "E","F","Q","R","T","G","V","C","X","Z","B","N","M",
 "A","S","D","W","Y","U","I","O","P","H","J","K","L",
 "One","Two","Three","Four","Five","Six","Seven","Eight","Nine","Zero",
 "LeftShift","LeftControl","LeftAlt","CapsLock","Tab",
}
local CVU_RIVALS_AutoBlockKeyLookup={}
for _,name in ipairs(CVU_RIVALS_AutoBlockKeyNames)do
 local ok,key=pcall(function()return Enum.KeyCode[name]end)
 if ok and key then CVU_RIVALS_AutoBlockKeyLookup[name]=key end
end

local CVU_RIVALS_AutoBlockVirtualKeys={
 E=0x45,F=0x46,Q=0x51,R=0x52,T=0x54,G=0x47,V=0x56,C=0x43,X=0x58,Z=0x5A,
 B=0x42,N=0x4E,M=0x4D,A=0x41,S=0x53,D=0x44,W=0x57,Y=0x59,U=0x55,I=0x49,
 O=0x4F,P=0x50,H=0x48,J=0x4A,K=0x4B,L=0x4C,
 One=0x31,Two=0x32,Three=0x33,Four=0x34,Five=0x35,
 Six=0x36,Seven=0x37,Eight=0x38,Nine=0x39,Zero=0x30,
 LeftShift=0xA0,LeftControl=0xA2,LeftAlt=0xA4,CapsLock=0x14,Tab=0x09,
}

function CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoBlockQuickMeleeKey()
 local name=tostring(Settings.RivalsAutoBlockKey or"E")
 local key=CVU_RIVALS_AutoBlockKeyLookup[name]
 if not key then
  name="E"
  Settings.RivalsAutoBlockKey=name
  key=Enum.KeyCode.E
 end
 return name,key,CVU_RIVALS_AutoBlockVirtualKeys[name]
end

function CVU_RIVALS_SendQuickMeleeKey()
 local keyName,keyCode,virtualKey=CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoBlockQuickMeleeKey()
 local ok=false

 -- Prefer the executor key helper when the selected key has a Windows VK mapping.
 if virtualKey and type(keypress)=="function"and type(keyrelease)=="function"then
  ok=pcall(function()
   keypress(virtualKey)
   task.wait(.008)
   keyrelease(virtualKey)
  end)
  if ok then return true,keyName end
 end

 -- Generic fallback supports every exposed Enum.KeyCode option above.
 local vim=nil
 pcall(function()vim=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")end)
 if vim and keyCode then
  ok=pcall(function()
   vim:SendKeyEvent(true,keyCode,false,game)
   task.wait(.008)
   vim:SendKeyEvent(false,keyCode,false,game)
  end)
 end
 return ok,keyName
end

function CVU_RIVALS_TriggerAutoBlock(threat)
 if Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockBusy or Settings.RivalsAutoBlock~=true then return false end
 local now=os.clock()
 if now<(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockCooldownUntil)or 0)then return false end
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive)=="function"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive()then return false end

 -- V71 hard prerequisite: no Katana in this loadout = never press Quick Melee for Auto Block.
 local hasKatana,katanaSource=CVU_RIVALS_LocalHasKatanaLoadout(true)
 if not hasKatana then
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus="未攜帶 Katana｜不啟動自動格擋"
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockCooldownUntil=now+.18
  return false
 end

 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockBusy=true
 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockLastThreat=threat and threat.Player or nil
 local quickKeyName=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoBlockQuickMeleeKey())
 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus="攻擊意圖成立｜按快速近戰 "..tostring(quickKeyName)
 task.spawn(function()
  -- V72: the actual action is the player's configured Quick Melee key.
  -- We do not synthesize an ADS/Deflect input here.
  local pressed,usedKey=CVU_RIVALS_SendQuickMeleeKey()
  local success=false
  local katanaItem=nil

  if pressed then
   local deadline=os.clock()+.18
   repeat
    task.wait(.006)
    local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
    if item and CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(item)then
     katanaItem=item
     success=true
     break
    end
    if CVU_RIVALS_LocalKatanaLooksDeflecting(item)then
     katanaItem=item
     success=true
     break
    end
   until os.clock()>=deadline
  end

  local t=os.clock()
  if success then
   Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockLastTriggerAt=t
   local remaining=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalKatanaCooldownRemaining(katanaItem)
   Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockCooldownUntil=t+math.max(3.85,math.min(4.20,remaining>0 and remaining or 4.00))
   Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus="快速近戰 "..tostring(usedKey or quickKeyName).." 已觸發｜Katana｜"..tostring(threat and threat.Player and threat.Player.Name or"敵人")
  else
   Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockCooldownUntil=t+.20
   Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus=pressed
    and("已按 "..tostring(usedKey or quickKeyName).."｜未確認 Katana Quick Melee")
    or("快速近戰 "..tostring(usedKey or quickKeyName).." 輸入失敗")
  end

  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockBusy=false
 end)
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateAutoBlock(dt)
 if Settings.RivalsAutoBlock~=true or Runtime.Shutdown then
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockLastThreat=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus=Settings.RivalsAutoBlock==true and"待命"or"OFF"
  return
 end
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive)=="function"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive()then
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockLastThreat=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus="大廳｜自動格擋停用"
  return
 end

 -- V71: without Katana in the local loadout, do not even run attack-intent scanning.
 local hasKatana=CVU_RIVALS_LocalHasKatanaLoadout(false)
 if not hasKatana then
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockLastThreat=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus="未攜帶 Katana｜自動格擋待機"
  return
 end

 -- Respect a manually-started Katana Deflect too.
 local localItem=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if localItem and CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaItem(localItem)then
  local remaining=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalKatanaCooldownRemaining(localItem)
  if remaining>=2.45 then
   Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockCooldownUntil=math.max(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockCooldownUntil)or 0,os.clock()+remaining)
   Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus="Katana 已在 Deflect / 冷卻"
   return
  end
 end

 if Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockBusy or os.clock()<(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockCooldownUntil)or 0)then return end
 local now=os.clock()
 local threat=CVU_RIVALS_FindAutoBlockThreat(now)
 if threat then
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus=string.format("攻擊意圖 %.0f%%｜%s｜%s｜%.0f stud｜射線偏差 %.1f",
   math.clamp(tonumber(threat.Confidence)or 0,0,100),
   tostring(threat.Player and threat.Player.Name or"enemy"),tostring(threat.Kind),
   threat.Distance,tonumber(threat.AimMiss)or 999)
  CVU_RIVALS_TriggerAutoBlock(threat)
 else
  Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus="待命｜沒有成立的射擊威脅"
 end
end

function CVU_ShutdownRivalsAutoBlock()
 Settings.RivalsAutoBlock=false
 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockBusy=false
 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockCooldownUntil=0
 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockLastTriggerAt=0
 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockThreatSince=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockIntentState=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockLastThreat=nil
 Runtime.RivalsLocalKatanaLoadoutCache=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAutoBlockStatus="OFF"
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ShouldBlockManualShot()
local localItem=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()

-- Exact rule requested: only Primary is blocked by Anti-Katana.
-- Secondary / Melee / Utility / unknown slot are never blocked here.
if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem)~="function"or not CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem(localItem)then
 if localItem and type(CVU_RIVALS_IsSecondaryItem)=="function"and CVU_RIVALS_IsSecondaryItem(localItem)then
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="Secondary｜Katana 不禁止射擊"
 elseif localItem and type(CVU_RIVALS_IsMeleeItem)=="function"and CVU_RIVALS_IsMeleeItem(localItem)then
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="Melee｜Katana 不限制"
 else
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="非 Primary｜Katana 不攔截"
 end
 return false,nil
end

if Settings.RivalsAntiKatana~=true or not Camera then return false,nil end
local localCharacter=LocalPlayer.Character
local origin=Camera.CFrame.Position
local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
local radius=math.max(120,tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaAimRadius)or 180)
local bestPlayer=nil
local bestScore=math.huge
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
if CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)and CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(player)then
local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
local part=character and(character:FindFirstChild("Head")or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
if part then
local point,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
if onScreen and point.Z>0 then
local screenDistance=(Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)-center).Magnitude
if screenDistance<=radius then
local params=RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.IgnoreWater=true
params.FilterDescendantsInstances=localCharacter and{localCharacter}or{}
local ray=Workspace:Raycast(origin,part.Position-origin,params)
local visible=(not ray)or(ray.Instance and ray.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character))
if visible and screenDistance<bestScore then bestScore=screenDistance bestPlayer=player end
end
end
end
end
end
return bestPlayer~=nil,bestPlayer
end

function CVU_RIVALS_RestoreAntiKatanaInputGate()
local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
if type(mechanics)=="table"and type(Runtime.RivalsOriginalEquippedItemInput)=="function"then
pcall(function()mechanics.EquippedItemInput=Runtime.RivalsOriginalEquippedItemInput end)
end
Runtime.RivalsOriginalEquippedItemInput=nil
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaInputHooked=false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_InstallAntiKatanaInputGate()
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
if Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaInputHooked then return true end
local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
if type(mechanics)~="table"or type(mechanics.EquippedItemInput)~="function"then return false end
local original=mechanics.EquippedItemInput
Runtime.RivalsOriginalEquippedItemInput=original
mechanics.EquippedItemInput=function(self,inputName,...)
if Settings.RivalsAntiKatana==true and inputName=="StartShooting"then
local blocked,player=CVU_RIVALS_ShouldBlockManualShot()
if blocked then
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="攔截射擊｜"..tostring(player and player.Name or"Katana").." 正在反彈"
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaBlockedShots=(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaBlockedShots or 0)+1
return nil
end
end
return original(self,inputName,...)
end
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaInputHooked=true
return true
end

function CVU_SetRivalsAntiKatana(enabled)
-- V17: Anti-Katana is no longer an independent option.  It follows Aim Assist.
Settings.RivalsAntiKatana=Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_RestoreAntiKatanaInputGate)
if Settings.RivalsAntiKatana then
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InstallStartShootingHook)
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="Aim Assist 內建｜只禁止 Primary 對持 Katana 敵人射擊"
else
 Runtime.RivalsKatanaDeflectUntil=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}) Runtime.RivalsKatanaDeflectState=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="OFF｜跟隨 Aim Assist"
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_UpdateStartShootingHookLifecycle)
end
return true
end

function CVU_ShutdownRivalsAntiKatana()
Settings.RivalsAntiKatana=false
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_RestoreAntiKatanaInputGate)
Runtime.RivalsKatanaDeflectUntil=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"}) Runtime.RivalsKatanaDeflectState=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaRecentKatana=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaFXCache=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaPreFireWatch=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeGate=false
Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeTarget=nil
Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="OFF"
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit)
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_UpdateStartShootingHookLifecycle)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetTargetPart(character,rage360)
if not character then return nil end
local mode=tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or"自動")
local names
if mode=="頭部"then names={"HitboxHead","PhysicalHitboxHead","Head"}
elseif mode=="胸口"then names={"UpperTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"}
elseif mode=="腹部"then names={"LowerTorso","HumanoidRootPart","Torso"}
elseif mode=="左手臂"then names={"LeftUpperArm","LeftLowerArm","LeftHand","Left Arm"}
elseif mode=="右手臂"then names={"RightUpperArm","RightLowerArm","RightHand","Right Arm"}
elseif mode=="左腿"then names={"LeftUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg","LeftFoot","Left Leg"}
elseif mode=="右腿"then names={"RightUpperLeg","RightLowerLeg","RightFoot","Right Leg"}
elseif rage360 then names={"Head","UpperTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"}
else names={"Head","UpperTorso","Torso","HumanoidRootPart"}end
for _,name in ipairs(names)do
local part=character:FindFirstChild(name,true)
if part and part:IsA("BasePart")then return part end
end
return nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_HasWorldBlocker(origin,part)
if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or not part then return false end
local delta=part.Position-origin
if delta.Magnitude<=.01 then return false end
local params=RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.IgnoreWater=true
local ignore={}
if LocalPlayer.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=LocalPlayer.Character end
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
if character then ignore[#ignore+1]=character end
end
params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
local hit=Workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,params)
return hit~=nil and hit.Instance~=nil
end

local CVU_RIVALS_MeleeNames={
 battleaxe=true,chainsaw=true,fist=true,fists=true,glastshard=true,katana=true,
 knife=true,maul=true,riotshield=true,scythe=true,spear=true,trowel=true,
 boxinggloves=true,
}

function CVU_RIVALS_IsMeleeItem(item)
 if not item then return false end
 local info=type(item)=="table"and rawget(item,"Info")or nil
 local function sourceSaysMelee(source)
  if type(source)~="table"then return false end
  for _,key in ipairs({"Category","Type","ItemType","WeaponType","Class","Slot","SlotType"})do
   local value=rawget(source,key)
   if value~=nil and string.find(string.lower(tostring(value)),"melee",1,true)then return true end
  end
  return false
 end
 if sourceSaysMelee(item)or sourceSaysMelee(info)then return true end
 local name=""
 if type(item)=="table"then name=tostring(rawget(item,"Name")or"")end
 if name==""and type(info)=="table"then name=tostring(info.DisplayName or info.Name or info.ItemName or"")end
 local compact=string.lower(name):gsub("[^%w]","")
 return CVU_RIVALS_MeleeNames[compact]==true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
 local name=""
 if item then
  name=tostring(rawget(item,"Name")or"")
  local info=rawget(item,"Info")
  if name==""and type(info)=="table"then name=tostring(info.DisplayName or info.Name or info.ItemName or"")end
 end
 local lower=string.lower(name)
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsMeleeItem(item)then return"melee",name end
 if string.find(lower,"sniper",1,true)then return"sniper",name end
 if string.find(lower,"revolver",1,true)then return"revolver",name end
 if string.find(lower,"shotgun",1,true)then return"shotgun",name end
 if string.find(lower,"crossbow",1,true)then return"crossbow",name end
 if string.find(lower,"bow",1,true)then return"bow",name end
 if string.find(lower,"rpg",1,true)or string.find(lower,"launcher",1,true)then return"launcher",name end
 if string.find(lower,"burst",1,true)then return"burst",name end
 if string.find(lower,"assault",1,true)or string.find(lower,"rifle",1,true)or string.find(lower,"smg",1,true)or string.find(lower,"energy",1,true)then return"rifle",name end
 return"gun",name
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponSignature(item)
 local kind,name=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
 return tostring(item).."|"..tostring(kind).."|"..tostring(name),kind,name
end

-- Built-in真人打法目前只作用於 Sniper。
-- SWit／彈弓叔叔不再改寫 Rifle、Burst、Revolver、Shotgun、Crossbow 等其他 Aim Assist。
-- 「自訂」保留原有跨武器可調邏輯，之後再逐項拆分。
function CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind)
 local style=tostring(Settings.RivalsAimStyle or"彈弓叔叔")
 if style~="彈弓叔叔"and style~="SWit"and style~="自訂"then style="彈弓叔叔"end
 if kind=="sniper"or style=="自訂"then return style end
 return"基礎"
end

-- V43 Custom style: auto-fire state is isolated from the built-in styles.
function CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled()
 -- V66: Auto-fire is impossible in the lobby regardless of saved settings.
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive)=="function"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive()then
  return false
 end
 local style=tostring(Settings.RivalsAimStyle or"彈弓叔叔")
 if style=="自訂"then return Settings.RivalsCustomAutoFire==true end
 return Settings.RivalsAimAutoFire==true
end

-- V45: built-in Uncle + Custom share one stable controller for ordinary firearms.
-- Sniper/Crossbow keep their precision controllers; SWIt stays completely untouched.
function CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(kind)
 return kind=="rifle"or kind=="burst"or kind=="revolver"or kind=="shotgun"or kind=="gun"or kind=="launcher"or kind=="bow"
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ApplyAimTimingProfile(item)
 local signature,kind=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponSignature(item)
 local style=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind)
 Runtime.RivalsAimWeaponSignature=signature
 if kind=="sniper"or kind=="crossbow"then
  -- V37: precision timing is its own profile. SWit sniper keeps the exact V36 timing.
  -- Slingshot sniper now has a separate motion controller below, so rifle tuning can no
  -- longer leak into sniper behavior (or vice versa).
  Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.30,.50)
  Runtime.RivalsAimDuration=style=="彈弓叔叔"and Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.055,.080)or Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.065,.095)
 else
  if style=="SWit"and(kind=="rifle"or kind=="burst")then
   -- SWit rifle was visually too magnetic in V36. Keep its own tracking controller,
   -- but give it more acquisition time and less aggressive catch-up.
   Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.22,.32)
   Runtime.RivalsAimDuration=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.82,1.06)
  else
   -- V45: every non-sniper firearm in Uncle/Custom uses the same stable acquisition model.
   -- No weapon gets a fake left/right bias or a slower generic fallback merely because it
   -- is a Revolver / Shotgun / generic gun. Distance-specific timing is applied once the
   -- target is visible below.
   if style=="彈弓叔叔"and CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(kind)then
    if CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled()then
     Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.080,.120)
    else
     Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.115,.170)
    end
    Runtime.RivalsAimDuration=.58
   elseif style=="自訂"and CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(kind)then
    Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomReactionMid)or .15
    Runtime.RivalsAimDuration=.64
   else
    Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.30,.40)
    Runtime.RivalsAimDuration=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.90,1.15)
   end
  end
 end
 -- Manual anti-cheater rage profile: remove only the human reaction delay.
 -- V27's frame-visible movement / collision-box fire rules remain intact.
 if Settings.RivalsCheaterRage==true then Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=0 end
 return kind,signature
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetSniperCrosshairDistance(target)
 if not Camera or not target then return 500 end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local part=target.Head or target.TrackPart or target.Chest or target.Root
 if part then
  local point,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
  if onScreen and point.Z>0 then
   return math.clamp((Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)-center).Magnitude,0,500)
  end
 end
 return math.clamp(tonumber(target.ScreenDistance)or 500,0,500)
end

-- V42 Uncle Slingshot distance profile.
-- This is REAL player-to-player world distance, not crosshair pixel distance.
-- Close targets occupy more screen space and their animation/head-bob creates much larger
-- angular motion, so the human-limit controller is intentionally stronger and brakes harder
-- at close range.  SWIt never reads this helper.
function CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local localCharacter=LocalPlayer.Character
 local localRoot=localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local targetRoot=target and(target.Root or target.Chest or target.Head or target.TrackPart)or nil
 local distance=math.huge
 if localRoot and targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart")then
  distance=(targetRoot.Position-localRoot.Position).Magnitude
 elseif Camera and targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart")then
  distance=(targetRoot.Position-Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
 end
 if distance==math.huge then distance=120 end

 -- Full close-range assistance at <=24 studs, fading smoothly to the original V41
 -- strength by 110 studs.  The curve is continuous so crossing a distance boundary
 -- never causes a visible snap.
 local closeWeight=1-math.clamp((distance-24)/(110-24),0,1)
 closeWeight=closeWeight*closeWeight*(3-2*closeWeight)
 local tier=distance<=35 and"玩家近距離"or(distance<=85 and"玩家中距離"or"玩家遠距離")
 return distance,closeWeight,tier
end

-- V43 Custom style uses player-to-player world distance. Values are smoothly interpolated
-- so crossing 35 / 85 / 110 studs never snaps the camera.
function CVU_RIVALS_CustomDistanceLerp(distance,nearValue,midValue,farValue)
 distance=tonumber(distance)or 120
 nearValue=tonumber(nearValue)or 0
 midValue=tonumber(midValue)or nearValue
 farValue=tonumber(farValue)or midValue
 if distance<=35 then return nearValue end
 if distance<=85 then
  local a=math.clamp((distance-35)/50,0,1)
  return nearValue+(midValue-nearValue)*a
 end
 if distance<=110 then
  local a=math.clamp((distance-85)/25,0,1)
  return midValue+(farValue-midValue)*a
 end
 return farValue
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomDistanceTuning(target)
 local distance,_,tier=CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local lockSmooth=CVU_RIVALS_CustomDistanceLerp(
  distance,
  math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomLockSmoothNear)or .22,.05,.95),
  math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomLockSmoothMid)or .36,.05,.95),
  math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomLockSmoothFar)or .52,.05,.95)
 )
 local trackingSmooth=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomTrackingSmoothness)or .38,.05,.95)
 return distance,tier,lockSmooth,trackingSmooth
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomReactionDelayForTarget(target,autoFire)
 local distance,_,tier=CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local nearValue,midValue,farValue
 if autoFire then
  nearValue=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomAutoFireReactionNear)or .070,.02,.40)
  midValue=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomAutoFireReactionMid)or .095,.02,.40)
  farValue=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomAutoFireReactionFar)or .130,.02,.50)
 else
  nearValue=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomReactionNear)or .110,.02,.50)
  midValue=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomReactionMid)or .150,.02,.60)
  farValue=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.RivalsCustomReactionFar)or .200,.02,.70)
 end
 return CVU_RIVALS_CustomDistanceLerp(distance,nearValue,midValue,farValue),distance,tier
end

-- V55 SWIt world-distance profile.  This measures player-to-player world distance
-- (HumanoidRootPart preferred), never crosshair pixel distance.  The five stages control
-- both human reaction timing and long-range headshot reliability.
function CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local localCharacter=LocalPlayer.Character
 local localRoot=localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local targetRoot=target and(target.Root or target.TrackPart or target.Chest or target.Head)or nil
 local distance=math.huge
 if localRoot and targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart")then
  distance=(targetRoot.Position-localRoot.Position).Magnitude
 elseif Camera and targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart")then
  distance=(targetRoot.Position-Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
 end
 if distance==math.huge then distance=120 end

 -- Five WORLD-distance stages.  Roblox exposes this in studs; the labels intentionally
 -- say player distance rather than metres so no fake physical conversion is implied.
 if distance<=25 then
  return distance,"玩家極近距離",.18,.27,.96,.98
 elseif distance<=45 then
  return distance,"玩家近距離",.19,.26,.92,.96
 elseif distance<=70 then
  return distance,"玩家中距離",.21,.28,.87,.92
 elseif distance<=100 then
  return distance,"玩家遠距離",.25,.32,.80,.86
 end
 -- Extreme range: SWIt remains elite but is not supernatural.  Per-shot success is sampled
 -- inside 70-80%, matching the requested human long-range ceiling.
 return distance,"玩家極遠距離",.27,.33,.70,.80
end

-- V57 SWIt dual-distance aim kinematics.  Crosshair pixels decide HOW FAR the mouse must
-- travel; real player-to-player world distance decides HOW AGGRESSIVELY SWIt can carry speed
-- into the head and HOW EARLY the final braking/fine-correction should begin.
-- The returned values are base profiles only; a tiny per-shot variation is sampled once when
-- a new sniper target/shot is initialized, never every render frame.
function CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItAimKinematicProfile(target)
 local distance=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItWorldDistanceProfile(target))
 if distance<=25 then
  -- Large on-screen head: keep speed almost all the way in, then finish aggressively.
  return distance,1.18,34,1.12,"極近｜晚煞高速"
 elseif distance<=45 then
  return distance,1.11,46,1.07,"近｜偏晚煞車"
 elseif distance<=70 then
  return distance,1.00,64,1.00,"中｜標準"
 elseif distance<=100 then
  return distance,.97,78,.92,"遠｜短甩保持速度"
 end
 -- V58: a tiny long-range head still gets a fine final correction, but we no longer start
 -- braking around 120 px.  SWIt keeps an elite-speed short flick until roughly the last 70 px.
 return distance,.90,72,.84,"極遠｜150px快甩＋末段細修"
end

-- V64 SWIt crosshair-distance lock-speed profile.
-- Pixel distance controls remaining mouse travel; world distance still controls
-- head-size/braking/accuracy elsewhere.
function CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItCrosshairLockSpeed(px)
 px=math.max(0,tonumber(px)or 0)
 -- V78 SWit preset is immutable outside source code.
 local nearScale=.84
 local midScale=.96
 local farScale=.99
 if px<=60 then return nearScale,"準心最近" end
 if px<120 then
  local a=math.clamp((px-60)/60,0,1)
  a=a*a*(3-2*a)
  return nearScale+(midScale-nearScale)*a,"近→中"
 end
 if px<=220 then return midScale,"準心中距離" end
 if px<320 then
  local a=math.clamp((px-220)/100,0,1)
  a=a*a*(3-2*a)
  return midScale+(farScale-midScale)*a,"中→遠"
 end
 return farScale,"準心最遠"
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetSniperReactionDelayForTarget(target,kind)
 local crosshairDistance=CVU_RIVALS_GetSniperCrosshairDistance(target)
 local style=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind or"sniper")
 if style=="自訂"then
  return CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomReactionDelayForTarget(target,CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled())
 end
 if style=="彈弓叔叔"then
  -- V42: Uncle Slingshot timing is now based on REAL player distance.
  local worldDistance,closeWeight,tier=CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target)
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled()then
   if worldDistance<=35 then
    return Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.075,.115),worldDistance,tier
   elseif worldDistance<=85 then
    return Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.105,.165),worldDistance,tier
   end
   return Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.145,.225),worldDistance,tier
  end
  if worldDistance<=35 then
   return Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.115,.175),worldDistance,tier
  elseif worldDistance<=85 then
   return Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.165,.245),worldDistance,tier
  end
  return Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.22,.32),worldDistance,tier
 end
 -- V58 SWIt dual-distance reaction.  World distance still represents target difficulty,
 -- but a target already sitting close to the crosshair is noticed/committed to faster even
 -- when it is physically far away.  This fixes the sluggish ~150 px long-range acquisition
 -- without making genuinely large cross-screen flicks superhuman.
 local worldDistance,tier,reactionMin,reactionMax=CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local px=math.clamp(tonumber(crosshairDistance)or 500,0,500)
 local proximity=1-math.clamp((px-70)/260,0,1) -- 70 px => 1, 330+ px => 0
 proximity=proximity*proximity*(3-2*proximity)
 local worldFar=math.clamp((worldDistance-45)/80,0,1)
 -- At long range and ~150 px, shave roughly 70-105 ms off the old world-only delay.
 -- Near the head this never goes below a plausible elite-human floor.
 local shave=(.035+.070*worldFar)*proximity
 local lo=math.max(.155,reactionMin-shave)
 local hi=math.max(lo+.025,reactionMax-shave*.92)
 return Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(lo,hi),worldDistance,tier
end

-- A scoped RIVALS gun is not considered ready merely because IsFullyAiming() returns true:
-- native IsFullyAiming also returns true while ADS is off.  Require the actual replicated ADS
-- state and the live ViewModel focus amount to have reached AimScopePercent.
function CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperScopeReady(item)
 if not item then return false end
 local kind=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
 if kind~="sniper"then return true end
 local info=rawget(item,"Info")
 local scopePercent=type(info)=="table"and tonumber(info.AimScopePercent)or nil
 if not scopePercent or scopePercent<=0 then return false end
 local aiming=false
 pcall(function()
  local getter=rawget(item,"Get")or item.Get
  if type(getter)=="function"then aiming=getter(item,"IsAiming")==true end
 end)
 if not aiming then
  local data=rawget(item,"Data")
  if type(data)=="table"then aiming=data.IsAiming==true end
 end
 if not aiming then
  Runtime.RivalsAimScopeReadyLatchUntil=0
  return false
 end

 -- V52 Auto-fire reliability: once the native scope has genuinely reached full focus,
 -- keep that readiness alive for a very short replication-grace window.  RIVALS can expose
 -- a one-frame ViewModel/replication dip even though the player is visibly still scoped.
 -- This latch can NEVER make an unscoped/never-ready sniper fire: it is armed only after
 -- a real fully-focused frame and is cleared immediately when ADS ends.
 local nowTick=tick()
 local function acceptReady(value)
  if value==true then
   Runtime.RivalsAimScopeReadyLatchUntil=nowTick+.11
   return true
  end
  return nowTick<=(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimScopeReadyLatchUntil)or 0)
 end

 local currentAim=nil
 local vm=rawget(item,"ViewModel")
 pcall(function()if vm then currentAim=tonumber(vm.CurrentAimValue)end end)
 if currentAim~=nil then return acceptReady(currentAim+1e-4>=scopePercent)end
 local original=Runtime.RivalsOriginalIsFullyAiming
 if type(original)=="function"then
  local ok,value=pcall(original,item)
  if ok then return acceptReady(value==true)end
 end
 local method=rawget(item,"IsFullyAiming")or item.IsFullyAiming
 if type(method)=="function"then
  local ok,value=pcall(method,item)
  if ok then return acceptReady(value==true)end
 end
 return nowTick<=(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimScopeReadyLatchUntil)or 0)
end

-- V44: actual ADS intent, separate from "scope fully focused".
-- This becomes true as soon as the player starts ADS, including the blurry focus-in frames.
function CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperAiming(item)
 if not item or CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)~="sniper"then return false end
 local aiming=false
 pcall(function()
  local getter=rawget(item,"Get")or item.Get
  if type(getter)=="function"then aiming=getter(item,"IsAiming")==true end
 end)
 if not aiming then
  local data=rawget(item,"Data")
  if type(data)=="table"then aiming=data.IsAiming==true end
 end
 return aiming==true
end

-- Store only information that was genuinely visible. Hidden enemies are never sampled here.
-- When LOS is lost, a short last-seen velocity projection creates a human pre-aim at the
-- likely re-peek / wall-exit point instead of omniscient through-wall tracking.
function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateUncleSniperPreAimMemory(target,now)
 if not target or not target.Player or target.Visible~=true then return end
 local part=target.Head or target.TrackPart or target.Chest or target.Root
 if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return end
 local root=target.Root or target.Chest or part
 local velocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
 pcall(function()velocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
 if velocity.Magnitude>150 then velocity=velocity.Unit*150 end
 Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPreAimMemory[target.Player]={
  World=part.Position,
  Velocity=velocity,
  SeenAt=tonumber(now)or os.clock(),
 }
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleSniperPreAimWorld(target,now)
 if not target or not target.Player then return nil end
 local memory=Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPreAimMemory[target.Player]
 if type(memory)~="table"or typeof(memory.World)~="Vector3"then return nil end
 local age=(tonumber(now)or os.clock())-(tonumber(memory.SeenAt)or 0)
 if age<0 or age>.80 then return nil end
 local velocity=typeof(memory.Velocity)=="Vector3"and memory.Velocity or Vector3.new(0,0,0)
 -- Lead only a short human-plausible window. A fast upward launch receives a little
 -- extra vertical anticipation because Scythe / jump mobility can enter above the old head line.
 local lead=math.clamp(.055+age*.55,.055,.22)
 if math.abs(velocity.Y)>36 then lead=math.min(.25,lead+.035)end
 local offset=velocity*lead
 if offset.Magnitude>18 and offset.Magnitude>0 then offset=offset.Unit*18 end
 return memory.World+offset
end

-- ADS warm-pull: active during the native focus-in animation. It is intentionally slower
-- than the commit flick; its job is to bring the scope toward the nearest threat while the
-- lens is still focusing, so scope-ready does not begin from a dead stop.
function CVU_RIVALS_MoveUncleSniperWarmPull(target,dt,targetPart,explicitWorld,isPreAim)
 if not Camera or not target then return false end
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local worldPos=typeof(explicitWorld)=="Vector3"and explicitWorld or nil
 if not worldPos then
  targetPart=targetPart or target.Head or target.Chest or target.TrackPart
  if not targetPart or not targetPart:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(targetPart)then
   worldPos=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position))
  else
   worldPos=CVU_RIVALS_GetStablePrecisionWorld(targetPart,frameDt)or targetPart.Position
  end
 end
 if not worldPos then return false end
 local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not on or p.Z<=0 then return false end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local delta=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)-center
 if delta.Magnitude<=3.5 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*math.exp(-18*frameDt)
  return true
 end
 local _,closeWeight=CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local root=target.Root or target.Chest or target.Head
 local targetVelocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
 if root and root:IsA("BasePart")then pcall(function()targetVelocity=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)end
 local mobility=math.clamp((math.max(math.abs(targetVelocity.Y)-28,targetVelocity.Magnitude-70))/70,0,1)
 local strength=(isPreAim and 3.1 or 5.2)*(1+.18*closeWeight+.20*mobility)
 local desired=delta*strength
 local maxSpeed=(isPreAim and 620 or 980)*(1+.16*closeWeight+.20*mobility)
 if desired.Magnitude>maxSpeed and desired.Magnitude>0 then desired=desired.Unit*maxSpeed end
 local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local rate=isPreAim and 7.0 or 10.5
 local velocity=previous:Lerp(desired,1-math.exp(-rate*frameDt))
 local dv=velocity-previous
 local maxDv=(isPreAim and 5200 or 8600)*(1+.20*mobility)*frameDt
 if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
 local step=velocity*frameDt
 local maxStep=isPreAim and 6.0 or 9.5
 if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
  local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
  if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
 elseif Camera then
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
 end
 return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoTargetParts(character)
 if not character then return nil,nil,nil end
 local head=character:FindFirstChild("HitboxHead",true)or character:FindFirstChild("PhysicalHitboxHead",true)or character:FindFirstChild("Head",true)
 local chest=character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso",true)or character:FindFirstChild("Torso",true)or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart",true)
 local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart",true)or chest
 return head,chest,root
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsRealPlayerTarget(target)
 local key=target and target.Player or nil
 return typeof(key)=="Instance"and key:IsA("Player")and key.Parent==Players
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsTargetKatanaDeflecting(target)
 if not CVU_RIVALS_IsRealPlayerTarget(target)then return false end
 return CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(target.Player)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsTargetKatanaEquipped(target)
 if not CVU_RIVALS_IsRealPlayerTarget(target)then return false end
 return CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaEquipped(target.Player)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsTargetShieldEquipped(target)
 if not CVU_RIVALS_IsRealPlayerTarget(target)then return false end
 return CVU_RIVALS_IsShieldEquipped(target.Player)
end


-- V58 shield/reload acquisition gates.
-- Shield logic is decided from the LOCAL weapon slot: when an enemy equips a shield,
-- Aim Assist ignores that player unless our currently equipped item is a Secondary.
-- This is an acquisition gate (not merely an Auto-fire gate), so free-FOV tracking also
-- stops following shielded enemies instead of visually locking and then refusing to shoot.
function CVU_RIVALS_GetItemSlotLabel(item)
 if not item then return nil end
 local sources={item}
 if type(item)=="table"then
  local info=rawget(item,"Info")
  local properties=rawget(item,"Properties")
  if type(info)=="table"then sources[#sources+1]=info end
  if type(properties)=="table"then sources[#sources+1]=properties end
 end
 for _,source in ipairs(sources)do
  if type(source)=="table"then
   for _,key in ipairs({"Slot","SlotType","InventorySlot","WeaponSlot","LoadoutSlot","ItemSlot"})do
    local value=rawget(source,key)
    if value~=nil then
     local s=tostring(value)
     if s~=""then return s end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 if type(item)=="table"and type(rawget(item,"Get"))=="function"then
  for _,key in ipairs({"Slot","SlotType","InventorySlot","WeaponSlot","LoadoutSlot","ItemSlot"})do
   local ok,value=pcall(function()return item:Get(key)end)
   if ok and value~=nil and tostring(value)~=""then return tostring(value)end
  end
 end
 return nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsSecondaryItem(item)
 if not item then return false end
 local slot=CVU_RIVALS_GetItemSlotLabel(item)
 if slot then
  local compact=string.lower(tostring(slot)):gsub("[^%w]","")
  if string.find(compact,"secondary",1,true)
  or string.find(compact,"sidearm",1,true)
  or compact=="slot2"or compact=="2"then return true end
  if string.find(compact,"primary",1,true)or string.find(compact,"melee",1,true)then return false end
 end
 -- Metadata is preferred.  This fallback covers common RIVALS sidearm names on builds
 -- where the client item omits Slot/SlotType from the live object.
 local _,name=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
 local compact=string.lower(tostring(name or"")):gsub("[^%w]","")
 return string.find(compact,"pistol",1,true)~=nil
  or string.find(compact,"handgun",1,true)~=nil
  or string.find(compact,"revolver",1,true)~=nil
  or string.find(compact,"sidearm",1,true)~=nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem(item)
 if not item then return false end

 -- Explicit exclusions first.
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsMeleeItem)=="function"and CVU_RIVALS_IsMeleeItem(item)then return false end
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsSecondaryItem(item)then return false end

 -- Prefer actual RIVALS slot metadata.
 local slot=CVU_RIVALS_GetItemSlotLabel(item)
 if slot then
  local compact=string.lower(tostring(slot)):gsub("[^%w]","")
  if string.find(compact,"primary",1,true)
   or compact=="slot1"or compact=="1"then
   return true
  end
  if string.find(compact,"secondary",1,true)
   or string.find(compact,"sidearm",1,true)
   or string.find(compact,"melee",1,true)
   or string.find(compact,"utility",1,true)
   or compact=="slot2"or compact=="2"
   or compact=="slot3"or compact=="3"
   or compact=="slot4"or compact=="4"then
   return false
  end
 end

 -- Secondary metadata fallback: only an explicit Primary label counts.
 local sources={item}
 if type(item)=="table"then
  local info=rawget(item,"Info")
  local properties=rawget(item,"Properties")
  if type(info)=="table"then sources[#sources+1]=info end
  if type(properties)=="table"then sources[#sources+1]=properties end
 end
 for _,source in ipairs(sources)do
  if type(source)=="table"then
   for _,key in ipairs({"Category","WeaponType","Type","Class","Group","SlotType"})do
    local value=rawget(source,key)
    if value~=nil then
     local compact=string.lower(tostring(value)):gsub("[^%w]","")
     if string.find(compact,"primary",1,true)then return true end
     if string.find(compact,"secondary",1,true)
      or string.find(compact,"sidearm",1,true)
      or string.find(compact,"melee",1,true)
      or string.find(compact,"utility",1,true)then
      return false
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end

 -- Conservative fallback for known RIVALS Primary weapon names.
 -- Unknown/new weapons are NOT blocked until their slot can be proven Primary.
 local _,name=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
 local compact=string.lower(tostring(name or"")):gsub("[^%w]","")
 local knownPrimary={
  ["assaultrifle"]=true,
  ["burstrifle"]=true,
  ["bow"]=true,
  ["crossbow"]=true,
  ["exogun"]=true,
  ["flamethrower"]=true,
  ["grenadelauncher"]=true,
  ["minigun"]=true,
  ["paintballgun"]=true,
  ["rpg"]=true,
  ["shotgun"]=true,
  ["sniper"]=true,
 }
 return knownPrimary[compact]==true
end


Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadItem=Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadItem or nil
Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadUntil=Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadUntil or 0
Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputHooked=Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputHooked or false
Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputWrapper=Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputWrapper or nil
Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadOriginalInput=Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadOriginalInput or nil

local function CVU_RIVALS_ReadItemStateValue(item,key)
 if not item then return nil end
 if type(item)=="table"then
  local direct=rawget(item,key)
  if direct~=nil then return direct end
  for _,containerKey in ipairs({"State","Properties"})do
   local source=rawget(item,containerKey)
   if type(source)=="table"then
    local value=rawget(source,key)
    if value~=nil then return value end
   end
  end
  local getter=rawget(item,"Get")
  if type(getter)=="function"then
   local ok,value=pcall(function()return item:Get(key)end)
   if ok and value~=nil then return value end
  end
 end
 return nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetReloadDuration(item)
 local sources={}
 if type(item)=="table"then
  sources[#sources+1]=item
  local info=rawget(item,"Info")
  local properties=rawget(item,"Properties")
  if type(info)=="table"then sources[#sources+1]=info end
  if type(properties)=="table"then sources[#sources+1]=properties end
 end
 for _,source in ipairs(sources)do
  for _,key in ipairs({"ReloadTime","ReloadDuration","EmptyReloadTime","TacticalReloadTime","ReloadCooldown"})do
   local value=tonumber(rawget(source,key))
   if value and value>0 then
    if value>20 then value=value/1000 end
    if value>=.15 and value<=8 then return value end
   end
  end
 end
 if item and type(item)=="table"and type(rawget(item,"Get"))=="function"then
  for _,key in ipairs({"ReloadTime","ReloadDuration","EmptyReloadTime","TacticalReloadTime","ReloadCooldown"})do
   local ok,value=pcall(function()return item:Get(key)end)
   value=ok and tonumber(value)or nil
   if value and value>0 then
    if value>20 then value=value/1000 end
    if value>=.15 and value<=8 then return value end
   end
  end
 end
 return 2.7
end

function CVU_RIVALS_MarkLocalReloading(item)
 item=item or CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if not item or CVU_RIVALS_IsMeleeItem(item)then return end
 Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadItem=item
 Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadUntil=tick()+math.clamp(CVU_RIVALS_GetReloadDuration(item)+.12,.35,8.2)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ClearLocalReloading(item)
 if item==nil or Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadItem==nil or Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadItem==item then
  Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadItem=nil
  Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadUntil=0
 end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalReloading(item)
 item=item or CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if not item or CVU_RIVALS_IsMeleeItem(item)then return false end

 -- Prefer explicit live state when the client item exposes it.
 for _,key in ipairs({"Reloading","IsReloading","_reloading","_is_reloading","ReloadInProgress","IsReloadingWeapon"})do
  local value=CVU_RIVALS_ReadItemStateValue(item,key)
  if value==true or value==1 then return true end
 end
 for _,key in ipairs({"ReloadUntil","ReloadEndTime","_reload_until","_reload_end_time","_reload_end"})do
  local value=tonumber(CVU_RIVALS_ReadItemStateValue(item,key))
  if value and value>tick()and value-tick()<=8.5 then return true end
 end

 -- MechanicsController input tracking is the fallback for builds that hide reload state.
 local tracked=Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadItem
 if tracked and tracked~=item then
  CVU_RIVALS_ClearLocalReloading()
  return false
 end
 if tracked==item and tick()<(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadUntil)or 0)then return true end
 if tracked==item then CVU_RIVALS_ClearLocalReloading(item)end
 return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_RestoreReloadInputTracker()
 local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
 local wrapper=Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputWrapper
 if type(mechanics)=="table"and wrapper and mechanics.EquippedItemInput==wrapper
 and type(Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadOriginalInput)=="function"then
  pcall(function()mechanics.EquippedItemInput=Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadOriginalInput end)
 end
 Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputHooked=false
 Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputWrapper=nil
 Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadOriginalInput=nil
 CVU_RIVALS_ClearLocalReloading()
end

function CVU_RIVALS_InstallReloadInputTracker()
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 if Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputHooked then return true end
 local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
 if type(mechanics)~="table"or type(mechanics.EquippedItemInput)~="function"then return false end
 local original=mechanics.EquippedItemInput
 local wrapper
 wrapper=function(self,inputName,...)
  local label=string.lower(tostring(inputName or""))
  if string.find(label,"reload",1,true)then
   local ending=string.find(label,"finish",1,true)
    or string.find(label,"stop",1,true)
    or string.find(label,"end",1,true)
    or string.find(label,"cancel",1,true)
   if ending then
    CVU_RIVALS_ClearLocalReloading(CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem())
   else
    CVU_RIVALS_MarkLocalReloading(CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem())
   end
  end
  return original(self,inputName,...)
 end
 Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadOriginalInput=original
 Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputWrapper=wrapper
 mechanics.EquippedItemInput=wrapper
 Runtime.RivalsLocalReloadInputHooked=true
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetNearestLegPart(character)
 if not character then return nil end
 local origin=Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or nil
 local center=Camera and Camera.ViewportSize*.5 or nil
 local best,bestDistance=nil,math.huge
 for _,name in ipairs({"LeftUpperLeg","RightUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg","RightLowerLeg","LeftFoot","RightFoot","Left Leg","Right Leg"})do
  local part=character:FindFirstChild(name,true)
  if part and part:IsA("BasePart")then
   local visible=typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,part)
   if visible then
    local score=0
    if Camera and center then
     local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
     score=on and p.Z>0 and(Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)-center).Magnitude or math.huge
    end
    if score<bestDistance then bestDistance=score best=part end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

function CVU_RIVALS_BuildCrossbowShotCycle()
 local cycle={}
 local order={}
 for i=1,10 do cycle[i]="頭" order[i]=i end
 for i=10,2,-1 do
  local j=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextInteger(1,i)
  order[i],order[j]=order[j],order[i]
 end
 local chestCount=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextInteger(2,3)
 for i=1,chestCount do cycle[order[i]]="胸" end
 Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycle=cycle
 Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycleIndex=1
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetCrossbowShotSlot()
 local cycle=Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycle
 local index=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycleIndex)or 0
 if type(cycle)~="table"or#cycle~=10 or index<1 or index>10 then
  CVU_RIVALS_BuildCrossbowShotCycle()
  cycle=Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycle
  index=Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycleIndex
 end
 return cycle[index],index
end

function CVU_RIVALS_CommitCrossbowShotSlot()
 local index=(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycleIndex)or 1)+1
 if index>10 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycle=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycleIndex=0
 else
  Runtime.RivalsAimCrossbowCycleIndex=index
 end
end
