function CVU_RIVALS_GetPrecisionShotPart(target,kind)
 if not target or not target.Player or not target.Character then return nil,nil end
 local existing=Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotPart
 if Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotPlayer==target.Player and Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotKind==kind and existing and existing.Parent then
  return existing,Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotLabel
 end

 local part,label=nil,"頭"
 if kind=="crossbow"then
  local slot=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrossbowShotSlot()
  if slot=="胸"then part=target.Chest label="胸" else part=target.Head label="頭" end
  part=part or target.Head or target.Chest or target.TrackPart
 elseif kind=="sniper"then
  -- V63 strict sniper head-only policy: Auto-fire / shot correction may NEVER fall back
  -- to chest, arm, torso, or TrackPart when the head reference is missing or stale.
  part=target.Head
  if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")or not CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(part)then
   part=target.Character and select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoTargetParts(target.Character))or nil
  end
  if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")or not CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(part)then return nil,nil end
  local localRoot=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  local targetRoot=target.Root or target.Chest or target.Head
  local elevation=0
  if localRoot and targetRoot then elevation=targetRoot.Position.Y-localRoot.Position.Y end
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperElevationDelta=elevation
  -- V44 Uncle: the commit flick is explicitly head-first.  Do not manufacture a random
  -- elevated chest/leg decision for this built-in style; the videos show the first large
  -- motion being thrown at the head line, with misses coming from motion/overshoot instead.
  local precisionStyle=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyle()
  -- V63: every sniper style is head-only at the precision-shot layer.  Elevation may still
  -- influence motion timing, but it is no longer allowed to reroll the shot onto chest/legs.
  -- This removes the last legacy path that could make sniper Auto-fire resolve to a body part.
  local _=precisionStyle
 else
  return nil,nil
 end

 Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotPart=part
 Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotPlayer=target.Player
 Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotKind=kind
 Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotLabel=label
 return part,label
end

function CVU_RIVALS_CommitPrecisionShot(kind)
 if kind=="crossbow"then CVU_RIVALS_CommitCrossbowShotSlot()end
 CVU_RIVALS_ClearPrecisionShotPart()
end

-- Return the point on a BasePart's collision box that is closest to the screen-center
-- crosshair.  Inside=true means the center camera ray actually intersects the OBB, so
-- auto-fire can use the real hitbox instead of requiring the part's visual center.
function CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(part)
 if not Camera or not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return nil end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local ray=Camera:ViewportPointToRay(center.X,center.Y)
 local origin=ray.Origin
 local direction=ray.Direction
 if direction.Magnitude<=.000001 then return nil end
 direction=direction.Unit
 local localOrigin=part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(origin)
 local localDirection=part.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(direction)
 local half=part.Size*.5
 local tMin=-math.huge
 local tMax=math.huge
 local hit=true

 if math.abs(localDirection.X)<.000001 then
  if localOrigin.X<-half.X or localOrigin.X>half.X then hit=false end
 else
  local a=(-half.X-localOrigin.X)/localDirection.X
  local b=( half.X-localOrigin.X)/localDirection.X
  if a>b then a,b=b,a end
  tMin=math.max(tMin,a)tMax=math.min(tMax,b)
  if tMin>tMax then hit=false end
 end
 if hit then
  if math.abs(localDirection.Y)<.000001 then
   if localOrigin.Y<-half.Y or localOrigin.Y>half.Y then hit=false end
  else
   local a=(-half.Y-localOrigin.Y)/localDirection.Y
   local b=( half.Y-localOrigin.Y)/localDirection.Y
   if a>b then a,b=b,a end
   tMin=math.max(tMin,a)tMax=math.min(tMax,b)
   if tMin>tMax then hit=false end
  end
 end
 if hit then
  if math.abs(localDirection.Z)<.000001 then
   if localOrigin.Z<-half.Z or localOrigin.Z>half.Z then hit=false end
  else
   local a=(-half.Z-localOrigin.Z)/localDirection.Z
   local b=( half.Z-localOrigin.Z)/localDirection.Z
   if a>b then a,b=b,a end
   tMin=math.max(tMin,a)tMax=math.min(tMax,b)
   if tMin>tMax then hit=false end
  end
 end

 if hit and tMax>=math.max(tMin,0)then
  local t=tMin>=0 and tMin or tMax
  local world=origin+direction*t
  return{Part=part,WorldPosition=world,Screen=center,PixelDistance=0,Inside=true}
 end

 -- Missed the box: sample the center ray at the part's depth, clamp that point into
 -- the oriented collision box, then project it back to screen space.  This is the
 -- nearest practical aim point on the hitbox for the next flick step.
 local depth=(part.Position-origin):Dot(direction)
 if depth<=0 then depth=(part.Position-origin).Magnitude end
 local sample=origin+direction*depth
 local localSample=part.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(sample)
 local clamped=Vector3.new(
  math.clamp(localSample.X,-half.X,half.X),
  math.clamp(localSample.Y,-half.Y,half.Y),
  math.clamp(localSample.Z,-half.Z,half.Z)
 )
 local world=part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(clamped)
 local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(world)
 if not on or p.Z<=0 then return nil end
 local screen=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)
 return{Part=part,WorldPosition=world,Screen=screen,PixelDistance=(screen-center).Magnitude,Inside=false}
end

-- Head aim-point policy V47: use the actually exposed portion of the head, not only
-- the center ray.  <=50% exposed keeps the aim inside the visible edge/peek region;
-- only >50% exposed AND a clean center LOS is allowed to return to the true center.
-- A symmetric grid deliberately has no center row/column, so an exact half-head peek
-- measures as half instead of being promoted just because the center line barely clears cover.
local CVU_RIVALS_HeadAimSampleOffsets={
 Vector2.new(-.88,-.88),Vector2.new(-.52,-.88),Vector2.new(-.02,-.88),Vector2.new(.02,-.88),Vector2.new(.52,-.88),Vector2.new(.88,-.88),
 Vector2.new(-.88,-.52),Vector2.new(-.52,-.52),Vector2.new(-.02,-.52),Vector2.new(.02,-.52),Vector2.new(.52,-.52),Vector2.new(.88,-.52),
 Vector2.new(-.88,-.02),Vector2.new(-.52,-.02),Vector2.new(-.02,-.02),Vector2.new(.02,-.02),Vector2.new(.52,-.02),Vector2.new(.88,-.02),
 Vector2.new(-.88,.02),Vector2.new(-.52,.02),Vector2.new(-.02,.02),Vector2.new(.02,.02),Vector2.new(.52,.02),Vector2.new(.88,.02),
 Vector2.new(-.88,.52),Vector2.new(-.52,.52),Vector2.new(-.02,.52),Vector2.new(.02,.52),Vector2.new(.52,.52),Vector2.new(.88,.52),
 Vector2.new(-.88,.88),Vector2.new(-.52,.88),Vector2.new(-.02,.88),Vector2.new(.02,.88),Vector2.new(.52,.88),Vector2.new(.88,.88),
}

function CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(part)
 if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
 local name=string.lower(tostring(part.Name or""))
 return name=="head"or string.find(name,"hitboxhead",1,true)~=nil or string.find(name,"headhitbox",1,true)~=nil or string.find(name,"physicalhitboxhead",1,true)~=nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsWorldPointVisible(origin,worldPoint,preparedParams)
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or typeof(worldPoint)~="Vector3"then return false end
 local delta=worldPoint-origin
 if delta.Magnitude<=.01 then return true end
 local params=preparedParams
 if not params then
  params=RaycastParams.new()
  params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  params.IgnoreWater=true
  local ignore={}
  if LocalPlayer.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=LocalPlayer.Character end
  for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
   local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
   if character then ignore[#ignore+1]=character end
  end
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
 end
 return Workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,params)==nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(part,knownOrigin)
 if not Camera or not CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(part)then return nil end
 local origin=typeof(knownOrigin)=="Vector3"and knownOrigin or Camera.CFrame.Position
 local viewportCenter=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local now=os.clock()

 -- Several sniper controllers can ask for the same head solution in one render frame.
 -- Reuse that answer briefly so the exposure grid is not raycast multiple times per frame.
 local cached=Runtime.RivalsHeadAimExposureCache
 if type(cached)=="table"and cached.Part==part and typeof(cached.Origin)=="Vector3"and(now-(tonumber(cached.At)or 0))<=.010 and(cached.Origin-origin).Magnitude<=.35 then
  return cached.Solution
 end

 -- Build the ignore list once for the entire exposure scan.  The old helper rebuilt it
 -- for every sample, which would make partial-head sampling unnecessarily expensive.
 local visibilityParams=RaycastParams.new()
 visibilityParams.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 visibilityParams.IgnoreWater=true
 local ignore={}
 if LocalPlayer.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=LocalPlayer.Character end
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
  if character then ignore[#ignore+1]=character end
 end
 visibilityParams.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore

 local half=part.Size*.5
 local visibleSamples={}
 local visibleCount=0
 local sumX,sumY=0,0

 -- Measure the exposed head area.  The samples stay inside the hitbox, including the
 -- outer .88 ring, so a thin edge peek can still produce a legal target point.
 for _,uv in ipairs(CVU_RIVALS_HeadAimSampleOffsets)do
  local localOffset=Vector3.new(uv.X*half.X,uv.Y*half.Y,0)
  local world=part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(localOffset)
  local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(world)
  if on and p.Z>0 and CVU_RIVALS_IsWorldPointVisible(origin,world,visibilityParams)then
   local screen=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)
   visibleCount+=1
   sumX+=uv.X
   sumY+=uv.Y
   visibleSamples[#visibleSamples+1]={UV=uv,LocalOffset=localOffset,WorldPosition=world,Screen=screen}
  end
 end
 if visibleCount<=0 then
  Runtime.RivalsHeadAimExposureCache=nil
  return nil
 end

 local exposedFraction=visibleCount/#CVU_RIVALS_HeadAimSampleOffsets
 local centerWorld=part.Position
 local cp,centerOn=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(centerWorld)
 local centerVisible=centerOn and cp.Z>0 and CVU_RIVALS_IsWorldPointVisible(origin,centerWorld,visibilityParams)

 -- More than half the head must really be exposed before the lock is allowed to return
 -- to the geometric center.  Exactly half remains an edge/peek shot by design.
 if exposedFraction>.50 and centerVisible then
  local screen=Vector2.new(cp.X,cp.Y)
  local result={Part=part,WorldPosition=centerWorld,LocalOffset=Vector3.new(0,0,0),Screen=screen,PixelDistance=(screen-viewportCenter).Magnitude,Mode="center",CenterVisible=true,ExposedFraction=exposedFraction}
  Runtime.RivalsHeadAimExposureCache={Part=part,Origin=origin,At=now,Solution=result}
  return result
 end

 -- Partial peek: aim near the center of the VISIBLE patch, not the hidden full-head
 -- center.  A half-head peek therefore lands around that exposed half's head edge;
 -- a very thin peek naturally moves farther outward toward the visible rim.
 local visibleCentroid=Vector2.new(sumX/visibleCount,sumY/visibleCount)
 local best=nil
 for _,sample in ipairs(visibleSamples)do
  local delta=sample.UV-visibleCentroid
  local radial=sample.UV.Magnitude
  local score=delta.X*delta.X+delta.Y*delta.Y+radial*.0005+(sample.Screen-viewportCenter).Magnitude*.000001
  if not best or score<best.Score then
   best={Part=part,WorldPosition=sample.WorldPosition,LocalOffset=sample.LocalOffset,Screen=sample.Screen,PixelDistance=(sample.Screen-viewportCenter).Magnitude,Mode="edge",CenterVisible=centerVisible,ExposedFraction=exposedFraction,Score=score}
  end
 end
 if best then Runtime.RivalsHeadAimExposureCache={Part=part,Origin=origin,At=now,Solution=best}end
 return best
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(part,frameDt,knownOrigin)
 local solution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(part,knownOrigin)
 if not solution then return nil,nil end
 local stableCenter=CVU_RIVALS_GetStablePrecisionWorld(part,frameDt)or part.Position
 if solution.Mode=="center"then
  solution.SafeEdgeFactor=0
  -- V63 final-center correction: coarse travel keeps the anti-jitter stable point, but once
  -- the actual geometric head center is near the crosshair we switch to raw part.Position.
  -- This prevents a 22 ms lead/filter offset from leaving Auto-fire on the cheek/temple.
  if Camera then
   local rawPoint,rawOn=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
   if rawOn and rawPoint.Z>0 then
    local rawDistance=(Vector2.new(rawPoint.X,rawPoint.Y)-Camera.ViewportSize*.5).Magnitude
    if rawDistance<=34 then return part.Position,solution end
   end
  end
  return stableCenter,solution
 end
 if typeof(solution.LocalOffset)=="Vector3"then
  -- V63 sniper safe-edge policy.  The visual head rim is slightly more generous than the
  -- reliable sniper collision area in RIVALS.  For partial peeks, pull the visible-edge
  -- solution inward toward the head center whenever LOS still permits it.  If cover blocks
  -- the safer inner point, progressively move outward; the last-resort visual rim is kept for
  -- tracking only and Auto-fire will refuse to shoot that unsafe extreme edge.
  local origin=typeof(knownOrigin)=="Vector3"and knownOrigin or(Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position)
  if typeof(origin)=="Vector3"then
   for _,factor in ipairs({.70,.78,.86,.92})do
    local rawWorld=part.Position+part.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(solution.LocalOffset*factor)
    if CVU_RIVALS_IsWorldPointVisible(origin,rawWorld)then
     solution.SafeEdgeFactor=factor
     return stableCenter+part.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(solution.LocalOffset*factor),solution
    end
   end
  end
  solution.SafeEdgeFactor=1
  return stableCenter+part.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(solution.LocalOffset),solution
 end
 solution.SafeEdgeFactor=1
 return solution.WorldPosition,solution
end

-- V69: verify that a sniper ray aimed at the chosen head point is not physically intercepted
-- by the TARGET'S own chest/arm/hand, another enemy, or world geometry before reaching the head.
-- Friendly teammates are deliberately ignored here so a teammate body-blocking the sightline
-- does NOT suppress Auto-fire.  Enemy bodies remain queryable and can still block the shot.
function CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperHeadRayClear(target,headPart,worldPos)
 if not Camera or not target or not target.Character or not headPart or typeof(worldPos)~="Vector3"then return false end
 local origin=Camera.CFrame.Position
 local delta=worldPos-origin
 if delta.Magnitude<=.01 then return false end

 local ignore={}
 if LocalPlayer.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=LocalPlayer.Character end

 -- V69 teammate pass-through:
 -- Ignore only FRIENDLY characters.  In FFA/no-team modes CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer()
 -- returns true for every other live player, so nobody is accidentally treated as friendly.
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if player~=LocalPlayer and not CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)then
   local friendlyCharacter=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
   if friendlyCharacter then ignore[#ignore+1]=friendlyCharacter end
  end
 end

 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.IgnoreWater=true
 for _=1,6 do
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
  local result=Workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,params)
  if not result then
   -- Some builds expose non-queryable hitboxes.  In that case keep the ordinary world LOS
   -- result instead of disabling Auto-fire completely.
   return CVU_RIVALS_IsWorldPointVisible(origin,worldPos)
  end
  local hit=result.Instance
  if not hit then return false end
  local accessory=hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory")
  if accessory then
   ignore[#ignore+1]=accessory
  elseif hit:IsDescendantOf(target.Character)then
   return hit==headPart or CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(hit)
  else
   return false
  end
 end
 return false
end

-- V63: planned SWit misses must remain misses, not accidental chest/right-arm body shots.
function CVU_RIVALS_IsCrosshairClearOfTargetBody(target)
 if not Camera or not target or not target.Character then return true end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local ray=Camera:ViewportPointToRay(center.X,center.Y)
 local origin=ray.Origin
 local direction=ray.Direction
 if direction.Magnitude<=.000001 then return false end
 local maxDistance=5000
 local root=target.Root or target.Chest or target.Head
 if root and root:IsA("BasePart")then maxDistance=math.max(8,(root.Position-origin).Magnitude+12)end
 local ignore={}
 if LocalPlayer.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=LocalPlayer.Character end
 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.IgnoreWater=true
 for _=1,6 do
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
  local result=Workspace:Raycast(origin,direction.Unit*maxDistance,params)
  if not result then return true end
  local hit=result.Instance
  if not hit then return true end
  local accessory=hit:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory")
  if accessory then
   ignore[#ignore+1]=accessory
  elseif hit:IsDescendantOf(target.Character)then
   return false
  else
   return true
  end
 end
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_FindAutoFireContact(target,kind,preferredPart,frameDt)
 if not target or not Camera then return nil end
 local origin=Camera.CFrame.Position
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local precision=kind=="sniper"or kind=="crossbow"
 local parts=preferredPart and{preferredPart}or(precision and{target.Head}or{target.Head,target.Chest})
 local best=nil
 local dt=math.clamp(tonumber(frameDt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 for _,part in ipairs(parts)do
  if part and part:IsA("BasePart")then
   if CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(part)and kind=="sniper"then
    -- V63 sniper Auto-fire is HEAD-ONLY and uses two distinct exposure rules:
    --   >50% exposed/full head -> require the CENTER solution.  Touching the rim is not fire-ready.
    --   <=50% exposed        -> use the safer inward visible-edge point, never the raw visual rim.
    local worldPos,solution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(part,dt,origin)
    if solution and solution.Mode=="center"then worldPos=part.Position end
    if worldPos and solution and CVU_RIVALS_IsWorldPointVisible(origin,worldPos)then
     local exposed=tonumber(solution.ExposedFraction)or 0
     -- If more than half is exposed but the center itself is still blocked, wait; do not
     -- downgrade to an edge shot because that is exactly when center-head fire is expected.
     if exposed>.50 and solution.Mode~="center"then
      -- no fire contact this frame
     else
      local projected,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
      if on and projected.Z>0 then
       local screen=Vector2.new(projected.X,projected.Y)
       local pixelDistance=(screen-center).Magnitude
       local safeEdge=solution.Mode=="center"or(tonumber(solution.SafeEdgeFactor)or 1)<=.92
       local threshold=solution.Mode=="center"and 3.5 or 3.8
       if safeEdge and pixelDistance<=threshold and CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperHeadRayClear(target,part,worldPos)then
        best={
         Part=part,
         WorldPosition=worldPos,
         Screen=screen,
         PixelDistance=pixelDistance,
         Inside=true,
         HeadAimMode=solution.Mode,
         HeadExposedFraction=solution.ExposedFraction,
         SafeEdgeFactor=solution.SafeEdgeFactor,
        }
       end
      end
     end
    end
   elseif CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(part)and precision then
    -- Crossbow keeps the prior precision behavior.
    local boxContact=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(part)
    if boxContact and boxContact.Inside==true and typeof(boxContact.WorldPosition)=="Vector3"
    and CVU_RIVALS_IsWorldPointVisible(origin,boxContact.WorldPosition)then
     best={Part=part,WorldPosition=boxContact.WorldPosition,Screen=center,PixelDistance=0,Inside=true,HeadAimMode="hitbox",HeadExposedFraction=nil}
    end
    local worldPos,solution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(part,dt,origin)
    if solution and typeof(worldPos)=="Vector3"and CVU_RIVALS_IsWorldPointVisible(origin,worldPos)then
     local projected,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
     if on and projected.Z>0 then
      local screen=Vector2.new(projected.X,projected.Y)
      local pixelDistance=(screen-center).Magnitude
      local threshold=solution.Mode=="center"and 4.5 or 7.0
      if pixelDistance<=threshold then
       local contact={Part=part,WorldPosition=worldPos,Screen=screen,PixelDistance=pixelDistance,Inside=true,HeadAimMode=solution.Mode,HeadExposedFraction=solution.ExposedFraction}
       if not best or contact.PixelDistance<best.PixelDistance then best=contact end
      end
     end
    end
   elseif CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,part)then
    local contact=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(part)
    if contact and(not best or contact.PixelDistance<best.PixelDistance)then best=contact end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,part)
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(part)then return CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(part,origin)~=nil end
 return not CVU_RIVALS_HasWorldBlocker(origin,part)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetCurvePart(character)
 if not character then return nil end
 local mode=tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or"自動")
 if mode~="自動"then return CVU_RIVALS_GetTargetPart(character,false)end
 local head,chest=CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoTargetParts(character)
 if not Camera then return head or chest end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local best,bestDist=nil,math.huge
 for _,part in ipairs({head,chest})do
  if part then
   local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
   if on and p.Z>0 then
    local d=(Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)-center).Magnitude
    if d<bestDist then bestDist=d best=part end
   end
  end
 end
 return best or head or chest
end

function CVU_RIVALS_FindCurveTarget(origin)
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or not Camera then return nil end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local fov=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.PseudoWallFOV)or 110,10,500)
 local best=nil
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)and not CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(player)then
   local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
   local part=CVU_RIVALS_GetCurvePart(character)
   if part and CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,part)then
    local point,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    if onScreen and point.Z>0 then
     local screenDistance=(Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)-center).Magnitude
     if screenDistance<=fov then
      local worldDistance=(part.Position-origin).Magnitude
      local score=screenDistance+worldDistance*.001
      if not best or score<best.Score then
       best={Player=player,Character=character,Part=part,Position=part.Position,Distance=worldDistance,Score=score,Visible=true}
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

-- V66 RIVALS permanent lobby guard (always enabled; no UI switch).
-- LocalFighter alone is NOT enough: RIVALS can keep/create a LocalFighter while the user is
-- still standing in the lobby.  A real combat session must also have a native Duel subject
-- which can resolve LocalPlayer to a Dueler.
function CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalActiveDuel()
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 local spectator=Runtime.RivalsSpectateController
 local duel=spectator and spectator.CurrentDuelSubject or nil
 if not duel then return nil,nil end

 local dueler=nil
 local ok=pcall(function()
  if type(duel.GetDueler)=="function"then
   dueler=duel:GetDueler(LocalPlayer)
  end
 end)
 if not ok or not dueler then return nil,nil end
 return duel,dueler
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive()
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)

 local controller=Runtime.RivalsFighterController
 local fighter=controller and controller.LocalFighter or nil
 if not fighter then return false end

 local fighterPlayer=nil
 pcall(function()fighterPlayer=fighter.Player end)
 if fighterPlayer~=nil and fighterPlayer~=LocalPlayer then return false end

 local duel,dueler=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalActiveDuel()
 if not duel or not dueler then return false end

 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ForceLobbyAimReset()
 Runtime.RivalsAimTarget=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=0
 Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0
 Runtime.RivalsAimFOVVisualCenter=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimWeaponSignature=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=false
 Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainSince=0
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ClearPrecisionShotPart)
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit)=="function"then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit)end
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_ResetAimMotion)=="function"then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetAimMotion)end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_FindAimTarget()
 if not Camera then return nil end
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive)=="function"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive()then
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ForceLobbyAimReset)
  return nil
 end
 local origin=Camera.CFrame.Position
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local now=os.clock()

 -- V50 target priority:
 -- 1) Any enemy actually exposed to LOS inside 700 px outranks every wall-hidden enemy.
 -- 2) Among exposed enemies, smaller crosshair distance always wins.
 -- 3) Only when NO exposed enemy exists inside 700 px may the nearest wall-hidden enemy
 --    become the fallback target, still respecting the ordinary acquisition range.
 local currentAimItem=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 local currentAimKind=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(currentAimItem))
 local blockKatanaTarget=CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem(currentAimItem)
 local aimStyle=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(currentAimKind)
 local freeFollow=Settings.RivalsAimFOVFollow==true
 local ordinaryRange=(aimStyle=="SWit"and freeFollow)and 700 or CVU_RIVALS_GetEffectiveAimFOV()
 local visiblePriorityRange=700
 local scanRange=math.max(ordinaryRange,visiblePriorityRange)

 local currentPlayer=Runtime.RivalsAimTarget and Runtime.RivalsAimTarget.Player or nil
 local chainPlayer=Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer
 local currentCandidate=nil
 local nearestOrdinary=nil
 local nearestVisible700=nil
 local visibleSince=Runtime.RivalsAimCandidateVisibleSince

 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  local candidate=nil
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)
  and(not blockKatanaTarget or not CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaEquipped(player))then
   local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
   local head,chest,root=CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoTargetParts(character)
   local trackPart=head or chest or root
   local hp=character and select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))or nil
   if trackPart and character:GetAttribute("Dead")~=true and(hp==nil or hp>0)then
    local point,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(trackPart.Position)
    if onScreen and point.Z>0 then
     local screenPos=Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)
     local screenDistance=(screenPos-center).Magnitude
     if screenDistance<=scanRange then
      local headVisible=head and CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,head)or false
      local chestVisible=chest and CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,chest)or false
      local visible=headVisible or chestVisible
      if visible then
       if typeof(visibleSince[player])~="number"then visibleSince[player]=now end
      else
       visibleSince[player]=nil
      end
      candidate={
       Player=player,
       Character=character,
       Head=head,
       Chest=chest,
       Root=root,
       TrackPart=trackPart,
       Screen=screenPos,
       ScreenDistance=screenDistance,
       Visible=visible,
       HeadVisible=headVisible,
       VisibleSince=visibleSince[player],
       Score=screenDistance,
      }
     end
    end
   end
  end

  if not candidate then visibleSince[player]=nil end
  if candidate then
   if player==currentPlayer then currentCandidate=candidate end
   if candidate.ScreenDistance<=ordinaryRange and(not nearestOrdinary or candidate.ScreenDistance<nearestOrdinary.ScreenDistance)then
    nearestOrdinary=candidate
   end
   if candidate.Visible==true and candidate.ScreenDistance<=visiblePriorityRange
   and(not nearestVisible700 or candidate.ScreenDistance<nearestVisible700.ScreenDistance)then
    nearestVisible700=candidate
   end
  end
 end

 -- Preserve an already-qualified sniper chain only while that exact chained target is
 -- still a real visible candidate. Once it hides, normal V50 priority resumes immediately.
 if chainPlayer then
  if currentCandidate and currentCandidate.Player==chainPlayer and currentCandidate.Visible==true then
   return currentCandidate
  end
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainSince=0
 end

 -- Wall-out priority is global for Aim Assist: no sticky wall target may steal the lock
 -- from a visible enemy merely because the hidden target sits closer to screen center.
 if nearestVisible700 then
  return nearestVisible700
 end

 -- No visible enemy exists inside 700 px. The nearest ordinary-range target is now the
 -- fallback; at this point it may be behind a wall, which is intentionally second priority.
 return nearestOrdinary
end
function CVU_RIVALS_FindSniperChainTarget(excludePlayer,now)
 if not Camera then return nil end
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive)=="function"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive()then return nil end
 local origin=Camera.CFrame.Position
 local localAimItem=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 local blockKatanaTarget=CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem(localAimItem)
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local maxRange=CVU_RIVALS_GetEffectiveAimFOV()
 local minVisible=math.max(.30,tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainMinVisible)or .30)
 local history=Runtime.RivalsAimCandidateVisibleSince
 local best=nil
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if player~=excludePlayer and CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)
  and(not blockKatanaTarget or not CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaEquipped(player))then
   local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
   local head,chest,root=CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoTargetParts(character)
   local trackPart=head or chest or root
   local hp=character and select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))or nil
   if head and trackPart and character:GetAttribute("Dead")~=true and(hp==nil or hp>0)then
    local point,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(trackPart.Position)
    if onScreen and point.Z>0 then
     local screenPos=Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)
     local screenDistance=(screenPos-center).Magnitude
     local since=history[player]
     local headVisible=CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,head)
     if screenDistance<=maxRange and headVisible and typeof(since)=="number"and now-since>=minVisible then
      local candidate={Player=player,Character=character,Head=head,Chest=chest,Root=root,TrackPart=trackPart,Screen=screenPos,ScreenDistance=screenDistance,Visible=true,HeadVisible=true,VisibleSince=since,Score=screenDistance,SniperChain=true}
      if not best or candidate.ScreenDistance<best.ScreenDistance then best=candidate end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

function CVU_RIVALS_RequestSniperChainAim()
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if not item or CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)~="sniper"then return false end
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperScopeReady(item)then return true end
 local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
 if mechanics and type(mechanics.EquippedItemInput)=="function"then
  pcall(mechanics.EquippedItemInput,mechanics,"StartAiming")
  return true
 end
 local input=rawget(item,"Input")or item.Input
 if type(input)=="function"then
  pcall(input,item,"StartAiming")
  return true
 end
 return false
end

local CVU_RIVALS_SlingshotShotPattern={"胸","頭","胸","胸","頭","胸","胸","頭","胸","空"}
local CVU_RIVALS_SWitShotPattern={"胸","頭","空","胸","胸","頭","空","胸","頭","空","胸","頭","胸","空","頭","胸","空","胸","頭","空"}

function CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyle()
 local style=tostring(Settings.RivalsAimStyle or"彈弓叔叔")
 if style~="彈弓叔叔"and style~="SWit"and style~="自訂"then style="彈弓叔叔"end
 return style
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetAimShotCandidate(origin)
 if Settings.RivalsAimAssist~=true then return nil end
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive)=="function"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive()then
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ForceLobbyAimReset)
  return nil
 end
 local target=Runtime.RivalsAimTarget
 if not target or not target.Player or not target.Character or not target.Visible then return nil end
 if not target.Character.Parent then return nil end
 if (Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt or 0)<=0 then return nil end
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem(item)and CVU_RIVALS_IsTargetKatanaEquipped(target)then return nil end
 local kind=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
 -- Melee is deliberately excluded from all Aim Assist body-part / silent correction.
 -- It remains fully manual until a real close-range hit is observed.
 if kind=="melee"then return nil end
 local forcedPart=Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart
 local forcedPosition=Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition
 Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=nil Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=nil
 if forcedPart and forcedPart.Parent and CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,forcedPart)then
  if kind=="sniper"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(forcedPart)then return nil end
  local pos=typeof(forcedPosition)=="Vector3"and forcedPosition or forcedPart.Position
  return{Player=target.Player,Character=target.Character,Part=forcedPart,Position=pos,Distance=(pos-origin).Magnitude,Score=0,Visible=true,AimAssist=true}
 end
 local part=nil
 local style=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind)
 local uncleContact=nil
 if kind=="sniper"then
  -- V63: sniper shot correction is strictly head-only.  No chest/arm fallback is legal.
  part=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetPrecisionShotPart(target,kind))
  if not part or not CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(part)then return nil end
  if style=="彈弓叔叔"or style=="自訂"then
   local strictContact=CVU_RIVALS_FindAutoFireContact(target,"sniper",part,1/60)
   if not strictContact or strictContact.Inside~=true then return nil end
   uncleContact=strictContact
  end
 elseif kind=="crossbow"then
  part=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetPrecisionShotPart(target,kind))or target.Head or target.Chest
  if (style=="彈弓叔叔"or style=="自訂")and part then
   uncleContact=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(part)
   if not uncleContact or uncleContact.Inside~=true then return nil end
  end
 elseif (style=="彈弓叔叔"or style=="自訂")and CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(kind)then
  -- V46: honor the acquisition's persistent body-part intent. Chest-first sequences
  -- cannot be silently redirected into the head, and direct-head sequences cannot be
  -- pulled down into the chest merely because both boxes happen to overlap the ray.
  local preferred=CVU_RIVALS_GetStableGunPreferredPart(target,kind)
  local contact=preferred and CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(preferred)or nil
  if contact and contact.Inside==true then
   part=preferred uncleContact=contact
  else
   return nil
  end
 else
  -- Everything outside the V39 Uncle rifle/sniper scope keeps the exact pre-V39 selection.
  if Runtime.RivalsAimPreferHead==true then
   local headChance=style=="彈弓叔叔"and .86 or .92
   if Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()>headChance then return nil end
   part=target.Head or target.Chest
  else
   local pattern=style=="彈弓叔叔"and CVU_RIVALS_SWitShotPattern or CVU_RIVALS_SlingshotShotPattern
   Runtime.RivalsAimShotIndex=(Runtime.RivalsAimShotIndex%#pattern)+1
   local slot=pattern[Runtime.RivalsAimShotIndex]
   if slot=="空"then return nil end
   part=slot=="頭"and(target.Head or target.Chest)or(target.Chest or target.Head)
  end
 end
 if not part or not CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,part)then return nil end
 local shotPos=uncleContact and uncleContact.WorldPosition or part.Position
 if not uncleContact and CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(part)then
  local headSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(part,origin)
  if headSolution then shotPos=headSolution.WorldPosition end
 end
 return{Player=target.Player,Character=target.Character,Part=part,Position=shotPos,Distance=(shotPos-origin).Magnitude,Score=0,Visible=true,AimAssist=true}
end

-- V37 SWit rifle tracking (legacy Slingshot-named runtime fields retained for stability).
-- This remains velocity-based, but is deliberately weaker than V36 so SWit does not
-- look like a magnetic lock. Slingshot rifle does NOT call this function.
-- Unlike the old position-chasing path, this controller keeps its own cursor velocity,
-- low-passes the target screen sample, estimates target screen velocity, and only slowly
-- moves a small persistent aim bias.  The acceleration cap deliberately preserves a few
-- frames of old motion during a direction change, creating lag -> catch-up -> tiny
-- overshoot -> correction instead of an instant robotic reversal.
function CVU_RIVALS_MoveSlingshotRifle(target,worldPos,dt)
 if not Camera or not target or typeof(worldPos)~="Vector3"then return end
 local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not on or p.Z<=0 then return end
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local rawScreen=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)
 local player=target.Player
 local now=os.clock()

 if Runtime.RivalsSlingshotTrackPlayer~=player
 or typeof(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotFilteredScreen)~="Vector2"
 or typeof(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotRawScreen)~="Vector2"then
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotTrackPlayer=player
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotFilteredScreen=rawScreen
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotRawScreen=rawScreen
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotTargetVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotBias=Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotBiasTarget=Vector2.new(
   Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-8.5,8.5),
   Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-3.0,9.5)
  )
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotBiasUntil=now+Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.24,.42)
 end

 local previousRaw=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotRawScreen
 local rawTargetVelocity=(rawScreen-previousRaw)/frameDt
 if rawTargetVelocity.Magnitude>2400 and rawTargetVelocity.Magnitude>0 then
  rawTargetVelocity=rawTargetVelocity.Unit*2400
 end
 Runtime.RivalsSlingshotRawScreen=rawScreen

 -- Target velocity reacts slower than target position.  A sudden strafe reversal therefore
 -- cannot flip the aim direction in one render frame.
 local oldTargetVelocity=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotTargetVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local velocityAlpha=1-math.exp(-5.4*frameDt)
 local targetVelocity=oldTargetVelocity:Lerp(rawTargetVelocity,velocityAlpha)
 Runtime.RivalsSlingshotTargetVelocity=targetVelocity

 -- Filter small head-bob / replication noise while still following genuine translation.
 local filtered=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotFilteredScreen
 local filterAlpha=1-math.exp(-12.5*frameDt)
 filtered=filtered:Lerp(rawScreen,filterAlpha)
 Runtime.RivalsSlingshotFilteredScreen=filtered

 -- Low-frequency error envelope.  The target changes only every few tenths of a second
 -- and the live bias eases toward it; no frame gets an independent random offset.
 if now>=(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotBiasUntil)or 0)then
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotBiasTarget=Vector2.new(
   Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-10.0,10.0),
   Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-3.5,11.0)
  )
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotBiasUntil=now+Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.24,.46)
 end
 local bias=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotBias or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local biasTarget=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotBiasTarget or Vector2.new(0,0)
 bias=bias:Lerp(biasTarget,1-math.exp(-3.4*frameDt))
 Runtime.RivalsSlingshotBias=bias

 local desiredScreen=filtered+bias
 local error=desiredScreen-center
 local distance=error.Magnitude
 local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)

 if distance<.20 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=previous*math.exp(-5.5*frameDt)
  return
 end

 -- Far acquisition eats distance quickly; once close, target-velocity feed-forward and
 -- preserved cursor inertia dominate instead of snapping to the exact point.
 local farScale=math.clamp(distance/220,0,1)
 local gain=5.3+1.8*farScale
 local desiredVelocity=error*gain+targetVelocity*.10
 local maxSpeed=980+370*farScale
 if desiredVelocity.Magnitude>maxSpeed and desiredVelocity.Magnitude>0 then
  desiredVelocity=desiredVelocity.Unit*maxSpeed
 end

 local response=7.5+1.5*farScale
 local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,1-math.exp(-response*frameDt))
 local dv=velocity-previous
 local maxAccel=(4700+1900*farScale)*frameDt
 if dv.Magnitude>maxAccel and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxAccel end
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
 if velocity.Magnitude>45 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
  Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit
 end

 -- Do not clamp exactly onto the error vector.  Retaining a small amount of velocity
 -- through the target is what makes the correction look like a hand, not a coordinate lock.
 local step=velocity*frameDt
 local maxVisibleStep=math.clamp(8+distance*.032,8,21)
 if step.Magnitude>maxVisibleStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxVisibleStep end
 local overshootAllowance=math.min(4.0,1.5+previous.Magnitude*.0012)
 local maxTravel=distance+overshootAllowance
 if step.Magnitude>maxTravel and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxTravel end

 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
  local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
  if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
 elseif Camera then
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
 end
end

-- V45 stable non-sniper controller for Uncle/Custom.
-- Design goal: elite-human tracking WITHOUT manufactured wobble. The horizontal anchor
-- follows HumanoidRootPart instead of raw head animation, so idle/run head-bob cannot make
-- the crosshair wag left/right. Real target translation and direction changes are still followed.
-- V46 non-sniper intent model for Uncle/Custom.
-- One intent is chosen per real acquisition (not per frame), so chest/head variation never
-- becomes artificial wobble. Bomb-jump rifle sequences deliberately open on chest for two
-- accepted shots, then climb to the head line. A small minority of acquisitions graze the
-- head hitbox edge once, allowing a genuine miss before the correction.
function CVU_RIVALS_ResetStableGunIntent()
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentPlayer=nil
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentKind=nil
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode=nil
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunAcceptedShots=0
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunTransitionShots=1
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunEdgeSign=1
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunEdgeMissConsumed=false
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunAirLatched=false
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentStarted=0
end

function CVU_RIVALS_EnsureStableGunIntent(target,kind)
 if not target or not target.Player then return "head",0 end
 local localRoot=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local ownAir=hum and hum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air or false
 local ownVelocity=Vector3.zero
 if localRoot then pcall(function()ownVelocity=localRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)end
 if typeof(ownVelocity)~="Vector3"then ownVelocity=Vector3.zero end
 local bombAir=ownAir and(kind=="rifle"or kind=="burst")and(math.abs(ownVelocity.Y)>=24 or ownVelocity.Magnitude>=62)
 local changed=Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentPlayer~=target.Player or Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentKind~=kind or Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode==nil
 if changed then
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentKind=kind
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunAcceptedShots=0
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunTransitionShots=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextInteger(1,2)
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunEdgeSign=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()<.5 and -1 or 1
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunEdgeMissConsumed=false
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentStarted=os.clock()
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunAirLatched=bombAir==true
  if bombAir then
   Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="air_chest_to_head"
   Runtime.RivalsStableGunTransitionShots=2
  else
   local roll=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()
   if kind=="rifle"or kind=="burst"then
    if roll<.54 then Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="head"
    elseif roll<.82 then Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="chest_to_head"
    elseif roll<.92 then Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="chest"
    else Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="head_edge"end
   elseif kind=="revolver"or kind=="gun"or kind=="bow"then
    if roll<.64 then Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="head"
    elseif roll<.86 then Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="chest_to_head"
    elseif roll<.94 then Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="chest"
    else Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="head_edge"end
   elseif kind=="shotgun"then
    Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode=roll<.18 and"head"or(roll<.90 and"chest"or"chest_to_head")
   elseif kind=="launcher"then
    Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="chest"
   else
    Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="head"
   end
  end
 elseif bombAir and Runtime.RivalsStableGunAirLatched~=true then
  -- Entering a real mobility/bomb-jump after target acquisition starts a fresh two-shot
  -- chest catch. Do this once per airborne episode, never every render frame.
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="air_chest_to_head"
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunAcceptedShots=0
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunTransitionShots=2
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunEdgeMissConsumed=false
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentStarted=os.clock()
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunAirLatched=true
 elseif not ownAir then
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunAirLatched=false
 end
 return Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode or"head",tonumber(Runtime.RivalsStableGunAcceptedShots)or 0
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetStableGunPreferredPart(target,kind)
 if not target then return nil end
 local mode,shots=CVU_RIVALS_EnsureStableGunIntent(target,kind)
 local chest=target.Chest or target.TrackPart or target.Root or target.Head
 local head=target.Head or chest
 if mode=="chest"then return chest,"胸"end
 local age=os.clock()-(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentStarted)or os.clock())
 if mode=="air_chest_to_head"then
  -- Approximately the first two rifle rounds. The time cap also handles native hold-fire
  -- implementations that report only one StartShooting call for a whole automatic burst.
  if shots<2 and age<.24 then return chest,"胸"end
  return head,"頭"
 end
 if mode=="chest_to_head"then
  local need=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsStableGunTransitionShots)or 1,1,2)
  if shots<need and age<.19 then return chest,"胸"end
  return head,"頭"
 end
 return head,"頭"
end

function CVU_RIVALS_CommitStableGunShot(kind)
 if not CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(kind)then return end
 local style=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind)
 if style~="彈弓叔叔"and style~="自訂"then return end
 local target=Runtime.RivalsAimTarget
 if not target or not target.Player then return end
 CVU_RIVALS_EnsureStableGunIntent(target,kind)
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunAcceptedShots=(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsStableGunAcceptedShots)or 0)+1
 if Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode=="head_edge"then
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunEdgeMissConsumed=true
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunIntentMode="head"
 end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ShouldStableGunGrazeMiss(target,kind)
 if not target or not target.Head or not target.Head:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
 local mode=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_EnsureStableGunIntent(target,kind))
 if mode~="head_edge"or Runtime.RivalsStableGunEdgeMissConsumed==true then return false end
 local origin=Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or nil
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or not CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,target.Head)then return false end
 local contact=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(target.Head)
 -- Fire exactly once just outside the head OBB. Because the regular AimShotCandidate
 -- requires true Inside contact, this native shot is not silently redirected back into the head.
 return contact~=nil and contact.Inside~=true and contact.PixelDistance<=3.2
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetStableNonSniperAimWorld(target,kind,dt)
 if not target then return nil end
 local root=target.Root or target.Chest or target.Head or target.TrackPart
 local chest=target.Chest or root
 local head=target.Head or chest or root
 if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart")then return nil end
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local distance,closeWeight=CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local style=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyle()
 local customStyle=style=="自訂"
 local lockSmooth=.36
 if customStyle then
  local _,_,customLock=CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomDistanceTuning(target)
  lockSmooth=customLock or .36
 end

 local mode,shots=CVU_RIVALS_EnsureStableGunIntent(target,kind)
 local preferred,label=CVU_RIVALS_GetStableGunPreferredPart(target,kind)
 -- Keep horizontal tracking rooted to body translation. Only the vertical corridor and the
 -- rare edge-graze intent change; head animation itself never makes the reticle wag L-R.
 local yBlend=.90
 if label=="胸"then
  yBlend=(kind=="shotgun"or kind=="launcher")and .24 or .12
 elseif kind=="revolver"or kind=="gun"or kind=="bow"then
  yBlend=.92
 elseif kind=="rifle"or kind=="burst"then
  yBlend=.91+.04*closeWeight
 end
 local chestY=chest and chest.Position.Y or root.Position.Y+1.4
 local headY=head and head.Position.Y or chestY+1.25
 local targetY=chestY+(headY-chestY)*yBlend
 local raw=Vector3.new(root.Position.X,targetY,root.Position.Z)

 if mode=="head_edge"and Runtime.RivalsStableGunEdgeMissConsumed~=true and head and Camera then
  local right=Camera.CFrame.RightVector
  local flat=Vector3.new(right.X,0,right.Z)
  if flat.Magnitude>.001 then
   local edgeAmount=math.max(.18,head.Size.X*.56)
   raw+=flat.Unit*edgeAmount*(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsStableGunEdgeSign)or 1)
  end
 end

 -- Tiny physical lead only. This is derived from actual root velocity, not random bias.
 local linear=Vector3.zero
 pcall(function()linear=root.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
 if typeof(linear)~="Vector3"then linear=Vector3.zero end
 local leadTime=.007+.004*closeWeight
 if label=="胸"then leadTime*=.88 end
 raw+=Vector3.new(linear.X,0,linear.Z)*leadTime

 if Runtime.RivalsStableGunPlayer~=target.Player or Runtime.RivalsStableGunKind~=kind or typeof(Runtime.RivalsStableGunWorld)~="Vector3"then
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunKind=kind
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunWorld=raw
  return raw
 end

 local previous=Runtime.RivalsStableGunWorld
 local smoothness=customStyle and math.clamp(lockSmooth,.05,.95)or(.31-.12*closeWeight)
 local rate=20+(1-smoothness)*19+closeWeight*8
 if mode=="air_chest_to_head"and shots>=2 then rate*=1.16 end
 local alpha=1-math.exp(-rate*frameDt)
 local stable=previous:Lerp(raw,alpha)
 local delta=raw-previous
 local maxStep=math.max(.24,linear.Magnitude*frameDt*1.40+.16)
 if delta.Magnitude>4.5 then stable=raw
 elseif (stable-previous).Magnitude>maxStep and (stable-previous).Magnitude>0 then
  stable=previous+(stable-previous).Unit*maxStep
 end
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunWorld=stable
 return stable
end

function CVU_RIVALS_MoveStableNonSniperGun(target,kind,dt)
 if not Camera or not target then return false end
 local worldPos=CVU_RIVALS_GetStableNonSniperAimWorld(target,kind,dt)
 if typeof(worldPos)~="Vector3"then return false end
 local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not on or p.Z<=0 then return false end

 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local rawScreen=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)
 local distance,closeWeight=CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local customStyle=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyle()=="自訂"
 local lockSmooth=.36
 local trackSmooth=.38
 if customStyle then
  local _,_,a,b=CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomDistanceTuning(target)
  lockSmooth=a or lockSmooth
  trackSmooth=b or trackSmooth
 end

 if Runtime.RivalsStableGunPlayer~=target.Player
 or Runtime.RivalsStableGunKind~=kind
 or typeof(Runtime.RivalsStableGunRawScreen)~="Vector2"
 or typeof(Runtime.RivalsStableGunFilteredScreen)~="Vector2"then
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunKind=kind
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunRawScreen=rawScreen
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunFilteredScreen=rawScreen
  Runtime.RivalsStableGunTargetVelocity=Vector2.zero
  local carry=Runtime.RivalsUncleCarryVelocity
  if typeof(carry)=="Vector2"and carry.Magnitude>1 then
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=carry*.42
  else
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.zero)*.25
  end
  Runtime.RivalsUncleCarryVelocity=Vector2.zero
 end

 local oldRaw=Runtime.RivalsStableGunRawScreen
 local rawVelocity=(rawScreen-oldRaw)/frameDt
 if rawVelocity.Magnitude>3200 then rawVelocity=rawVelocity.Unit*3200 end
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunRawScreen=rawScreen

 local oldTV=Runtime.RivalsStableGunTargetVelocity or Vector2.zero
 -- Smooth target velocity enough to ignore animation/replication twitch, but react fast to
 -- a true strafe or mobility launch. No random noise and no synthetic alternating bias.
 local velocityRate=customStyle and(7+(1-trackSmooth)*9)or(10.5+4.5*closeWeight)
 local targetVelocity=oldTV:Lerp(rawVelocity,1-math.exp(-velocityRate*frameDt))
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunTargetVelocity=targetVelocity

 local filtered=Runtime.RivalsStableGunFilteredScreen
 local filterRate=customStyle and(15+(1-lockSmooth)*16)or(22+8*closeWeight)
 filtered=filtered:Lerp(rawScreen,1-math.exp(-filterRate*frameDt))
 Runtime.RivalsStableGunFilteredScreen=filtered

 local localRoot=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local ownAir=hum and hum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air or false
 local ownSpeed=localRoot and localRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude or 0
 local motionLoad=math.clamp(ownSpeed/100,0,1)

 -- Near target = stronger lock and less lead. Far target = a touch more predictive tracking.
 local leadTime=(.004+.006*(1-closeWeight))
 if ownAir then leadTime*=.82 end
 local desiredScreen=filtered+targetVelocity*leadTime
 local error=desiredScreen-center
 local pixelDistance=error.Magnitude
 local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.zero
 if pixelDistance<.30 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=previous*math.exp(-24*frameDt)
  return true
 end

 local tight=customStyle and(1-math.clamp(lockSmooth,.05,.95))or closeWeight
 local direct=customStyle and(1-math.clamp(trackSmooth,.05,.95))or closeWeight
 local gain=(8.2+3.2*tight)+math.clamp(pixelDistance/260,0,1)*2.2
 local feedScale=.055+.035*direct
 if pixelDistance<14 then feedScale*=math.clamp(pixelDistance/14,.12,1)end
 local desiredVelocity=error*gain+targetVelocity*feedScale
 local maxSpeed=(1550+650*tight)+math.clamp(pixelDistance/240,0,1)*520
 if kind=="revolver"or kind=="gun"then maxSpeed*=1.06 end
 if kind=="shotgun"then maxSpeed*=1.10 end
 if desiredVelocity.Magnitude>maxSpeed then desiredVelocity=desiredVelocity.Unit*maxSpeed end

 -- Critical damping near the target: if old hand velocity has already crossed the target,
 -- brake immediately instead of letting it travel through and then swing back the other way.
 if previous.Magnitude>1 and error.Magnitude>0 and previous:Dot(error)<0 then
  previous*=math.exp(-26*frameDt)
 end
 local response=(12.5+6.5*tight)*(customStyle and(1.10-.32*trackSmooth)or 1)
 local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,1-math.exp(-response*frameDt))
 local dv=velocity-previous
 local maxAccel=(10800+5200*tight)*(ownAir and .78 or(1-.10*motionLoad))*frameDt
 if dv.Magnitude>maxAccel and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxAccel end
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
 if velocity.Magnitude>45 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
  Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit
 end

 local step=velocity*frameDt
 local maxVisibleStep=(13+math.clamp(pixelDistance*.052,0,20))*(1+.14*tight)
 if ownAir then maxVisibleStep*=.94 end
 if step.Magnitude>maxVisibleStep then step=step.Unit*maxVisibleStep end
 -- V45 deliberately forbids synthetic pass-through on non-snipers. A real target reversal
 -- can still create tracking lag, but the controller itself will not manufacture L-R-L sway.
 if step.Magnitude>pixelDistance then step=error end
 if pixelDistance<1.25 then step=error end

 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
  local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
  if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
 else
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
 end
 return pixelDistance<=2.0
end

-- V39 Uncle Slingshot rifle / Burst Rifle controller.
-- Goal from the 22-video sample: human-limit speed, not magnetic certainty.
-- Error comes from real motion causes (target reversal, own air movement, retained hand
-- velocity), never from per-frame random jitter.
function CVU_RIVALS_MoveUncleSlingshotRifle(target,worldPos,dt)
 if not Camera or not target or typeof(worldPos)~="Vector3"then return end
 local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not on or p.Z<=0 then return end
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local rawScreen=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)
 local player=target.Player
 local now=os.clock()
 local playerDistance,closeWeight=CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local customStyle=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyle()=="自訂"
 local customLockSmooth,customTrackSmooth=nil,nil
 if customStyle then
  local customDistance,customTier
  customDistance,customTier,customLockSmooth,customTrackSmooth=CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomDistanceTuning(target)
  playerDistance=customDistance
 end

 if Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleTrackPlayer~=player
 or typeof(Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleFilteredScreen)~="Vector2"
 or typeof(Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleRawScreen)~="Vector2"then
  Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleTrackPlayer=player
  Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleFilteredScreen=rawScreen
  Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleRawScreen=rawScreen
  Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleTargetVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleDisturbedUntil=0
  local carry=Runtime.RivalsUncleCarryVelocity
  if typeof(carry)=="Vector2"and carry.Magnitude>1 then
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=carry
  end
  Runtime.RivalsUncleCarryVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 end

 local previousRaw=Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleRawScreen
 local rawTargetVelocity=(rawScreen-previousRaw)/frameDt
 if rawTargetVelocity.Magnitude>3300 and rawTargetVelocity.Magnitude>0 then
  rawTargetVelocity=rawTargetVelocity.Unit*3300
 end
 Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleRawScreen=rawScreen

 local oldTargetVelocity=Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleTargetVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 -- Sudden strafe reversal / vertical pop causes a short disturbed-track window.  This is
 -- the video-observed "lag then rescue", not a fabricated random miss.
 if rawTargetVelocity.Magnitude>170 and oldTargetVelocity.Magnitude>170 then
  local reversal=rawTargetVelocity.Unit:Dot(oldTargetVelocity.Unit)
  local accel=(rawTargetVelocity-oldTargetVelocity).Magnitude
  if reversal<-.18 or accel>1850 then
   Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleDisturbedUntil=math.max(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleDisturbedUntil)or 0,now+(.055*(customStyle and(.55+.45*(customLockSmooth or .36))or(1-.28*closeWeight))))
  end
 end
 local customTight=customStyle and(1-math.clamp(customLockSmooth or .36,.05,.95))or nil
 local customDirect=customStyle and(1-math.clamp(customTrackSmooth or .38,.05,.95))or nil
 local distanceBoost=customStyle and customTight or closeWeight
 local velocityRate=customStyle and(5.0+4.8*customDirect+3.0*customTight)or(7.1+2.7*closeWeight)
 local velocityAlpha=1-math.exp(-velocityRate*frameDt)
 local targetVelocity=oldTargetVelocity:Lerp(rawTargetVelocity,velocityAlpha)
 Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleTargetVelocity=targetVelocity

 local filtered=Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleFilteredScreen
 local filterRate=customStyle and(8.0+9.0*customDirect+8.0*customTight)or(14.0+6.5*closeWeight)
 filtered=filtered:Lerp(rawScreen,1-math.exp(-filterRate*frameDt))
 Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleFilteredScreen=filtered

 local localRoot=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local ownAir=hum and hum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air or false
 local ownSpeed=localRoot and localRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude or 0
 local disturbed=now<(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleDisturbedUntil)or 0)
 local motionLoad=math.clamp(ownSpeed/95,0,1)
 local closeGain=customStyle and(.86+.95*customTight)or(1+.34*closeWeight)
 local closeSpeed=customStyle and(.92+.58*customTight)or(1+.22*closeWeight)
 local closeResponse=customStyle and((.94+.88*customTight)*(1.16-.42*(customTrackSmooth or .38)))or(1+.34*closeWeight)
 local closeAccel=customStyle and(.92+.88*customTight)or(1+.40*closeWeight)
 local closeOvershoot=customStyle and(.34+.66*(customLockSmooth or .36))or(1-.48*closeWeight)

 -- Only a tiny lead is allowed.  The target can reverse before the filtered velocity does,
 -- which creates the same short tracking lag seen in the videos.
 local leadTime=disturbed and .006 or(.014+.006*(1-motionLoad))
 local desiredScreen=filtered+targetVelocity*leadTime
 local error=desiredScreen-center
 local distance=error.Magnitude
 local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)

 if distance<.28 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=previous*math.exp(-(disturbed and 5.0 or 7.5)*frameDt)
  return
 end

 local farScale=math.clamp(distance/230,0,1)
 local gain=((disturbed and 5.7 or 7.4)+(disturbed and 1.0 or 2.0)*farScale)*closeGain
 local feed=targetVelocity*(disturbed and(.045+.020*distanceBoost)or(.105+.055*distanceBoost))
 local desiredVelocity=error*gain+feed
 local maxSpeed=((disturbed and 1180 or 1460)+(disturbed and 360 or 610)*farScale)*closeSpeed
 if ownAir then maxSpeed*=.94 end
 if desiredVelocity.Magnitude>maxSpeed and desiredVelocity.Magnitude>0 then
  desiredVelocity=desiredVelocity.Unit*maxSpeed
 end

 local response=((disturbed and 7.1 or 9.4)+(disturbed and .7 or 1.3)*farScale)*closeResponse
 local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,1-math.exp(-response*frameDt))
 local dv=velocity-previous
 local baseAccel=((disturbed and 5600 or 8200)+(disturbed and 1300 or 2200)*farScale)*closeAccel
 -- Airborne / bomb-jump movement keeps more of the previous mouse vector instead of
 -- allowing an impossible one-frame vertical snap.
 local accelScale=ownAir and .70 or(1-.18*motionLoad)
 local maxDv=baseAccel*accelScale*frameDt
 if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
 if velocity.Magnitude>45 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
  Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit
 end

 local step=velocity*frameDt
 local maxVisibleStep=math.clamp(11+distance*.045,11,29)*(1+.12*distanceBoost)
 if ownAir then maxVisibleStep*=.93 end
 if step.Magnitude>maxVisibleStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxVisibleStep end
 -- Do not clamp to the target point.  A little travel-through is the natural overshoot
 -- caused by retained hand velocity; the next frames perform the elite-human correction.
 local overshootAllowance=math.min(6.5,1.8+previous.Magnitude*.0018)*closeOvershoot
 local maxTravel=distance+overshootAllowance
 if step.Magnitude>maxTravel and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxTravel end

 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
  local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
  if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
 elseif Camera then
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
 end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_MoveAimToward(worldPos,dt,fast,sniperFlick)
 if not Camera or typeof(worldPos)~="Vector3"then return end
 local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not on or p.Z<=0 then return end
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local delta=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)-center
 local distance=delta.Magnitude
 if distance<.35 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*math.exp(-16*frameDt)
  return
 end

 -- V19 sniper flick: still acceleration-limited (not a teleport), but dramatically faster
 -- once the 0.5-0.6 s reaction and native scope-focus gates are both satisfied.
 local gain=sniperFlick and 26.0 or(fast and 8.5 or 5.0)
 local maxSpeed=sniperFlick and 6200 or(fast and 2150 or 690)
 local desiredSpeed=math.min(maxSpeed,distance*gain)
 local desiredVelocity=delta.Unit*desiredSpeed
 local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local velocity=previous
 local response=sniperFlick and 30.0 or(fast and 11.0 or 7.2)
 local blend=1-math.exp(-response*frameDt)
 velocity=velocity:Lerp(desiredVelocity,blend)

 local maxAccel=sniperFlick and 52000 or(fast and 9200 or 3300)
 local dv=velocity-previous
 local maxDv=maxAccel*frameDt
 if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
 if (fast or sniperFlick)and velocity.Magnitude>45 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
  Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit
 end

 local step=velocity*frameDt
 local nearScale=sniperFlick and math.clamp(distance/90,.82,1)or math.clamp(distance/42,.28,1)
 step*=nearScale
 if step.Magnitude>distance then step=delta end
 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
  local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
  if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
 else
  local desired=CFrame.lookAt(Camera.CFrame.Position,worldPos)
  local rate=sniperFlick and 26.0 or(fast and 9.5 or 4.8)
  local alpha=1-math.exp(-rate*frameDt)
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame:Lerp(desired,alpha)
 end
end

-- Stabilize the world-space aim point used by precision flicks.  RIVALS character
-- replication/animation can move a head hitbox a few pixels back and forth between
-- render frames; following that raw sample directly makes the cursor visibly twitch.
-- Keep a fast low-pass track with a tiny velocity lead so a genuinely moving player
-- still gets followed without inheriting one-frame network/animation noise.
function CVU_RIVALS_GetStablePrecisionWorld(part,dt)
 if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return nil end
 Runtime.RivalsAimStablePartWorld=Runtime.RivalsAimStablePartWorld or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 local states=Runtime.RivalsAimStablePartWorld
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local raw=part.Position
 local state=states[part]
 local velocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
 pcall(function()velocity=part.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)
 if typeof(velocity)~="Vector3"then velocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)end

 if not state or typeof(state.Pos)~="Vector3"or(raw-state.Pos).Magnitude>7 then
  state={Pos=raw}
  states[part]=state
  return raw
 end

 local predicted=raw+velocity*math.min(.022,frameDt*1.25)
 local error=predicted-state.Pos
 -- Ignore microscopic single-frame motion; it is usually head-bob/replication noise,
 -- not meaningful target travel.
 if error.Magnitude<.035 then return state.Pos end

 local alpha=1-math.exp(-24*frameDt)
 local desired=state.Pos:Lerp(predicted,alpha)
 local move=desired-state.Pos
 local maxStep=math.max(.16,velocity.Magnitude*frameDt*1.55+.10)
 if move.Magnitude>maxStep and move.Magnitude>0 then desired=state.Pos+move.Unit*maxStep end
 state.Pos=desired
 return desired
end

function CVU_RIVALS_BeginSniperHumanShot(target,targetPart)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPlayer=target and target.Player or nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPart=targetPart
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanSideBias=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-8,8)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanSpeedScale=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.92,1.07)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanMicroGap=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(16,28)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanMicroSide=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-4.5,4.5)
 local canNearHeadMicro=target and target.Head and targetPart==target.Head
 local roll=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()
 if canNearHeadMicro and roll<.34 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanVariant="near_micro"
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPhase="approach"
 else
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanVariant="direct"
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPhase="main"
 end
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPhaseStarted=os.clock()
end

-- V37 Slingshot-only sniper controller.
-- SWit sniper and Crossbow still use CVU_RIVALS_MoveSniperTopDown unchanged.
-- This path models two common human-looking finishes selected once per shot:
-- 1) fast flick -> tiny settle/pause -> correction, or
-- 2) fast flick -> genuine overshoot -> brake -> counter-correction.
-- V39 Uncle Slingshot sniper controller built from the 22-video sample:
-- visual pre-aim -> explosive flick -> brake -> assess -> micro-correct.  It can miss the
-- first alignment and recover very quickly; it never manufactures a random per-frame wobble.
function CVU_RIVALS_MoveUncleSlingshotSniper(target,dt,targetPart)
 if not Camera or not target then return false end
 targetPart=targetPart or target.Head or target.Chest or target.TrackPart
 if not targetPart or not targetPart:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local worldPos=nil
 local solution=nil
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(targetPart)then
  worldPos,solution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
 else
  worldPos=CVU_RIVALS_GetStablePrecisionWorld(targetPart,frameDt)or targetPart.Position
 end
 if not worldPos then return false end
 local point,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not on or point.Z<=0 then return false end
 local screen=Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)
 local delta=screen-center
 local threshold=solution and(solution.Mode=="center"and 5.0 or 7.5)or 7.0
 local now=os.clock()
 local playerDistance,closeWeight=CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target)
 local customStyle=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyle()=="自訂"
 local customLockSmooth,customTrackSmooth=nil,nil
 if customStyle then
  local customDistance,customTier
  customDistance,customTier,customLockSmooth,customTrackSmooth=CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomDistanceTuning(target)
  playerDistance=customDistance
 end

 if Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPlayer~=target.Player
 or Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPart~=targetPart
 or not Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhase then
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPart=targetPart
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhase="flick"
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhaseStarted=now
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperInitialDistance=delta.Magnitude
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperRawScreen=screen
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperTargetVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  local initialDir=delta.Magnitude>.5 and delta.Unit or(Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection or Vector2.new(1,0))
  if initialDir.Magnitude<=.001 then initialDir=Vector2.new(1,0)end
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperInitialDirection=initialDir.Unit
  local carry=Runtime.RivalsUncleCarryVelocity
  if typeof(carry)=="Vector2"and carry.Magnitude>1 then Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=carry end
  Runtime.RivalsUncleCarryVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 end

 local previousRaw=Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperRawScreen
 local rawTargetVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 if typeof(previousRaw)=="Vector2"then rawTargetVelocity=(screen-previousRaw)/frameDt end
 if rawTargetVelocity.Magnitude>3000 and rawTargetVelocity.Magnitude>0 then rawTargetVelocity=rawTargetVelocity.Unit*3000 end
 Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperRawScreen=screen
 local oldTargetVelocity=Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperTargetVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local customTight=customStyle and(1-math.clamp(customLockSmooth or .36,.05,.95))or nil
 local customDirect=customStyle and(1-math.clamp(customTrackSmooth or .38,.05,.95))or nil
 local distanceBoost=customStyle and customTight or closeWeight
 local sniperVelocityRate=customStyle and(4.8+4.5*customDirect+2.8*customTight)or(6.4+2.8*closeWeight)
 local targetVelocity=oldTargetVelocity:Lerp(rawTargetVelocity,1-math.exp(-sniperVelocityRate*frameDt))
 Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperTargetVelocity=targetVelocity

 if delta.Magnitude<=threshold then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*math.exp(-20*frameDt)
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
  return true
 end

 local phase=Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhase or"flick"
 local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local localRoot=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 local hum=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local ownAir=hum and hum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air or false
 local ownSpeed=localRoot and localRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude or 0
 local motionLoad=math.clamp(ownSpeed/100,0,1)
 -- V44: fast vertical / mobility launches demand an immediate human commit rather than
 -- waiting for the ordinary tracking filter to catch up over several frames.
 local targetRoot=target.Root or target.Chest or target.Head
 local targetLinear=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
 if targetRoot and targetRoot:IsA("BasePart")then pcall(function()targetLinear=targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity end)end
 local mobilityBoost=math.clamp(math.max(math.abs(targetLinear.Y)-28,targetLinear.Magnitude-70)/75,0,1)
 local customCrosshairScale=customStyle and select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomCrosshairLockSpeed(delta.Magnitude))or 1
 local customResponseScale=math.clamp(.68+.32*customCrosshairScale,.78,1.24)
 local closeFlick=(customStyle and(.94+.50*customTight)or(1+.20*closeWeight))*(1+.24*mobilityBoost)*customCrosshairScale
 local closeCorrection=(customStyle and(.88+.92*customTight)or(1+.38*closeWeight))*(1+.20*mobilityBoost)*customCrosshairScale
 local closeBrake=customStyle and(.90+.78*customTight)or(1+.30*closeWeight)
 local closeAccel=(customStyle and(.92+.82*customTight)or(1+.32*closeWeight))*(1+.28*mobilityBoost)*customResponseScale
 local closeOvershoot=customStyle and(.30+.70*(customLockSmooth or .36))or(1-.52*closeWeight)

 if phase=="flick"then
  -- Preserve old hand velocity.  The new target pulls on that vector instead of replacing it,
  -- so high/low targets during jumps trace a diagonal arc rather than a robotic vertical line.
  local distance=delta.Magnitude
  local desiredVelocity=delta*(math.clamp(13.5+distance*.018,13.5,19.0)*closeFlick)+targetVelocity*(.055+.035*distanceBoost)
  local maxSpeed=math.clamp(2550+distance*3.0,2550,3600)*(1+.14*distanceBoost)
  if ownAir then maxSpeed*=.94 end
  if desiredVelocity.Magnitude>maxSpeed and desiredVelocity.Magnitude>0 then desiredVelocity=desiredVelocity.Unit*maxSpeed end
  local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,1-math.exp(-(18.0+5.0*distanceBoost)*frameDt))
  local dv=velocity-previous
  local maxAccel=(ownAir and 15500 or 21500)*(1-.12*motionLoad)*closeAccel*frameDt
  if dv.Magnitude>maxAccel and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxAccel end
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
  if velocity.Magnitude>45 then Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit end

  local step=velocity*frameDt
  local maxStep=math.clamp(17+distance*.042,17,34)*(1+.10*distanceBoost)
  if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
  local maxTravel=distance+math.min(7.0,2.0+previous.Magnitude*.0017)*closeOvershoot
  if step.Magnitude>maxTravel and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxTravel end
  if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
   local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
   local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
   if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
  elseif Camera then
   Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
  end

  -- Re-sample after the visible move.  A near arrival begins braking; actually passing the
  -- original flick direction also counts, creating natural overshoot without a random offset.
  local nextWorld=CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(targetPart)and select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position))or(CVU_RIVALS_GetStablePrecisionWorld(targetPart,frameDt)or targetPart.Position)
  if nextWorld then
   local np,non=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(nextWorld)
   if non and np.Z>0 then
    local afterDelta=Vector2.new(np.X,np.Y)-center
    local initialDir=Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperInitialDirection or Vector2.new(1,0)
    if afterDelta.Magnitude<=math.max(12,threshold+5)or afterDelta:Dot(initialDir)<-3 then
     Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhase="brake"
     Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhaseStarted=now
     Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity*.58
    end
   end
  end
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end

 if phase=="brake"then
  local elapsed=now-(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhaseStarted)or now)
  local initialDistance=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperInitialDistance)or 0
  local brakeTime=math.clamp(.012+initialDistance/18000,.012,.030)/(1+.22*distanceBoost)
  local velocity=previous*math.exp(-(18*closeBrake)*frameDt)
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
  local step=velocity*frameDt
  if step.Magnitude>4.5 and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*4.5 end
  if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
   local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
   local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
   if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
  elseif Camera then
   Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
  end
  if elapsed>=brakeTime then
   Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhase="correct"
   Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhaseStarted=now
  end
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end

 -- Correct / hold-scope phase.  When the initial flick was already excellent this lasts only
 -- a frame or two; large residual error or target motion naturally produces the longer scoped
 -- micro-adjust rhythm visible in several recordings.
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(targetPart)then
  worldPos,solution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
 else
  worldPos=CVU_RIVALS_GetStablePrecisionWorld(targetPart,frameDt)or targetPart.Position
  solution=nil
 end
 if not worldPos then return false end
 point,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not on or point.Z<=0 then return false end
 screen=Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)
 delta=screen-center
 threshold=solution and(solution.Mode=="center"and 5.0 or 7.5)or 7.0
 if delta.Magnitude<=threshold then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.18
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
  return true
 end

 -- If the opponent makes a violent move during correction, do not instantly know the new
 -- answer.  Re-enter a restrained flick after a brief human correction interval.
 if targetVelocity.Magnitude>1450 and delta.Magnitude>55 and now-(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhaseStarted)or now)>.045 then
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhase="flick"
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhaseStarted=now
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperInitialDistance=delta.Magnitude
  Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperInitialDirection=delta.Unit
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end

 local desiredVelocity=delta*(math.clamp(10.5+delta.Magnitude*.045,10.5,15.5)*closeCorrection)+targetVelocity*(.035+.030*distanceBoost)
 local maxSpeed=math.clamp(1350+delta.Magnitude*5.0,1350,2300)*(1+.24*distanceBoost)
