 if desiredVelocity.Magnitude>maxSpeed and desiredVelocity.Magnitude>0 then desiredVelocity=desiredVelocity.Unit*maxSpeed end
 previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,1-math.exp(-(13.5*closeCorrection)*frameDt))
 local dv=velocity-previous
 local maxDv=(ownAir and 10500 or 14500)*closeAccel*frameDt
 if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
 local step=velocity*frameDt
 local maxStep=math.clamp(8+delta.Magnitude*.075,8,16)*(1+.16*distanceBoost)
 if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
 local correctionOvershoot=2.5*closeOvershoot
 if step.Magnitude>delta.Magnitude+correctionOvershoot and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*(delta.Magnitude+correctionOvershoot)end
 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
  local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
  if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
 elseif Camera then
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
 end
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
 return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItSniperMissOffset(targetPart,initialDir,initialDistance)
 if not Camera or not targetPart or not targetPart:IsA("BasePart")then return Vector2.new(7,0)end
 local cp,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
 if not on or cp.Z<=0 then return Vector2.new(7,0)end
 local centerScreen=Vector2.new(cp.X,cp.Y)
 local radius=4
 local halfX=targetPart.Size.X*.52
 local halfY=targetPart.Size.Y*.52
 local offsets={
  targetPart.CFrame.RightVector*halfX,
  -targetPart.CFrame.RightVector*halfX,
  targetPart.CFrame.UpVector*halfY,
  -targetPart.CFrame.UpVector*halfY,
 }
 for _,worldOffset in ipairs(offsets)do
  local p,ok=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position+worldOffset)
  if ok and p.Z>0 then radius=math.max(radius,(Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)-centerScreen).Magnitude)end
 end
 local dir=initialDir and initialDir.Magnitude>.001 and initialDir.Unit or Vector2.new(1,0)
 local perp=Vector2.new(-dir.Y,dir.X)
 if perp.Magnitude<=.001 then perp=Vector2.new(0,1)else perp=perp.Unit end
 local sign=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()<.5 and-1 or 1
 local distanceMargin=math.clamp(math.sqrt(math.max(tonumber(initialDistance)or 0,0))*.18,1.5,4.5)
 return perp*(radius+2.2+distanceMargin)*sign
end

function CVU_RIVALS_MoveSlingshotSniper(target,dt,targetPart)
 if not Camera or not target then return false end
 targetPart=targetPart or target.Head
 if not targetPart or not targetPart:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
 if not target.Head or targetPart~=target.Head or not CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(targetPart)then
  return CVU_RIVALS_MoveSniperTopDown(target,dt,targetPart,"sniper")
 end

 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local worldPos,solution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
 if not worldPos or not solution then return false end
 local hp,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not on or hp.Z<=0 then return false end
 local headScreen=Vector2.new(hp.X,hp.Y)
 local headDelta=headScreen-center
 local threshold=solution.Mode=="center"and 3.5 or 3.8

 if Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPlayer~=target.Player
 or Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPart~=targetPart
 or not Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperVariant then
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPart=targetPart
  local initialDir=headDelta.Magnitude>.5 and headDelta.Unit or(Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection or Vector2.new(1,0))
  if initialDir.Magnitude<=.001 then initialDir=Vector2.new(1,0)end
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperDirection=initialDir.Unit
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperInitialDistance=headDelta.Magnitude

  -- V55 SWit personality: synthetic overshoot is secondary; shot accuracy is world-distance limited.
  -- Long-distance overshoot comes primarily from real flick velocity + post-shot carry.
  local syntheticOvershootChance=headDelta.Magnitude>=280 and .08 or .18
  local overshootVariant=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()<syntheticOvershootChance
  local autoFireEnabled=type(CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled)=="function"and CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled()==true
  local plannedFail=false
  -- V55 distance-limited SWIt accuracy.  Do NOT make a far enemy magically easier just
  -- because its head is close to the crosshair.  Auto-fire rolls one human accuracy decision
  -- per sniper shot from actual player-to-player world distance.  At extreme range, only
  -- roughly 70-80% of shots are allowed to resolve as clean headshots.
  if autoFireEnabled then
   local shotWorldDistance,shotTier,_,_,successMin,successMax=CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItWorldDistanceProfile(target)
   local successChance=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(successMin,successMax)
   plannedFail=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()>successChance
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperShotWorldDistance=shotWorldDistance
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperShotDistanceTier=shotTier
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperShotSuccessChance=successChance
  else
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperShotWorldDistance=nil
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperShotDistanceTier=nil
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperShotSuccessChance=nil
  end
  if overshootVariant then
   Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperVariant=plannedFail and"overshoot_fail"or"overshoot"
  else
   Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperVariant=plannedFail and"direct_fail"or"direct"
  end
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase="flick"
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperSpeedScale=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.98,1.10)

  -- V57 dual-distance profile: sample once for this shot.  Screen distance still supplies the
  -- large-flick amplitude below.  World distance only changes how much speed is carried into
  -- the final approach, where the apparent head size actually matters to a human player.
  local kinWorldDistance,kinAggression,kinBrakeStart,kinFineScale,kinTier=CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItAimKinematicProfile(target)
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperKinematicWorldDistance=kinWorldDistance
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperWorldAggression=kinAggression*Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.985,1.015)
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperWorldBrakeStart=kinBrakeStart*Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.94,1.06)
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperWorldFineScale=kinFineScale*Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.985,1.015)
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperKinematicTier=kinTier

  -- V50 SWIt overshoot: the cursor no longer aims at a fixed fake point far beyond the head.
  -- Store only a modest momentum-carry budget plus a tiny lateral hand error.  The visible
  -- overshoot is then created by the existing flick velocity carrying through the head line,
  -- which avoids the robotic "go to overshoot point -> stop -> come back" shape.
  local distance01=math.clamp(headDelta.Magnitude/320,0,1)
  local amount=0
  local side=0
  if overshootVariant then
   amount=(3.0+11.5*(distance01^.72))*Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.78,1.22)
   side=amount*Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-.16,.16)
  end
  local perpendicular=Vector2.new(-initialDir.Y,initialDir.X)
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperOvershoot=initialDir*amount+perpendicular*side
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissOffset=plannedFail and CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItSniperMissOffset(targetPart,initialDir,headDelta.Magnitude)or Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPauseUntil=0
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperTargetMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperMoveSamples=0
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperReversalUntil=0
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperReversalDirection=Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperReversalSpeedScale=1
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperLastReversalAt=0
Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimChecked=false
Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimRemaining=Vector2.new(0,0)
Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimUntil=0
Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimLead=0
Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimSpeedScale=1
  Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughMinDistance=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(280,320)
  Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughPending=false
  Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughDuration=0
  Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughRetain=.65
  Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingUntil=0
  Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPlayer=nil
  Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPart=nil
 end

 -- V65 Anti-Katana V2 SWit controller.
 -- During the real frontal Deflect window, do not stare at head center and do not fire.
 -- Move decisively to a stable point just beside the head.  The instant the effective window
 -- ends (or our angle becomes rear-safe), snap back to the live safe head solution for a short
 -- cooldown-punish burst.  This is visible cursor motion, not a redirected bullet.
 local katanaDanger=target.Player and CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(target.Player)or false
 local katanaPhase,katanaState=target.Player and CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaDeflectPhase(target.Player)or"ready",nil
 if target.Player then
  local phase,state=CVU_RIVALS_GetKatanaDeflectPhase(target.Player)
  katanaPhase,katanaState=phase,state
 end
 local katanaNow=os.clock()
 if katanaDanger then
  local state=katanaState
  if state and state.HoldSide==nil then
   local x=headScreen.X-center.X
   if math.abs(x)>=2 then state.HoldSide=x>=0 and -1 or 1
   else state.HoldSide=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()<.5 and -1 or 1 end
  end
  local side=(state and state.HoldSide)or 1
  local holdPixels=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaHoldPixels)or 16,10,26)
  local holdPoint=headScreen+Vector2.new(side*holdPixels,0)
  local holdDelta=holdPoint-center

  Runtime.RivalsSWItKatanaHoldPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsSWItKatanaPunishUntil=0
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase="katana_hold"
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
  CVU_RIVALS_ClearSniperFireLatch()

  if holdDelta.Magnitude>1.25 then
   local desiredSpeed=math.min(5200,holdDelta.Magnitude*42)
   local desired=holdDelta.Unit*desiredSpeed
   local prior=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
   if prior.Magnitude>1 and prior.Unit:Dot(desired.Unit)<0 then prior=prior*.14 end
   local velocity=prior:Lerp(desired,1-math.exp(-45*frameDt))
   local dv=velocity-prior
   local maxDv=70000*frameDt
   if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=prior+dv.Unit*maxDv end
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
   if velocity.Magnitude>45 then
    Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
    Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit
   end
   local step=velocity*frameDt
   local maxStep=math.clamp(20+holdDelta.Magnitude*.16,20,36)
   if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
   if step.Magnitude>holdDelta.Magnitude then step=holdDelta end
   if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
    local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
    local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
    if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
   elseif Camera then
    Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
   end
  else
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.35
  end
  return false
 elseif Runtime.RivalsSWItKatanaHoldPlayer==target.Player then
  -- Deflect just became shootable: no second human reaction delay.  Use a brief aggressive
  -- return-to-head controller, then hand control back to the ordinary SWit state machine.
  Runtime.RivalsSWItKatanaHoldPlayer=nil
  Runtime.RivalsSWItKatanaPunishUntil=katanaNow+.115
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.22
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase="katana_punish"
 end

 if katanaNow<(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItKatanaPunishUntil)or 0)then
  local liveWorld,liveSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
  if liveWorld and liveSolution then
   local kp,kon=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(liveWorld)
   if kon and kp.Z>0 then
    local liveDelta=Vector2.new(kp.X,kp.Y)-center
    local liveThreshold=liveSolution.Mode=="center"and 3.5 or 3.8
    if liveDelta.Magnitude<=liveThreshold then
     Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.08
     Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
     return true
    end
    local desiredSpeed=math.min(5600,liveDelta.Magnitude*48)
    local desired=liveDelta.Unit*desiredSpeed
    local prior=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
    local velocity=prior:Lerp(desired,1-math.exp(-48*frameDt))
    local dv=velocity-prior
    local maxDv=76000*frameDt
    if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=prior+dv.Unit*maxDv end
    Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
    Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
    if velocity.Magnitude>45 then Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit end
    local step=velocity*frameDt
    local maxStep=math.clamp(24+liveDelta.Magnitude*.18,24,38)
    if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
    if step.Magnitude>liveDelta.Magnitude then step=liveDelta end
    if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
     local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
     local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
     if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
    elseif Camera then
     Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
    end
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
    return false
   end
  end
 end

 -- V52 SWIt sudden reversal flick.  Read the enemy's actual character velocity in camera-space
 -- instead of inferring it from cursor error, so our own camera motion cannot manufacture a fake
 -- reversal.  Dot-product detection is rotationally symmetric: L<->R, UL<->DR and UR<->DL
 -- all trigger through the same rule when the new movement vector is nearly opposite the old one.
 local reversalNow=os.clock()
 local motionPart=target.TrackPart
 if not motionPart and target.Character then motionPart=target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")end
 if not motionPart then motionPart=targetPart end
 local currentMove=Vector2.new(0,0)
 local worldDistance=math.huge
 if motionPart and motionPart:IsA("BasePart")then
  worldDistance=(motionPart.Position-Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
  local velocity3=motionPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  if typeof(velocity3)=="Vector3"then
   currentMove=Vector2.new(velocity3:Dot(Camera.CFrame.RightVector),-velocity3:Dot(Camera.CFrame.UpVector))
  end
 end
 local oldMove=Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperTargetMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local samples=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperMoveSamples)or 0
 local currentMag=currentMove.Magnitude
 local oldMag=oldMove.Magnitude
 local midNear=worldDistance>=15 and worldDistance<=55
 local lastReversal=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperLastReversalAt)or 0
 if midNear and samples>=2 and oldMag>=5.0 and currentMag>=6.0 and reversalNow-lastReversal>=.13 then
  local directionDot=oldMove.Unit:Dot(currentMove.Unit)
  -- <= -0.55 means roughly 123 degrees or more of direction change.  It catches genuine
  -- counter-strafes while ignoring ordinary curves, head-bob and small diagonal corrections.
  if directionDot<=-.55 then
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperReversalUntil=reversalNow+Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.033,.067)
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperReversalDirection=currentMove.Unit
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperReversalSpeedScale=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.98,1.08)
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperLastReversalAt=reversalNow
   Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase="reversal"
   -- Throw away most of the stale hand momentum from the old direction.  Do not zero it: the
   -- remaining 8-18% creates the tiny visible brake before the explosive human correction.
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.08,.18)
  end
 end
 -- Keep a short memory of the previous genuine travel direction.  The current frame is compared
 -- against the OLD filtered direction above; only afterwards do we learn the new one.
 if currentMag>=1.0 then
  local motionAlpha=1-math.exp(-9.5*frameDt)
  oldMove=oldMove:Lerp(currentMove,motionAlpha)
 else
  oldMove=oldMove*math.exp(-7.5*frameDt)
 end
 Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperTargetMoveVelocity=oldMove
 Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperMoveSamples=math.min(samples+1,120)

 if reversalNow<(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperReversalUntil)or 0)then
  -- A reversal is not a teleport.  For 33-67 ms we run a very high-response short flick and
  -- still move through visible mouse steps.  As soon as the live head solution is reached,
  -- hand control yields immediately to the normal fire latch/auto-fire path.
  local liveWorld,liveSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
  if liveWorld and liveSolution then
   local rp,ron=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(liveWorld)
   if ron and rp.Z>0 then
    local liveDelta=Vector2.new(rp.X,rp.Y)-center
    local liveThreshold=liveSolution.Mode=="center"and 3.5 or 3.8
    if liveDelta.Magnitude<=liveThreshold then
     Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.08
     Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
     Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
     return true
    end
    local reversalScale=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperReversalSpeedScale)or 1,.96,1.10)
    local desiredSpeed=math.min(5400*reversalScale,liveDelta.Magnitude*44*reversalScale)
    local desiredVelocity=liveDelta.Magnitude>.001 and liveDelta.Unit*desiredSpeed or Vector2.new(0,0)
    local prior=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
    if prior.Magnitude>1 and desiredVelocity.Magnitude>1 and prior.Unit:Dot(desiredVelocity.Unit)<0 then
     prior=prior*.10
    end
    local velocity=prior:Lerp(desiredVelocity,1-math.exp(-46*frameDt))
    local dv=velocity-prior
    local maxDv=68000*frameDt
    if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=prior+dv.Unit*maxDv end
    Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
    Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
    if velocity.Magnitude>45 then Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit end
    local step=velocity*frameDt
    local maxStep=math.clamp(24+liveDelta.Magnitude*.18,24,52)
    if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
    -- Reversal correction is decisive rather than an overshoot personality event.
    if step.Magnitude>liveDelta.Magnitude then step=liveDelta end
    if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
     local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
     local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
     if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
    elseif Camera then
     Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
    end
    local finalSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(targetPart,Camera.CFrame.Position)
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=finalSolution~=nil and(finalSolution.Screen-center).Magnitude<=(finalSolution.Mode=="center"and 3.5 or 3.8)
    Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
    return Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady==true
   end
  end
 end

 -- V62 near-head rescue.  A successful SWIt attempt must never park a few pixels beside
 -- the head waiting for Auto-fire.  Once the crosshair is already at the rim/near-rim, use a
 -- tiny decisive live correction independent of pre-aim/pause/correct state.  Planned human
 -- misses and the outgoing synthetic-overshoot flick are intentionally excluded.
 local rescueVariant=tostring(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperVariant or "direct")
 local rescuePlannedFail=string.find(rescueVariant,"fail",1,true)~=nil
 local rescuePhase=tostring(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase or "flick")
 local rescueOvershootOutgoing=string.find(rescueVariant,"overshoot",1,true)~=nil and rescuePhase=="flick"
 if not rescuePlannedFail and not rescueOvershootOutgoing then
  -- V63: raw visual-OBB edge contact is no longer considered ready.  Rescue always pushes
  -- toward the current safe center / safe exposed-edge solution, so the crosshair cannot park
  -- on a generous visual rim that the sniper's real collision test may still miss.
  local rescueScreen=headScreen
  local rescueDistance=headDelta.Magnitude
  local rescueRadius=math.max(threshold+14,18)
  if rescueDistance>threshold and rescueDistance<=rescueRadius then
   local rescueDelta=rescueScreen-center
   if rescueDelta.Magnitude>.001 then
    -- 1-2 visible mouse steps in the common 6-18 px rim zone.  The explicit one-pixel
    -- minimum prevents integer mousemoverel rounding from producing a stationary frame.
    local rescueSpeedScale=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItCrosshairLockSpeed(rescueDistance))
    local fraction=math.clamp((.58+(.18*(1-rescueDistance/rescueRadius)))*math.clamp(rescueSpeedScale,.78,1.22),.50,.86)
    local rescueStep=rescueDelta*fraction
    local rescueCap=9.5*math.clamp(rescueSpeedScale,.82,1.18)
    if rescueStep.Magnitude>rescueCap then rescueStep=rescueStep.Unit*rescueCap end
    local sx=rescueStep.X>=0 and math.floor(rescueStep.X+.5)or math.ceil(rescueStep.X-.5)
    local sy=rescueStep.Y>=0 and math.floor(rescueStep.Y+.5)or math.ceil(rescueStep.Y-.5)
    if sx==0 and sy==0 then
     if math.abs(rescueDelta.X)>=math.abs(rescueDelta.Y)then sx=rescueDelta.X>=0 and 1 or -1
     else sy=rescueDelta.Y>=0 and 1 or -1 end
    end
    local applied=Vector2.new(sx,sy)
    Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=applied/math.max(frameDt,1/240)
    if applied.Magnitude>0 then
     Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity
     Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=applied.Unit
    end
    if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
     pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)
    elseif Camera then
     Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-applied.Y*.0009,-applied.X*.0009,0)
    end
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
    Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
    return false
   end
  end
 end

 -- V53 SWIt motion-coupled pre-aim.
 -- This is intentionally a ONE-SHOT visual estimate, not per-frame prediction.  When our own
 -- character is airborne / moving fast, estimate where the head will appear after a short piece
 -- of combined self + enemy motion, then commit to that planned mouse path for a few frames.
 -- The normal live head controller only resumes after the plan expires or has mostly completed.
 if Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimChecked~=true then
  Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimChecked=true
  local localCharacter=LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character or nil
  local localRoot=localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or nil
  local localHumanoid=localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")or nil
  local selfVelocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
  if localRoot and localRoot:IsA("BasePart")and typeof(localRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity)=="Vector3"then
   selfVelocity=localRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  end
  local airborne=false
  if localHumanoid then
   local ok,floor=pcall(function()return localHumanoid.FloorMaterial end)
   airborne=ok and floor==Enum.Material.Air
  end
  local selfSpeed=selfVelocity.Magnitude
  local movingFast=selfSpeed>=22
  if (airborne or movingFast)and headDelta.Magnitude>=55 and headDelta.Magnitude<=430 then
   local targetVelocity=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
   if motionPart and motionPart:IsA("BasePart")and typeof(motionPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity)=="Vector3"then
    targetVelocity=motionPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
   end
   local targetSpeed=targetVelocity.Magnitude
   -- Roughly 52-118 ms of look-ahead. Airborne movement gets the longer visual estimate because
   -- SWIt often lets his own travel finish part of the aim instead of immediately chasing the head.
   local leadBase=airborne and .078 or .058
   local lead=math.clamp(
    leadBase+math.clamp(selfSpeed,0,110)*.00032+math.clamp(targetSpeed,0,90)*.00012
    +Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-.006,.010),
    .052,.118
   )
   -- Project FUTURE RELATIVE motion into the CURRENT camera once.  Subtracting our own velocity
   -- is what makes this a movement-coupled pre-aim instead of ordinary target prediction.
   local predictedWorld=worldPos+(targetVelocity-selfVelocity)*lead
   local pp,pon=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(predictedWorld)
   if pon and pp.Z>0 then
    local predictedDelta=Vector2.new(pp.X,pp.Y)-center
    -- Humans usually commit most, not all, of the initial estimate. The remaining error is left
    -- for body motion + the final SWIt correction.  Tiny fixed error is sampled ONCE per attempt.
    local commit=airborne
     and Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.62,.82)
     or Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.72,.88)
    local estimateError=Vector2.new(
     Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-2.4,2.4),
     Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(-1.6,1.6)
    )
    Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimRemaining=predictedDelta*commit+estimateError
    Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimLead=lead
    Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimUntil=reversalNow+math.clamp(
     lead*Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.72,1.02),.045,.105
    )
    Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimSpeedScale=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.94,1.06)
    Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase="preaim"
   end
  end
 end

 if Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase=="preaim"then
  local preVariant=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperVariant or"direct"
  local prePlannedFail=string.find(preVariant,"fail",1,true)~=nil
  -- If body motion naturally carries the REAL head under the crosshair, take the shot.  Do not
  -- force completion of the synthetic plan just because some planned mouse delta remains.
  if not prePlannedFail and headDelta.Magnitude<=threshold then
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.10
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
   Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
   return true
  end

  local remaining=Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimRemaining or Vector2.new(0,0)
  local preUntil=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimUntil)or 0
  if reversalNow>=preUntil or remaining.Magnitude<=6.0 then
   Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase="flick"
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.48
  else
   local preScale=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimSpeedScale)or 1,.92,1.08)
   local distance=remaining.Magnitude
   local desiredSpeed=math.min(2450*preScale,distance*14.5*preScale)
   local desiredVelocity=distance>.001 and remaining.Unit*desiredSpeed or Vector2.new(0,0)
   local prior=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
   local velocity=prior:Lerp(desiredVelocity,1-math.exp(-15.0*frameDt))
   local dv=velocity-prior
   local maxDv=18000*frameDt
   if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=prior+dv.Unit*maxDv end
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
   if velocity.Magnitude>45 then
    Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
    Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit
   end
   local step=velocity*frameDt
   local maxStep=math.clamp(10+distance*.055,10,27)
   if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
   if step.Magnitude>distance and step.Magnitude>0 then step=remaining end

   local applied=step
   if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
    local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
    local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
    applied=Vector2.new(sx,sy)
    if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
   elseif Camera then
    Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
   end
   Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperPreAimRemaining=remaining-applied
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
   Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
   return false
  end
 end

 local variant=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperVariant or"direct"
 local plannedFail=string.find(variant,"fail",1,true)~=nil
 if not plannedFail and headDelta.Magnitude<=threshold then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.16
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
  return true
 end

 local phase=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase or"flick"
 local direct=variant=="direct"or variant=="direct_fail"
 local overshootPath=variant=="overshoot"or variant=="overshoot_fail"
 local dir=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperDirection or Vector2.new(1,0)
 local overshoot=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperOvershoot or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local missOffset=Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissOffset or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local speedScale=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperSpeedScale)or 1,.96,1.12)
 local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local now=os.clock()
 local initialDistance=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperInitialDistance)or headDelta.Magnitude,0,520)
 local initial01=math.clamp(initialDistance/320,0,1)
 local flickScale=math.clamp(.78+math.sqrt(initial01)*.54,.78,1.32)

 if phase=="flick"then
  local targetOffset=Vector2.new(0,0)
  if direct and plannedFail then
   targetOffset=missOffset
  elseif overshootPath then
   -- Keep only a little sideways hand error during the outgoing flick.  Forward overshoot is
   -- produced by momentum after crossing the head instead of chasing a synthetic point.
   local perp=Vector2.new(-dir.Y,dir.X)
   targetOffset=perp*overshoot:Dot(perp)*.55
  end
  local targetScreen=headScreen+targetOffset
  local delta=targetScreen-center
  local distance=delta.Magnitude
  local live01=math.clamp(distance/300,0,1)
  local liveScale=math.clamp(.80+math.sqrt(live01)*.48,.80,1.28)
  local amplitudeScale=math.clamp((flickScale+liveScale)*.5,.78,1.30)

  -- V57 dual-distance blend.  Far from the head, world distance barely changes the coarse
  -- acquisition at all.  Only when the cursor enters the distance-dependent braking zone do
  -- close targets retain extra speed and far targets shed speed earlier.  Smoothstep keeps the
  -- transition continuous instead of creating another robotic hard threshold.
  local worldAggression=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperWorldAggression)or 1,.80,1.24)
  local worldBrakeStart=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperWorldBrakeStart)or 64,28,132)
  local brakeBlend=1-math.clamp(distance/worldBrakeStart,0,1)
  brakeBlend=brakeBlend*brakeBlend*(3-2*brakeBlend)
  local worldMotionScale=1+(worldAggression-1)*brakeBlend
  local worldResponseScale=1+(worldAggression-1)*brakeBlend*.62

  -- V58 100-190 px short-flick lane.  At long player distance the old controller felt slow
  -- even though the target was already close to the crosshair.  A real strong aimer/SWIt can
  -- make this small correction explosively, then brake only in the final tiny-head zone.
  local sampledWorldDistance=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperKinematicWorldDistance)or 70
  local farWeight=math.clamp((sampledWorldDistance-60)/90,0,1)
  local shortFlickWeight=0
  if distance>=85 and distance<=205 then
   local d=math.abs(distance-145)/60
   shortFlickWeight=1-math.clamp(d,0,1)
   shortFlickWeight=shortFlickWeight*shortFlickWeight*(3-2*shortFlickWeight)
  end
  local shortFlickBoost=1+shortFlickWeight*(.08+.10*farWeight)
  local shortResponseBoost=1+shortFlickWeight*(.10+.12*farWeight)
  -- V64: explicit CROSSHAIR-distance speed lanes.
  local crosshairLockScale=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetSWItCrosshairLockSpeed(distance))
  local crosshairResponseScale=math.clamp(.55+.45*crosshairLockScale,.82,1.30)
  local desiredSpeed=math.min((direct and 3820 or 3520)*speedScale*amplitudeScale*worldMotionScale*shortFlickBoost*crosshairLockScale,distance*(direct and 22.5 or 19.0)*speedScale*amplitudeScale*worldMotionScale*shortFlickBoost*crosshairLockScale)
  local desiredVelocity=distance>.001 and delta.Unit*desiredSpeed or Vector2.new(0,0)
  local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,1-math.exp(-(direct and 24.0 or 20.5)*amplitudeScale*worldResponseScale*shortResponseBoost*crosshairResponseScale*frameDt))
  local dv=velocity-previous
  local maxDv=(direct and 29000 or 25000)*amplitudeScale*math.clamp(worldResponseScale,.88,1.12)*math.clamp(shortResponseBoost,1,1.22)*math.clamp(crosshairResponseScale,.82,1.30)*frameDt
  if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
  if velocity.Magnitude>45 then Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit end

  local step=velocity*frameDt
  local minStep=direct and 17 or 15
  local maxCap=direct and 46 or 42
  local maxStep=math.clamp((direct and 19 or 17)+distance*.050,minStep,maxCap)*amplitudeScale*math.clamp(worldMotionScale,.86,1.14)*math.clamp(shortFlickBoost,1,1.18)*math.clamp(crosshairLockScale,.84,1.24)
  if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
  if direct then
   if step.Magnitude>distance then step=delta end
  else
   local overshootAlong=math.max(0,overshoot:Dot(dir))
   local passAllowance=math.clamp(2.2+overshootAlong*.78,2.2,12.0)*(0.92+0.08*flickScale)
   local maxTravel=distance+passAllowance
   if step.Magnitude>maxTravel and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxTravel end
  end

  -- V54 natural through-head shot: only a genuinely long, fast outgoing flick can arm it.
  -- We land inside the live head zone for the firing frame, but preserve the outgoing
  -- hand velocity so the cursor can continue naturally AFTER native fire accepts the shot.
  local naturalAutoFire=type(CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled)=="function"and CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled()==true
  local naturalMinDistance=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughMinDistance)or 300
  local naturalHighSpeed=velocity.Magnitude>=1700
  local naturalHeadDistance=headDelta.Magnitude
  local naturalTowardHead=step.Magnitude>.001 and naturalHeadDistance>.001 and step.Unit:Dot(headDelta.Unit)>=.94
  local naturalWillEnter=step.Magnitude>=math.max(0,naturalHeadDistance-threshold*.72)
  local naturalEligible=naturalAutoFire and not plannedFail and initialDistance>=naturalMinDistance
   and naturalHighSpeed and naturalTowardHead and naturalWillEnter
  if naturalEligible then
   local settle=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.965,.992)
   step=headDelta*settle
   Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughPending=true
   Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughVelocity=velocity
   Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughDuration=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.025,.065)
   Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughRetain=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.55,.80)
   Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingUntil=now+.10
   Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPlayer=target.Player
   Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPart=targetPart
  end
  if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
   local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
   local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
   if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
  elseif Camera then
   Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
  end

  local afterWorld,afterSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
  if afterWorld and afterSolution then
   local ap,aon=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(afterWorld)
   if aon and ap.Z>0 then
    local afterHead=Vector2.new(ap.X,ap.Y)
    local afterDelta=afterHead-center
    local afterThreshold=afterSolution.Mode=="center"and 3.5 or 3.8
    local naturalCrossing=Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughPending==true
     and os.clock()<=(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingUntil)or 0)
     and Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPlayer==target.Player
     and Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPart==targetPart
    if naturalCrossing and afterDelta.Magnitude<=afterThreshold+1.25 then
     Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
     Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
     Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
     return true
    end
    if direct and not plannedFail and afterDelta.Magnitude<=afterThreshold then
     Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity*.12
     Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
     Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
     return true
    end
    if direct and plannedFail then
     local missDelta=(afterHead+missOffset)-center
     if missDelta.Magnitude<=3.6 then
      local contact=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(targetPart)
      if not contact or contact.Inside~=true then
       Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity*.10
       Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=true
       Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
       return false
      end
      Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissOffset=missOffset*1.22
     end
    end
    local passedAmount=-afterDelta:Dot(dir)
    local overshootAlong=math.max(0,overshoot:Dot(dir))
    local neededPass=math.clamp(1.8+overshootAlong*.48,1.8,7.5)
    if not direct and(passedAmount>=neededPass or(afterDelta.Magnitude<=3.8 and velocity:Dot(dir)>0))then
     -- This phase is a moving brake, not a dead pause.  Human hands keep carrying a little
     -- momentum while the brain starts the correction, so never zero or sharply halve speed.
     Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase="pause"
     Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPauseUntil=now+Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.020,.038)
     Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity*Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.74,.88)
    elseif direct and not plannedFail and(passed or afterDelta.Magnitude<=9)then
     Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase="correct"
     Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity*.14
    end
   end
  end
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end

 if phase=="pause"then
  -- V50 moving brake: preserve the outgoing hand momentum, but begin a soft correction before
  -- the brake window ends.  This produces one continuous arc instead of a visible stop/reverse.
  local brakeWorld,brakeSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
  local brakeDelta=headDelta
  if brakeWorld then
   local bp,bon=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(brakeWorld)
   if bon and bp.Z>0 then brakeDelta=Vector2.new(bp.X,bp.Y)-center end
  end
  local carry=previous*math.exp(-11.2*frameDt)
  local guide=Vector2.new(0,0)
  if brakeDelta.Magnitude>.001 then
   local guideSpeed=math.min(980,brakeDelta.Magnitude*10.5)
   guide=brakeDelta.Unit*guideSpeed
  end
  local velocity=carry:Lerp(guide,1-math.exp(-6.8*frameDt))
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
  local step=velocity*frameDt
  local brakeCap=math.clamp(3.0+initial01*2.1,3.0,5.2)
  if step.Magnitude>brakeCap and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*brakeCap end
  if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
   local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
   local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
   if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
  elseif Camera then
   Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
  end
  local brakeDone=now>=(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPauseUntil)or 0)
  if not brakeDone and brakeDelta.Magnitude<9 and velocity.Magnitude<420 then brakeDone=true end
  if brakeDone then Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase="correct"end
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end

 worldPos,solution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
 if not worldPos or not solution then return false end
 hp,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not on or hp.Z<=0 then return false end
 headScreen=Vector2.new(hp.X,hp.Y)
 local correctionTarget=headScreen
 if plannedFail then correctionTarget=headScreen+missOffset end
 local delta=correctionTarget-center
 threshold=solution.Mode=="center"and 3.5 or 3.8
 if not plannedFail and(headScreen-center).Magnitude<=threshold then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.12
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
  return true
 end
 if plannedFail and delta.Magnitude<=3.6 then
  local contact=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(targetPart)
  if not contact or contact.Inside~=true then
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.10
   Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=true
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
   return false
  end
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissOffset=missOffset*1.22
 end

 local correctionScale=math.clamp(.86+math.sqrt(initial01)*.32,.86,1.18)
 -- V57 final correction is where real player distance matters most.  A close target has a large
 -- head on screen, so SWIt can finish faster; a far target has a tiny head, so speed/response/
 -- acceleration are reduced together rather than forcing a supernatural exact snap.
 local worldFineScale=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItSniperWorldFineScale)or 1,.80,1.15)
 -- Overshoot recovery is deliberately softer than a normal direct correction.  SWIt's hand
 -- visibly rounds the turn; it does not reverse at the same acceleration used by the flick.
 local correctionSpeedCap=overshootPath and 2320 or 2920
 local correctionGain=overshootPath and 18.0 or 23.0
 local correctionResponse=overshootPath and 14.6 or 19.0
 local correctionAccel=overshootPath and 16500 or 21500
 local desiredSpeed=math.min(correctionSpeedCap*speedScale*correctionScale*worldFineScale,delta.Magnitude*correctionGain*speedScale*correctionScale*worldFineScale)
 local desiredVelocity=delta.Magnitude>.001 and delta.Unit*desiredSpeed or Vector2.new(0,0)
 previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,1-math.exp(-correctionResponse*correctionScale*math.clamp(worldFineScale,.84,1.12)*frameDt))
 local dv=velocity-previous
 local maxDv=correctionAccel*correctionScale*math.clamp(worldFineScale,.84,1.12)*frameDt
 if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
 local step=velocity*frameDt
 local maxStep=(overshootPath and math.clamp(7.5+delta.Magnitude*.055,7.5,17)or math.clamp(9+delta.Magnitude*.070,9,23))*correctionScale*math.clamp(worldFineScale,.86,1.10)
 if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
 local correctionAllowance=overshootPath and 1.2 or 1.8
 if step.Magnitude>delta.Magnitude+correctionAllowance and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*(delta.Magnitude+correctionAllowance)end
 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
  local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
  if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
 elseif Camera then
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
 end
 if plannedFail then
  local contact=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(targetPart)
  Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=delta.Magnitude<=4.5 and(not contact or contact.Inside~=true)
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end
 local finalSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(targetPart,Camera.CFrame.Position)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=finalSolution~=nil and(finalSolution.Screen-center).Magnitude<=(finalSolution.Mode=="center"and 3.5 or 3.8)
 Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
 return Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady==true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_MoveSniperTopDown(target,dt,targetPart,kind)
 if not Camera or not target then
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end
 targetPart=targetPart or target.Head
 if not targetPart or not targetPart:IsA("BasePart")then
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end
 kind=tostring(kind or"sniper")
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local isHeadTarget=target.Head~=nil and targetPart==target.Head and CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(targetPart)

 -- Sniper gets a per-shot motion personality.  It is selected once and held until the
 -- real shot commits, so "human" variation never turns into frame-to-frame randomness.
 if kind=="sniper"and(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPlayer~=target.Player or Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPart~=targetPart)then
  CVU_RIVALS_BeginSniperHumanShot(target,targetPart)
 end

 local headSolution=nil
 local worldPos=targetPart.Position
 if isHeadTarget then
  worldPos,headSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(targetPart,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
  if not worldPos or not headSolution then
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
   return false
  end
 elseif kind=="sniper"then
  worldPos=CVU_RIVALS_GetStablePrecisionWorld(targetPart,frameDt)or worldPos
 end
 local point,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
 if not onScreen or point.Z<=0 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end

 local rawPartScreen=Vector2.new(point.X,point.Y)
 local rawPartDelta=rawPartScreen-center
 local rawDistance=math.clamp(rawPartDelta.Magnitude,0,500)
 local sideBias=kind=="sniper"and(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanSideBias)or 0)or 0
 -- A fixed per-shot side bias produces a tiny arc instead of a mathematically perfect
 -- straight line.  It fades out near the final center/visible-edge aim point.
 local biasScale=math.clamp(rawDistance/180,0,1)
 local partScreen=rawPartScreen+Vector2.new(sideBias*biasScale,0)
 local partDelta=partScreen-center
 local contact=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(targetPart)
 local aimScreen=partScreen
 if not isHeadTarget and contact then
  if contact.Inside==true then
   aimScreen=center
  elseif contact.PixelDistance<=46 then
   aimScreen=contact.Screen
  end
 end
 local aimDelta=aimScreen-center
 local crosshairDistance=math.clamp(rawPartDelta.Magnitude,0,500)
 local speedScale=kind=="sniper"and math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanSpeedScale)or 1,.88,1.10)or 1
 local headThreshold=headSolution and(headSolution.Mode=="center"and 4.5 or 7.0)or nil
 local headPointReached=isHeadTarget and headThreshold and rawPartDelta.Magnitude<=headThreshold or false

 -- About one third of normal Sniper head shots use the V30 two-stage human correction.
 -- The final correction now resolves to the center if the center is exposed; only a true
 -- partial peek (center blocked) resolves to an exposed edge sample.
 if kind=="sniper"
 and Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanVariant=="near_micro"
 and isHeadTarget
 and rawPartDelta.Y>=-24 then
  local phase=Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPhase or"approach"
  if headPointReached then
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
   return true
  end

  local headAim=rawPartScreen
  local headDistance=(headAim-center).Magnitude
  local microGap=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanMicroGap)or 22,14,30)

  if phase=="approach"then
   if headDistance<=microGap then
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPhase="micro_finish"
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPhaseStarted=os.clock()
    Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*.22
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
    return false
   end

   local microSide=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanMicroSide)or 0
   local delta=(headAim+Vector2.new(microSide,0))-center
   if delta.Magnitude<=.35 then
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPhase="micro_finish"
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperHumanPhaseStarted=os.clock()
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
    return false
   end
   local desiredSpeed=math.min(3050*speedScale,delta.Magnitude*16.5*speedScale)
   local desiredVelocity=delta.Unit*desiredSpeed
   local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
   local blend=1-math.exp(-20*frameDt)
   local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,blend)
   local dv=velocity-previous
   local maxDv=22000*frameDt
   if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
   Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
   if velocity.Magnitude>45 then Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit end

   local step=velocity*frameDt
   local maxStep=math.clamp(19+delta.Magnitude*.030,19,33)
   if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
   local remainingBeforeMicro=math.max(0,headDistance-microGap)
   if remainingBeforeMicro>0 and step.Magnitude>remainingBeforeMicro then step=step.Unit*remainingBeforeMicro end
   if step.Magnitude>delta.Magnitude then step=delta end
   if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
    local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
    local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
    if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
   elseif Camera then
    Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
   end
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
   return false
  end

  -- Last-instant correction: recompute the visibility solution because a moving player
  -- can emerge from cover while the flick is already in progress.
  local liveWorld,liveSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimWorldForMotion(target.Head,frameDt,Camera.CFrame.Position)
  if not liveWorld or not liveSolution then
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
   return false
  end
  local hp,hon=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(liveWorld)
  if not hon or hp.Z<=0 then
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
   return false
  end
  local liveScreen=Vector2.new(hp.X,hp.Y)
  local liveThreshold=liveSolution.Mode=="center"and 4.5 or 7.0
  local delta=liveScreen-center
  if delta.Magnitude<=liveThreshold then
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
   return true
  end

  local desiredSpeed=math.min(3900*speedScale,delta.Magnitude*31*speedScale)
  local desiredVelocity=delta.Unit*desiredSpeed
  local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
  local blend=1-math.exp(-33*frameDt)
  local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,blend)
  local dv=velocity-previous
  local maxDv=39000*frameDt
  if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
  Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
  if velocity.Magnitude>45 then Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit end

  local step=velocity*frameDt
  local maxStep=math.clamp(9+delta.Magnitude*.20,9,16)
  if step.Magnitude>maxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxStep end
  if step.Magnitude>delta.Magnitude then step=delta end
  if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
   local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
   local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
   if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
  elseif Camera then
   Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
  end
  local finalSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(target.Head,Camera.CFrame.Position)
  if finalSolution then
   local finalThreshold=finalSolution.Mode=="center"and 4.5 or 7.0
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=(finalSolution.Screen-center).Magnitude<=finalThreshold
  else
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  end
  return Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady==true
 end

 -- A head shot is ready only at its preferred visible point.  Merely touching the OBB
 -- edge no longer fires when the head center itself is visible.
 local preferredReached=isHeadTarget and headPointReached or(contact and contact.Inside==true)
 if preferredReached and partDelta.Y>=0 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPart=targetPart
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPhase="down"
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  return true
 end

 -- Every normal precision shot finishes from above the selected hitbox/visible head point.
 if Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPlayer~=target.Player or Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPart~=targetPart then
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPart=targetPart
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownLead=math.clamp(34+crosshairDistance*.10,34,78)
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPhase=partDelta.Y>=Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownLead*.55 and"down"or"setup"
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 end

 local lead=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownLead)or 48,28,82)
 local phase=Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPhase or"setup"
 if phase=="setup"then
  local waypoint=Vector2.new(partScreen.X,partScreen.Y-lead)
  local delta=waypoint-center
  if delta.Magnitude<=5 or partDelta.Y>=lead*.70 then
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPhase="down"
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
   return false
  end

  local gain=9.0*speedScale
  local maxSpeed=1650*speedScale
  local desiredSpeed=math.min(maxSpeed,delta.Magnitude*gain)
  local desiredVelocity=delta.Magnitude>.001 and delta.Unit*desiredSpeed or Vector2.new(0,0)
  local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
  local blend=1-math.exp(-10.5*frameDt)
  local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,blend)
  local dv=velocity-previous
  local maxDv=10500*frameDt
  if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
  local step=velocity*frameDt
  local setupMaxStep=30
  if step.Magnitude>setupMaxStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*setupMaxStep end
  if step.Magnitude>delta.Magnitude then step=delta end
  if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
   local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
   local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
   if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
  elseif Camera then
   Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
  end
  return false
 end

 -- Normal/direct shots retain the V24 top-down finish.  V30's near_micro path above
 -- is the only path allowed to use the short last-instant correction near the head.
 if partDelta.Y<0 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownPhase="setup"
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  return false
 end

 if(isHeadTarget and headPointReached)or((not isHeadTarget)and contact and contact.Inside==true)then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=true
  return true
 end
 local delta=Vector2.new(aimDelta.X,math.max(0,aimDelta.Y))
 local distance=delta.Magnitude
 if distance<=.35 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  return false
 end

 local desiredSpeed=math.min(3000*speedScale,distance*16.0*speedScale)
 local desiredVelocity=delta.Unit*desiredSpeed
 local previous=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 previous=Vector2.new(previous.X,math.max(0,previous.Y))
 local blend=1-math.exp(-20.0*frameDt)
 local velocity=previous:Lerp(desiredVelocity,blend)
 velocity=Vector2.new(velocity.X,math.max(0,velocity.Y))
 local dv=velocity-previous
 local maxDv=22000*frameDt
 if dv.Magnitude>maxDv and dv.Magnitude>0 then velocity=previous+dv.Unit*maxDv end
 velocity=Vector2.new(velocity.X,math.max(0,velocity.Y))
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
 Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastVelocity=velocity
 if velocity.Magnitude>45 then Runtime.RivalsAimLastFastDirection=velocity.Unit end

 local step=velocity*frameDt*math.clamp(distance/110,.74,1)
 local maxVisibleStep=math.clamp(18+distance*.032,18,34)
 if step.Magnitude>maxVisibleStep and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*maxVisibleStep end
 if step.Magnitude>distance then step=delta end
 step=Vector2.new(step.X,math.max(0,step.Y))
 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
  local sy=math.max(0,math.floor(step.Y+.5))
  if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
 elseif Camera then
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
 end
 if isHeadTarget then
  local afterSolution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(targetPart,Camera.CFrame.Position)
  if afterSolution then
   local afterThreshold=afterSolution.Mode=="center"and 4.5 or 7.0
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=(afterSolution.Screen-center).Magnitude<=afterThreshold and partDelta.Y>=0
  else
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  end
 else
  local afterContact=CVU_RIVALS_GetCrosshairPartContact(targetPart)
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=afterContact~=nil and afterContact.Inside==true and partDelta.Y>=0
 end
 return Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady==true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsAimCharacterDead(character)
 if not character or not character.Parent then return true end
 if character:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return true end
 local hum=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if hum and(hum.Health<=0 or hum:GetState()==Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)then return true end
 local hp=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))
 if hp~=nil and hp<=0 then return true end
 return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ApplySniperFollowThroughCarry(dt,now)
 now=tonumber(now)or os.clock()
 local untilTime=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughUntil)or 0
 local startTime=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughStart)or 0
 if untilTime<=0 or now>=untilTime or startTime<=0 then
  if untilTime>0 and now>=untilTime then
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughUntil=0
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughStart=0
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  end
  return false
 end
 local base=Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 if typeof(base)~="Vector2"or base.Magnitude<1 then return false end
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local duration=math.max(untilTime-startTime,.001)
 local t=math.clamp((now-startTime)/duration,0,1)
 local velocity=base*((1-t)^1.35)
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=velocity
 local step=velocity*frameDt
 local cap=math.clamp(16+base.Magnitude*.0045,18,31)
 if step.Magnitude>cap and step.Magnitude>0 then step=step.Unit*cap end
 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local sx=step.X>=0 and math.floor(step.X+.5)or math.ceil(step.X-.5)
  local sy=step.Y>=0 and math.floor(step.Y+.5)or math.ceil(step.Y-.5)
  if sx~=0 or sy~=0 then pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)end
 elseif Camera then
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-step.Y*.0009,-step.X*.0009,0)
 end
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ArmSniperFollowThrough(target)
 if not target or not target.Character then return end
 local now=os.clock()
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchCharacter=target.Character
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchPlayer=target.Player
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchUntil=now+.60
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchOffset=Vector2.new(0,0)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchDuration=0

 -- V54: only a fresh genuine long-flick crossing creates visible post-shot carry.
 local fresh=Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughPending==true
  and now<=(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingUntil)or 0)+.04
  and Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPlayer==target.Player
 local rawVelocity=Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
 if fresh and typeof(rawVelocity)=="Vector2"and rawVelocity.Magnitude>=1500 then
  local duration=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughDuration)or .04,.025,.065)
  local retain=math.clamp(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughRetain)or .65,.55,.80)
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughStart=now
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughUntil=now+duration
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughVelocity=rawVelocity*retain
 else
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughUntil=0
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughStart=0
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 end
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughTargetOffset=Vector2.new(0,0)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughAppliedOffset=Vector2.new(0,0)
 Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughPending=false
 Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughDuration=0
 Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingUntil=0
 Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPlayer=nil
 Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPart=nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateSniperFollowThrough(dt,now)
 if CVU_RIVALS_ApplySniperFollowThroughCarry(dt,now)then return true end

 local watchUntil=Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchUntil or 0
 if watchUntil>0 and now<=watchUntil then
  local character=Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchCharacter
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsAimCharacterDead(character)then
   local deadPlayer=Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchPlayer
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchUntil=0
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchCharacter=nil
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchPlayer=nil
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchOffset=Vector2.new(0,0)
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchDuration=0

   local deadVisibleSince=deadPlayer and Runtime.RivalsAimCandidateVisibleSince[deadPlayer]or nil
   local firstQualified=typeof(deadVisibleSince)=="number"and now-deadVisibleSince>=math.max(.30,tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainMinVisible)or .30)
   local chain=firstQualified and CVU_RIVALS_FindSniperChainTarget(deadPlayer,now)or nil
   if chain then
    Runtime.RivalsAimTarget=chain
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer=chain.Player
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainSince=now
    Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=tonumber(chain.VisibleSince)or(now-.31)
    Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=0
    Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=now
    Runtime.RivalsAimPreferHead=true
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperCrosshairDistance=CVU_RIVALS_GetSniperCrosshairDistance(chain)
    local chainPx=Runtime.RivalsAimSniperCrosshairDistance
    Runtime.RivalsAimSniperCrosshairTier=chainPx<=100 and"準心第1段"or(chainPx<=200 and"準心第2段"or(chainPx<=300 and"準心第3段"or(chainPx<=450 and"準心第4段"or"準心第5段")))
    pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetAimMotion)
    pcall(CVU_RIVALS_RequestSniperChainAim)
    return true
   end

   Runtime.RivalsAimTarget=nil
   Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=0
   Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer=nil
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainSince=0
   pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetAimMotion)
   return true
  end
 elseif watchUntil>0 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchUntil=0
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchCharacter=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchPlayer=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchOffset=Vector2.new(0,0)
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchDuration=0
 end
 return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ResetMeleeAimBehavior(clearOvershoot)
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastMouseDown=false
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchPlayer=nil
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchCharacter=nil
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchHealth=nil
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchUntil=0
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchDirection=0
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastArmAt=0
 if clearOvershoot~=false then
  Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootDirection=0
  Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootRemaining=0
  Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootSpeed=0
 end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_FindMeleeWatchTarget()
 if not Camera then return nil end
 local localCharacter=LocalPlayer.Character
 local localRoot=localCharacter and localCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not localRoot then return nil end
 local origin=Camera.CFrame.Position
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local best=nil
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)then
   local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
   local head,chest,root=CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoTargetParts(character)
   local targetRoot=root or chest or head
   local targetPart=chest or root or head
   local hp=character and select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))or nil
   if targetRoot and targetPart and character:GetAttribute("Dead")~=true and(hp==nil or hp>0)then
    local worldDistance=(targetRoot.Position-localRoot.Position).Magnitude
    if worldDistance<=12.5 and CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,targetPart)then
     local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
     if on and p.Z>0 then
      local screen=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)
      local screenDistance=(screen-center).Magnitude
      if screenDistance<=280 then
       local score=screenDistance+worldDistance*5
       if not best or score<best.Score then
        best={Player=player,Character=character,Part=targetPart,Root=targetRoot,Health=hp,Screen=screen,Score=score}
       end
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ArmMeleeHitWatch(now)
 local candidate=CVU_RIVALS_FindMeleeWatchTarget()
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastArmAt=now
 if not candidate then
  Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchPlayer=nil Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchCharacter=nil Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchHealth=nil Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchUntil=0 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchDirection=0
  return false
 end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local direction=0
 local userDX=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastUserDX)or 0
 local userDXRecent=now-(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastUserDXAt)or 0)<=.16
 if userDXRecent and math.abs(userDX)>=1.25 then
  direction=userDX>0 and 1 or-1
 else
  local offset=candidate.Screen.X-center.X
  if math.abs(offset)>=3 then direction=offset>0 and 1 or-1
  else direction=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()<.5 and-1 or 1 end
 end
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchPlayer=candidate.Player
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchCharacter=candidate.Character
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchHealth=candidate.Health
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchUntil=now+.52
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchDirection=direction
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_StartMeleeHorizontalOvershoot(direction,now)
 direction=tonumber(direction)or 0
 if direction==0 then direction=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber()<.5 and-1 or 1 end
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootDirection=direction>0 and 1 or-1
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootRemaining=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(52,92)
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootSpeed=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(900,1320)
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastOvershootAt=now
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchPlayer=nil Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchCharacter=nil Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchHealth=nil Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchUntil=0 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchDirection=0
end

function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateMeleeHorizontalOvershoot(dt)
 local remaining=math.max(0,tonumber(Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootRemaining)or 0)
 local direction=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootDirection)or 0
 if remaining<=.25 or direction==0 then
  Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootRemaining=0 Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootDirection=0 Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootSpeed=0
  return false
 end
 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local speed=math.max(300,tonumber(Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootSpeed)or 1050)
 local ease=math.clamp(remaining/72,.48,1)
 local step=math.min(remaining,speed*frameDt*ease)
 step=math.min(step,19)
 local sx=math.max(1,math.floor(step+.5))*direction
 -- Horizontal carry only: never add positive or negative Y overshoot for melee.
 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  pcall(mousemoverel,sx,0)
 elseif Camera then
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(0,-sx*.0009,0)
 end
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootRemaining=math.max(0,remaining-math.abs(sx))
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateMeleeNoLock(dt,now)
 -- Melee never owns an Aim Assist target.  Clear every state that can visually pull the
 -- crosshair toward Head/Chest, including a leftover sniper chain after a weapon swap.
 Runtime.RivalsAimTarget=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=0
 Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0
 Runtime.RivalsAimFOVVisualCenter=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=false
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer=nil Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainSince=0
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchCharacter=nil Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchPlayer=nil Runtime.RivalsAimSniperKillWatchUntil=0
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughUntil=0 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFollowThroughVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=nil Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=nil
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ClearPrecisionShotPart)
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetAimMotion)

 local dx=0
 pcall(function()dx=UserInputService:GetMouseDelta().X end)
 if math.abs(dx)>=.55 then Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastUserDX=dx Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastUserDXAt=now end

 local mouseDown=Runtime.MouseDown==true
 local rising=mouseDown and Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastMouseDown~=true
 -- Rising-edge arms normal melee.  Holding also refreshes the watch at a conservative
 -- cadence so continuous weapons such as Chainsaw can still produce a confirmed-hit carry.
 if rising or(mouseDown and(not Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchCharacter or now>(Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchUntil or 0))and now-(Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastArmAt or 0)>=.22)then
  CVU_RIVALS_ArmMeleeHitWatch(now)
 end
 Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastMouseDown=mouseDown

 local character=Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchCharacter
 if character and now<=(Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchUntil or 0)then
  local currentHP=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))
  local previousHP=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchHealth)
  local dead=character:GetAttribute("Dead")==true
  local hum=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if hum and hum.Health<=0 then dead=true end
  local damaged=previousHP~=nil and currentHP~=nil and currentHP<previousHP-.01
  if dead and(previousHP==nil or previousHP>0)then damaged=true end
  if damaged and now-(Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastOvershootAt or 0)>=.16 then
   CVU_RIVALS_StartMeleeHorizontalOvershoot(Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchDirection,now)
  elseif currentHP~=nil then
   Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchHealth=currentHP
  end
 elseif character then
  Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchPlayer=nil Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchCharacter=nil Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchHealth=nil Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchUntil=0 Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchDirection=0
 end

 CVU_RIVALS_UpdateMeleeHorizontalOvershoot(dt)
 return true
end

-- V33: ClientItem:Input() returns actionFired.  Use that real native return value instead
-- of treating a successful pcall as a successful shot.  This is the same layer that sends
-- Fighter.UseItem only after StartShooting itself accepts the action.
function CVU_RIVALS_NativeItemInput(item,actionName)
 if not item or type(actionName)~="string"then return false end
 local input=rawget(item,"Input")or item.Input
 if type(input)=="function"then
  local ok,result=pcall(input,item,actionName)
  return ok and result==true
 end
 local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
 if mechanics and type(mechanics.EquippedItemInput)=="function"then
  local ok,result=pcall(mechanics.EquippedItemInput,mechanics,actionName)
  return ok and result==true
 end
 return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ClearSniperFireLatch()
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchUntil=0
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchPlayer=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchPart=nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ArmSniperFireLatch(target,part,now)
 if not target or not target.Player or not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return false end
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchPlayer=target.Player
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchPart=part
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchUntil=(tonumber(now)or os.clock())+.130
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperFireLatched(target,part,now)
 local t=tonumber(now)or os.clock()
 if t>(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchUntil)or 0)then
  CVU_RIVALS_ClearSniperFireLatch()
  return false
 end
 if not target or Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchPlayer~=target.Player or Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchPart~=part then
  return false
 end
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ArmSniperBoltCycle(item)
 if not item then return false end
 local nowTick=tick()
 local info=rawget(item,"Info")
 local fallback=.55
 if type(info)=="table"then
  fallback=tonumber(rawget(info,"ShootCooldown"))or tonumber(rawget(info,"ShootBurstCooldown"))or fallback
 end
 fallback=math.clamp(fallback,.20,3.00)
 local due=rawget(item,"_shoot_cooldown")
 local untilTick=(typeof(due)=="number"and due>nowTick)and due or(nowTick+fallback)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltItem=item
 local _,boltName=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltName=tostring(boltName or"")
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltUntil=math.max(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltUntil)or 0,untilTick)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltSuppressing=true
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 CVU_RIVALS_ClearSniperFireLatch()
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperBoltCycleActive(item)
 -- The Gun.StartShooting hook and the ClientItem input path can expose different table
 -- objects for the SAME weapon. Compare the weapon name, not table identity, so manual
 -- shots cannot accidentally cancel the bolt pause on the very next frame.
 local storedName=tostring(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltName or"")
 if item and storedName~=""then
  local _,currentName=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
  currentName=tostring(currentName or"")
  if currentName~=""and currentName~=storedName then
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltItem=nil
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltName=nil
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltUntil=0
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltSuppressing=false
   return false
  end
 end
 if tick()<(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltUntil)or 0)then
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltSuppressing=true
  return true
 end
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltItem=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltName=nil
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltUntil=0
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltSuppressing=false
 return false
end

function CVU_RIVALS_TryManualSniperFlickCorrection(target,kind,dt)
 if kind~="sniper"or not Camera or not target or not target.Player or not target.Head then return false end
 if not target.Head:IsA("BasePart")then return false end

 -- Do not fight the Anti-Katana hold/punish controller during a real frontal Deflect.
 if type(CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting)=="function"and CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(target.Player)then
  Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickConsumed=false
  Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickLastDistance=math.huge
  return false
 end

 local frameDt=math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05)
 local solution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(target.Head,Camera.CFrame.Position)
 if not solution or typeof(solution.Screen)~="Vector2"then return false end

 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local delta=solution.Screen-center
 local distance=delta.Magnitude
 local player=target.Player
 local now=os.clock()

 if Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickPlayer~=player then
  Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickPlayer=player
  Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickConsumed=false
  Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickLastDistance=distance
  Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickLastAt=0
  Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickLastUserDelta=Vector2.new(0,0)
 end

 -- Once the crosshair leaves the head neighborhood, arm the feature for the next real flick.
 if distance>=72 then
  Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickConsumed=false
 end

 local rawDelta=Vector2.new(0,0)
 pcall(function()
  local d=UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
  rawDelta=Vector2.new(d.X,d.Y)
 end)
 Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickLastUserDelta=rawDelta

 local oldDistance=tonumber(Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickLastDistance)or math.huge
 Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickLastDistance=distance

 if Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickConsumed==true then return false end
 if distance<5.0 or distance>46 then return false end

 -- "Player flick" gate:
 -- 1) actual mouse movement this frame,
 -- 2) movement direction points toward the head,
 -- 3) the current/predicted gap is genuinely shrinking.
 local manualMag=rawDelta.Magnitude
 if manualMag<3.8 or delta.Magnitude<=.001 then return false end

 local directionDot=rawDelta.Unit:Dot(delta.Unit)
 if directionDot<.58 then return false end

 local predictedDistance=(delta-rawDelta).Magnitude
 local shrinkNow=oldDistance-distance
 local shrinkPredicted=distance-predictedDistance
 if shrinkNow<.7 and shrinkPredicted<1.15 then return false end

 -- Reject slow ordinary tracking.  Threshold is intentionally modest so a short 15-30 px
 -- human flick can still qualify at high FPS.
 local manualSpeed=manualMag/frameDt
 if manualSpeed<230 then return false end

 -- One short visible correction.  Near the head it almost closes the gap; farther out it
 -- contributes at most ~16.5 px and then gives control straight back to the player.
 local leavePixels=2.4
 local correctionMag=math.max(0,distance-leavePixels)
 correctionMag=math.min(correctionMag,16.5)
 if correctionMag<1 then return false end

 local correction=delta.Unit*correctionMag
 local sx=correction.X>=0 and math.floor(correction.X+.5)or math.ceil(correction.X-.5)
 local sy=correction.Y>=0 and math.floor(correction.Y+.5)or math.ceil(correction.Y-.5)
 if sx==0 and sy==0 then return false end

 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  pcall(mousemoverel,sx,sy)
 elseif Camera then
  Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(-sy*.0009,-sx*.0009,0)
 end

 Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickConsumed=true
 Runtime.RivalsManualSniperFlickLastAt=now
 Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
 Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false

 -- The player's own flick is already a real reaction; do not add another artificial delay.
 Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=0
 return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_AimNativeFireOnce()
 if not CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled()then return false end
 if Runtime.MouseDown==true then return false end
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 local kind=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
 if kind=="melee"then return false end
 if kind=="sniper"then
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperBoltCycleActive(item)then return false end
  if not CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperScopeReady(item)then return false end
 end
 -- Do not spend the Aim-Assist retry window on a native cooldown rejection.
 -- A failed attempt is retried on the next frame; only an ACCEPTED shot starts our interval.
 local nativeDue=item and rawget(item,"_shoot_cooldown")or nil
 if typeof(nativeDue)=="number"and tick()<nativeDue then return false end
 Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeGate=true
 Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeTarget=Runtime.RivalsAimTarget
 local nativeOK,fired=pcall(CVU_RIVALS_NativeItemInput,item,"StartShooting")
 Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeGate=false
 Runtime.RivalsAutoFireKatanaNativeTarget=nil
 if not nativeOK then return false end
 if fired then
  if kind=="sniper"then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ArmSniperBoltCycle,item)end
  task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_RIVALS_NativeItemInput,item,"FinishShooting")end)
 end
 return fired
end

function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateAimAssist(dt)
 local rivalsCombatActive=type(CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive)=="function"and CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalCombatActive()or false
 if Settings.RivalsAimAssist~=true or Runtime.Shutdown or not rivalsCombatActive then
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ForceLobbyAimReset)
  if type(CVU_RIVALS_ResetMeleeAimBehavior)=="function"then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetMeleeAimBehavior,true)end
  return
 end
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 local now=os.clock()
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 local weaponSignature,kind=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponSignature(item)
 local earlyAimStyle=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyle()
 local uncleSniperAiming=kind=="sniper"and earlyAimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"and CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperAiming(item)
 Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperADSActive=uncleSniperAiming==true
 if not uncleSniperAiming then Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperScopeWasReady=false end
