 -- V49: after a real sniper shot is accepted, the native bolt/cycle window owns the mouse.
 -- No target pull, head-edge correction, chain handoff, or warm-pull is allowed until the
 -- weapon's own cooldown says the next shot is mechanically ready.
 if kind=="sniper"and CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperBoltCycleActive(item)then
  -- V54: bolt-cycle still suppresses target logic, but does not erase the 25-65 ms
  -- hand momentum that was already moving when the shot was accepted.
  if not CVU_RIVALS_ApplySniperFollowThroughCarry(dt,now)then
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  end
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperTopDownReady=false
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=false
  Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=nil Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=nil
  Runtime.RivalsHeadAimExposureCache=nil
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ClearPrecisionShotPart)
  return
 end
 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperBoltSuppressing=false
 if kind=="melee"then
  Runtime.RivalsAimWeaponSignature=weaponSignature
  CVU_RIVALS_UpdateMeleeNoLock(dt,now)
  return
 end
 -- Leaving melee cancels any unfinished horizontal carry/watch before ranged aim resumes.
 if (Runtime.RivalsMeleeOvershootRemaining or 0)>0 or Runtime.RivalsMeleeWatchCharacter or Runtime.RivalsMeleeLastMouseDown==true then
  CVU_RIVALS_ResetMeleeAimBehavior(true)
 end
 if CVU_RIVALS_UpdateSniperFollowThrough(dt,now)then return end

 -- V58: while the LOCAL ranged weapon is reloading, Aim Assist owns no target at all.
 -- Melee is handled above and is intentionally exempt.  Clearing the FOV-follow center here
 -- also prevents the free-FOV visual from continuing to trail an enemy during reload.
 if kind~="melee"and CVU_RIVALS_IsLocalReloading(item)then
  Runtime.RivalsAimReloadSuppressed=true
  Runtime.RivalsAimTarget=nil Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=0 Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0 Runtime.RivalsAimFOVVisualCenter=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAimWeaponSignature=nil Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=false
  Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=nil Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer=nil Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainSince=0
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ClearPrecisionShotPart)
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetAimMotion)
  return
 end
 Runtime.RivalsAimReloadSuppressed=false

 local target=CVU_RIVALS_FindAimTarget()
 local old=Runtime.RivalsAimTarget
 if not target then
  Runtime.RivalsAimTarget=nil Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=0 Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0 Runtime.RivalsAimFOVVisualCenter=nil
  Runtime.RivalsAimWeaponSignature=nil Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=false
  Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=nil Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=nil
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ClearPrecisionShotPart)
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetAimMotion)
  return
 end

 local weaponChanged=Runtime.RivalsAimWeaponSignature~=weaponSignature
 if not old or old.Player~=target.Player or weaponChanged then
  local styleBeforeReset=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind)
  local uncleCarry=Vector2.new(0,0)
  if (styleBeforeReset=="彈弓叔叔"or styleBeforeReset=="自訂")and not weaponChanged and old and old.Player~=target.Player then
   local oldVelocity=Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0)
   if oldVelocity.Magnitude>0 then uncleCarry=oldVelocity*.58 end
  end
  Runtime.RivalsAimTarget=target
  Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=0
  Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=false
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ClearPrecisionShotPart)
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetAimMotion)
  if styleBeforeReset=="彈弓叔叔"or styleBeforeReset=="自訂"then Runtime.RivalsUncleCarryVelocity=uncleCarry end
  kind=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_ApplyAimTimingProfile(item))
  Runtime.RivalsAimPreferHead=false
 else
  Runtime.RivalsAimTarget=target
 end

 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local follow=CVU_RIVALS_GetEffectiveAimTrackStrength()
 local desiredFOVCenter=target.Screen
 local previousFOVCenter=Runtime.RivalsAimFOVVisualCenter
 if typeof(previousFOVCenter)~="Vector2"then previousFOVCenter=center end
 local fovAlpha=1-math.exp(-(3.0+follow*8.0)*math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05))
 Runtime.RivalsAimFOVVisualCenter=previousFOVCenter:Lerp(desiredFOVCenter,fovAlpha)

 if kind=="sniper"and earlyAimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"and target.Visible==true then
  CVU_RIVALS_UpdateUncleSniperPreAimMemory(target,now)
 end

 if not target.Visible then
  -- V44 wall/peek anticipation: while the player is actively ADS-ing, hold near a short
  -- last-seen velocity projection. We never read the hidden enemy's current position.
  if uncleSniperAiming then
   local preAimWorld=CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleSniperPreAimWorld(target,now)
   if preAimWorld then
    Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=0 Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=false
    CVU_RIVALS_MoveUncleSniperWarmPull(target,dt,nil,preAimWorld,true)
    return
   end
  end
  Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=0 Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0 Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=false
  local scopedStyle=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind)
  if scopedStyle=="彈弓叔叔"or scopedStyle=="自訂"then
   Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleFilteredScreen=nil
   Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleRawScreen=nil
   Runtime.RivalsUncleRifleTargetVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
   Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperRawScreen=nil
   Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperTargetVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
  end
  Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*math.exp(-10*math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05))
  return
 end
 if (Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince or 0)<=0 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince=now
  if kind=="sniper"or kind=="crossbow"then
   local delay,reactionDistance,tier=CVU_RIVALS_GetSniperReactionDelayForTarget(target,kind)
   -- V44 Uncle: manual ADS is already the human reaction. Do not add another artificial
   -- 0.xx-second gate after the player has committed to opening the scope.
   if kind=="sniper"and earlyAimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"and uncleSniperAiming then
    Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=0
   else
    Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Settings.RivalsCheaterRage==true and 0 or delay
   end
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperCrosshairDistance=reactionDistance
   Runtime.RivalsAimSniperCrosshairTier=tier
  elseif CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind)=="自訂"and CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(kind)then
   if Settings.RivalsCheaterRage==true then
    Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=0
   else
    Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetCustomReactionDelayForTarget(target,CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled()))
   end
  elseif CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind)=="彈弓叔叔"and CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(kind)then
   -- V45: all ordinary non-sniper guns use REAL player distance and the same elite-human
   -- acquisition philosophy. Close targets react faster because their angular motion is larger.
   local worldDistance=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetUncleWorldDistanceProfile(target))
   if Settings.RivalsCheaterRage==true then
    Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=0
   elseif CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled()then
    if worldDistance<=35 then
     Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.060,.090)
    elseif worldDistance<=85 then
     Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.075,.110)
    else
     Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.090,.125)
    end
   else
    if worldDistance<=35 then
     Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.095,.140)
    elseif worldDistance<=85 then
     Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.110,.160)
    else
     Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(.125,.180)
    end
   end
  elseif Settings.RivalsCheaterRage==true then
   Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=0
  end
  if kind=="sniper"and earlyAimStyle=="SWit"and CVU_RIVALS_IsTargetKatanaDeflecting(target)then
   Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay=0
  end
  local head,chest=target.Head,target.Chest
  if head and chest then
   local hp=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
   local cp=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(chest.Position)
   local hd=(Vector2.new(hp.X,hp.Y)-center).Magnitude
   local cd=(Vector2.new(cp.X,cp.Y)-center).Magnitude
   Runtime.RivalsAimPreferHead=hd<=cd and hd<=95
  end
  -- V73: if the PLAYER is already manually flicking the sniper toward this head, that
  -- physical mouse motion itself counts as the reaction.  Near-head correction may happen
  -- even on this first visible frame; otherwise normal profiles still observe one frame.
  local manualFlickCorrected=CVU_RIVALS_TryManualSniperFlickCorrection(target,kind,dt)
  if manualFlickCorrected then return end

  -- Normal profiles still spend at least one render frame observing a new target.
  -- V44 Uncle Sniper is the exception: starting ADS already expresses the player's reaction,
  -- so warm-pull begins on this same frame instead of visibly waiting and then creeping.
  local immediateUncleADS=kind=="sniper"and earlyAimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"and uncleSniperAiming
  if Settings.RivalsCheaterRage~=true and not immediateUncleADS then return end
 end

 -- V73 subsequent reaction frames: continue watching only for a genuine user flick.
 -- Triggering it zeroes the remaining artificial reaction delay, then returns control next frame.
 if CVU_RIVALS_TryManualSniperFlickCorrection(target,kind,dt)then return end

 if not(kind=="sniper"and earlyAimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"and uncleSniperAiming)
 and now-Runtime.RivalsAimVisibleSince<(Runtime.RivalsAimReactionDelay or .7)then return end

 -- Sniper and Crossbow share the screen-space reaction and top-down head path.
 -- <=120 px uses 0.20 s; both 120-300 px and 300-500 px use randomized 0.30-0.50 s.
 -- Only the Sniper keeps the native ADS/focus gate; Crossbow follows its native fire readiness.
 local precisionKind=kind=="sniper"or kind=="crossbow"
 local precisionPart=nil
 if precisionKind then
  precisionPart=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetPrecisionShotPart(target,kind))
  local origin=Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or nil
  local precisionVisible=precisionPart and typeof(origin)=="Vector3"and CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,precisionPart)or false
  local scopeReady=kind~="sniper"or CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperScopeReady(item)
  local chainActive=kind=="sniper"and Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer==target.Player
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=kind=="sniper"and scopeReady or false
  if not precisionVisible then
   Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*math.exp(-14*math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05))
   if chainActive then Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer=nil Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainSince=0 end
   return
  end
  if kind=="sniper"and earlyAimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"and uncleSniperAiming and not scopeReady and not chainActive then
   -- Native focus-in / blurry-scope phase: start moving NOW, but never fire before scope-ready.
   Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperScopeWasReady=false
   if (Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt or 0)<=0 then Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=now end
   CVU_RIVALS_MoveUncleSniperWarmPull(target,dt,precisionPart,nil,false)
   return
  end
  if kind=="sniper"and not scopeReady and not chainActive then
   Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=0
   Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity=(Runtime.RivalsAimMoveVelocity or Vector2.new(0,0))*math.exp(-14*math.clamp(tonumber(dt)or 1/60,1/240,.05))
   return
  end
  if kind=="sniper"and earlyAimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"and scopeReady then
   if Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperScopeWasReady~=true then
    -- First fully-focused frame: preserve warm-pull hand velocity, but force a fresh
    -- flick phase from the CURRENT crosshair position. No second reaction timer.
    Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPlayer=nil
    Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPart=nil
    Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhase=nil
    Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperPhaseStarted=0
    Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperRawScreen=nil
    Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperTargetVelocity=Vector2.new(0,0)
    Runtime.RivalsUncleSniperScopeWasReady=true
   end
  end
 else
  Runtime.RivalsAimSniperScopeReady=false
 end

 if (Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt or 0)<=0 then
  Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt=now
  local hum=LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if hum and hum.FloorMaterial==Enum.Material.Air and kind~="sniper"and kind~="crossbow"then Runtime.RivalsAimDuration=Runtime.RivalsAimRandom:NextNumber(1.8,2.0)end
 end
 local elapsed=now-(Runtime.RivalsAimStartedAt or now)
 local progress=math.clamp(elapsed/math.max(Runtime.RivalsAimDuration or 1,.05),0,1)
 local aimStyle=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyleForKind(kind)
 local uncleStableGun=aimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"and CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(kind)
 local customStableGun=aimStyle=="自訂"and CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(kind)
 local coraxRifle=aimStyle=="SWit"and(kind=="rifle"or kind=="burst")
 local aimPos=nil
 if precisionKind then
  aimPos=(precisionPart or target.Head or target.Chest or target.TrackPart).Position
 elseif uncleStableGun or customStableGun then
  -- V45 stable non-sniper path computes its own root-anchored aim corridor inside the
  -- controller exactly once per frame; do not double-filter it here.
  aimPos=nil
 elseif coraxRifle then
  -- Corax-style rifle tracking lives around the head/neck/upper-chest corridor rather
  -- than deterministically sweeping chest -> head over one fixed duration.
  local chest=target.Chest or target.TrackPart or target.Head
  local head=target.Head or chest
  if chest and head then
   local upperBlend=Runtime.RivalsAimPreferHead==true and .80 or .68
   aimPos=chest.Position:Lerp(head.Position,upperBlend)
  elseif head or chest then
   aimPos=(head or chest).Position
  else
   return
  end
 elseif Runtime.RivalsAimPreferHead then
  aimPos=(target.Head or target.Chest or target.TrackPart).Position
 else
  local chest=target.Chest or target.TrackPart
  local head=target.Head or chest
  local smooth=progress*progress*(3-2*progress)
  aimPos=chest.Position:Lerp(head.Position,smooth)
 end
 local sniperFlick=kind=="sniper"or kind=="crossbow"
 local fast=sniperFlick or((aimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"or aimStyle=="自訂")and progress>.72)
 local sniperTopDownReady=true
 if kind=="sniper"and(aimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"or aimStyle=="自訂")then
  sniperTopDownReady=CVU_RIVALS_MoveUncleSlingshotSniper(target,dt,precisionPart)
 elseif kind=="sniper"and aimStyle=="SWit"then
  -- V46 SWIt: direct head flick is the main path; ~30% keeps a real overshoot/correction.
  sniperTopDownReady=CVU_RIVALS_MoveSlingshotSniper(target,dt,precisionPart)
 elseif sniperFlick then
  -- Crossbow keeps the proven V36 precision path.
  sniperTopDownReady=CVU_RIVALS_MoveSniperTopDown(target,dt,precisionPart,kind)
 elseif uncleStableGun or customStableGun then
  CVU_RIVALS_MoveStableNonSniperGun(target,kind,dt)
 elseif coraxRifle then
  -- SWIt rifle remains on the exact V37 controller.
  CVU_RIVALS_MoveSlingshotRifle(target,aimPos,dt)
 else
  CVU_RIVALS_MoveAimToward(aimPos,dt,fast,false)
 end

 -- V49: once the sniper controller reports a genuine head/visible-edge lock, keep that
 -- fire permission alive for a few render frames.  This prevents a one-frame replication
 -- wobble from deleting the shot before native StartShooting has a chance to accept it.
 if kind=="sniper"then
  if sniperTopDownReady==true and precisionPart then
   CVU_RIVALS_ArmSniperFireLatch(target,precisionPart,now)
  elseif Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchPlayer~=target.Player or Runtime.RivalsAimSniperFireLatchPart~=precisionPart then
   CVU_RIVALS_ClearSniperFireLatch()
  end
 end

 if CVU_RIVALS_IsAimAutoFireEnabled()then
  -- Exact Primary-only Anti-Katana rule.
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsPrimaryItem(item)and CVU_RIVALS_IsTargetKatanaEquipped(target)then
   pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit)
   Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="Primary Auto-fire｜敵人持 Katana｜禁止射擊"
   return
  end
  local switMissReady=kind=="sniper"and aimStyle=="SWit"and Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady==true

  -- V52 Auto-fire reliability: test the REAL crosshair/head contact before trusting the
  -- motion-controller ready flag.  Previously the function returned above this point when
  -- sniperTopDownReady lagged one frame behind the visible lock, producing the "aimed at
  -- the head but just stares" failure.
  if kind=="sniper"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperScopeReady(item)then return end
  if kind=="crossbow"and sniperTopDownReady~=true then return end
  local autoPreferred=precisionPart
  if not autoPreferred and(uncleStableGun or customStableGun)then autoPreferred=CVU_RIVALS_GetStableGunPreferredPart(target,kind)end
  local fireContact=CVU_RIVALS_FindAutoFireContact(target,kind,autoPreferred,dt)

  -- A genuine current-frame head/visible-edge contact becomes authoritative fire evidence
  -- and arms the existing short retry latch.  If native cooldown rejects this exact frame,
  -- Auto-fire gets a few render frames to retry instead of forgetting that the crosshair
  -- really reached the head.
  if kind=="sniper"and fireContact and fireContact.Inside==true and fireContact.Part then
   CVU_RIVALS_ArmSniperFireLatch(target,fireContact.Part,now)
  end
  local sniperFireLatched=kind=="sniper"and CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperFireLatched(target,precisionPart,now)

  -- Keep SWIt's intentional overshoot personality: while the initial overshoot flick is
  -- still travelling past the head, crossing the hit zone does not cancel the planned
  -- overshoot.  Once the path is in pause/correct (or on a direct shot), real contact can
  -- authorize the shot even if the controller-ready boolean is one frame late.
  local switOvershootFlick=false
  if kind=="sniper"and aimStyle=="SWit"then
   local switVariant=tostring(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperVariant or"")
   switOvershootFlick=string.find(switVariant,"overshoot",1,true)~=nil and tostring(Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperPhase or"")=="flick"
  end
  local switNaturalCrossing=kind=="sniper"and aimStyle=="SWit"
   and Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalFollowThroughPending==true
   and now<=(tonumber(Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingUntil)or 0)
   and Runtime.RivalsSWItNaturalCrossingPlayer==target.Player
  local realContactReady=fireContact and fireContact.Inside==true and(not switOvershootFlick or switNaturalCrossing)

  -- V63: the retry latch preserves timing only; it may not manufacture a loose edge hit.
  -- Re-check the same strict head-only contact rule used by the current frame.
  if not fireContact and sniperFireLatched and precisionPart and CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(precisionPart)then
   local retryContact=CVU_RIVALS_FindAutoFireContact(target,"sniper",precisionPart,dt)
   if retryContact and retryContact.Inside==true then
    fireContact=retryContact
    if not switOvershootFlick or switNaturalCrossing then realContactReady=true end
   end
  end

  if kind=="sniper"and sniperTopDownReady~=true and not sniperFireLatched and not switMissReady and not realContactReady then return end
  local info=item and rawget(item,"Info")or nil
  local cd=type(info)=="table"and(tonumber(info.ShootCooldown)or tonumber(info.ShootBurstCooldown))or nil
  local precisionKind=kind=="sniper"or kind=="crossbow"
  local interval=math.max(cd or(kind=="sniper"and .45 or(kind=="crossbow"and .35 or .10)),kind=="sniper"and .34 or(kind=="crossbow"and .12 or .055))
  local switPlannedMiss=switMissReady
  if switPlannedMiss then
   if now-(Runtime.RivalsAimLastAutoFire or 0)>=interval then
    -- A deliberate long-range miss must be a real miss, not an accidental chest/right-hand hit.
    if not CVU_RIVALS_IsCrosshairClearOfTargetBody(target)then return end
    if not CVU_RIVALS_AutoFireKatanaCommitReady(target,now)then return end
    Runtime.RivalsSWItPlannedMissShot=true
    Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=nil Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=nil
    local missOK,missFired=pcall(CVU_RIVALS_AimNativeFireOnce)
    Runtime.RivalsSWItPlannedMissShot=false
    if missOK and missFired==true then
     pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit)
     Runtime.RivalsAimLastAutoFire=now
     Runtime.RivalsSlingshotSniperMissReady=false
     CVU_RIVALS_ClearSniperFireLatch()
    end
   end
   return
  end
  if fireContact and fireContact.Inside==true then
   if now-(Runtime.RivalsAimLastAutoFire or 0)>=interval then
    local forcedPart=fireContact.Part
    local forcedPosition=fireContact.WorldPosition

    -- V63 final sniper gate: recompute the STRICT head-only contact immediately before native
    -- StartShooting.  This prevents a one-frame arm/chest crossing or a visual head-rim touch
    -- from being converted into a body shot.  >50% exposure always resolves to head center.
    if kind=="sniper"then
     if not forcedPart or not CVU_RIVALS_IsHeadPart(forcedPart)then return end
     local strictContact=CVU_RIVALS_FindAutoFireContact(target,"sniper",forcedPart,dt)
     if not strictContact or strictContact.Inside~=true then return end
     forcedPart=strictContact.Part
     forcedPosition=strictContact.WorldPosition
     fireContact=strictContact
    end

    -- Final simple Katana holding-state gate before native StartShooting.
    if not CVU_RIVALS_AutoFireKatanaCommitReady(target,now)then return end

    Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=forcedPart
    Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=forcedPosition
    local fireOK,fired=pcall(CVU_RIVALS_AimNativeFireOnce)
    Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=nil Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=nil
    if fireOK and fired==true then
     pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit)
     -- IMPORTANT: only an actually accepted native shot consumes the Aim-Assist interval.
     -- If StartShooting rejects this frame, the lock remains armed and retries next frame.
     Runtime.RivalsAimLastAutoFire=now
     if kind=="sniper"then
      CVU_RIVALS_ClearSniperFireLatch()
      Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainPlayer=nil Runtime.RivalsAimSniperChainSince=0
      pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ArmSniperFollowThrough,target)
     end
    end
   end
  elseif (uncleStableGun or customStableGun)and CVU_RIVALS_ShouldStableGunGrazeMiss(target,kind)then
   -- One acquisition-level edge miss: fire natively with NO forced candidate, so the
   -- shot follows the current crosshair just outside the head hitbox, then the intent
   -- commits to head and immediately corrects on the next frame.
   if now-(Runtime.RivalsAimLastAutoFire or 0)>=interval then
    if not CVU_RIVALS_AutoFireKatanaCommitReady(target,now)then return end
    Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPart=nil Runtime.RivalsAimForcedShotPosition=nil
    local grazeOK,grazeFired=pcall(CVU_RIVALS_AimNativeFireOnce)
    if grazeOK and grazeFired==true then
     pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ResetKatanaPreFireCommit)
     Runtime.RivalsAimLastAutoFire=now
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_InstallShotRedirectHook()
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
if Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectHookInstalled then return true end
local utility=Runtime.RivalsUtility
if type(utility)~="table"or type(utility.Raycast)~="function"then
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="RIVALS 射線改道：找不到 Utility.Raycast"
return false
end
Runtime.RivalsOriginalUtilityRaycast=utility.Raycast
local original=Runtime.RivalsOriginalUtilityRaycast
utility.Raycast=function(self,origin,direction,distance,...)
local candidate=Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectCandidate
if Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectActive==true
and candidate and candidate.Part and candidate.Part.Parent
and tick()<=(Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectUntil or 0)
and not CVU_RIVALS_IsTargetKatanaDeflecting(candidate)then
local targetPos=typeof(candidate.Position)=="Vector3"and candidate.Position or candidate.Part.Position
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectCount=(Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectCount or 0)+1
return original(self,origin,targetPos,distance,...)
end
return original(self,origin,direction,distance,...)
end
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectHookInstalled=true
return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_RestoreShotRedirectHook()
local utility=Runtime.RivalsUtility
if type(utility)=="table"and type(Runtime.RivalsOriginalUtilityRaycast)=="function"then
pcall(function()utility.Raycast=Runtime.RivalsOriginalUtilityRaycast end)
end
Runtime.RivalsOriginalUtilityRaycast=nil
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectHookInstalled=false
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectActive=false
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectCandidate=nil
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectOrigin=nil
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectUntil=0
end

function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateShotRedirectHookLifecycle()
if Settings.PseudoWallPenetration==true or Settings.RivalsRageCurveEnabled==true or Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true then
return CVU_RIVALS_InstallShotRedirectHook()
end
CVU_RIVALS_RestoreShotRedirectHook()
return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_BuildWallInner(candidate,originPos)
if not candidate or not candidate.Part then return nil end
if typeof(originPos)~="Vector3"then return nil end
local targetPos=typeof(candidate.Position)=="Vector3"and candidate.Position or candidate.Part.Position
local look=CFrame.lookAt(originPos,targetPos)
local offsetCF=candidate.Part.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(CFrame.new(targetPos))
local encodedLook=CVU_RIVALS_EncodeCFrame(look)
local encodedOffset=CVU_RIVALS_EncodeCFrame(offsetCF)
if encodedLook==nil or encodedOffset==nil then return nil end
return{
[utf8.char(0)]=encodedLook,
[utf8.char(1)]=encodedLook,
[utf8.char(2)]=candidate.Part,
[utf8.char(3)]=encodedOffset,
}
end
function CVU_RIVALS_BuildWallRemoteData(candidate,knownOrigin)
local originPos=knownOrigin
if typeof(originPos)~="Vector3"and Camera then originPos=Camera.CFrame.Position end
local inner=CVU_RIVALS_BuildWallInner(candidate,originPos)
if not inner then return nil end
return{[utf8.char(1)]=inner}
end

function CVU_RIVALS_InjectWallCandidateIntoStartResult(packed,candidate,originPos)
if type(packed)~="table"or not candidate then return false end
local camdata=packed[3]
if type(camdata)~="table"then return false end
if CVU_RIVALS_IsTargetKatanaDeflecting(candidate)then return false end
if typeof(originPos)~="Vector3"and Camera then originPos=Camera.CFrame.Position end
if typeof(originPos)~="Vector3"then return false end
local inner=CVU_RIVALS_BuildWallInner(candidate,originPos)
if not inner then return false end

local destination=camdata
if type(camdata[utf8.char(1)])=="table"then destination=camdata[utf8.char(1)]end
for key,value in pairs(inner)do destination[key]=value end
if Runtime.RivalsForcedWallCandidate and Runtime.RivalsForcedCurveVisible~=true then
 packed[4]=true
 packed.n=math.max(tonumber(packed.n)or 0,4)
end
Runtime.RivalsPendingRemoteCandidate=candidate
Runtime.RivalsPendingRemoteUntil=tick()+.12

local rate=Runtime.RivalsForcedCurveVisible==true and 30 or(tonumber(Settings.GunModRate)or 12)
CVU_RIVALS_MarkPendingTarget(candidate.Player,rate)
Runtime.PseudoWallLastTarget=candidate.Player
local redirectLabel=candidate.RageCurve and"RIVALS 暴怒子彈轉彎180：露出部位即射→"or(candidate.AimAssist and"RIVALS Aim Assist：shot correction→"or"RIVALS 子彈轉彎：visible ray + cameraData→")
Runtime.PseudoWallStatus=redirectLabel..tostring(candidate.Player and candidate.Player.Name or"enemy").."｜"..tostring(candidate.Part and candidate.Part.Name or Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or"自動")
if candidate.RageCurve then Runtime.RivalsRageCurveStatus=Runtime.PseudoWallStatus end
return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_InjectWallIntoStartResult(packed)
local candidate=Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectCandidate
local originPos=Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectOrigin
if not candidate then return false end
if typeof(originPos)~="Vector3"and Camera then originPos=Camera.CFrame.Position end
return CVU_RIVALS_InjectWallCandidateIntoStartResult(packed,candidate,originPos)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_FindAntiKatanaRedirectTarget(origin,blockedPlayer)
 if Settings.RivalsAimAssist~=true or typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or not Camera then return nil end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local fov=CVU_RIVALS_GetEffectiveAimFOV()
 local best=nil
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if player~=blockedPlayer and CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)and not CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(player)then
   local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
   local head,chest=CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoTargetParts(character)
   local part=head or chest
   if part and CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,part)then
    local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    if on and p.Z>0 then
     local sd=(Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)-center).Magnitude
     if sd<=fov then
      local score=sd+(part.Position-origin).Magnitude*.001
      if not best or score<best.Score then
       best={Player=player,Character=character,Part=part,Position=part.Position,Distance=(part.Position-origin).Magnitude,Score=score,Visible=true,AimAssist=true,AntiKatanaRedirect=true}
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

-- ============================================================
-- Unified RIVALS Gun.StartShooting hook V3
-- The wall target is selected BEFORE native StartShooting, so Utility.Raycast inside the native
-- shot and the returned cameraData are redirected to the exact same target.
-- ============================================================
function CVU_RIVALS_InstallStartShootingHook()
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
if Runtime.RivalsStartShootingHookInstalled then return true end
local gun=Runtime.RivalsGunModule
if type(gun)~="table"or type(gun.StartShooting)~="function"then
Runtime.GunModFireStatus="RIVALS：找不到 Gun.StartShooting"
return false
end
local original=gun.StartShooting
Runtime.RivalsOriginalStartShooting=original
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_UpdateShotRedirectHookLifecycle)

gun.StartShooting=function(self,...)
local isLocal=self and self.ClientFighter and self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer==true
local forced=Runtime.RivalsForcedWallCandidate
local plannedAimMiss=isLocal and Runtime.RivalsSWItPlannedMissShot==true

-- Restored simple policy: no startup-prediction gate.
-- Final simple Katana holding check at native StartShooting.
-- Secondary and Melee exceptions are handled by CVU_RIVALS_ShouldBlockManualShot().
if isLocal and not forced and Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true then
 local blocked,player=CVU_RIVALS_ShouldBlockManualShot()
 if blocked then
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaBlockedShots=(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaBlockedShots or 0)+1
  Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="敵人持有 Katana｜禁止這一發｜"..tostring(player and player.Name or"Katana")
  return false
 end
end

local candidate=nil
local packetOrigin=nil
if isLocal then
if forced and forced.Part and forced.Part.Parent and not CVU_RIVALS_IsTargetKatanaDeflecting(forced)then
candidate=forced
packetOrigin=Runtime.RivalsForcedWallOrigin
elseif Settings.PseudoWallPenetration==true then
local origin=Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or nil
if typeof(origin)=="Vector3"then candidate=CVU_RIVALS_FindCurveTarget(origin) packetOrigin=origin end
elseif Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true and not plannedAimMiss then
local origin=Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or nil
if typeof(origin)=="Vector3"then candidate=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimShotCandidate(origin) packetOrigin=origin end
end
if candidate then
if forced and typeof(packetOrigin)~="Vector3"and Camera then packetOrigin=Camera.CFrame.Position end
if not forced and typeof(packetOrigin)~="Vector3"and Camera then packetOrigin=Camera.CFrame.Position end
if typeof(packetOrigin)=="Vector3"then
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InstallShotRedirectHook)
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectCandidate=candidate
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectOrigin=packetOrigin
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectUntil=tick()+.18
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectActive=true
else
candidate=nil
end
end
end

local info=isLocal and rawget(self,"Info")or nil
local rapidBackup=nil
if isLocal and Settings.GunModEnabled==true and type(info)=="table"then
local requested=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.GunModRate)or 12)+.5),4,50)
local rate=type(CVU_RIVALS_GetAdaptiveFireRate)=="function"and CVU_RIVALS_GetAdaptiveFireRate(self,requested)or requested
local interval=1/math.max(rate,1)
rapidBackup={}
for _,key in ipairs({"ShootCooldown","ShootBurstCooldown","BurstCooldown","InternalUseCooldown"})do
local value=rawget(info,key)
if typeof(value)=="number"then rapidBackup[key]=value info[key]=interval end
end
pcall(function()if rawget(self,"_shoot_cooldown")~=nil then local now=tick() local due=self._shoot_cooldown if typeof(due)~="number"or due>now+interval then self._shoot_cooldown=now+interval end end end)
pcall(function()if rawget(self,"_shoot_cooldown_no_ammo")~=nil then local now=tick() local limit=now+math.max(.1,interval) local due=self._shoot_cooldown_no_ammo if typeof(due)~="number"or due>limit then self._shoot_cooldown_no_ammo=limit end end end)
pcall(function()if rawget(self,"_is_input_queueing")~=nil then self._is_input_queueing=false end end)
end

local packed=table.pack(original(self,...))

if rapidBackup and type(info)=="table"then
for key,value in pairs(rapidBackup)do info[key]=value end
end

if isLocal and candidate and packed[1]~=false then
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InjectWallCandidateIntoStartResult,packed,candidate,packetOrigin)
end

-- Advance the per-shot precision decision only after native StartShooting actually
-- accepted the shot. This keeps Crossbow's 10-shot 2-3 chest cycle exact and also
-- rerolls the elevated Sniper body-part variation once per real shot, not per frame.
if isLocal and packed[1]~=false then
 local shotKind=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(self)
 -- V49 manual and automatic sniper shots both enter the same native bolt/cycle pause.
 if shotKind=="sniper"and Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true then
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ArmSniperBoltCycle,self)
 end
 if Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true then
  if Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotPart and Runtime.RivalsAimPrecisionShotKind==shotKind then
   pcall(CVU_RIVALS_CommitPrecisionShot,shotKind)
  end
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsStableNonSniperGunKind(shotKind)then
   pcall(CVU_RIVALS_CommitStableGunShot,shotKind)
  end
 end
end

Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectActive=false
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectCandidate=nil
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectOrigin=nil
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectUntil=0
Runtime.RivalsSWItPlannedMissShot=false
return table.unpack(packed,1,packed.n)
end

Runtime.RivalsStartShootingHookInstalled=true
return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_RestoreStartShootingHook()
local gun=Runtime.RivalsGunModule
if type(gun)=="table"and type(Runtime.RivalsOriginalStartShooting)=="function"then
pcall(function()gun.StartShooting=Runtime.RivalsOriginalStartShooting end)
end
Runtime.RivalsOriginalStartShooting=nil
Runtime.RivalsStartShootingHookInstalled=false
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectActive=false
Runtime.RivalsShotRedirectCandidate=nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateStartShootingHookLifecycle()
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_UpdateShotRedirectHookLifecycle)
if Settings.GunModEnabled==true or Settings.PseudoWallPenetration==true or Settings.RivalsRageCurveEnabled==true or Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true then
return CVU_RIVALS_InstallStartShootingHook()
end
CVU_RIVALS_RestoreStartShootingHook()
return true
end

-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS rapid fire V5 — per-weapon adaptive server cadence
-- Slider is a REQUESTED MAXIMUM.  Each weapon gets a conservative cap from its original cooldown,
-- magazine size and weapon family, so a 4-round Sniper is never spammed at rifle cadence.
-- ============================================================
Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals=Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive=false

function CVU_RIVALS_RememberRapidOriginal(tbl,key)
 Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals=Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 local saved=Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals[tbl]
 if not saved then saved={}Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals[tbl]=saved end
 if saved[key]==nil then local value=rawget(tbl,key)if typeof(value)=="number"then saved[key]=value end end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetRapidOriginal(tbl,key)
 local saved=Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals and Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals[tbl]
 local value=saved and saved[key]or rawget(tbl,key)
 return typeof(value)=="number"and value or nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetAdaptiveFireRate(itemOrInfo,requested,nameHint)
 requested=math.clamp(tonumber(requested)or 12,1,50)
 local item=(type(itemOrInfo)=="table"and rawget(itemOrInfo,"Info"))and itemOrInfo or nil
 local info=item and rawget(item,"Info")or itemOrInfo
 if type(info)~="table"then return math.min(requested,12)end
 local name=tostring(nameHint or(item and rawget(item,"Name"))or info.DisplayName or info.Name or info.ItemName or"")
 local lower=string.lower(name)
 local familyCap=15
 if string.find(lower,"sniper",1,true)then familyCap=2.5
 elseif string.find(lower,"bow",1,true)then familyCap=2.0
 elseif string.find(lower,"rpg",1,true)or string.find(lower,"launcher",1,true)then familyCap=1.5
 elseif string.find(lower,"shotgun",1,true)then familyCap=3.5
 elseif string.find(lower,"revolver",1,true)then familyCap=4.5
 elseif string.find(lower,"handgun",1,true)or string.find(lower,"pistol",1,true)then familyCap=10
 elseif string.find(lower,"burst",1,true)then familyCap=12
 elseif string.find(lower,"assault",1,true)or string.find(lower,"rifle",1,true)or string.find(lower,"smg",1,true)or string.find(lower,"energy",1,true)then familyCap=20 end
 local nativeCooldown=CVU_RIVALS_GetRapidOriginal(info,"ShootCooldown")or CVU_RIVALS_GetRapidOriginal(info,"ShootBurstCooldown")or rawget(info,"ShootCooldown")or rawget(info,"ShootBurstCooldown")
 local nativeRate=(typeof(nativeCooldown)=="number"and nativeCooldown>.001)and(1/nativeCooldown)or nil
 local maxAmmo=tonumber(rawget(info,"MaxAmmo"))
 if not maxAmmo and item and type(item.Get)=="function"then pcall(function()maxAmmo=tonumber(item:Get("MaxAmmo"))end)end
 local magCap=maxAmmo and math.max(1.5,maxAmmo/1.5)or 50
 local accelCap=nativeRate and math.max(nativeRate,nativeRate*2.0)or 50
 local effective=math.min(requested,familyCap,magCap,accelCap)
 if nativeRate then effective=math.max(math.min(nativeRate,requested),effective)end
 return math.clamp(effective,1,20)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ApplyRapidTable(tbl,requested,nameHint)
 if type(tbl)~="table"then return 0,nil end
 for _,key in ipairs({"ShootCooldown","ShootBurstCooldown","BurstCooldown","InternalUseCooldown","Cooldown","RecoveryTime","ResetTime"})do
  if typeof(rawget(tbl,key))=="number"then CVU_RIVALS_RememberRapidOriginal(tbl,key)end
 end
 local rate=CVU_RIVALS_GetAdaptiveFireRate(tbl,requested,nameHint)
 local interval=1/math.max(rate,1)
 local changed=0
 for _,key in ipairs({"ShootCooldown","ShootBurstCooldown","BurstCooldown","InternalUseCooldown"})do
  local original=CVU_RIVALS_GetRapidOriginal(tbl,key)
  if original then tbl[key]=math.min(original,interval)changed+=1 end
 end
 for _,key in ipairs({"Cooldown","RecoveryTime","ResetTime"})do
  local original=CVU_RIVALS_GetRapidOriginal(tbl,key)
  if original then tbl[key]=math.min(original,interval)changed+=1 end
 end
 return changed,rate
end

function CVU_GunModApplyFireRates()
 if Settings.GunModEnabled~=true then return false end
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InstallStartShootingHook)
 local requested=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.GunModRate)or 12)+.5),4,50)
 Settings.GunModRate=requested
 local library=Runtime.RivalsItemLibrary
 local root=type(library)=="table"and(type(library.Items)=="table"and library.Items or library)or nil
 local applied=0
 if type(root)=="table"then
  for name,tbl in pairs(root)do if type(tbl)=="table"then local n=CVU_RIVALS_ApplyRapidTable(tbl,requested,tostring(name))applied+=n end end
 end
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 local info=item and rawget(item,"Info")or nil
 local effective=math.min(requested,12)
 if type(info)=="table"then local n,r=CVU_RIVALS_ApplyRapidTable(info,requested,item and item.Name)applied+=n effective=r or effective end
 if item then
  local interval=1/math.max(effective,1)
  local now=tick()
  pcall(function()local due=rawget(item,"_shoot_cooldown")if typeof(due)=="number"and due>now+interval then item._shoot_cooldown=now+interval end end)
  pcall(function()local due=rawget(item,"_shoot_cooldown_no_ammo")if typeof(due)=="number"and due>now+math.max(.1,interval)then item._shoot_cooldown_no_ammo=now+math.max(.1,interval)end end)
 end
 Runtime.GunModAppliedCount=applied
 Runtime.GunModAppliedInterval=1/math.max(effective,1)
 Runtime.GunModEffectiveRate=effective
 Runtime.GunModFireStatus="RIVALS 快速射擊｜要求 "..tostring(requested).."/s｜目前武器安全值 "..string.format("%.1f",effective).."/s"
 return applied>0
end

function CVU_GunModRestoreFireRates()
 local restored=0
 for tbl,saved in pairs(Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals or{})do
  if type(tbl)=="table"and type(saved)=="table"then for key,value in pairs(saved)do tbl[key]=value restored+=1 end end
 end
 Runtime.RivalsRapidOriginals=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
 Runtime.GunModAppliedCount=0 Runtime.GunModAppliedInterval=nil Runtime.GunModEffectiveRate=nil
 Runtime.GunModFireStatus="RIVALS 快速射擊：OFF｜已還原原生 cooldown"
 return restored
end

function CVU_RIVALS_RapidNativeInputPulse()
 if Settings.GunModEnabled~=true then return false end
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 if Settings.RivalsAntiKatana==true then local blocked=CVU_RIVALS_ShouldBlockManualShot()if blocked then return false end end
 local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
 if not mechanics or type(mechanics.EquippedItemInput)~="function"then return false end
 return pcall(mechanics.EquippedItemInput,mechanics,"StartShooting")
end

function CVU_GunModSetEnabled(enabled)
 Settings.GunModEnabled=enabled==true
 Settings.GunModRate=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.GunModRate)or 12)+.5),4,50)
 if Runtime.RivalsRapidStepped then pcall(function()Runtime.RivalsRapidStepped:Disconnect()end)Runtime.RivalsRapidStepped=nil end
 if Runtime.RivalsRapidHeartbeat then pcall(function()Runtime.RivalsRapidHeartbeat:Disconnect()end)Runtime.RivalsRapidHeartbeat=nil end
 if Settings.GunModEnabled then
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend) pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InstallStartShootingHook) CVU_GunModApplyFireRates()
  Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive=false Runtime.RivalsRapidNextInput=0
  Runtime.RivalsRapidStepped=RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()if Runtime.Shutdown or Settings.GunModEnabled~=true then return end pcall(CVU_GunModApplyFireRates)end)
  Runtime.RivalsRapidHeartbeat=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
   if Runtime.Shutdown or Settings.GunModEnabled~=true then return end
   local held=Runtime.MouseDown==true
   if not held then pcall(function()held=UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)end)end
   local now=os.clock()
   local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
   local requested=math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(Settings.GunModRate)or 12)+.5),4,50)
   local effective=CVU_RIVALS_GetAdaptiveFireRate(item or{},requested)
   local interval=1/math.max(effective,1)
   Runtime.GunModEffectiveRate=effective Runtime.GunModAppliedInterval=interval
   if held then
    if Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive~=true then Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive=true Runtime.RivalsRapidNextInput=now+interval
    elseif now>=(Runtime.RivalsRapidNextInput or 0)then Runtime.RivalsRapidNextInput=now+interval pcall(CVU_RIVALS_RapidNativeInputPulse)end
   elseif Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive==true then
    Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive=false Runtime.RivalsRapidNextInput=0
    local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
    if mechanics and type(mechanics.EquippedItemInput)=="function"then pcall(mechanics.EquippedItemInput,mechanics,"FinishShooting")end
   end
  end)
 else
  local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
  if Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive and mechanics and type(mechanics.EquippedItemInput)=="function"then pcall(mechanics.EquippedItemInput,mechanics,"FinishShooting")end
  Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive=false CVU_GunModRestoreFireRates() pcall(CVU_RIVALS_UpdateStartShootingHookLifecycle)
 end
 CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
end

function CVU_ShutdownGunMod()
 Settings.GunModEnabled=false
 local mechanics=Runtime.RivalsMechanicsController
 if Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive and mechanics and type(mechanics.EquippedItemInput)=="function"then pcall(mechanics.EquippedItemInput,mechanics,"FinishShooting")end
 Runtime.RivalsRapidNativeActive=false
 pcall(CVU_GunModRestoreFireRates)
 if Runtime.GunModHeartbeat then pcall(function()Runtime.GunModHeartbeat:Disconnect()end)Runtime.GunModHeartbeat=nil end
 if Runtime.RivalsRapidStepped then pcall(function()Runtime.RivalsRapidStepped:Disconnect()end)Runtime.RivalsRapidStepped=nil end
 if Runtime.RivalsRapidHeartbeat then pcall(function()Runtime.RivalsRapidHeartbeat:Disconnect()end)Runtime.RivalsRapidHeartbeat=nil end
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_UpdateStartShootingHookLifecycle)
end

-- RIVALS no recoil V4 — live class parity + late binding
-- Public working implementations no-op Gun._Recoil and ClientViewModel.ApplyRecoil.  The previous
-- build could bind only the required module/proxy and miss the class actually used by the live item.
-- Resolve and hook BOTH the required module and the equipped item's metatable chain, plus every
-- CameraController method table.  Keep spring cleanup as a final visual guard.
-- ============================================================
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookRecords=Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookRecords or{}
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookKeys=Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookKeys or setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})

function CVU_RIVALS_ZeroSpring(spring)
if type(spring)~="table"and typeof(spring)~="table"then return end
for _,key in ipairs({"Position","Velocity","Target","Value"})do
local ok,value=pcall(function()return spring[key]end)
if ok then
local zero=nil
local kind=typeof(value)
if kind=="Vector3"then zero=Vector3.zero
elseif kind=="Vector2"then zero=Vector2.zero
elseif kind=="number"then zero=0
elseif kind=="CFrame"then zero=CFrame.identity end
if zero~=nil then pcall(function()spring[key]=zero end)end
end
end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ZeroViewModelRecoil(vm)
if type(vm)~="table"then return end
for _,key in ipairs({"_recoil_spring","_unrecoil_spring","_sway_spring","_bobbing_value_spring","_tilt_spring","_jump_spring","_landing_spring","_impulse_position_spring"})do
local spring=rawget(vm,key)or vm[key]
if spring then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroSpring,spring)end
end
end

function CVU_RIVALS_ZeroCameraRecoil(camera)
if type(camera)~="table"then return end
for _,key in ipairs({"_recoil_spring","_unrecoil_spring","_sway_spring","_bobbing_value_spring","_jump_spring","_leaning_spring","_tilt_spring"})do
local spring=rawget(camera,key)or camera[key]
if spring then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroSpring,spring)end
end
pcall(function()if camera.ShakeCFrame~=nil then camera.ShakeCFrame=CFrame.identity end end)
end

function CVU_RIVALS_CollectMethodTables(object,seed)
local out,seen={},{}
local function add(tbl)
if type(tbl)=="table"and not seen[tbl]then seen[tbl]=true out[#out+1]=tbl end
end
add(seed)
add(object)
local current=type(object)=="table"and getmetatable(object)or nil
local depth=0
while type(current)=="table"and depth<8 do
add(current)
local index=rawget(current,"__index")
if type(index)=="table"and index~=current then current=index else break end
depth+=1
end
return out
end

function CVU_RIVALS_AddNoRecoilHook(tbl,key,kind)
if type(tbl)~="table"then return false end
local original=rawget(tbl,key)
if type(original)~="function"then return false end
local keys=Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookKeys[tbl]
if not keys then keys={}Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookKeys[tbl]=keys end
if keys[key]then return false end
local wrapper
if kind=="block"then
wrapper=function(self,...)
if Settings.NoRecoil==true then
if key=="ApplyRecoil"then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroViewModelRecoil,self)end
return nil
end
return original(self,...)
end
elseif kind=="vmupdate"then
wrapper=function(self,...)
if Settings.NoRecoil==true then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroViewModelRecoil,self)end
local packed=table.pack(original(self,...))
if Settings.NoRecoil==true then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroViewModelRecoil,self)end
return table.unpack(packed,1,packed.n)
end
elseif kind=="camupdate"then
wrapper=function(self,...)
if Settings.NoRecoil==true then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroCameraRecoil,self)end
local packed=table.pack(original(self,...))
if Settings.NoRecoil==true then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroCameraRecoil,self)end
return table.unpack(packed,1,packed.n)
end
elseif kind=="shake"then
wrapper=function(self,...)
if Settings.NoRecoil==true then pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroCameraRecoil,self)return nil end
return original(self,...)
end
else return false end
tbl[key]=wrapper
keys[key]=true
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookRecords[#Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookRecords+1]={Table=tbl,Key=key,Original=original,Wrapper=wrapper}
return true
end

function CVU_RIVALS_EnsureNoRecoilLiveHooks()
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
local installed=0
local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
local liveVM=item and(rawget(item,"ViewModel")or item.ViewModel)or nil

-- Required Gun module + the actual equipped-item class chain.  This fixes builds where require(Gun)
-- is a proxy while the live item inherits _Recoil from another __index table.
for _,tbl in ipairs(CVU_RIVALS_CollectMethodTables(item,Runtime.RivalsGunModule))do
if CVU_RIVALS_AddNoRecoilHook(tbl,"_Recoil","block")then installed+=1 end
end
-- Required ClientViewModel + the actual live ViewModel class chain.
for _,tbl in ipairs(CVU_RIVALS_CollectMethodTables(liveVM,Runtime.RivalsClientViewModel))do
if CVU_RIVALS_AddNoRecoilHook(tbl,"ApplyRecoil","block")then installed+=1 end
if CVU_RIVALS_AddNoRecoilHook(tbl,"Update","vmupdate")then installed+=1 end
end
-- CameraController may expose methods on object, metatable, or metatable.__index.
local cameraTables=Runtime.RivalsCameraControllerMethodTables
if type(cameraTables)~="table"then cameraTables=CVU_RIVALS_CollectMethodTables(Runtime.RivalsCameraControllerObject,Runtime.RivalsCameraControllerMethods)end
for _,tbl in ipairs(cameraTables)do
if CVU_RIVALS_AddNoRecoilHook(tbl,"ShakeOnce","shake")then installed+=1 end
if CVU_RIVALS_AddNoRecoilHook(tbl,"Shake","shake")then installed+=1 end
if CVU_RIVALS_AddNoRecoilHook(tbl,"Update","camupdate")then installed+=1 end
end
return installed
end

function CVU_RIVALS_SuppressRecoilFrame()
if Runtime.Shutdown or Settings.NoRecoil~=true then return end
local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
local vm=item and(rawget(item,"ViewModel")or item.ViewModel)or nil
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroViewModelRecoil,vm)
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_ZeroCameraRecoil,Runtime.RivalsCameraControllerObject)
local now=os.clock()
if now-(Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilRehookAt or 0)>=.25 then
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilRehookAt=now
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_EnsureNoRecoilLiveHooks)
end
end

function CVU_InstallNoRecoil()
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
if Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHooksInstalled then
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_EnsureNoRecoilLiveHooks)
return true
end
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookRecords={}
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookKeys=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local installed=CVU_RIVALS_EnsureNoRecoilLiveHooks()
pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_RivalsNoRecoil")end)
pcall(function()RunService:BindToRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_RivalsNoRecoil",1998,CVU_RIVALS_SuppressRecoilFrame)end)
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHooksInstalled=installed>0
Runtime.NoRecoilInstalled=installed>0
Runtime.NoRecoilStatus=installed>0
and("RIVALS 無後座力：live class hooks="..tostring(installed).."｜_Recoil/ApplyRecoil/Update")
or"RIVALS 無後座力：尚未找到 live recoil method；持續重試"
-- Even if the live class is not ready this exact frame, keep the RenderStep guard alive so it can
-- late-bind after equip/respawn instead of permanently reporting success on an incomplete backend.
if installed==0 then
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHooksInstalled=true
Runtime.NoRecoilInstalled=true
end
return true
end

function CVU_SetNoRecoil(enabled)
Settings.NoRecoil=enabled==true
if Settings.NoRecoil then CVU_InstallNoRecoil()else CVU_ShutdownNoRecoil()end
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
end

function CVU_ShutdownNoRecoil()
Settings.NoRecoil=false
for index=#(Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookRecords or{}),1,-1 do
local record=Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookRecords[index]
if record and type(record.Table)=="table"and record.Table[record.Key]==record.Wrapper then
pcall(function()record.Table[record.Key]=record.Original end)
end
end
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookRecords={}
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHookKeys=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ChickenVisualUI_RivalsNoRecoil")end)
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilRehookAt=0
Runtime.RivalsNoRecoilHooksInstalled=false
Runtime.NoRecoilInstalled=false
Runtime.NoRecoilStatus="RIVALS 無後座力：OFF"
end

-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS spread reduction
-- GameplayUtility.GetSpread returns an angular CFrame in current RIVALS builds.
-- V6 only scaled number/Vector values, therefore it often changed nothing.
-- ============================================================
function CVU_RIVALS_ScaleSpreadValue(value,factor)
local kind=typeof(value)
if kind=="CFrame"then
if factor<=.0001 then return CFrame.identity end
return CFrame.identity:Lerp(value,math.clamp(factor,0,1))
elseif kind=="number"or kind=="Vector2"or kind=="Vector3"then
return value*factor
end
return value
end

function CVU_InstallBulletSpread()
pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
if Runtime.RivalsSpreadHookInstalled then return true end
local gameplay=Runtime.RivalsGameplayUtility
local gun=Runtime.RivalsGunModule
local installed=false
if type(gameplay)=="table"and type(gameplay.GetSpread)=="function"then
Runtime.RivalsOriginalGetSpread=Runtime.RivalsOriginalGetSpread or gameplay.GetSpread
local original=Runtime.RivalsOriginalGetSpread
gameplay.GetSpread=function(...)
local packed=table.pack(original(...))
if Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled==true and packed.n>=1 then
local percent=math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.BulletSpreadPercent)or 35,0,100)
packed[1]=CVU_RIVALS_ScaleSpreadValue(packed[1],1-percent/100)
end
return table.unpack(packed,1,packed.n)
end
installed=true
end

if type(gun)=="table"and type(gun.IsFullyAiming)=="function"then
Runtime.RivalsOriginalIsFullyAiming=Runtime.RivalsOriginalIsFullyAiming or gun.IsFullyAiming
local original=Runtime.RivalsOriginalIsFullyAiming
gun.IsFullyAiming=function(...)
if Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled==true and (tonumber(Settings.BulletSpreadPercent)or 0)>=99.5 then return true end
return original(...)
end
installed=true
end
Runtime.RivalsSpreadHookInstalled=installed
Runtime.BulletSpreadInstalled=installed
Runtime.BulletSpreadStatus=installed and"RIVALS 散布：已 hook GameplayUtility.GetSpread(CFrame)"or"RIVALS 散布：找不到 GetSpread / IsFullyAiming"
return installed
end

function CVU_SetBulletSpread(enabled)
Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled=enabled==true
if Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled then
if not CVU_InstallBulletSpread()then Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled=false return false end
Runtime.BulletSpreadStatus="RIVALS 散布降低｜"..string.format("%.0f%%",math.clamp(tonumber(Settings.BulletSpreadPercent)or 35,0,100))
else
CVU_ShutdownBulletSpread()
end
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
return true
end

function CVU_ShutdownBulletSpread()
Settings.BulletSpreadEnabled=false
local gameplay=Runtime.RivalsGameplayUtility
local gun=Runtime.RivalsGunModule
if type(gameplay)=="table"and Runtime.RivalsOriginalGetSpread then pcall(function()gameplay.GetSpread=Runtime.RivalsOriginalGetSpread end)end
if type(gun)=="table"and Runtime.RivalsOriginalIsFullyAiming then pcall(function()gun.IsFullyAiming=Runtime.RivalsOriginalIsFullyAiming end)end
Runtime.RivalsOriginalGetSpread=nil
Runtime.RivalsOriginalIsFullyAiming=nil
Runtime.RivalsSpreadHookInstalled=false
Runtime.BulletSpreadInstalled=false
Runtime.BulletSpreadStatus="RIVALS 散布：OFF"
end

-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS visible-only bullet curve
-- Uses the current camera origin.  No HRP teleport and no fake through-wall origin.
-- Utility.Raycast and native StartShooting cameraData are redirected to the same visible part.
-- ============================================================
function CVU_RIVALS_InstallCurveRemoteHook()
 if Runtime.RivalsCurveRemoteHookInstalled then return true end
 if type(hookfunction)~="function"then return false end
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 local remote=Runtime.RivalsUseItemRemote
 local actionEnum=Runtime.RivalsStartShootingEnum
 if not remote or actionEnum==nil then return false end
 local global=(type(getgenv)=="function"and getgenv())or _G
 local prior=global.__CVU_RivalsCurveRemoteHook
 if type(prior)=="table"and prior.Remote and type(prior.Original)=="function"then
  pcall(function()hookfunction(prior.Remote.FireServer,prior.Original)end)
 end
 local original
 local wrapper=function(self,objectID,action,cameraData,...)
  if self==remote and action==Runtime.RivalsStartShootingEnum and (Settings.PseudoWallPenetration==true or Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true)then
   local origin=Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or nil
   local candidate=nil
   if Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true and typeof(origin)=="Vector3"then
    local blocked,player=CVU_RIVALS_ShouldBlockManualShot()
    if blocked then
     Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaBlockedShots=(Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaBlockedShots or 0)+1
     Runtime.RivalsAntiKatanaStatus="Katana Remote｜2.025s 硬安全窗攔截｜"..tostring(player and player.Name or"Katana")
     return nil
    end
   end
   if not candidate and tick()<=(Runtime.RivalsPendingRemoteUntil or 0)then candidate=Runtime.RivalsPendingRemoteCandidate end
   Runtime.RivalsPendingRemoteCandidate=nil Runtime.RivalsPendingRemoteUntil=0
   if not candidate and typeof(origin)=="Vector3"then
    if Settings.PseudoWallPenetration==true then candidate=CVU_RIVALS_FindCurveTarget(origin)
    elseif Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true then candidate=CVU_RIVALS_GetAimShotCandidate(origin)end
   end
   if candidate and candidate.Part and typeof(origin)=="Vector3"and CVU_RIVALS_IsPartVisible(origin,candidate.Part)then
    local inner=CVU_RIVALS_BuildWallInner(candidate,origin)
    if inner then
     cameraData=type(cameraData)=="table"and cameraData or{}
     cameraData[utf8.char(1)]=inner
     Runtime.RivalsCurveRemoteRedirects=(Runtime.RivalsCurveRemoteRedirects or 0)+1
    end
   end
  end
  return original(self,objectID,action,cameraData,...)
 end
 if type(newcclosure)=="function"then wrapper=newcclosure(wrapper)end
 local ok,old=pcall(function()return hookfunction(remote.FireServer,wrapper)end)
 if not ok or type(old)~="function"then return false end
 original=old
 Runtime.RivalsCurveRemoteOriginal=old
 Runtime.RivalsCurveRemoteHookInstalled=true
 global.__CVU_RivalsCurveRemoteHook={Remote=remote,Original=old}
 return true
end

function CVU_InstallPseudoWallPenetration()
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 local a=CVU_RIVALS_InstallShotRedirectHook()
 local b=CVU_RIVALS_InstallStartShootingHook()
 local c=CVU_RIVALS_InstallCurveRemoteHook()
 Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled=b==true and(a==true or c==true)
 Runtime.PseudoWallStatus=Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled and"RIVALS 子彈轉彎：visible-only Raycast + cameraData 已就緒"or"RIVALS 子彈轉彎：hook 失敗"
 return Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled
end

function CVU_SetPseudoWallPenetration(enabled)
 Settings.PseudoWallPenetration=enabled==true
 if Settings.PseudoWallPenetration then
  if not CVU_InstallPseudoWallPenetration()then Settings.PseudoWallPenetration=false return false end
  Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="RIVALS 子彈轉彎：ON｜只修正可見敵人｜不穿牆、不瞬移"
 else
  Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="RIVALS 子彈轉彎：OFF" Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled=false
  pcall(CVU_RIVALS_UpdateStartShootingHookLifecycle)
 end
 CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
 return true
end

function CVU_ShutdownPseudoWallPenetration()
 Settings.PseudoWallPenetration=false Runtime.PseudoWallInstalled=false Runtime.PseudoWallStatus="RIVALS 子彈轉彎：OFF"
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_UpdateStartShootingHookLifecycle)
end

-- ============================================================
-- RIVALS rage bullet-curve 180
-- Full visible viewport, no FOV radius.  The selected/shared body-part mode must expose
-- at least one sampled point to the camera; then native StartShooting is fired immediately
-- and redirected through the existing Utility.Raycast + cameraData path.
-- ============================================================
Runtime.RivalsRageCurveStatus=Runtime.RivalsRageCurveStatus or"RIVALS 暴怒子彈轉彎180：OFF"
Runtime.RivalsRageCurveLastFireAt=Runtime.RivalsRageCurveLastFireAt or 0
Runtime.RivalsRageCurveHeartbeat=Runtime.RivalsRageCurveHeartbeat or nil

function CVU_RIVALS_HasWorldPointBlocker(origin,targetPos)
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or typeof(targetPos)~="Vector3"then return true end
 local delta=targetPos-origin
 if delta.Magnitude<=.01 then return false end
 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.IgnoreWater=true
 local ignore={}
 if LocalPlayer.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=LocalPlayer.Character end
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
  if character then ignore[#ignore+1]=character end
 end
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances=ignore
 local hit=Workspace:Raycast(origin,delta,params)
 return hit~=nil and hit.Instance~=nil
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetRageCurveParts(character)
 if not character then return{}end
 local mode=tostring(Settings.PseudoWallTargetPart or"自動")
 if mode~="自動"then
  local part=CVU_RIVALS_GetTargetPart(character,false)
  return part and{part}or{}
 end
 local names={
  "HitboxHead","PhysicalHitboxHead","Head",
  "UpperTorso","Torso","LowerTorso","HumanoidRootPart",
  "LeftUpperArm","LeftLowerArm","LeftHand","Left Arm",
  "RightUpperArm","RightLowerArm","RightHand","Right Arm",
  "LeftUpperLeg","LeftLowerLeg","LeftFoot","Left Leg",
  "RightUpperLeg","RightLowerLeg","RightFoot","Right Leg",
 }
 local parts,seen={},{}
 for _,name in ipairs(names)do
  local part=character:FindFirstChild(name,true)
  if part and part:IsA("BasePart")and not seen[part]then seen[part]=true parts[#parts+1]=part end
 end
 return parts
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetExposedScreenPoint(origin,part)
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or not Camera or not part or not part:IsA("BasePart")then return nil end
 local half=part.Size*.48
 local samples={
  Vector3.new(0,0,0),
  Vector3.new( half.X,0,0),Vector3.new(-half.X,0,0),
  Vector3.new(0, half.Y,0),Vector3.new(0,-half.Y,0),
  Vector3.new(0,0, half.Z),Vector3.new(0,0,-half.Z),
 }
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local best=nil
 for _,offset in ipairs(samples)do
  local world=part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(offset)
  local p,on=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(world)
  if on and p.Z>0 and not CVU_RIVALS_HasWorldPointBlocker(origin,world)then
   local screen=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)
   local score=(screen-center).Magnitude
   if not best or score<best.Score then
    best={Position=world,Screen=screen,Score=score}
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

function CVU_RIVALS_FindRageCurveTarget(origin)
 if Settings.RivalsRageCurveEnabled~=true or typeof(origin)~="Vector3"or not Camera then return nil end
 local best=nil
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)
  and not CVU_RIVALS_IsPendingTarget(player)
  and not CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(player)
  and not CVU_RIVALS_IsShieldEquipped(player)then
   local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
   if character and character:GetAttribute("Dead")~=true then
    local hp=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))
    if hp==nil or hp>0 then
     for _,part in ipairs(CVU_RIVALS_GetRageCurveParts(character))do
      local exposed=CVU_RIVALS_GetExposedScreenPoint(origin,part)
      if exposed then
       local worldDistance=(exposed.Position-origin).Magnitude
       local score=exposed.Score+worldDistance*.0005
       if not best or score<best.Score then
        best={Player=player,Character=character,Part=part,Position=exposed.Position,Distance=worldDistance,Screen=exposed.Screen,Score=score,Visible=true,RageCurve=true}
       end
       -- In explicit body-part modes there is only one part; in Auto keep looking
       -- so the closest exposed body sample wins across the full 180-degree viewport.
      end
     end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

function CVU_RIVALS_RageCurveFireOnce()
 if Settings.RivalsRageCurveEnabled~=true then return false end
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InstallStartShootingHook)
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InstallShotRedirectHook)
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InstallCurveRemoteHook)
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if not item then Runtime.RivalsRageCurveStatus="RIVALS 暴怒子彈轉彎180：沒有 EquippedItem" return false end
 local origin=Camera and Camera.CFrame.Position or nil
 if typeof(origin)~="Vector3"then return false end
 local candidate=CVU_RIVALS_FindRageCurveTarget(origin)
 if not candidate then
  Runtime.RivalsRageCurveStatus="RIVALS 暴怒子彈轉彎180：全螢幕無可自動射擊目標（持盾目標會跳過）"
  return false
 end
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsShieldEquipped(candidate.Player)then
  Runtime.RivalsRageCurveStatus="RIVALS 暴怒子彈轉彎180：敵人持盾｜停止自動射擊"
  return false
 end

 -- Respect the native weapon cooldown.  "Instant" here means zero target-reaction delay,
 -- not fabricating extra shots that the weapon/client has not accepted yet.
 local due=rawget(item,"_shoot_cooldown")
 if typeof(due)=="number"and tick()<due then return false end

 Runtime.RivalsForcedWallCandidate=candidate
 Runtime.RivalsForcedWallOrigin=origin
 Runtime.RivalsForcedCurveVisible=true
 local fired=CVU_RIVALS_NativeItemInput(item,"StartShooting")
 if fired then task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_RIVALS_NativeItemInput,item,"FinishShooting")end)end
 Runtime.RivalsForcedCurveVisible=false
 Runtime.RivalsForcedWallCandidate=nil
 Runtime.RivalsForcedWallOrigin=nil
 if fired then
  Runtime.RivalsRageCurveStatus="RIVALS 暴怒子彈轉彎180：射線改道→"..tostring(candidate.Player and candidate.Player.Name or"enemy").."｜"..tostring(candidate.Part and candidate.Part.Name or"part")
 end
 return fired
end

 if Runtime.RivalsRageCurveHeartbeat then pcall(function()Runtime.RivalsRageCurveHeartbeat:Disconnect()end)Runtime.RivalsRageCurveHeartbeat=nil end

   if Runtime.Shutdown or Settings.RivalsRageCurveEnabled~=true then return end
   -- One attempt per render/heartbeat is enough; native weapon cooldown decides whether
   -- an accepted shot can happen on this frame.
   pcall(CVU_RIVALS_RageCurveFireOnce)
  end)

if Runtime.GunModHeartbeat then pcall(function()Runtime.GunModHeartbeat:Disconnect()end)Runtime.GunModHeartbeat=nil end

Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageTarget=Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageTarget or nil
Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus=Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus or"RIVALS 零反應鎖：OFF"
Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageLastAimRequest=Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageLastAimRequest or 0
Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageLastAcceptedFire=Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageLastAcceptedFire or 0

function CVU_RIVALS_ClearCheaterRageState()
 Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageTarget=nil
 Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageLastAimRequest=0
 Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageLastAcceptedFire=0
end

function CVU_RIVALS_GetCheaterRageCandidate(player,origin,center)
 if not player or not CVU_RIVALS_IsEnemyPlayer(player)or CVU_RIVALS_IsKatanaDeflecting(player)then return nil end
 local character=CVU_RIVALS_GetCharacter(player)
 if not character or not character.Parent or character:GetAttribute("Dead")==true then return nil end
 local hp=select(1,CVU_GetHealth(character))
 if hp~=nil and hp<=0 then return nil end
 local head=select(1,CVU_RIVALS_GetAutoTargetParts(character))
 if not head then return nil end
 local solution=CVU_RIVALS_GetHeadAimSolution(head,origin)
 if not solution then return nil end
 local score=(solution.Screen-center).Magnitude
 return{Player=player,Character=character,Head=head,Solution=solution,Score=score}
end

function CVU_RIVALS_FindCheaterRageTarget()
 if not Camera then return nil end
 local origin=Camera.CFrame.Position
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 local current=Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageTarget
 if current then
  local sticky=CVU_RIVALS_GetCheaterRageCandidate(current,origin,center)
  if sticky then return sticky end
  Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageTarget=nil
 end
 local best=nil
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  local candidate=CVU_RIVALS_GetCheaterRageCandidate(player,origin,center)
  if candidate and(not best or candidate.Score<best.Score)then best=candidate end
 end
 if best then Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageTarget=best.Player end
 return best
end

function CVU_RIVALS_UpdateCheaterRage(dt)
 if Settings.RivalsCheaterRage~=true or Runtime.Shutdown then return false end
 pcall(CVU_RIVALS_InitCombatBackend)
 Camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera
 if not Camera then return false end
 local item=CVU_RIVALS_GetLocalGunItem()
 if not item then
  Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus="RIVALS 零反應鎖：沒有 EquippedItem"
  return false
 end
 local kind=CVU_RIVALS_GetWeaponKind(item)
 if kind=="melee"then
  Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageTarget=nil
  Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus="RIVALS 零反應鎖：近戰不鎖頭"
  return false
 end
 local candidate=CVU_RIVALS_FindCheaterRageTarget()
 if not candidate or not candidate.Solution then
  Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus="RIVALS 零反應鎖：沒有可見頭部"
  return false
 end

 -- Zero reaction means a true hard camera lock: center when the whole head is exposed,
 -- or the innermost visible hitbox edge when the center is behind world geometry.
 local solution=candidate.Solution
 local origin=Camera.CFrame.Position
 if typeof(solution.WorldPosition)=="Vector3"then
  Camera.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(origin,solution.WorldPosition,Camera.CFrame.UpVector)
 end
 Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus="RIVALS 零反應鎖："..tostring(solution.Mode or"head").."｜"..tostring(candidate.Player and candidate.Player.Name or"enemy")

 -- Sniper is allowed to fire only after native ADS focus is genuinely complete.
 -- The mode may request native StartAiming itself, but never bypasses CurrentAimValue/AimScopePercent.
 if kind=="sniper"and not CVU_RIVALS_IsSniperScopeReady(item)then
  local aiming=false
  pcall(function()local getter=rawget(item,"Get")or item.Get if type(getter)=="function"then aiming=getter(item,"IsAiming")==true end end)
  local now=os.clock()
  if not aiming and now-(Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageLastAimRequest or 0)>=.08 then
   Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageLastAimRequest=now
   pcall(CVU_RIVALS_NativeItemInput,item,"StartAiming")
  end
  Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus=Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus.."｜等待狙擊鏡聚焦"
  return true
 end

 -- V34 shield safety: hard-lock may keep tracking / ADS ready, but automatic fire
 -- is suppressed for as long as this target is currently holding a shield.
 if CVU_RIVALS_IsShieldEquipped(candidate.Player)then
  Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus=Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus.."｜敵人持盾：停止自動射擊"
  return true
 end

 -- Do not pre-mark a shot as successful. ClientItem:Input returns true only when the
 -- native StartShooting action was accepted and its UseItem packet was actually emitted.
 local fired=CVU_RIVALS_NativeItemInput(item,"StartShooting")
 if fired then
  Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageLastAcceptedFire=os.clock()
  Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus=Runtime.RivalsCheaterRageStatus.."｜原生射擊已接受"
  task.defer(function()pcall(CVU_RIVALS_NativeItemInput,item,"FinishShooting")end)
 end
 return true
end
