-- ============================================================
-- C4 / CT 拆包工具
--
-- Remote Defuse:
--   優先走遊戲原生 Router "Start Defuse Bomb"，
--   並只在遠距離拆包啟用期間阻止 DefuseBomb 因 >10 studs 的本機 Cancel(false)。
--   若原生 Router 沒拿到 server ack，再 fallback 到官方 C4.StartDefuse packet。
--   如果伺服器本身驗證玩家距離，客戶端不能保證繞過；狀態會明確顯示 server reject。
--
-- C4 Advisor:
--   不使用穿牆直線距離。
--   透過 PathfindingService 計算目前位置 -> C4 周圍可站立點的走道 waypoint 距離。
-- ============================================================
Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseBomb=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionId=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial=Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial or 0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStartLocal=0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus or"關閉"
Runtime.RemoteDefuseRemotes=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseInputController=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseRouter=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDefuseModule=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseHeartbeat=nil

Runtime.C4ESPHighlight=nil
Runtime.C4AdvisorFrame=nil
Runtime.C4AdvisorText=nil
Runtime.C4PathBusy=false
Runtime.C4PathGeneration=0
Runtime.C4PathBomb=nil
Runtime.C4PathStart=nil
Runtime.C4PathDistance=nil
Runtime.C4PathTime=nil
Runtime.C4PathStatus="idle"
Runtime.C4PathComputedAt=0
Runtime.C4UtilityClock=0

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRemotes()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseRemotes then return Runtime.RemoteDefuseRemotes end
local ok,remotes=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Database.Security.Remotes)
end)
if ok and type(remotes)=="table"
and type(remotes.C4)=="table"
and type(remotes.C4.StartDefuse)=="table"
and type(remotes.C4.CancelDefuse)=="table"
and type(remotes.C4.Defused)=="table"
then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseRemotes=remotes
return remotes
end
return nil
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRouter()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseRouter then return Runtime.RemoteDefuseRouter end
local ok,router=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Database.Security.Router)
end)
if ok and type(router)=="table"and type(router.broadcastRouter)=="function"then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseRouter=router
return router
end
return nil
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetInputController()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseInputController then return Runtime.RemoteDefuseInputController end
local ok,controller=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Controllers.InputController)
end)
if ok and type(controller)=="table"then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseInputController=controller
return controller
end
return nil
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseInstallNativeCancelGuard()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel then return true end
local ok,module=pcall(function()
return require(ReplicatedStorage.Interface.Screens.Gameplay.Middle.DefuseBomb)
end)
if not ok or type(module)~="table"or type(module.CancelDefuse)~="function"then
return false
end

local oldCancel=module.CancelDefuse
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDefuseModule=module
Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel=oldCancel

module.CancelDefuse=function(self,forced,...)
-- 遊戲原生 heartbeat 在距離 >10 或 Use 狀態不符時會呼叫 CancelDefuse(false)。
-- 遠程模式期間只攔本機 false cancel；server/強制 true cancel 仍照常執行。
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive==true and Settings.RemoteDefuse==true and forced~=true then
return
end
return oldCancel(self,forced,...)
end

return true
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseRestoreNativeCancelGuard()
local module=Runtime.RemoteDefuseDefuseModule
local old=Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel
if module and type(old)=="function"then
pcall(function()module.CancelDefuse=old end)
end
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDefuseModule=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseOriginalCancel=nil
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()
return LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Team")=="Counter-Terrorists"
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseAlive()
local character=LocalPlayer.Character
if not character or not character:IsDescendantOf(Workspace)then return false end
local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
return humanoid~=nil and humanoid.Health>0
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBomb()
local tagged=CollectionService:GetTagged("Bomb")
local bomb=tagged and tagged[1]or nil
if not bomb or not bomb.Parent then return nil end
if bomb:GetAttribute("Defused")==true then return nil end
if bomb:GetAttribute("Exploding")==true then return nil end
if bomb:GetAttribute("Exploded")==true then return nil end
return bomb
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBombRoot(bomb)
if not bomb then return nil end
return bomb.PrimaryPart or bomb:FindFirstChild("Weapon",true)or bomb:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart",true)
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseDistance(bomb)
local character=LocalPlayer.Character
local root=character and(character.PrimaryPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
local bombRoot=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBombRoot(bomb)
if not root or not bombRoot then return math.huge end
return(root.Position-bombRoot.Position).Magnitude
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseUseHeld()
if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()then return false end
local controller=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetInputController()
if controller and type(controller.isActionActive)=="function"then
local ok,value=pcall(controller.isActionActive,"Use")
if ok then return value==true end
end
return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E)
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel(reason,silent)
local wasActive=Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive
local sessionId=Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionId
local nativeStarted=Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted
local directSent=Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent

-- 先解除 active，讓 Router Cancel 可以正常進原版 CancelDefuse。
Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseBomb=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionId=nil
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStartLocal=0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=0
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent=false

if wasActive and not silent then
if nativeStarted then
local router=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRouter()
if router then
pcall(router.broadcastRouter,"Cancel Defuse Bomb")
end
end

if directSent and sessionId~=nil then
local remotes=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRemotes()
if remotes then
pcall(function()
remotes.C4.CancelDefuse.Send({SessionId=sessionId})
end)
end
end
end

Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=tostring(reason or"已取消")
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseSendDirectFallback()
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent then return true end
local remotes=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRemotes()
if not remotes then return false end

Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial=(Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial+1)%4294967295
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial<=0 then Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial=1 end
local sessionId=Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionSerial
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSessionId=sessionId

local ok=pcall(function()
remotes.C4.StartDefuse.Send({SessionId=sessionId})
end)

if ok then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent=true
return true
end
return false
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseBegin(bomb)
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then return false end
if Settings.RemoteDefuse~=true then return false end
if not CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="僅限 CT"
return false
end
if not CVU_RemoteDefuseAlive()then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="角色未存活"
return false
end
if not bomb then return false end

local distance=CVU_RemoteDefuseDistance(bomb)
if distance<=10 then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="近距離使用原生拆包"
return false
end

Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive=true
Runtime.RemoteDefuseBomb=bomb
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStartLocal=Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=os.clock()+1.15
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted=false
Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent=false

pcall(CVU_RemoteDefuseInstallNativeCancelGuard)

-- 只改本機 Bomb attribute，讓原生 Use/Defuse UI 能走自己的正常流程。
pcall(function()bomb:SetAttribute("CanDefuse",true)end)

local router=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRouter()
if router then
local ok=pcall(router.broadcastRouter,"Start Defuse Bomb")
if ok then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted=true
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=string.format("原生遠距離拆包請求｜%.0f stud",distance)
return true
end
end

-- Router 不可用才直接 fallback。
if CVU_RemoteDefuseSendDirectFallback()then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=os.clock()+1.50
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=string.format("直接遠距離拆包請求｜%.0f stud",distance)
return true
end

CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("StartDefuse 發送失敗",true)
return false
end

function CVU_RemoteDefuseStep()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end

if Settings.RemoteDefuse~=true then
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("關閉")end
return
end

if not CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()then
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("僅限 CT")end
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="僅限 CT"
return
end

if not CVU_RemoteDefuseAlive()then
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("角色死亡")end
return
end

local bomb=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBomb()
if not bomb then
if Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("沒有可拆除的 C4",true)end
return
end

local useHeld=CVU_RemoteDefuseUseHeld()

if not Runtime.RemoteDefuseActive then
if useHeld and CVU_RemoteDefuseDistance(bomb)>10 then
CVU_RemoteDefuseBegin(bomb)
end
return
end

if Runtime.RemoteDefuseBomb~=bomb then
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("C4 已更換")
return
end

-- 防止原生 Bomb observer 每幀把 CanDefuse 改回 false。
pcall(function()bomb:SetAttribute("CanDefuse",true)end)

if not useHeld then
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("已放開使用鍵")
return
end

if bomb:GetAttribute("Defused")==true then
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("拆包成功",true)
return
end

local serverAccepted=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb")==true
if not serverAccepted then
if os.clock()>Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline then
if not Runtime.RemoteDefuseDirectFallbackSent then
if CVU_RemoteDefuseSendDirectFallback()then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseAckDeadline=os.clock()+1.50
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="原生流程未 ACK｜改送直接 StartDefuse"
else
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("遠距離拆包請求失敗",true)
end
else
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("伺服器拒絕遠距離拆包",true)
end
end
return
end

local hasKit=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("HasDefuseKit")==true
local defuseTime=hasKit and 5 or 10
local serverStart=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("DefuseStartTime")
local startTime=typeof(serverStart)=="number"and serverStart or Runtime.RemoteDefuseStartLocal
local elapsed=Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-startTime

Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=string.format(
"CT 遠距離拆包｜%.1f / %.1f 秒｜%.0f stud",
math.max(elapsed,0),
defuseTime,
CVU_RemoteDefuseDistance(bomb)
)

-- 原生 Router 已成功啟動時，由 DefuseBomb 自己送 Defused。
-- 只有完全走 direct fallback 時，這裡才補送完成 packet。
if elapsed>=defuseTime
and not Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish
and Runtime.RemoteDefuseNativeStarted~=true then
Runtime.RemoteDefuseSentFinish=true
local remotes=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetRemotes()
if remotes then
pcall(function()remotes.C4.Defused.Send()end)
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus="已提交 Defused"
end
end
end

function CVU_SetRemoteDefuse(enabled)
Settings.RemoteDefuse=enabled==true
if not Settings.RemoteDefuse then
CVU_RemoteDefuseCancel("關閉")
CVU_RemoteDefuseRestoreNativeCancelGuard()
else
Runtime.RemoteDefuseStatus=CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()and"CT 遠距離拆包待命"or"僅限 CT"
pcall(CVU_RemoteDefuseInstallNativeCancelGuard)
end
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
return Settings.RemoteDefuse
end

function CVU_C4GetBombRemaining(bomb)
if not bomb then return nil end
local raw=bomb:GetAttribute("BombPlanted")
if type(raw)~="string"or raw==""then return nil end

local ok,data=pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode,HttpService,raw)
if not ok or type(data)~="table"then return nil end

local plantedAt=tonumber(data.Time)
local total=tonumber(data.TimeUntilExplode)or 40
if not plantedAt then return nil end

return math.max((plantedAt+math.max(total,.1))-Workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),0)
end

function CVU_C4GetCharacterNavInfo()
local character=LocalPlayer.Character
if not character then return nil,nil,nil end
local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or character.PrimaryPart
local humanoid=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health<=0 then return nil,nil,nil end
return root,humanoid,math.max(tonumber(humanoid.WalkSpeed)or 16,1)
end

function CVU_C4PathDistanceForWaypoints(startPos,waypoints,bombPos)
if type(waypoints)~="table"or #waypoints==0 then return nil end
local distance=0
local previous=startPos
for _,waypoint in ipairs(waypoints)do
if waypoint and typeof(waypoint.Position)=="Vector3"then
distance+=(waypoint.Position-previous).Magnitude
previous=waypoint.Position
end
end

-- 路徑終點只要到 C4 附近即可；最後幾 stud 視為互動範圍，不用硬走到 C4 幾何中心。
local finalGap=(bombPos-previous).Magnitude
if finalGap>6.5 then return nil end
return distance
end

function CVU_C4ComputeBestWalkPathAsync(bomb)
if Runtime.C4PathBusy then return end
local root,humanoid,walkSpeed=CVU_C4GetCharacterNavInfo()
local bombRoot=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBombRoot(bomb)
if not root or not bombRoot then return end

Runtime.C4PathBusy=true
Runtime.C4PathGeneration+=1
local generation=Runtime.C4PathGeneration
local startPos=root.Position
local bombPos=bombRoot.Position

task.spawn(function()
local bestDistance=nil
local bestStatus="NoPath"

if (startPos-bombPos).Magnitude<=5 then
bestDistance=0
bestStatus="NearBomb"
else
local candidates={
bombPos,
bombPos+Vector3.new(4,0,0),
bombPos+Vector3.new(-4,0,0),
bombPos+Vector3.new(0,0,4),
bombPos+Vector3.new(0,0,-4),
bombPos+Vector3.new(3,0,3),
bombPos+Vector3.new(-3,0,3),
bombPos+Vector3.new(3,0,-3),
bombPos+Vector3.new(-3,0,-3),
}

for _,goal in ipairs(candidates)do
if generation~=Runtime.C4PathGeneration then break end

local ok,path=pcall(function()
local p=PathfindingService:CreatePath({
AgentRadius=2,
AgentHeight=5,
AgentCanJump=true,
AgentCanClimb=true,
WaypointSpacing=3,
})
p:ComputeAsync(startPos,goal)
return p
end)

if ok and path and path.Status==Enum.PathStatus.Success then
local distance=CVU_C4PathDistanceForWaypoints(startPos,path:GetWaypoints(),bombPos)
if distance and(not bestDistance or distance<bestDistance)then
bestDistance=distance
bestStatus="Success"
end
end
end
end

if generation==Runtime.C4PathGeneration then
Runtime.C4PathBomb=bomb
Runtime.C4PathStart=startPos
Runtime.C4PathDistance=bestDistance
Runtime.C4PathTime=bestDistance and(bestDistance/walkSpeed)or nil
Runtime.C4PathStatus=bestStatus
Runtime.C4PathComputedAt=os.clock()
Runtime.C4PathBusy=false
end
end)
end

function CVU_C4MaybeRefreshPath(bomb)
if not Settings.C4DefuseAdvisor then return end
local root=select(1,CVU_C4GetCharacterNavInfo())
if not root or not bomb then return end

local moved=
not Runtime.C4PathStart
or(root.Position-Runtime.C4PathStart).Magnitude>=5

local changed=Runtime.C4PathBomb~=bomb
local stale=os.clock()-(Runtime.C4PathComputedAt or 0)>=.85

if not Runtime.C4PathBusy and(changed or moved or stale)then
CVU_C4ComputeBestWalkPathAsync(bomb)
end
end

function CVU_C4GetRemainingDefuseTime()
local total=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("HasDefuseKit")==true and 5 or 10
if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb")==true then
local start=LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("DefuseStartTime")
if typeof(start)=="number"then
return math.max(total-(Workspace:GetServerTimeNow()-start),0)
end
end
return total
end

function CVU_C4UpdateAdvisor()
local frame=CVU_C4EnsureAdvisorUI()
if Settings.C4DefuseAdvisor~=true or not CVU_RemoteDefuseIsCT()then
frame.Visible=false
return
end

local bomb=CVU_RemoteDefuseGetBomb()
if not bomb then
frame.Visible=false
return
end

frame.Visible=true
CVU_C4MaybeRefreshPath(bomb)

local remaining=CVU_C4GetBombRemaining(bomb)
if not remaining then
frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(90,90,100)
Runtime.C4AdvisorText.Text="C4 已安裝｜等待炸彈計時資料"
return
end

local defuseTime=CVU_C4GetRemainingDefuseTime()
local routeTime=nil

if LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("IsDefusingBomb")==true then
routeTime=0
elseif Runtime.C4PathBomb==bomb then
routeTime=Runtime.C4PathTime
end

if routeTime==nil then
frame.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(150,55,55)
Runtime.C4AdvisorText.Text=string.format(
"C4 %.1fs｜正在計算實際走道路徑…｜不使用穿牆直線距離",
remaining
)
return
end

-- 留 0.35 秒給抵達後互動／網路延遲，避免剛好 0.0 秒被誤判成安全。
local required=routeTime+defuseTime+.35
local margin=remaining-required
local canDefuse=margin>=0

frame.BackgroundColor3=
canDefuse
and Color3.fromRGB(45,105,200)
or Color3.fromRGB(190,48,48)

Runtime.C4AdvisorText.Text=string.format(
"%s｜C4 %.1fs｜走道 %.1fs｜拆包 %.1fs｜餘裕 %+.1fs",
canDefuse and"可成功拆包"or"時間不足，快撤離",
remaining,
routeTime,
defuseTime,
margin
)
end

function CVU_SetC4DefuseAdvisor(enabled)

Runtime.C4PathStart=nil
Runtime.C4PathDistance=nil
Runtime.C4PathTime=nil
Runtime.C4PathStatus="idle"
Runtime.C4PathComputedAt=0
CVU_C4UpdateAdvisor()
CVU_QueueSaveSettings()
end

Runtime.RivalsAimFOVUIControls=Runtime.RivalsAimFOVUIControls or{}
local RivalsAimFOVUI=Runtime.RivalsAimFOVUIControls
function CVU_RIVALS_RefreshAimFOVUI()
 local master=Settings.RivalsAimAssist==true
 local show=master and Settings.RivalsAimFOVVisible==true
 local outline=show and Settings.RivalsAimFOVOutline==true
 local fill=show and Settings.RivalsAimFOVFill==true
 local custom=master and CVU_RIVALS_GetAimStyle()=="自訂"
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.Style then RivalsAimFOVUI.Style.Visible=master end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.AutoFire then RivalsAimFOVUI.AutoFire.Visible=master and not custom end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.CustomAutoFire then RivalsAimFOVUI.CustomAutoFire.Visible=custom end
 for _,key in ipairs({"CustomLockSpeedFar","CustomLockSpeedMid","CustomLockSpeedNear"})do
  local control=RivalsAimFOVUI[key]
  if control then control.Visible=custom end
 end
 for _,key in ipairs({"CustomReactionNear","CustomReactionMid","CustomReactionFar","CustomAutoFireNear","CustomAutoFireMid","CustomAutoFireFar","CustomTrackingSmoothness","CustomLockSmoothNear","CustomLockSmoothMid","CustomLockSmoothFar"})do
  local control=RivalsAimFOVUI[key]
  if control then
   if key=="CustomAutoFireNear"or key=="CustomAutoFireMid"or key=="CustomAutoFireFar"then
    control.Visible=custom and Settings.RivalsCustomAutoFire==true
   else
    control.Visible=custom
   end
  end
 end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.Show then RivalsAimFOVUI.Show.Visible=master end
 -- Built-in styles always use 153 px; only Custom may edit the numeric size.
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.Size then RivalsAimFOVUI.Size.Visible=show and custom end
 -- Everyone may turn free-follow on/off, but only Custom may edit its numeric smoothness.
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.Follow then RivalsAimFOVUI.Follow.Visible=show end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.TrackStrength then RivalsAimFOVUI.TrackStrength.Visible=show and custom and Settings.RivalsAimFOVFollow==true end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.Outline then RivalsAimFOVUI.Outline.Visible=show end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.OutlineColor then RivalsAimFOVUI.OutlineColor.Visible=outline end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.Fill then RivalsAimFOVUI.Fill.Visible=show end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.FillColor1 then RivalsAimFOVUI.FillColor1.Visible=fill end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.FillColor2 then RivalsAimFOVUI.FillColor2.Visible=fill end
 if RivalsAimFOVUI.Rotate then RivalsAimFOVUI.Rotate.Visible=fill end
 pcall(CVU_UpdateFOV)
end

function CVU_SetWeaponVisualOwner(owner)
if owner~="glass"and owner~="metal"then owner="none"end
Runtime.WeaponVisualOwner=owner
Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration=(Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration or 0)+1
return Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration
end

function CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()
local owner=Runtime.WeaponVisualOwner
if owner=="glass"or owner=="metal"then return owner end
return "none"
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------
-- ViewModel refresh recursion guard
-- ------------------------------------------------------------
-- 任何 ChickenVisual 自己建立的 Camera 視覺物件，都不能再反過來觸發
-- Camera.DescendantAdded -> CVU_RefreshViewModelVisuals。
function CVU_IsOwnCameraVisual(obj)
local current=obj
local depth=0
while current and depth<10 do
local name=current.Name or""

if string.sub(name,1,4)=="CVU_"then return true end
if current:GetAttribute("CVU_KnifeExperience")==true then return true end
if current:GetAttribute("CVU_GhostOverlay")==true then return true end
if current:GetAttribute("CVU_MetalCoat")==true then return true end

if current==Camera then break end
current=current.Parent
depth+=1
end
return false
end

function CVU_BeginViewModelMutation()
Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth=(Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth or 0)+1
end

function CVU_EndViewModelMutation()
Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth=math.max((Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth or 1)-1,0)
end

function CVU_IsViewModelMutationActive()
return (Runtime.ViewModelMutationDepth or 0)>0
end

function CVU_RefreshViewModelVisuals()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end

-- 自己正在改 ViewModel 時，事件監聽器可能同步收到 DescendantAdded。
-- 這些事件就是這次 mutation 的結果，直接忽略，不能再排下一輪 refresh。
if CVU_IsViewModelMutationActive()then return end

if not Settings.GhostArms and not CVU_IsAnyMetalEnabled() and not Settings.GlassWeapon then return end
CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache()

if Runtime.ViewModelVisualRefreshQueued then
if CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="metal"and CVU_IsAnyMetalEnabled()then
Runtime.MetalRefreshNeedsRebuild=true
end
return
end

-- Register-safe: queued generation / owner / pcall result live in Runtime instead of
-- allocating more locals in this already register-heavy root build.
Runtime.ViewModelVisualRefreshQueued=true
Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedGeneration=Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration or 0
Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedOwner=CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()

task.defer(function()
Runtime.ViewModelVisualRefreshQueued=false
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if (Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedGeneration or 0)~=(Runtime.WeaponVisualGeneration or 0)then return end

Camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera
if not Camera then return end
CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache()

CVU_BeginViewModelMutation()
Runtime.ViewModelVisualMutationOK,Runtime.ViewModelVisualLastError=pcall(function()
-- 同一個 mutation 內先處理手臂，再只套當前 owner 的一種武器效果。
if Settings.GhostArms then
pcall(CVU_ApplyGhostArms)
end

if Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedOwner=="metal"
and CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="metal"
and CVU_IsAnyMetalEnabled()then
pcall(CVU_ApplyMetalWeapon,true)
pcall(CVU_RefreshKnifeExperience,false)
Runtime.MetalRefreshNeedsRebuild=false

elseif Runtime.ViewModelVisualQueuedOwner=="glass"
and CVU_GetWeaponVisualOwner()=="glass"
and Settings.GlassWeapon then
pcall(CVU_RefreshGlassWeaponViewModel)
end
end)
CVU_EndViewModelMutation()

if Runtime.ViewModelVisualMutationOK~=true then
warn("[ChickenVisualUI] ViewModel refresh mutation failed: "..tostring(Runtime.ViewModelVisualLastError))
end
end)
end

function CVU_BindCamera(camera)
if not camera then return end

camera.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if CVU_IsViewModelMutationActive()then return end
if CVU_IsOwnCameraVisual(child)then return end

-- 只接受遊戲自己加入的真正 ViewModel Model。
if child:IsA("Model")then
CVU_RefreshViewModelVisuals()
end
end)

camera.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if CVU_IsViewModelMutationActive()then return end
if CVU_IsOwnCameraVisual(obj)then return end

-- 遊戲自己分幀加入的真正 ViewModel 幾何 / 表面資產才觸發。
if obj:IsA("BasePart")
or obj:IsA("SpecialMesh")
or obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance")
or obj:IsA("Decal")
or obj:IsA("Texture")then
CVU_RefreshViewModelVisuals()
end
end)

camera.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
if CVU_IsViewModelMutationActive()then return end
if CVU_IsOwnCameraVisual(child)then return end

-- 舊刀 ViewModel 一離開 Camera 就立即停止 Inspect/Swing。
-- 不等 Tool 狀態、不等下一幀，避免 Butterfly Inspect 留在 Animator 裡。
local trackRoot=Runtime.KnifeExperienceTrackRoot
if Settings.KnifeExperienceEnabled
and child:IsA("Model")
and trackRoot
and (child==trackRoot or trackRoot:IsDescendantOf(child))then
pcall(CVU_KnifeExpCancelActionState,"ViewModelRemoved",true)
Runtime.KnifeExperienceWasKnifeHeld=false
end

if child==Runtime.MetalWeaponRoot or child:IsA("Model")then
CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache()
CVU_RefreshViewModelVisuals()
end
end)
end if Camera then CVU_BindCamera(Camera)end Workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()pcall(CVU_ClearKnifeExperience) pcall(CVU_DestroyGhostArmOverlays) pcall(CVU_RestoreGhostSourceArms) Camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera CVU_InvalidateViewModelCache() if Camera then CVU_BindCamera(Camera) CVU_RefreshViewModelVisuals() end end)local CVU_MetalCharacterConnections={}

pcall(function()conn:Disconnect()end)

CVU_MetalCharacterConnections[#CVU_MetalCharacterConnections+1]=character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)

CVU_RefreshViewModelVisuals()

-- Run after the camera/viewmodel update. This reads the game's final ADS visibility and mirrors it to the coating.
local CVU_METAL_VISIBILITY_BIND="ChickenVisualUI_MetalVisibilitySync"
pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CVU_METAL_VISIBILITY_BIND)end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep(CVU_METAL_VISIBILITY_BIND,Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value-1,function(dt)
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end

Runtime.MetalVisibilityClock=(Runtime.MetalVisibilityClock or 0)+(dt or 0)

Runtime.MetalVisibilityClock%=1/30
CVU_SyncMetalCoatVisibility()
if Runtime.ADSScopedSession and Runtime.ADSLatched then
CVU_ForceADSLockedPartsHidden()

Runtime.MetalVisibilityClock=0

-- 最後一層：一定在遊戲 ViewModel / Metal shell 更新後再壓一次。
-- 避免遊戲或 ViewModel refresh 在同一幀最後把槍管與 scope 黑邊寫回來。
local CVU_ADS_FINAL_BIND="ChickenVisualUI_ADS_BarrelHardLock"
pcall(function()RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(CVU_ADS_FINAL_BIND)end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep(CVU_ADS_FINAL_BIND,Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value,function()
if Runtime.Shutdown then return end

-- 先清理「狙擊槍 scope latch 洩漏到下一把武器」；
-- 否則下面的 scopeActive 會被舊 latch 永久維持為 true。
if Settings.MetalWeapon then
pcall(CVU_ValidateADSScopedWeapon)
end

local scopeActive=CVU_IsScopedADSActive()

if Settings.MetalWeapon then
local scopedWeapon=
Runtime.ADSScopedSession
or Runtime.ADSWeaponHasScope
or CVU_HasActiveScopedOptic()

-- 如果遊戲 scope GUI / FOV 已經證明進鏡，但某次 InputBegan 因 refresh 時機漏掉，
-- 在這裡自動補回 ADS latch。剛按第二次右鍵退出的 0.24 秒內不會重新 latch。
if scopeActive
and scopedWeapon
and not Runtime.ADSLatched
and os.clock()-(Runtime.ADSLastTogglePress or 0)>0.24 then
Runtime.ADSLatched=true
Runtime.ADSScopedSession=true
Runtime.ADSLatchedRoot=Runtime.MetalWeaponRoot
Runtime.ADSLastPositive=os.clock()
end

if Runtime.ADSLatched or (scopeActive and scopedWeapon)then
CVU_UpdateADSForwardPartVisibility()
CVU_ForceADSLockedPartsHidden()
end
end
end)

table.sort(translations,function(a,b)return #a[1]>#b[1]end)
local function tr(text)
local index=table.find(languageCodes,Settings.UILanguage)or 1
if index==1 then return text end
-- Replace against original text in one pass; translations never become input.
local out={} local cursor=1
while cursor<=#text do
local found=false
for _,row in ipairs(translations)do
if text:sub(cursor,cursor+#row[1]-1)==row[1]then
out[#out+1]=row[index] cursor+=#row[1] found=true break
end
end
if not found then out[#out+1]=text:sub(cursor,cursor) cursor+=1 end
end
return table.concat(out)
end
local textRecords=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function watchText(obj)
if not(obj:IsA("TextLabel")or obj:IsA("TextButton"))or textRecords[obj]then return end
if obj:GetAttribute("CVU_LanguageNative")then return end
local rec={raw=obj.Text,busy=false,rendered=nil} textRecords[obj]=rec
local function render()
rec.busy=true rec.rendered=tr(rec.raw) obj.Text=rec.rendered rec.busy=false
end
obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
-- Roblox may defer property events until after the write has returned.
if rec.busy or obj.Text==rec.rendered then return end rec.raw=obj.Text render()
end)
render()
end
local function refreshLanguage()
for obj,rec in pairs(textRecords)do
if obj.Parent then rec.busy=true rec.rendered=tr(rec.raw) obj.Text=rec.rendered rec.busy=false end
end
end
local function make(class,parent,props)
local obj=Instance.new(class)
for k,v in pairs(props or {})do obj[k]=v end
obj.Parent=parent return obj
end
local function text(parent,label,x,y,w,h,size)
return make("TextLabel",parent,{Text=label,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundTransparency=1,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextSize=size or 14,Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,ZIndex=200005,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(225,230,240)})
end
local function round(obj,r)
local c=obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")or make("UICorner",obj)
c.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r)
end
local function card(parent,x,y,w,h)
local obj=make("Frame",parent,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(27,30,38),BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=200003})
round(obj,12)
make("UIStroke",obj,{Color=Color3.fromRGB(65,75,90),Transparency=.55})
return obj
end
local function button(parent,label,x,y,w,h,callback)
local b=make("TextButton",parent,{Text=label,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(40,44,53),TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(235,240,250),TextSize=13,TextWrapped=true,Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=200006,AutoButtonColor=true})
round(b,7) b.Activated:Connect(callback) return b
end

-- Quarter-pixel scanlines with fractional edge coverage, built once.
-- Curved barbs keep their contour when the UI is enlarged; no asset fetch.
local featherRoot=make("Frame",Main,{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(43,10),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(96,98),BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=200003})
local function featherSpan(x,y,width,alpha)
if width<=0 or alpha<=0 then return end
-- UDim offsets are integers: a .25 offset height becomes zero.
-- Scale components preserve fractional geometry against the 96 x 98 root.
local f=make("Frame",featherRoot,{Position=UDim2.fromScale(x/96,y/98),Size=UDim2.fromScale(width/96,.25/98),BorderSizePixel=0,BackgroundColor3=Settings.UIAccent,BackgroundTransparency=1-math.clamp(alpha,0,1),ZIndex=200003})
f:SetAttribute("CVU_Accent",true)
end
local function featherPolygon(points)
local minY,maxY=100,0
for _,p in ipairs(points)do minY=math.min(minY,p[2]) maxY=math.max(maxY,p[2])end
for row=math.floor(minY*4),math.ceil(maxY*4)-1 do
local y=(row+.5)/4
local hits={}
for i,a in ipairs(points)do
local b=points[i%#points+1]
if(a[2]<=y and b[2]>y)or(b[2]<=y and a[2]>y)then
hits[#hits+1]=a[1]+(y-a[2])*(b[1]-a[1])/(b[2]-a[2])
end
end
table.sort(hits)
for i=1,#hits-1,2 do
local left,right=hits[i],hits[i+1]
local first,last=math.floor(left*4),math.ceil(right*4)-1
if first==last then
featherSpan(first/4,row/4,.25,(right-left)*4)
else
featherSpan(first/4,row/4,.25,((first+1)/4-left)*4)
featherSpan((first+1)/4,row/4,(last-first-1)/4,1)
featherSpan(last/4,row/4,.25,(right-last/4)*4)
end
end
end
end
local function featherCurve(points,a,b,c,d)
for step=0,20 do
local t=step/20 local u=1-t
points[#points+1]={u^3*a[1]+3*u*u*t*b[1]+3*u*t*t*c[1]+t^3*d[1],u^3*a[2]+3*u*u*t*b[2]+3*u*t*t*c[2]+t^3*d[2]}
end
end
local shaft={}
featherCurve(shaft,{13,97},{30,74},{56,33},{72,4})
featherCurve(shaft,{72,4},{61,34},{34,78},{16,97})
featherPolygon(shaft)
for i=0,8 do
local t=i/8
local x=24+43*t local y=80-65*t
local width=22*(1-t)+5
local right={}
featherCurve(right,{x,y},{x+width*.55,y-2},{x+width,y-12},{x+width,y-21+8*t})
featherCurve(right,{x+width,y-21+8*t},{x+width*.50,y-10},{x+3,y-10},{x,y-3})
featherPolygon(right)
local left={}
featherCurve(left,{x-2,y-1},{x-15+9*t,y-8},{x-13+9*t,y-19},{x-6+5*t,y-28+12*t})
featherCurve(left,{x-6+5*t,y-28+12*t},{x-7+5*t,y-16},{x-1,y-12},{x-1,y-5})
featherPolygon(left)
end

function CVU_SetWindowLayout(mode)
-- V77: page switching must never recenter the window.
-- Keep the exact dragged position; only the page contents/layout are changed.
local positionBeforeLayout=Main.Position
local appearance=mode=="appearance"
local size=appearance and Runtime.WindowAppearanceSize or Runtime.WindowNormalSize
Main.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(size.X,size.Y)
Main.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
Main.Position=positionBeforeLayout
local contentX=204
if Runtime.SidebarDivider then Runtime.SidebarDivider.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(180,18)end
TabBar.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(contentX,18)
TabBar.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(contentX+28),0,40)
for _,page in ipairs({DefaultPage,RagePage,settingsPage,musicPage,appearancePage,customPage})do
if page then
page.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(contentX,80)
page.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(contentX+28),1,-110)
end
end
if type(sideButtons)=="table"then
for i,b in ipairs(sideButtons)do
if b then
b.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(17,206+(i-1)*54)
b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(146,42)
b.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
local pad=b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
if pad then pad.PaddingLeft=UDim.new(0,0)end
local corner=b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
if corner then corner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,6)end
end
end
end
end

function CVU_RivalsAppearanceRefresh()
local state=Runtime.RivalsCosmeticsState
if not state then
Runtime.RivalsUnlockMasterButton.Text="RIVALS Provider 未載入"
Runtime.RivalsUnlockMasterButton.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(72,48,52)
Runtime.RivalsUnlockMasterButton:SetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor",true)
Runtime.RivalsSaveStatus.Text="找不到 RIVALS CosmeticLibrary / PlayerDataController，外觀後台沒有啟動。"
return
end
local summary=type(state.GetSummary)=="function"and state.GetSummary()or{}
local on=summary.MasterUnlock==true
Runtime.RivalsUnlockMasterButton.Text=on and"全部外觀解鎖：ON\nSkin + Wrap + Charm + Finisher"or"全部外觀解鎖：OFF\n點擊開啟"
Runtime.RivalsUnlockMasterButton.BackgroundColor3=on and Settings.UIAccent or Color3.fromRGB(35,45,57)
Runtime.RivalsUnlockMasterButton.TextColor3=on and Color3.fromRGB(10,19,28)or Color3.fromRGB(225,235,244)
Runtime.RivalsUnlockMasterButton:SetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor",on)
local counts=summary.Counts or{}
for _,name in ipairs({"Skin","Wrap","Charm","Finisher"})do
local label=Runtime.RivalsStatLabels[name]
if label then label.Text=tostring(counts[name]or 0)end
end
local saveState
if summary.SaveSupported then
saveState=summary.SaveError and("自動儲存錯誤："..tostring(summary.SaveError))or(summary.LoadedFromDisk and"自動儲存：READY｜已載入上次選擇"or"自動儲存：READY")
else
saveState="自動儲存：目前執行器不支援檔案 API，只保留本次 Session"
end
Runtime.RivalsSaveStatus.Text=
"目前保存／套用："..tostring(summary.WeaponCount or 0).." 把武器｜"..tostring(summary.CosmeticCount or 0).." 個外觀\n"..
saveState.."\n設定檔："..tostring(summary.ConfigPath or"memory-only").."｜擊殺動畫後台："..(summary.FinisherHookInstalled and"ON"or"OFF")
end

CVU_SetWindowLayout("normal")
Main.Position=tabWindowPosition

sideSelected=index==4 and 4 or 1
selected=index DefaultPage.Visible=index<=2 RagePage.Visible=false settingsPage.Visible=index==4 musicPage.Visible=index==3
visualColumn.Visible=index==1 combatColumn.Visible=index==2
visualColumn.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,0) visualColumn.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-10)
combatColumn.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(10,0) combatColumn.Size=UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-10)
if applyTheme then applyTheme()end
end

local originals=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function isPreserved(obj)
local p=obj
while p and p~=Main do
if p:GetAttribute("CVU_ThemePreview")or p:GetAttribute("CVU_PreserveColor")then return true end
if p.Name=="ToggleTrack"then return true end
if p.Name=="Swatch"or p.Name=="FullColorPalette"or p:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")then return true end
p=p.Parent
end
return false
end
local function themeObject(obj)
if isPreserved(obj)then return end
local light=Settings.UIStyle=="light"
if obj:IsA("GuiObject")then
if not originals[obj]then originals[obj]=obj.BackgroundColor3 end
local original=originals[obj]
local max=math.max(original.R,original.G,original.B)local min=math.min(original.R,original.G,original.B)
if obj:GetAttribute("CVU_Accent")then obj.BackgroundColor3=Settings.UIAccent
elseif max-min<.12 and obj.BackgroundTransparency<1 then
obj.BackgroundColor3=light and Color3.fromRGB(242,245,253)or Color3.fromRGB(18,30,40)
end
if obj:IsA("TextLabel")or obj:IsA("TextButton")or obj:IsA("TextBox")then
obj.TextColor3=light and Color3.fromRGB(40,48,77)or Color3.fromRGB(221,235,244)
end
if obj:IsA("TextButton")and obj:GetAttribute("ToggleEnabled")~=nil then
obj.TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
-- Do not pad the button: UIPadding also shifts the toggle's child geometry.
local track=obj:FindFirstChild("ToggleTrack")
if track then
track.BackgroundColor3=obj:GetAttribute("ToggleEnabled")and Settings.UIAccent or(light and Color3.fromRGB(185,195,215)or Color3.fromRGB(45,50,58))
for _,child in ipairs(track:GetChildren())do
if child:IsA("Frame")then child.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(245,250,255)end
end
end
end
elseif obj:IsA("UICorner")then obj.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,light and 12 or 5)
end
end
applyTheme=function()
for _,obj in ipairs(Main:GetDescendants())do themeObject(obj)end
local light=Settings.UIStyle=="light"
Main.BackgroundColor3=light and Color3.fromRGB(223,232,249)or Color3.fromRGB(7,16,25)
Main.BackgroundTransparency=Settings.UITransparency
Runtime.MainCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,light and 22 or 5)
for i,b in ipairs(tabs)do
b.BackgroundColor3=i==selected and Settings.UIAccent or(light and Color3.fromRGB(231,237,249)or Color3.fromRGB(17,30,41))
b.TextColor3=i==selected and Color3.fromRGB(10,19,28)or(light and Color3.fromRGB(45,52,82)or Color3.fromRGB(202,218,232))
end
for i,b in ipairs(languageButtons)do
local active=languageCodes[i]==Settings.UILanguage
b.BackgroundColor3=active and Settings.UIAccent or(light and Color3.fromRGB(224,231,246)or Color3.fromRGB(30,45,57))
b.TextColor3=active and Color3.fromRGB(10,19,28)or(light and Color3.fromRGB(45,52,82)or Color3.fromRGB(220,232,240))
end
for i,b in ipairs(sideButtons)do
b.BackgroundColor3=i==sideSelected and Settings.UIAccent or(light and Color3.fromRGB(231,237,249)or Color3.fromRGB(17,30,41))
b.TextColor3=i==sideSelected and Color3.fromRGB(10,19,28)or(light and Color3.fromRGB(45,52,82)or Color3.fromRGB(202,218,232))
end
for i,b in ipairs(Runtime.AppearanceTabButtons or {})do
local active=i==Runtime.AppearanceTabSelected
b.BackgroundColor3=active and Settings.UIAccent or(light and Color3.fromRGB(231,237,249)or Color3.fromRGB(17,30,41))
b.TextColor3=active and Color3.fromRGB(10,19,28)or(light and Color3.fromRGB(45,52,82)or Color3.fromRGB(202,218,232))
end
for i,b in ipairs(styleButtons)do
local border=b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")or make("UIStroke",b)
border.Color=Settings.UIAccent border.Thickness=2
border.Transparency=((i==1 and not light)or(i==2 and light))and 0 or 1
end
local c=Settings.UIAccent
Runtime.UIHexBox.Text=string.format("#%02X%02X%02X",math.floor(c.R*255+.5),math.floor(c.G*255+.5),math.floor(c.B*255+.5))
CVU_RefreshAllToggleVisuals()
for _,refresh in ipairs(Runtime.CVUUISliderRefreshers or {})do pcall(refresh)end
for _,refresh in ipairs(Runtime.CVUUIColorRefreshers or {})do pcall(refresh)end
if ui.refreshMusic then ui.refreshMusic()end
end

Main.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)task.defer(function()if obj.Parent then watchText(obj)themeObject(obj)end end)end)

-- ============================================================
-- ChickenVisualUI OVERKILL Provider V2 Clean
-- OVERKILL by One-Shot / PlaceId 124842176624983

-- This is NOT a renamed RIVALS provider.
-- No FighterController, GunModule, DuelSubject, RIVALS item.Info,
-- RIVALS ray redirect or RIVALS cooldown assumptions are used here.
-- ============================================================
do
 local placeOK=game.PlaceId==124842176624983
 local nameOK=string.find(string.upper(tostring(game.Name or"")),"OVERKILL",1,true)~=nil
 if not placeOK and not nameOK then
  warn("[ChickenVisual OVERKILL V2] OVERKILL not detected")
  return
 end
end

end

local function accent()
 return Color3.fromRGB(Settings.UIAccentR,Settings.UIAccentG,Settings.UIAccentB)
end

local function connect(signal,fn)
 local c=signal:Connect(fn)
 Runtime.Connections[#Runtime.Connections+1]=c
 return c
end

-- ============================================================
-- Lightweight persistence
-- ============================================================
local SETTINGS_FILE="ChickenVisualUI_OVERKILL_V2.json"

local function saveSettings()
 if type(writefile)~="function"then return end
 local ok,data=pcall(function()return HttpService:JSONEncode(Settings)end)
 if ok then pcall(writefile,SETTINGS_FILE,data)end
end

local function loadSettings()
 if type(readfile)~="function"or type(isfile)~="function"then return end
 local okExists,exists=pcall(isfile,SETTINGS_FILE)
 if not okExists or not exists then return end
 local okRead,data=pcall(readfile,SETTINGS_FILE)
 if not okRead or type(data)~="string"then return end
 local okDecode,decoded=pcall(function()return HttpService:JSONDecode(data)end)
 if not okDecode or type(decoded)~="table"then return end
 for k,v in pairs(decoded)do
  if Settings[k]~=nil and type(v)==type(Settings[k])then Settings[k]=v end
 end
 -- Built-in SWit values are source presets, never loaded from old config.
 Settings.SWitNear=.84
 Settings.SWitMid=.96
 Settings.SWitFar=.99
 Settings.SWitFOV=153
 Settings.SWitFollow=.27
end
loadSettings()

-- ============================================================
-- OVERKILL direct entity provider
-- ============================================================
local function aliveCharacter(model)
 if not(model and model:IsA("Model")and model.Parent and model:IsDescendantOf(Workspace))then return false end
 if model:GetAttribute("Dead")==true or model:GetAttribute("Eliminated")==true or model:GetAttribute("IsDead")==true then return false end
 local hum=model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 if hum and hum.Health<=0 then return false end
 local root=model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or model:FindFirstChild("Torso")or model.PrimaryPart
 return root~=nil
end

local function refreshEntityIndex(force)
 local now=os.clock()
 if not force and now-(Runtime.EntityIndexAt or 0)<1.50 then return end
 Runtime.EntityIndexAt=now
 table.clear(Runtime.EntityIndex)

 -- Direct Player.Character is always first choice and costs almost nothing.
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if aliveCharacter(player.Character)then
   Runtime.EntityIndex[player]=player.Character
  end
 end

 -- One shared Workspace scan every ~1.5 s, NOT once per player / per frame.
 -- Only used for players whose combat avatar is not their Player.Character.
 local unresolved={}
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if not Runtime.EntityIndex[player]then unresolved[player]=true end
 end
 if next(unresolved)==nil then return end

 local scanned=0
 for _,model in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants())do
  if model:IsA("Model")and aliveCharacter(model)then
   scanned+=1
   if scanned>420 then break end

   local owner=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
   if owner and unresolved[owner]then
    Runtime.EntityIndex[owner]=model
    unresolved[owner]=nil
   else
    for player in pairs(unresolved)do
     local matched=false
     if model.Name==player.Name or model.Name==player.DisplayName then
      matched=true
     else
      for _,key in ipairs({"UserId","PlayerUserId","OwnerUserId","OwnerId"})do
       if tonumber(model:GetAttribute(key))==player.UserId then matched=true break end
      end
      if not matched then
       for _,key in ipairs({"PlayerName","Username","OwnerName"})do
        if tostring(model:GetAttribute(key)or"")==player.Name then matched=true break end
       end
      end
     end
     if matched then
      Runtime.EntityIndex[player]=model
      unresolved[player]=nil
      break
     end
    end
   end
   if next(unresolved)==nil then break end
  end
 end
end

local function resolveCharacter(player)
 if not player then return nil end
 if aliveCharacter(player.Character)then return player.Character end
 refreshEntityIndex(false)
 local indexed=Runtime.EntityIndex[player]
 if aliveCharacter(indexed)then return indexed end
 return nil
end

local function teamValue(player)
 if not player then return nil end
 if player.Team and not player.Neutral then return "TEAM:"..tostring(player.Team.Name)end
 for _,key in ipairs({"TeamID","TeamId","Team","Side","Faction","Squad","SquadId"})do
  local value=player:GetAttribute(key)
  if value~=nil then return "ATTR:"..tostring(value)end
 end
 local c=player.Character
 if c then
  for _,key in ipairs({"TeamID","TeamId","Team","Side","Faction","Squad","SquadId"})do
   local value=c:GetAttribute(key)
   if value~=nil then return "CHAR:"..tostring(value)end
  end
 end
 return nil
end

local function refreshTeamMode()
 local now=os.clock()
 if now-(Runtime.TeamModeAt or 0)<1.0 then return Runtime.TeamModeActive end
 Runtime.TeamModeAt=now

 local unique={}
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if player~=LocalPlayer and aliveCharacter(resolveCharacter(player))then
   local v=teamValue(player)
   if v~=nil then unique[v]=true end
  end
 end
 local mine=teamValue(LocalPlayer)
 if mine~=nil then unique[mine]=true end

 local count=0
 for _ in pairs(unique)do
  count+=1
  if count>=2 then break end
 end
 Runtime.TeamModeActive=count>=2
 return Runtime.TeamModeActive
end

local function sameTeam(player)
 if not Settings.TeamCheck then return false end
 if not player or player==LocalPlayer then return true end

 -- OVERKILL FFA can put everybody on the same Roblox Team. Team filtering only becomes
 -- active when the live session actually contains 2+ distinct team identifiers.
 if not refreshTeamMode()then return false end

 local a=teamValue(LocalPlayer)
 local b=teamValue(player)
 return a~=nil and b~=nil and a==b
end

local function isEnemy(player)
 if not player or player==LocalPlayer or player.Parent~=Players then return false end
 if sameTeam(player)then return false end
 return aliveCharacter(resolveCharacter(player))
end

local function getParts(character)
 if not character then return nil,nil,nil,nil end
 local hum=character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
 local head=character:FindFirstChild("Head")
 local root=character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")or character.PrimaryPart
 local chest=character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")or root
 return head,chest,root,hum
end

local function getWeaponName(player)
 local character=resolveCharacter(player)
 if character then
  for _,obj in ipairs(character:GetChildren())do
   if obj:IsA("Tool")then return obj.Name end
  end
  for _,key in ipairs({"EquippedWeapon","CurrentWeapon","Weapon","WeaponName","Item","ItemName","EquippedItem"})do
   local v=character:GetAttribute(key)
   if type(v)=="string"and v~=""then return v end
  end
 end
 if player then
  for _,key in ipairs({"EquippedWeapon","CurrentWeapon","Weapon","WeaponName","Item","ItemName","EquippedItem"})do
   local v=player:GetAttribute(key)
   if type(v)=="string"and v~=""then return v end
  end
 end

 -- Local first-person fallback: many shooters keep the active weapon only in Camera/ViewModel.
 if player==LocalPlayer and Camera then
  local best=nil
  for _,obj in ipairs(Camera:GetChildren())do
   local n=string.lower(obj.Name)
   if obj:IsA("Model")or obj:IsA("Folder")or obj:IsA("Tool")then
    if string.find(n,"viewmodel",1,true)
     or string.find(n,"weapon",1,true)
     or string.find(n,"gun",1,true)
     or string.find(n,"arms",1,true)then
     for _,child in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants())do
      local cn=string.lower(child.Name)
      if child:IsA("Tool")or child:IsA("Model")then
       if not string.find(cn,"arm",1,true)
        and not string.find(cn,"hand",1,true)
        and #child.Name>=2 and #child.Name<=40 then
        best=child.Name
        break
       end
      end
     end
    end
    if best then break end
   end
  end
  if best then return best end
 end
 return "Unknown"
end

local function weaponKind(name)
 local n=string.lower(tostring(name or""))
 if string.find(n,"sniper",1,true)
  or string.find(n,"awp",1,true)
  or string.find(n,"barrett",1,true)
  or string.find(n,"intervention",1,true)
  or string.find(n,"marksman",1,true)
  or string.find(n,"kar",1,true)then
  return "sniper"
 end
 if string.find(n,"shotgun",1,true)or string.find(n,"pump",1,true)then return "shotgun"end
 if string.find(n,"revolver",1,true)or string.find(n,"deagle",1,true)then return "revolver"end
 if string.find(n,"knife",1,true)or string.find(n,"katana",1,true)or string.find(n,"sword",1,true)then return "melee"end
 return "gun"
end

-- ============================================================
-- Combat/lobby state
-- ============================================================
local function explicitMatchAttribute()
 local character=LocalPlayer.Character
 for _,holder in ipairs({LocalPlayer,character,Workspace})do
  if holder then
   for _,key in ipairs({"InMatch","InGame","Playing","MatchActive","RoundActive"})do
    local v=holder:GetAttribute(key)
    if v==true then return true,true end
    if v==false and(key=="InMatch"or key=="InGame"or key=="Playing"or key=="MatchActive")then return false,true end
   end
  end
 end
 return false,false
end

local function lobbyUIVisible()
 local gui=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
 if not gui then return false end
 for _,obj in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants())do
  if obj:IsA("GuiObject")and obj.Visible then
   local n=string.lower(obj.Name)
   if string.find(n,"lobby",1,true)
    or string.find(n,"mainmenu",1,true)
    or string.find(n,"home_menu",1,true)
    or string.find(n,"matchmaking",1,true)then
    return true
   end
  end
 end
 return false
end

local function hudCombatEvidence()
 local gui=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
 if not gui then return false end
 local score=0
 for _,obj in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants())do
  if obj:IsA("GuiObject")and obj.Visible then
   local n=string.lower(obj.Name)
   if string.find(n,"ammo",1,true)then score=score+3 end
   if string.find(n,"crosshair",1,true)or string.find(n,"reticle",1,true)then score=score+2 end
   if string.find(n,"round",1,true)or string.find(n,"score",1,true)then score=score+1 end
   if score>=4 then return true end
  end
 end
 return false
end

local function combatActive()
 if Settings.ForceCombat then return true end

 local value,known=explicitMatchAttribute()
 if known then return value end

 -- Lobby-name UI is only trusted when there is no combat HUD evidence.
 local hudActive=hudCombatEvidence()
 if lobbyUIVisible()and not hudActive then return false end
 if hudActive then return true end

 -- Do NOT require a recognized Tool / weapon name. OVERKILL may use a custom
 -- viewmodel/controller rather than Tool or replicated weapon attributes.
 if not resolveCharacter(LocalPlayer)then return false end
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if isEnemy(player)then return true end
 end
 return false
end

-- ============================================================
-- World visibility / final fire safety
-- ============================================================
local function friendlyIgnoreList()
 local ignore={}
 if LocalPlayer.Character then ignore[#ignore+1]=LocalPlayer.Character end
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if player~=LocalPlayer and sameTeam(player)then
   local c=resolveCharacter(player)
   if c then ignore[#ignore+1]=c end
  end
 end
 return ignore
end

local function castTo(worldPos,maxDistance)
 if not Camera or typeof(worldPos)~="Vector3"then return nil end
 local origin=Camera.CFrame.Position
 local delta=worldPos-origin
 if delta.Magnitude<=.01 then return nil end
 local params=RaycastParams.new()
 params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
 params.IgnoreWater=true
 params.FilterDescendantsInstances=friendlyIgnoreList()
 return Workspace:Raycast(origin,delta.Unit*math.min(delta.Magnitude,maxDistance or delta.Magnitude),params)
end

local function visibleTarget(player,part)
 if not(player and part and part:IsA("BasePart"))then return false end
 local result=castTo(part.Position)
 if not result then return true end
 local character=resolveCharacter(player)
 return character and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)or false
end

local function strictHeadRay(player,head)
 if not(player and head and head:IsA("BasePart"))then return false end
 local result=castTo(head.Position)
 if not result then return false end
 local character=resolveCharacter(player)
 if not character or not result.Instance or not result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)then return false end
 return result.Instance==head or result.Instance.Name=="Head"
end

 line.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(d.Magnitude,thickness or 2)
 line.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(d.Y,d.X))
 line.BackgroundColor3=color or accent()
 line.Visible=true
end

local function hideESP(d)
 if not d then return end
 if d.Highlight then d.Highlight.Enabled=false d.Highlight.Adornee=nil end
 if d.Billboard then d.Billboard.Enabled=false d.Billboard.Adornee=nil end
 for _,line in ipairs(d.Box or{})do line.Visible=false end
 for _,line in ipairs(d.Skeleton or{})do line.Visible=false end
end

local function destroyESP(player)
 local d=Runtime.ESP[player]
 if not d then return end
 for _,obj in ipairs({d.Highlight,d.Billboard})do
  if obj then pcall(function()obj:Destroy()end)end
 end
 for _,line in ipairs(d.Box or{})do pcall(function()line:Destroy()end)end
 for _,line in ipairs(d.Skeleton or{})do pcall(function()line:Destroy()end)end
 Runtime.ESP[player]=nil
 Runtime.CharacterCache[player]=nil
end

local function projectedBounds(character)
 if not Camera or not character then return nil end
 local ok,cf,size=pcall(function()return character:GetBoundingBox()end)
 if not ok or typeof(cf)~="CFrame"or typeof(size)~="Vector3"then return nil end
 local h=size*.5
 local minX,minY=math.huge,math.huge
 local maxX,maxY=-math.huge,-math.huge
 local valid=false
 for _,v in ipairs({
  Vector3.new(-h.X,-h.Y,-h.Z),Vector3.new(h.X,-h.Y,-h.Z),
  Vector3.new(-h.X,h.Y,-h.Z),Vector3.new(h.X,h.Y,-h.Z),
  Vector3.new(-h.X,-h.Y,h.Z),Vector3.new(h.X,-h.Y,h.Z),
  Vector3.new(-h.X,h.Y,h.Z),Vector3.new(h.X,h.Y,h.Z),
 })do
  local p=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(cf:PointToWorldSpace(v))
  if p.Z>0 then
   valid=true
   minX=math.min(minX,p.X) minY=math.min(minY,p.Y)
   maxX=math.max(maxX,p.X) maxY=math.max(maxY,p.Y)
  end
 end
 if not valid then return nil end
 return minX,minY,maxX,maxY
end

local function updateESPPlayer(player,d)
 if not Settings.ESP or not isEnemy(player)then hideESP(d)return end
 local character=resolveCharacter(player)
 local head,chest,root,hum=getParts(character)
 if not(root and head)then hideESP(d)return end

 local rootScreen,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
 if not onScreen or rootScreen.Z<=0 then hideESP(d)return end

 d.Highlight.Adornee=character
 d.Highlight.OutlineColor=accent()
 d.Highlight.Enabled=Settings.ESPHighlight

 d.Billboard.Adornee=head
 d.Billboard.Enabled=Settings.ESPName or Settings.ESPDistance or Settings.ESPHealth or Settings.EnemyWeaponESP
 d.Name.Visible=Settings.ESPName
 d.Name.Text=player.DisplayName~=""and player.DisplayName or player.Name
 d.Distance.Visible=Settings.ESPDistance
 d.Distance.Text=tostring(math.floor((Camera.CFrame.Position-root.Position).Magnitude+.5)).." stud"

 local hp=hum and hum.Health or character:GetAttribute("Health")
 local maxHP=hum and hum.MaxHealth or character:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")
 if type(hp)~="number"then hp=100 end
 if type(maxHP)~="number"or maxHP<=0 then maxHP=100 end
 d.Health.Visible=Settings.ESPHealth
 d.Health.Text=string.format("HP %d / %d",math.max(0,math.floor(hp+.5)),math.max(1,math.floor(maxHP+.5)))

 d.Weapon.Visible=Settings.EnemyWeaponESP
 d.Weapon.Text=Settings.EnemyWeaponESP and("[ "..getWeaponName(player).." ]")or""

 local l,t,r,b=projectedBounds(character)
 if Settings.ESPBox and l then
  local color=accent()
  drawLine(d.Box[1],Vector2.new(l,t),Vector2.new(r,t),color,2)
  drawLine(d.Box[2],Vector2.new(r,t),Vector2.new(r,b),color,2)
  drawLine(d.Box[3],Vector2.new(r,b),Vector2.new(l,b),color,2)
  drawLine(d.Box[4],Vector2.new(l,b),Vector2.new(l,t),color,2)
 else
  for _,line in ipairs(d.Box)do line.Visible=false end
 end

 if Settings.ESPSkeleton then
  local bones=character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")and R15Bones or R6Bones
  for i,line in ipairs(d.Skeleton)do
   local pair=bones[i]
   if pair then
    local a=character:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
    local bb=character:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
    if a and bb and a:IsA("BasePart")and bb:IsA("BasePart")then
     local pa,oa=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(a.Position)
     local pb,ob=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(bb.Position)
     if oa and ob and pa.Z>0 and pb.Z>0 then
      drawLine(line,Vector2.new(pa.X,pa.Y),Vector2.new(pb.X,pb.Y),Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),2)
     else line.Visible=false end
    else line.Visible=false end
   else line.Visible=false end
  end
 else
  for _,line in ipairs(d.Skeleton)do line.Visible=false end
 end
end

local function updateDirections()
 if not Settings.ESPDirectionIndicators or not Settings.ESP then
  for _,obj in pairs(Runtime.Direction)do if obj then obj.Visible=false end end
  return
 end
 local center=Camera.ViewportSize*.5
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if player~=LocalPlayer then
   local obj=directionIndicator(player)
   if not isEnemy(player)then obj.Visible=false
   else
    local c=resolveCharacter(player)
    local _,_,root=getParts(c)
    if not root then obj.Visible=false
    else
     local p,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
     local dir
     if onScreen and p.Z>0 then
      local d=Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y)-center
      dir=d.Magnitude>4 and d.Unit or Vector2.new(0,-1)
     else
      local rel=root.Position-Camera.CFrame.Position
      local v=Vector2.new(rel:Dot(Camera.CFrame.RightVector),-rel:Dot(Camera.CFrame.LookVector))
      dir=v.Magnitude>.001 and v.Unit or Vector2.new(0,-1)
     end
     obj.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(center.X+dir.X*Settings.ESPDirectionRadius,center.Y+dir.Y*Settings.ESPDirectionRadius)
     obj.Rotation=math.deg(math.atan2(dir.Y,dir.X))+90
     obj.TextColor3=accent()
     obj.Visible=true
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

local FOVCircle=Instance.new("Frame")
FOVCircle.Name="OVERKILL_FOV"
FOVCircle.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
FOVCircle.BackgroundTransparency=1
FOVCircle.Visible=false
FOVCircle.ZIndex=120
FOVCircle.Parent=Overlay
local fovCorner=Instance.new("UICorner")
fovCorner.CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
fovCorner.Parent=FOVCircle
local fovStroke=Instance.new("UIStroke")

local function styleFOV()
 if Settings.AimStyle=="自訂"then return math.clamp(Settings.CustomFOV,80,500)end
 return 153
end

local function followStrength()
 if Settings.AimStyle=="SWit"then return .27 end
 if Settings.AimStyle=="自訂"then return math.clamp(Settings.CustomFollow,.15,.65)end
 return .38
end

local function distanceSpeed(px)
 if Settings.AimStyle=="SWit"then
  if px<=60 then return .84 end
  if px<120 then
   local a=(px-60)/60
   return .84+(.96-.84)*a
  end
  if px<=220 then return .96 end
  if px<320 then
   local a=(px-220)/100
   return .96+(.99-.96)*a
  end
  return .99
 elseif Settings.AimStyle=="自訂"then
  local near=math.clamp(Settings.CustomNear,.60,1.60)
  local mid=math.clamp(Settings.CustomMid,.60,1.60)
  local far=math.clamp(Settings.CustomFar,.60,1.60)
  if px<=60 then return near end
  if px<120 then return near+(mid-near)*((px-60)/60)end
  if px<=220 then return mid end
  if px<320 then return mid+(far-mid)*((px-220)/100)end
  return far
 end
 -- 彈弓叔叔 preset.
 if px<=60 then return .78 end
 if px<=220 then return .88 end
 return .94
end

local function moveMouse(dx,dy)
 if math.abs(dx)<.05 and math.abs(dy)<.05 then return false end

 if type(mousemoverel)=="function"then
  local ok=pcall(mousemoverel,dx,dy)
  if ok then Runtime.LastInputMode="mousemoverel" return true end
 end

 local vim
 pcall(function()vim=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")end)
 if vim then
  local p=UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
  local ok=pcall(function()vim:SendMouseMoveEvent(p.X+dx,p.Y+dy,game)end)
  if ok then Runtime.LastInputMode="VirtualInputManager" return true end
 end

 -- Final fallback for OVERKILL/executors where synthetic mouse movement does not affect aim.
 -- Convert pixel delta into a small camera rotation instead of silently doing nothing.
 if Camera then
  local viewport=Camera.ViewportSize
  local vfov=math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView)
  local yScale=math.tan(vfov*.5)/math.max(1,viewport.Y*.5)
  local xScale=yScale*(viewport.X/math.max(1,viewport.Y))
  local yaw=-dx*xScale
  local pitch=-dy*yScale
  local ok=pcall(function()
   Camera.CFrame=Camera.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(pitch,yaw,0)
  end)
  if ok then Runtime.LastInputMode="CameraCFrame" return true end
 end

 Runtime.LastInputMode="failed"
 return false
end

local function mouseFire()
 if type(mouse1click)=="function"then
  local ok=pcall(mouse1click)
  return ok
 end
 if type(mouse1press)=="function"and type(mouse1release)=="function"then
  local ok=pcall(function()
   mouse1press()
   task.wait(.008)
   mouse1release()
  end)
  return ok
 end
 local vim
 pcall(function()vim=game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")end)
 if vim then
  local p=UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
  return pcall(function()
   vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(p.X,p.Y,0,true,game,0)
   vim:SendMouseButtonEvent(p.X,p.Y,0,false,game,0)
  end)
 end
 return false
end

local function currentScreenCenter()
 return Camera.ViewportSize*.5
end

local function targetHeadScreen(player)
 local c=resolveCharacter(player)
 local head=getParts(c)
 if not head then return nil,nil end
 local p,onScreen=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
 if not onScreen or p.Z<=0 then return nil,nil end
 return Vector2.new(p.X,p.Y),head
end

local function acquireTarget()
 if not Runtime.CombatActive then return nil end
 local base=currentScreenCenter()
 local maxRange=styleFOV()
 local best=nil
 local bestDist=math.huge
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if isEnemy(player)then
   local screen,head=targetHeadScreen(player)
   if screen and head and visibleTarget(player,head)then
    local d=(screen-base).Magnitude
    if d<=maxRange and d<bestDist then
     bestDist=d
     best={Player=player,Head=head,Screen=screen,Distance=d}
    end
   end
  end
 end
 return best
end

local function projectedHeadRadius(head)
 if not(head and head:IsA("BasePart"))then return 7 end
 local center=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
 local up=Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position+Vector3.new(0,head.Size.Y*.5,0))
 local radius=math.abs(up.Y-center.Y)*.60
 return math.clamp(radius,4,18)
end

local function manualFlickCorrection(target)
 if not Settings.ManualFlickCorrection or not target or not target.Head then return false end
 local center=currentScreenCenter()
 local screen=target.Screen
 local delta=screen-center
 local distance=delta.Magnitude
 if Runtime.ManualFlickPlayer~=target.Player then
  Runtime.ManualFlickPlayer=target.Player
  Runtime.ManualFlickConsumed=false
  Runtime.ManualFlickLastDistance=distance
 end
 if distance>=72 then Runtime.ManualFlickConsumed=false end
 if Runtime.ManualFlickConsumed or distance<5 or distance>46 then
  Runtime.ManualFlickLastDistance=distance
  return false
 end
 local raw=UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
 local userDelta=Vector2.new(raw.X,raw.Y)
 local old=Runtime.ManualFlickLastDistance
 Runtime.ManualFlickLastDistance=distance
 if userDelta.Magnitude<3.8 or delta.Magnitude<=.001 then return false end
 if userDelta.Unit:Dot(delta.Unit)<.58 then return false end
 local predicted=(delta-userDelta).Magnitude
 if old-distance<.7 and distance-predicted<1.15 then return false end
 local correction=math.min(math.max(0,distance-2.4),16.5)
 if correction<1 then return false end
 local step=delta.Unit*correction
 moveMouse(step.X,step.Y)
 Runtime.ManualFlickConsumed=true
 return true
end

local function updateFOV(target,dt)
 local center=currentScreenCenter()
 if Runtime.CombatActive and Settings.AimFOVFollow and target and target.Screen then
  local old=Runtime.FOVCenter or center
  local strength=followStrength()
  local alpha=1-math.pow(1-strength,math.clamp(dt*60,.25,3))
  Runtime.FOVCenter=old:Lerp(target.Screen,math.clamp(alpha,0,1))
 else
  Runtime.FOVCenter=center
 end
 local f=styleFOV()
 FOVCircle.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(f*2,f*2)
 FOVCircle.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(Runtime.FOVCenter.X,Runtime.FOVCenter.Y)
 FOVCircle.Visible=Settings.AimAssist and Settings.AimFOVVisible
 fovStroke.Color=accent()
end

local function updateAim(dt)
 Runtime.CombatActive=combatActive()
 if not Settings.AimAssist or not Runtime.CombatActive then
  Runtime.CurrentTarget=nil
  updateFOV(nil,dt)
  return
 end

 local target=acquireTarget()
 Runtime.CurrentTarget=target
 updateFOV(target,dt)
 if not target then return end

 if manualFlickCorrection(target)then return end

 local center=currentScreenCenter()
 local delta=target.Screen-center
 local scale=distanceSpeed(delta.Magnitude)
 local baseResponse=Settings.AimStyle=="SWit"and 13.5 or(Settings.AimStyle=="彈弓叔叔"and 10.5 or 12.0)
 local alpha=1-math.exp(-baseResponse*scale*dt)
 local step=delta*math.clamp(alpha,0,1)
 if step.Magnitude>0.4 then
  moveMouse(step.X,step.Y)
 end

 if Settings.AimAutoFire then
  local weapon=getWeaponName(LocalPlayer)
  local kind=weaponKind(weapon)
  if kind=="melee"then return end
  if kind=="sniper"and not Runtime.ADSDown and Camera.FieldOfView>58 then return end

  local freshScreen,head=targetHeadScreen(target.Player)
  if not freshScreen or not head then return end
  local gap=(freshScreen-center).Magnitude
  local safe=projectedHeadRadius(head)
  if gap<=safe and strictHeadRay(target.Player,head)then
   local now=os.clock()
   local interval=kind=="sniper"and .34 or(kind=="shotgun"and .18 or .075)
   if now-Runtime.LastAutoFire>=interval then
    if mouseFire()then Runtime.LastAutoFire=now end
   end
  end
 end
end

local function createPage(name)
 local scroll=Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
 scroll.Name=name
 scroll.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
 scroll.BackgroundTransparency=1
 scroll.BorderSizePixel=0
 scroll.ScrollBarThickness=5
 scroll.ScrollBarImageColor3=accent()
 scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
 scroll.CanvasSize=UDim2.new()
 scroll.Visible=false
 scroll.ZIndex=202
 scroll.Parent=Content
 local list=Instance.new("UIListLayout")
 list.Padding=UDim.new(0,8)
 list.Parent=scroll
 pages[name]=scroll
 return scroll
end

local function refreshTabs()
 for name,b in pairs(tabButtons)do
  local active=name==selectedTab
  b.BackgroundColor3=active and accent()or Color3.fromRGB(18,31,42)
  b.TextColor3=active and Color3.fromRGB(8,18,26)or Color3.fromRGB(215,230,240)
  pages[name].Visible=active
 end
end

local function addToggle(parent,textValue,getter,setter)
 local r=row(parent,42)
 label(r,textValue)
 local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
 b.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5)
 b.Position=UDim2.new(1,-12,.5,0)
 b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(74,28)
 b.BorderSizePixel=0
 b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
 b.TextSize=12
 b.ZIndex=205
 b.Parent=r
 corner(b,14)
 local function refresh()
  local on=getter()==true
  b.Text=on and"ON"or"OFF"
  b.BackgroundColor3=on and accent()or Color3.fromRGB(48,56,65)
  b.TextColor3=on and Color3.fromRGB(5,20,25)or Color3.fromRGB(225,230,236)
 end
 connect(b.Activated,function()
  setter(not getter())
  saveSettings()
  refresh()
 end)
 refresh()
 return r,b,refresh
end

local function addCycle(parent,textValue,getter,values,setter)
 local r=row(parent,42)
 label(r,textValue)
 local b=Instance.new("TextButton")
 b.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5)
 b.Position=UDim2.new(1,-12,.5,0)
 b.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(160,28)
 b.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(28,43,55)
 b.BorderSizePixel=0
 b.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
 b.TextSize=12
 b.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(230,240,246)
 b.ZIndex=205
 b.Parent=r
 corner(b,6)
 local function refresh()b.Text=tostring(getter())end
 connect(b.Activated,function()
  local current=getter()
  local index=table.find(values,current)or 0
  index=index%#values+1
  setter(values[index])
  saveSettings()
  refresh()
 end)
 refresh()
 return r,b,refresh
end

local function addSlider(parent,textValue,minValue,maxValue,getter,setter,formatter)
 local r=row(parent,48)
 local title=label(r,textValue)
 title.Size=UDim2.new(1,-210,1,0)
 local valueLabel=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 valueLabel.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5)
 valueLabel.Position=UDim2.new(1,-14,.5,0)
 valueLabel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(70,24)
 valueLabel.BackgroundTransparency=1
 valueLabel.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
 valueLabel.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
 valueLabel.TextSize=12
 valueLabel.TextColor3=accent()
 valueLabel.ZIndex=205
 valueLabel.Parent=r

 local bar=Instance.new("Frame")
 bar.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(1,.5)
 bar.Position=UDim2.new(1,-90,.5,0)
 bar.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(110,5)
 bar.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(50,62,72)
 bar.BorderSizePixel=0
 bar.ZIndex=205
 bar.Parent=r
 corner(bar,3)
 local fill=Instance.new("Frame")
 fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(0,1)
 fill.BackgroundColor3=accent()
 fill.BorderSizePixel=0
 fill.ZIndex=206
 fill.Parent=bar
 corner(fill,3)

 local dragging=false
 local function refresh()
  local v=math.clamp(tonumber(getter())or minValue,minValue,maxValue)
  local p=(v-minValue)/(maxValue-minValue)
  fill.Size=UDim2.fromScale(p,1)
  valueLabel.Text=formatter and formatter(v)or string.format("%.2f",v)
 end
 local function applyX(x)
  local p=math.clamp((x-bar.AbsolutePosition.X)/math.max(1,bar.AbsoluteSize.X),0,1)
  setter(minValue+(maxValue-minValue)*p)
  refresh()
 end
 connect(bar.InputBegan,function(input)
  if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging=true applyX(input.Position.X)end
 end)
 connect(UserInputService.InputChanged,function(input)
  if dragging and input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then applyX(input.Position.X)end
 end)
 connect(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
  if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and dragging then
   dragging=false
   saveSettings()
  end
 end)
 refresh()
 return r,refresh
end

-- ============================================================
-- Input / runtime loops
-- ============================================================
connect(UserInputService.InputBegan,function(input,processed)
 if processed then return end
 if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
  Runtime.ADSDown=true
  Runtime.ADSStartedAt=os.clock()
 end
end)
connect(UserInputService.InputEnded,function(input)
 if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then Runtime.ADSDown=false end
end)

local espClock=0
local entityClock=0
connect(RunService.Heartbeat,function(dt)
 if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
 entityClock=entityClock+(dt or 0)
 if entityClock>=1.50 then
  entityClock=0
  refreshEntityIndex(true)
 end
 espClock=espClock+(dt or 0)
 if espClock>=.12 then
  espClock=0
  for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
   if player~=LocalPlayer and not Runtime.ESP[player]then createESP(player)end
  end
  for player,d in pairs(Runtime.ESP)do
   if player.Parent~=Players then destroyESP(player)
   elseif not Settings.ESP then hideESP(d)end
  end
 end
 local entityCount=0
 local enemyCount=0
 for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers())do
  if resolveCharacter(player)then entityCount+=1 end
  if isEnemy(player)then enemyCount+=1 end
 end
 Status.Text=string.format(
  "combat=%s｜entities=%d｜enemies=%d｜input=%s",
  tostring(Runtime.CombatActive),
  entityCount,
  enemyCount,
  tostring(Runtime.LastInputMode)
 )
end)

connect(RunService.RenderStepped,function(dt)
 if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
 Camera=Workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera
 Runtime.RenderAccum=(Runtime.RenderAccum or 0)+(dt or 0)

 -- Aim remains per-frame for responsiveness.
 updateAim(dt)

 -- ESP geometry/skeleton projection at ~30 Hz is visually smooth enough and much cheaper.
 if Runtime.RenderAccum>=1/30 then
  Runtime.RenderAccum=0
  for player,d in pairs(Runtime.ESP)do
   if player.Parent==Players then updateESPPlayer(player,d)end
  end
  updateDirections()
 end
end)

connect(Players.PlayerRemoving,function(player)
 destroyESP(player)
 local d=Runtime.Direction[player]
 if d then pcall(function()d:Destroy()end)end
 Runtime.Direction[player]=nil
 Runtime.CharacterCache[player]=nil
end)

local function Shutdown()
 if Runtime.Shutdown then return end
 Runtime.Shutdown=true
 saveSettings()
 for _,c in ipairs(Runtime.Connections)do pcall(function()c:Disconnect()end)end
 for player in pairs(Runtime.ESP)do destroyESP(player)end
 for _,d in pairs(Runtime.Direction)do pcall(function()d:Destroy()end)end
 if GUI then pcall(function()GUI:Destroy()end)end
 if rawget(_G,"ChickenVisual")and _G.ChickenVisual.Provider=="OVERKILL"then
  _G.ChickenVisual=nil
 end
end

connect(shutdownButton.Activated,Shutdown)

_G.ChickenVisual={
 Provider="OVERKILL",
 ProviderVersion="V2.1 Core Fix",
 Settings=Settings,
 Runtime=Runtime,
 Shutdown=Shutdown,
 OverkillStatus=function()
  return{
   Provider="OVERKILL",
   Version="V2.1 Core Fix",
   CombatActive=Runtime.CombatActive,
   Weapon=getWeaponName(LocalPlayer),
   AimTarget=Runtime.CurrentTarget and Runtime.CurrentTarget.Player.Name or nil,
   ESPCount=(function()local n=0 for _ in pairs(Runtime.ESP)do n=n+1 end return n end)(),
   CharacterMode="Player.Character + Workspace ownership fallback",
   FireMode="native mouse input + Camera fallback",
   InputMode=Runtime.LastInputMode,
   TeamModeActive=Runtime.TeamModeActive,
   EntityIndexAge=os.clock()-(Runtime.EntityIndexAt or 0),
  }
 end,
}

Runtime.Status="OVERKILL Provider V2.1 Core Fix loaded"

local function detectBloxStrike()
local assets=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
local libraries=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Libraries")
return assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Weapons")and libraries and libraries:FindFirstChild("Skins")
end

local function detectRivals()
local modules=ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
local scripts=LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
local controllers=scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
return modules and modules:FindFirstChild("CosmeticLibrary")and controllers and controllers:FindFirstChild("PlayerDataController")
end

local function detectOverkill()
if game.PlaceId==124842176624983 then return true end
return string.find(string.upper(tostring(game.Name or"")),"OVERKILL",1,true)~=nil
end

local function stopCurrent()
local cv=rawget(_G,"ChickenVisual")
if type(cv)=="table"and type(cv.Shutdown)=="function"then pcall(cv.Shutdown)end
local rv=G.RIVALS_CosmeticsUnlock_V3_State
if type(rv)=="table"and type(rv.Restore)=="function"then pcall(rv.Restore)end
end

local function runSource(source,label)
if type(loadstring)~="function"then return false,"loadstring unavailable"end
local fn,err=loadstring(source,"ChickenVisualUI_"..tostring(label or"Provider"))
if type(fn)~="function"then
 return false,"編譯失敗｜"..tostring(err)
end
local ok,result=pcall(fn)
if not ok then
 return false,"執行失敗｜"..tostring(result)
end
return true
end

local s=Instance.new("UIStroke",b)
s.Thickness=1.3 s.Transparency=.3 s.Color=detected and Color3.fromRGB(70,190,205)or Color3.fromRGB(72,78,92)
local t=Instance.new("TextLabel",b)
t.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,18) t.Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,30) t.BackgroundTransparency=1 t.Text=name t.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(242,246,252) t.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left t.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold t.TextSize=20
local badge=Instance.new("TextLabel",b)
badge.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,56) badge.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(125,24) badge.BackgroundColor3=detected and Color3.fromRGB(27,83,91)or Color3.fromRGB(52,55,65) badge.BorderSizePixel=0 badge.Text=detected and"目前遊戲已偵測"or"目前未偵測" badge.TextColor3=detected and Color3.fromRGB(152,242,248)or Color3.fromRGB(160,165,178) badge.Font=Enum.Font.GothamSemibold badge.TextSize=10
Instance.new("UICorner",badge).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
local d=Instance.new("TextLabel",b)
d.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(18,94) d.Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,72) d.BackgroundTransparency=1 d.Text=desc d.TextWrapped=true d.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(174,183,199) d.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left d.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top d.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham d.TextSize=12
local go=Instance.new("TextLabel",b)
go.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,1) go.Position=UDim2.new(0,18,1,-16) go.Size=UDim2.new(1,-36,0,28) go.BackgroundTransparency=1 go.Text="載入 "..name.."  →" go.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(92,224,233) go.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left go.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold go.TextSize=13
b.Activated:Connect(function()
status.Text="正在載入 "..name.."…"
stopCurrent()
local ok,err=runSource(source,name)
if ok then

else

 status.Text="載入 "..name.." 失敗：\n"..msg
 warn("[CVU MultiGame Hub]",name,msg)
end
end)
end
